title: CoDimRecon: Agentic Reconstruction of Sim-Ready 3D Scenes with Deformable Curves, Surfaces, and Volumes
summary: Reconstructing simulation-ready 3D scenes from real-world observations enables robotics, gaming, and immersive applications, yet existing methods largely assume rigid objects. This leaves an important gap for deformables, whose simulation-ready geometry depends on dimensionality (curves, surfaces, or volumes) and whose behavior may require models beyond elasticity. We present CoDimRecon, an agentic framework that reconstructs editable scenes containing rigid, articulated, and deformable objects from multi-view RGB observations. Scene-level geometric priors ground scale and layout, while object-level generated meshes guide the agent toward detailed, compact geometry; articulated rigid objects are decomposed into movable parts with explicit joints. For deformables, category-wise agent sessions reconstruct curves as centerlines with radii, surfaces as manifold shells with thickness, and volumes as watertight solids for volumetric meshing. Reusable simulator skills initialize compatible physical models and parameters, while agent-guided behavioral tests expose mismatches and trigger targeted revisions of motion, geometry, numerics, or material modeling. On evaluated Replica and ScanNet++ scenes, CoDimRecon achieves competitive compositional reconstruction accuracy while additionally producing deformable assets for rod, shell, and solid simulation. We further demonstrate robot interactions across all three representations, including a controlled paper-folding case in which behavioral testing motivates plastic bending.

AI.tldr: CoDimRecon 是一个智能体框架，可从多视角 RGB 观测重建包含刚性、铰接和可变形物体的可编辑、可仿真 3D 场景。
AI.motivation: 现有仿真就绪场景重建方法主要假设物体为刚性，难以处理可变形物体；可变形物体的仿真几何取决于维度（曲线、曲面或体积），且行为建模可能超出弹性模型。
AI.method: 提出 CoDimRecon：利用场景级几何先验确定尺度与布局，物体级生成网格引导智能体获得细节紧凑几何；将铰接刚体分解为可动部件与显式关节；对可变形物体按类别重建曲线为中心线加半径、曲面为带厚度流形壳、体积为水密实体；复用仿真器技能初始化物理模型与参数，并通过智能体引导的行为测试发现不匹配并修正运动、几何、数值或材料建模。
AI.result: 在 Replica 和 ScanNet++ 场景上取得有竞争力的组合重建精度，并额外生成用于杆、壳和实体仿真的可变形资产；展示了三类表示下的机器人交互，包括受控折纸案例中行为测试促使采用塑性弯曲。
AI.conclusion: CoDimRecon 能重建可编辑且仿真就绪的场景，统一覆盖刚性、铰接和可变形物体，并通过行为测试支持更准确的物理建模与机器人交互应用。

title: Design and Validation of an Antagonistic Tendon-Driven Dexterous Robotic Hand with Bidirectional Operation
summary: Dexterous robotic hands typically reproduce human hand morphology but inherit its one-sided grasping workspace, requiring wrist or arm reorientation to grasp from the opposite side. Existing reversible hands generally rely on non-anthropomorphic, soft, or task-specific finger arrangements, whereas conventional five-digit anthropomorphic hands remain designed primarily for palmar-side grasping. This paper presents an anthropomorphic, human-scale (200 mm length), lightweight (220 g), 3D-printed, 17-DoF robotic hand built on a bidirectional antagonistic tendon-routing mechanism, in which flexion/extension (except the coupled joint) and abduction/adduction at joints are actively driven without passive return springs. The proposed routing mechanism allows all degrees of freedom to cross their neutral configuration and form grasp closures on either the palmar or dorsal side. Experimental evaluation demonstrates an average motor-to-joint transmission error of 3.0%, an average joint transmission bandwidth of 13.2 Hz, a maximum fingertip force of 29 N, and a positioning repeatability up to 0.15 mm. The hand further achieves a Kapandji score of 8, successfully performs all 33 GRASP Taxonomy grasp types, and performs palmar- and dorsal-side grasping tasks, validating bidirectional operation in a compact, human-scale platform.

AI.tldr: 提出一种拟人化、人体尺度、轻量、3D打印、17自由度的机器人手，采用双向拮抗肌腱布线机制，实现手掌和手背两侧抓取。
AI.motivation: 现有灵巧手虽模仿人手但只有单侧抓取工作空间，需腕/臂重定向才能对侧抓取；现有可反转手多为非拟人化、软体或任务特定设计，传统五指拟人手主要面向手掌侧抓取。
AI.method: 设计基于双向拮抗肌腱布线机制的拟人化手，17自由度，无被动回位弹簧，主动驱动屈伸（除耦合关节）和外展内收。所有自由度可越过中立位置，形成手掌或手背侧抓取闭合。实验评估传动误差、带宽、指尖力、定位重复精度，并进行Kapandji评分、GRASP分类抓取和双侧抓取任务。
AI.result: 平均电机-关节传动误差3.0%，平均关节传动带宽13.2 Hz，最大指尖力29 N，定位重复精度达0.15 mm。Kapandji评分8，成功执行全部33种GRASP分类抓取类型，并完成手掌和手背侧抓取任务。
AI.conclusion: 验证了在紧凑、人体尺度平台上实现双向操作的可行性。

title: From Lexical Baselines to Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation: Structured Skill and Responsibility-Level Extraction with the SFIA Framework
summary: Automated skill extraction underpins workforce planning, yet most systems represent skills as flat labels with no notion of the responsibility level at which a skill is practiced. The Skills Framework for the Information Age (SFIA) captures exactly this dimension, defining 147 professional skills across seven responsibility levels, but no automated LLM-based extraction targeting SFIA has been reported. We formalize the task as structured prediction of (skill, level) pairs from free text and ask three questions: how accurately can text be mapped onto SFIA's closed vocabulary, which strategies reliably predict the level alongside the skill, and do agentic designs improve on simpler retrieval and prompting? We evaluate five strategies (a lexical baseline, dense retrieval with LLM reranking, a zero-shot schema-constrained LLM, single-agent agentic RAG, and a three-agent retriever--matcher--verifier crew) against expert-mapped European ICT role profiles, all drawing on an SFIA~9 corpus built by a fully automated agentic pipeline that we release. Retrieval-based matching identifies the most skills while generative strategies are markedly more precise; only strategies assigning the level as an explicit decision predict it reliably, with similarity-based selection more than twice as inaccurate; and the crew doubles latency without improving accuracy, so added agent roles do not automatically benefit closed-taxonomy matching. These results provide the first reproducible baseline for structured, level-aware skill extraction against SFIA.

AI.tldr: 论文形式化从自由文本中抽取SFIA技能及其责任等级的（技能，等级）对任务，比较五种抽取策略，发布全自动构建的SFIA 9语料，并给出首个可复现的等级感知技能抽取基线。
AI.motivation: 自动化技能抽取支撑劳动力规划，但多数系统将技能表示为无责任等级概念的扁平标签；SFIA定义了147项技能和7个责任等级，然而尚无基于LLM并面向SFIA的自动抽取系统。
AI.method: 将任务定义为从自由文本结构化预测（技能，等级）对；评估五种策略：词法基线、密集检索加LLM重排、零样本模式约束LLM、单智能体agentic RAG、三智能体检索—匹配—验证团队；以专家标注的欧洲ICT角色画像评测，并基于全自动智能体流水线构建和发布SFIA 9语料。
AI.result: 检索式匹配识别技能最多，生成式策略精确率更高；只有将等级作为显式决策的策略能可靠预测等级，基于相似度的选择错误率高一倍以上；三智能体团队使延迟翻倍但未提升准确率，增加智能体角色未必有利于封闭分类体系匹配。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为面向SFIA的结构化、等级感知技能抽取提供首个可复现基线，并表明责任等级需显式建模，复杂智能体架构不必然带来性能增益。

title: Environment Steering: Using Data Flow Control to Improve Agent Utility and Safety
summary: LLM agents can make unsafe tool calls even when instructed to behave safely. Existing defenses constrain agents before execution, modify tool inputs/outputs, or rely on LLM judges; these approaches may depend on model behavior or block unsafe actions without helping the agent recover. We argue that the execution environment should instead enforce safety as the agent runs and steer it toward safe alternatives when violations occur---we call this Environment Steering. We implement this by modeling the agent and harness execution state as database tables, track the record-level data flows, and check these data flows against declarative policies during runtime. When violations are detected, policy- and context-specific feedback steers the agent toward safe trajectories. On AgentDyn, this enables the agent to improve task success rate over no-defense while achieving 0% attack success rate.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Environment Steering，通过在运行时将 agent 与 harness 执行状态建模为数据库表并跟踪记录级数据流，对照声明式策略检查，违规时给出策略与上下文相关反馈，引导 agent 走向安全轨迹。
AI.motivation: LLM agents 即使被要求安全行为也可能进行不安全工具调用。现有防御（执行前约束、修改工具输入输出、LLM judge）可能依赖模型行为，或只是阻止不安全动作而不帮助 agent 恢复。
AI.method: 将 agent 和 harness 执行状态建模为数据库表，跟踪记录级数据流，并在运行时依据声明式策略检查这些数据流；检测到违规后，使用策略和上下文特定反馈来引导 agent 选择安全替代方案。
AI.result: 在 AgentDyn 上，相比无防御，该方法提升了任务成功率，同时达到 0% 攻击成功率。
AI.conclusion: 执行环境应在 agent 运行时强制安全，并在违规时引导其走向安全替代方案；Environment Steering 能兼顾任务成功与安全。

title: VoxelSage: Tool-Augmented 3D CT Analysis and Simulator-Shielded Sequential Resection Planning for Liver Tumors
comment: 21 pages, 10 figures. Technical report. Code at https://github.com/ZJUMAI/VoxelSage
summary: Preoperative liver-tumor assessment requires segmentation, physical-space measurement, visual evidence, and resection planning from the same three-dimensional CT volume. Existing tools often handle these steps separately, while language models cannot reliably compute physical measurements from CT. To provide an integrated workflow, we present VoxelSage, a multi-modal system for two- and three-dimensional visualization, liver-tumor analysis, and preoperative resection planning. Its dual-port architecture separates language-model orchestration from image computation: Port A interprets requests and selects skills, while Port B applies them to CT volumes and segmentation masks and returns structured results. Keeping physical measurements in Port B prevents the LLM from computing them directly and reduces the risk of fabricated numerical results. Eight built-in skills support quantitative analysis, visual evidence generation, three-dimensional reconstruction, segmentation refinement, and sequential resection planning; user-defined skills can extend these functions. For sequence planning, a behavior-cloned neural ranker orders candidate resection targets, while a simulator-based shield checks them against predefined constraints. Across 256 unseen simulator scenes, this approach reduced mean simulated time from 34.274 to 33.388 min (0.886 min, 2.59%) and mean simulated blood loss from 300.847 to 183.852 mL (116.995 mL, 38.89%) relative to a deterministic baseline. These results demonstrate system integration and simulator-level performance, not clinical efficacy or safety. The public implementation is available at https://github.com/ZJUMAI/VoxelSage.

AI.tldr: VoxelSage 是一个用于肝脏肿瘤术前评估与切除规划的多模态系统，通过双端口架构将语言模型编排与图像计算分离，支持二维/三维可视化、定量分析、分割优化和序贯切除规划。
AI.motivation: 术前肝脏肿瘤评估需要从同一三维 CT 体积中完成分割、物理空间测量、视觉证据和切除规划，但现有工具通常将这些步骤分开处理，且语言模型无法可靠地从 CT 中计算物理测量值。
AI.method: 系统采用双端口架构：Port A 由语言模型解释请求并选择技能，Port B 将技能应用于 CT 体积和分割掩膜并返回结构化结果，从而避免 LLM 直接计算物理测量。内置八项技能，涵盖定量分析、视觉证据生成、三维重建、分割优化和序贯切除规划；用户可自定义技能扩展。序贯规划中，行为克隆神经排序器对候选切除目标排序，基于模拟器的 shield 按预定义约束检查。
AI.result: 在 256 个未见过的模拟器场景中，与确定性基线相比，平均模拟时间从 34.274 分钟降至 33.388 分钟（减少 0.886 分钟，2.59%），平均模拟出血量从 300.847 mL 降至 183.852 mL（减少 116.995 mL，38.89%）。结果仅证明系统集成和模拟器层面性能，不代表临床有效性或安全性。
AI.conclusion: VoxelSage 提供了集成的肝脏肿瘤分析与切除规划工作流，双端口设计可减少 LLM 直接计算物理测量带来的数值捏造风险，并在模拟器场景中改善了规划指标；但尚需临床验证。

title: Expediting AC Contingency Analysis using a Basecase Machine Learning Model
summary: Grid planning and operation under increasingly variable operating conditions require fast and accurate AC power flow (AC-PF) contingency analysis for numerous line outages. While ML models can accelerate these computations, existing approaches often require either training separate models for different contingencies or a single model using data from multiple topologies. Both approaches incur substantial offline data generation and training costs. To address this gap, this work proposes a fixed-point framework that reuses a single ML model trained exclusively on basecase topology data to predict post-contingency AC-PF states under any non-critical single-line outage. We analyze the proposed method's convergence under the DC model approximation and derive its convergence rate in terms of network parameters. As a side result, we show that power transfer distribution factors (PTDFs) for non-critical lines have magnitudes less than one. We further characterize the ML training region to accommodate PF specifications encountered during fixed-point iterations and derive bounds on ML prediction errors for post-contingency state estimates. Numerical tests on a 6,717-bus synthetic Texas system demonstrate convergence across all non-critical single-line outages, with prediction errors remaining close to those of basecase. The proposed framework offers a favorable tradeoff between the speed of DC solvers and Newton-Raphson accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出一种定点框架，仅用基态拓扑数据训练单个机器学习模型，即可预测任意非关键单线故障后的AC潮流状态，并在6717节点德州合成系统上验证了其收敛性与精度。
AI.motivation: 电网规划与运行条件日益多变，需要对大量线路故障进行快速准确的AC潮流预想事故分析。现有人工智能方法通常要为不同故障分别训练模型，或使用多拓扑数据训练单一模型，导致高昂的离线数据生成与训练成本。
AI.method: 设计定点迭代框架，复用仅在基态拓扑上训练的单一ML模型来估计故障后AC-PF状态；在DC近似下分析收敛性并推导与网络参数相关的收敛率；刻画ML训练区域以适应定点迭代中的潮流规格，并推导故障后状态估计的ML预测误差界；在6717节点合成德州系统上进行数值测试。
AI.result: 在所有非关键单线故障下均实现收敛，预测误差与基态情况接近；作为附带结果，证明非关键线路的PTDF幅值小于1；框架在DC求解器速度与Newton-Raphson精度之间取得良好折中。
AI.conclusion: 该定点框架无需为各故障单独训练模型或多拓扑数据，即可实现快速且较准确的AC潮流预想事故分析，降低离线成本，并兼顾DC求解速度与Newton-Raphson精度。

title: When Successful Memories Mislead Embodied Agents:Memory Adaption For Task-Conditioned Execution
summary: Experience reuse can reduce repeated exploration in embodied agents, but a trajectory that succeeded previously may be unsuitable for the current execution context. Existing memory systems pri marily optimize construction and retrieval; semantic relevance and historical success therefore remain insufficient when retrieved ex perience contains incompatible actions or an inappropriate level of structure. We introduce Memory Adaptation for Task-Conditioned Execution (MATE), a deterministic post-retrieval procedure that converts trajectories into execution-oriented memory. MATE re moves obsolete control context, extracts condition-action-effect transitions, applies verified action normalization, selects a task dependent representation, and serializes the result under a fixed budget without additional LLM inference. On 134 ALFWorld tasks, MATE achieves task success rates of 81.3% and 93.3% with Qwen2.5-14B and 72B while using approximately one-tenth of the tokens required by raw trajectories. Controlled comparisons show that verified action normalization is the principal mechanism by which MATE restores the utility of retrieved experience, support ing memory adaptation as a distinct stage between retrieval and embodied execution.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MATE（Memory Adaptation for Task-Conditioned Execution），一种确定性的检索后记忆适配方法，将成功轨迹转换为面向执行的任务条件化记忆，从而减少具身智能体中的重复探索。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆系统主要优化构建与检索，但语义相关性和历史成功经验不足以保证检索到的经验适用于当前执行上下文；旧轨迹可能包含不兼容动作或结构不当，导致经验复用失败。
AI.method: MATE在检索后执行确定性过程：移除过时控制上下文、提取条件-动作-效果三元组、应用经过验证的动作归一化、选择任务相关表示，并在固定预算内序列化结果，且不额外调用LLM推理。
AI.result: 在134个ALFWorld任务上，MATE使用Qwen2.5-14B和72B分别达到81.3%和93.3%的任务成功率，同时仅使用原始轨迹约十分之一的token；对照实验表明，经过验证的动作归一化是恢复检索经验效用的主要机制。
AI.conclusion: 记忆适配应被视为检索与具身执行之间的独立阶段；MATE通过确定性后处理有效提升了经验复用效率与成功率。

title: AerialDojo-200K: A Large-Scale Benchmark Suite for Open-World Aerial Object-Goal Search
summary: Open-world aerial object-goal search is a foundational yet challenging task, requiring aerial agents to autonomously explore large-scale, unstructured three-dimensional environments and reach target objects specified by semantic descriptions or reference images, rather than following route-specific instructions. However, research in this task remains at a nascent stage and relies on small, environment-specific benchmarks with heterogeneous action spaces and data formats. These limitations hinder large-scale training and cross-benchmark evaluation, constraining the scalability and generalizability of aerial agents. To address this problem, we propose AerialDojo-200K, a large-scale benchmark suite for open-world aerial object-goal search, with 3 times as many scenes and 18.7 times as many task instances as the largest existing benchmark for this task. Specifically, we construct 42 simulation scenes spanning four scene families and 21 scene types, including 18 urban, 12 natural, six infrastructure, and six disaster scenes. To ensure data quality, 12 annotators spent two months manually annotating 109 landmarks, 2099 target objects, and 2099 object anchors across these scenes. We further construct 205,732 task instances, comprising over 100K semantic-goal and over 100K image-goal instances across Base, Standard, and Long-Horizon settings. Each task instance includes a collision-free reference trajectory and corresponding multi-view video recordings. We also develop a unified evaluation framework with a scene partition comprising 21 in-distribution scenes and 21 out-of-distribution scenes. Finally, our evaluation of five open-source and four closed-source multimodal large language models reveals that there is still a long way to go toward achieving general-purpose aerial agents. All can be found at https://fengtt42.github.io/AerialDojo/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出AerialDojo-200K，一个面向开放世界空中目标搜索的大规模基准套件，包含42个仿真场景和205,732个任务实例，规模显著超过现有基准，并配有统一评估框架。
AI.motivation: 开放世界空中目标搜索仍处于早期阶段，现有研究依赖小规模、特定环境的基准，且动作空间和数据格式异构，阻碍大规模训练与跨基准评估，限制空中智能体的可扩展性和泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建42个仿真场景，涵盖4类场景家族和21种场景类型（18城市、12自然、6基础设施、6灾害）；12名标注员耗时两个月标注109个地标、2099个目标物体和2099个物体锚点；生成205,732个任务实例，包括超10万语义目标实例和超10万图像目标实例，覆盖Base、Standard和Long-Horizon设置；每个实例包含无碰撞参考轨迹和多视角视频；提出统一评估框架，划分21个分布内和21个分布外场景；评测5个开源和4个闭源多模态大语言模型。
AI.result: AerialDojo-200K的场景数是最大现有基准的3倍，任务实例数是其18.7倍；对9个多模态大语言模型的评测显示，当前模型距离通用空中智能体仍有较大差距。
AI.conclusion: AerialDojo-200K为开放世界空中目标搜索提供了大规模、高质量、可统一评估的基准，但实现通用空中智能体仍需进一步研究。

title: Beyond Symmetric Agents: Cognitive Diversity and Multi-Agent Debate in Small Language Models
summary: Multi-agent debate (MAD) reportedly improves reasoning and factuality over single-model inference, but prior work treats agents as symmetric peers, leaving open what drives the gains. We test the hypothesis that cognitive diversity among agents is the driver, in the setting where the question is still measurable: small open-weight models with benchmark headroom. Across 23 models from eleven vendor families, five tasks, and 5,500+ debate and control runs, we vary diversity along three axes - personas, sampling temperature, and model identity - pairing every debate configuration with a generation-budget-matched majority-vote control. The hypothesis is rejected on every axis. Debate beats single-agent inference (3--7 points where tasks have headroom) but at matched budget conditions it ties or even loses to self-consistency sampling at 1.6$\times$ the wall-clock and 3.4$\times$ the token cost. Persona prompting reduces accuracy and a dose-response experiment over each model's full combinatorial persona space shows the cost is a persona tax, not a diversity tax: redundant personas hurt most, while maximally-diverse teams recover part of the loss. Furthermore, mixed-model teams lose to majority votes over their own rosters, with accuracy tracking member capability rather than heterogeneity, and nearly all of debate's benefit comes from the first exchange of answers. We further identify a pervasive measurement hazard in which debate transcripts silently overflow serving context windows, whose correction alone moves our debate-versus-sampling comparison from $-1.8$ points to parity. Our results recast reported MAD gains as an ensemble-sampling effect and provide the budget-matched, contamination-checked baseline bar that future debate mechanisms should be required to clear.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验多智能体辩论(MAD)的增益是否源于智能体间的认知多样性。在23个模型、5个任务、5500+次运行中，匹配生成预算与多数投票对照，发现多样性假设在所有维度上被拒绝，MAD的收益实为集成采样效应。
AI.motivation: 先前工作将MAD智能体视为对称同伴，未明确其增益来源。作者假设认知多样性是驱动因素，并在小规模开放权重模型（仍有基准提升空间）的可测量设定下进行检验。
AI.method: 使用来自11个厂商家族的23个模型，5个任务，超过5500次辩论与控制运行。沿三个维度改变多样性：角色提示、采样温度、模型身份。每个辩论配置都与生成预算匹配的多数投票控制配对。另进行全组合角色空间剂量反应实验，并检查上下文窗口溢出等测量风险。
AI.result: 多样性假设在每个维度上均被拒绝。辩论优于单智能体推理（有提升空间时高3-7分），但在预算匹配下与自一致性采样持平甚至更差，耗时1.6倍、token成本3.4倍。角色提示降低准确率，存在“角色税”而非“多样性税”：冗余角色伤害最大，最大多样性团队可部分恢复。混合模型团队输给其自身名册的多数投票，准确率随成员能力而非异质性变化。几乎所有辩论收益来自第一轮答案交换。此外发现辩论记录静默溢出服务上下文窗口的测量危害，校正后辩论-采样比较从-1.8分变为持平。
AI.conclusion: 报告的MAD增益应重新解释为集成采样效应。研究提供了预算匹配、污染检查的基线标准，未来辩论机制必须超越该基线。

title: Invariance is Compositional for Continuous-time Systems: From Sleekness to Lebesgue Density
summary: This work establishes the first bidirectional compositional invariance result: robust forward invariance of a global Cartesian product set is shown to be equivalent to robust forward invariance of each local subsystem under coupling inputs from its neighbors. To facilitate this, we introduce the notion of tangential Lebesgue-density, a new condition that is weaker than classical sleekness but sufficient to ensure that the product of individual tangent cones equals the tangent cone of the product set. This equivalence reduces the curse of dimensionality by allowing the verification of a high-dimensional global system to be decomposed into a series of local sub-checks. The framework's scalability is demonstrated through a DC microgrid numerical example, confirming that the verification complexity grows only linearly with the number of subsystems.

AI.tldr: 该工作首次建立双向组合不变性结果：全局笛卡尔积集合的鲁棒前向不变性等价于各局部子系统在邻居耦合输入下的鲁棒前向不变性。
AI.motivation: 高维组合系统的鲁棒前向不变性验证通常面临维数灾难，亟需一种可分解、可扩展的验证方法。
AI.method: 引入 tangential Lebesgue-density 概念，该条件弱于经典 sleekness，但足以保证个体切锥的乘积等于乘积集合的切锥；据此将全局高维系统验证分解为一系列局部子检查，并通过 DC 微电网数值算例验证可扩展性。
AI.result: 证明了全局鲁棒前向不变性与局部子系统鲁棒前向不变性的等价性，从而降低维数灾难；DC 微电网算例表明验证复杂度仅随子系统数量线性增长。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了组合系统的分解式鲁棒不变性验证，使高维全局验证可转化为局部子验证，并具备随子系统数量线性增长的可扩展性。

title: ATLAS: Aligned Transport of Latent Structure for Reliable World Model Planning
summary: Latent world models rely on representation geometry for planning, yet regularizing the latent marginal alone does not determine the state-to-state relationships used for action selection. We show that this can cause planning-relevant novelty structure to be weakened as representations are transformed into the final latent used by the planner. We introduce Aligned Transport of Latent Structure (ATLAS), a training objective that explicitly preserves relational geometry while calibrating the global latent distribution. ATLAS transfers normalized pairwise structure from an informative encoder representation to the planning latent and uses Wasserstein embedding matching (WEMReg) to calibrate its marginal through one-dimensional Wasserstein-2 transport. Our analysis shows that relational preservation and marginal calibration impose non-redundant constraints, and connects finite-candidate planning stability to relational distortion, latent-scale mismatch, and prediction error. Instantiated in LeWM, ATLAS improves mean goal-reaching success across PushT, TwoRoom, and OGBench-Cube on both lower- and higher-novelty evaluation subsets, with the largest gain on higher-novelty TwoRoom episodes. Representation and rollout diagnostics further show stronger novelty-related structure in the planning latent, improved marginal calibration, and lower multi-step prediction error. Together, these results highlight preservation of planning-relevant latent geometry as an important ingredient for reliable world-model planning. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/atlas-world-model-72C4/.

AI.tldr: 论文指出仅正则化潜在边缘分布不足以确定规划所需的状态间关系，会导致规划相关的新颖性结构被削弱；提出 ATLAS 训练目标，同时保留关系几何并校准全局潜在分布，在多个世界模型规划任务上取得更优表现。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型依赖表示几何进行规划，但仅约束潜在边缘分布无法决定动作选择所需的状态间关系，可能使规划相关的新颖性结构在表示变换为规划器最终潜变量时被削弱。
AI.method: 提出 Aligned Transport of Latent Structure (ATLAS)：将来自信息量更大的编码器表示的归一化成对结构迁移到规划潜变量以保留关系几何，并使用 Wasserstein 嵌入匹配 (WEMReg) 通过一维 Wasserstein-2 传输校准其边缘分布；在 LeWM 中实例化。
AI.result: 在 PushT、TwoRoom 和 OGBench-Cube 上，ATLAS 在低新颖性与高新颖性评估子集上均提升平均目标达成成功率，其中 TwoRoom 高新颖性回合提升最大；表示与 rollout 诊断显示规划潜变量中新颖相关结构更强、边缘校准更好、多步预测误差更低。
AI.conclusion: 保留规划相关的潜在几何结构是可靠世界模型规划的重要要素。

title: Representational Simplicity and Circuit Size Dissociate in a Threshold-Dependent Way: A Controlled Test via Adversarial Training
comment: Under review at ICLR 2027. 21 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables
summary: Sparse-autoencoder decomposability and concentrated feature attribution are increasingly treated as evidence that a model's computation is easier to reverse-engineer. Whether this representational and attributional cleanliness actually predicts a smaller or more tractable causal circuit remains an open question. We test this directly using adversarial training as a controlled instrument: it reliably reshapes internal representations, but this alone does not constitute a test of circuit size. We investigate this question through reverse-engineering complexity: the causal structure required to recover a model's behavior at a fixed level of faithfulness. To our knowledge, this is the first controlled empirical test of whether representational or attributional simplicity translates into causal simplicity at the circuit level. Starting from the same pretrained GPT-2 Small checkpoint, we apply matched standard and adversarial continual training, requiring both conditions to retain competence on indirect object identification and pass independent robustness verification before comparing mechanisms. We then compare the models along three complementary axes: sparse-autoencoder decomposability, SAE feature engagement in task attribution, and the size of faithful circuits recovered from the raw computational graph. The robust model is more SAE-decomposable and engages fewer SAE features in task attribution. Circuit size is regime-dependent: on competence-matched IOI, standard leads or ties below 85% faithfulness, but robust needs substantially fewer edges at high faithfulness (90%, 95%), a pattern established on the primary pair while representational trends generalize across a seven-point sweep and a second corpus.

AI.tldr: 论文首次受控检验稀疏自编码器可分解性与集中式特征归因是否意味着更小、更易逆向的因果电路。以对抗训练为工具，在保持IOI任务能力的前提下比较标准与鲁棒GPT-2 Small，发现表示/归因简洁性并不简单等同于电路简洁性，电路大小依赖忠实度阈值。
AI.motivation: 稀疏自编码器可分解性和集中式特征归因常被视为模型计算更易逆向工程的证据，但它们是否真的预示更小或更可处理的因果电路尚不清楚。
AI.method: 从同一预训练GPT-2 Small检查点出发，进行匹配的标准与对抗持续训练，要求两者均保持间接宾语识别能力并通过独立鲁棒性验证；随后沿三条轴线比较：SAE可分解性、任务归因中的SAE特征参与度、从原始计算图中恢复的忠实电路大小。
AI.result: 鲁棒模型具有更高SAE可分解性，并在任务归因中激活更少SAE特征。电路大小呈区间依赖：在能力匹配的IOI任务上，低于85%忠实度时标准模型领先或持平；但在90%、95%高忠实度下，鲁棒模型所需边数显著更少。该模式在主模型对上成立，表示趋势在七点扫描和第二语料上可泛化。
AI.conclusion: 表示或归因层面的简洁性并不均匀地转化为因果电路层面的简洁性；两者关系取决于忠实度区间。高忠实度下鲁棒模型电路更小，说明更简洁的表示可能仅在特定条件下对应更小的忠实因果电路。

title: DORA: Divergence-Oriented Data-Relay Algorithm for Partially Connected Robot Teams
summary: Teams of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) deployed for search and monitoring missions frequently operate as partially connected networks, forcing each robot to trade off exploring the environment against relaying information to teammates. This tradeoff is especially acute when robots are semantically heterogeneous: an observation that appears uninformative to the robot that made it may be critical to a teammate with complementary detection capabilities. In this work, we formalize this setting as the heterogeneous mission-aware coverage (HMAC) problem, which couples complete multi-robot coverage of an area with capability-constrained mission-relevant target (MRT) discovery under intermittent communication. We then present DORA, a divergence-oriented data-relay algorithm that drives communication by the value of information to the team rather than by discovery alone. DORA quantifies the mission-relevant divergence between a robot's current information state and its estimate of each teammate's knowledge, capturing mission relevance, discovery novelty, sensor uncertainty, and the age of information. We evaluate DORA in simulation across four environments with differing object densities and spatial structure, and validate it on a physical UAV platform. Our results show that DORA improves MRT resolution delay by up to 74.8% over traditional time-based communication scheduling methods.

AI.tldr: 论文研究部分连通的多无人机团队在搜索监视中的探索-通信权衡，形式化异质任务感知覆盖(HMAC)问题，并提出以信息价值驱动通信的DORA数据中继算法。
AI.motivation: UAV团队常处于部分连通网络，机器人需在探索环境与向队友中继信息间权衡；当机器人语义异质时，对自身无用的观测可能对具有互补探测能力的队友至关重要。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为HMAC，耦合间歇通信下完整多机器人区域覆盖与能力受限的任务相关目标(MRT)发现；提出DORA算法，量化机器人当前信息状态与对队友知识估计间的任务相关分歧，涵盖任务相关性、发现新颖性、传感器不确定性与信息年龄。在四种不同物体密度和空间结构环境中仿真，并在实体UAV平台验证。
AI.result: DORA相比传统基于时间的通信调度方法，将MRT解算延迟最多改善74.8%。
AI.conclusion: 以信息对团队的价值而非仅发现本身来驱动通信，可显著提升异质UAV团队在间歇通信下任务相关目标的发现效率。

title: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Generate and Detect Multimodal Social Media Fake News?
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures. Accepted for publication in the Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: The rapid advancement of generative AI raises concerns about the misuse of Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) for large-scale disinformation campaigns on social media. Despite existing research on textual disinformation, a fundamental question remains unanswered: can MLLMs be exploited to fabricate realistic multimodal fake news, and can they reliably detect it? We introduce a multi-agent framework in which a story agent, an image agent, and a critic agent collaborate to produce fake social media posts that plausibly counter true news. We apply the framework to generate over 9,000 paired multimodal news posts across science, health, and entertainment domains, and benchmark 16 open- and closed-source MLLMs for automated detection. We find that most models fall substantially short of human-level accuracy and fail critically on identifying image authenticity. Our research provides a foundation for developing robust defenses against social media fake news. Code and data are available at https: //github.com/xiuzhenzhang/Multimodal.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究多模态大模型是否可被用于生成逼真的多模态假新闻，以及它们能否可靠检测此类假新闻。作者提出多智能体框架生成超过9000条跨领域多模态假新闻，并评测16个开源与闭源模型。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI快速发展引发对多模态大模型被滥用于社交媒体大规模虚假信息传播的担忧。现有研究多聚焦文本虚假信息，但仍不清楚MLLM能否被利用来伪造真实感强的多模态假新闻，以及能否可靠检测。
AI.method: 提出一个多智能体框架，由故事智能体、图像智能体和评论智能体协作，生成看似合理且与真实新闻相对抗的虚假社交媒体帖子。在科学、健康和娱乐领域生成超过9000条成对的多模态新闻帖子，并对16个开源和闭源MLLM进行自动检测基准测试。
AI.result: 大多数模型在检测准确率上明显低于人类水平，并且在识别图像真实性方面存在严重失败。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为开发针对社交媒体假新闻的稳健防御措施提供了基础，代码和数据已公开。

title: Attack-Resiliency Analytics for Wide-Area Control Systems in Smart Grids
summary: Wide-area monitoring, protection, and control (WAMPAC) systems damp inter-area oscillations in large interconnected grids, but their reliance on synchronized PMU measurements carried over wide-area networks exposes them to false data injection (FDI) attacks. This paper presents an attack-resiliency analytics framework that formally models the coupled dynamics of the wide-area damping loop, automatic generation control, and the governor and excitation systems, and formulates the optimal stealthy FDI attack as a mixed-integer linear program (MILP). The anomaly detection model (ADM) enters as a replaceable constraint set: either a static bad-data detection (BDD) rule or a boundary learned from benign operation calibrated to a common false-positive rate. On the IEEE 39 and 118 bus systems, with reference dynamics validated on an OPAL-RT hardware-in-the-loop testbed, the optimal attack with wide-area access attains 3.3 and 8.1 times the benign objective and reaches a 0.5Hz frequency excursion more than twice as fast as an attack confined to automatic generation control. Learned boundaries reduce the attack objective by 15.5 55.0% and prevent over-frequency relay trips in all configurations, with feasible stealthy attacks remaining in every case, and residual risk tracks the width of the learned boundary rather than the detector family.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向WAMPAC系统的攻击弹性分析框架，将广域阻尼控制、自动发电控制以及调速与励磁系统的耦合动态形式化，并把最优隐蔽FDI攻击建模为混合整数线性规划。在IEEE 39和118节点系统上验证表明，广域访问攻击影响显著，学习型异常检测边界可降低攻击目标并阻止过频继电器跳闸，但无法完全消除隐蔽攻击风险。
AI.motivation: WAMPAC系统依赖通过广域网络传输的同步PMU测量来抑制大型互联电网中的区间振荡，但这种依赖使其易受虚假数据注入攻击。因此需要评估广域FDI攻击的隐蔽性与破坏性，并分析异常检测对攻击弹性的影响。
AI.method: 构建攻击弹性分析框架，耦合广域阻尼回路、自动发电控制、调速和励磁系统动态；将最优隐蔽FDI攻击表述为MILP；异常检测模型作为可替换约束集，可为静态不良数据检测规则或按共同误报率校准的良性运行学习边界；在IEEE 39和118节点系统上测试，参考动态通过OPAL-RT硬件在环平台验证。
AI.result: 在IEEE 39和118节点系统中，具备广域访问能力的最优攻击达到良性目标的3.3倍和8.1倍，并比仅攻击自动发电控制更快实现0.5Hz频率偏移，速度超过两倍。学习边界使攻击目标降低15.5%至55.0%，并在所有配置下防止过频继电器跳闸；每种情况下仍存在可行的隐蔽攻击，残余风险随学习边界宽度变化，而非取决于检测器类型。
AI.conclusion: 广域访问会显著增强隐蔽FDI攻击对互联电网动态的破坏能力；学习型异常检测边界能降低攻击效果并避免部分保护动作，但不能完全消除可行隐蔽攻击。残余风险主要由检测边界的宽度决定，而非检测器家族。

title: TRACE: Deployable Tree-Relational Structure Enhancement for Oncology LLMs
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures, 19 tables. Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Industry Track for oral presentation
summary: Large language models are increasingly used in oncology applications, but their predictions are often weakly grounded in explicit medical structure. We present TRACE, a deployable tree-relational enhancement framework for oncology LLMs. TRACE separates expensive offline structure learning from lightweight online inference: oncology concepts and relations are organized into an updatable tree-relational structure, refined using LM-loss-derived evidence, and retrieved at inference time as compact prompt evidence. This design supports task-adaptive evidence selection without requiring supervised labels in the zero-shot setting. Across ten oncology classification tasks and one MedQuAD CancerGov QA benchmark, TRACE improves both label-free evaluation and supervised fine-tuning. Additional analyses show that TRACE improves over vanilla RAG and generic GraphRAG, remains useful under leakage-controlled METABRIC inputs, and produces interpretable evidence paths aligned with clinical reasoning. These results suggest that explicit, updatable medical structure is a practical path toward more accurate and auditable oncology LLM deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出TRACE，一种面向肿瘤学大语言模型的树关系增强框架，通过可更新的医学结构提升预测准确性与可审计性。
AI.motivation: 肿瘤学LLM应用增多，但其预测往往缺乏显式医学结构支撑，现有方法在零样本和可部署性上存在不足。
AI.method: TRACE将昂贵的离线结构学习与轻量在线推理分离：把肿瘤学概念和关系组织为可更新的树关系结构，利用语言模型损失衍生的证据进行精炼，并在推理时检索为紧凑提示证据，无需监督标签即可实现任务自适应证据选择。
AI.result: 在十个肿瘤学分类任务和一个MedQuAD CancerGov问答基准上，TRACE同时提升了无标签评估和有监督微调效果；优于原始RAG和通用GraphRAG，在泄漏控制的METABRIC输入下仍有效，并能产生与临床推理一致的可解释证据路径。
AI.conclusion: 显式且可更新的医学结构是提升肿瘤学LLM部署准确性、可审计性和实用性的可行路径。

title: One from Infinity: Actualizing Futures from Pretrained World Models into Robot Actions
summary: A pretrained video world model admits many plausible futures for a scene, but a robot must realize the exact task-conditioned one. To turn world models into executable robot policies, existing methods fine-tune the heavy world model backbone using large-scale robot data and computational resources. Challenging this status quo, we argue that the expensive part has already been paid in the world model pretraining since the representation space of a video world model lays out the diverse potential futures. In this case, what remains is to select the future that accomplishes the task and to read out the actions that realize it. We formalize this task as actualization, which learns a task-conditioned selection and realization on top of a prior supplied by a frozen world model. This can be solved by a tiny actualizer model. We implement RoboActualizer with as few as 60M parameters on top of a frozen world model encoder. The actualizer is composed of two lightweight DiT experts that jointly predict future latents and actions by flow matching. The model can be trained entirely on a single GPU with 32 GB peak memory. With up to 100x fewer trainable parameters than existing WAMs and VLAs, RoboActualizer reaches great performance on simulation benchmarks including LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin 2.0 and five tasks on two real-world platforms, with a low latency of 39 ms that allows real-time control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将预训练视频世界模型转化为机器人策略的新范式：冻结世界模型，仅训练一个轻量级的“实现器”来选择任务相关未来并读取出动作，60M参数即可在多个仿真和真实平台上实现实时控制。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将世界模型转为机器人策略时，需要大规模机器人数据微调庞大的世界模型主干，计算成本极高。作者认为昂贵的表示学习已在世界模型预训练中完成，真正需要的只是选择符合任务的未来并输出对应动作。
AI.method: 形式化任务为“实际化”（actualization）：在冻结世界模型提供的先验上，学习任务条件的选择与实现。实现为RoboActualizer，仅60M参数，由两个轻量DiT专家组成，通过flow matching联合预测未来潜变量和动作。训练仅需单张32GB GPU。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0仿真基准以及两个真实平台上的五项任务中取得优秀性能；可训练参数比现有WAM和VLA少至多100倍，延迟仅39ms，支持实时控制。
AI.conclusion: 无需微调庞大的世界模型，仅靠冻结世界模型加小型实际化器即可高效地将世界模型转化为可执行机器人策略，兼具高性能、低训练成本和低推理延迟。

title: Self-discovering RL in the Era of Experience: Is Learning History an Asset or a Burden?
summary: The pursuit of recursive self-improvement (RSI) toward general intelligence is divided between macro-level language model scaling and the interaction-driven principles of "Era of Experience". Yet, any self-improving architecture ultimately rests upon its underlying optimization engine: if general intelligence requires learning from grounded interaction, the reinforcement learning (RL) update rule itself must be capable of cumulative adaptation. While algorithm self-discovery has produced Disco103 that surpassed PPO to achieve SOTA benchmark performance -- its internal update machinery remains an uninspected black box. We present the first causal mechanistic audit of a self-discovered RL rule, structured directly around the five pillars of the Era of Experience: extended horizon, grounded reward scales, continuing streams, within-lifetime change, and exploration depth. By surgically pinning, freezing, and transplanting recurrent states while holding meta-parameters fixed, we test when learning history acts as an asset or a burden. Three findings organize the audit: (1) Recurrent history actively expands usable reward scales, sustaining a six-decade window versus three under zero-pinning. (2) Decoupling historical content from its maintenance reveals that the penalty of mismatched history stems from perpetual clamping; allowing imported state to evolve naturally attenuates this burden. (3) Under environmental change, controlling replay retention reverses the apparent adaptation advantage over DQN, demonstrating that external data turnover can confound internal plasticity. Validated through capability thresholds and ported to a second rule (OPEN), this work grounds macro-RSI ambitions in micro-level learning dynamics, establishing a foundational audit standard for next-generation, self-evolving RL algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对自发现强化学习规则 Disco103 进行因果机制审计，围绕“经验时代”的五大支柱，揭示其循环状态、历史维护与回放保留如何影响累积适应能力。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）若依赖基于交互的通用智能，底层强化学习更新规则本身必须具备累积适应能力；但自发现规则 Disco103 虽超越 PPO 达到 SOTA，其内部更新机制仍是未受检验的黑箱。
AI.method: 围绕扩展视界、接地奖励尺度、持续流、生命周期内变化和探索深度五支柱，通过外科式固定、冻结和移植循环状态，同时保持元参数不变，检验学习历史何时是资产或负担；并通过能力阈值验证，以及移植到第二个规则 OPEN 进行检验。
AI.result: （1）循环历史主动扩展可用奖励尺度，维持六十年窗口，而零固定仅三年。（2）将历史内容与其维护解耦后发现，不匹配历史的惩罚源于持续钳制；允许导入状态自然演化可减轻负担。（3）在环境变化下，控制回放保留会逆转相对 DQN 的表观适应优势，表明外部数据更替可混淆内部可塑性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将宏观 RSI 雄心扎根于微观学习动态，为下一代自演化强化学习算法建立了基础性审计标准。

title: Information-theoretic receding-horizon active learning of nonlinear dynamical systems
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC)
summary: Accurately learning nonlinear dynamics from a finite-duration experiment requires the efficient collection of informative data. We address this challenge for stochastic controlled nonlinear dynamical systems whose state is observed along a single trajectory. Our goal is to reconstruct the unknown controlled state-increment map over a prescribed compact subset of state-input space. We construct a parametric estimator of the map using fixed nonlinear features, so that the model is nonlinear in the state and input, but linear in the unknown parameters. A Gaussian prior over the parameters yields recursive Bayesian posterior updates as data stream in, enabling online quantification of predictive uncertainty in the reconstructed dynamics over the target set. We formulate an optimal adaptive-design problem over an information state, using a prediction-oriented acquisition criterion based on the mean marginal mutual information between candidate future trajectories and the reconstructed dynamics over the target set. We then approximate the resulting adaptive-design problem by a non-myopic receding-horizon formulation, evaluate its remaining expectation using a scenario-based sample average, and solve the resulting deterministic program with the cross-entropy method, leveraging parallel candidate-scenario evaluations. Numerical experiments on a noisy multistable system demonstrate that the proposed adaptive information-seeking strategy reduces predictive uncertainty and reconstruction error more efficiently than common excitation baselines under comparable experimental constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何从单条轨迹的有限时长实验中高效学习随机受控非线性动力学，并在给定状态-输入紧凑子集上重构未知的受控状态增量映射。
AI.motivation: 准确学习非线性动力学需要高效收集信息量大的数据，而在单轨迹观测和有限实验条件下，常规激励方法往往效率不足。
AI.method: 采用固定非线性特征构造对状态和输入非线性、但对未知参数线性的参数化估计器；利用高斯先验进行递归贝叶斯后验更新，实现在线预测不确定性量化；构建基于信息状态的最优自适应设计问题，并用面向预测的采集准则，即候选未来轨迹与目标集上重构动力学之间的平均边缘互信息；通过非短视滚动时域近似、基于场景的样本平均和交叉熵方法求解确定性规划问题，并并行评估候选场景。
AI.result: 在噪声多稳系统上的数值实验表明，与常见激励基线相比，所提出的自适应信息寻求策略在相当实验约束下能更有效地降低预测不确定性和重构误差。
AI.conclusion: 面向预测的信息寻求自适应设计可提升随机受控非线性动力学在单轨迹有限实验中的数据效率与重构精度。

title: Grab a Coffee: Future-Aware Guidance for Discrete Diffusion with Compiled Objectives
summary: Discrete diffusion models generate sequences by iteratively resolving multiple tokens in parallel, offering a flexible alternative to left-to-right generation. However, guiding this process with a sequence-level objective is difficult because the value of one unresolved token depends on the other tokens with which it can form a high-reward sequence. Enumerating all such completions makes the whole guidance computation grow exponentially with the number of unresolved positions. We introduce COFFEE, a plug-and-play framework that avoids this enumeration by separating sequence dependence from the objective. At each diffusion step, a target-free carrier absorbs the marginal token distributions predicted by the denoiser to construct a joint model over the unresolved tokens, while a compiled finite-state model records how their combinations affect the sequence-level preference. Pairing their states allows COFFEE to transfer global preferences to unresolved positions and sample a clean reconstruction without retraining the diffusion model. The same framework supports explicit hard constraints and learned soft objectives. We evaluate COFFEE across multiple symbolic, language, and biological benchmarks, where it achieves strong control results with task-dependent quality and diversity trade-offs. By making objectives available to inference rather than only evaluation, COFFEE brings joint conditioning, completion-weighted guidance, and optimization-based constraints into pretrained neural generation, showing the potential of neural-symbolic methods in diffusion guidance.

AI.tldr: 提出 COFFEE，一种即插即用的离散扩散模型引导框架，通过分离序列依赖与目标函数，避免枚举未解析位置的所有组合，从而在无需重训练的情况下实现序列级偏好控制。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散模型可并行迭代生成多个 token，但用序列级目标引导生成很困难，因为未解析 token 的价值取决于它与其他 token 能否组成高奖励序列，枚举所有补全会导致计算量随未解析位置数量指数增长。
AI.method: COFFEE 将序列依赖与目标分离：每步扩散中，无目标载体吸收去噪器预测的边缘 token 分布，构建未解析 token 的联合模型；同时用编译的有限状态模型记录 token 组合如何影响序列级偏好。通过配对二者状态，将全局偏好转移到未解析位置并采样干净重建，无需重训练扩散模型，并支持硬约束与学习到的软目标。
AI.result: 在多个符号、语言和生物基准上评估 COFFEE，取得较强控制效果，并存在随任务变化的质量与多样性权衡。
AI.conclusion: COFFEE 将目标用于推理而非仅用于评估，把联合条件生成、补全加权引导和基于优化的约束引入预训练神经生成，展示了神经符号方法在扩散引导中的潜力。

title: Xiaomi-OCR-0 Technical Report
summary:
Compact OCR-specific vision-language models achieve strong document parsing performance, but often rely on costly supervision and focus primarily on visual-text reconstruction. We introduce Xiaomi-OCR-0, a unified 0.8B model for document parsing and OCR-centric understanding. We build an approximately 170M-sample OCR-centric corpus using an automated data engine that combines expert consensus, render-based verification, and targeted synthesis. Starting from Qwen3.5-0.8B, our progressive training recipe combines Q-Mask-based text anchoring, continued pretraining, and mixed-task reinforcement learning (Mix-RL). Xiaomi-OCR-0 achieves 95.24 on Real5-OmniDocBench, 96.83 on OmniDocBench v1.6, and 87.94 on Wild-OmniDocBench, while reaching an average score of 83.2 across five OCR-oriented VQA benchmarks. Ablations further show that, with sufficient parsing training, OCR-centric understanding supervision provides additional gains for document parsing.
  Homepage: https://huggingface.co/spaces/SeerRay-Lab/Xiaomi-OCR-0.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Xiaomi-OCR-0，一个0.8B的统一文档解析与OCR中心理解模型。通过约1.7亿样本OCR语料和渐进式训练策略，在多个文档解析与OCR-VQA基准上取得领先表现。
AI.motivation: 现有紧凑型OCR专用视觉语言模型虽文档解析性能强，但依赖高昂监督成本，且主要关注视觉-文本重建，缺乏OCR中心理解能力。
AI.method: 基于Qwen3.5-0.8B，构建自动化数据引擎生成约170M样本OCR语料，结合专家共识、渲染验证和定向合成；采用Q-Mask文本锚定、持续预训练和混合任务强化学习（Mix-RL）的渐进式训练方案。
AI.result: 在Real5-OmniDocBench达95.24，OmniDocBench v1.6达96.83，Wild-OmniDocBench达87.94；在五个OCR导向VQA基准上平均83.2。消融显示，在充分解析训练后，OCR中心理解监督可进一步提升文档解析。
AI.conclusion: Xiaomi-OCR-0验证了统一小模型在文档解析与OCR理解上的有效性，并表明OCR中心理解监督对文档解析具有额外增益。

title: Hardware-Aware Functional Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Efficient Medical Image Enhancement and Segmentation
summary: Functional Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (FunKAN) achieve state-of-the-art accuracy on MRI Gibbs artifact removal and anatomical segmentation, but their 11.6 M parameters and 8.7 GFLOPs are too large for edge medical devices. We present FunKANLite, a two-stage, hardware-aware compression of FunKAN for point-of-care use. FunKANLite-TR reduces the spatial prior and replaces the ResBlock offset predictor with a depthwise-separable block. It has 1.9x fewer parameters than FunKAN and no loss in accuracy. We then distill FunKANLite-TR into FunKANLite-ST, which lowers the Hermite basis rank, factorizes the spatial prior into a low-rank form, and halves the filter widths. FunKANLite-ST has 5.6x fewer parameters and 3.7x fewer GFLOPs than FunKAN. It stays within 1.4 percentage points IoU of FunKAN on BUSI, GlaS, and CVC-ClinicDB, and reaches 33.95 dB PSNR on IXI. On an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano and a Raspberry Pi 5, FunKANLite-ST reduces energy per inference by up to 68% and raises throughput by 2.9x.

AI.tldr: 提出FunKANLite，一种面向边缘医疗设备的两阶段硬件感知压缩方法，将FunKAN大幅轻量化，在保持精度的同时显著降低参数量、计算量、能耗并提升吞吐量。
AI.motivation: FunKAN在MRI Gibbs伪影去除和解剖分割上达到先进精度，但其11.6M参数和8.7 GFLOPs对于边缘医疗设备而言过大，难以用于即时诊断。
AI.method: 采用两阶段压缩：第一阶段FunKANLite-TR减少空间先验，并用深度可分离块替换ResBlock偏移预测器；第二阶段将FunKANLite-TR蒸馏为FunKANLite-ST，降低Hermite基秩，对空间先验进行低秩分解，并将滤波器宽度减半。
AI.result: FunKANLite-TR参数量比FunKAN少1.9倍且精度无损；FunKANLite-ST参数量少5.6倍、GFLOPs少3.7倍，在BUSI、GlaS和CVC-ClinicDB上IoU与FunKAN差距在1.4个百分点内，在IXI上PSNR达33.95 dB。在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano和Raspberry Pi 5上，单次推理能耗降低高达68%，吞吐量提升2.9倍。
AI.conclusion: FunKANLite成功实现了面向即时医疗的边缘部署，在显著压缩模型的同时保持了与原始FunKAN相近的精度，并大幅提升了能效和推理速度。

title: One Geometry, Different Outcomes: Readout-Dependent Effects of the Modality Gap in Vision-Language Models
summary: Contrastive vision-language models learn shared embedding spaces by aligning matched image-text pairs, yet their representations remain separated by a modality gap. Prior work reports divergent effects of modifying this gap: reducing it can improve zero-shot classification and cross-modal alignment, whereas removing gap-related structure can degrade image-text retrieval. In this paper, we provide a unified geometric explanation for these task-dependent effects. Across CLIP and SigLIP encoders, we find that a single dominant direction captures 94.4-99.9% of the squared norm of the image-text mean separation, revealing that the mean-separation component is approximately rank-one. A decomposition of the similarity score then identifies three task-specific roles. In zero-shot classification, query-side fixed gap-offset subtraction is exactly equivalent to an additive class bias. In standard cross-modal retrieval, projecting out the gap direction and renormalising residuals discards candidate-specific norm information, inducing a multiplicative ranking distortion; a geometry-derived exponent tracks the grid-search optimum (Spearman rho = 0.93) and restores performance in some settings, although the gains transfer unevenly. In mixed-modal retrieval, the gap direction sorts candidates by modality; its removal can improve cross-modal ranking, unlike random or non-gap controls. Residual semantic structure after removal defines the limits of the rank-one account. Together, these results explain why gap modification can improve, degrade, or restore performance across downstream settings. By clarifying when and why gap modification changes model behavior, this account provides a principled basis for selecting gap interventions in similarity-based vision-language systems across evaluated downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过几何分析统一解释了对比视觉-语言模型（如CLIP和SigLIP）中模态间隙修改在不同任务中效果迥异的原因，发现图像-文本均值分离近似秩一，并分解相似度得分揭示任务特定作用。
AI.motivation: 先前工作报告了修改模态间隙的矛盾效果：减少间隙可改善零样本分类和跨模态对齐，而移除间隙相关结构可能损害图像-文本检索。需要统一几何解释这些任务依赖效应。
AI.method: 使用CLIP和SigLIP编码器，分析图像-文本均值分离的几何结构，发现单一主导方向捕获94.4-99.9%的平方范数，表明均值分离分量近似秩一。分解相似度得分，识别零样本分类、标准跨模态检索和混合模态检索中的任务特定角色。
AI.result: 零样本分类中，查询侧固定间隙偏移减法等价于加性类别偏差。标准跨模态检索中，投影掉间隙方向并重新归一化残差会丢弃候选特定范数信息，导致乘法排序失真；几何推导的指数跟踪网格搜索最优（Spearman rho=0.93）并在某些设置中恢复性能，但增益转移不均匀。混合模态检索中，间隙方向按模态排序候选，移除可改善跨模态排序，不同于随机或非间隙控制。移除后的残差语义结构定义了秩一解释的界限。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果解释了间隙修改为何能改善、降低或恢复下游任务性能，为在基于相似度的视觉-语言系统中选择间隙干预提供了原则性基础。

title: FineART: Fine-grained Annotated Robotic Trajectory Dataset and Vision-Language-Action Model for Bimanual Manipulation
comment: 26 pages. Code and model weights will be integrated into Hugging Face LeRobot https://github.com/huggingface/lerobot
summary: Robots operating in real-world environments must execute complex, multi-step bimanual tasks over long horizons rather than single, isolated actions. Current manipulation datasets struggle to support this capability: although single-arm datasets reach hundreds of thousands of trajectories, they typically provide only one high-level instruction per episode while the rare bimanual effort that does label subtasks annotates only a fraction of its hours. We present FineART, a densely annotated bimanual manipulation dataset of 40,543 episodes, 1,718 hours, and 533,913 subtasks across 151 tasks. We also introduce FineART-VLA, a vision-language-action policy that predicts its own next subtask, and show that mid-training it this way yields substantial gains. Specifically, success on a spatial disambiguation task increases from 32.0% to 100.0%, and step-by-step human subtask guidance lifts success on an unseen long-horizon task from 16.0% to 76.0%. Furthermore, after minimal fine-tuning on a new robot, the policy requires one-tenth the data of baselines without mid-training and generalizes zero-shot to completely unseen tasks on the new hardware. We open-source the full dataset, model weights, and training code.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了密集标注的双臂操作数据集 FineART（40,543 条轨迹、1,718 小时、533,913 个子任务、151 个任务），并基于此提出 FineART-VLA 策略，使其能预测下一步子任务，从而显著提升长时程双臂操作与迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现实环境中的机器人需要执行复杂、多步骤、长时程的双臂任务，但现有操作数据集难以支撑：单臂数据集虽大，却通常每个 episode 只有一个高层指令；少数双臂数据集即使标注子任务，也只覆盖部分时长和样本。
AI.method: 构建 FineART 密集标注双臂操作数据集，并提出 FineART-VLA 视觉-语言-动作策略，让模型在训练中预测自身下一步子任务，即进行子任务预测式 mid-training；同时评估人工子任务引导和新机器人上的少量微调迁移。
AI.result: 空间消歧任务成功率从 32.0% 提升到 100.0%；在未见长时程任务上，逐步人工子任务引导将成功率从 16.0% 提升到 76.0%；在新机器人上仅需基线十分之一的数据进行微调，并能零样本泛化到新硬件上的完全未见任务。
AI.conclusion: 密集子任务标注与自预测下一步子任务的训练方式，能有效提升双臂长时程操作、空间消歧、未见任务泛化及跨机器人迁移能力；论文开源了完整数据集、模型权重和训练代码。

title: Lookahead-R: Budget-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution-Centric Planning
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Published in ICMR 2026
summary: Tool retrieval is a critical bottleneck for LLM-based agents operating over large, heterogeneous API ecosystems. Existing approaches face an inherent trade-off: semantic retrievers are fast but suffer from the semantic-functional gap, while execution-based validation improves precision at the cost of prohibitive latency. We propose Lookahead-R, a planning-based framework that reformulates tool retrieval as a resource-constrained sequential decision-making problem. At its core, Lookahead-R introduces a lightweight execution-aware surrogate world model that jointly predicts tool execution success, latency cost, and semantic utility---without invoking real APIs. This world model drives a cost-sensitive, uncertainty-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search that navigates the tool space under strict budget constraints. Evaluated on the large-scale ToolBench benchmark, Lookahead-R achieves a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off across all test scenarios. On the most challenging I3 split, it attains an NDCG@5 of 91.40\%, outperforming the state-of-the-art ToolGen (90.16\%) by 1.24\%. Ablation studies confirm that explicit latency modeling is the key discriminative signal for identifying high-quality tools under resource constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出 Lookahead-R，将工具检索建模为资源受限的序列决策问题，通过轻量级执行感知代理世界模型与成本敏感、不确定性引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索，在无需真实调用 API 的情况下提升 LLM 智能体工具检索的准确率与效率。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在大型异构 API 生态中面临工具检索瓶颈：语义检索快但存在语义-功能鸿沟，基于执行的验证精度高但延迟过大，现有方法难以兼顾准确率与效率。
AI.method: Lookahead-R 是一个基于规划的框架，将工具检索重述为资源受限的序列决策问题。其核心是轻量级执行感知代理世界模型，联合预测工具执行成功、延迟成本和语义效用，无需调用真实 API。该世界模型驱动成本敏感、不确定性引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索，在严格预算约束下探索工具空间。
AI.result: 在 ToolBench 基准上，Lookahead-R 在所有测试场景中取得更优的准确率-效率权衡。在最难的 I3 划分上，NDCG@5 达到 91.40%，比最先进的 ToolGen（90.16%）高 1.24%。消融实验确认，显式延迟建模是资源约束下识别高质量工具的关键判别信号。
AI.conclusion: Lookahead-R 通过规划式检索和代理世界模型，有效缓解工具检索中精度与延迟的权衡问题；显式建模延迟对资源受限下的高质量工具选择尤为重要。

title: Right Words, Wrong Moment: A Clinician-Grounded Analysis of Distress in 19,930 Conversations between Young People and ChatGPT
summary: Young people increasingly turn to General-Purpose Conversational Agents (GPCAs), such as ChatGPT, in moments of distress. We examine young adults' (ages 18-25) experiences using ChatGPT. We first collected 19,930 ChatGPT conversations and survey data from 158 young adults. We then selected five example conversations reflecting user distress. Finally, we asked ten clinicians to review those five conversations. We found distressed participants reported greater emotional engagement with ChatGPT and greater behavioral change from using it than their peers. When they turned to ChatGPT in moments of acute distress, ChatGPT was quick to give overly dramatic responses and excessive action-oriented suggestions. Clinicians endorsed ChatGPT's availability and much of its wording, but identified seven process failures, such as prematurely jumping to solutions. We translated clinicians' feedback into design guidelines following three stages: 1) asking about safety, 2) de-escalating intensity to restore emotional regulation, and 3) exploring concerns without agreeing with them.

AI.tldr: 研究考察18-25岁年轻人在情绪困扰时使用ChatGPT等通用对话代理的体验，结合 conversations、问卷和临床医生评审，发现困扰用户情感投入和行为改变更强，ChatGPT在急性困扰中易给出过度戏剧化和行动导向建议，并据此提出三阶段设计指南。
AI.motivation: 年轻人越来越多在痛苦时刻向ChatGPT等通用对话代理求助，但其实际使用体验、风险及临床适当性尚不明确。
AI.method: 收集158名年轻成人的19,930段ChatGPT对话和问卷数据；选取5段反映用户困扰的对话；邀请10名临床医生评审这些对话，并将反馈转化为设计指南。
AI.result: 困扰参与者比同伴报告更高的情感投入和行为改变。在急性困扰时，ChatGPT倾向给出过度戏剧化回应和过多行动导向建议。临床医生认可其可用性和许多措辞，但指出7类过程失败，如过早跳到解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出三阶段设计指南：1)询问安全问题，2)降低强度以恢复情绪调节，3)探索担忧但不表示认同，以改进通用对话代理在心理困扰场景中的支持方式。

title: On a Class of Decentralized Feedback Controllers for the Networked Bivirus SIS Model
summary: Recent work has established many properties of systems modeling the spread of two competing viruses in a population, and for networks with multiple connected populations with different spreading properties (e.g. men and women). This work considers the introduction of a class of nonlinear decentralized feedback controls aimed at reducing the fractions of populations infected at an endemic equilibrium. One surprising conclusion is that in some circumstances, new types of equilibria can arise. They can be viewed as an outcome of a transcritical bifurcation which is never observed for uncontrolled systems. In addition, we show that the controlled system is strongly monotone, and an unstable boundary equilibrium of the uncontrolled system cannot be stabilized using the class of decentralized state feedback controllers considered in this paper.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在两种竞争病毒传播及多群体连通网络中，引入非线性分散反馈控制以降低地方性平衡点处的感染比例，并分析控制系统的平衡点与稳定性性质。
AI.motivation: 已有工作刻画了竞争病毒传播系统及具有不同传播属性的多连通群体网络，本文希望在此基础上通过分散反馈控制减少各群体在地方性平衡点中的感染比例。
AI.method: 采用一类非线性分散反馈控制器，并结合平衡点分析、分岔分析以及强单调系统理论来研究受控系统的动力学性质。
AI.result: 在某些情形下，控制会引入新的平衡点，这可视为未受控系统中未曾出现的跨临界分岔结果；受控系统具有强单调性；未受控系统的不稳定边界平衡点无法用本文所考虑的一类分散状态反馈控制器镇定。
AI.conclusion: 分散反馈控制虽可降低感染水平，但也可能产生新的平衡点，且对不稳定边界平衡点的镇定存在固有限制；强单调性为理解受控系统行为提供了重要结构性质。

title: From Sharp Eyes to Expert Mind: Internalizing Expert Knowledge in MLLMs for Tampered Text Detection
summary: Tampered Text Detection (TTD) is essential for safeguarding document authenticity in security-critical workflows. Existing expert models are effective at capturing subtle manipulation traces but often generalize poorly across diverse document domains, while Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer stronger semantic understanding and transferability yet remain insensitive to fine-grained forensic artifacts. This complementarity motivates us to investigate how expert forensic perception can be internalized into an MLLM rather than merely accessed through an external module. We identify a fundamental Double Mismatch that hinders this goal: a Spatial Precision Mismatch between coarse visual tokens and tiny tampered regions, and a Perceptual Granularity Mismatch between semantics-oriented pre-training and low-level forensic perception. To address these challenges, we propose Expert Knowledge Internalization (EKI), a progressive two-stage framework that transfers forensic expertise into the MLLM itself. In Stage 1, Text-Focused and Image-Focused strategies establish precise spatial focus on small text regions. In Stage 2, the proposed Forensic-General Representation Alignment (FGRA) loss aligns shallow LLM representations with those of a pre-trained forensic expert, enabling the model to acquire fine-grained artifact perception before such cues are diluted by deeper semantic abstraction. Extensive experiments on multiple in-domain and cross-domain benchmarks demonstrate that EKI achieves state-of-the-art performance and stronger generalization than existing expert-model-based and MLLM-based methods. Moreover, the expert is required only during training, allowing the resulting MLLM to maintain inference efficiency nearly identical to the vanilla model without relying on any external expert at inference.

AI.tldr: 本文研究篡改文本检测（TTD），提出专家知识内化（EKI）框架，将取证专家的细粒度篡改感知能力逐步迁移到多模态大语言模型（MLLM）内部，从而在保持推理效率的同时提升检测性能与跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有专家模型擅长捕捉细微篡改痕迹，但跨文档域泛化差；MLLM语义理解与迁移能力强，却对细粒度取证伪影不敏感。二者互补，因此作者希望将专家取证感知内化到MLLM中，而非仅依赖外部模块。
AI.method: 作者指出阻碍该目标的双重错配：粗粒度视觉 token 与微小篡改区域之间的空间精度错配，以及语义导向预训练与低层取证感知之间的感知粒度错配。为此提出 EKI 两阶段渐进框架：第一阶段用文本聚焦和图像聚焦策略建立对小文本区域的精确空间关注；第二阶段提出取证-通用表示对齐（FGRA）损失，将 LLM 浅层表示与预训练取证专家表示对齐，使模型在细微线索被深层语义抽象稀释前学会细粒度伪影感知。
AI.result: 在多个域内和跨域基准上，EKI 取得了最先进性能，并比现有基于专家模型和基于 MLLM 的方法具有更强泛化能力。同时，专家仅在训练阶段需要，最终 MLLM 在推理时无需外部专家，推理效率与原始模型几乎相同。
AI.conclusion: EKI 通过将取证专家知识内化到 MLLM 中，有效缓解双重错配，在篡改文本检测任务中实现高精度、强泛化和高效率推理，为安全关键场景下的文档真实性保护提供了新方案。

title: Automated Evaluation of Multi-Turn Dialogues in In-Car Conversational Assistants
comment: Accepted at the 29th IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (IEEE ITSC 2026)
summary: In-car conversational assistants (ICAs) are increasingly integrated into vehicles to support route planning, vehicle control, and information access. Ensuring their reliability is challenging due to multi-turn interactions, the absence of explicit ground truth, and strict safety constraints. Existing evaluation techniques fall short, as they target single-turn settings and fail to capture constraint handling, context retention, and safety-critical behavior across turns. We propose an automated framework for testing the multi-turn conversational capabilities of ICAs. The system is treated as a black box and evaluated via closed-loop simulation with a strategy-guided user simulator, an adversarial strategy manager, and a two-tier LLM judge assessing turn-level failures and conversation-level quality. We evaluate the approach on an industrial ICA with six LLM backends and twelve human annotators. The automated judge shows substantial agreement with humans, and strategy guidance uncovers 2.96 times more unique failure types per conversation and more than doubles the number of unique failing conversations compared to unguided simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向车载对话助手（ICAs）多轮对话能力的自动化测试框架，通过闭环模拟、策略引导用户模拟器、对抗策略管理器和两层LLM评判器来检测多轮交互中的故障，并在工业ICAs上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有评估方法主要针对单轮对话，无法有效评估ICAs在多轮交互中的约束处理、上下文保持和安全关键行为，难以保证其可靠性。
AI.method: 将系统视为黑盒，采用闭环仿真测试；使用策略引导的用户模拟器、对抗策略管理器，以及两层LLM评判器分别评估轮级故障和对话级质量；在工业ICA上对6个LLM后端和12名人工标注者进行评估。
AI.result: 自动评判器与人工评判达到较高一致性；与无引导模拟相比，策略引导在每个对话中发现多2.96倍的独特故障类型，并使独特故障对话数量增加一倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 该自动化框架能有效测试ICAs的多轮对话能力，策略引导显著提升故障发现能力，自动评判结果与人类判断较为一致。

title: Receding Horizon Control and Dissipativity - Optimal Control, Games and Uncertainty
summary: We provide a tutorial overview of receding horizon control across deterministic, stochastic, multi-agent, and game-theoretic settings. We contrast the minimizer of an optimal control problem with the equilibrium of a game in terms of cost and constraint handling to motivate the difference of MPC schemes involving multiple agents/players. Interestingly, dissipativity theory and the turnpike property have turned out to be a unifying thread and system-theoretic backbone across all these schemes. This paper is the first to give an overview of results, summarizing fundamental insights, drawing parallels, and highlighting technical differences in dissipativity and turnpike analysis across economic, game theoretic, and stochastic settings. We also explore recent trends in numerical methods for games. We conclude by pointing to a list of open challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于滚动时域控制的教程式综述，涵盖确定性、随机、多智能体与博弈论场景，并以耗散性理论和转轨性质作为统一主线。
AI.motivation: 多智能体/博弈场景中的MPC与单智能体最优控制存在本质差异：前者关注博弈均衡而非代价最小化，且代价与约束处理方式不同，因此需要统一梳理相关理论。
AI.method: 采用教程/综述方法，对比最优控制问题的最小化解与博弈均衡，并系统分析耗散性理论和转轨性质在经济、博弈论及随机场景中的作用，同时回顾博弈数值方法的新趋势。
AI.result: 首次综述了这些场景下的基本洞见，揭示了耗散性与转轨分析作为系统论主线的统一性，并总结了不同场景之间的共性与技术差异。
AI.conclusion: 耗散性与转轨性质是贯穿各类滚动时域控制方案的核心线索；文章最后指出了该领域尚未解决的开放挑战。

title: An Energy-Based Framework for Transient Stability of Grid-Forming Converter Networks With Current Limiting
summary: Existing analyses for the transient stability of grid-forming (GFM) converters under current limiting mainly address single-converter systems, while network-level transient stability analysis remains challenging. This paper develops a network energy construction that incorporates current limiting while retaining a provable dissipation property. This structure enables Lyapunov-based analysis consistent with classical direct method for synchronous-machine based systems, without switching between mode-dependent energy functions. A two-GFM example using a reactive circular current limiter and impedance insertion illustrates the proposed framework. Electromagnetic transient simulations support the theoretical results.

AI.tldr: 本文针对限流下构网型（GFM）变流器的网络级暂态稳定分析难题，提出一种计及限流的网络能量构造方法，并保持可证明的耗散特性，从而支持无需切换模式相关能量函数的Lyapunov分析。
AI.motivation: 现有GFM变流器限流下暂态稳定分析主要针对单机系统，网络级暂态稳定分析仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 构造考虑限流的网络能量函数，并保持可证明的耗散性质；基于Lyapunov方法进行分析，使其与同步机系统经典直接法一致，且无需在模式相关能量函数之间切换。以两个GFM为例，采用无功环形限流器与阻抗插入进行说明。
AI.result: 所提框架可用于双GFM系统示例，电磁暂态仿真验证了理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 所提网络能量构造方法能够支持限流下GFM变流器的网络级暂态稳定Lyapunov分析，并避免模式相关能量函数切换。

title: World4Scorer: Outcome-Grounded World Modeling for Autonomous Driving
comment: 28 pages, 14 figures, 13 tables. Project page: https://guobapei.github.io/World4Scorer/
summary: Autonomous driving requires choosing a safe and efficient plan as surrounding traffic evolves. Generate-and-select planners propose multiple trajectories and score them for execution, and they have outperformed representative direct-prediction baselines on NAVSIM. Their scorer must compare plans that were never executed. Driving logs record the future of only the executed trajectory, so matching the logged future can leave predictions for the alternatives unconstrained; a simulator, in contrast, can label the outcome of every candidate. We introduce World4Scorer, which builds the scorer as a trajectory-conditioned JEPA-style predictor: it predicts a state for each candidate and reads the candidate's scores from that state. Simulator outcome labels supervise the states of all candidates, and the observed future of the executed trajectory anchors the predictor to real scene evolution. Because one predictor produces every candidate's state, the anchor can constrain shared parameters used to score unexecuted plans, while the future itself is needed only during training. Generated candidates mostly score well, so a scene-matched bank adds low-scoring plans to the outcome supervision; framewise choices can conflict, so inertial re-ranking keeps consecutive selections consistent. World4Scorer achieves state-of-the-art NAVSIM-v2 performance and a strong adapted-system result on closed-loop Bench2Drive. With the LeWM world model and planning budget fixed, outcome-based scoring also improves manipulation planning on the OGBench-Cube benchmark.

AI.tldr: 提出 World4Scorer，将规划评分器构建为轨迹条件化的 JEPA 风格预测器：为每个候选轨迹预测状态并从中读取分数，利用模拟器结果监督所有候选，并用真实执行未来作为锚点。
AI.motivation: 生成-选择式规划器需要评分器比较候选方案，但驾驶日志只记录已执行轨迹的未来，未执行候选的预测缺乏约束；模拟器则可为所有候选标注结果。
AI.method: 使用轨迹条件化 JEPA 风格预测器，为每个候选产生状态并评分；模拟器结果标签监督所有候选状态，已执行轨迹的真实未来锚定共享参数；引入场景匹配低分候选库补充监督，并用惯性重排序保持连续选择一致。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM-v2 上达到 SOTA，在闭环 Bench2Drive 上取得强 adapted-system 结果；固定 LeWM 世界模型和规划预算时，基于结果的评分也提升 OGBench-Cube 操作规划。
AI.conclusion: 通过世界模型对候选结果进行监督评分，可有效约束未执行方案并提升自动驾驶与操作规划性能。

title: PowerZooJax: A JAX-based Power System Benchmark for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Power system operation is a safety-critical sequential decision-making problem, making it a natural testbed for reinforcement learning (RL). However, existing RL environments for power systems are often narrow in scope and computationally limited by CPU-based simulation workflows, making large-scale evaluation difficult. We introduce PowerZooJax, a JAX-based benchmark suite for RL in power system operation. It provides five constrained Markov decision process tasks spanning generation, transmission, distribution, distributed energy resources, and data center microgrid. By rewriting power flow, economic dispatch, market clearing, and device dynamics as JAX computation graphs, PowerZooJax keeps the entire training and evaluation loop on the GPU. Experiments show substantial speedups over CPU-based simulations and demonstrate standardized evaluation of policy returns, safety violations, and out-of-distribution stress conditions. Our open-source benchmark is available at: https://github.com/powerzoojax/PowerZooJax.

AI.tldr: PowerZooJax 是一个基于 JAX 的强化学习基准套件，用于电力系统运行，支持 GPU 端到端训练与评估，并覆盖五类典型电力系统任务。
AI.motivation: 现有电力系统强化学习环境范围较窄，且受限于 CPU 仿真，难以进行大规模评估。
AI.method: 将潮流计算、经济调度、市场出清和设备动态重写为 JAX 计算图，构建五个约束马尔可夫决策过程任务，涵盖发电、输电、配电、分布式能源和数据中心微电网。
AI.result: 实验显示相比 CPU 仿真有显著加速，并能标准化评估策略回报、安全违规和分布外压力场景。
AI.conclusion: PowerZooJax 为安全关键的电力系统运行强化学习提供了可扩展、标准化的开源基准平台。

title: Exploring Learning Models for Topological Relationship Recognition from Image Data
summary: Figuring out how objects relate to each other, like whether they touch, overlap, stay completely separate or one sits inside another, matters a lot in fields like GIS, biomedical imaging, and robotics. Even though machine learning has come a long way, people haven't really focused on spotting these topological relationships in images. The main roadblocks? Not enough good datasets and no clear way to measure results. So, we rolled up our sleeves and built a new dataset. It's pretty sizable: over 11,000 labelled images showing all those essential relationships. We ran tests with some classic machine learning models, Naive Bayes, KNN, Random Forest, SVM, and Artificial Neural Networks, and threw in some deep learning stars like VGG16 and InceptionResNetV2. For the dataset itself, we used segmentation, contour detection, and grayscale normalization to tease out solid feature vectors. The results? Deep learning methods, especially VGG16, pulled ahead, with validation accuracy hitting 89.55%. That's a big jump compared to the traditional models. This shows how powerful transfer learning is for analyzing topological relationships in images, and it gives researchers a new standard to aim for in future work on spatial reasoning and topological classification.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个包含超过11000张标注图像的数据集，用于识别图像中物体间的拓扑关系（如接触、重叠、分离、包含），并比较传统机器学习与深度学习方法。
AI.motivation: 图像中的拓扑关系在GIS、生物医学成像和机器人等领域很重要，但机器学习领域缺乏相关数据集和明确的评价标准，因此需要建立新数据集并评估方法。
AI.method: 构建大规模标注数据集；使用分割、轮廓检测和灰度归一化提取特征向量；测试Naive Bayes、KNN、Random Forest、SVM、ANN等传统模型，以及VGG16、InceptionResNetV2等深度学习模型。
AI.result: 深度学习方法表现更优，其中VGG16验证准确率达到89.55%，显著优于传统机器学习模型。
AI.conclusion: 迁移学习在图像拓扑关系分析中非常有效，该工作为未来空间推理和拓扑分类研究提供了新的基准。

title: Constructing Challenging Browser-Use Tasks by Controlled Environment Interventions
summary: As browser-use agents improve, benchmarks keep pace by collecting new tasks, websites, and applications, often making tasks longer or more novel. This makes difficulty expensive to refresh and difficult to control: when many aspects change at once, it is unclear what actually makes a task challenging. We instead construct challenging instances from tasks agents already solve, turning difficulty into a programmable property of the environment. BreakingWeb pairs every base task with an intervention condition that preserves the user instruction, latent target, and backend success criterion while changing the environment at different web stack layers. Each intervention is deterministic, detectable, and recoverable, and is annotated with the cognitive primitive it primarily loads. The benchmark contains 519 clean/intervention task pairs across seven self-hosted websites and 29 intervention families, all graded against outcomes. We evaluate six strong browser-use agents, three GUI-only agents that see only screenshots, and humans. The construction is effective: interventions cut agent pass rate by 22.9% on average and overturn nearly half of the tasks each agent solves cleanly, whereas humans lose 10.0% on a first attempt and 5.7% after one familiarisation attempt. The dominant failure is belief failure: 75% of the six agents' failures end with a declared success although the required change never happened. Our code, data and environment are publicly available at www.breakingweb.app.

AI.tldr: 提出 BreakingWeb，一种通过环境干预将 Agent 已会任务转化为高难度任务的浏览器 Agent 基准，覆盖 519 个任务对，能可控地评估难度并揭示 belief failure。
AI.motivation: 现有浏览器 Agent 基准多靠新增任务、网站或应用来提升难度，成本高且难以控制；多因素同时变化时，难以判断真正导致任务困难的原因。
AI.method: 从 Agent 已能解决的任务出发，为每个基础任务配对一个干预条件：保持用户指令、潜在目标和后端成功标准不变，仅在不同 Web 栈层级改变环境。每个干预确定、可检测、可恢复，并标注主要加载的认知原语。基准含 519 个 clean/intervention 任务对、7 个自托管网站、29 类干预，并按结果评分。评估了 6 个强浏览器 Agent、3 个仅看截图的 GUI Agent 和人类。
AI.result: 干预使 Agent 平均通过率下降 22.9%，并推翻近一半原本能干净解决的任务；人类首次尝试仅损失 10.0%，熟悉一次后损失 5.7%。主要失败是 belief failure：6 个 Agent 的失败中 75% 最终声称成功，但所需环境变化从未发生。
AI.conclusion: BreakingWeb 将难度变成环境的可编程属性，能更可控地评估浏览器 Agent 的鲁棒性，尤其暴露其信念失败问题；代码、数据和环境已公开于 www.breakingweb.app。

title: Losing the name before the box: measuring and repairing what narrow fine-tuning costs a detector outside its deployment vocabulary
comment: 25 pages, 3 figures. Supplementary material (69 pages) is included as an ancillary file. Submitted to the International Journal of Computer Vision
summary: A detector pretrained on a broad corpus is fine-tuned on a narrow domain, its in-domain accuracy improves, and it ships. We ask what happens meanwhile to its coverage of objects the vocabulary never names, which in obstacle detection and inspection carry the risk. No in-domain test set holds an example of one. We give a longitudinal protocol: one pretrained checkpoint against its own fine-tuned descendants. It tracks held-out top-$K$ proposal coverage $C_τ$: of categories pretraining covered and the vocabulary omits, the share of boxes a detector's top $K$ regions still cover. The quantity is the open-world proposal literature's; the longitudinal reading is not. $C_τ$ falls while in-domain accuracy rises, on four architectures and three domains, by $5.12$ to $63.35$ points on boxes above $1024$ px$^2$. No in-domain number identifies the fall, and neither does detection average precision, which charges a missed and a misnamed box alike. On the one architecture scoring both, adaptation costs $87\%$ of the AP against a fifth of the coverage, and the naming goes first at all six depths of its freeze ladder, every run. What breaks is structured: three architectures sharing no pretraining run agree on which categories lose coverage, and those a model never learned do not lose any. A repair follows and needs no training: mixing a quarter of the pretrained state back, normalisation statistics included, raises coverage on every cell swept for at most $2.47$ points of in-domain accuracy. Seeing it costs one extra evaluation pass.

AI.tldr: 论文研究检测器从广泛预训练微调到窄域后，域内精度虽提升，但对预训练覆盖而词表未命名类别的开放世界覆盖会系统性下降；提出纵向评估协议，并给出无需训练的修复方法。
AI.motivation: 微调后域内精度提升常被视为部署标准，但域内测试集不含未命名或开放世界物体；在障碍物检测与巡检中，这些未命名物体恰是风险来源，因此需要追踪微调对开放世界覆盖的副作用。
AI.method: 提出纵向协议：用同一预训练检查点与其微调后代对比；跟踪 held-out top-K proposal coverage C_tau，即预训练覆盖但词表省略的类别中，检测器 top K 区域仍覆盖的框比例；在四种架构、三个域上评估，并与域内精度和检测 AP 比较；提出混回预训练状态（含归一化统计）的免训练修复。
AI.result: C_tau 在域内精度上升时下降，四种架构、三个域上对大于 1024 px^2 的框下降 5.12 至 63.35 点；域内指标和检测 AP 均无法识别该下降。某架构上适配损失 87% AP，但覆盖损失约五分之一；命名先失效，且在六层冻结阶梯的每次运行中都如此。三个无共享预训练运行的架构对哪些类别失去覆盖一致；模型从未学过的类别不下降。修复：混回四分之一预训练状态（含归一化统计）可提升所有扫描单元的覆盖，域内精度最多降 2.47 点，仅需额外一次评估。
AI.conclusion: 窄域微调会系统性且结构化地损害开放世界未命名类别覆盖，而该风险不被常规域内指标或 AP 揭示；通过混回少量预训练状态可近乎免费地修复覆盖，建议部署前进行纵向覆盖监测。

title: Boosting Metric Depth Completion via Training-Free Adaptive Response Geometry
summary: Depth completion aims to recover dense metric depth from sparse sensor measurements, increasingly leveraging visual foundation models as geometric priors. However, aligning these priors to true metric scale typically relies on rigid affine assumptions in predefined coordinate systems, leaving systematic calibration errors. Linearity in depth calibration depends on the response coordinate. We introduce adaptive response geometry, which makes the fixed choice of depth, log depth, or disparity an image-level unknown. A continuous response family unifies these coordinates and defines an explicit depth-dependent gain. We derive the response-gradient relation and estimate the response parameters in metric space. Hard-Dirichlet residual reconstruction completes the calibrated prior. Under deliberately incomplete metric observations, the training-free pipeline achieves macro AbsRel 0.0301 and macro NMed 14.04°, improving both aggregate measures over PriorDA, LDCM, and Any2Full. Linearity diagnostics examine how the selected response changes the depth relation and its metric error.

AI.tldr: 面向深度补全，提出自适应响应几何，将深度、对数深度或视差的选择作为图像级未知量，统一为连续响应族并显式建模深度相关增益，结合响应梯度关系与 Hard-Dirichlet 残差重建，实现免训练的度量深度校准与补全。
AI.motivation: 现有利用视觉基础模型先验进行深度补全时，通常依赖预定义坐标下的刚性仿射假设来对齐真实度量尺度，容易产生系统性标定误差；且深度标定的线性性取决于响应坐标的选择。
AI.method: 引入自适应响应几何，将深度、对数深度和视差统一为连续响应族，并定义显式的深度相关增益；推导响应-梯度关系，在度量空间中估计响应参数；使用 Hard-Dirichlet 残差重建完成校准先验，形成免训练流程。
AI.result: 在故意不完整的度量观测下，方法取得 macro AbsRel 0.0301 和 macro NMed 14.04°，在两项聚合指标上均优于 PriorDA、LDCM 和 Any2Full；线性诊断进一步分析了所选响应如何改变深度关系及其度量误差。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明深度标定的响应坐标不应固定选择，而应作为图像级未知量自适应估计；该免训练框架能减少标定误差并提升深度补全度量精度，同时线性诊断有助于理解响应选择对深度标定误差的影响。

title: SAGE: A Statistical Acceptance Gate for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents increasingly self-evolve by editing a persistent skill document that encodes their workflow, tool-use rules, and decision logic. This loop has two steps, an optimizer that proposes a candidate edit and a gate that accepts or rejects it. Prior work has concentrated on the optimizer, while the gate still follows a naive rule that keeps any edit which improves an aggregate validation score. We show that this rule fails in two ways. First, it admits permanent regressions, since an edit can raise the average while breaking items the skill already solves. Second, it is vulnerable to the Optimizer's Curse, since the best observed score on a finite and noisy validation set is upward biased. To solve the above two limitations, we propose a statistical acceptance gate for self-evolving agents (SAGE). Compared with previous work, SAGE has two contributions. First, SAGE proposes a per-item paired comparison that evaluates the current skill and the edited skill on identical validation items, which exposes regressions that an aggregate score hides and penalizes them asymmetrically. Second, SAGE also employs a one-sided paired test that commits an edit only when its wins are statistically reliable against its losses, and it abstains otherwise. SAGE is a conservative refinement of the standard gate that recovers the baseline exactly at a boundary setting. It commits only a subset of the baseline's edits, filtering out those whose gains are unreliable or purchased by breaking already-solved items. Across five benchmarks and four backbone LLMs under an equal-budget protocol, SAGE lowers the regression rate in 19 of 20 settings and matches the baseline in the remaining one, for example from 36.5% to 0% on LiveMath and from 42.8% to 0% on OfficeQA with DeepSeek-V4. SAGE also attains the highest final score in all 20 settings, raising LiveMath from 34.15 to 48.78.

AI.tldr: 针对LLM智能体通过编辑技能文档自进化时，现有接受门控仅依据聚合验证分提升就保留编辑，导致永久性回归和优化者诅咒问题。提出SAGE统计接受门控，采用逐项配对比较与单侧配对检验，仅在收益统计可靠时提交编辑。在五个基准和四个骨干LLM上，SAGE在19/20设置中降低回归率，并在全部20设置中取得最高最终分。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化循环中优化器被广泛研究，但门控仍用朴素规则：只要编辑提升聚合验证分就接受。该规则有两个缺陷：一是平均分上升但可能破坏已解决项目，造成永久回归；二是在有限且噪声验证集上，最佳观测分存在向上偏差，即优化者诅咒。
AI.method: SAGE包含两项贡献：1）逐项配对比较，在相同验证项上评估当前技能与编辑后技能，暴露聚合分数掩盖的回归，并不对称惩罚回归；2）单侧配对检验，仅当编辑的胜出相对于失败在统计上可靠时才提交，否则弃权。SAGE是标准门控的保守改进，在边界设置下可精确恢复基线。
AI.result: 在五个基准和四个骨干LLM的等预算协议下，SAGE在20个设置中的19个降低回归率，剩余1个与基线持平。例如DeepSeek-V4上LiveMath从36.5%降至0%，OfficeQA从42.8%降至0%。SAGE在全部20个设置中获得最高最终分，LiveMath从34.15提升至48.78。
AI.conclusion: SAGE通过保守统计门控仅提交基线编辑的子集，过滤掉收益不可靠或靠破坏已解决项目换取的编辑，有效缓解永久回归与优化者诅咒，在降低回归率的同时提升最终性能。

title: Decentralized Continuous-Time Power Dispatch for Integrated Heat and Power Systems via Bernstein-Galerkin Equivalent Projection
summary: Decentralized power dispatch for integrated heat and power systems (IHPSs) involves coordinating electric power systems (EPSs) and district heating networks (DHNs) while preserving privacy. The existing methods rely mainly on discretetime DHN models and constant-flow operations, limiting the ability to exploit thermal flexibility. Enabling variable-flow and variable-temperature (VF-VT) operations requires thermal-hydraulic coupling to be addressed together with continuous-time thermal dynamics. However, the simultaneous variations in mass flows and temperature lead to a nonconvex IHPS model, for which conventional decomposition methods are difficult to apply. This paper proposes a decentralized continuous-time dispatch framework using Bernstein-Galerkin equivalent projection. For a prescribed mass flow trajectory, DHN thermal dynamics are formulated in the Bernstein space and projected onto boundary variables, yielding an equivalent feasible-region model without disclosing the internal DHN topology or states. The equivalent model and DHN subproblem are derived from a unified Bernstein-Galerkin formulation, ensuring a consistent thermal state representation throughout the EPS-DHN coordination procedure. A safeguarded Anderson prediction scheme further accelerates the alternating coordination process by using historical updates and fixed-point residuals to predict the next input without additional subproblem solving steps. Numerical results show the proposed method preserves thermal state consistency, exploits VF-VT flexibility, and improves economic and computational performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于Bernstein-Galerkin等效投影的分散式连续时间调度框架，用于电热综合能源系统（IHPS）的隐私保护协调，支持变流量-变温度（VF-VT）运行。
AI.motivation: 现有分散式调度方法主要依赖离散时间热网模型和恒定流量运行，限制了热灵活性的挖掘。实现VF-VT运行需同时处理热-水力耦合与连续时间热动态，但流量和温度的同时变化导致IHPS模型非凸，传统分解方法难以应用。
AI.method: 提出基于Bernstein-Galerkin等效投影的分散式连续时间调度框架。对于给定质量流量轨迹，将热网热动态在Bernstein空间表述并投影到边界变量，得到不泄露内部拓扑和状态的等效可行域模型。等效模型与热网子问题源自统一的Bernstein-Galerkin表述，确保协调过程中热状态表示一致。采用带保护的Anderson预测方案，利用历史更新和不动点残差预测下一步输入，加速交替协调过程，无需额外求解子问题。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，所提方法保持了热状态一致性，挖掘了VF-VT灵活性，并提升了经济性和计算性能。
AI.conclusion: 所提分散式连续时间调度框架能够有效协调电热综合能源系统，在保护隐私的同时支持变流量-变温度运行，改善系统运行的经济性与计算效率。

title: Staircase Policy: Streaming Inference for World-Action Models with Large Action Chunks
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) improve robotic manipulation by conditioning action generation on predicted future observations, but future prediction adds further inference overhead to already expensive iterative action generation. Action chunking can amortize this cost over multiple actions, yet performance degrades over long execution horizons because later actions remain conditioned on stale observations. We introduce STAIRCASE POLICY, a streaming inference and training framework that turns a flow-matching VLA into a JEPA-style WAM and partitions a large action chunk into sub-chunks at staggered denoising stages.
