Near-term actions are executed as soon as they become available, while later actions continue to be refined. At each sub-chunk boundary, the future latent is re-predicted from the latest observation and used to update all unexecuted actions, enabling long-horizon execution without repeated full policy inference. The resulting future-prediction error can further serve as a signal for adaptive chunking. S-WAM achieves 97.7% on LIBERO and 87.9% on LIBERO-Plus, and improves performance across multiple policy backbones and real-robot tasks. It reaches 292.7 executed actions per second, $3.62\times$ the throughput of conventional execution at comparable accuracy, while reducing time-to-first-action from 123.6 to 73.3 ms. With additional inference optimizations, throughput further increases to 642.9 actions per second.

AI.tldr: 提出 Staircase Policy / S-WAM，将 flow-matching VLA 转为 JEPA 风格的世界-动作模型，通过流式推理与分块去噪实现长时程机器人操作的高效执行。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型通过预测未来观测来改善动作生成，但未来预测会增加本已昂贵的迭代式动作生成推理开销。动作分块虽可摊薄成本，但在长执行时程中后续动作会依赖过时观测，导致性能下降。
AI.method: 提出流式推理与训练框架 Staircase Policy，将 flow-matching VLA 转为 JEPA 风格 WAM，并把大动作块划分为处于交错去噪阶段的子块。近期动作一旦可用即执行，后续动作继续精炼；在每个子块边界，从最新观测重新预测未来潜变量并更新所有未执行动作，从而无需反复进行完整策略推理即可支持长时程执行。未来预测误差还可作为自适应分块信号。
AI.result: S-WAM 在 LIBERO 上达到 97.7%，在 LIBERO-Plus 上达到 87.9%，并在多种策略骨干和真实机器人任务上取得提升。其执行吞吐达 292.7 个动作/秒，在相近准确率下为传统执行的 3.62 倍，同时将首动作时间从 123.6 ms 降至 73.3 ms；结合额外推理优化后吞吐进一步提升至 642.9 个动作/秒。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过流式分块去噪与基于最新观测的未来潜变量重预测，实现了长时程执行而无需重复完整策略推理，显著提升吞吐并降低首动作延迟，同时保持或提升操作性能。

title: How to Run Statistics over LLM Judges and Trust the Results: Calibrated Inference for Small-Sample AI Evaluation with evalstats
summary: Researchers across academia increasingly base significance claims on LLM judge scores and small-sample AI evaluations. Yet without well-calibrated confidence intervals (CIs), hypothesis tests, and judge-bias corrections, such claims are unreliable. We address these issues in several contributions. First, we find that running statistics over raw LLM judge scores leads to inflated false positives: counterintuitively, for many inter-rater agreement metrics, false positive risk peaks at "almost perfect" human-LLM agreement. To help researchers understand how to run statistics over LLM judges responsibly, we present guidance and tooling for the statistical analysis of mixed human-AI judge designs, and implement nine hypothesis tests via prediction-powered inference (PPI), including the first known PPI corrections for four rank-based tests (Wilcoxon signed-rank, Mann-Whitney U, and omnibus variants). To keep PPI++ stable with small human-labeled calibration sets, we introduce bootstrap-adaptive power tuning, which shrinks the estimated weight toward a target estimated from the labeled data, and accounts for that weight's own sampling variance. Second, through Monte Carlo simulations, we derive recommendations for what CI, p-value, and FWER correction methods to use for small-sample AI evaluations (N<100), and warn researchers against bootstrap CIs. We package these recommendations into evalstats, an open-source Python package that selects calibrated methods automatically, and demonstrate it in three scenarios, including one where a real LLM judge validated at "substantial agreement" would have led a researcher to publish a spurious finding. evalstats is publicly available at https://github.com/ianarawjo/evalstats.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，基于LLM评判分数和小样本AI评估的显著性声明常缺乏校准的置信区间、假设检验和评判偏差校正，因而不可靠。作者提供统计分析与工具支持，并发布evalstats包。
AI.motivation: 学术界越来越多地依赖LLM评判分数和小样本AI评估来支撑显著性结论，但若没有良好校准的置信区间、假设检验及评判偏差校正，这些结论可能不可靠，甚至导致假阳性。
AI.method: 提出混合人类-AI评判设计的统计分析与工具指南；通过预测驱动推断（PPI）实现九种假设检验，包括对四种秩检验（Wilcoxon符号秩、Mann-Whitney U及综合变体）的首次PPI校正；引入bootstrap自适应功效调优，使PPI++在小规模人工标注校准集下更稳定；并通过蒙特卡洛模拟给出小样本AI评估（N<100）中CI、p值和FWER校正方法建议；开发开源Python包evalstats自动选择校准方法。
AI.result: 发现直接对原始LLM评判分数做统计会抬高假阳性，且在许多评分者间一致性指标中，假阳性风险在人类-LLM“几乎完美”一致时反而达到峰值；给出小样本评估的统计方法建议，并警告不要使用bootstrap置信区间；在三个场景中展示evalstats，其中一个真实LLM评判器虽被验证为“高度一致”，却可能诱导研究者发表虚假发现。
AI.conclusion: 对LLM评判和小样本AI评估必须使用经过校准的统计方法、假设检验与偏差校正；evalstats可自动选择合适方法，帮助研究者更负责任地进行统计推断并避免虚假结论。

title: FD-AA: A Lightweight Focal-Diffuse And Attenuation-Aware Head for Incidental Abdominal Abnormality Detection in Chest CT
summary: Routine chest CT captures upper-abdominal structures that may contain clinically relevant incidental abnormalities. Detecting these findings requires feature extraction from organs with different spatial extents and attenuation patterns. We propose FD-AA, a lightweight organ-aware classification head adaptable for frozen 3-D CT encoders. Within each organ, an attenuation-aware module preserves sparse focal evidence, while masked generalized-mean pooling captures diffuse anomaly patterns. In seven abdominal organs, FD-AA with Pillar-0 achieved state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in both the CT-RATE test set (AUC = 0.798) and the external RAD-ChestCT dataset (AUC = 0.713). More specifically, FD-AA improved macro AUC/AP from 0.763/0.346 to 0.798/0.405 over direct classification using frozen Pillar-0 only (p = 0.034/0.016). Such performance gain generalizes across multiple frozen encoders (AUC improvement on MedicalNet +9.8%, CT-CLIP +14.7%, ResNet +3.7%), demonstrating the effectiveness of FD-AA across different feature representations. These results support the effectiveness of integrating focal-diffuse aggregation with explicit HU evidence for incidental abdominal abnormality detection.

AI.tldr: 提出一种轻量级器官感知分类头FD-AA，可适配冻结的3D CT编码器，用于胸部CT中上腹部偶发异常的检测，并在多个数据集和编码器上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 常规胸部CT会包含上腹部结构，其中可能存在临床相关的偶发异常；但检测这些异常需要从空间范围和衰减模式不同的器官中提取特征，现有方法难以有效捕捉稀疏局灶证据和弥漫异常模式。
AI.method: FD-AA是一种轻量级器官感知分类头，可适配冻结的3-D CT编码器；在每个器官内，使用衰减感知模块保留稀疏局灶证据，并通过掩码广义均值池化捕捉弥漫性异常模式。
AI.result: 在七个腹部器官上，FD-AA结合Pillar-0在CT-RATE测试集达到AUC=0.798，在外部RAD-ChestCT数据集达到AUC=0.713，均为SOTA；相比仅用冻结Pillar-0直接分类，宏AUC/AP从0.763/0.346提升至0.798/0.405，p=0.034/0.016；该提升可泛化到多个冻结编码器，AUC分别提升MedicalNet +9.8%、CT-CLIP +14.7%、ResNet +3.7%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将局灶-弥漫聚合与显式HU证据相结合，可有效提升偶发性腹部异常检测性能，并支持FD-AA在不同特征表示上的通用性。

title: GeoWind2Plan: Mission-Time 3D Urban Wind Prediction for Energy-Efficient UAV Planning
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Spotlight). 31 pages. Code and dataset: https://github.com/DUAL-Xiao/GeoWind2Plan/
summary: In urban low-altitude flight, buildings reshape ambient wind into spatially varying 3D flow, making unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) energy depend on local wind exposure as well as path length. However, building-resolved wind information is rarely available when a mission must be planned. Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) can produce high-fidelity urban flow fields, but each simulation is tied to a fixed inflow boundary condition and can take hours to days, which is incompatible with urban UAV missions that typically last minutes to tens of minutes. We present GeoWind2Plan, a geometry-to-wind-to-planning framework for mission-time 3D urban wind prediction and energy-efficient UAV planning. Given only a background wind vector, 3D building geometry, and a start-goal pair, GeoWind2Plan transforms the building geometry into a reference-wind frame, predicts mission-relevant 3D wind patches with a localized geometry-conditioned neural operator, stitches them into a queryable local wind field, and optimizes a feasible 3D path and speed profile using a physically grounded UAV energy model. Rather than pursuing CFD-perfect reconstruction, GeoWind2Plan targets decision-useful wind prediction: trajectories are planned with predicted wind and evaluated under high-fidelity CFD wind. Across held-out urban domains, wind speeds, and mission wind-angle regimes, GeoWind2Plan performs corridor-localized wind inference in about 3 seconds, compared with roughly 8 hours for CFD. Under CFD evaluation, trajectories planned with GeoWind2Plan reduce energy by 6.9%, 12.7%, and 4.5% in tailwind, headwind, and crosswind missions relative to wind-agnostic planning, recovering 87.9%, 85.7%, and 75.0% of CFD-reference savings. These results show that fast, corridor-localized 3D urban wind prediction can make wind-aware UAV energy planning practical at mission time.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoWind2Plan框架，利用建筑几何与背景风快速预测任务相关三维城市风场，并据此进行无人机节能路径规划；预测约3秒完成，远快于CFD约8小时，且规划轨迹在CFD评估下显著节能。
AI.motivation: 城市低空飞行中建筑使风场复杂化，无人机能耗不仅取决于路径长度，还受局部风影响；但任务规划时通常缺少建筑解析风场，而CFD虽高保真却因固定入流边界且耗时数小时至数天，难以满足分钟级城市无人机任务需求。
AI.method: 提出GeoWind2Plan，将建筑几何转换到参考风坐标系，用局部几何条件神经算子预测任务相关三维风片，拼接为可查询局部风场，再结合物理无人机能量模型优化可行三维路径与速度剖面；规划使用预测风，评估使用高保真CFD风。
AI.result: 在未见城市区域、风速和任务风向条件下，GeoWind2Plan约3秒完成走廊局部风推断，CFD约需8小时；CFD评估下，相比风无关规划，顺风、逆风、侧风任务能耗分别降低6.9%、12.7%、4.5%，并恢复CFD参考节能的87.9%、85.7%、75.0%。
AI.conclusion: 快速、走廊局部化的三维城市风预测可使风感知无人机能量规划在任务时间尺度上变得实用。

title: Ancillary Services in High-Renewable Power Systems: Comparing Market Design, Emerging Trends, and Future Challenges
summary: Rapid growth in renewable generation is changing power-system operation and increasing the importance of ancillary services for security and reliability. As inverter-based resources displace conventional synchronous generation, system operators must procure a broader set of services spanning five categories: frequency control and reserves, voltage and reactive power support, system stability, restoration, and congestion management. This paper compares ancillary-service market design in Great Britain, Germany, Denmark, Italy, California, Texas, and Australia. It examines how these systems define, procure, remunerate, and coordinate services as variable renewable generation increases. The review develops a consistent product-level classification, provides comparable timing visualisations of frequency-control and reserve products, and maps implementation modalities across services and systems. Four trends emerge: faster and more granular frequency-response products, more explicit procurement of stability capabilities including inertia, system strength, and dynamic voltage support, broader participation by storage, demand-side resources, and other inverter-based resources, and greater use of locational, targeted, and technology-neutral procurement. Challenges include limited harmonisation, incomplete valuation of flexibility and stability capabilities whose value depends on location and operating conditions, barriers to participation by distributed and emerging resources, and insufficient coordination between market and operational arrangements. The comparison finds no convergence towards a single market design and supports differentiated but coordinated ancillary-service frameworks reflecting each service's technical, temporal, and locational characteristics.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了英国、德国、丹麦、意大利、加州、得州和澳大利亚的辅助服务市场设计，分析在可再生能源增长背景下辅助服务的定义、采购、报酬和协调方式，并总结趋势与挑战。
AI.motivation: 可再生能源发电快速增长，逆变器型资源逐步取代传统同步发电，系统运营商需要采购更广泛的辅助服务，以保障电力系统安全性和可靠性。
AI.method: 采用跨系统比较研究，建立一致的产品级分类，提供频率控制和备用产品的可比时间可视化，并映射不同服务和系统下的实施方式。
AI.result: 发现四大趋势：频率响应产品更快更精细；惯量、系统强度和动态电压支撑等稳定性能力被更明确采购；储能、需求侧资源和其他逆变器型资源参与更广；位置性、针对性和技术中性采购增加。挑战包括协调不足、灵活性和稳定性价值评估不完整、分布式和新兴资源参与壁垒，以及市场与运行安排协调不够。
AI.conclusion: 未发现向单一市场设计收敛的趋势，支持建立差异化但协调的辅助服务框架，以反映各项服务在技术、时间和位置上的特征。

title: PreviewDiff: Multimodal Critic-Guided Search over Diffusion Latents
summary: Diffusion models can produce striking images and videos, but they still struggle with the compositional details that make a generation faithful to a prompt, such as object counts, attribute binding, spatial relations, and temporally grounded actions. A common way to improve prompt satisfaction is to spend more compute at test time through Best-of-N sampling, but final-sample selection is fixed. Best-of-N can only choose among completed outputs and cannot repair a promising trajectory before it fails. We introduce PreviewDiff, a training-free test-time search method that turns diffusion sampling from scalar search into a multimodal critic-guided search over intermediate latents. At selected denoising checkpoints, PreviewDiff decodes a partial preview, asks a multimodal judge to score and critique it, and uses the resulting natural-language feedback to branch over semantic prompt edits and locally re-noised latent continuations. These branches are then scored and selectively rolled forward, allowing verifier compute to guide generation while the sample is still editable. Across image and video generation benchmarks, PreviewDiff consistently improves over budget-matched Best-of-N selection and strong scalar-search baselines. Ablations show that earlier interventions and increased search width provide the largest gains, while deeper search and additional semantic variants offer complementary improvements. PreviewDiff demonstrates that multimodal feedback is most useful not only as a final verifier, but as an active controller inside the denoising process.

AI.tldr: 提出 PreviewDiff，一种无需训练的多模态评论引导的测试时搜索方法，通过在扩散去噪中间步骤解码预览、用多模态评判模型评分并生成自然语言反馈，来分支编辑提示与局部重加噪潜在轨迹，从而在样本仍可编辑时引导生成。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在物体计数、属性绑定、空间关系和时间动作等组合细节上仍难以忠实遵循提示。Best-of-N 只能在完整输出中选择，无法在失败前修复有希望的生成轨迹。
AI.method: PreviewDiff 是无需训练的测试时搜索方法，将扩散采样从标量搜索转为多模态评论引导的中间潜在搜索。在选定的去噪检查点解码部分预览，让多模态评判模型打分并给出自然语言批评，据此在语义提示编辑和局部重加噪潜在延续上进行分支，再对分支评分并选择性继续前向生成。
AI.result: 在图像和视频生成基准上，PreviewDiff 持续优于预算匹配的 Best-of-N 选择和强标量搜索基线。消融实验表明，更早干预和增大搜索宽度带来最大增益，更深搜索和更多语义变体提供互补提升。
AI.conclusion: 多模态反馈不仅可作为最终验证器，更可作为去噪过程中的主动控制器，在样本仍可编辑时利用验证器计算引导生成，从而提升提示遵循度。

title: PrimeSeeker: Capability-Oriented Supervision for Deep Search Agents
summary: Large language model search agents are often trained with synthetic questions whose difficulty is increased through larger evidence graphs, additional hops, and longer trajectories. These global properties, however, are only indirect proxies for the local retrieval capabilities required during search. To address this mismatch, we introduce latent anchor reasoning, which consists of resolving an unnamed retrieval anchor from descriptive specifications and transferring the recovered anchor into a subsequent information demand. This primitive retrieval unit decomposes deep search into chains of coupled operations and organizes question construction around anchor resolution and relation transfer, without prescribing a canonical search path. Based on this formulation, we propose PrimeSeeker, a capability-oriented framework that constructs web-grounded anchor structures and jointly derives a question and a reference evidence skeleton. The skeleton preserves supporting evidence from construction and guides expert generation through extractive highlights of current tool observations. These highlights are removed before supervised fine-tuning, while the skeleton is subsequently reused to audit reference-step coverage for reinforcement-learning rewards. We construct 9,221 expert trajectories, training a 30B search agent. Across five deep-search benchmarks, PrimeSeeker achieves strong performance, while reference-step optimization further improves the supervised policy. The resulting trajectories exhibit low retrieval redundancy, and fixed-budget evaluation shows strong solution coverage with substantially fewer tool calls than long-horizon systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出潜在锚点推理，将深度搜索分解为未命名检索锚点的解析与关系迁移，并基于此构建PrimeSeeker框架，训练30B搜索智能体，在多个深度搜索基准上取得强性能且工具调用更少。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型搜索智能体常通过扩大证据图、增加跳数和轨迹长度来提升合成问题难度，但这些全局属性只是搜索所需局部检索能力的间接代理，存在训练目标与能力需求不匹配的问题。
AI.method: 提出潜在锚点推理，以锚点解析和关系迁移组织问题构建；提出PrimeSeeker，构建网络锚点结构并联合生成问题与参考证据骨架；专家生成时利用当前工具观察的抽取式高亮引导，高亮在监督微调前移除；参考证据骨架随后用于审计参考步骤覆盖并作为强化学习奖励；构建9,221条专家轨迹训练30B搜索智能体。
AI.result: 在五个深度搜索基准上表现强劲，参考步骤优化进一步提升监督策略；生成轨迹检索冗余低；固定预算评估中，相比长时程系统以显著更少工具调用实现较强解决方案覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 围绕局部检索能力而非全局难度的锚点式训练框架，能更好对齐深度搜索所需能力，提升搜索智能体的性能与效率。

title: Mirror-Score: Calibrated, Inference-only Scoring Exposes the Limits of Sequence-compatibility Ranking in D-peptide Design
summary: D-peptides combine protease resistance with high target specificity, but computational design of D-peptide binders remains immature. Mirror-Peptidizer introduced an in silico mirror-image screening pipeline using target reflection, backbone generation, and ProteinMPNN sequence design, but its raw ProteinMPNN negative log-likelihood (NLL) ranking was not validated against measured affinities, and only 4 of 9 tested MDM2 designs bound detectably. We introduce Mirror-Score, a calibrated, inference-only scoring framework for heterochiral D-peptide/L-protein complexes, and a public benchmark of 31 crystal complexes across four target families, including 18 with literature-verified affinities. Raw ProteinMPNN NLL is not a valid affinity ranker: its pooled Spearman correlation with affinity is 0.19, and correlations reverse between MDM2/CHIP (+0.62) and gp41 (-0.70). We therefore evaluate Boltz-2 mirror-space cofolding confidence. For the complete viral-entry family (7 structures representing 3 peptides), interface predicted local distance difference test (pLDDT) achieves structure-level leave-one-out Spearman rho = 0.90 (p = 0.006) and correctly orders all three peptides by affinity, whereas NLL fails (structure-level rho = 0.18). Because only three independent chemotypes are represented, this result indicates directional consistency rather than a statistically validated predictor. Cross-family calibration does not transfer at current sample sizes, supporting family-matched calibration as the practical deployment mode. We also specify a prospective design protocol for the antimicrobial-resistance targets LasR and LecB from Pseudomonas aeruginosa, including mirrored structures, ligand-derived hotspot maps, diffusion-model-ready inputs, and Mirror-Score ranking. Code, benchmark data, structures, and analysis scripts are openly available at https://github.com/Jiadalee/Mirror-Score.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Mirror-Score，一个用于异手性 D-肽/L-蛋白复合物的校准型纯推理评分框架，并构建了包含 31 个晶体复合物、覆盖四类靶标家族的公开基准，用于检验 D-肽结合剂的计算设计与亲和力排序。
AI.motivation: D-肽兼具蛋白酶抗性和高靶标特异性，但计算设计仍不成熟。已有 Mirror-Peptidizer 流程依赖 ProteinMPNN 的 NLL 排序，却未与实测亲和力验证，且 MDM2 设计中仅 4/9 可检测结合，因此需要更可靠的评分与基准。
AI.method: 构建 Mirror-Score 评分框架及 31 个晶体复合物基准，其中 18 个有文献验证亲和力。评估原始 ProteinMPNN NLL 与亲和力的相关性，并测试 Boltz-2 镜像空间共折叠置信度，如界面 pLDDT，同时进行结构级留一法 Spearman 相关分析和跨家族校准。
AI.result: 原始 ProteinMPNN NLL 不是有效亲和力排序器：总体 Spearman 仅 0.19，且在 MDM2/CHIP 为 +0.62、gp41 为 -0.70，方向相反。对完整病毒进入家族，界面 pLDDT 的结构级留一法 Spearman rho 达 0.90，p=0.006，并能正确排序三条肽；NLL 失败，rho=0.18。但仅三个独立化学型，说明仅具方向一致性而非统计验证预测器。跨家族校准在当前样本量下不能迁移，支持按家族匹配校准。
AI.conclusion: Mirror-Score 表明应谨慎使用原始 NLL 排序，镜像空间共折叠置信度如 pLDDT 更有潜力，但需家族匹配校准和更大样本验证。论文还为铜绿假单胞菌耐药靶标 LasR 和 LecB 提出前瞻性设计协议，并公开代码、基准数据、结构和分析脚本。

title: DQ-MPCC: Dual-Quaternion MPCC for Quadrotor Racing
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters
summary: Quadrotor racing demands aggressive attitude and progress control while passing through every gate, and conventional quadrotor MPCC formulations state the prediction model in inertial coordinates and the attitude error in the body frame. We present a Dual-Quaternion Model Predictive Contouring Control (DQ-MPCC) for quadrotor racing in which the pose is a unit dual quaternion and the contouring errors are projected onto the tangent space of the dual quaternion manifold, expressed in the desired body frame: the same rigid-body dynamics as the conventional model, in unified pose-twist coordinates in the body frame. We compare DQ-MPCC against a baseline MPCC through Monte Carlo software-in-the-loop simulations and real-world racing on an eight-gate circuit of 11x4.5x3.65 m. With the same gains in simulation and hardware, DQ-MPCC keeps every crossing of its completed flights within the prescribed geometric margin, whereas the baseline exceeds it, its median worst-gate offset growing by 71.5% sim-to-real against a 10.1% decrease for DQ-MPCC. Among the configurations that keep every simulated gate crossing within the geometric margin, DQ-MPCC also reduces the minimum lap time by 6.7%, and by 10.5% in the real-world flights, while running onboard at 100 Hz.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于四旋翼竞速的双四元数模型预测轮廓控制（DQ-MPCC），将位姿表示为单位双四元数，轮廓误差投影到双四元数流形切空间并在期望机体系表达，实现统一的位姿-旋量坐标下的刚体动力学控制。
AI.motivation: 四旋翼竞速要求激进姿态与进度控制并穿过每个门；传统MPCC在惯性系中建模预测、在机体系中定义姿态误差，存在坐标不统一问题，需要更统一的位姿表示与控制方法。
AI.method: 采用双四元数MPCC，将位姿建模为单位双四元数，轮廓误差投影到双四元数流形切空间并表达在期望机体系；使用与传统模型相同的刚体动力学，在机体系下以统一位姿-旋量坐标描述。通过蒙特卡洛软件在环仿真和真实八门赛道（11x4.5x3.65 m）与基线MPCC对比。
AI.result: 相同增益下，仿真和硬件中DQ-MPCC所有已完成飞行的过门均在规定几何裕度内，而基线超出；基线最差门偏移中位数从仿真到现实增大71.5%，DQ-MPCC则降低10.1%。在所有仿真过门均保持在几何裕度内的配置中，DQ-MPCC最小圈速降低6.7%，真实飞行降低10.5%，并以100 Hz机载运行。
AI.conclusion: DQ-MPCC通过双四元数统一位姿-旋量表示和轮廓误差投影，提高了四旋翼竞速的过门精度与圈速，并在仿真与真实世界中验证了有效性和实时性。

title: Vertiport Design Methodology and Capacity Analysis
summary: This paper presents a comprehensive methodology for vertiport design and capacity analysis using stochastic queueing models. Vertiport capacity is defined as the maximum steady-state throughput of aircraft per hour while maintaining a specified maximum queuing delay with high probability. We introduce a two-node queueing network model with a finite buffer to analytically derive mean queue lengths and delays at singleTLOF vertiports, supported by a simulation model that validates these findings under various operational conditions. Our analyses reveal that vertiport capacity is significantly constrained by the interactions between takeoff/landing operations and turnaround activities. Capacity is further reduced by the variance in these operational parameters, with deterministic times substantially enhancing capacity. The study shows that vertiport throughput is typically around 50% of the theoretical maximum departure capacity in a Markovian model, decreasing sharply as confidence in maximum queuing delay increases. Non-Markovian models with adequate parking pads achieve full TLOF capacity. Additionally, our methodology identifies the optimal number of parking pads required to maximize throughput per unit area. The findings provide insights for designing vertiport infrastructure to support scalable and efficient UAM deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于随机排队模型的垂直起降场设计与容量分析方法，用于评估单TLOF垂直起降场的容量、排队延迟及停车位配置。
AI.motivation: 为了支持可扩展且高效的UAM部署，需要合理设计垂直起降场基础设施，并准确分析其容量与运行效率。
AI.method: 构建带有限缓冲区的两节点排队网络模型，解析推导单TLOF垂直起降场的平均队列长度和延迟，并用仿真模型在不同运行条件下验证。
AI.result: 容量受起降操作与周转活动交互显著约束，运行参数方差会降低容量，确定性时间可提升容量；马尔可夫模型中吞吐量约为理论最大离场容量的50%，且随最大排队延迟置信度提高而急剧下降；非马尔可夫模型在停车位充足时可达到满TLOF容量，并识别出使单位面积吞吐量最大化的最优停车位数量。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为垂直起降场基础设施设计提供了洞见，有助于支持可扩展、高效的UAM部署。

title: Less Uniform Discrete Diffusion is More Powerful and Scalable
summary: Although uniform diffusion language models (UDLMs) represent a promising diffusion paradigm, scaling them remains challenging. We identify the core obstacle as an over-uniform training objective and condition-target confusion during sampling. To address these, we propose Less Uniform Diffusion (LUDI), a novel UDLM framework. Specifically, we (i) introduce a less uniform loss that directs each reverse transition toward the clean token, and (ii) equip the model with per-token time embeddings that supply token-level corruption hints, enabling confidence-based few-step sampling. Experiments across scales show that LUDI yields cleaner supervision and improves few-step generation. We further continue-train a 7B autoregressive model into LUDI-7B, resulting in a UDLM capable of complex reasoning. It achieves a 3-token-per-step speedup over AR decoding and competitive performance compared with masked diffusion baselines, revealing that the full potential of UDLMs for complex generation remains to be unlocked.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LUDI，一种改进的均匀扩散语言模型框架，通过更少均匀的损失和每 token 时间嵌入，提升少步生成质量，并将 7B 自回归模型继续训练为具备复杂推理能力的扩散语言模型。
AI.motivation: 均匀扩散语言模型（UDLMs）难以扩展，核心障碍是训练目标过度均匀以及采样时的条件-目标混淆。
AI.method: 提出 Less Uniform Diffusion (LUDI)：引入 less uniform loss，使每个反向转移直接指向干净 token；加入 per-token time embeddings 提供 token 级 corruption hints，支持基于置信度的少步采样。
AI.result: 跨规模实验显示 LUDI 提供更干净的监督并改善少步生成；将 7B 自回归模型继续训练为 LUDI-7B，实现复杂推理，相比 AR 解码获得 3 token/step 加速，且与 masked diffusion 基线性能相当。
AI.conclusion: UDLM 在复杂生成上的全部潜力尚未被完全释放，LUDI 揭示了改进方向与可行性。

title: Closed-Form Cartesian Forward Kinetostatics for Spatial Multi-Segment Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots
summary: Forward kinetostatics of spatial tendon-driven continuum robots typically requires a nonlinear equilibrium solve for each actuation input. This paper develops a force-to-Cartesian-configuration model with a closed-form solution in quadratures for spatial multi-segment robots under tendon actuation. The Cartesian backbone centerline and accumulated material twist serve as generalized coordinates, from which the strain measures and tendon geometry are derived. Variational equilibrium yields explicit axial and bending relations and establishes zero equilibrium material twist within the proposed model for admissible longitudinal non-helical routing. The solution is propagated segment by segment without an iterative equilibrium solve, while retaining axial deformation, spatially varying axial and bending stiffnesses and tendon-routing diameter, and segment-dependent tendon participation. Numerical comparisons with a full-strain geometric variable-strain model (GVS) yield maximum length-normalized tip-position discrepancies of 8.91 x 10^-6 and 1.01 x 10^-5 for the single- and three-segment robots, respectively. Mean evaluation times of 1.52 μs and 2.94 μs, with corresponding speedups of approximately 1864x and 3348x over the baseline, demonstrate the computational advantage of the explicit force-to-configuration mapping in the reported benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于空间多段腱驱动连续机器人的力到笛卡尔构型闭式求积模型，可逐段传播求解，无需迭代平衡计算。
AI.motivation: 空间腱驱动连续机器人的正向运动静力学通常需要对每个驱动输入进行非线性平衡求解，计算成本较高。
AI.method: 以骨干中心线和累积材料扭转作为广义坐标，推导应变度量与腱几何；通过变分平衡得到显式轴向和弯曲关系，并在所提模型中建立 admissible 纵向非螺旋路由下的零平衡材料扭转；采用逐段传播而非迭代平衡求解，同时保留轴向变形、空间变化轴向/弯曲刚度、腱路由直径和分段腱参与。
AI.result: 与全应变几何变应变模型（GVS）相比，单段和三段机器人的最大长度归一化末端位置误差分别为 8.91×10^-6 和 1.01×10^-5；平均评估时间为 1.52 μs 和 2.94 μs，相对基线加速约 1864 倍和 3348 倍。
AI.conclusion: 显式力到构型映射在所报道基准中展现出显著计算优势，可高效且精确地求解空间腱驱动连续机器人的正向运动静力学。

title: Sparse-View Interpretable 3D Animal Behavior Representations for Neural Encoding and Decoding
summary: A deeper understanding of brain function requires a precise, structured characterization of behavior.Yet, extracting behavioral representations from video in a form suitable for scientific analysis remains a fundamental challenge. Many prior studies represent behavior via pose estimation or nonlinear video embeddings. However, pose tracking discards rich information beyond predefined keypoints, while nonlinear video embeddings lack interpretability. We address this limitation with SABLE (Sparse-view Animal Behavior Latent Embeddings), a self-supervised framework that leverages a geometric inductive bias to learn behavior representations.By augmenting a multi-view transformer with priors from monocular depth and pose estimation, SABLE reconstructs 3D animal behavior from extremely sparse views while learning explicit 3D latent structure. Without ground-truth 3D labels, it reliably recovers 3D behavior from two-view videos, whereas state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods fail or yield degenerate solutions. Across the International Brain Lab and Cheese3D datasets, we demonstrate that SABLE learns 3D representations that match or exceed prior SOTA performance in neural encoding and decoding. Once pretrained across animals, SABLE serves as an off-the-shelf model that generalizes zero-shot to unseen animals without animal-specific calibration or retraining. Our method establishes 3D-aware video embeddings that capture complex behavior, opening new avenues for studying brain-behavior relationships.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SABLE，一种自监督框架，利用几何归纳偏置从极稀疏视角视频中学习可解释的 3D 动物行为潜表征，并证明其在神经编码/解码和跨动物零样本泛化上优于或匹配现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有行为表征方法存在局限：姿态估计会丢失预定义关键点之外的信息，而非线性视频嵌入缺乏可解释性；因此需要从视频中提取结构化、可解释且适合科学分析的行为表征。
AI.method: SABLE 将多视角 Transformer 与单目深度和姿态估计先验结合，在无 3D 真值标签下，从双视角视频中重建 3D 动物行为并学习显式 3D 潜结构，实现自监督的稀疏视角行为表征学习。
AI.result: 在 International Brain Lab 和 Cheese3D 数据集上，SABLE 学到的 3D 表征在神经编码与解码任务中达到或超过先前 SOTA；从双视角视频中可靠恢复 3D 行为，而 SOTA 方法失败或产生退化解；预训练后可零样本泛化到未见动物，无需个体校准或重训练。
AI.conclusion: SABLE 建立了能够捕捉复杂行为的 3D 感知视频嵌入，为研究脑-行为关系提供了新途径。

title: $τ$-Multilingual: Benchmarking Voice Agents Across Languages
summary: English-only benchmarks expose only a narrow slice of voice-agent behavior. We introduce $τ$-Multilingual, extending $τ$-Voice to Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Hindi, Korean, and Mandarin with native-speaker review and evaluation of generated language and spoken output. Across 4,500 full-duplex calls and five voice configurations, Spanish, Portuguese, and Hindi remain within 3.2 task-completion points of English, but Korean and Mandarin fall by 14.7 and 8.4 points. The failure modes also vary: Korean systems miss more responses, Mandarin systems interrupt more often, and both struggle with tools and entities. Grok leads task completion but scores lowest on generation quality, motivating separate task, interaction, and generation reporting. We release language packs, validated judges, and tools for community-built multilingual voice-agent evaluation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 τ-Multilingual，将 τ-Voice 扩展到西班牙语、巴西葡萄牙语、印地语、韩语和普通话，并引入母语者评审来评估多语言语音智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要面向英语，只能反映语音智能体行为的一小部分，无法全面评估多语言场景下的表现。
AI.method: 在 τ-Voice 基础上扩展五种语言，使用母语者评审生成语言和语音输出，并开展 4500 通全双工通话、五种语音配置的评估。
AI.result: 西班牙语、葡萄牙语和印地语与英语的任务完成率差距在 3.2 个百分点内，但韩语和普通话分别下降 14.7 和 8.4 个百分点。失败模式不同：韩语系统更多漏答，普通话系统更频繁打断，两者在工具和实体处理上都较吃力。Grok 任务完成领先但生成质量最低，说明应分别报告任务、交互和生成指标。
AI.conclusion: 多语言语音智能体评估需要母语者参与和分维度报告；论文发布语言包、经验证的评判器及工具，支持社区构建多语言语音智能体评测。

title: LIBERO-MAX: Do Robot Policies Adapt When the World Changes?
summary: Robots must often continue a task after a target moves, the viewpoint shifts, or an obstacle appears, even though their earlier observations and committed actions reflect the previous scene. Many simulation robustness benchmarks fix external conditions at reset, leaving this temporal challenge underexamined. We introduce LIBERO-MAX, a benchmark of 8,000 paired cases spanning eight types of changes to geometry, observations, appearance, clutter, and paths. Each pair compares task execution with and without a mid-task event, holding the task, initial state, policy seed, and pre-event action sequence fixed. This controlled comparison distinguishes event-associated regressions from failures already present without the change. Across fourteen current VLA, hybrid, and world-action policies, events reduce success by 11.0-25.7 percentage points. Event profiles reveal shared vulnerabilities to geometry and observation changes, while policy-family rankings interleave. Camera controls show that robustness reflects both competence under the changed conditions and the trajectory from which they are encountered; varying query cadence does not eliminate the gap. Together, the paired protocol and temporal diagnostics establish LIBERO-MAX as a reproducible testbed for diagnosing failures under mid-execution changes and measuring progress toward robot policies that remain effective as the world changes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LIBERO-MAX，一个包含 8,000 个配对案例、覆盖八类几何/观测/外观/杂乱/路径变化的基准，用于评估机器人在任务执行中遇到变化时能否继续完成任务。
AI.motivation: 机器人常需在目标移动、视角变化或障碍出现后继续任务，但已有仿真鲁棒性基准多在重置时固定外部条件，忽视了任务执行过程中发生变化的时序挑战。
AI.method: 构建配对实验：每个案例比较有/无任务中事件时的执行表现，并固定任务、初始状态、策略种子和事件前动作序列；评测十四种 VLA、混合及 world-action 策略，并分析事件画像、相机控制和查询频率影响。
AI.result: 任务中事件使十四种策略成功率下降 11.0–25.7 个百分点；策略普遍对几何和观测变化脆弱，不同策略家族排名交错；鲁棒性既取决于变化条件下的能力，也取决于遭遇变化时的轨迹，改变查询频率不能消除差距。
AI.conclusion: LIBERO-MAX 提供了可复现的测试平台，可用于诊断任务执行中变化导致的失败，并衡量机器人策略在动态世界变化下持续有效的进展。

title: LongCat-DeepResearch Technical Report
summary: We present LongCat-DeepResearch, a deep research system that combines an enhanced LongCat model with a multi-agent workflow for producing comprehensive, evidence-grounded reports. The workflow separates global planning from detailed investigation and coordinates revision at the section level. Multiple planning agents first explore external sources and refine an actionable research plan, termed ResearchSpec. Research agents then investigate and draft their assigned sections in parallel, gathering additional evidence in separate contexts as their analyses develop. Once the sections are assembled, global review guides targeted local revisions, reducing reliance on repeated full-report rewriting. This workflow also supports the construction of research tasks and trajectories for the mid-training and post-training of LongCat's general-purpose models. LongCat-DeepResearch achieves 55.25 on DeepResearchBench, 51.35 on DeepResearchBench II, and 79.83 on ResearchRubrics. On an in-house benchmark, it scores 76.04, ranking second among four compared systems. Development-set analyses show benefits from combining planning perspectives, while further planning refinement has mixed effects. Additional editing improves average automatic readability preference across two benchmarks, with different trends on each.

AI.tldr: 提出 LongCat-DeepResearch 深度研究系统，将增强的 LongCat 模型与多智能体工作流结合，可生成全面且基于证据的研究报告，同时支持模型训练数据构建。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究系统在全局规划与细节调查之间耦合过紧，常需反复重写整篇报告，效率低且难以保证证据充分性；同时缺乏可用于模型微调的高质量研究轨迹。
AI.method: 采用多智能体工作流：先由多个规划智能体探索外部来源并生成可执行的研究计划 ResearchSpec，实现全局规划与细节调查分离；随后研究智能体并行调查各自章节、在独立上下文中补充证据；章节汇总后由全局审查指导局部定向修改，避免整篇重写。该流程亦用于构建中期训练与后训练所需的研究任务与轨迹。
AI.result: 在 DeepResearchBench 得 55.25，DeepResearchBench II 得 51.35，ResearchRubrics 得 79.83；内部基准得 76.04，在四个对比系统中排名第二。开发集分析显示多规划视角组合有益，而进一步规划细化效果不一；额外编辑提升两个基准上的平均自动可读性偏好，但各基准趋势不同。
AI.conclusion: LongCat-DeepResearch 通过规划与调查分离、并行章节撰写和局部修订，有效提升报告质量与效率，并可作为通用模型训练数据的来源；但规划细化与可读性改进的效果因设定而异。

title: From Demand to System Co-Shaping: A Review of User Roles in Transportation Systems
summary: Users are central to transportation systems, yet their roles are often simplified in transportation modeling and decision-making. Conventional approaches primarily represent users through demand-related inputs, such as trip flows, delivery requests, and charging loads. However, digital, electrified, and platform-based services create more direct user-system interactions, with users responding to prices, incentives, service availability, and information in ways that can influence operational and planning decisions. This review develops a concept-oriented, taxonomy-based synthesis of how user-related information is represented and used in transportation decision-making. Rather than organizing the literature primarily by transport domain, we distinguish three user roles: passive demand, operational agents, and system co-shapers. Drawing on studies across transportation electrification, urban logistics, shared mobility, multimodal transport, and Mobility-as-a-Service (MaaS), the review examines how user preferences, flexibility, willingness to pay, acceptance, participation, and feedback are incorporated into modeling and decision frameworks. The synthesis shows that progress has been made in measuring and predicting user behavior, but user-related variables are still often used mainly for behavioral analysis rather than as actionable inputs to system decisions. Their integration into operational decision-making remains incomplete, and systematic feedback from operational user responses and outcomes to long-term planning is even more limited. Key challenges include closing the loop between operation and planning, modeling heterogeneous and strategic users, integrating optimization with user acceptance, and ensuring privacy, equity, and deployability. Together, these findings point toward a shift from user-behavior analysis to user-informed and user-driven transportation system design.

AI.tldr: 该综述提出以用户角色为基础的概念性分类框架，系统梳理交通决策中用户相关信息的表示与使用，指出用户变量多用于行为分析而非可操作的决策输入，并呼吁转向用户知情和用户驱动的交通系统设计。
AI.motivation: 传统交通建模和决策常将用户简化为需求输入，如出行流、配送请求和充电负荷。但数字化、电动化和平台化服务使用户与系统直接互动，用户会对价格、激励、服务可用性和信息作出反应，进而影响运营与规划决策，因此需要系统理解用户信息如何被表示和使用。
AI.method: 采用概念导向、基于分类法的文献综述，而非按交通领域组织。将用户角色分为三类：被动需求、运营代理、系统共同塑造者。综述覆盖交通电气化、城市物流、共享出行、多式联运和MaaS等研究，考察用户偏好、灵活性、支付意愿、接受度、参与和反馈如何被纳入建模与决策框架。
AI.result: 综述发现，用户在测量和预测方面已有进展，但用户相关变量仍主要用于行为分析，而非作为系统决策的可操作输入。其融入运营决策仍不完整，且从运营层面用户响应和结果到长期规划的系统性反馈更有限。关键挑战包括：闭合运营与规划之间的环路、建模异质且策略性用户、将优化与用户接受度结合，以及确保隐私、公平和可部署性。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现共同指向一种转变：从用户行为分析转向用户知情和用户驱动的交通系统设计。

title: Distilling Privileged Control Barrier Functions into RGB-Only Safety Filters for Dynamic Visual Navigation
summary: RGB-only end-to-end visual navigation policies remain vulnerable to collisions in real-world dynamic environments, motivating a dedicated safety layer. Existing visual Control Barrier Function (CBF) approaches seek to provide safety from RGB observations, but often rely on real-time rendering or explicit scene reconstruction and are primarily designed for static scenes, limiting their practicality for onboard deployment. We propose a teacher-student visual distillation framework that transfers the safety behavior of a privileged CBF teacher to an RGB-only student filter for dynamic environments. The student maps a short RGB history, robot velocity, and a nominal control action directly to a safe action, while the teacher uses ground-truth robot and obstacle states in a real-to-sim dynamic Gaussian Splatting environment. To reduce the teacher-student information gap, the teacher constructs safety constraints only from obstacles observable within the student's RGB history. It also accounts for obstacle-velocity uncertainty to improve robustness to motion variations, while action augmentation exposes the student to diverse safe and unsafe nominal actions to better capture the safety boundary. At deployment, the student requires only RGB observations and robot velocity, without explicit 3D reconstruction or online rendering. Experiments show that the proposed method outperforms visual CBF baselines and improves the safety of RGB-based navigation policies under dynamic obstacle motion. Project page: https://syeon-yoo.github.io/distill-cbf-site/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种教师-学生视觉蒸馏框架，将特权CBF教师的安全行为迁移到仅依赖RGB的学生安全滤波器，用于动态环境下的视觉导航避碰。
AI.motivation: RGB-only端到端视觉导航策略在真实动态环境中易发生碰撞，需要专门安全层；现有视觉CBF方法常依赖实时渲染或显式场景重建，且主要面向静态场景，难以机载部署。
AI.method: 采用教师-学生蒸馏：教师在real-to-sim动态Gaussian Splatting环境中使用真实机器人与障碍物状态构建CBF；学生输入短RGB历史、机器人速度和名义控制动作，直接输出安全动作。为缩小信息差，教师仅使用学生RGB历史中可观测的障碍物构建安全约束，并考虑障碍物速度不确定性；通过动作增强让学生接触多样安全/不安全名义动作。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法优于视觉CBF基线，并在动态障碍物运动下提升了基于RGB导航策略的安全性。
AI.conclusion: 部署时学生仅需RGB观测和机器人速度，无需显式3D重建或在线渲染，为动态环境中的RGB视觉导航提供了更实用的机载安全层。

title: SMat-Attention: Structured Long-Context Sequence Modeling
summary: Long-context sequence models face a fundamental tradeoff: softmax attention uses flexible token-level interactions at quadratic cost, whereas linear attention obtains linear-time training and constant-time decoding by compressing history into a fixed-size state. In this work, we ask whether we can connect these regimes through a tunable notion of structure. To this end, we introduce Structured Matrix Attention (SMat-Attention) via a family of causal masks with structured long-range routing whose row supports have VC-dimension $d$. In our construction, $d=1$ recovers the standard causal mask, and increasing $d$ permits richer subset-routing patterns. We give chunkwise forward and backward algorithms to enable hardware-efficiency. For sequences of length $T$, the hard-routing construction takes $O(T^{2-3/d}+T)$ work, despite the mask being dense, for our prescribed family. In fixed-horizon streaming, decoding after the distant prefix takes constant time per token using $O(T^{1-1/d})$ cached states. SMat-Attention therefore makes VC-dimension an explicit knob governing access-pattern complexity, prefill cost, and decoding memory. Empirically, subset-routing and rule-assisted multi-key retrieval experiments illustrate the masks' routing expressiveness. Extensions to Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet using learned routing with top-$k$ query reads retain subquadratic prefill, improve recall accuracy over the backbones in several settings, and achieve comparable small-scale language-modeling performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Structured Matrix Attention（SMat-Attention），用 VC 维 d 调节结构化因果掩码的长程路由，从而在 softmax attention 与 linear attention 之间建立可调结构连接。
AI.motivation: softmax attention 具有灵活的 token 级交互但训练为二次成本；linear attention 训练线性、解码常数时间，但把历史压缩到固定状态，表达能力受限。作者希望用可调的结构化程度统一二者。
AI.method: 构造一类因果掩码，其行支持集 VC 维为 d；d=1 退化为标准因果掩码，增大 d 允许更丰富的子集路由。给出分块前向与反向算法以提升硬件效率。硬路由在长度 T 下约需 O(T^{2-3/d}+T) 计算；固定窗口流式解码中，远端前缀之后每 token 常数时间，需 O(T^{1-1/d}) 缓存状态。并将该思路扩展到 Mamba-2 与 Gated DeltaNet，采用学习路由与 top-k query reads。
AI.result: 理论上，VC 维 d 显式控制访问模式复杂度、预填充成本与解码内存。实验上，子集路由与规则辅助多键检索展示了掩码的路由表达力；扩展到 Mamba-2 和 Gated DeltaNet 后仍保持亚二次预填充，在多个设置中提升召回准确率，并在小规模语言建模上取得可比性能。
AI.conclusion: SMat-Attention 将 VC 维作为调节旋钮，连接 softmax attention 与 linear attention，在复杂度、预填充成本和解码内存之间提供可调权衡，并具备向线性注意力骨干网络扩展的潜力。

title: Reduced-Order Model Characterization of Nonlinear Sustained Oscillations
summary: Nonlinear sustained oscillations involving inverter-based resources can happen when device and network interactions produce an attracting limit cycle around an unstable equilibrium. A damping controller must then describe nonlinear dynamics over the region between the two invariant sets, where a local equilibrium linearization can be insufficient. In this paper, a controlled phase--isostable model is first developed on a two-dimensional invariant manifold connecting the equilibrium and the limit cycle. Dynamics on this surface are represented by phase and isostable coordinates, while physical states and control inputs are related to these coordinates through nonlinear reconstruction and response functions. The required functions are computed from connecting trajectories and periodic-orbit data. A control strategy is then designed to provide extra damping while limiting phase distortion. Case studies on a two-area system and an IEEE 39-bus system demonstrate more effective oscillation damping than the compared equilibrium-linearized designs under the same conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文针对逆变器资源引发的非线性持续振荡，提出基于受控相位-等稳定坐标的阻尼控制方法，并在两区域和IEEE 39节点系统中验证其优于平衡点线性化设计。
AI.motivation: 当设备与电网交互产生围绕不稳定平衡点的吸引极限环时，局部平衡点线性化难以描述平衡点与极限环之间的非线性动态，因此需要更有效的阻尼控制器。
AI.method: 首先在连接平衡点与极限环的二维不变流形上建立受控相位-等稳定模型，用相位和等稳定坐标表示动态，并通过非线性重构和响应函数关联物理状态与控制输入；所需函数由连接轨迹和周期轨道数据计算；随后设计兼顾额外阻尼与限制相位畸变的控制策略。
AI.result: 在两区域系统和IEEE 39节点系统算例中，相同条件下该方法比对比的平衡点线性化设计具有更有效的振荡阻尼效果。
AI.conclusion: 受控相位-等稳定建模与控制策略能够更好处理逆变器资源引起的非线性持续振荡，提升阻尼性能并限制相位畸变。

title: LeRF: Learning Reference Coordinate Frames for Perspective Taking Reasoning
summary: Perspective taking is a fundamental component of spatial intelligence, requiring models interpret spatial relations from a specified viewpoint, such as that of another entity or an imagined observer. Despite the increasing spatial reasoning capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), they still struggle with perspective taking, often defaulting to the camera viewpoint when a query requires reasoning from a different perspective. We introduce Learning Reference Coordinate Frames for Perspective Taking (LeRF), a framework that trains VLMs to construct and use explicit reference frames for viewpoint-dependent reasoning. Given an image and a query, LeRF decides whether a coordinate frame is necessary. If so, it grounds the reference entity and predicts the frame's origin and entity-centered reference frame. A lightweight renderer overlays the frame onto the image, enabling subsequent reasoning over these visual cues without external perception models or explicit 3D reconstruction. To learn this process, we first perform supervised fine-tuning to teach selective tool invocation and reference coordinate frame prediction, followed by reinforcement learning on spatial VQA pairs to improve frame-guided reasoning. Across diverse perspective-taking benchmarks, LeRF consistently improves over its backbone and achieves strong performance against existing open-source methods. Further evaluations also show improved reference-frame grounding and orientation estimation, supporting the effectiveness of learned reference frames for viewpoint-dependent reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LeRF框架，通过训练视觉语言模型构建并使用显式参考坐标系，以提升视角采择能力。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在视角采择任务中表现不佳，常默认使用相机视角，无法从其他视角进行空间推理。
AI.method: LeRF首先判断是否需要坐标系，若需要则定位参考实体并预测坐标系原点及以实体为中心的参考系；轻量级渲染器将坐标系叠加到图像上，进而基于视觉线索推理。训练分两阶段：监督微调学习选择性调用工具和预测参考坐标系，再通过强化学习在空间VQA数据上优化框架引导的推理。
AI.result: 在多个视角采择基准上，LeRF持续优于骨干模型，并与现有开源方法相比取得强劲性能；参考系定位和方向估计也有提升。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的参考坐标系能有效支持视角依赖的空间推理。

title: Can We Still Trust Disaster Social Sensing? Empirical Evidence on Detecting AI-Generated Social Media Posts
summary: Disaster social sensing converts public social-media posts into evidence for situational awareness and humanitarian needs, but generative artificial intelligence (AI) can produce plausible messages that resemble eyewitness reports. This study investigates whether text-based AI detectors can reliably distinguish human-authored from AI-generated disaster posts. We construct a dataset of 12,000 texts organised into 3,000 matched semantic units from nine disasters: original human posts (H0), minimally LLM-proofread human posts (H1), factual AI-generated posts based on the same verified facts (A0), and affectively framed versions of those AI posts (A1). A separate 6,000-text corpus from 42 events supports model selection and threshold calibration. We evaluate OSM-Det, Fast-DetectGPT, Binoculars, and direct large language model (LLM) judges across five model families, then test disaster-domain calibration, a frozen-encoder linear readout, paired transformation sensitivity, and dataset artifact controls. Across fourteen frozen cross-family configurations, AUROC is 0.402-0.517 and the best prospective recall at a calibration-derived low-false-positive operating point is 3.6%; OSM-Det reaches AUROC 0.521 and 10.4% recall at a realised 6.7% false-positive rate. A disaster-trained linear head reaches AUROC 0.817, but a seven-feature surface classifier reaches 0.784 on the H0-versus-A0 contrast, and neutralising identified surface asymmetries reduces the head from 0.733 to 0.594. The head also separates A0 from A1 even though provenance is unchanged. The results show that text-based detection is not reliable enough to serve as an operational trust gate; multimodal claims, accountable sources, and other contextual evidence should be rested on to safeguard trust in disaster social sensing.

AI.tldr: 研究检验文本AI检测器能否可靠区分灾害社交媒体中的人类撰写帖与AI生成帖，发现现有检测方法不可靠，不宜作为运营信任门槛。
AI.motivation: 灾害社会感知依赖公众社交媒体信息提供情境意识与人道需求证据，但生成式AI可生成看似目击报告的合理内容，因此需要评估文本检测器能否守护信任。
AI.method: 构建12,000条文本数据集，含3,000个语义匹配单元，覆盖九种灾害，分为人类原帖H0、LLM轻度校对H1、基于相同已核实事实的事实型AI帖A0、情感框架型AI帖A1；另用42事件6,000条文本做模型选择与阈值校准。评估OSM-Det、Fast-DetectGPT、Binoculars及直接LLM评审，跨五个模型家族，并进行灾害域校准、冻结编码器线性读出、配对变换敏感性和数据集伪影控制。
AI.result: 十四个冻结跨家族配置AUROC为0.402–0.517，校准低假阳性点下最佳前瞻召回仅3.6%；OSM-Det AUROC 0.521，在6.7%假阳性率下召回10.4%。灾害训练线性头AUROC达0.817，但七特征表层分类器在H0对A0上达0.784；中和表层不对称后线性头由0.733降至0.594。该线性头还能区分A0与A1，尽管来源未变。
AI.conclusion: 基于文本的AI检测尚不足以作为操作信任门槛；应依靠多模态声明、可问责来源及其他情境证据来保障灾害社会感知中的信任。

title: Mutually Adversarial Self-Training with Evolving Data for Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) combine image generation and visual understanding in a shared backbone. Since generation and understanding are inverse tasks, recent studies self-train UMMs by letting the two branches cooperatively supervise each other. We introduce MATE (Mutually Adversarial self-Training with Evolving data), a reinforcement-learning-based post-training framework in which the two branches instead challenge each other, and the challenges evolve as the model trains. MATE lets generation and understanding take turns to be challenger and solver. Given an image, the understanding branch proposes several candidate descriptions that the generation branch must turn back into similar images, and vice versa. The candidates are screened for consistency with the image or prompt they were proposed from, and the solver is trained on the candidate it handles worst. The adversary thus comes from the model's own outputs, and no separate adversary is trained. Moreover, the candidates that defeat one branch become the sources of the next challenges to the other in the next epoch, which keeps the challenges evolving with the model and turns the training into self-play in data space. On Janus-Pro-1B, MATE improves GenEval by 2.4 points, DPG-Bench by 1.7 points, and the average over nine understanding benchmarks by 0.7 points, while strengthening consistency across repeated image-text cycles.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MATE，一种基于强化学习的统一多模态模型后训练框架，让生成与理解分支互为对手、轮流出题与解题，并通过挑战在数据空间中演化实现自博弈式训练。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型需同时具备图像生成与视觉理解能力，而二者本质上是互逆任务。现有自训练方法多让两分支协作互相监督，作者希望改为让它们相互对抗，从而更有效地提升双方能力。
AI.method: MATE 采用强化学习后训练：生成和理解分支轮流充当挑战者和求解者。给定图像时，理解分支提出多个候选描述，生成分支需据此重建相似图像；反向亦然。候选根据其与原始图像或提示的一致性进行筛选，求解者只在其表现最差的候选上训练。对抗样本来自模型自身输出，无需单独训练对抗器。同时，击败某一分支的候选会成为下一轮对另一分支出题的来源，使挑战随模型演化，形成数据空间中的自博弈。
AI.result: 在 Janus-Pro-1B 上，MATE 将 GenEval 提升 2.4 分，DPG-Bench 提升 1.7 分，九个理解基准平均提升 0.7 分，并增强了重复图像-文本循环中的一致性。
AI.conclusion: MATE 通过让生成与理解分支相互对抗并演化挑战，无需独立对抗器即可实现统一多模态模型的后训练，在生成与理解指标上均取得提升，并改善跨模态循环一致性。

title: Trajectory-Level Mode Guidance for Controllable Diffusion-Based Multi-Robot Motion Planning
summary: Motion planning often admits multiple feasible solutions, making multimodal generation valuable, particularly for flexible multi-robot coordination. Diffusion models naturally learn such trajectory distributions, yet incorporating coarse and partial trajectory priors without restricting generation remains challenging. Such priors indicate a desirable region of the solution space rather than a single solution, motivating conditioned generation that preserves multimodality. In this paper, we guide trajectory generation in the clean trajectory space and progressively incorporate trajectory priors with a timestep-dependent guidance strength. At each reverse diffusion step, the reconstructed clean trajectory provides a unified space for integrating planning costs and partial trajectory priors. Planning costs are incorporated through gradient-based refinement, while the partial prior is progressively injected at the corresponding noise levels with decreasing guidance strength. This guides generation toward the prior in early stages while gradually releasing the constraint to preserve the inherent multimodality of the diffusion model. The framework naturally extends to multi-robot planning by incorporating inter-robot collision costs. Experiments on single- and multi-robot planning tasks demonstrate controllable trajectory synthesis, diverse feasible solutions, and safe multi-agent coordination.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种在干净轨迹空间中引导扩散模型生成轨迹的方法，通过随时间步递减的引导强度融入规划代价与部分轨迹先验，从而在保留多模态性的同时实现可控轨迹生成，并扩展到多机器人协调。
AI.motivation: 运动规划通常存在多个可行解，多模态生成对灵活的多机器人协调很有价值。扩散模型能学习轨迹分布，但如何在不过度限制生成的前提下融入粗略、部分轨迹先验仍具挑战。这类先验指向解空间中的理想区域而非单一解，因此需要一种保留多模态性的条件生成方法。
AI.method: 在反向扩散的每个时间步，利用重建出的干净轨迹作为统一空间，融合规划代价与部分轨迹先验。规划代价通过基于梯度的细化引入；部分先验则按对应噪声水平逐步注入，并采用随时间步递减的引导强度。早期引导强，使生成趋向先验，后期逐渐释放约束以保留扩散模型固有的多模态性。通过加入机器人间碰撞代价，框架可自然扩展到多机器人规划。
AI.result: 在单机器人和多机器人规划任务上的实验表明，该方法能够实现可控的轨迹合成、生成多样且可行的解，并支持安全的多智能体协调。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，在干净轨迹空间中进行时间步依赖的渐进引导，可以在融入规划代价和部分先验的同时保持多模态生成能力，为单/多机器人运动规划提供了一种有效且可扩展的条件扩散规划框架。

title: A Polyphonic Conception of AI Understanding
summary: When a doctor, a judge, or an engineer must decide whether to trust an AI model's output, they cannot avoid asking what the model understands. Purely mathematical or statistical descriptions struggle to distinguish trustworthy from untrustworthy outputs without reintroducing the question of AI understanding in all but name. Yet the question is ill-framed as it stands, because the inherited concept operates within a monophonic paradigm: the idea that a cognitive system's understanding of something must be localised to a single mechanism underpinning all the capacities conferred by such understanding. Drawing on a wide range of mechanistic evidence, we show that LLMs are pervasively polyphonic: outputs emerge from coalitions of parallel mechanisms of uneven reliability, which variously complement, duplicate, or drown out one another, with several coalitions sufficing for a task without any one being indispensable. Polyphony not only complicates attributions of understanding, but renders monophonic inference patterns hazardous. In response, we develop a conception of understanding fit for polyphonic AI. It centres on sound circuitry that is reliably and correctly recruited and in control of outputs. Attributions of understanding thereby become tractable claims about internal organisation, and can do the work of guiding trust in AI.

AI.tldr: 论文主张，大语言模型的理解是“复调的”：输出由多个并行机制组成的联盟产生，这些机制可靠性不一，彼此互补、重复或相互压制，且没有单一 indispensible 机制。因此，传统“单音式”理解观不适用，需要以“可靠且正确被调用并控制输出的健全回路”来重新定义理解，从而指导对 AI 的信任。
AI.motivation: 医生、法官或工程师在决定是否信任 AI 输出时，无法回避模型是否“理解”的问题；纯数学或统计描述难以区分可信与不可信输出，但传统理解概念预设了单一机制支撑所有能力的“单音范式”，因而问题本身被错误框定。
AI.method: 基于广泛的机制性证据进行概念分析，批判继承的“单音式”理解观，并提出适合复调 AI 的理解理论框架。
AI.result: LLMs 普遍是复调的：输出来自并行机制的联盟，可靠性不均，机制之间可互补、冗余或淹没彼此；多个联盟都能完成任务，且无一不可或缺。这不仅使理解归因复杂化，也使单音式推理模式变得危险。
AI.conclusion: 应发展一种面向复调 AI 的理解观：理解的核心是可靠且正确被调用、并控制输出的“健全回路”。这样，理解归因就成为关于内部组织的可处理主张，并能用于指导对 AI 的信任。

title: Isostable-Based Nonlinear Model Reduction for Power System Oscillations
summary: Power systems are often represented by high-dimensional dynamic models, making nonlinear control design computationally expensive and limiting its practical application. Oscillation analysis and damping control therefore commonly rely on linearized models, which do not capture the nonlinear oscillatory behavior induced by large disturbances. This paper proposes an isostable-based model reduction method for nonlinear modal analysis of power systems. The method constructs an invariant manifold associated with a selected oscillatory mode and uses isostable coordinates to describe the mode with only two real state variables. The isostable formulation gives linear autonomous modal dynamics, with nonlinear state reconstruction and input response computed on the modal manifold. An optimal damping control problem is then formulated directly in the reduced coordinates. Case studies on the IEEE 39-bus system demonstrate the accuracy of the proposed model in describing nonlinear oscillations and show improved damping compared with control designed using a linear reduced model.

AI.tldr: 提出基于等稳坐标的等稳流形模型降维方法，用于电力系统非线性模态分析与阻尼控制，将选定振荡模态降为两个实状态变量，并在降维坐标中设计最优阻尼控制。
AI.motivation: 电力系统高维动态模型使非线性控制设计计算代价高，而常用线性化模型无法捕捉大扰动引起的非线性振荡行为。
AI.method: 构建与选定振荡模态相关的不变流形，采用等稳坐标以两个实状态变量描述该模态；等稳表述给出线性自治模态动力学，非线性状态重构和输入响应在模态流形上计算；随后在降维坐标中建立最优阻尼控制问题。
AI.result: IEEE 39节点系统算例表明，所提模型能准确描述非线性振荡，并且相比基于线性降维模型设计的控制，具有更好的阻尼效果。
AI.conclusion: 等稳流形降维方法可用于电力系统非线性模态分析和阻尼控制，在降低计算复杂度的同时提升对非线性振荡的描述与控制性能。

title: Tracing mechanisms of sycophantic agreement in language models
summary: Sycophantic agreement in language models refers to the tendency to overly affirm a user's stated beliefs or preferences, often at the expense of factual accuracy. Although it is widely recognized as an alignment failure, its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this work, we use causal mediation analysis to identify the mechanisms behind sycophantic agreement. We show that a stated opinion is incorporated into the residual stream of the final prompt token early, where it biases subsequent answer retrieval. A sparse set of early attention heads carries this opinion signal. Ablating these heads substantially reduces sycophancy while leaving factual accuracy largely intact. The same heads carry the opinion when it is explicitly stated, regardless of how it is phrased. When an opinion is not stated explicitly but instead conveyed through content-free pushback (e.g., ``Are you sure?"), we find a distinct set of heads that suppresses the model's original correct answer to promote a revised answer. By providing a mechanistic account of how opinions induce sycophantic agreement, this work takes a step toward developing more targeted and reliable alignment interventions.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过因果中介分析揭示语言模型谄媚性同意的机制：用户明示观点会早期进入最后一个提示词的残差流并偏向答案检索，由一小组早期注意力头承载；消融这些头可显著减少谄媚且基本保持事实准确性。
AI.motivation: 谄媚性同意被广泛视为对齐失败，但其内部机制尚不清楚，因此需要机理性解释以支持更精准可靠的对齐干预。
AI.method: 采用因果中介分析，定位并消融相关注意力头，比较明示观点与内容无关的反驳（如“你确定吗？”）两种条件下的机制。
AI.result: 明示观点由一小组早期注意力头携带，在最终提示词残差流中早期编码并偏置后续答案检索；消融这些头能大幅降低谄媚而基本不影响事实准确性。对于非明示的内容无关反驳，则存在另一组不同的注意力头，抑制原正确答案以促成修正答案。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了观点如何诱发谄媚性同意的机制性解释，是迈向更有针对性、更可靠对齐干预的一步。

title: Think Before You Restore: Risk-Aware Manchu Manuscript Restoration with Stroke-Guided Attention
summary: Full-page blind restoration of historical Manchu manuscripts is challenging due to scarce annotations, unknown degradation regions, and fragile connected strokes. Generic restoration models may improve visual quality but often modify intact content, leading to over-restoration. We propose SAGE-Restore (Stroke-Aware Gated rEstoration), a selective restoration framework that first assesses where restoration is needed and then uses this assessment to guide restoration candidate generation and pixel-level selection. Its encoder predicts patch-level repair probabilities from complementary appearance and stroke-structural cues to condition restoration candidate generation, while the corresponding repair logits are refined into a pixel-level soft gate that selectively controls where the restoration candidate is applied. We further introduce a fidelity-aware evaluation protocol that jointly measures degraded-region recovery, intact-content preservation, and their balance. SAGE-Restore achieves the highest R-Recovery (0.463) and RFS (0.626), while maintaining high U-Fidelity (0.968), demonstrating an effective balance between restoration and content preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出 SAGE-Restore 选择性修复框架，用于历史满文手稿整页盲修复，通过先判断需修复区域再引导修复候选生成与像素级选择，在修复退化区域与保留完整内容之间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: 历史满文手稿整页盲修复面临标注稀缺、退化区域未知、连笔笔画脆弱等挑战；通用修复模型虽能提升视觉质量，却常改动完整内容，导致过度修复。
AI.method: SAGE-Restore 先评估何处需要修复，再据此引导修复候选生成和像素级选择。其编码器从外观与笔画结构线索预测补丁级修复概率，以条件化修复候选生成；相应修复 logits 被细化为像素级软门控，选择性控制修复候选的应用位置。同时提出保真度感知评估协议，联合衡量退化区域恢复、完整内容保持及二者平衡。
AI.result: SAGE-Restore 取得最高 R-Recovery（0.463）和 RFS（0.626），同时保持较高 U-Fidelity（0.968），表明其能有效平衡修复与内容保持。
AI.conclusion: SAGE-Restore 通过选择性修复和像素级软门控，能够在历史满文手稿盲修复中兼顾退化区域恢复与完整内容保真，缓解过度修复问题。

title: Asymmetric Scout-Worker Reconnaissance for Route Validation in Unknown Environments
summary: This paper studies asymmetric scout-worker reconnaissance in unknown environments, where a small, agile autonomous scout explores routes for a larger worker robot that must visit an ordered sequence of goal locations. Because the scout has a smaller footprint and greater mobility, a scout-traversable route may be infeasible for the worker; worker feasibility must therefore be inferred from scout observations. This setting is not explicitly addressed by existing exploration and replanning methods, which typically assume a single traversability model and seek optimal paths for the same robot performing the exploration. We introduce a symbiotic scout-based framework that exploits the scout's superior mobility to explore only the portions of the unknown environment needed to identify worker-feasible path segments connecting the ordered goals. Evaluations in simulated and real-world settings demonstrate that the proposed approach validates feasible routes, repairs blocked segments with validated worker-feasible detours, and substantially reduces scout travel compared to baseline exploration and planning methods. A real-world indoor deployment further demonstrates the scout navigating narrow corridors to identify a worker-feasible route.

AI.tldr: 本文研究非对称侦察者-工作者在未知环境中的路径侦察问题，提出一种共生式侦察框架，让小型敏捷侦察机器人仅为大型工作者机器人探索必要区域，以找到连接有序目标点的可行路径。
AI.motivation: 现有探索与重规划方法通常假设单一可通行性模型，并让同一机器人同时承担探索与路径规划任务，无法处理侦察者与工作者因尺寸和机动性不同而导致的可行路径差异。
AI.method: 提出共生式侦察框架：侦察者利用更高机动性，只探索未知环境中识别工作者可行路径段所需的部分；工作者需按顺序访问目标点，其可行性需从侦察者观测中推断。在仿真和真实环境中评估，并部署室内场景验证。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法能够验证可行路径、用验证过的工作者可行绕行修复受阻路段，并显著减少侦察者移动距离；真实室内部署中，侦察者成功穿越狭窄走廊以识别工作者可行路径。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架能有效解决非对称侦察者-工作者在未知环境中的路径侦察与可行性推断问题，优于基线探索与规划方法。

title: GeoOutageBench: Benchmarking Ambiguity-aware, Ontology-grounded Geospatiotemporal KGQA for Multimodal Power Outage and Resilience Analysis
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Advances in Geographic Information Systems (SIGSPATIAL '26), November 3-6, 2026, Riverside, CA, USA
summary: We introduce GeoOutageBench, a benchmark for assessing LLM-based geospatiotemporal KGQA for multimodal outage and resilience analysis. Unlike existing KGQA benchmarks for Web knowledge, GeoOutageBench considers a spatiotemporal KG that integrates visual, textual, and structured data from outage records, remote sensing, weather observations, storm and power events, geographic entities, and domain ontologies. It provides a competency query taxonomy at different difficulty levels from spatiotemporal containment and proximity, spatiotemporal co-occurrence analysis, multimodal evidence, to hypothetical evaluation. Over multimodal KG and query classes, GeoOutageBench provides user-configurable evaluation of three important, highly coherent yet less studied tasks: (1) LLMs' understanding for ambiguous geospatiotemporal questions in terms of NL to SPARQL interpretation, (2) query-driven assessment of ontology utility, and (3) answer accuracy of multimodal KGQA retrieval. GeoOutageBench provides a design principle and foundation for assessing LLM-KG systems that support real-world infrastructure resilience analysis. Our benchmark, source code, data, results, and other documentation are available at https://github.com/UCF-SAGE/GeoOutageBench.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了GeoOutageBench，一个用于评估基于LLM的地理时空知识图谱问答（KGQA）的基准，旨在支持多模态停电与韧性分析。
AI.motivation: 现有KGQA基准主要针对Web知识，缺乏对整合多模态时空数据的知识图谱的评估，因此需要新的基准来支持现实世界的基础设施韧性分析。
AI.method: 构建了一个整合视觉、文本和结构化数据的时空知识图谱，涵盖停电记录、遥感、天气观测、风暴与电力事件、地理实体和领域本体。提供了不同难度级别的能力查询分类（时空包含与邻近、时空共现分析、多模态证据、假设评估），并对三个任务进行用户可配置评估：(1) LLM对模糊地理时空问题的理解（自然语言到SPARQL），(2) 本体实用性的查询驱动评估，(3) 多模态KGQA检索的答案准确性。
AI.result: 提供了基准、源代码、数据、结果和文档，网址为https://github.com/UCF-SAGE/GeoOutageBench。为评估支持现实世界基础设施韧性分析的LLM-KG系统提供了设计原则和基础。
AI.conclusion: GeoOutageBench为评估支持现实世界基础设施韧性分析的LLM-KG系统提供了基础。

title: An Exact Generate - Transform Decomposition of Small-LLM Team Scaling Across Orchestration Architectures
summary:
Replacing one LLM agent with a collaborating team can raise accuracy, but whether scaling the team helps, and which architecture to scale, is unclear. Sweeping eight agent orchestration architectures across five instruction-tuned 7-9B models, five short-answer benchmarks, and an executable-code benchmark up to 30 calls, we find that the returns to team scaling are sharply task-dependent: from three to thirty calls accuracy rises by up to 17 points on the two arithmetic word-problem benchmarks (GSM8K, GSMHard) but by at most four on ARC, GPQA, and MMLU, for every architecture, a split the usual task-averaged number conceals. Proposer-Critic captures the arithmetic gains, scaling steepest and, in aggregate, surpassing every other architecture at the largest budget (item-clustered intervals exclude zero), though it ranks among the weakest elsewhere, and no architecture wins across tasks.
  We explain these trajectories with an exact generate-transform decomposition. Partitioning any workflow into proposal coverage and a downstream transform, any accuracy change splits exactly into an extensive coverage dividend and an intensive transformation change. The decomposition diagnoses each task: arithmetic offers coverage headroom that a critic-guided transform converts, whereas the multiple-choice benchmarks either saturate in coverage or fail to convert it, and on open-ended code generative recovery nearly vanishes so accuracy tracks coverage. At equal call budgets token cost still varies 2.1x. Extra calls therefore create candidate opportunity that only some architectures, on some tasks, convert. Team scaling is a task- and architecture-specific bet, not a uniform lever.

AI.tldr: 论文扫描8种智能体编排架构、5个7-9B指令微调模型、5个短答案基准与1个代码基准，发现扩大协作团队规模的收益强烈依赖任务，并提出生成-变换分解解释其机制。
AI.motivation: 用协作团队替代单个LLM智能体可提升准确率，但团队规模扩大是否有效、应扩展哪种架构尚不明确。
AI.method: 在最多30次调用的预算下，跨8种编排架构、5个短答案基准和可执行代码基准进行系统扫描；提出精确的生成-变换分解，将任意工作流的准确率变化拆分为覆盖增益与变换变化两部分。
AI.result: 从3到30次调用，GSM8K和GSMHard算术题准确率最多提升17分，而ARC、GPQA、MMLU最多仅提升4分；Proposer-Critic在算术任务上增益最大且最大预算下总体最优，但在其他任务上偏弱，无架构全任务胜出；同等调用预算下token成本仍相差2.1倍。
AI.conclusion: 额外调用创造候选机会，但只有部分架构在部分任务上能将其转化；团队扩展是任务与架构特定的赌注，而非统一杠杆。

title: Reliable but Design-Sensitive: Instrument Uncertainty in LLM Annotation
comment: Accepted to "3rd Workshop on Uncertainty-Aware NLP" @ EMNLP 2026 (archival)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can give reliable labels under one setup yet change those labels when researchers make other reasonable design choices. We tested seven LLMs, 12 task designs, three independent runs, and 3,000 tweets labeled for offensive language and hate speech. Repeating the same model and task design produced high agreement (median Fleiss' $κ= 0.91$). Agreement fell when we changed the task design for the same tweets (median Cohen's $κ= 0.76$). Task design and model choice increased the variance of estimated prevalence by factors of 76.7 for offensive language and 110.6 for hate speech compared with sampling variance alone. Variation across LLM task designs reached 560-572 basis points, compared with 270-331 basis points across five human instrument versions. Confidence scores did not solve this problem. They tracked repeated model outputs more closely than agreement with human labels, and grouping six tweets in one prompt lowered mean offensive-language confidence by 660 basis points. We call the variation caused by task design and model choice instrument uncertainty. Researchers can measure it only by comparing reasonable task designs. Repeating one setup or relying on confidence scores cannot replace that test.

AI.tldr: 该研究测试了7个大语言模型、12种任务设计、3次独立运行，对3000条推文进行冒犯性语言和仇恨言论标注，发现任务设计与模型选择会显著改变LLM标注结果，并将此称为“工具不确定性”。
AI.motivation: LLM标注在一个设定下看似可靠，但研究者做出其他合理设计选择时标签可能改变，因此需要检验这种由任务设计和模型选择带来的不稳定性。
AI.method: 使用7个LLM、12种任务设计、3次独立运行，对3000条推文标注冒犯性语言和仇恨言论；比较同一设定重复结果、不同任务设计间一致性、估计 prevalence 方差，并分析置信度分数和将6条推文合并到一个提示中的影响。
AI.result: 同一模型和任务设计重复运行一致性高（Fleiss' κ中位数=0.91）；改变任务设计后一致性下降（Cohen's κ中位数=0.76）。任务设计和模型选择使估计 prevalence 的方差相对仅抽样方差分别增加76.7倍（冒犯性语言）和110.6倍（仇恨言论）。LLM任务设计间差异达560-572个基点，而5个人工工具版本间为270-331个基点。置信度未能解决问题，其更贴近重复模型输出而非与人工标签的一致性；将6条推文放入一个提示使冒犯性语言平均置信度降低660个基点。
AI.conclusion: 任务设计和模型选择造成的变化称为“工具不确定性”。研究者只有通过比较合理的任务设计才能测量它；重复单一设定或依赖置信度分数不能替代这种检验。

title: Active Informativity: Online Input Design for Data-Driven Control
summary: We develop a unified framework for online input design in data-driven control from noisy data. We introduce a performance measure and analyze how such quality measure changes as new data are added. Based on such analysis we propose an online method for selecting inputs that ensures that data quality does not decrease over time. We demonstrate the validity of our approach by formulating six common noisy data-driven control problems in our framework, and by solving numerical examples for three of them.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一的在线输入设计框架，用于噪声数据下的数据驱动控制，通过性能度量分析数据质量变化，并提出保证数据质量不随时间下降的在线选点方法。
AI.motivation: 在噪声数据驱动的控制中，在线输入设计对数据质量至关重要，但缺乏统一框架来度量和保证新增数据对控制性能的影响。
AI.method: 引入性能度量，分析数据质量随新增数据的变化；基于该分析提出在线输入选择方法，确保数据质量不下降；并用该框架统一描述六类常见噪声数据驱动控制问题，对其中三类进行数值求解。
AI.result: 框架能够统一表达六类常见噪声数据驱动控制问题，并通过三个数值例子验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的统一在线输入设计方法可行，能保证数据质量随时间不下降，并适用于多种噪声数据驱动控制问题。

title: StructRL: Online Structured Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Tasks
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models perform well on shorter-horizon manipulation tasks but still struggle with long-horizon tasks that require multiple dependent manipulations from a single command. Online reinforcement learning (RL) can improve these policies through environment interaction, yet many existing methods provide reward only after the complete task succeeds. However, such terminal supervision is sparse and does not distinguish early failures from rollouts that make substantial partial progress. We propose StructRL, an online RL framework that constructs structured intermediate supervision from verifiable subtask completions. StructRL decomposes each task into verifiable subtasks, grants intermediate rewards only after the prerequisite subtasks have been completed, and scales each reward according to completion pace. Across RoboCasa365 and LIBERO-Long with GR00T-N1.5 and pi 0.5, StructRL consistently outperforms evaluated online RL baselines. These results show that verifiable, structured intermediate rewards improve long-horizon VLA post-training. Code is available at https://github.com/amazon-science/StructRL.

AI.tldr: 提出StructRL在线强化学习框架，通过可验证子任务完成构建结构化中间奖励，提升长视野VLA模型后训练性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在长视野操作任务上表现不佳，在线RL虽可改善，但多数方法仅在任务完全成功后给奖励，监督稀疏且无法区分早期失败与有实质进展的尝试。
AI.method: 将任务分解为可验证子任务，仅在前提子任务完成后给予中间奖励，并根据完成速度调整奖励尺度。
AI.result: 在RoboCasa365和LIBERO-Long上，使用GR00T-N1.5和pi 0.5，StructRL持续优于所评估的在线RL基线。
AI.conclusion: 可验证的结构化中间奖励能有效改善长视野VLA后训练。代码见https://github.com/amazon-science/StructRL。

title: The Layer Mystery of VLA: An Information-Theoretical Analysis of VLA Latent Interface
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies connect a pretrained vision-language backbone to an action head through a latent interface, but which backbone layers this interface should expose remains unclear. We study single-layer selection and multi-layer fusion for frozen backbones across three pretrained models and two manipulation benchmarks, LIBERO and CALVIN, with three policy-training seeds per configuration. Across three fusion mechanisms and three layer-subset strategies, 47 of 54 configurations underperform the best observed single-layer policy. Our stastical analysis further confirms that fusion's advantage is very limited. However, the best layer varies substantially across backbones and benchmarks, making layer selection consequential and exhaustive policy sweeps expensive. We further derive a reweighting equivalence between the proposed information-bottleneck objectives for action-conditioned InfoNCE and action prediction, motivating InfoNCE as a proxy for layer quality. Empirically, InfoNCE provides the most consistent positive association with policy success among four evaluated proxies. Selecting the layer with the highest InfoNCE score requires 9-33 times less GPU compute than exhaustive policy sweeps and reduces mean selection regret from 17.89 percentage points for deepest-layer selection to 3.71 points across six settings. Its mean regret is close to the 3.28-3.50 points achieved by fixed-layer heuristics optimized retrospectively using all six oracle sweeps, without requiring closed-loop evaluations during selection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中冻结骨干网络与动作头之间的潜在接口应选择哪些层，比较单层选择与多层融合，并提出以InfoNCE作为层质量代理来高效选择层。
AI.motivation: VLA策略通过潜在接口连接预训练视觉-语言骨干和动作头，但哪些骨干层应暴露给动作头尚不明确；穷举式策略评估成本高，且最佳层可能因骨干和基准而异。
AI.method: 在3个预训练模型和LIBERO、CALVIN两个操作基准上，对冻结骨干进行单层选择与多层融合实验，每个配置使用3个策略训练种子；比较3种融合机制和3种层子集策略；从动作条件InfoNCE与动作预测的信息瓶颈目标推导重加权等价关系，并评估4种层质量代理。
AI.result: 54个融合配置中有47个不如最佳单层策略，统计上融合优势非常有限；最佳层随骨干和基准显著变化。InfoNCE与策略成功率一致性最好；用最高InfoNCE选层比穷举策略扫描少用9-33倍GPU算力，并将平均选择遗憾从最深层的17.89个百分点降至3.71个百分点，接近事后优化的固定层启发式的3.28-3.50个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 多层融合通常不如最佳单层选择，层选择对VLA策略性能有实质影响；InfoNCE可作为高效且较可靠的层选择代理，在无需闭环评估的情况下显著降低选择成本和遗憾。

title: Beyond the Context Window: An Adaptive Entropy-Based Routing Framework for Hybrid Retrieval and Long-Context Language Models
summary: Modern large language models now support context windows of more than one million tokens, which has raised the question of whether retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is still necessary. Pure long-context (LC) processing is expensive and is known to under-attend to information placed in the middle of long inputs, while pure RAG is fast but bounded by retrieval quality and prone to errors when retrieved chunks are partially relevant or contradictory. We propose the Entropy-Driven Adaptive Router (EDAR), a framework that decides at inference time whether to answer a query from retrieved chunks or to escalate it to full long-context processing. The decision uses the predictive entropy of the token-level probability distribution computed over the first few generated tokens of the RAG response. The entropy threshold is selected on a held-out validation set by sweeping cost against accuracy. Experiments compare EDAR against pure-RAG and pure-LC baselines on LongBench v2 and Infinity-Bench. Predictive entropy correlates strongly with hallucination rate on a held-out set of 2,000 generations (Pearson r = 0.85, 95% CI [0.83, 0.87]). On the long-context benchmarks, EDAR retains 97.4% of the accuracy of the pure long-context baseline while reducing total token expenditure by 70.7%, escalating only 18.2% of incoming queries. The accuracy gap between EDAR and the pure long-context system is not statistically distinguishable from zero at standard sample sizes. Predictive entropy is a useful model-internal signal for routing between RAG and long-context inference, and a threshold-based hybrid system can recover most of the accuracy of long-context models at a small fraction of the cost. The framework does not depend on a specific retriever or LC backbone, and it does not require additional supervision beyond what is normally produced during decoding.

AI.tldr: 提出EDAR框架，利用RAG响应早期token的预测熵，在推理时自适应决定使用检索片段还是升级到完整长上下文处理。
AI.motivation: 长上下文处理成本高且对中间信息关注不足，而纯RAG虽快但受检索质量限制，在片段部分相关或矛盾时易出错，因此需要一种动态路由机制来平衡成本与准确率。
AI.method: 计算RAG响应前几个生成token的预测熵，在留出验证集上通过权衡成本与准确率选择熵阈值；在LongBench v2和Infinity-Bench上对比纯RAG与纯长上下文基线。
AI.result: 预测熵与幻觉率强相关（Pearson r=0.85，95% CI [0.83, 0.87]）；EDAR保留纯长上下文基线97.4%的准确率，同时减少70.7%的token消耗，仅升级18.2%的查询；与纯长上下文系统的准确率差距在标准样本量下统计不显著。
AI.conclusion: 预测熵是路由RAG与长上下文推理的有效模型内部信号，基于阈值的混合系统能以小部分成本恢复长上下文模型的大部分准确率；该框架不依赖特定检索器或长上下文骨干，也无需额外监督。

title: Representation by Design in Generation: Cross-View Class-Token Alignment in Diffusion Transformers
summary: Generative and representation learning remain asymmetrically connected: semantic representations are used to improve diffusion generation, whereas the models' own representations are often treated as a by-product of synthesis. We ask whether diffusion models can instead be trained to learn substantially stronger semantic representations without sacrificing generation quality. SelfFlow takes a step in this direction by introducing self-supervised patch alignment into flow matching, but its main gains remain in faster convergence and improved generation. Inspired by DINO and iBOT, we extend this framework with cross-view class-token alignment to further strengthen semantic representations. Specifically, we form two independently noised, dual-timestep observations of each image and align each student class-token representation with the stop-gradient EMA-teacher target from the other observation. This objective is optimized jointly with the inherited flow-matching and local patch objectives. Notably, although the additional objective acts only on the class token, it strengthens both class-token and patch representations. Compared with a matched two-view baseline, ImageNet linear-probing accuracy improves by 9.4\% using the class token and 10.1\% using mean-pooled patch tokens, while frozen-backbone VOC2012 segmentation improves by 3.6 mIoU. These representation gains are achieved while maintaining comparable ImageNet generation FID. In text-to-image training, the same objective also improves generation FID, reducing it from 2.52 to 2.37 at matched checkpoints. Our results show that representation need not remain a by-product of generation or merely a tool for improving it: it can be directly optimized as a first-class capability of diffusion pretraining alongside generation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出在flow matching中引入跨视角class-token对齐，使扩散模型在维持生成质量的同时学习更强的语义表征。
AI.motivation: 生成与表征学习仍不对称：语义表征常被用来改进扩散生成，而扩散模型自身表征多被视为合成副产物。SelfFlow虽引入patch自监督对齐，但主要收益是更快收敛和更好生成，因此作者追问能否直接训练扩散模型获得更强语义表征且不牺牲生成质量。
AI.method: 基于SelfFlow框架，对每张图像构造两个独立加噪、双时间步的观测；将学生class-token表征与另一观测的stop-gradient EMA教师目标对齐，并与继承的flow-matching和局部patch目标联合优化。该方法受DINO和iBOT启发。
AI.result: 相比匹配的双视角基线，ImageNet线性探测中class token提升9.4%，mean-pooled patch tokens提升10.1%；冻结主干VOC2012分割提升3.6 mIoU。ImageNet生成FID保持相当；文生图训练中FID从2.52降至2.37。
AI.conclusion: 表征不必是生成的副产物或仅用于改进生成，而可以作为扩散预训练中的一等能力，与生成能力一起被直接优化。

title: Reactive Real-Time Flow Policies via Asynchronous Distribution Alignment
summary: Generalist robot policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) have achieved remarkable generalization, but their inference delays can conflict with the demands of real-time control. Asynchronous execution avoids pauses between action chunks by predicting the next sequence of actions while the robot carries out the previous one. In this paper, we study whether asynchronous execution produces the same action distribution as the original VLA. We find that, for non-Markovian demonstrations, asynchronous execution can produce a fundamentally different action distribution, which can limit the policy's reactivity. In our method, we seek to restore this reactivity by aligning the asynchronously produced action distribution with that of the original VLA through two complementary mechanisms. First, Recursive Flow-Field Distillation trains the asynchronous policy using the VLA's action-generation flow. We characterize the learned distribution theoretically and show experimentally that our asynchronous policy can generate nearly the full range of actions the original VLA would produce, while existing asynchronous methods recover only a fraction of that range. Second, Propose-Resolve prepares multiple action sequences asynchronously and uses the latest observation to select among them based on a lightweight approximation of their likelihood under the VLA's action distribution. Our resulting method matches the original VLA's success on LIBERO and retains about 80% of its success on RoboMimic, about 30 percentage points more than existing asynchronous methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了异步执行对VLA模型动作分布的影响，并提出通过递归流场蒸馏和提议-解决机制来恢复策略的反应性，从而在LIBERO和RoboMimic上取得显著优于现有异步方法的成功率。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人策略如VLA模型具有泛化能力，但推理延迟与实时控制需求冲突。异步执行可避免动作块之间的停顿，但可能改变动作分布，限制策略反应性，尤其对于非马尔可夫演示。
AI.method: 论文提出两种互补机制：1) 递归流场蒸馏，利用VLA的动作生成流训练异步策略，使其生成的动作分布接近原始VLA；2) 提议-解决，异步准备多个动作序列，并基于VLA动作分布的轻量似然近似，用最新观测选择动作序列。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上匹配原始VLA的成功率，在RoboMimic上保留约80%的成功率，比现有异步方法高出约30个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效恢复异步执行下的策略反应性，使动作分布与原始VLA对齐，显著提升成功率。

title: Quantifying EnergyNet performance: a simulation-based framework for decentralized energy networks
summary: Power transmission and distribution infrastructure connects generation with consumers. Extreme weather, infrastructure failures, and geopolitical conflicts increasingly disrupt these connections, leaving large groups without electricity until service is restored. Local generation, storage, and controllable loads pose challenges but also enable new ways to organize energy systems. EnergyNet is a decentralized architecture of interconnected power electronic Energy Routers. Each coordinates local loads, generation, storage, and grid connections. Bidirectional Energy Links enable exchange between routers, while the Energy Protocol communicates needs and availability to coordinate transfers. EnergyNet can operate with or without the public grid. This paper develops a quantitative framework for modeling and evaluating EnergyNet. It represents topology, prioritized loads, generation, storage, grid connections, links, and component limits. Receding-horizon optimization calculates energy allocation and exchange, supporting also disturbance and reliability analysis. A three-router case illustrates energy sharing and islanded operation. The framework then models a Stanford University campus microgrid and an off-grid microgrid in Half Moon Bay. Under low-solar conditions, electric bus visits support the off-grid microgrid while preserving transport service. Finally, the paper models an EnergyNet under construction in Lund, Sweden, comprising ten buildings and 278 apartments. Full service is maintained in summer and winter and after the loss of one grid interface or Energy Link. Losing two links partitions the network; service in the island depends on local resources and repair time. Reliability screening identifies partitioning as rare but credible. Monte Carlo analysis shows full critical service in sampled summer conditions and median continuous critical service of approximately 92% in winter.
