AI.tldr: 本文提出了EnergyNet（一种由互联电能路由器组成的去中心化架构）的量化建模与评估框架，并通过三路由器系统、斯坦福校园微电网与Half Moon Bay离网微电网、瑞典隆德在建EnergyNet三个案例，验证其在正常与故障情况下的能量共享与可靠性。
AI.motivation: 极端天气、基础设施故障和地缘政治冲突日益破坏电力输配网络，导致大面积停电。本地发电、储能和可控负荷带来挑战，但也为组织能源系统提供了新途径。
AI.method: EnergyNet由电能路由器互连，协调本地负荷、发电、储能和电网连接；双向能量链路实现路由器间能量交换，能量协议通信需求与可用性。论文建立量化框架，表示拓扑、优先级负荷、发电、储能、电网连接、链路和组件限制，采用滚动时域优化计算能量分配与交换，并支持扰动与可靠性分析。
AI.result: 三路由器案例展示能量共享与孤岛运行。框架模拟了斯坦福大学校园微电网和Half Moon Bay离网微电网，低日照下电动巴士访问支持离网微电网并保持交通服务。模拟瑞典隆德在建EnergyNet（10栋建筑、278套公寓）：夏冬两季及失去一个电网接口或能量链路时保持全面服务；失去两个链路会分区，孤岛服务取决于本地资源和修复时间。可靠性筛选表明分区罕见但可信。蒙特卡洛分析显示夏季采样条件下关键服务完全满足，冬季关键服务连续满足时间中位数约92%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能有效建模和评估EnergyNet，展示其在多种条件下维持关键服务的韧性和潜力，为未来去中心化能源系统提供分析工具。

title: Planning Oriented 3D Scene Completion via Coupled TUDF Occupancy Representation Learning from Partial Observations
summary: Partial observability remains a fundamental challenge in robotic navigation, where limited sensor coverage and occlusions leave large portions of the environment unobserved. Existing scene completion methods primarily focus on improving incomplete mapping or reconstructing partially observed 3D structures, but rarely investigate how scene completion can be designed to benefit downstream tasks such as path planning. In this work, we propose a path-planning-oriented 3D scene completion framework that moves beyond pure occupancy modeling toward a coupled geometric formulation. Specifically, given partial LiDAR observations as input, the proposed framework jointly predicts completed Truncated Unsigned Distance Field (TUDF)-based continuous geometric representations and voxel-wise occupancy maps. This coupled representation allows the network to better reason about obstacle boundaries and free-space geometry. To fully exploit the synergy between the two representations, we introduce a bidirectionally coupled learning scheme, where TUDF features provide dense geometric guidance to improve occupancy reconstruction, while occupancy features in turn offer complementary structural constraints that refine distance-field estimation. Consequently, the proposed network directly predicts complete occupancy and TUDF representations, allowing seamless integration of TUDF into trajectory planning without post-processing. Extensive experiments on unseen environments demonstrate that the proposed method consistently improves both geometric reconstruction quality and downstream planning performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向路径规划的3D场景补全框架，在部分LiDAR观测下联合预测连续的TUDF几何表示与体素占用图，并通过双向耦合学习提升场景补全质量和下游路径规划性能。
AI.motivation: 机器人导航中部分可观测性是根本挑战，传感器覆盖有限和遮挡导致环境大片区域未被观测。现有场景补全方法多关注改善不完整建图或重建部分观测的3D结构，较少研究如何设计场景补全以直接服务于路径规划等下游任务。
AI.method: 给定部分LiDAR观测，框架联合预测补全后的截断无符号距离场（TUDF）连续几何表示和体素级占用图。引入双向耦合学习方案：TUDF特征为占用重建提供密集几何引导，占用特征为距离场估计提供互补结构约束。网络直接预测完整占用和TUDF表示，使TUDF无需后处理即可融入轨迹规划。
AI.result: 在未见环境上的大量实验表明，所提方法在几何重建质量和下游规划性能上均持续优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 面向路径规划的耦合场景补全表示能够有效提升机器人导航中的场景理解与规划能力，说明场景补全设计应与下游任务协同优化。

title: Grid Demand Flexibility Assessment of AI Data Centers via Batch Workload Temporal Shifting
summary: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) data centers has introduced new challenges to power system operation. As their power demand becomes larger and more variable, quantitatively characterizing their demand flexibility is increasingly important for effective power system coordination. However, heterogeneous workload characteristics and resource requirements make this flexibility difficult to characterize directly. This paper proposes a framework for assessing the grid-compatible demand flexibility of AI data centers via batch workload temporal shifting. An averaging-based resource usage processing method is developed to map fine-resolution CPU, GPU and memory usage into unified time intervals compatible with power system operation. A workload temporal scheduling model is then formulated to shift batch workloads while preserving execution continuity, delay constraints, and server resource capacities, and is coupled with a utilization-dependent server power model to translate workload scheduling decisions into server power demand. Two complementary flexibility metrics are evaluated: short-term peak demand shaving and the maximum duration of sustained power reduction. Numerical results based on real GPU cluster traces demonstrate that workload temporal shifting can provide quantifiable and grid-compatible demand flexibility for AI data centers with limited disruption to computing workloads.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种通过批处理负载时间迁移来评估AI数据中心电网兼容需求灵活性的框架，并基于真实GPU集群轨迹验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: AI数据中心快速增长且功率需求大、波动性强，但其异构负载和资源需求导致需求灵活性难以直接量化，影响电力系统协调。
AI.method: 提出平均化资源使用处理方法，将细粒度CPU、GPU和内存使用映射为电力系统兼容的统一时间区间；构建批处理负载时间调度模型，考虑执行连续性、延迟约束和服务器资源容量；结合利用率相关服务器功耗模型，将调度决策转化为功率需求；评估短期峰值削减和最大持续降功率时长两类灵活性指标。
AI.result: 基于真实GPU集群轨迹的数值结果表明，负载时间迁移能够为AI数据中心提供可量化且电网兼容的需求灵活性，同时对计算负载干扰有限。
AI.conclusion: 通过批处理负载时间迁移，AI数据中心可在较小计算干扰下提供有效需求灵活性，支持电力系统协调运行。

title: AdaST: Adaptive Coupling for Spatial-Temporal Forecasting
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (main conference). Code: https://github.com/LzyFischer/AdaST
summary: Spatial-temporal (ST) forecasting underpins many real-world systems such as traffic, climate, and energy networks. While existing methods implicitly assume strong spatiotemporal coupling, we observe that real-world ST data exhibits distinct coupling regimes, ranging from temporal-dominated and spatial-dominated to strongly coupled patterns. This mismatch causes current models to suffer from spurious dependencies and degraded performance when one correlation dominates. To overcome this limitation, we aim to dynamically modulate spatial and temporal modeling based on the data's inherent coupling structure. However, three key challenges exist: unknown coupling structure, heterogeneous coupling dynamics, and suboptimal spatial modeling. We propose AdaST, an adaptive ST forecasting framework that tackles these challenges through a decompose-recompose paradigm. AdaST factorizes inputs into components capturing different coupling patterns using heterogeneity-aware experts. Each component is processed by role-aligned modules, and a correlation-informed adaptive recomposer integrates them for final prediction. Extensive experiments confirm that AdaST significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, validating the necessity of an adaptive approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaST，一个面向时空预测的自适应框架，通过分解-重组范式动态调节空间与时间建模，以应对真实数据中不同的时空耦合模式。
AI.motivation: 现有时空预测方法通常隐含假设时空强耦合，但真实世界时空数据存在时间主导、空间主导和强耦合等不同耦合机制。这种不匹配会导致虚假依赖，并在某一相关性占主导时降低模型性能。因此，需要根据数据内在耦合结构动态调整空间和时间建模。
AI.method: AdaST采用分解-重组范式：使用异质性感知专家将输入分解为捕捉不同耦合模式的组件；每个组件由角色对齐模块处理；再通过相关性信息驱动的自适应重组器整合各组件进行最终预测。该方法旨在解决未知耦合结构、异质耦合动态和次优空间建模三个挑战。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，AdaST显著优于当前最先进的基线方法，验证了自适应方法的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 面对真实时空数据中多样化的耦合机制，自适应地调节空间与时间建模是必要且有效的，AdaST能够提升时空预测性能。

title: When Should LLMs Trust Their Own Revisions? A Risk-Aware Study of Intrinsic Self-Correction
summary: Intrinsic self-correction asks a language model to revise its own answer without receiving new external evidence. A second pass can recover mistakes, but it can also overturn answers that were already correct. We study this trade-off across 29 open-weight LLMs on BoolQ, GSM8K, and Corr2Cause by tracking correctness transitions between initial and revised answers. Aggregate accuracy can conceal substantially different revision behavior: for example, Llama-3.1-8B improves by 25.5 percentage points on GSM8K, while refinement changes 19.1% of initially correct answers into wrong ones. A controlled BoolQ study further shows that refinement prompts shift the balance between recovery and harm. We then compare three runtime choices: keeping the initial answer, always accepting the revision, and selectively invoking revision using signals available after the initial response. The comparison identifies settings where learned gating is useful and others where a simpler unconditional policy performs better. These results suggest treating intrinsic self-correction as a revision policy rather than as a uniformly beneficial second pass, and evaluating it through both the corrections it recovers and the errors it introduces.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型的内在自我纠错权衡：第二遍修正既能改对错误，也可能改错原本正确的答案；作者在29个开源权重模型和三个数据集上追踪答案正确性转移，并比较不同修正策略。
AI.motivation: 内在自我纠错通常被视为有益的二次修正，但实际可能同时带来纠错收益和引入新错误，且总体准确率会掩盖这种双向变化，因此需要系统评估其收益与代价。
AI.method: 在BoolQ、GSM8K和Corr2Cause上，对29个开源权重LLM追踪初次答案与修正答案之间的正确性转移；通过受控BoolQ实验考察修正提示如何影响恢复与损害；并比较三种运行时策略：保留初始答案、总是接受修正、以及基于初始回答后可用信号选择性触发修正。
AI.result: 总体准确率掩盖了差异显著的修正行为，例如Llama-3.1-8B在GSM8K上提升25.5个百分点，但修正将19.1%的初始正确答案改为错误；受控BoolQ研究表明修正提示会改变恢复与损害之间的平衡；策略比较显示，学习式门控在某些场景有用，而更简单的无条件策略在其他场景表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 应将内在自我纠错视为一种修正策略，而非普遍有益的二次处理，并从恢复的纠正和引入的错误两方面进行评价。

title: Learning to Explore Hidden Kinematics for Articulated Object Manipulation
summary: The kinematics of an articulated object is often ambiguous from vision alone. Interaction resolves the ambiguity, and active perception methods exploit this by searching for the single action that most sharpens a belief over the kinematic parameters at each step. Such greedy search cannot be extended over a horizon without forward models of the contact and inertial dynamics, which are themselves unknown. We instead amortize action selection into training. We maintain a belief distribution over joint type and parameters, initialized from a generative prior and updated by Bayesian filtering on the observed part motion. To condition the policy on this belief, we render it as a per-point articulation flow field, the motion that the current posterior predicts for every point on the object. Carrying the inductive bias of articulated motion, this representation generalizes better than a latent encoding of the belief or flow tracked from observation. We train the policy with reinforcement learning, rewarding the entropy that each interaction removes from the posterior, so that informative exploration becomes learned behavior rather than a search at every step. Our method outperforms previous approaches across door and drawer manipulation on the PartManip benchmark, and reaches 61.7% success on ArticuRiddle, a new dataset of objects whose appearance implies the wrong articulation, against 44.4% for the best previous method. Project Website: https://hiddenkinematics.github.io/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种通过强化学习将主动感知中的动作选择摊销到训练阶段的方法，用于从视觉和交互中推断铰接物体的运动学参数。
AI.motivation: 仅从视觉推断铰接物体的运动学通常存在歧义，而交互可以消除歧义。现有主动感知方法每步贪心地寻找最能锐化运动学参数信念的单一动作，但由于接触和惯性动力学未知，这种贪心搜索难以扩展到更长时间范围。
AI.method: 维护关于关节类型和参数的信念分布，该分布由生成先验初始化，并通过观测到的部件运动进行贝叶斯滤波更新。将信念渲染为逐点的铰接流场，即当前后验对物体上每个点预测的运动，以此作为策略的条件输入。使用强化学习训练策略，奖励为每次交互从后验中移除的熵，使信息性探索成为学习到的行为，而非每步搜索。
AI.result: 在PartManip基准的门和抽屉操作任务上优于先前方法；在ArticuRiddle新数据集上达到61.7%成功率，而最佳先前方法为44.4%。该数据集包含外观暗示错误铰接方式的物体。
AI.conclusion: 将动作选择摊销到训练中，并结合基于铰接流场的信念表示，可以更有效地学习主动感知策略，在铰接物体操作和存在视觉歧义的场景中取得更好性能。

title: Compress to Remember: Learning Compact Memory via On-Policy Distillation for Long Video Generation
summary: Standard video generators do not natively compact historical context into reusable memory tokens. As generation continues, the growing history makes it increasingly difficult to retain information from earlier frames due to long-context degradation. Key-frame-based approaches address this challenge by retaining selected past frames, but can discard information needed for future generation. Rather than relying on frame selection alone, we study whether a frozen video generator can supply the supervision needed to learn a compact representation of the history. We propose Prediction-Aligned Context Compaction (PACC), which uses a learned compressor to aggregate information across past frames into compact memory tokens. We train the compressor through on-policy distillation, using the same frozen generator both as a student when conditioned on compressed memory and as a teacher when conditioned on the full history. The student generates continuations, while the teacher provides targets for the same noisy inputs at each denoising step. Only the compressor is updated to align the student's predictions with these targets. We evaluate PACC on MBench, which jointly measures memory-event coverage and consistency. PACC outperforms the strongest baseline by 6.63 points on Causal-rCM and 3.19 points on Causal Forcing. Evaluation on VBench-Long using MovieGen prompts further shows that PACC produces minute-long videos with generation quality competitive with baselines. Together, these results show that learning to compact historical context can improve long-video memory without modifying the underlying generator.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PACC，用可学习压缩器将历史帧压缩为紧凑记忆 token，并通过冻结视频生成器的在线蒸馏训练压缩器，从而在不修改生成器的情况下提升长视频记忆与一致性。
AI.motivation: 标准视频生成器无法原生地将历史上下文压缩为可复用记忆，随生成进行，长上下文退化使早期帧信息难以保留；基于关键帧的方法虽可缓解，但可能丢弃未来生成所需的信息。
AI.method: PACC 使用学习到的压缩器聚合过去帧信息为紧凑 memory tokens。训练采用 on-policy distillation：同一冻结生成器在条件于压缩记忆时作为学生，在条件于完整历史时作为教师；学生在每个去噪步生成续帧，教师对相同噪声输入提供目标，仅更新压缩器以对齐学生预测。
AI.result: 在 MBench 上，PACC 在 Causal-rCM 上比最强基线高 6.63 分，在 Causal Forcing 上高 3.19 分。在 VBench-Long 和 MovieGen prompts 上，可生成分钟级长视频，生成质量与基线相当。
AI.conclusion: 学习压缩历史上下文可以提升长视频记忆能力，且无需修改底层视频生成器。

title: Complete Characterization of Minimum-Order Functional Observers from Darouach to Luenberger
summary:
This paper gives an order-by-order characterization of linear functional
  observers between the minimum dimension permitted by the algebraic observer
  condition and the upper endpoint determined by functional observability.
  Functional observability indices determine the minimum algebraically
  admissible order
  $$
  q_0=\sum_{j=1}^rη_j,
  $$
  where $r$ is the number of independent functionals to be estimated and
  $η_j$ is the functional observability index associated with the $j$th
  functional. For an $n$-dimensional system with $p$ independent measured outputs, let
  $n_0$ denote the rank of the observability matrix. Under functional
  observability, the upper endpoint of the functional-observer order range
  is $n_0-p$. The algebraic
  and spectral observer conditions are characterized at each prescribed
  order between these two endpoints. A nullspace representation in the
  original state space yields rank and matrix-pencil characterizations of
  the algebraic and spectral conditions, respectively. The minimum observer
  order is obtained as the smallest spectrally feasible order in the
  resulting order spectrum. The two endpoints include the classical
  Darouach and Luenberger orders as special cases: the lower endpoint
  reduces to the Darouach order when $q_0=r$, while, under complete
  observability, the upper endpoint reduces to the Luenberger order $n-p$.

AI.tldr: 本文对线性函数观测器进行了逐阶表征，给出了从代数观测器条件下最小允许维数到函数可观性决定的上界之间的所有可能阶数范围，并刻画了各阶的代数与谱条件。
AI.motivation: 现有函数观测器设计多关注最小阶或特定阶，缺乏对介于最小代数可行阶与函数可观性上界之间所有阶数的系统刻画。本文旨在填补这一空白，并统一经典 Darouach 阶与 Luenberger 阶等特例。
AI.method: 利用函数可观性指标确定最小代数允许阶 q0=sum η_j；对 n 维系统、p 个独立测量输出，设 n0 为可观性矩阵的秩，在函数可观性下上界为 n0-p。通过原状态空间中的零空间表示，分别得到代数条件的秩表征和谱条件的矩阵束表征，并构造阶数谱以寻找最小谱可行阶。
AI.result: 给出了函数观测器阶数的下界 q0=sum η_j 与上界 n0-p；在每个预设阶数上刻画代数与谱观测器条件；最小观测器阶数为阶数谱中最小的谱可行阶；当 q0=r 时下界退化为 Darouach 阶，在完全可观时上界退化为 Luenberger 阶 n-p。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了线性函数观测器从最小可行阶到函数可观性上界的完整阶数表征框架，推广并统一了经典观测器阶数结果，为函数观测器的阶数选择与设计提供了系统依据。

title: Hyperspherical Semantic Trajectory Analysis: Mapping Technological Diffusion across Academic Preprints, Patent Signals, and Compute Scaling
summary: Macroeconomic productivity metrics, such as Total Factor Productivity, register technological breakthroughs with multi-year reporting lags due to administrative survey intervals and national accounting conventions. This paper introduces Hyperspherical Semantic Trajectory Analysis (HSTA), an unsupervised quantitative methodology that tracks technology diffusion directly from unstructured scientific and commercial text streams. We analyze 30,000 filtered document records spanning academic preprints from arXiv and patent application records from the USPTO. By projecting high-dimensional Transformer sentence embeddings onto unit hyperspheres using Spherical K-Means clustering across eight primary sub-topics and UMAP manifold reductions, HSTA formalizes two quantitative metrics: (1) Semantic Centroid Vector Drift, which tracks vocabulary shifts between temporal sub-corpora to identify structural paradigm transformations; and (2) Commercialization Offset, which evaluates cross-corpus peak density alignments between scientific discovery and intellectual property filings. Linking quarterly topic volume velocity with physical hardware metrics from the Epoch AI database, Vector Autoregressive F-tests demonstrate that quarterly paper volume velocity alone does not Granger-cause frontier compute allocation surges at conventional statistical significance levels, highlighting the necessity of conditioning textual signals on physical capital constraints. Empirical results reveal that sub-topics covering Large Language Models (with a drift metric of 0.332) and Artificial Intelligence Systems (with a drift metric of 0.234) undergo the highest rate of semantic evolution, offering an objective, real-time mechanism to complement traditional economic statistics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无监督定量方法 HSTA，利用 arXiv 论文与 USPTO 专利文本追踪技术扩散，并构建语义质心漂移与商业化偏移两个指标，以补充传统宏观经济生产率统计的滞后性。
AI.motivation: 传统全要素生产率等宏观经济指标因行政调查周期和国民核算惯例存在数年报告滞后，难以及时反映技术突破与扩散。
AI.method: 分析 3 万条 arXiv 预印本与 USPTO 专利申请记录，使用 Transformer 句向量、球面 K-Means 聚类和 UMAP 降维，将高维嵌入投影到单位超球面；提出语义质心向量漂移和商业化偏移两个指标，并用向量自回归 F 检验关联季度主题量与 Epoch AI 硬件指标。
AI.result: 大语言模型子主题语义漂移最高为 0.332，人工智能系统为 0.234；季度论文量速度单独并未在常规显著性水平上格兰杰导致前沿算力分配激增，说明文本信号需结合物理资本约束。
AI.conclusion: HSTA 可提供客观、实时的技术语义演化监测机制，补充传统经济统计，但技术扩散信号应结合物理资本约束进行解释。

title: Cascaded consensus splitting for multi-branch contingency games
summary: Contingency games enable agents to anticipate and plan for other agents' hypothetical intents by constructing trajectories with a shared prefix and intent-dependent branches. While contingency games capture intent uncertainty, existing formulations rely on a single branching time, oversimplifying interactions in which different agents' intentions are revealed at different times. Moreover, the computational cost of such problems grows rapidly with the number of agents and intents, as all scenario-dependent best responses must be solved jointly. We introduce a multi-branch contingency architecture in which sources of intent uncertainty can be resolved progressively at different branching times, allowing the planned trajectories to adapt to the asynchronous revelation of intents. We also develop an ADMM-based solver that exploits scenario-level parallelism. Experiments on tightly coupled three-agent interactions support that the proposed architecture outperforms the conventional single-branch while achieving a lower mean receding-horizon solve time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多分支偶然性架构，用于处理不同智能体意图在不同时间揭示的异步不确定性问题，并开发了基于ADMM的并行求解器。
AI.motivation: 现有偶然性博弈通常假设单一分支时间，无法准确刻画不同智能体意图在不同时刻揭示的交互；同时，随着智能体和意图数量增加，联合求解所有场景相关最佳响应的计算成本迅速增长。
AI.method: 引入多分支偶然性架构，使意图不确定性可在不同分支时间逐步解决，从而让规划轨迹适应意图的异步揭示；并设计基于ADMM的求解器，利用场景级并行性降低计算负担。
AI.result: 在紧密耦合的三智能体交互实验中，所提架构优于传统单分支方法，同时实现了更低的滚动时域平均求解时间。
AI.conclusion: 多分支偶然性架构能够有效处理异步意图揭示问题，并在保持性能优势的同时提升计算效率。

title: A robust single-sensing-element tactile sensor for concurrent pressure and tackiness detection with real-time signal decoupling capability
summary: Integrating tackiness sensation into the artificial skin of humanoid robots significantly enhances their cognitive and operational capabilities. However existing tactile sensors face challenges in decoupling of the multimodal signal and stability. Here we present a surface-soft tactile sensor that incorporates a Hall effect sensor and a soft magnetic composite within a robust elastic framework. The sensor surface indents under pressure and bulges prominently when retracted from sticky surfaces dynamically altering the Hall sensor-magnet distance. This generates whole-process-traceable and baseline-separated signals enabling real-time differentiation between pressure and pull-off force. This single-sensing-element design facilitates bimodal sensing at the same contact spot while eliminate stress cross-talk enhancing both accuracy and sensitivity. The fusion of a robust framework and magneto-mechanical sensing mechanism equips the sensor with exceptional reliability and excellent signal baseline stability. This tactile sensor holds substantial potential for advancing robotic capabilities in evaluating adhesive properties monitoring rubber aging precisely handling lightweight objects and cognizing natural objects surface characteristics.

AI.tldr: 提出一种表面柔软触觉传感器，利用霍尔传感器与软磁复合材料在弹性框架内实现压力与粘附/拉脱力的双模态实时区分，具有高可靠性和优异基线稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有触觉传感器难以解耦多模态信号且稳定性不足，而将粘性感知集成到人形机器人人工皮肤中可显著提升其认知与操作能力。
AI.method: 在稳健弹性框架中集成霍尔效应传感器和软磁复合材料；传感器表面受压时凹陷、脱离粘性表面时凸起，动态改变霍尔传感器与磁体间距；通过单传感单元在同一接触点实现双模态感知，并消除应力串扰。
AI.result: 产生全过程可追踪且基线分离的信号，可实时区分压力与拉脱力；单传感单元双模态设计提高精度与灵敏度；稳健框架与磁-机械传感机制带来高可靠性和优异信号基线稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 该触觉传感器在评估粘附性能、监测橡胶老化、精确抓取轻量物体以及认知自然物体表面特性方面具有较大潜力，可推进机器人能力发展。

title: Memory Is a Derivation: The Distributed-Evidence Paradox in Long-Term Agents
summary: Long-running LLM agents compress past interactions into persistent memories that may be reused as premises for later tasks. This creates a distinct derivation problem: whether the memory actually follows from what the interaction history supports. Relevant evidence may be scattered across earlier interactions, while compression can introduce relations or event status that the history never established. A valid memory may therefore appear unsupported because its citations omit relevant evidence, while individually supported facts may be composed into a stronger statement the history never established. We characterize this problem through three coupled requirements: (1) Evidence scope; (2) Compositional validity; (3) Admission reliability. We therefore ask whether the interaction history available at write time supports what enters persistent memory. We introduce DerivAudit, a framework for auditing whether a memory is actually supported by the history available when it was written. The audit separates three questions: whether supporting evidence lies beyond writer-provided citations, whether the composed memory introduces unsupported meaning, and how write-time admission decisions affect later memory use. Across two natural memory corpora, audits using broader pre-write history recover support for nearly 60% of memories that appear unsupported from citations alone, while 17-21% remain unsupported after expansion. Yet broader evidence does not by itself make admission reliable: unsupported memories are still frequently admitted across verification models, and evidence expansion alone worsens it on two backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文研究长时运行LLM智能体将交互历史压缩为持久记忆时的推导问题，提出DerivAudit审计框架，揭示记忆支持性与准入可靠性的挑战。
AI.motivation: 长时LLM智能体将过去交互压缩为持久记忆并作为后续任务前提，但记忆可能并不真正由交互历史支持。证据可能分散，压缩可能引入历史未确立的关系或事件状态；有效记忆可能因引用遗漏而看似无支持，单独支持的事实也可能被组合成历史未确立的更强陈述。因此需要审计写入时历史是否支持进入持久记忆的内容。
AI.method: 提出DerivAudit框架，围绕三个耦合要求（证据范围、组合有效性、准入可靠性），将审计分为三个问题：支持证据是否超出写入者提供的引用、组合记忆是否引入无支持含义、写入时准入决策如何影响后续记忆使用。并在两个自然记忆语料库上评估。
AI.result: 使用更广泛的写入前历史进行审计，可从仅凭引用看似无支持的记忆中恢复近60%的支持，但17-21%在扩展后仍无支持。更广泛证据本身并不能使准入可靠：无支持记忆仍常被验证模型接纳，且仅靠证据扩展在两个骨干模型上反而恶化准入。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖引用或扩大证据范围不足以确保持久记忆的可靠准入，需要结合证据范围、组合有效性与准入决策进行系统审计。

title: OTT3R: Multi-View 3D Reconstruction and Fast Dataset Generation at 1% Compute
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models have achieved impressive performance by scaling model and dataset size, but their cost excludes most research groups and precludes edge deployment. Additionally, generating 3D supervision without sensors still relies on slow, unreliable Structure-from-Motion, as the community lacks a COLMAP-like system for neural 3D pseudo-label generation. We present OTT3R (RGB-Only Tiny Transformer for 3D Reconstruction), a knowledge distillation framework that addresses both problems on a single workstation equipped with 2 GPUs. Distilling $π^3$ (959M parameters) into a 102M-parameter student yields 9.4$\times$ compression and up to 7$\times$ faster inference, trained at 1.6% of VGGT's training compute. An integrated pseudo-label pipeline offers a reliable, high-throughput alternative to COLMAP, generating dense per-pixel point maps and SE(3) camera poses for a 667K-image corpus in 3.5 hours on two commodity GPUs and succeeding on every sequence we tested, including those where COLMAP fails. The general student tracks the teacher on in-distribution monocular depth and, zero-shot, outperforms COLMAP on 7-Scenes and on DTU completion, but it does not replace the teacher on out-of-distribution multi-view geometry. The deployable artifact is the domain-specialized student: after specialization at 0.2% compute, it is 4$\times$ more accurate than COLMAP on 7-Scenes at 980$\times$ throughput, with near-teacher completion. Code is available at https://github.com/TheFourthKaramazov/OTT3R

AI.tldr: OTT3R 是一个知识蒸馏框架，将 959M 参数的 π^3 教师模型蒸馏为 102M 参数的 RGB-only 轻量 Transformer 学生模型，并集成无需 COLMAP 的神经伪标签生成流程，在双 GPU 工作站上实现高效 3D 重建与监督数据生成。
AI.motivation: 前馈 3D 重建模型虽性能强，但模型和数据集规模导致训练与部署成本过高，大多数研究组和边缘设备难以承受；同时，无传感器 3D 监督仍依赖缓慢且不可靠的 Structure-from-Motion，社区缺乏类似 COLMAP 的神经 3D 伪标签生成系统。
AI.method: 提出 OTT3R，采用知识蒸馏将 π^3 教师蒸馏到 102M 参数的学生模型；构建集成的伪标签流水线，生成稠密逐像素点图和 SE(3) 相机位姿；并支持在低计算量下进行领域专用化。
AI.result: 蒸馏实现 9.4 倍压缩和最高 7 倍推理加速，训练计算量仅为 VGGT 的 1.6%；伪标签流水线在两张消费级 GPU 上 3.5 小时处理 667K 图像，所有测试序列均成功，包括 COLMAP 失败的情况。通用学生在同分布单目深度上接近教师，零样本在 7-Scenes 和 DTU 补全上优于 COLMAP，但在分布外多视图几何上不能替代教师。领域专用学生在仅 0.2% 计算量专用化后，于 7-Scenes 上比 COLMAP 准确 4 倍、吞吐量高 980 倍，补全性能接近教师。
AI.conclusion: OTT3R 证明通过知识蒸馏与伪标签流水线，可在低成本工作站上获得可部署的轻量 3D 重建模型，作为 COLMAP 的高效替代用于伪标签生成和特定领域任务，但通用学生尚不能完全替代教师在分布外多视图几何上的能力。

title: LEGO-Anything: Coding Agents for 3D Scene Reconstruction
summary: A 3D scene reconstructed from a single image is most useful when represented not as a rendering or a fixed 3D output, but as an explicit scene program whose execution yields a scene that can be inspected, edited, and queried. We present LEGO-Anything, an Image-to-Code framework in which a coding agent iteratively writes and executes Blender code, inspects scenes and renderings, and revises the program. To evaluate end-to-end scene recovery, we introduce LEGO-Bench, a simulator-grounded benchmark with 208 images from 104 diverse indoor and outdoor scenes. LEGO-Bench separately scores artifact validity, visible-surface geometry, and rendered appearance. Its simulator-grounded design enables extensibility and precise automatic evaluation. Among evaluated agents, GPT-6-astra achieves the strongest overall results, with 53.4% indoor and 39.6% outdoor scores, yet substantial gaps remain between delivering valid scene artifacts and faithfully recovering scene geometry and appearance. Analysis of agent construction trajectories reveals three recurring issues: weak scene initialization, regressive edits during iteration, and unreliable self-evaluation. These findings motivate LEGO-Plugin, a training-free harness plugin for more controlled iterative scene construction, which improves all six evaluated models, with relative gains of up to 62.7% in overall score. Finally, we test whether reconstructed scenes can represent natural images and support vision tasks. In LEGO-World, we derive object detections, instance masks, and relative depth as deterministic queries on scenes reconstructed by GPT-6-astra. These readouts show non-trivial performance across all three tasks but fall well short of specialized vision models, suggesting that program-constructed scenes from current coding agents are a promising but not yet sufficiently precise representation of natural images.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LEGO-Anything，将单图 3D 场景重建表示为可执行、可检查、可编辑和可查询的 Blender 代码程序，并构建 LEGO-Bench 评估端到端场景恢复，同时提出 LEGO-Plugin 改进迭代构建过程。
AI.motivation: 现有单图 3D 重建多输出渲染图或固定 3D 结果，难以检查、编辑和查询；作者希望将场景表示为显式“场景程序”，从而支持更灵活的场景操作与评估。
AI.method: 提出 Image-to-Code 框架 LEGO-Anything：编码智能体迭代编写并执行 Blender 代码、检查场景与渲染并修正程序。构建 LEGO-Bench：基于模拟器，包含 104 个室内外场景的 208 张图像，分别评估产物有效性、可见表面几何和渲染外观。分析智能体轨迹后提出免训练插件 LEGO-Plugin 以改进迭代场景构建。还通过 LEGO-World 将重建场景用于目标检测、实例掩码和相对深度查询。
AI.result: GPT-6-astra 总体表现最强，室内得分 53.4%、室外 39.6%，但在有效场景产物与忠实恢复几何和外观之间仍有明显差距。轨迹分析发现三类问题：场景初始化弱、迭代中出现退化编辑、自评估不可靠。LEGO-Plugin 提升了全部六个评估模型，总体得分相对提升最高达 62.7%。LEGO-World 中查询得到的目标检测、实例掩码和相对深度有一定效果，但远低于专用视觉模型。
AI.conclusion: 由当前编码智能体通过程序构建的场景，是自然图像的一种有前景但尚不够精确的表示；该方法在可编辑、可查询场景程序方向上有潜力，但仍需改进几何与外观恢复精度。

title: More Features Are Not More Evidence: Limits of Training-Free Human Activity Recognition with Jev
summary: General-purpose models promise sensor-based decisions without training a task-specific classifier, which could reduce the dependence of Human Activity Recognition (HAR) on labeled data. Yet it remains unclear whether such models can directly interpret deterministic descriptions of physical sensor signals well enough to replace or complement trained HAR models. We study this question using Jev, a fixed general-purpose probabilistic decision model, on 1,800 class-balanced accelerometer windows from WISDM, UCI341, and PAMAP2. Jev receives no labeled examples, retrieval context, or HAR-specific parameter updates. We evaluate three deterministic sensor representations and compare 5,400 Jev decisions with a generative baseline and three supervised HAR models. Jev remains far below supervised recognition, with its strongest representation reaching macro-F1 of 0.038, 0.118, and 0.089 across the three datasets, compared with 0.686 to 0.907 for the supervised models. More numerical features do not improve Jev. Instead, they reduce recognition on all three datasets, while augmenting the same numerical evidence with a deterministic semantic rendering partially recovers performance, although the experiment does not isolate semantics from the accompanying serialization and redundancy changes. Jev is fast and inexpensive to query, but its probabilities are not reliably calibrated for recognition. A post-hoc fusion analysis finds a small improvement on WISDM that does not replicate on UCI341 or PAMAP2. These results show that training-free sensor decisions depend not only on the information available in the signal, but also on whether the model can use the representation through which that information is exposed. The sensor-to-model interface should therefore be treated as part of the model evaluation rather than as a neutral preprocessing step.

AI.tldr: 本文研究通用概率决策模型Jev能否无需训练直接根据确定性传感器表示进行人体活动识别，并在WISDM、UCI341和PAMAP2上发现其性能远低于监督模型，说明传感器到模型的接口会显著影响识别效果。
AI.motivation: 通用模型有望减少HAR对标注数据的依赖，但尚不清楚此类模型能否直接解释物理传感器信号的确定性描述，以替代或补充训练好的HAR模型。
AI.method: 使用固定通用概率决策模型Jev，在三个数据集的1800个类别均衡加速度窗口上测试，不提供标注样本、检索上下文或HAR专用参数更新；评估三种确定性传感器表示，将5400次Jev决策与一个生成基线及三个监督HAR模型比较，并分析特征数量、语义渲染、概率校准和事后融合。
AI.result: Jev最强表示在三数据集上的macro-F1仅为0.038、0.118、0.089，而监督模型为0.686至0.907；增加数值特征未改善反而降低识别性能；加入确定性语义渲染可部分恢复性能，但实验未分离语义与序列化、冗余变化的影响；Jev查询快速廉价，但概率校准不可靠；事后融合仅在WISDM有微小提升，未在UCI341或PAMAP2复现。
AI.conclusion: 无训练传感器决策不仅取决于信号中可用信息，也取决于模型能否利用呈现该信息的表示；传感器到模型的接口应作为模型评估的一部分，而非中性的预处理步骤。

title: Riemannian Splat Regression Models for Learning Time Fields on Arbitrary Riemannian Manifolds
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, Spotlight Paper at IEEE/RSJ IROS Workshop on Geometric Representations in Robotics
summary: Motion planning on arbitrary Riemannian manifolds is an important and difficult problem that frustrates typical planning methods for Euclidean spaces. In particular, motion planning methods that approximate optimal time-to-go functions with neural networks, e.g., Neural Time Fields (NTFields), cannot be directly applied without using ad-hoc coordinate projections into higher dimensions. Using these methods directly without such projections is desirable, as it promises to provide the lowest-possible-runtime method for obtaining optimal plans on high-dimensional manifolds while using minimal model capacity. In this work, we develop a model that requires no coordinate projection and can learn arbitrary functions on Riemannian manifolds by combining splat regression models with splats defined by wrapped Gaussian distributions. We successfully apply this model for learning arrival time fields on several Riemannian manifolds, and we compare the accuracy and model size of this approach with multi-layer perceptrons adapted to work on each manifold individually.

AI.tldr: 本文研究任意黎曼流形上的运动规划，提出一种无需坐标投影即可学习黎曼流形上任意函数的模型，并将其用于学习到达时间场。
AI.motivation: 传统欧氏空间规划方法难以直接用于任意黎曼流形；基于神经网络逼近最优时间代价函数的方法（如NTFields）若不进行额外高维坐标投影便无法直接应用。避免投影有望以最低运行时和最小模型容量获得高维流形上的最优规划。
AI.method: 将splat回归模型与由wrapped Gaussian distribution定义的splat相结合，构建无需坐标投影、可直接在黎曼流形上学习任意函数的模型；在多个黎曼流形上学习arrival time fields。
AI.result: 该模型成功用于多个黎曼流形上的到达时间场学习，并与针对各流形分别适配的多层感知机（MLP）在准确率和模型大小方面进行了比较。
AI.conclusion: 无需坐标投影的黎曼流形函数学习模型可用于学习到达时间场，为在高维黎曼流形上实现低运行时、低模型容量的最优运动规划提供了可行途径。

title: Principled Thoughts for Latent Recursive LLM Systems
summary: Large language models can reason in continuous space instead of decoded text, by recurring on their own hidden states or by passing those states between agents, while training supervises only the Cross-Entropy (CE) of the final decoded answer and does not constrain the thought. Theoretical and empirical analyses establish and confirm four failures of CE-only training that lead to a lower probability of the correct answer such as collapsing thoughts across distinct questions and retaining irrelevant information. We introduce REST (REpresentation-Supervised Thoughts), a training objective that turns four properties of a valid thought representation (causality, minimality, separability, and stability) into differentiable losses added to CE. We instantiate it in latent single-agent and multi-agent systems, without architectural changes or added parameters at inference. Across 7 benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, medicine, and code generation, with the same training data, compute, and latent budget, REST increases accuracy over CE-only training across agent settings and model sizes by up to 7.5 percentage points and convergence on a final answer by 30\%. Furthermore, REST thoughts encode more of what is required to achieve the correct answer, and decoding them better recovers the intended output of the agent, which makes latent communication easier to interpret. Project Website: https://fard-lab.github.io/REST

AI.tldr: 论文提出REST训练目标，通过将有效思维表示的四个性质（因果性、最小性、可分离性、稳定性）转化为可微损失并加入交叉熵训练，提升潜空间推理的准确率和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型可在连续潜空间中进行推理（如递归自身隐藏状态或在智能体间传递状态），但训练仅用最终解码答案的交叉熵监督，不约束思维过程。理论与实证分析表明这种CE-only训练存在四种失败模式，会降低正确答案概率，如不同问题思维坍缩、保留无关信息。
AI.method: 提出REST（REpresentation-Supervised Thoughts），将有效思维表示的四个性质——因果性、最小性、可分离性和稳定性——转化为可微损失，并与交叉熵损失联合训练。在单智能体和多智能体潜空间系统中实例化，不改变架构、推理时不增加参数。
AI.result: 在数学、科学、医学和代码生成等7个基准上，在相同训练数据、计算量和潜空间预算下，REST相比CE-only训练在多种智能体设置和模型规模上准确率最高提升7.5个百分点，最终答案收敛率提升30%。REST思维编码了更多获得正确答案所需信息，解码后能更好恢复智能体预期输出，使潜通信更易解释。
AI.conclusion: 仅用交叉熵监督潜空间推理不足，REST通过监督思维表示本身，有效提升潜空间推理性能、收敛性与可解释性，且无需架构修改或推理额外参数。

title: Stochastic World Models for Verifying Vision-Based Neural Feedback Systems
summary: Verifying a vision-based neural feedback system requires a model of the observations its controller acts upon. Such a model must capture the variation the sensor produces, while remaining tractable for closed-loop analysis. Generative adversarial networks (GANs) have served as perception surrogates, but they are large, reproduce complex scenes poorly, and are hard to verify. We explore stochastic world models as a richer class of perception surrogates. We train a world model with physically grounded latents, built from operations that standard verifiers bound. It reproduces held-out frames more faithfully than GAN surrogates with up to 130 times as many parameters. To verify these surrogates, we develop a procedure that combines falsification, adaptive refinement, symbolic, and backward analyses. On an emergency braking benchmark with a GAN surrogate, our procedure resolves the entire state space, 38% of which the state-of-the-art verifier left unresolved. On the RGB version of the benchmark, where no verification results have previously been reported, our procedure resolves over 80% of the state space with a world model surrogate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用随机世界模型作为视觉感知替代模型，并结合假证、自适应细化、符号分析和反向分析来验证基于视觉的神经反馈系统；在紧急制动基准上显著提升可验证状态空间比例。
AI.motivation: 验证基于视觉的神经反馈系统需要对其控制器所依赖的观测进行建模。该模型需捕捉传感器变化且对闭环分析可处理。现有GAN感知替代模型规模大、复杂场景还原差且难以验证。
AI.method: 探索随机世界模型作为更丰富的感知替代模型，训练具有物理 grounding 的隐变量世界模型，且其操作可被标准验证器约束。开发一种验证流程，结合假证、自适应细化、符号分析和反向分析。
AI.result: 世界模型在重现留出帧方面比参数量最多130倍的GAN替代模型更忠实。在紧急制动基准的GAN替代模型上，该流程解决了整个状态空间，其中38%是先前最先进验证器未解决的。在RGB版本基准上，此前无验证结果，使用世界模型替代模型后解决了超过80%的状态空间。
AI.conclusion: 具有物理 grounding 隐变量的世界模型可作为更优的感知替代模型，配合所提验证流程，能有效验证基于视觉的神经反馈系统，并在多个基准上超越GAN替代模型和最先进验证器。

title: Resolving the Missing Financial Data Crisis: A Generative AI Pipeline for SEC 10-K Extraction
comment: Presented as a Lightning Talk at MIT URTC 2026
summary: SEC 10-K filings contain substantial financial information that is not consistently captured in structured datasets, creating a missing-data problem affecting over 70% of firms and half of total market capitalization. This can disproportionately bias quantitative analysis against smaller firms, which may be excluded due to limited available data. Traditional financial extraction methods such as Regular Expressions (Regex) and BERT, have been widely used. However, they are highly brittle when parsing complex SEC 10-K filings, which leads to data that is existent in the files being lost since these methods do not consider that a data attribute could be located in a different section or a footnote. This study evaluates several Large Language Models (LLMs), including Llama-3 8B, Qwen-2.5 14B, and Llama-3.3 70B, to figure out individual model strengths and weaknesses when extracting specific attributes from SEC 10-K text. The extraction quality was evaluated across four financial variables of varying structural complexity: Cash and Cash Equivalents (tabular), Short-Term Debt (hybrid), Credit Facilities (narrative), and Research and Development (hybrid). Results show that while smaller models like Llama-3 8B experience performance degradation under complex negative prompting, aligning parameter scale with document complexity yields high zero-shot accuracy. Qwen-2.5 14B excels as a tabular specialist with an 83.33% F1 score on Cash, whereas Llama-3.3 70B effectively navigates dense narrative footnotes, achieving a 76.92% F1 score on R&D. This scalable framework addresses critical information gaps in quantitative finance datasets and eliminates missing-data bias through a more thorough analysis of the SEC 10-K files.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了不同规模的大语言模型（LLMs）在从SEC 10-K文件中提取财务信息的表现，以解决结构化数据缺失问题。通过对四种不同复杂度财务变量的提取实验，发现模型规模与文档复杂度匹配时零样本准确率高，且不同模型各有专长。
AI.motivation: SEC 10-K文件中的大量财务信息未被结构化数据集一致捕获，导致超过70%的公司和一半市值的数据缺失，对小型公司造成量化分析偏差。传统方法如正则表达式和BERT在解析复杂文件时脆弱，忽略信息可能位于不同章节或脚注，造成数据丢失。
AI.method: 评估多个LLM（Llama-3 8B、Qwen-2.5 14B、Llama-3.3 70B）从SEC 10-K文本中提取特定属性的表现，针对四个结构复杂度不同的财务变量（现金及现金等价物、短期债务、信贷便利、研发）进行提取质量评估。
AI.result: 小型模型如Llama-3 8B在复杂负面提示下性能下降；模型参数规模与文档复杂度匹配时零样本准确率高。Qwen-2.5 14B作为表格专家在现金提取上F1达83.33%；Llama-3.3 70B有效处理密集叙述脚注，在研发提取上F1达76.92%。
AI.conclusion: 该可扩展框架通过更全面地分析SEC 10-K文件，解决了量化金融数据集中的关键信息缺口，并消除了缺失数据偏差。

title: PACT: Pairwise-Anchored Calibrated Tuning for Single-Token Typed Decisions
summary: Single-token typed-decision models answer a schema question by reading the logits of a few one-letter answer codes at a single position: they are fast and return a probability for every allowed answer, but they are trained with plain cross-entropy that ignores most of the structure in their training data. We study such a model whose data is curated as contrastive pairs---two contexts that differ in one edited fact that flips the answer---each carrying a machine-checked certificate that deleting the decisive sentence makes the fact unknown. We propose PACT, which turns this structure into four training terms that need no new annotation: a difference-in-differences margin over each pair that is invariant to any shared logit offset, a permutation-consistency term against answer-code position bias, an evidence-necessity term on certificate-verified ablated contexts, and an ordinal transport cost for rubric fields, plus a three-parameter contextual temperature. On a frozen 324-item holdout with three seeds, PACT matches the published recipe in accuracy ($84.6\%$ vs. $85.2\%$; McNemar $p \ge 0.50$ at every seed) while giving the lowest position bias of all runs (answer flips under relabelling $9.8\%$ vs. $13.8\%$) and the lowest ordinal error on rubric fields (MAE $0.232$ vs. $0.311$). Against a control with the same optimiser and schedule but cross-entropy only, PACT is significantly more accurate at two of three seeds, halves the seed-to-seed spread and lowers NLL by $26\%$. Seed-matched ablations and pre-specified falsification tests locate these gains precisely: no single term raises raw accuracy, and the method's value lies in robustness and stability rather than headline accuracy. Code, data splits, trained adapters, and all run records are available at https://github.com/BennyLinntu/PACT-Pairwise-Anchored-Calibrated-Tuning-for-Single-Token-Typed-Decisions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PACT方法，利用对比样本对和机器可验证证书中的结构信息，为单token类型化决策模型设计四项训练损失，在不增加标注的情况下提升鲁棒性与稳定性，而非单纯提高准确率。
AI.motivation: 单token类型化决策模型虽快速且可给出每个候选答案的概率，但通常仅用普通交叉熵训练，忽略了训练数据中对比样本对、答案翻转、证据证书等丰富结构。
AI.method: PACT将数据结构转化为四项无需新标注的训练项：每个对比对上的双重差分间隔损失（对共享logit偏移不变）、针对答案代码位置偏差的排列一致性项、基于证书验证的消融上下文证据必要性项、以及评分字段的有序传输成本，另加三参数上下文温度。
AI.result: 在冻结的324项留出集和三个随机种子上，PACT准确率与已发表方法相当（84.6%对85.2%，各种子McNemar p≥0.50），但位置偏差最低（重标记下答案翻转9.8%对13.8%），评分字段有序误差最低（MAE 0.232对0.311）。相比仅用交叉熵的同优化器与调度控制组，PACT在两个种子上显著更准，将种子间波动减半，NLL降低26%。
AI.conclusion: 种子匹配消融和预指定证伪测试表明，没有任何单一训练项能单独提升原始准确率；PACT的价值主要在于鲁棒性和稳定性，而非头条准确率。代码、数据划分、训练适配器和运行记录均已公开。

title: Inferring Soil Friction Angle from Robot Foot-Ground Force Histories: A Bayesian Inverse Approach to Proprioceptive Soil Sensing
summary: Foot-ground interaction signals recorded by quadruped robots may enable spatially distributed, in situ characterization of soil strength. As a first step, we test whether the internal friction angle $φ$ of cohesionless soil can be identified from the force history of a simplified rotating leg. A two-dimensional continuum model implemented with the material point method, benchmarked against measured rotating-leg force histories, generates the training data, and two Gaussian-process surrogates support Bayesian inversion of the full histories. In matched-model experiments, the framework recovers 14 off-grid friction angles with a median absolute error of approximately $0.1^\circ$ (maximum $\sim 0.7^\circ$); the reported credible intervals contain the true value in every case. These results establish that $φ$ is identifiable when the forward model is correctly specified, and support further development of proprioceptive soil sensing for spatially variable terrain, with applications from physics-grounded world models for robot training to post-wildfire slope assessment.

AI.tldr: 该研究测试四足机器人通过足-地相互作用力史识别无黏性土内摩擦角φ的可行性，并利用简化旋转腿、MPM正演模型与高斯过程代理进行贝叶斯反演。
AI.motivation: 四足机器人足部接触信号有望实现土壤强度的空间分布式原位表征，但需先验证土体参数是否可从腿-地作用力史中辨识。
AI.method: 建立二维连续体材料点法（MPM）模型，并用实测旋转腿力史进行基准验证；以该模型生成训练数据，构建两个高斯过程代理模型，对完整力史进行贝叶斯反演。
AI.result: 在模型匹配实验中，框架成功反演14个非网格内摩擦角，中位绝对误差约0.1°（最大约0.7°），且所有情况的可信区间均包含真值。
AI.conclusion: 当正演模型正确设定时，内摩擦角φ是可辨识的；结果支持进一步发展本体感受式土壤感知，用于空间变异地形，并可应用于机器人训练的物理世界模型及野火后边坡评估等场景。

title: EquivDP3: A SIM(3)-Invariant Point-Cloud Encoder for Data-Efficient Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. A shorter version has been submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: Visuomotor policies for humanoid loco-manipulation must generalize across object poses and lighting from only a handful of demonstrations. 3D Diffusion Policy (DP3) conditions a diffusion-based action generator on point-cloud features, but its PointNet-style encoder has no built-in equivariance to the rotations, translations, and scalings (SIM(3)) that manipulation tasks respect. EquiBot closed this gap for wheeled manipulators with a SIM(3)-equivariant Vector Neuron Network (VNN) encoder. We extend this to a substantially more complex embodiment, the 43-joint Unitree G1 humanoid, and propose EquivDP3: a two-stage policy where a high-level diffusion planner with a SIM(3)-equivariant VNN encoder emits 6 Hz whole-body command chunks, executed at 50 Hz by a frozen, pre-trained RL locomotion policy and a differential inverse-kinematics module for the arms, trained end-to-end by behavior cloning. Across two simulated IsaacLab benchmarks and four non-equivariant baselines (5-100 demonstrations, in- and out-of-distribution), EquivDP3's advantage concentrates in the low-data regime: at 5-10 demonstrations it reaches 67.1% success versus 38.2-52.4% for the baselines, while by 50-100 all encoders converge (74.3-85.2%) and the ordering is no longer meaningful. A proprioception-only control confirms this gap is genuinely perceptual: with the point cloud removed, success drops to 31% vs. 60% (EquivDP3) at 5 demonstrations and 78% vs. 99% at 10, but vanishes by 50-100, showing the high-data plateau reflects a benchmark ceiling, not five encoders learning the same invariance. The encoder costs only 0.8 ms of extra latency per action chunk over the PointNet encoder it replaces. Baking geometric symmetry into a hierarchical diffusion policy's perception backbone is a practical, nearly free way to improve data efficiency for humanoid loco-manipulation when demonstrations are scarce.

AI.tldr: 提出EquivDP3：将SIM(3)等变VNN编码器从轮式机械臂扩展到43自由度Unitree G1人形机器人，构建两阶段扩散策略（6Hz高层全身指令+50Hz冻结RL运动策略与IK执行），行为克隆端到端训练。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人视觉运动策略需在少量示范下泛化到不同物体位姿和光照。DP3用PointNet编码点云，不具备操作任务所需的旋转、平移、缩放（SIM(3)）等变性；EquiBot虽在轮式机械臂上引入等变VNN编码器，但尚未验证于更复杂的人形本体。
AI.method: 两阶段策略：高层扩散规划器采用SIM(3)等变VNN编码器，输出6Hz全身命令块；底层以冻结的预训练RL运动策略和手臂微分逆运动学模块以50Hz执行。在IsaacLab两个仿真基准上与四个非等变基线对比，示范数5-100，含分布内/外测试，并用仅本体感觉控制作消融，训练方式为行为克隆。
AI.result: 低数据下优势显著：5-10个示范时成功率67.1%，基线为38.2-52.4%；50-100个示范时所有编码器收敛至74.3-85.2%，排序失去意义。仅本体感觉控制在5个示范时成功率31% vs EquivDP3的60%，10个时78% vs 99%，但50-100时差距消失，说明高数据平台期是基准上限而非所有编码器等价。等变编码器每动作块仅增加0.8ms延迟。
AI.conclusion: 将几何对称性嵌入分层扩散策略的感知主干，是提升人形移动操作在示范稀缺时数据效率的实用且近乎零成本的方法；低数据下等变感知优势真实存在，而高数据下性能饱和受基准上限限制。

title: FigAct: Turning Scientific Figures into Active Canvases for Explanation
summary: Scientific figures are designed to communicate information visually, yet MLLMs typically explain them by translating their visual content back into text. This requires readers to manually map the resulting explanations back to the figure. Inspired by how people present visual information, we introduce FigAct, a framework that transforms static scientific figures into question-conditioned visual presentations by acting directly on their existing graphical elements. Like a human presenter, FigAct generates a sequence of short narrations, grounds each narration in the corresponding visual evidence, and applies visual actions to guide the viewer's attention. We develop a hierarchical search strategy for efficient element localization, reducing token usage by approximately 40$\times$. We further train FigAct-8B using three task-specific rewards for grounding accuracy, search efficiency, and rendering quality. We further build a human-verified benchmark from figures in real-world scientific papers to evaluate the ability of MLLMs to generate grounded visual explanations. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of FigAct and show that treating scientific figures as presentation canvases makes explanations clearer and easier to follow.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FigAct框架，将静态科学图表转化为基于问题的动态视觉演示，通过定位图中元素、生成简短旁白并施加视觉动作来引导注意力，从而提升多模态大模型对科学图表的解释效果。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM通常将科学图表的视觉内容转回文本进行解释，读者需要自行将文本映射回图表，理解效率低。受人类展示视觉信息方式启发，希望直接在图表现有图形元素上操作来生成更直观的解释。
AI.method: FigAct生成一系列简短旁白，将每段旁白对应到视觉证据，并施加视觉动作引导注意力；采用分层搜索策略高效定位元素，减少约40倍token消耗；用三个任务特定奖励训练FigAct-8B，分别针对定位准确性、搜索效率和渲染质量；并构建人工验证的真实科学论文图表基准。
AI.result: 实验表明FigAct有效，分层搜索显著降低token使用量，训练后的模型在定位准确、搜索高效和渲染质量方面表现良好，基于真实论文图表的基准验证了其生成有依据视觉解释的能力。
AI.conclusion: 将科学图表视为演示画布，可使MLLM生成的解释更清晰、更易跟随，为科学图表理解与展示提供了新思路。

title: What Makes High-Magnification Knowledge Transferable? A Study of Cross-Resolution Distillation in Whole-Slide Imaging
summary: Cross-resolution knowledge distillation aims to improve low-magnification whole- slide analysis by transferring high-magnification representations, yet the conditions for useful transfer remain unclear. We develop a decomposition-based analysis of teacher access, representation loss, and model excess, motivating three questions: whether (a) teacher targets help the task, (b) low-magnification students can predict them, and (c) slide models benefit from those predictions. We investigate them through controlled experiments across ten pathology cohorts spanning classifi- cation, grading, and survival prediction. In the main comparison, providing teacher regional means alongside native low-magnification features improves downstream performance in all ten cohorts. Direct prediction achieves lower reconstruction error than residual prediction, yet the predicted features underrepresent variation in the teacher targets. Moreover, better reconstruction does not consistently improve downstream scores, and retaining native features changes performance even when the predicted teacher features are held fixed. Together, these findings expose a gap between reconstructing teacher representations and realizing their downstream value. They challenge the sufficiency of reconstruction error as a measure of cross-resolution transfer and provide a diagnostic framework for examining where that transfer breaks down. Future distillation designs must account for both what students can predict and how slide models use those predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文分析跨分辨率知识蒸馏在全切片病理图像中的有效迁移条件，发现重建教师表征与提升下游任务表现之间存在明显差距。
AI.motivation: 跨分辨率蒸馏常用于提升低倍镜全切片分析，但教师高倍表征在何种条件下能真正带来收益尚不明确。
AI.method: 基于分解的分析框架，考察教师信息获取、表征损失和模型冗余；在十个病理队列上开展受控实验，覆盖分类、分级和生存预测。
AI.result: 将教师区域均值与原生低倍特征一同提供，可在全部十个队列中提升下游性能；直接预测比重残差预测重建误差更低，但预测特征仍低估教师目标变异；更好的重建并不稳定提升下游分数，且保留原生特征会改变性能。
AI.conclusion: 跨分辨率迁移的关键差距在于重建教师表征不等于实现其下游价值；重建误差不足以衡量迁移效果，未来蒸馏设计需同时考虑学生能预测什么以及切片模型如何使用这些预测。

title: The Detectability Gap: Hidden Heterogeneity in Hallucination Detection Across Language Models
summary: Sampling based consistency is widely used for hallucination detection, yet aggregate performance can conceal systematic differences in which errors are detectable. This work studies that heterogeneity across four language models and three factual question answering datasets. Partitioning hallucinations by answer agreement reveals high agreement (Ghost) and low agreement (Flickering) regimes with an apparent detectability gap of $0.35$ to $0.46$ AUC. Because the statistics used to define the regimes and measure this gap are strongly coupled ($|ρ|\approx0.94$ to $1.00$), the raw result is treated as a property of agreement based detection rather than independent evidence. After freezing regime assignments, lexical and semantic response dispersion preserve the asymmetry, with bootstrap $95\%$ intervals excluding zero in all $12$ model and dataset settings. A stricter test using individual diffusion trajectories and no cross seed information preserves the asymmetry across all three LLaDA datasets ($p<0.005$) and directionally across all three Dream datasets, with one reaching significance. The hard regime varies substantially in prevalence across models ($16\%$ to $77\%$), and matched prompts frequently change regimes between models. These findings show that aggregate detection metrics conceal persistent, model dependent heterogeneity in language model failures and motivate regime conditioned evaluation.

AI.tldr: 论文研究基于采样一致性的幻觉检测在不同语言模型和事实问答数据集上的异质性，发现幻觉可分为高答案一致性的Ghost和低一致性的Flickering两类，二者存在可检测性差距，且该差距在多种检验下持续存在，表明总体检测指标掩盖了模型依赖的系统性差异。
AI.motivation: 现有基于采样一致性的幻觉检测常报告总体性能，但总体指标可能掩盖哪些错误可被检测的系统性差异；作者希望解构这种异质性并推动按机制或区域条件进行评估。
AI.method: 在4个语言模型和3个事实问答数据集上，按答案一致性划分Ghost与Flickering幻觉区域；计算检测AUC差距并考察定义统计与差距统计的耦合；冻结区域分配后，用词汇和语义响应离散度验证；进一步用个体扩散轨迹且不提供跨种子信息进行严格检验，覆盖LLaDA和Dream数据集。
AI.result: 初始发现Ghost与Flickering的检测性差距为0.35至0.46 AUC，但定义与测量统计强耦合，|ρ|约为0.94至1.00。冻结区域后，词汇和语义离散度仍保持不对称，12个模型与数据集设置中bootstrap 95%区间均排除0；扩散轨迹检验在3个LLaDA数据集上均显著，p<0.005，3个Dream数据集中方向一致且1个显著。困难区域占比因模型而异，为16%至77%，同一提示在不同模型间常切换区域。
AI.conclusion: 总体检测指标会掩盖语言模型失败中持续且模型依赖的异质性；应进行区域条件化评估，而非仅依赖聚合检测性能。

title: CruxBench: A Benchmark of Information Discovery
summary: Benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) typically evaluate the accuracy of answers against fixed reference labels. But a central step in many complex real-world tasks is identifying which questions are worth asking in the first place: decomposing a difficult problem into subquestions -- which we call cruxes -- whose answers provide key steps on the path toward solving the target problem. To evaluate this capability of information discovery, we introduce CruxBench, a benchmark that grades LLM-generated questions by their Value of Information (VOI): how much a model-proposed crux updates beliefs about a target forecasting question. CruxBench enjoys a rare combination of three key properties: it is (1) contamination-resistant by construction, since ground truth is generated by future world events; (2) open-ended, admitting unbounded and complex text-based submissions rather than one correct numeric answer; and (3) grounded, with informativeness measured against quantified changes in real-world beliefs. We evaluate a diverse set of eight models on 293 target forecasting questions and find that VOI correlates highly with independent measures of model capability (r=0.90) and captures cruxes' usefulness for answering target questions. However, information discovery remains challenging even for frontier LLMs, which only narrowly outperform a random-timing baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CruxBench，用于评估大语言模型发现关键问题（cruxes）的能力，即通过生成子问题来更新对目标预测问题的信念，并以信息价值（VOI）作为评分标准。
AI.motivation: 传统 LLM 基准通常只评估固定参考答案的准确性，但许多现实复杂任务的核心是先判断哪些问题值得问，并将难题分解为能推动解决目标问题的关键子问题。
AI.method: 提出 CruxBench 基准，根据 LLM 生成问题的信息价值（VOI）进行评分，衡量模型提出的 crux 能在多大程度上更新对目标预测问题的信念。该基准具有三个特性：抗污染（由未来事件生成真值）、开放式（可提交复杂文本而非单一数值答案）、有现实依据（以真实世界信念的量化变化衡量信息量）。在 293 个目标预测问题上评估了 8 个模型。
AI.result: VOI 与独立模型能力指标高度相关（r=0.90），并能反映 cruxes 对回答目标问题的有用性。但信息发现问题对前沿 LLM 仍具挑战性，它们仅略微优于随机时机基线。
AI.conclusion: CruxBench 为评估 LLM 的信息发现能力提供了新基准，但当前模型在识别关键子问题方面仍表现有限，信息发现仍是未充分解决的能力。

title: Stealth Is a Relation, Not a Property: How Event Representations Create Blind Spots for Timing Attacks in Event-Based Perception
summary: An event camera produces an asynchronous stream, but what is visible in that stream depends on how a downstream consumer, such as a model or detector, processes time. The same timestamp change may leave a coarse temporal representation unchanged while changing the response of a model that preserves finer timing. We characterize this dependence as observer-relative stealth. For recorded event streams, retiming an event within its protected accumulation window leaves the accumulated integer tensor exactly unchanged. We use this exact blind space to construct Null, a gradient-guided timestamp-retiming attack, and define SC-ASR_A(tau) to measure attack success while bounding the change visible to observer A. On DVS Gesture at a 10% event budget, Null reaches 81.56 +/- 5.81% ASR on ConvSNN and 98.67 +/- 0.45% on a GRU while preserving the protected tensor exactly. On DailyDVS-200, a protocol-scale Multi-View Fusion Network variant reaches 99.28 +/- 0.11% exact-null ASR, compared with 9.70 +/- 1.06% for its matched control. In a five-attack comparison, Null is the only method with nonzero attack success at exact observer equality, reaching 81.4% on DVS Gesture and 87.35% on DailyDVS-200. We also search the same exact blind space with an independently implemented constrained projected-gradient optimizer, C-PGD. At matched victim-gradient evaluations, C-PGD reaches 84.50 +/- 2.89% ASR on DVS Gesture and 89.55 +/- 4.39% on DailyDVS-200, again with exact protected equality. Perturbations that are exactly hidden from the protected observer become visible under shifted, finer, overlapping, and randomized temporal views. Adding observer constraints reduces the real-valued blind-space fraction from 87.5% to 75.0% to 62.5%, while DVS ConvSNN ASR falls from 74.9% to 61.9% to 37.2%. These results show that stealth is not a property of the perturbation alone.

AI.tldr: 论文研究事件相机时间戳重定时攻击中的“观察者相对隐蔽性”，提出 Null 攻击和 SC-ASR_A(tau) 指标，利用受保护累积窗口内的精确盲空间，在受保护观察者完全不变的情况下实现高攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 事件流中可见内容取决于下游模型或检测器如何处理时间；相同时间戳变化可能对粗时间表示不可见，却影响保留更细时间信息的模型。因此，隐蔽性不应只归因于扰动本身，而需相对于观察者来定义和评估。
AI.method: 将事件流在受保护累积窗口内重定时，使累积整数张量精确不变，从而构造精确盲空间；基于该空间提出梯度引导的时间戳重定时攻击 Null，并定义 SC-ASR_A(tau) 衡量在限制观察者 A 可见变化下的攻击成功率；同时用独立实现的约束投影梯度优化器 C-PGD 搜索同一盲空间，并在 DVS Gesture、DailyDVS-200 等数据集及 ConvSNN、GRU、Multi-View Fusion Network 等模型上评估。
AI.result: 在 DVS Gesture 10% 事件预算下，Null 对 ConvSNN 达 81.56±5.81% ASR，对 GRU 达 98.67±0.45%，且受保护张量精确不变；DailyDVS-200 上 Multi-View Fusion Network 变体达 99.28±0.11% exact-null ASR，对照仅 9.70±1.06%。五攻击比较中，Null 是唯一在观察者完全相等时仍有非零成功的方法，DVS Gesture 81.4%，DailyDVS-200 87.35%。C-PGD 在匹配 victim-gradient 评估下分别达 84.50±2.89% 和 89.55±4.39%，同样保持受保护观察者精确相等。受保护观察者不可见的扰动在移位、更细、重叠和随机时间视图下会变得可见；增加观察者约束使实数盲空间比例从 87.5% 降至 75.0% 再降至 62.5%，DVS ConvSNN ASR 从 74.9% 降至 61.9% 再降至 37.2%。
AI.conclusion: 隐蔽性不是扰动本身的固有属性，而是相对于观察者时间处理方式的性质。精确隐藏于某一受保护观察者的扰动能被其他时间视图观察者看见，因此事件流安全评估必须明确观察者及其时间表示约束。

title: An Empirical Study and Assessment of EU AI Act Compliance Checkers
summary: The EU AI Act introduces extensive compliance requirements for organizations that develop, deploy, or integrate AI systems. Many of these requirements are directly relevant to security and privacy, while also addressing closely related issues such as data governance, transparency, accuracy, and robustness. However, stakeholders such as small-to-medium businesses and individual developers often lack the legal expertise required to interpret these obligations and translate them into engineering and governance practices. This disconnect creates challenges for implementing the EU AI Act and may lead to missing safeguards or misdirected development and deployment efforts. To address this, various automated EU AI Act compliance checkers (AIACCs) have emerged, claiming to streamline compliance assessments and provide practical guidance. In this paper, we present the first empirical study and assessment of AIACCs. We characterize 12 mainstream AIACCs across multiple dimensions, evaluate their legal coverage and alignment, and analyze checker-generated compliance reports for structure, determinacy, and actionability. We find that the quality of AIACCs varies significantly and that they currently can only serve as early-stage orientation tools. Specifically, we observe inconsistent interaction modes and user-friendliness, a tendency to overly simplify or omit key obligations, and a failure to provide determinate, actionable guidance. As a result, reliance on the current generation of AIACCs may foster a false sense of compliance. With our study, we provide a critical baseline of the current AIACC landscape. We further offer design principles for the implementation of more reliable compliance-support tools.

AI.tldr: 本文对欧盟AI法案合规检查器（AIACC）进行了首次实证研究，评估了12种主流工具，发现其质量参差不齐，仅能作为早期导向工具，并可能带来虚假合规感。
AI.motivation: 欧盟AI法案对AI系统开发、部署和集成提出了广泛合规要求，但中小企业和个人开发者缺乏法律专业知识来解读和落实这些义务，导致合规实施困难。自动化合规检查器应运而生，但其有效性尚未得到验证。
AI.method: 选取12种主流AIACC，从多个维度进行特征分析，评估其法律覆盖范围与对齐程度，并分析生成的合规报告在结构、确定性和可操作性方面的表现。
AI.result: AIACC质量差异显著，交互模式和用户友好性不一致，倾向于过度简化或遗漏关键义务，且未能提供确定、可操作的指导。依赖当前AIACC可能导致虚假合规感。
AI.conclusion: 当前AIACC仅适合早期导向，研究提供了该领域的批判性基线，并为开发更可靠的合规支持工具提出了设计原则。

title: Towards Scalable Context-Aware Single-Cell Spatial Transcriptomics Prediction from Histology Images
summary: Predicting gene expression from H&E-stained histology images offers a scalable alternative to costly spatial transcriptomics, yet most existing methods operate at the spot level, where signals from multiple cells are aggregated and critical cellular heterogeneity is obscured. Extending this paradigm to single-cell resolution is non-trivial. Naively applying pathology foundation models faces a scale mismatch: their patch-level representations mix multiple cells, whereas per-cell cropping or resizing distorts morphology and removes local context. Conversely, segmentation-based models without strong pretrained visual encoders often lack the morphological representation capacity needed for accurate molecular prediction and inherit errors from imperfect cell boundary masks. Here, we present CELLO, an efficient end-to-end framework that performs a single pathology foundation model forward pass per image and uses grid sampling to extract location-specific features for all cells simultaneously. We further introduce a distance-decay cross-attention module that refines each cell representation using spatially biased local morphological context. Using 52 public Xenium-H&E pairs from HEST-1k that span 12 organs and approximately 10 million cells, CELLO improves the average predictive accuracy over the evaluated baselines while reducing the mean whole-slide inference time compared to DeepSpot2Cell, a 14.0x speed-up on average that excludes upstream cell segmentation. Our work establishes a scalable foundation for single-cell gene expression prediction from H&E images.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CELLO，一种从H&E组织学图像预测单细胞基因表达的端到端框架。它通过单次病理基础模型前向传播和网格采样，同时提取所有细胞的位置特异性特征，并用距离衰减交叉注意力融入局部形态学上下文。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多在spot层面预测基因表达，会聚合多个细胞信号并掩盖细胞异质性。扩展到单细胞分辨率并不简单：病理基础模型的patch级表示混合多个细胞，而逐细胞裁剪或缩放会扭曲形态并丢失局部上下文；基于分割的模型若缺乏强预训练视觉编码器，则分子预测能力不足且会继承细胞边界掩码错误。
AI.method: CELLO采用高效端到端框架：每张图像仅进行一次病理基础模型前向传播，利用网格采样为所有细胞同时提取位置特异性特征；并引入距离衰减交叉注意力模块，用空间偏置的局部形态学上下文细化每个细胞的表示。
AI.result: 在HEST-1k的52对公开Xenium-H&E数据上评估，覆盖12个器官和约1000万个细胞。CELLO相比所评估基线提高了平均预测准确率；相比DeepSpot2Cell，在不包括上游细胞分割的情况下，平均全切片推理时间减少，平均加速14.0倍。
AI.conclusion: CELLO为从H&E图像进行单细胞基因表达预测建立了可扩展的基础，兼顾准确性与推理效率。

title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Vision-Language-Action Models via Reinforced Fine Tuning
summary: We study reinforcement learning (RL) methods for cooperative multi-agent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. This problem is challenging because VLAs are pretrained on large-scale single-agent data and therefore lack the fine-grained coordination skills required for inter-robot collaboration. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on multi-robot demonstrations partially bridges this gap, but its performance is bounded by the demonstration data and cannot improve from its own experience. We present a three-stage reinforced fine-tuning (RFT) pipeline for multi-agent VLAs. First, initialization-aware data collection sweeps over initial configurations and invokes human demonstrations only when the pretrained VLA repeatedly fails, yielding robustness to initialization shift with reduced human cost. Second, offline credit-filtered tuning assigns credit to individual agents and fine-tunes on per-agent trajectories with positive advantage rather than on entire joint rollouts. Third, we find existing online RL for VLAs are less effective for hard multi-agent tasks, which we attribute to noisy co-exploration and unstable updates. We instead use online latent-space fine tuning, which freeze the VLA and perform RL in its latent noise space. We evaluate our multi-agent VLA with both $π_0$ and $π_{0.5}$ backbones across 11 tasks in RoboTwin, RoboFactory and real-world manipulation with two Franka robots. Our multi-agent VLA improves the average success rate by $+23.1\%$, $+16.4\%$, and $+44\%$ on RoboTwin, RoboFactory, and real-world tasks, respectively. Code available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/mavla_rft-2BC0/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向多智能体视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的三阶段强化微调（RFT）流程，用于提升协作机器人任务中的协调能力，并在仿真与真实环境中取得显著成功率提升。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型主要基于大规模单智能体数据预训练，缺乏多机器人协作所需的细粒度协调能力；仅靠多机器人示范的监督微调受限于示范数据，无法从自身经验中持续改进。
AI.method: 提出三阶段RFT流程：1）初始化感知数据收集，仅在预训练VLA反复失败时调用人类示范，以降低人工成本并增强对初始状态变化的鲁棒性；2）离线信用过滤微调，将信用分配给单个智能体，并仅使用具有正优势的个体轨迹进行微调；3）在线潜空间微调，冻结VLA并在其潜噪声空间中进行RL，以缓解多智能体在线RL中的噪声协同探索和更新不稳定问题。
AI.result: 使用π0和π0.5两种VLA骨干，在RoboTwin、RoboFactory的11个任务以及两台Franka机器人的真实操作任务上评估。平均成功率分别提升+23.1%、+16.4%和+44%。
AI.conclusion: 该三阶段RFT流程能有效提升多智能体VLA的协作性能，在仿真和真实任务中均优于基线，并表明在线潜空间微调比直接在线RL更适合困难多智能体任务。

title: MERID: Multimodal Exploration via Recursive Self-Improvement Agents for Major Depression Analysis
summary: Major depressive disorder (MDD) severely impacts daily activities and quality of life. Detecting MDD involves multimodal data, such as interview recordings and sensor measurements. This is particularly challenging, as these heterogeneous modalities often demand distinct, customized prediction pipelines. Existing efforts to address this challenge have explored both manually engineered multimodal architectures and agent-assisted pipeline development. Despite their progress, it remains challenging to autonomously revise pipelines based on experimental feedback and carry verified improvements forward into subsequent designs. To this end, we propose Multimodal Exploration via Recursive Self-Improvement Agents for Major Depression Analysis (MERID). The framework develops depression pipelines through experience-based recursive self-improvement (RSI). Grounded State Construction (GSC) grounds experience by aligning multimodal records with subject-level depression targets. Coupled Pipeline Exploration (CPE) jointly modifies representations, fusion, and predictors to build successor pipelines for classification and severity estimation. Evidence-Guided Evolution (EGE) guides revisions through feedback and verifies gains under uncertainty in small depression cohorts before inheritance. Extensive experiments on depression benchmarks show that MERID achieves the best results on multiple tasks compared with multimodal and agent-based baselines. Further analysis highlights the value of acoustic and linguistic cues for depression detection. Our code is available at https://github.com/DiscoAILab/MERID

AI.tldr: 提出MERID框架，通过递归自我改进智能体自动探索多模态抑郁分析流水线，在多个任务上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 重度抑郁症检测涉及多模态异构数据，现有手动或智能体辅助方法难以根据实验反馈自主修正流水线并继承验证过的改进。
AI.method: MERID基于经验递归自我改进（RSI），包含接地状态构建（GSC）对齐多模态记录与受试者抑郁标签、耦合流水线探索（CPE）联合修改表示、融合与预测器、证据引导进化（EGE）通过反馈指导修正并在小队列不确定性下验证增益。
AI.result: 在抑郁基准测试上，MERID在多个任务中优于多模态和智能体基线，并突显了声学和语言线索对抑郁检测的价值。
AI.conclusion: MERID能有效自动演化多模态抑郁分析流水线，递归自我改进框架具有潜力，代码已开源。

title: Temporal-Aware Fusion for Robust Outdoor LiDAR Localization
summary: LiDAR relocalization aims to estimate the global 6-DoF pose of a sensor in the environment. However, existing regression-based approaches often encounter limitations in dynamic or ambiguous scenarios, as they typically prioritize single-frame inference, leaving the potential of spatio-temporal consistency across scans not fully explored. In this paper, we propose a Temporal-aware Localization framework (TempLoc) designed to enhance the robustness of outdoor localization by effectively modeling sequential consistency. Specifically, a Global Coordinate Estimation module is first introduced to predict point-wise global coordinates and associated uncertainties for each LiDAR scan. A Prior Coordinate Generation module is then presented to estimate inter-frame point correspondences by the attention mechanism. Lastly, an Uncertainty-Guided Coordinate Fusion module is deployed to integrate both predictions of point correspondence in an end-to-end fashion, yielding a more temporally consistent and accurate global 6-DoF pose. Experimental results on the NCLT and Oxford RobotCar benchmarks show that our TempLoc outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a large margin, demonstrating the effectiveness of temporal-aware correspondence modeling in LiDAR relocalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种时序感知的定位框架TempLoc，通过有效建模序列一致性来增强户外LiDAR重定位的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于回归的LiDAR重定位方法在动态或模糊场景中常受限制，因为它们通常优先考虑单帧推理，未能充分利用扫描间的时空一致性。
AI.method: 提出TempLoc框架，包含三个模块：全局坐标估计模块（预测每个LiDAR扫描的点级全局坐标和不确定性）、先验坐标生成模块（通过注意力机制估计帧间点对应关系）和不确定性引导的坐标融合模块（以端到端方式整合点对应预测，生成时序一致且准确的全局6-DoF位姿）。
AI.result: 在NCLT和Oxford RobotCar基准测试上，TempLoc大幅优于最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，时序感知的对应建模在LiDAR重定位中是有效的。

title: Simple Agentic Memory for Generalist Robot Policies
summary: Visual-memory systems commonly retain or compress past observations. Robot control additionally requires interaction-derived state that no individual frame may explicitly represent, such as persistent identity relations, accumulated progress, or ordered procedures. We introduce Simple Agentic Robot Memory (SimpleARM), a training-free memory layer for frozen generalist robot policies. From the task instruction, SimpleARM specifies what to monitor; frozen perceptual tools maintain compact typed state online; structured access retrieves that state only when a proposed subgoal depends on history; and current-view grounding resolves recalled entities before execution. We evaluate SimpleARM on RoboMME, a benchmark of memory-dependent robot manipulation tasks that require history information no longer available in the current observation. Across all 16 tasks and three policy seeds, SimpleARM achieves 67.17% mean success, compared with 44.51% for the strongest non-oracle baseline. Matched ablations show mechanism specificity: removing relation, reference, progress, or route state produces large losses where the affected state is retrieved for control, while largely sparing other tasks. These results support a state-based view of robot memory: effective memory for control is not simply retained visual history, but compact task-relevant state derived from the interaction history.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的机器人记忆层SimpleARM，为冻结的通用机器人策略提供基于交互历史的任务相关状态，在RoboMME基准的16个任务上平均成功率达67.17%。
AI.motivation: 视觉记忆系统通常保留或压缩过去观察，但机器人控制还需要单帧无法显式表示的交互衍生状态，如持久身份关系、累积进度或有序流程。
AI.method: 从任务指令确定监控内容；用冻结的感知工具在线维护紧凑的类型化状态；结构化访问仅在提议子目标依赖历史时检索状态；当前视图接地在执行前解析被回忆的实体。
AI.result: 在RoboMME全部16个任务和3个策略种子上，平均成功率67.17%，而最强非oracle基线为44.51%；匹配消融显示移除关系、引用、进度或路线状态会在相应检索控制的任务上造成大幅损失，而其他任务基本不受影响。
AI.conclusion: 支持机器人记忆的基于状态观点：有效的控制记忆并非简单保留的视觉历史，而是从交互历史中提取的紧凑且任务相关的状态。

title: CoRe: Co-Evolving Reward Models for Mitigating Latent Reward Hacking in Video Diffusion Models
summary: Latent reward models (LRMs) enable efficient alignment of video diffusion models by scoring intermediate states directly in latent space. However, we find that optimizing against a fixed latent reward rapidly leads to latent reward hacking: the predicted reward stays high while perceptual and motion quality deteriorate. Our analysis identifies distributional escape as the central cause: within a few hundred updates, the generator moves beyond the reward model's training support, where its scores no longer reflect video quality. Based on this insight, we introduce CoRe, a co-evolving reward framework that treats latent-space alignment as a dynamic interaction between the generator and the reward model. Rather than optimizing against a stationary proxy, CoRe continually refits the reward model on the generator's current samples while anchoring it to real-video preferences, so the generator cannot gain reward by drifting away from the data. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, experiments show that CoRe consistently improves generation quality over both the pretrained model and prior alignment methods, while avoiding the quality collapse of fixed-reward optimization.

AI.tldr: 论文发现潜在奖励模型在视频扩散模型对齐中会导致奖励黑客问题，并提出CoRe框架，通过生成器与奖励模型协同演化来避免分布外漂移，从而提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有方法使用固定的潜在奖励模型优化视频扩散模型，但会快速出现潜在奖励黑客：奖励分数保持很高，而感知质量和运动质量却下降。作者分析认为核心原因是分布逃逸，即生成器在数百次更新后就超出奖励模型的训练支持范围。
AI.method: 提出CoRe，一种协同演化的奖励框架。它将潜在空间对齐视为生成器与奖励模型之间的动态交互，持续用生成器当前样本重新拟合奖励模型，同时用真实视频偏好进行锚定，防止生成器通过偏离数据分布来获得奖励。
AI.result: 在Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B上实验表明，CoRe相比预训练模型和先前对齐方法能持续提升生成质量，并避免固定奖励优化带来的质量崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 潜在空间视频扩散对齐需要让奖励模型与生成器协同演化，而非优化固定代理，这样才能在保持高奖励的同时维持感知与运动质量。

title: RA-CFGCache: From Branch-Level Criteria to Guided-Risk Control under Classifier-Free Guidance
summary: Diffusion models enable high-quality visual generation, but iterative denoising remains computationally expensive, especially under classifier-free guidance (CFG), which requires both conditional and unconditional evaluations. Training-free caching reduces this cost by reuse of previously computed features or predictions. However, existing branch-local reuse criteria do not explicitly account for how cache errors combine under CFG or how local perturbations affect the final output. We identify two misalignments in cache control: a branch-guided mismatch, where guided error depends on both the magnitudes and alignment of branch errors, and a local-final mismatch, where the downstream impact of a local error varies across timesteps. We propose RA-CFGCache, a Risk-Aligned Caching framework under CFG that incorporates both factors while keeping the sampling schedule and guidance rule fixed. CFG-aware Guided-Risk Composition combines existing branch-wise proxies using CFG coefficients and offline-calibrated cross-branch alignment. Propagation-Aware Rescaling further weights the resulting guided-risk estimate with a timestep-dependent propagation prior calibrated from isolated reuse perturbations. An online threshold controller then determines when to jointly refresh or reuse both branches. Experiments on FLUX.1-dev, Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, and CogVideoX-2B demonstrate improved efficiency--fidelity trade-offs over evaluated training-free caching baselines. Moreover, RA-CFGCache is compatible with diverse base proxy families, including TeaCache-, DiCache-, and MagCache-style estimators, and consistently improves fidelity at nearly unchanged latency. Code is available at https://github.com/yiming-l21/RA-CFGCache.git.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RA-CFGCache，一种在无分类器引导（CFG）下风险对齐的无训练缓存框架，通过联合考虑分支误差组合与局部误差传播，动态决定何时复用或刷新两个分支，从而在保持采样与引导规则不变的前提下提升效率与保真度的权衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型迭代去噪计算昂贵，CFG下需同时评估条件与无条件分支，进一步加剧开销。现有无训练缓存方法的复用准则多为分支局部，未显式考虑CFG下缓存误差如何组合，以及局部扰动如何影响最终输出，存在分支引导错配与局部-最终错配。
AI.method: 提出RA-CFGCache风险对齐缓存框架：1）CFG感知的引导风险组合，利用CFG系数与离线校准的跨分支对齐，将现有分支级代理组合为引导误差估计；2）传播感知重缩放，使用从孤立复用扰动校准的、随时间步变化的传播先验对引导风险加权；3）在线阈值控制器决定何时联合刷新或复用两个分支。采样调度与引导规则保持不变。
AI.result: 在FLUX.1-dev、Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B和CogVideoX-2B上实验，相比评估的无训练缓存基线，实现更优的效率-保真度权衡；兼容TeaCache、DiCache、MagCache等多种基础代理族，在几乎不增加延迟的情况下持续提升保真度。
AI.conclusion: RA-CFGCache通过显式建模CFG下的分支误差组合与局部误差传播影响，有效提升了无训练缓存的效率-保真度权衡，并具有跨模型与跨代理族的通用性。代码已开源。

title: Question-Specific Knowledge Graphs for Efficient Visual Reasoning
summary: Recent work in visual question answering has shown that vision-language models can exhibit strong reasoning capabilities by translating visual inputs into textual representations. The effectiveness of this translation depends on how well visual details are retained; models need to surface and align both explicit and implicit knowledge sufficient to support reasoning, without introducing spurious assumptions. Existing methods that leverage detailed image captions introduce visual details unrelated to the reasoning task, inflating input token counts and increasing computational cost. To address these challenges, we propose VisKG, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework in which models learn to translate visual content into question-specific knowledge graph (KG) representations. This process filters out perceptual noise while preserving the entity-relation structure needed for chain-of-thought reasoning, following the principle of minimum sufficient information. To ensure stable RL post-training, VisKG adopts Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO). In addition, we strengthen the supervision stage with negative rationale samples, exposing the model to incorrect reasoning paths before RL post-training. Experimental results across science, mathematics, and general visual understanding benchmarks show that VisKG achieves performance comparable to or better than baselines, while requiring fewer tokens than caption-based representations. Moreover, training VisKG with GDPO improves accuracy by 2% over its GRPO-trained counterpart on average. These results suggest that KG representations are a promising approach for supporting multi-step reasoning and open up future work on adaptively selecting the most suitable representation for a given task.

AI.tldr: VisKG是一个强化学习框架，将视觉内容转化为问题特定的知识图谱表示，以最少充分信息进行推理，在多个基准上性能相当或更好，且比基于描述的表示使用更少token。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉问答方法将图像转为文本表示时，使用详细描述会引入与推理无关的视觉细节，增加输入token和计算成本，同时可能引入虚假假设。需要一种能保留足够支持推理的显式和隐式知识、且不引入无关信息的方法。
AI.method: 提出VisKG，基于强化学习让模型学习将视觉内容翻译为问题特定的知识图谱表示，过滤感知噪声并保留实体-关系结构以支持思维链推理。采用GDPO（Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization）稳定RL后训练，并在监督阶段加入负理性样本，让模型接触错误推理路径。
AI.result: 在科学、数学和通用视觉理解基准上，VisKG性能与基线相当或更好，且比基于描述的表示使用更少token。使用GDPO训练比GRPO训练平均提升2%准确率。
AI.conclusion: 知识图谱表示是支持多步推理的有前景方法，未来可研究自适应选择最适合给定任务的表示。

title: Causal and Interpretable Structures in LLM Compositional Tasks
summary: Large language models are able to solve tasks whose answers depend on not only individual input tokens, but also on relations among them. How is such relational information represented and processed across transformer layers? We study activations from ensembles of prompts that require inferring relationships between three tokens corresponding to a cyclic concept (months, hours, weekdays, and musical notes) to correctly predict the next token. Across model families (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, and Mistral) and cyclic concepts, we find a consistent layerwise progression in how the joint dependence among the tokens is geometrically organized and causally used: intermediate layers use a joint representation based on the inferred relationship between two tokens, while later layers use a joint representation associated with all three tokens to correctly complete the task. We also find other relationships between tokens that are geometrically structured but remain causally inert in the next-token prediction. Crucially, when taken together, these geometric and causal investigations reveal the representation-level mechanism that progressively organizes and composes the relational information to form the answer. More surprisingly, restricting the models to such causally relevant joint representations improves next-token prediction accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究大语言模型如何在Transformer各层中表示和处理多个token之间的关系信息，发现模型会逐层从两token关系表示过渡到三token联合表示，并揭示其因果机制。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能解决依赖token间关系的任务，但这些关系信息如何在Transformer层间被表示、组织并用于预测下一个token尚不清楚。
AI.method: 使用需要推断三个token之间关系的循环概念提示集（月份、小时、星期、音符），分析Llama、Qwen、Gemma和Mistral等模型家族的激活，并结合几何分析与因果分析研究层间表示。
AI.result: 跨模型和跨概念一致发现：中间层使用基于两个token推断关系的联合表示，较后层使用与三个token相关的联合表示来完成任务；还存在几何上有结构但因果上无作用的token关系；限制模型仅使用因果相关的联合表示反而提高下一token预测准确率。
AI.conclusion: 模型通过逐层组织与组合关系信息形成答案，几何与因果分析共同揭示了表示层面的机制，且因果相关的联合表示对预测至关重要。

title: ChronoSRL: Temporal Geometry for Self-Supervised Reinforcement Learning
summary: A goal that is close in space can be far away in time. Obstacles, terrain, and the agent's own capabilities determine how long it takes to get there. Yet, critics in contrastive and survival reinforcement learning do not measure the distances in their representation space in units of time. We therefore introduce ChronoSRL, which gives the critic's embeddings an explicit temporal geometry. The distance between state-action and goal embeddings is trained to match the time that the agent takes to reach the goal (goal-reaching time), while goals that were not reached, and goals from other trajectories, are pushed at least one discount horizon away. Furthermore, reaching a goal quickly once does not mean that reaching it is reliable in general, so the policy should not follow the temporal distance directly. Instead, we build on survival reinforcement learning and predict from our temporal embeddings not only the full distribution of goal-reaching times but also the time spent near the goal. Thereby, the policy is trained to favor actions that reach the goal sooner and more reliably and that keep the agent near it. ChronoSRL learns faster and reaches higher performance than contrastive, action-chunked contrastive, and survival reinforcement learning baselines on seven standard locomotion and navigation benchmarks, even with much smaller networks. To test the limits of self-supervised reinforcement learning, we introduce velocity tracking, goal-position reaching, and box climbing tasks with a quadruped robot in a realistic sim-to-real locomotion setup, and show how the shaping terms that are typical for robotics can be naturally incorporated into our framework.
