While the state-of-the-art differentiable rendering methods achieve remarkable accuracy, the use of binary masks can result in the loss of internal profile details, reducing precision. Additionally, these methods can also suffer from unstable optimization and local minima.
  In this study, we propose a novel RGB-based differentiable rendering framework that provides richer geometric and appearance cues by incorporating color and mask geometric features, thereby improving calibration accuracy and optimization stability. Additionally, we propose a mask-guided image-to-image translation method to ensure explicit preservation of color and geometric consistency throughout the translation. Our approach is validated through both simulation and real-world experiments, with results demonstrating strong accuracy and robustness and clear improvements over existing differentiable rendering methods. Our method achieves a grasping success rate of 88.9% and insertion success rate of 57.4% on the UR5e real-world experiment, outperforming the state-of-the-art differentiable rendering hand-eye calibration method EasyHeC by 46.3 and 48.1 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于RGB的可微分渲染手眼标定框架，通过引入颜色与掩膜几何特征提供更丰富的几何与外观线索，并配合掩膜引导的图像到图像翻译方法保证颜色与几何一致性，在仿真和真实实验中均取得优于现有方法的精度与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 高精度手眼标定对精密操作至关重要。传统方法依赖标记物，其精度受标记精度与可观测性限制；基于学习的方法虽无需标记物，但可解释性差。现有基于可微分渲染的方法（如EasyHeC）虽无需标定阶段使用标记且优化可解释，但仅使用二值掩膜会丢失内部轮廓细节、降低精度，并存在优化不稳定和陷入局部最优的问题。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的RGB可微分渲染框架，融合颜色信息与掩膜几何特征，以提供更丰富的几何与外观线索，从而提升标定精度和优化稳定性；同时提出掩膜引导的图像到图像（image-to-image）翻译方法，在翻译过程中显式保持颜色与几何一致性。通过仿真实验与真实世界实验进行验证。
AI.result: 仿真与真实实验表明该方法精度高、鲁棒性强，且相较现有可微分渲染方法有明显提升。在UR5e真实实验中，抓取成功率达88.9%，插入成功率达57.4%，分别比当前最优的可微分渲染手眼标定方法EasyHeC高出46.3和48.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 引入颜色与掩膜几何特征的RGB可微分渲染框架结合掩膜引导的图像翻译，可有效克服二值掩膜信息损失与优化不稳定问题，实现高精度、高鲁棒性的无标记手眼标定，并在真实机器人操作任务中显著优于现有方法。

title: FM-ReID: Selective Competitive Token Routing for Object Re-Identification
summary: Object re-identification (ReID) faces a recurring challenge: different identities can share highly similar global appearances, while the cues that distinguish them are localized, heterogeneous, and visible only under particular viewpoints. This challenge arises in animal ReID through markings, contours, and scars, in person ReID through subtle clothing and accessory cues, and in vehicle ReID through localized appearance details. Although visual foundation models encode such information in dense tokens, a single holistic descriptor can obscure discriminative local signals. We propose FM-ReID, an end-to-end framework that formulates local representation learning as selective competitive token routing. Its Competitive Fine-grained Mining module uses multiple mining queries and a residual query to compete for dense DINOv3 tokens. Above-prior selection retains tokens preferentially allocated to each mining query, while the residual slot receives tokens excluded from the retrieval descriptors. The resulting multi-query descriptors are jointly trained with a holistic representation for retrieval, without fixed spatial partitions or equal-area constraints. FM-ReID achieves strong results on animal, person, and vehicle ReID benchmarks, supporting competitive token routing as an effective way to augment holistic foundation-model representations.

AI.tldr: 提出FM-ReID框架，将局部表示学习形式化为选择性竞争性令牌路由，利用DINOv3密集令牌提升对象重识别性能。
AI.motivation: 对象重识别中不同身份可能具有相似全局外观，区分线索局部化、异质且依赖视角；单一整体描述符会掩盖有判别力的局部信号。
AI.method: FM-ReID端到端框架，包含竞争性细粒度挖掘模块，使用多个挖掘查询和残差查询竞争密集DINOv3令牌；通过先验选择为每个挖掘查询保留令牌，残差槽接收被排除令牌；多查询描述符与整体表示联合训练用于检索，无需固定空间划分或等面积约束。
AI.result: 在动物、行人和车辆重识别基准上取得强劲结果。
AI.conclusion: 竞争性令牌路由是增强整体基础模型表示的有效方法。

title: How Medical VLMs Underutilize Their Vision Encoders: A Dermatology Perspective
summary: Medical Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show significant promise for clinical image understanding, offering accurate diagnosis with interpretable reasoning. However, a critical performance gap exists between their strong vision encoders and the full multimodal model: in dermatology, the MedSigLIP encoder outperforms MedGemma by an average of 10.26 percentage points even when both use zero target-task labels; few-shot linear probing provides further evidence of strong visual representations. This gap motivates an investigation of how visual information is used in end-to-end diagnosis and why plausible-sounding predictions can lack grounding in image evidence. Using dermatology as our primary testbed, we systematically investigate three hypotheses for this phenomenon. We further provide a mechanistic analysis of the model's internal attention patterns, showing that a simple describe-then-decide prompting strategy increases vision attention by 30-40% during generation. Task-specific fine-tuning improves dermatology classification but reduces cross-domain medical question-answering performance in our evaluation. To address these challenges, we combine label-free prompting with low-label encoder-assisted reranking while keeping the VLM frozen. We validate the interventions across five VLM backbones in dermatology and provide supporting representation and attention analyses across additional medical modalities.

AI.tldr: 医学视觉语言模型在皮肤病学中存在视觉编码器与完整多模态模型之间的性能差距，研究通过机制分析和干预方法提升视觉信息利用，并提出冻结VLM的编码器辅助重排序策略。
AI.motivation: 医学VLM的视觉编码器性能显著优于完整多模态模型（如MedSigLIP比MedGemma平均高10.26个百分点），这促使研究者探究视觉信息在端到端诊断中的使用方式，以及为何预测看似合理却缺乏图像证据支撑。
AI.method: 以皮肤病学为主要测试平台，系统检验三种假设；进行内部注意力模式的机制分析；采用描述-然后-决策的提示策略；结合无标签提示与低标签编码器辅助重排序（保持VLM冻结）；在五个VLM主干上验证，并在其他医学模态上进行表征和注意力分析。
AI.result: 描述-然后-决策提示使生成过程中视觉注意力增加30-40%；任务特定微调提高皮肤病分类但降低跨域医学问答性能；所提方法在五个VLM主干上有效，并在其他医学模态上得到表征和注意力分析支持。
AI.conclusion: 通过无标签提示和低标签编码器辅助重排序可缓解视觉信息利用不足的问题，同时保持VLM冻结，为医学VLM的可靠诊断提供了一种有效策略。

title: Geometric Representations of African Languages: A Regional Semantic Hub and Cultural Steering
summary: We study how Gemma 4 31B represents African languages and responds to cultural steering. The first study compares nine African languages and three controls using probes, contrast directions, and measures of representation similarity. Transfer from English varies across languages and layers. Directions representing an Africa versus West contrast are more aligned among the African languages than between these languages and the controls at several layers. The comparison across language families passes the reported Holm threshold at five of twelve layers, although dependence between language pairs limits the statistical interpretation. Within Nigeria, Yoruba and Igbo are more aligned than the average of their pairs with Hausa at eleven of twelve layers. The second study uses separate English data to construct directions for Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and South Africa. Under union scoring at the selected strengths, estimated differences in attribution rates from random directions range from 0.63 to 0.81. Most outputs pass the automated structural coherence screen. Comparisons with Aya Expanse 32B show that results depend on the representation measure. Together, the studies document regional and family patterns in the sampled representations and country steering in English.

AI.tldr: 论文研究 Gemma 4 31B 如何表征非洲语言，以及如何用英语数据对非洲国家进行文化引导。两项研究分别考察非洲语言内部/与英语的表征相似性，以及针对尼日利亚、加纳、肯尼亚和南非的引导效果。
AI.motivation: 作者希望了解大模型对非洲语言的内部表征是否存在区域和语系模式，并检验能否通过文化引导方向影响模型对非洲国家的归因输出。
AI.method: 第一项研究比较九种非洲语言和三种对照语言，使用探针、对比方向和表征相似度，分析从英语迁移、非洲 vs 西方对比方向、语系差异及尼日利亚内部语言对齐。第二项研究用独立英语数据为尼日利亚、加纳、肯尼亚和南非构建引导方向，在联合评分下评估归因率差异，并检查输出结构连贯性，同时与 Aya Expanse 32B 比较。
AI.result: 英语迁移因语言和层而异；非洲语言间的非洲 vs 西方方向在若干层比其与对照语言更对齐；跨语系比较在 12 层中有 5 层通过 Holm 阈值，但语言对依赖限制统计解释；尼日利亚的约鲁巴语和伊博语在 12 层中有 11 层比它们与豪萨语的平均配对更对齐。第二项研究中，在选定强度下，归因率相对随机方向的估计差异为 0.63 至 0.81，多数输出通过自动结构连贯性筛查；与 Aya Expanse 32B 的比较显示结果依赖表征度量。
AI.conclusion: 两项研究共同记录了采样表征中的区域与语系模式，以及英语中的国家引导效应。

title: The Canonical Order Problem: When Large Language Models Are Unreliable Knowledge Bases for Multi-Valued Relations
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as knowledge bases (KBs) due to the vast amount of knowledge they acquire during pre-training. While many works focus on extracting single relational triples, most real-world relations are multi-valued and require generating sets of entities.
  In this paper, we investigate how LLMs represent and generate multi-valued relations. We identify the canonical order problem: The probabilistic distributions inside LLMs organize many multi-valued relations according to a canonical ordering (e.g., alphabetical or chronological). Through mechanistic analysis, we show that set generation in LLMs can be thought of in terms of three phases: (1) retrieval of candidate entities, (2) internal sorting, and (3) selection of the next element. As a result, prompts aiming to construct KBs that deviate from this internal canonical ordering lead to a markedly reduced reliability of LLMs when aiming to generate complete sets for multi-valued relations.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究大语言模型如何表示和生成多值关系，发现模型内部存在“规范顺序”问题，并通过机制分析将其集合生成过程分为候选实体检索、内部排序和下一元素选择三个阶段。
AI.motivation: 现有工作多关注从大语言模型中抽取单关系三元组，但现实世界的关系通常是多值的，需要生成实体集合，因此有必要研究模型如何表示和生成多值关系。
AI.method: 采用机制分析（mechanistic analysis）方法，考察大语言模型内部对多值关系的概率分布与生成过程。
AI.result: 发现多值关系在模型内部常按规范顺序（如字母顺序或时间顺序）组织；集合生成可理解为三阶段过程：候选实体检索、内部排序、下一元素选择。当提示要求构建偏离该内部规范顺序的知识库时，模型生成完整集合的可靠性显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型生成多值关系集合时受内部规范顺序影响，偏离该顺序的提示会降低生成完整集合的可靠性，这为将大语言模型用作知识库时提供了重要警示。

title: ThinkingGuard: Decoding Implicit Hazards via Step-by-Step Risk Attribution in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical domains, their reliability is threatened by multimodal implicit risks. Unlike explicit threats, these hazards emerge when individually benign text and neutral visual entities logically converge to induce unsafe outputs. Current detection methods fail to address this because they overlook the underlying risk activation mechanisms that govern cross-modal risk activation, leading to single-modality shortcut learning and hallucinated rationalizations. To bridge this gap, we first construct TriggerBench, the first dataset explicitly modeling risk compositionality (5,600 instances). By formally isolating Key Elements and Trigger Elements to build counterfactual contrastive pairs, TriggerBench eliminates risk residues and forces models to perform genuine logical deduction rather than superficial pattern matching, which provides a rigorous foundation for both large-scale training and fine-grained evaluation. Building on this, we propose a Step-Supervised Structured Reasoning training framework and employ it to train ThinkingGuard, a specialized guard model. Inspired by Situation Awareness theory, we decouple implicit risk identification into progressive cognitive stages, and utilize a step-reward Monte Carlo Tree Search algorithm to explore optimal reasoning trajectories, which are then distilled into the model through Dual-Constraint Preference Alignment. Extensive experiments across both standard and implicit safety benchmarks demonstrate that ThinkingGuard achieves strong performance. Project resources are available at https://github.com/FroggyChen/ThinkingGuard.

AI.tldr: 针对多模态大模型的隐式风险，提出TriggerBench数据集和ThinkingGuard防护模型，通过结构化推理训练提升隐式风险检测能力。
AI.motivation: MLLMs在安全关键领域部署，但其可靠性受多模态隐式风险威胁：单独良性的文本与中性视觉实体逻辑组合后可诱发不安全输出。现有检测方法忽略跨模态风险激活机制，导致单模态捷径学习和幻觉式推理。
AI.method: 构建TriggerBench，首个显式建模风险组合性的数据集（5,600实例），通过分离Key Elements和Trigger Elements构建反事实对比对；提出Step-Supervised Structured Reasoning训练框架，并训练专用防护模型ThinkingGuard；受情境意识理论启发，将隐式风险识别分解为渐进认知阶段，使用步奖励蒙特卡洛树搜索探索最优推理轨迹，再通过Dual-Constraint Preference Alignment蒸馏到模型中。
AI.result: 在标准与隐式安全基准上的大量实验表明，ThinkingGuard取得了强性能。
AI.conclusion: TriggerBench和结构化推理训练框架能有效建模与检测多模态隐式风险，提升MLLMs在安全关键场景中的防护可靠性。

title: AffectReveal: Event-Grounded Emotion Recognition Beyond Visual Appearances
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to ICLR 2027
summary: Visual emotion recognition commonly assumes that all evidence required for prediction is contained in the observed image or video. Yet the same visible reaction can convey different emotions depending on events beyond the input: tears, for example, may indicate grief or joy. We formulate Event-Grounded Emotion Recognition (EGER), where emotion recognition requires recovering the affect-determining event. We construct EGER-Bench, comprising 10,052 videos and 10,734 images across 11 emotions, two source domains, and four visual settings. A study with six annotators shows that event context raises human recognition accuracy from 33.96% to 72.08%, confirming that visual evidence alone is often insufficient. Semantic relevance alone does not solve EGER: a plausible event may imply the wrong emotion if its identity, focal-person role, relationship, or outcome is misinterpreted. We therefore propose AffectReveal, a tuning-free framework that first constructs and independently verifies evidence-grounded alternatives over these affect-critical factors. It then cross-checks the recovered event against face-masked in-media facts through bidirectional atomic evidence support, while retaining the original unmasked input for final prediction. Across three downstream models and four input settings, AffectReveal yields average UAR gains of 5.26--10.53 points. For three fine-tunable models, it also enables untuned models to outperform their fine-tuned visual-only counterparts in all 12 accuracy comparisons, without updating downstream parameters.

AI.tldr: 论文提出事件锚定情感识别（EGER）任务，认为情感识别需要恢复决定情感的事件，并构建 EGER-Bench 基准；提出免调优框架 AffectReveal，通过事件假设验证与多证据交叉检查提升识别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉情感识别默认输入图像或视频已包含全部预测证据，但同一可见反应可能因输入之外的事件而对应不同情感，例如眼泪可能表示悲伤或喜悦，因此仅靠视觉证据往往不足。
AI.method: 提出 AffectReveal，一个免调优框架：首先围绕影响情感的关键因素构建并独立验证有证据支撑的事件替代解释；然后通过双向原子证据支持，将恢复出的事件与面部遮罩后的媒体内事实进行交叉检查；最终预测仍使用原始未遮罩输入。
AI.result: 构建 EGER-Bench，包含 10,052 个视频和 10,734 张图像，覆盖 11 种情感、2 个源域和 4 种视觉设置。六名标注者研究显示，事件上下文将人类识别准确率从 33.96% 提升至 72.08%。在三种下游模型和四种输入设置下，AffectReveal 平均 UAR 提升 5.26 至 10.53 个百分点；对三种可微调模型，在不更新下游参数的情况下，未调优模型在全部 12 项准确率比较中均优于仅视觉的微调模型。
AI.conclusion: 情感识别不应仅依赖视觉证据，恢复影响情感的事件至关重要；仅靠语义相关性不够，还需正确判断事件身份、焦点人物角色、关系与结果。AffectReveal 表明，通过证据锚定与交叉验证，可在免调优条件下显著提升事件锚定情感识别性能。

title: Better Nearest Neighbor Graph Indices via (Efficient) LLM-Guided Pruning
summary: Graph-based approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) is widely used for large-scale semantic search. Its indices are constructed primarily based on geometric relationships among embeddings of an input dataset (e.g., documents or images), rather than explicitly optimizing for semantic relevance. However, when using these indices for downstream query retrieval, performance is evaluated based on the semantic relevance of the retrieved results to the query. This creates a fundamental "geometry-semantic" mismatch between how the indices are constructed and how their retrieval results are evaluated. While existing LLM-based reranking methods can partially mitigate this mismatch at query time, they leave this underlying structural problem in the graph unresolved. We therefore propose LLM-Guided Graph Pruning (LGP), a general framework that addresses this mismatch directly by leveraging LLM reasoning to refine an existing ANN graph index itself. LGP identifies structurally "low-value" neighbors of nodes and replaces them with LLM-selected alternatives that provide useful semantic information while retaining desired geometric structures of the original graph, including sparsity and efficient navigability. Experiments on representative semantic retrieval benchmarks show that LGP consistently improves end-to-end retrieval performance over both vanilla greedy graph search and LLM-based reranking across widely used graph-based ANN indices such as DiskANN and HNSW.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LLM引导的图剪枝（LGP）框架，通过LLM推理修正基于图的近似最近邻检索索引，以缓解几何结构与语义相关性不匹配的问题，并在多种图索引上提升语义检索性能。
AI.motivation: 图ANNS索引主要基于嵌入间的几何关系构建，但下游检索性能按结果与查询的语义相关性评估，存在“几何-语义”错配。现有LLM重排只能在查询时部分缓解，未解决图索引本身的结构性问题。
AI.method: 提出LGP通用框架，利用LLM推理识别节点中结构上“低价值”的邻居，并用LLM选择的语义替代邻居替换，同时保留原图的稀疏性和高效可导航性；可应用于DiskANN、HNSW等现有图ANNS索引。
AI.result: 在代表性语义检索基准上，LGP在DiskANN和HNSW等常用图ANNS索引中，端到端检索性能一致优于原始贪心图搜索和基于LLM的重排方法。
AI.conclusion: 直接优化图索引结构可更有效缓解几何-语义错配。LGP为图ANNS语义检索提供通用改进方案，并在保持图结构效率的同时提升检索效果。

title: CineSubBench: Evaluating LLMs on Long-Form Narrative and Cultural Understanding from Multilingual Movie Subtitles
summary: Large language models are increasingly evaluated in specialized domains such as law, medicine, software engineering, and cybersecurity, yet film remains comparatively underexplored despite requiring long-form narrative integration, multilingual interpretation, and culturally situated audience judgments. We introduce CineSubBench, a benchmark for evaluating long-context film understanding from multilingual movie subtitles. A subtitle track represents a film as thousands of short, temporally ordered utterances from which models must reconstruct characters, relationships, events, causal progression, and themes without explicit scene or event structure. CineSubBench contains 1,012 films with complete subtitle coverage in six languages, yielding 6,072 tracks and 8.13M timestamped subtitle entries. It provides a matched multi-task, multilingual, and multicultural (MultiX) evaluation setting: seven tasks span narrative reconstruction and abstraction, genre prediction, age suitability, country-specific motion-picture ratings across ten national classification systems, and subtitle-grounded language safety. Across nine LLMs, plot premises are recovered more reliably than event-complete synopses; cross-lingual consistency varies substantially across models and languages; national rating systems expose distinct calibration patterns; and strong profanity is far easier to ground than mild obscenity. CineSubBench establishes film as a long-context LLM evaluation domain and provides a unified benchmark for measuring narrative, multilingual, cultural, and evidence-grounding capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出CineSubBench基准，用多语言电影字幕评估大语言模型的长上下文电影理解能力，涵盖1012部电影、6种语言、6072条字幕轨和813万条时间戳字幕。
AI.motivation: 电影理解需要长叙事整合、多语言解读和文化情境判断，但现有LLM评估在电影领域探索不足，缺少统一基准。
AI.method: 构建CineSubBench，包含多任务、多语言、多文化（MultiX）匹配评估：七项任务覆盖叙事重建与抽象、类型预测、年龄适宜性、十国电影分级和字幕语言安全，测试九种LLM。
AI.result: 模型更易恢复剧情梗概而非完整事件摘要；跨语言一致性因模型和语言差异大；各国分级系统呈现不同校准模式；强烈脏话比轻度淫秽内容更易定位。
AI.conclusion: CineSubBench将电影确立为长上下文LLM评估领域，为衡量叙事、多语言、文化和证据 grounding 能力提供统一基准。

title: Scale-Invariant Manipulability Shape Tracking Across Heterogeneous Manipulators
summary: When transferring manipulability across systems with different sizes and kinematic structures, matching absolute ellipsoid scale may be unnecessary when the goal is to reproduce orientation and semi-axis length ratios. Full-matrix tracking, however, penalizes both shape and absolute-scale differences, even when only shape matching is required. We therefore propose a scale-invariant manipulability shape-tracking method that treats matrices differing only by a positive scalar factor as equivalent and uses their unit-determinant representatives. We derive the differential of the unit-determinant shape representative and an orthonormal coordinate representation of the tangent tracking residual under the affine-invariant Riemannian metric (AIRM). The resulting scale-invariant objective is integrated with position and end-effector direction tasks in a constrained joint-velocity quadratic program. Simulations with four heterogeneous robots evaluate robot-to-robot and human-to-robot transfer. On three followers, the proposed method achieves endpoint shape distances of 9.30 x 10^-5 without scale tuning. With robot-specific target scales tuned during motion, the Full method retains endpoint axis-ratio errors of 0.19-0.31 on KR500 and UR20. For human reaching with concurrent tasks, the proposed method yields dual force shapes elongated along X like the human target on all four robots, with endpoint position errors of 2.4-5.6% of reference arm length versus up to 75% for the Full method tracking the original human ellipsoid.

AI.tldr: 提出一种尺度不变的可操作度形状跟踪方法，用于异构机器人之间的可操作度椭球形状传递，无需绝对尺度匹配，通过单位行列式代表和仿射不变黎曼度量实现，并在多机器人仿真中验证。
AI.motivation: 跨不同尺寸和运动学结构的系统传递可操作度时，若目标只是复现方向和半轴长度比例，匹配绝对椭球尺度可能不必要；全矩阵跟踪会同时惩罚形状和绝对尺度差异，即使只需形状匹配。
AI.method: 提出尺度不变的可操作度形状跟踪，将仅差正标量因子的矩阵视为等价，使用单位行列式代表；推导单位行列式形状代表的微分，并在仿射不变黎曼度量下给出切空间跟踪残差的正交坐标表示；将尺度不变目标与位置和末端方向任务结合，在约束关节速度二次规划中求解。
AI.result: 四个异构机器人仿真（机器人-机器人、人-机器人）。在三个跟随者上，方法无需尺度调参达到端点形状距离9.30e-5。使用机器人特定目标尺度调参时，Full方法在KR500和UR20上端点轴比误差0.19-0.31。人臂伸展并发任务中，方法在四个机器人上产生与人类目标类似的沿X拉长的双力形状，端点位置误差为参考臂长的2.4-5.6%，而Full方法跟踪原始人类椭球误差高达75%。
AI.conclusion: 所提尺度不变形状跟踪方法能有效实现异构机器人间的可操作度形状传递，无需绝对尺度匹配，在多种任务中优于全矩阵跟踪。

title: Engineering Simplicity: Simple Mechanism Interfaces Steer LLM Agents
summary: Can interaction formats and textual scaffolds help large language model (LLM) agents make better decisions, and do better decisions come with better explanations? We study these questions in auctions and matching, multi-agent environments with explicit rules and known optimal strategies. These settings let us vary how a decision problem is presented while retaining a benchmark for evaluating behavior. Drawing on human-motivated theories of simplicity, we compare interfaces that elicit a complete bid or ranking with sequential interfaces that make safe choices easier to identify. We then hold the interaction format fixed and vary reasoning scaffolds and rule descriptions. Across four model families, the ascending auction interface substantially reduces bid deviations. The matching comparison also shows why sequential responses require different error accounting from complete rankings. Laying out payoff contingencies and explaining why truth-telling is safe also improve choices, whereas prompts to plan through matching rounds or form beliefs about opponents worsen play overall. In auctions, these behavioral gains are not accompanied by corresponding improvements in measured verbal indicators of strategic understanding in the agents' short stated plans. Other prompts change those indicators without improving bids. Our findings suggest that human-motivated theories of simplicity can inform the design of decision environments for artificial agents. They also show why scaffolds should be evaluated through realized choices as well as explanations: improvements in one need not appear in the other.

AI.tldr: 论文研究交互格式与文本脚手架能否帮助LLM智能体在拍卖和匹配等多智能体环境中做出更好决策，并探讨更好决策是否伴随更好的解释。
AI.motivation: 作者希望检验：在规则明确、存在已知最优策略的决策环境中，改变问题呈现方式和提供推理脚手架，是否能改善LLM智能体的实际选择与解释质量。
AI.method: 在拍卖与匹配环境中，比较要求完整出价/排序的接口与顺序式接口；固定交互格式后，变化推理脚手架和规则描述；跨四个模型家族进行实验，并同时评估行为表现与简短计划中的言语指标。
AI.result: 升价拍卖接口显著减少出价偏差；匹配任务中顺序回答需要不同于完整排序的误差核算。说明收益 contingencies 和解释说真话安全性可改善选择，而提示规划匹配轮次或形成对手信念反而整体变差。拍卖中行为收益并未伴随战略理解言语指标的相应提升，其他提示可改变言语指标却不改善出价。
AI.conclusion: 受人类启发的简洁性理论可为人工智能体决策环境设计提供参考；脚手架应同时通过实际选择和解释来评估，二者改善并不必然同步出现。

title: TaRL: Learning General and Physical Rewards from Tactile Demonstrations
summary: Contact-rich manipulation requires robots to sequence precise contacts, maintain stable grasps, and apply directed forces. Reinforcement learning (RL) can acquire such behaviors automatically, but its performance hinges on reward design: sparse rewards reduce the learning efficiency, while dense rewards are hard to specify. Visual reward learning addresses this by inferring rewards from action-free demonstrations. Because it conditions only on visual observations, it fails to capture rewards beyond visual goals. We propose Tactile Reward Learning (TaRL), a framework that learns rewards from tactile demonstrations. TaRL takes a sequence of tactile deformation maps as input, and regresses task-completion progress from both successful and failed demonstrations. Because TaRL captures local robot-object interaction, it provides informative feedback to learn firm grasps and correctly directed forces; meanwhile, it is robust to changes in scene layout such as object position. We evaluate TaRL on four manipulation tasks in simulation and two in the real world. Used as a shaping reward, it substantially improves both sample efficiency and final success rate, raising success on Nut threading from 34% to 56% in simulation and on cube pickup from 37% to 97% in the real world. Combining tactile with visual rewards improves performance further. TaRL also generalizes across object instances: trained on box placement and directly deployed to can placement, it significantly improves policy learning on the new task. Project page is available at https://embodiedai-ntu.github.io/tarl.

AI.tldr: 提出TaRL框架，利用触觉演示学习奖励，显著提升接触丰富操作任务的强化学习效率与成功率。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在接触丰富操作中依赖奖励设计，稀疏奖励效率低、密集奖励难指定；视觉奖励学习仅依赖视觉观测，无法捕捉视觉目标之外的奖励信息。
AI.method: TaRL以触觉形变图序列为输入，从成功与失败演示中回归任务完成进度，作为塑形奖励，并可结合视觉奖励。
AI.result: 在4个模拟和2个真实操作任务上评估：模拟螺母穿线成功率34%→56%，真实方块拾取37%→97%；触觉与视觉奖励结合进一步提升；可跨物体实例泛化（盒子放置训练后直接部署到罐子放置）。
AI.conclusion: TaRL能提供局部交互反馈，学习稳固抓取与正确施力，对场景布局变化鲁棒，并泛化到新任务。

title: Lost in Translation: Measuring the Effect of Non-Native English on End User Performance of Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used by people whose first language is not English, yet these users have been shown to receive systematically lower-quality responses than fluent speakers. Which specific features of non-native English drive this gap remains unclear, because fluency is itself a composite of mechanical accuracy, vocabulary use, organization, and discourse coherence. Here, we introduce FABLE, a controlled dataset of 190,911 English prompt variants derived from 174K real user prompts for writing-related tasks. Evaluating responses from 34 open-weight LLMs, we find a clear asymmetry; while models do not propagate surface errors such as misspellings into their outputs, models do mirror higher-level rhetorical and lexical qualities present in the user's prompt. Further, the overall quality of responses differs substantially between the least- and most-fluent prompts. These results highlight a key LLM performance disparity for non-native English LLM users, resulting in both lower-quality and less-fluent answers.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示非英语母语者使用大语言模型时，因提示词流利度差异导致回答质量更低且更不流利的不平等现象。
AI.motivation: 非英语母语者从LLM获得系统性较低质量的回答，但具体是哪些非母语英语特征导致这一差距尚不明确，因为流利度本身包含机械准确性、词汇、组织和语篇连贯性等多个维度。
AI.method: 构建FABLE数据集，包含从17.4万条真实用户写作提示衍生的190,911条英文提示变体；评估34个开源权重LLM的回答。
AI.result: 模型不会将拼写错误等表面错误传播到输出中，但会模仿提示中更高层次的修辞和词汇特征；最流利与最不流利提示的回答整体质量差异显著。
AI.conclusion: LLM对非英语母语用户存在性能差异，导致回答质量更低且流利度更差。

title: Beyond Legibility: Benchmarking Visual Text Rendering and In-Place Editing in Unified Video Generation
summary: A video can exhibit convincing motion and photorealism yet fail immediately when visual text collapses. Unlike generic scene content, visual text is unforgiving in video generation: minor stroke corruption, temporal instability, or editing errors instantly break legibility and realism. Existing benchmarks overlook this challenge by treating text as incidental or using static OCR metrics that ignore temporal dynamics. We introduce VidScribe, a unified diagnostic benchmark spanning four generation regimes: writing from language (T2V), transferring text identity from a reference (R2V), sustaining text under dynamics (I2V), and localized text editing (V2V). VidScribe contains 803 human-verified samples across a 12-axis conditionally orthogonal factor space covering Intrinsic Text Properties, Physical Imaging Conditions, and Temporal Behavior. For reliable evaluation, we build a track-grounded, gated suite with 11 shared metrics and 2 task-specific probes under strict measurability conditions. Benchmarking 11 commercial and open-source systems shows that video text capability is non-monolithic, with content recognition decoupled from stroke-level glyph correctness. Performance is highly task-asymmetric: I2V sustains text most reliably, whereas V2V editing is the primary bottleneck. Counter-intuitively, degradation concentrates on a small subset of text-centric structural and temporal factors rather than adverse imaging conditions. Further probes show that visual references improve glyph and typographic fidelity rather than content accuracy, while localized editing fails to isolate target text without corrupting undeclared source text. Beyond evaluation, VidScribe also provides an actionable training signal, where benchmark-aligned preference optimization measurably improves visual text generation. https://huggingface.co/datasets/Vicky0720/VidScribe.

AI.tldr: 提出 VidScribe，一个覆盖 T2V、R2V、I2V、V2V 四类视频生成范式的视觉文本诊断基准，包含 803 个人工验证样本、12 轴条件正交因素空间、11 个共享指标和 2 个任务特定探针，并评估了 11 个商业与开源系统。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成基准通常将视觉文本视为次要内容，或仅用静态 OCR 指标评估，忽略了视频中文本对笔画损坏、时序不稳定和编辑错误高度敏感的问题，因此需要专门且可靠的诊断基准。
AI.method: 构建统一诊断基准 VidScribe，覆盖从语言生成文本、参考迁移文本身份、动态中保持文本、局部文本编辑四类任务；设计涵盖内在文本属性、物理成像条件和时序行为的 12 轴条件正交因素空间；建立基于轨迹、带门控的评估套件，含 11 个共享指标和 2 个任务特定探针；对 11 个商业和开源系统进行基准测试；并提供基准对齐的偏好优化训练信号。
AI.result: 视频文本能力并非单一维度，内容识别与笔画级字形正确性解耦；性能任务不对称，I2V 最能稳定保持文本，V2V 编辑是主要瓶颈；退化集中在少数文本结构和时序因素而非不利成像条件；视觉参考提升字形与排版保真度而非内容准确性；局部编辑难以隔离目标文本且会破坏未声明源文本；基准对齐偏好优化可明显提升视觉文本生成。
AI.conclusion: VidScribe 揭示了当前视频视觉文本生成的关键局限，提供了可靠评估框架和可操作的训练信号，有助于推动视频生成中视觉文本能力的诊断与改进。

title: Spotter: Let the Embodied Model Lead, and the VLM Reflect for It
summary: Current embodied models do not respond to their own failures, although what just went wrong could inform a small adjustment on the next attempt, the kind of reflection behind the gains of thinking in language models. We test whether they can repair a known error, which requires producing a correction and judging whether it is right. Stopped at a failure and allowed to retry, they seldom repair it through their own randomness or from a language description of the error, and best-of-N selection cannot pick the successful candidate after a failure. We attribute this to training only on successful demonstrations and to inputs too narrow to show what went wrong, and conclude that reflection must come from a vision-language model (VLM), which takes in far more information, such as the episode history and text, and is more general. Prior VLM-led work has the VLM plan every step and invoke the embodied model as a tool, placing the VLM on the critical path. We propose Spotter, which reverses the roles: the embodied model leads and executes continuously, while the VLM runs in parallel, monitors through a lightweight local screener, intervenes only when an error is detected, reflects on and corrects it, and returns control. We run Spotter with Qwen and with GPT as the VLM, and both improve the embodied models; with GPT, Spotter improves Cosmos Policy and $π_{0.5}$ by 5.6 and 7.5 percentage points on RoboCasa, and raises $π_{0.5}$ from 47.2% to 57.0% on the Hard setting of RoboTwin 2.0 and from 53% to 83% on a real robot. Because the VLM steps in only when an error is confirmed, a successful episode with Qwen takes only 13 to 16 s longer than with the embodied model alone and about 70% less time than with a VLM-led baseline using the same model. Our code is available at https://github.com/zqc3117/Spotter.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Spotter，让具身模型主导连续执行，VLM 并行监控并在检测到错误时介入反思与纠正，从而提升具身模型在失败后修复错误的能力，并在多个基准和真实机器人上取得改进且开销较低。
AI.motivation: 当前具身模型无法对自身失败做出反应，很少能通过随机重试或语言描述错误来修复已知错误，best-of-N 选择也无法在失败后选出成功候选；作者认为原因在于只训练成功示范且输入信息过窄，因此反思需要来自能接收更多信息的视觉语言模型 VLM。
AI.method: 提出 Spotter，反转以往 VLM 主导、具身模型作为工具的角色：具身模型主导并持续执行，VLM 并行运行，通过轻量级局部筛选器监控，仅在确认错误时介入，对错误进行反思和纠正后交还控制权。实验使用 Qwen 和 GPT 作为 VLM。
AI.result: Spotter 搭配 Qwen 和 GPT 均能提升具身模型；使用 GPT 时，在 RoboCasa 上使 Cosmos Policy 和 π0.5 分别提升 5.6 和 7.5 个百分点；在 RoboTwin 2.0 Hard 设置上将 π0.5 从 47.2% 提升到 57.0%，在真实机器人上从 53% 提升到 83%。由于 VLM 仅在确认错误后介入，使用 Qwen 时成功回合仅比单独具身模型多 13 至 16 秒，并比同模型的 VLM 主导基线少约 70% 时间。
AI.conclusion: 反思应来自 VLM，而非具身模型自身；让 VLM 仅在错误确认后介入，可以有效反思并纠正具身模型的失败，同时兼顾性能与效率。

title: Learning from Teacher Continuations at Student States
summary: We present OLIVE (OnLine InterVEntion). At each iteration, the evolving student policy generates a new prefix, the teacher continues it autoregressively, and the student is updated using cross-entropy computed on the teacher-generated tokens. Each design choice targets a corresponding limitation of existing distillation methods: (1) sequential covariate shift in offline supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on fixed teacher trajectories, (2) fragmented supervision under prefix failure in token-level on-policy distillation (OPD), and (3) the need for access to teacher token probabilities in distribution-matching distillation. OLIVE achieves higher reasoning performance than OPD (with a top-16 KL approximation) at comparable GPU-hour cost. Our asynchronous implementation further reduces OLIVE's total training time by 23.8\%. We evaluate OLIVE on both hard reasoning tasks and agentic tasks which reflects modern post-training scenarios, and it consistently outperforms existing distillation methods under the same training budget. By regenerating prefixes from the evolving student, OLIVE continues improving after offline distillation plateaus while better preserving the general capabilities and plasticity of the student. Using only text from GPT-5.4-mini, continuously training with OLIVE outperforms offline SFT from the same teacher by 13\% on ScienceWorld. These results support OLIVE as an effective and efficient approach to online language-model distillation.

AI.tldr: 提出在线蒸馏方法OLIVE，通过学生模型生成前缀、教师模型续写、再用教师生成token更新学生，在推理与智能体任务上优于现有蒸馏方法。
AI.motivation: 现有蒸馏方法存在三个局限：离线SFT中固定教师轨迹导致的序贯协变量偏移、token级在线蒸馏中前缀失败导致的监督碎片化、以及分布匹配蒸馏需要教师token概率。
AI.method: OLIVE在每个迭代中由学生策略生成新前缀，教师自回归续写，学生基于教师生成token的交叉熵进行更新；并采用异步实现降低训练时间。
AI.result: OLIVE在同等GPU时耗下推理性能优于OPD（top-16 KL近似），异步实现减少23.8%训练时间；在困难推理和智能体任务上持续优于现有蒸馏方法，仅用GPT-5.4-mini文本在ScienceWorld上比离线SFT提升13%。
AI.conclusion: OLIVE是一种有效且高效的在线语言模型蒸馏方法，能持续改进并更好保持学生模型的通用能力与可塑性。

title: Support-Set Target Leakage in Relational Foundation Models during In-Context Learning: Impact, Detection, and Mitigation
summary: Relational in-context learning (ICL) conditions predictions on the labeled support examples and their linked tables, creating a failure mode when the support set contains target-derived features that are unavailable for the query. We formulate this problem as support-set target leakage, distinct from leakage during dataset construction, temporal splitting, or representation learning. Here, the target-derived (leaker) columns are present only in the labeled support set during relational in-context inference, while queries remain clean. We construct 14 synthetic leaker types, corresponding to 20 columns, spanning proxies with different noise levels, coverage, modalities, semantic transparency, and relational distances. We evaluate a frozen relational encoder with an ICL head on held-out RelBench databases and use Integrated Gradients (IG) to rank and remove suspicious columns. Our results show that the effect of support-set leakage varies across tasks and relational distances. Target-table leakers cause the clearest degradation, while one- and two-hop leakers are not consistently used by the model. IG ranks target-table leakers highly across datasets and partially recovers performance in settings where leakage has the largest effect.

AI.tldr: 论文研究关系型上下文学习中的支持集目标泄漏问题：当带标签支持集包含查询中不可用的目标派生特征时，模型会依赖这些泄漏列进行预测。作者构建14种合成泄漏类型（20列），在RelBench上评估冻结关系编码器与ICL头，并用Integrated Gradients排序和移除可疑列。
AI.motivation: 关系型ICL以带标签支持样本及其关联表为条件进行预测，若支持集包含仅支持集可见、查询不可见的目标派生特征，就会形成支持集目标泄漏。该问题不同于数据集构建、时间划分或表示学习中的泄漏，需要单独定义和研究。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为支持集目标泄漏；构造14种合成泄漏类型、对应20个列，覆盖不同噪声水平、覆盖率、模态、语义透明性和关系距离；在留出的RelBench数据库上评估冻结关系编码器加ICL头；使用Integrated Gradients对可疑列排序并移除，以检验检测和缓解效果。
AI.result: 支持集泄漏的影响因任务和关系距离而异。目标表泄漏导致最明显的性能下降；一跳和两跳泄漏并未被模型一致使用。IG在多个数据集上对目标表泄漏列给出高排名，并在泄漏影响最大的设置中部分恢复性能。
AI.conclusion: 支持集目标泄漏是关系型ICL中一个需要关注的失败模式。其影响取决于任务和关系距离，目标表泄漏最明确且可被IG部分检测与缓解，而更远关系距离的泄漏行为更复杂。

title: Pixel-wise Exposure for Highly Robust In-Vehicle Remote-PPG
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) offers a promising non-contact solution for heart rate monitoring, yet its real-world robustness is fundamentally limited by an inherent hardware limitation: existing camera exposure control paradigms, whether fixed or auto-exposure, impose a uniform exposure time across all pixels within a frame. In high-dynamic-range scenes such as automotive cabins with strong directional sunlight, this spatially invariant exposure constraint inevitably leads to localized facial overexposure or underexposure, irreversibly corrupting the subtle pulsatile signals essential for rPPG at the point of capture, a physical degradation that no downstream algorithm can recover. To overcome this bottleneck, we propose PixExpo (Pixel-wise Exposure), a "temporal-for-spatial" framework that sequentially captures frames under a predefined cyclic exposure schedule and performs non-iterative pixel-wise fusion. At each pixel location, PixExpo selects the observation closest to an rPPG-motivated target intensity. This criterion seeks to reduce local saturation and severe underexposure rather than optimize perceptual appearance. PixExpo requires no sensor modification but assumes programmable frame-level exposure control. We validate the proposed PixExpo framework using our newly introduced MEX-Drive dataset, comprising 48 participants under real-world driving conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that PixExpo outperforms manufacture-default auto-exposure methods, reducing the mean absolute error (MAE) by 7.21 bpm (from 13.94 to 6.73 bpm) and increasing the success rate by 37.29 percentage points (from 25.95% to 63.24%) across challenging driving scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出PixExpo框架，通过循环曝光序列采集与逐像素非迭代融合，解决rPPG在强方向光下车内场景的曝光限制，并在新数据集MEX-Drive上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有相机固定或自动曝光对全帧采用统一曝光时间，在高动态范围场景（如车内强阳光）中会导致面部局部过曝或欠曝，从采集端破坏rPPG所需的微弱脉搏信号，后续算法无法恢复。
AI.method: PixExpo采用“时间换空间”思路：按预定义循环曝光计划依次采集帧，再逐像素非迭代融合；在每个像素位置选择最接近rPPG目标强度的观测，以降低局部饱和和严重欠曝，而非优化视觉外观。无需改造传感器，但需可编程帧级曝光控制。使用新构建的MEX-Drive数据集（48名参与者在真实驾驶条件下）验证。
AI.result: 在挑战性驾驶场景中，PixExpo优于厂商默认自动曝光方法，MAE降低7.21 bpm（从13.94降至6.73 bpm），成功率提高37.29个百分点（从25.95%升至63.24%）。
AI.conclusion: PixExpo通过采集端曝光调度与逐像素融合，能有效缓解高动态范围下的局部过曝/欠曝问题，显著提升rPPG心率监测的鲁棒性和成功率。

title: PreferenceFlow: Test-Time Guidance of Flow-Matching Robot Policies from Human Interventions
summary: Flow-matching policies can represent complex robot behaviors but remain susceptible to local errors under distribution shift at deployment. Many reinforcement learning approaches to policy improvement require reward signals that are difficult to specify or obtain in real-world manipulation. We present PreferenceFlow, a framework for improving a pretrained flow policy at test time without environment rewards or updates to the base policy. Human intervention chunks are paired with robot chunks generated from the same initial conditioning state to train a preference model. During infer- ence, we adopt the QGF sampling update, replacing its value gradient with the preference gradient evaluated at an estimated clean action. A gradient-cap loss penalizes excessive gradients on intervention pairs, while a zero-gradient loss discourages guidance near actions from expert demonstrations. On four real-world precision insertion tasks with a Franka robot, Pref- erenceFlow achieves a mean success rate of 90.5%, compared with 69% for the frozen policy. Ablations support the roles of gradient regularization and correctly ordered preference labels in the evaluated settings. These results demonstrate the utility of human interventions as local preference supervision for guiding frozen generative robot policies.

AI.tldr: 提出 PreferenceFlow，一种在测试时利用人类干预偏好来改进预训练流匹配机器人策略的框架，无需环境奖励或更新基础策略。
AI.motivation: 流匹配策略能表示复杂机器人行为，但在部署分布偏移下易出现局部错误；而许多强化学习策略改进方法依赖难以指定或获取的奖励信号，尤其在实际操作任务中。
AI.method: 将人类干预片段与同一初始条件状态生成的机器人片段配对，训练偏好模型；推理时采用 QGF 采样更新，把价值梯度替换为在估计干净动作处评估的偏好梯度；引入梯度上限损失惩罚干预对上的过大梯度，并使用零梯度损失避免在专家演示动作附近施加引导。
AI.result: 在 Franka 机器人的四个真实世界精密插入任务中，PreferenceFlow 平均成功率达 90.5%，而冻结策略为 69%；消融实验支持梯度正则化和正确排序偏好标签的作用。
AI.conclusion: 人类干预可作为局部偏好监督，用于引导冻结的生成式机器人策略，从而在测试时提升性能而无需环境奖励或微调基础策略。

title: VidAct: Learning Manipulation from In-the-Wild Videos with Object-Centric 3D Awareness
summary: Video demonstrations offer a scalable alternative to costly robot data for learning manipulation, yet existing reconstruction-based approaches often rely on constrained camera viewpoints or human-to-robot retargeting, while the reconstructed trajectories are difficult to adapt to new objects configurations without distorting the trajectory shape. Another key limitation is that the resulting policies often lack precise object-level 3D geometry awareness, limiting object grounding and object shape awareness critical for precise manipulation. To bridge these gaps, we propose VidAct, an efficient video-to-robot framework that learns object-centric, 3D-aware manipulation policies from a single monocular video per task and enables zero-shot real-world deployment. VidAct consists of three key components. First, VidAct reconstructs object meshes and motion from arbitrary demo videos and canonicalizes the motion in the static object frame, avoiding embodiment-specific retargeting and accommodating diverse camera viewpoints. Second, VidAct employ residual trajectory transfer for adapting the reconstructed motion to novel object configurations while preserving its motion shape. Finally, as the key policy-learning component, VidAct predicts simulation-provided privileged complete-object point clouds at each frame as an auxiliary task while retaining RGB-only deployment, providing dense object-centric supervision over both object pose and 3D geometry. Experiments on human, robot, generated, and internet videos demonstrate broad video applicability and zero-shot deployment. Per-frame complete-object 3D supervision improves policy generalization and sim-to-real success, while residual trajectory transfer enables reliable trajectory adaptation with better shape preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出VidAct，一种从单目视频学习物体中心、3D感知操作策略的视频到机器人框架，支持零样本真实世界部署。
AI.motivation: 视频演示可替代昂贵的机器人数据，但现有基于重建的方法受限于固定相机视角或人-机器人重定向，轨迹难以适应新物体配置且易变形；同时策略缺乏精确的物体级3D几何感知，影响物体定位和形状理解。
AI.method: 框架包含三部分：1）从任意演示视频重建物体网格和运动，并在静态物体坐标系中规范化运动，避免特定本体重定向并适应多样视角；2）采用残差轨迹迁移，在保持运动形状的同时适应新物体配置；3）策略学习时，以预测仿真提供的特权完整物体点云为辅助任务，但部署仅用RGB，提供物体姿态和3D几何的密集监督。
AI.result: 在人类、机器人、生成和互联网视频上实验，证明广泛视频适用性和零样本部署。逐帧完整物体3D监督提升策略泛化与仿真到现实成功率，残差轨迹迁移实现可靠轨迹适应并更好保持形状。
AI.conclusion: VidAct通过物体中心3D感知和残差轨迹迁移，有效弥合视频演示与机器人操作间的差距，实现高效零样本部署。

title: Cognitive Expert Language Models Better Align with the Corresponding Brain Systems
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can predict human brain activity across a variety of brain regions during natural language comprehension. Typically, however, LLM-brain alignment is measured using one model for different regions of the brain, and then model performance is summarized across regions. This one-model-fits-all approach ignores the functional specialization of brain regions. In this study, we assess whether a model oriented toward a particular cognitive domain aligns better with the brain system dedicated to that domain. Through prompting and fine-tuning, we first build expert LLM variants for six domains: sensory, spatial, numerical, reasoning, social, and abstract processing. We then examine whether each expert best predicts activity in the brain region associated with the corresponding cognitive domain. Consistent with our hypotheses, each expert's representations align more closely with the brain system most associated with the matching domain than do other experts. This holds under both prompting and fine-tuning, across three base models and three fMRI datasets. In a series of control analyses, we show that this model-brain alignment is specific to cognitive domain interventions; non-cognitive and surface-level interventions do not result in comparable alignment. Specializing models shifts regional alignment while leaving aggregate prediction accuracy largely unchanged, suggesting that summarizing alignment across regions may obscure regional differences in performance for specific models.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验领域特化的大语言模型是否比通用模型更能对齐对应认知功能的脑区。作者构建了六个认知领域的专家模型，并发现每个专家均更好地预测匹配脑系统的活动。
AI.motivation: 以往LLM与脑活动对齐研究常采用“一个模型适配所有脑区”的方式，忽略了脑区功能特化，因此可能掩盖不同模型在不同脑区的表现差异。
AI.method: 通过提示和微调，为感觉、空间、数字、推理、社会、抽象六个认知领域构建专家LLM变体；在三种基础模型和三个fMRI数据集上，比较各专家模型与对应脑区活动的对齐程度，并进行非认知与表面级干预的控制分析。
AI.result: 每个领域专家模型的表征与对应认知领域脑系统的对齐程度高于其他专家；该结果在提示和微调下均成立，且跨三种基础模型和三个fMRI数据集。控制分析显示，非认知或表面级干预不会产生类似对齐。
AI.conclusion: 模型特化会改变区域层面的脑对齐，但总体预测准确率基本不变，说明仅汇总跨区域对齐可能掩盖特定模型在区域间的性能差异。

title: Persona Dosing: Calibrated Activation Steering for Graded Trait Control
summary: An activation-steering coefficient sets intervention strength, but requesting a particular degree of persona expression requires a behavioral scale. We study persona dosing: controlling a language model through a trait description and a requested mean intensity. PersonaDose specializes a shared, description-conditioned FLAS controller on persona responses, then calibrates its flow time against measured trait expression. Training responses are not paired with requested target intensities. Across Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-8B, and Gemma-3-4B, PersonaDose raises core-trait expression at the Persona Vectors coherence floor of 75 by 33.2, 18.3, and 17.8 points over contrastive activation addition. Calibration-selected settings retain an expression advantage on held-out questions, although the coherence floor does not hold for every trait there. Across seven trained traits, calibrated requests yield mean targeting errors of 4.7-6.2 points over 14-22 calibration-reachable targets out of 28 per model. These results separate the behavioral range learned by a controller from the accuracy of requests within that range.

AI.tldr: 论文研究人格剂量控制：通过特质描述和请求的平均强度来控制语言模型。提出 PersonaDose，将共享的描述条件 FLAS 控制器专用于人格响应，并用测得的特质表达校准其 flow time。
AI.motivation: 激活引导系数只能设定干预强度，但若要请求特定程度的人格表达，需要一种行为尺度。因此需要研究如何进行人格剂量控制。
AI.method: PersonaDose 先针对人格响应专门化一个共享的、描述条件化的 FLAS 控制器，然后根据测得的特质表达校准其 flow time。训练响应不与请求的目标强度配对。
AI.result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B、Gemma-3-4B 上，PersonaDose 在 Persona Vectors 一致性阈值 75 下，将核心特质表达比对比激活加法分别提高 33.2、18.3、17.8 个点。校准选出的设置在留出问题上保持表达优势，但一致性阈值并非对所有特质都成立。在七种训练特质上，校准请求在每模型 28 个目标中可达 14–22 个校准目标，平均目标误差为 4.7–6.2 个点。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果区分了控制器学到的行为范围与在该范围内请求的准确性。

title: Scaling Video Generation for Reasoning: At What Cost?
summary: We study whether scaling video generation enables models to reason about hidden information from the past frames, and at what computational cost. Our controlled benchmark requires predicting nine prescribed moves of an initially solved 2x2x2 Rubik's Cube from a fixed view of three faces. Correct predictions require inferring how actions change hidden states, and the simulator provides exact ground truth for evaluation. Models learn plausible cube geometry early, while correct sticker configurations require substantially more training. Although validation MSE follows approximate power-law scaling, lower MSE loss does not reliably indicate downstream reasoning capabilities. Smaller autoregressive models achieve higher state accuracy with limited compute, while larger models reach higher accuracy after more training. At roughly 0.1 PF-days, the 70M-parameter model correctly predicts the visible sticker configuration in 44.6% of post-action frames, compared with 0.3% for the 1B model, which reaches 83.7% at 3.14 PF-days. Symbolic state supervision raises the 20M model's frame accuracy from 31.1% to 67.3% at the same training-data budget, suggesting that learning representations of state changes can complement scaling.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视频生成模型能否通过过去帧推理隐藏信息，并分析其计算成本。作者用2x2x2魔方作为受控基准，要求模型根据固定视角的三面画面预测九个指定动作后的状态。结果显示，缩放能提升推理能力，但损失下降不一定代表推理能力提升；符号状态监督可显著补充缩放效果。
AI.motivation: 探究扩展视频生成模型是否能让模型从过去帧中推理隐藏信息，以及这种能力提升需要多少计算成本。现有缩放规律主要关注损失或生成质量，未必能反映下游推理能力，因此需要一个有精确真值的受控任务来检验。
AI.method: 构建2x2x2魔方基准：从固定视角观察三个面，预测九个预设动作后的可见贴纸配置。使用模拟器提供精确真值。训练不同规模的自回归视频生成模型，分析验证MSE的缩放规律、模型规模与计算量对状态预测准确率的影响，并测试符号状态监督的作用。
AI.result: 模型早期学会合理立方体几何，但正确贴纸配置需要更多训练。验证MSE近似遵循幂律缩放，但更低MSE并不能可靠指示下游推理能力。较小自回归模型在有限计算下状态准确率更高，而较大模型在更多训练后达到更高准确率。约0.1 PF-days时，70M模型在动作后帧中正确预测可见贴纸配置的比例为44.6%，而1B模型仅0.3%；1B模型在3.14 PF-days时达到83.7%。符号状态监督在相同训练数据预算下将20M模型的帧准确率从31.1%提升到67.3%。
AI.conclusion: 缩放视频生成模型有助于提升对隐藏状态的推理，但存在计算量与准确率之间的权衡，且MSE损失不能可靠反映推理能力。学习状态变化的表示或引入符号状态监督，可与缩放互补，显著提升小模型的状态预测表现。

title: ARCagent: An Adaptive Retrieval Calibration Agent for Clinical Question Answering
summary: In diseases where clinical guidelines are incomplete, contested, or mutually contradictory, knowledge completeness and dynamic conflict-aware synthesis are two safety-critical properties that standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems do not provide. Therefore, we present \sysname, an adaptive retrieval calibration clinical question-answering agent for ME/CFS, a disease where diagnostic frameworks coexist and major guidelines actively contradict each other on treatment. ARCagent contributes three components. First, a 1,706-chunk, 10-source knowledge base with a structured inter-guideline conflict registry spanning all active ME/CFS diagnostic frameworks. Second, a conflict-aware retrieval calibration pipeline that re-ranks retrieved evidence using query-specific focus and conflict signals. Third, a benchmark scored by LLM-as-Judge, avoiding systematic underestimation averaging 10.1 percentage points caused by keyword matching. ARCagent achieves 95.3%, outperforming all base LLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/Yukyin/ARCagent.

AI.tldr: 提出面向ME/CFS的自适应检索校准临床问答智能体ARCagent，通过冲突感知检索与LLM-as-Judge基准，在指南矛盾场景下实现95.3%的表现并超越所有基础LLM。
AI.motivation: 在临床指南不完整、有争议或相互矛盾时，标准RAG系统无法保证知识完整性和动态冲突感知综合，这对安全攸关的临床问答至关重要。ME/CFS正是多种诊断框架并存且主要治疗指南相互矛盾的疾病。
AI.method: 构建包含1,706个文本块、10个来源的知识库及跨指南冲突登记表；设计冲突感知检索校准流程，利用查询特定关注点和冲突信号对证据重排序；采用LLM-as-Judge构建基准，避免关键词匹配平均低估10.1个百分点的问题。
AI.result: ARCagent取得95.3%的评分，优于所有基础LLM。
AI.conclusion: ARCagent能有效应对指南矛盾疾病的临床问答，提升知识完整性与冲突感知综合能力，代码已开源。

title: NIDAR: NIR-Guided Intrinsic Decomposition for Scalable Scene-Agnostic LiDAR Intensity Reconstruction
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures. Accepted by IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026
summary: LiDAR return intensity provides complementary surface-response cues for robotic perception and state estimation, yet many simulation pipelines omit it or reproduce it using reconstruction methods that require real intensity supervision and per-scene optimization. These requirements increase data-collection and fitting costs and limit reuse across simulated scenes. We present NIDAR, a feed-forward framework that synthesizes dense intensity-like observations from RGB appearance and simulator geometry. NIDAR combines pretrained pseudo-NIR translation, hierarchical intrinsic decomposition, geometry-aware modulation, and source-domain distribution calibration to transfer reflectance-related image cues to simulated point clouds. Its learned components are trained offline using Waymo data; their weights and calibration remain fixed during evaluation on Waymo and nuScenes. Deployment therefore requires neither target-scene intensity labels nor target-scene gradient-based fitting. The reported comparisons show competitive pixel-wise accuracy and favorable structural and perceptual fidelity against the evaluated reconstruction baselines. A controlled pseudo-NIR-versus-RGB diagnostic further shows that the pseudo-NIR prior is most beneficial when used through the paper-aligned reflectance-and-remapping route, rather than as a simple direct intensity regressor. We further integrate NIDAR with Unreal Engine 5, Isaac Sim, and a generative LiDAR pipeline. Two intensity-aware SLAM systems evaluated in two simulated indoor scenes suggest potential downstream utility, but do not constitute real-robot validation. NIDAR therefore offers a scalable intensity-synthesis interface for the evaluated settings; cross-wavelength, camera-configuration, embedded, and real-sensor validation remain future work.

AI.tldr: NIDAR是一个前馈框架，能够从RGB外观和仿真器几何中合成稠密的类强度观测，离线在Waymo上训练后无需目标场景强度标签或逐场景优化即可泛化至Waymo和nuScenes。
AI.motivation: LiDAR回波强度为机器人感知与状态估计提供互补线索，但许多仿真流程忽略强度，或采用需真实强度监督和逐场景优化的重建方法，导致数据采集与拟合成本高、难以跨仿真场景复用。
AI.method: 结合预训练伪近红外翻译、分层本征分解、几何感知调制和源域分布校准，将反射率相关图像线索迁移至仿真点云；学习组件在Waymo上离线训练，评估时权重与校准固定；并与Unreal Engine 5、Isaac Sim及生成式LiDAR流程集成。
AI.result: 与评估的重建基线相比，具有竞争力的逐像素精度及更优的结构与感知保真度；受控的伪近红外与RGB对比诊断表明，伪近红外先验通过反射率与重映射路径使用时收益最大；在两个仿真室内场景中，两个强度感知SLAM系统显示潜在下游效用。
AI.conclusion: NIDAR为所评估场景提供可扩展的强度合成接口；跨波长、相机配置、嵌入式及真实传感器验证仍属未来工作。

title: CrossTimeEdit: A Decade-Spanning Cross-View Dataset and Reward-Guided Editing for Historical Street-View Generation
summary: Historical street-view imagery records urban evolution, but uneven coverage leaves substantial gaps in historical records. Generating plausible past appearances requires restoring changed structures while preserving persistent scene content. We construct VIGOR-his, a decade-spanning cross-view dataset containing 43,653 location-level quadruplets across 11 cities on three continents. Its automated pipeline performs spatial pairing, consistency screening, change classification, and the generation and validation of satellite-based change descriptions and local editing instructions. Based on VIGOR-his, we propose CrossTimeEdit, a model that reformulates historical street-view generation as editing, using recent street views to constrain viewpoint and unchanged appearance and temporal satellite differences as change evidence. Starting from FLUX.2 [Klein] 4B, we train CrossTimeEdit through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by online reinforcement learning (RL). We design three street-view editing criteria, namely Instruction Alignment (IA), Background Preservation (BP), and Quality and Physical Plausibility (QP), as both RL reward dimensions and evaluation metrics. We optimize this multi-reward objective using Within Group Relative Policy Optimization for flow-matching models (Flow-GRPO) with Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO), which normalizes each reward dimension before aggregation. CrossTimeEdit improves overall performance across the three editing criteria by 17.12\% over the pretrained baseline and outperforms cross-view generation models in scene consistency, visual realism, and perceptual quality. The implementation code, dataset, and model weights are available at https://luhanwen67.github.io/CrossTimeEdit-release/.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了跨十年、跨视角的历史街景数据集VIGOR-his，并提出CrossTimeEdit模型，将历史街景生成转化为编辑任务，利用近期街景约束视角与不变外观、卫星时序差异作为变化证据，通过SFT和强化学习训练，在指令对齐、背景保持和质量与物理合理性上显著提升。
AI.motivation: 历史街景影像记录城市演变，但覆盖不均导致历史记录存在大量空白。生成合理的过去外观需要在恢复变化结构的同时保留持续存在的场景内容，这一任务具有挑战性。
AI.method: 构建VIGOR-his数据集，包含三大洲11个城市的43,653个位置级四元组，自动流水线完成空间配对、一致性筛选、变化分类以及基于卫星的变化描述和局部编辑指令生成与验证。基于此提出CrossTimeEdit模型，将历史街景生成重构为编辑任务：用近期街景约束视角和不变外观，用时序卫星差异作为变化证据。以FLUX.2 [Klein] 4B为起点，先监督微调后在线强化学习。设计三个街景编辑标准——指令对齐、背景保持、质量与物理合理性，作为RL奖励维度和评估指标。采用Flow-GRPO与GDPO优化多奖励目标，后者在聚合前对每个奖励维度归一化。
AI.result: CrossTimeEdit在三个编辑标准上的整体性能比预训练基线提升17.12%，并在场景一致性、视觉真实感和感知质量上优于跨视角生成模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了实现代码、数据集和模型权重，验证了将历史街景生成视为编辑任务并利用多奖励强化学习优化的有效性。

title: HeurEvo: Agentic Evolution of Hybrid Solver-Augmented Heuristics for Time-Critical Mathematical Optimization
summary: Recent advances in agentic heuristic design use AI agents and execution feedback to automate algorithm discovery for challenging optimization problems. In many practical settings, high-quality solutions must be obtained under strict runtime constraints, motivating hybrid approaches that combine problem-specific heuristics with powerful mathematical programming solvers. However, existing approaches typically improve heuristic components within predefined procedures or tune solver configurations in isolation. This limits holistic adaptation of where to allocate computation, how to leverage solvers, and how to refine the overall algorithmic structure. To address these limitations, we propose HeurEvo, an automated plan--code--component co-evolution framework that jointly evolves the high-level algorithmic structures, their implementations, and a shared pool of reusable components. A planner determines which algorithmic components to use, how to combine them, and how to allocate runtime across stages, a coder realizes the resulting plan as executable code, while a component evolver updates the shared component pool. Within an island-based evolutionary framework, plans and implementations co-evolve with feedback from an interpreter agent that analyzes execution results and identifies opportunities for improvement. Across diverse combinatorial optimization benchmarks and challenging MIPLIB instances, HeurEvo finds high-quality solutions within tight runtime budgets, often matching or surpassing state-of-the-art optimization solvers given hours or days of computation. On several nonlinear geometry problems such as hexagon packing, it also improves upon the best previously reported results. These results highlight the value of jointly searching over algorithmic structure and implementation for agentic heuristic design.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 HeurEvo，一个自动化的“规划—代码—组件”协同进化框架，用于在严格运行时间约束下设计混合启发式与数学规划求解器的高质量优化算法。
AI.motivation: 现有智能启发式设计通常只在预定义流程内改进启发式组件，或孤立地调参求解器配置，难以整体适应计算资源分配、求解器利用和算法结构优化。实际场景又要求在严格运行时间约束下获得高质量解。
AI.method: HeurEvo 在岛屿式进化框架中联合进化高层算法结构、其代码实现和可复用组件池。规划器决定使用哪些算法组件、如何组合及如何分配各阶段运行时间；编码器将规划转化为可执行代码；组件进化器更新共享组件池。解释器代理分析执行结果并识别改进机会，形成反馈驱动协同进化。
AI.result: 在多种组合优化基准和具有挑战性的 MIPLIB 实例上，HeurEvo 能在紧张运行时间预算内找到高质量解，常可匹配或超越需要数小时甚至数天计算的最先进优化求解器。在六边形堆积等非线性几何问题上，还改进了此前最佳报告结果。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在智能启发式设计中，联合搜索算法结构与实现具有重要价值，能够更整体地适应运行时约束并提升优化性能。

title: All Roads Lead to Rome: Flow-driven Multi-Anchor Exploration for Open-Environment Active 3D Mapping
summary: To advance the development of embodied intelligence, Open-Environment Active 3D Mapping has attracted increasing attention, aiming to perform a long-horizon and shortest trajectory exploration for reconstructing unseen scenarios. Since only limited information about unseen environments is available, methods built on the closed-set assumption, i.e., assuming that the test environments are similar to those seen during training, cannot generalize satisfactorily. In existing active mapping methods, long-horizon exploration is often guided by predicting a coarse long-range goal and then converting it into an executable path. However, this stage is usually formulated as single-point prediction. Under partial observability, the same local observation may correspond to multiple plausible exploration directions, making such deterministic prediction prone to brittle decisions and degraded performance in unseen scenarios. Our experiments further verify that this is a key factor underlying their weak generalization. To address this issue, we reformulate long-horizon target prediction as conditional multimodal anchor generation using Conditional Flow Matching.Instead of predicting a single goal, our method learns a conditional distribution over coarse exploration anchors from the current mapping state. These anchors are first converted into executable candidate paths through obstacle-aware planning. We then apply exploration-mode clustering to compress geometrically similar trajectories and reduce candidate redundancy. Finally, a hierarchical selection module selects the most promising mode and reranks paths within it to produce the final executable trajectory. Experiments show that our method improves generalization and reconstruction efficiency in open environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向开放环境的主动三维建图方法，将长时程探索目标预测重新表述为基于条件流匹配的多模态锚点生成，以提升未见场景中的泛化能力和重建效率。
AI.motivation: 开放环境主动三维建图需要长时程、最短轨迹探索，但现有方法多基于闭集假设，难以泛化到未见环境。此外，长时程探索常通过预测单个粗粒度远距离目标再转为路径，这种单点确定性预测在部分可观测下容易因同一局部观测对应多个合理探索方向而产生脆弱决策，是泛化能力弱的关键因素。
AI.method: 作者将长时程目标预测重新表述为条件多模态锚点生成，使用条件流匹配（Conditional Flow Matching）从当前建图状态学习粗粒度探索锚点的条件分布。生成的锚点先通过障碍物感知规划转化为可执行候选路径；再用探索模式聚类压缩几何相似的轨迹，减少候选冗余；最后通过分层选择模块选择最有前景的探索模式，并在该模式内对路径重排序，得到最终可执行轨迹。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在开放环境中提升了泛化能力和重建效率，并验证了单点预测是导致现有方法泛化较弱的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: 通过条件多模态锚点生成与分层路径选择，可以缓解部分可观测下的脆弱单点预测问题，使长时程主动探索在未见开放环境中更稳健、更高效。

title: Beyond Binary Preferences: Graded Preference Optimization for Limb-Motion Captioning
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can generate rich video captions, yet often misidentify which person performs an action or which limb is involved, particularly across camera cuts. Improving these details requires evaluation and training that distinguish missing information from incorrect assertions. We introduce FlexBench, a benchmark spanning 3,105 shots and 18,161 evaluation queries, with human-verified identities and systematic per-person coverage of fine-grained limb actions and states. Its reference-derived checklists support automated assessment of complete captions in their person and shot contexts. Our Graded Physical Alignment score (GPA) awards credit for correct content and deducts points for incorrect or fabricated actions, making these errors explicit in the aggregate score. Building on this rubric, we propose Graded Margin Direct Preference Optimization (GM-DPO), which assigns stronger preference margins and greater training weight to more severe action errors. Across three VLM backbones, GM-DPO achieves the highest substantive-action and GPA scores among the evaluated preference objectives, improving GPA over DPO by 2.02-3.40 points. On Qwen3-8B, it reduces the weighted hallucination rate by 21.3% relative to DPO. These gains accompany sustained long-form output, improved shot structure, and competitive performance on three additional multimodal benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FlexBench基准与GPA评分，用于细粒度评估视频字幕中人物身份、肢体动作及镜头切换下的正确性，并提出GM-DPO训练方法，以惩罚更严重的动作错误，从而减少幻觉并提升字幕质量。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型能生成丰富视频字幕，但常误判动作执行者、涉及肢体，尤其在镜头切换时。要改进这些细节，需要能区分信息缺失与错误断言，并进行细粒度评估与训练。
AI.method: 构建FlexBench，包含3,105个镜头和18,161个评估查询，带人工验证身份及逐人细粒度肢体动作/状态覆盖；基于参考生成检查清单，支持自动评估完整字幕。提出Graded Physical Alignment score（GPA），正确内容得分，错误或虚构动作扣分。进一步提出Graded Margin Direct Preference Optimization（GM-DPO），对更严重动作错误赋予更大偏好边距和训练权重。
AI.result: 在三个VLM主干上，GM-DPO在实质动作得分和GPA上优于所评估的偏好目标，GPA较DPO提升2.02-3.40分；在Qwen3-8B上，加权幻觉率较DPO降低21.3%。同时保持长文本输出、改善镜头结构，并在三个额外多模态基准上具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: FlexBench、GPA和GM-DPO能更有效评估并训练视频字幕中的细粒度人物-动作对应关系，显式惩罚错误与虚构内容，减少幻觉，同时不损害长文本生成和其他多模态任务性能。

title: From Retrieval to Reasoning: Agentic Mechanism Prediction from Cell Painting Profiles
summary: Cell Painting is a high-content morphological profiling assay widely used for phenotype-based biological inference, with mechanism of action (MOA) prediction as a central application. Existing approaches largely formulate Cell Painting-based inference as representation matching, assigning predictions from nearby reference perturbations in morphological feature space. However, retrieved neighbors are often noisy and partially misleading evidence due to batch effects, non-specific cytotoxicity, phenotypic convergence, and source-dependent variability. We reformulate Cell Painting-based MOA prediction as a calibrated evidence reasoning problem, where retrieved neighbors are treated as uncertain observations that must be evaluated, compared, and sometimes rejected before supporting a mechanistic conclusion. We propose PhenoAIR, a reliability-aware multi-agent framework that maintains a candidate-centric evidence memory and performs controller-guided refinement over phenotype- and mechanism-side evidence. PhenoAIR uses offline reference-set calibration to weight evidence by source reliability, phenotype stability, and mechanism-level confusion. We evaluate PhenoAIR on a benchmark constructed from JUMP Cell Painting profiles and annotations, covering controlled, realistic, and discovery-oriented open-world MOA prediction settings. PhenoAIR outperforms representation-matching and LLM-based baselines across all settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文将Cell Painting的MOA预测重构为校准证据推理问题，并提出可靠性感知多智能体框架PhenoAIR，在JUMP基准上优于表征匹配和LLM基线。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多将Cell Painting推断视为表征匹配，即依据形态特征空间中的邻近参考扰动给出预测；但检索到的邻居常因批次效应、非特异性细胞毒性、表型趋同和来源变异而噪声大且部分误导。
AI.method: 提出PhenoAIR：一种可靠性感知多智能体框架，维护以候选为中心的证据记忆，并通过控制器引导对表型侧和机制侧证据进行精修。该方法将检索邻居视为不确定观察，需评估、比较，必要时拒绝；并使用离线参考集校准，按来源可靠性、表型稳定性和机制层混淆对证据加权。在基于JUMP Cell Painting profiles和注释构建的基准上评估，覆盖受控、真实和面向发现的开放世界MOA预测设置。
AI.result: PhenoAIR在所有评估设置中均优于表征匹配基线和基于LLM的基线。
AI.conclusion: 将Cell Painting的MOA预测从表征匹配转向校准证据推理是有效方向；PhenoAIR能提升MOA预测的可靠性，尤其在开放世界发现场景中。

title: OCA: ODE-Driven Cross-Attention for Image-to-Point-Cloud Registration
summary: Cross-attention is a crucial component in learning-based image-to-point-cloud (I2P) registration. Although existing cross-attention mechanisms have achieved promising progress, attention ambiguity remains a fundamental challenge that hinders the learning of discriminative 2D-3D correspondences. To address this problem, we revisit cross-attention and establish ordinary differential equations (ODEs) to model the ideal I2P feature interaction. Based on this formulation, we develop an ODE-driven cross-attention (OCA) module that refines feature representations and attention matrices through ODEs. In practice, OCA can be seamlessly integrated into existing I2P registration frameworks. To validate its effectiveness, we incorporate OCA into five state-of-the-art baselines and evaluate on four public benchmark datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that OCA improves registration recall by up to 5\%, 9\%, and 15\% under the standard, fine-tuning, and zero-shot settings, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文针对图像到点云配准中的跨注意力模糊问题，提出基于常微分方程（ODE）建模的ODE驱动跨注意力模块OCA，以提升2D-3D对应关系的判别能力。
AI.motivation: 现有跨注意力机制虽取得进展，但注意力模糊仍是学习判别性2D-3D对应关系的关键挑战，阻碍图像到点云配准性能提升。
AI.method: 重新审视跨注意力，建立ODE来建模理想的I2P特征交互，并据此设计OCA模块，通过ODE细化特征表示和注意力矩阵；该模块可无缝集成到现有I2P配准框架中，并在5个先进基线和4个公开数据集上验证。
AI.result: 实验表明，OCA在标准、微调和零样本设置下分别将配准召回率最多提升5%、9%和15%。
AI.conclusion: OCA能够有效缓解跨注意力模糊问题，提升多种I2P配准框架的性能，且具备良好的通用性和集成能力。

title: Population Fidelity: Evaluating Population Representativeness in LLMs
comment: 37 pages, 16 figures, 14 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/CriticalMaking/LLM-population-fidelity
summary: Large language models (LLMs) show considerable potential in simulating human attitudes and preferences. Prior work finds that LLM-generated responses can compress the range of attitudes found within populations and misrepresent particular subgroups in ways that vary across models and topics. We introduce Population Fidelity, an evaluation framework that distinguishes key conditions required for a set of LLM-generated responses to represent a population. It incorporates three dimensions: group-level accuracy, the amount of between-group variation, and the structure of that variation. We demonstrate the framework's utility in two ways. First, we reproduce a prior study of "machine bias" in LLM survey responses and apply the framework to its models and more recent ones, showing that poor representation reflects not only insufficient between-group variation but also variation assigned to the wrong groups. Second, we evaluate one proposed approach to improving models' population representativeness: cultural fine-tuning. We find that cultural fine-tuning can improve alignment with the survey center without improving the representation of within-population differences, a distinction that measures of aggregate agreement do not capture. We argue that representing a population requires models to reproduce several features of human attitudinal variation simultaneously. Our framework organizes these features and provides reusable code, data, and trained models for evaluating population fidelity across substantive domains and assessing proposed alignment methods.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Population Fidelity 评估框架，用于判断大语言模型生成回答能否代表人群，并从群体准确度、群体间变异量及变异结构三个维度进行评估。
AI.motivation: 已有研究发现，大语言模型模拟人类态度时会压缩态度范围并错误表征某些亚群体，且问题随模型和主题变化，因此需要更细粒度的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出包含三个维度的 Population Fidelity 框架；复现并扩展先前关于大语言模型调查回答中“机器偏见”的研究；评估文化微调对人口代表性的改进效果。
AI.result: 应用框架发现，表征不佳不仅因群体间变异不足，也因变异被分配到错误群体；文化微调能提升与调查中心的总体一致性，但未改善群体内差异表征，且总体一致性指标无法捕捉这一区别。
AI.conclusion: 代表一个群体要求模型同时复现人类态度变异的多个特征；该框架可组织这些特征，并提供可复用代码、数据与训练模型，用于跨领域评估人口保真度及检验对齐方法。

title: AeroManip-VLA: Scalable Vision-Language-Action Learning for Aerial Manipulation with RL-Generated Demonstrations
summary: Aerial manipulators extend robotic manipulation into 3D workspaces that are difficult for ground-based robots to access, creating new opportunities for general-purpose manipulation. However, extending Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to aerial robots introduces distinct challenges due to the tight coupling between manipulation and flight, continuously changing observations, and safety-critical physical interactions. These challenges demand diverse training data and systematic policy evaluation, yet collecting demonstrations and evaluating policies directly on physical aerial platforms are costly, difficult to scale, and hard to repeat under controlled conditions. We present AeroManip-VLA, a scalable benchmark for aerial VLA data generation and policy evaluation. AeroManip-VLA provides a GPU-accelerated simulation framework with low-level payload-aware flight and manipulation control in massively parallel environments. Building on this framework, we combine reusable reinforcement learning policies with expert task rules to automatically generate demonstrations without human teleoperation across diverse objects, environments, and randomized initial conditions. The generated data include basic skills such as grasping and placing, as well as long-horizon tasks that require both navigation and manipulation. We further introduce automated event labeling and trajectory categorization to filter demonstrations. These mechanisms enable fine-grained analysis of task progress, behavioral outcomes, and safety-related failures. Finally, we evaluate a range of imitation learning and VLA baselines across different task settings, revealing their performance characteristics and failure modes. Together, AeroManip-VLA enables scalable aerial manipulation data generation, structured trajectory analysis, and systematic VLA evaluation in simulation prior to real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 AeroManip-VLA，一个面向空中视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的可扩展基准，用于在仿真中自动生成空中操作数据并系统评估策略。
AI.motivation: 空中机械臂可将操作能力拓展到地面机器人难以到达的三维空间，但将 VLA 模型迁移到空中机器人面临操作与飞行紧耦合、观测持续变化、安全关键交互等挑战；同时在真实空中平台上采集演示与评估策略成本高、难扩展、难重复。
AI.method: AeroManip-VLA 提供 GPU 加速仿真框架，支持大规模并行环境下的负载感知底层飞行与操作控制；结合可复用强化学习策略与专家任务规则，在多样物体、环境和随机初始条件下自动生成无需人工遥操作的演示数据，覆盖抓取、放置等基础技能以及需要导航与操作的长时程任务；引入自动事件标注和轨迹分类以过滤演示，并评估多种模仿学习和 VLA 基线。
AI.result: 能够生成可扩展的空中操作数据，并对任务进度、行为结果和安全相关失败进行细粒度分析；对多种模仿学习与 VLA 基线的评估揭示了其性能特征和失败模式。
AI.conclusion: AeroManip-VLA 支持可扩展的空中操作数据生成、结构化轨迹分析，并可在真实部署前于仿真中系统评估 VLA 模型。

title: Track-and-Complete: Learning Humanoid Skills from a Single Failed Human Video
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Project website: https://tracc-humanoid.github.io
summary: Learning humanoid skills from videos typically requires a successful human demonstration, which often demands custom data collection. Although failures have traditionally been treated only as negative examples in robot learning, they can still reveal a usable trajectory prefix before the task fails, as well as the intended outcome. To leverage this information from a failed-attempt video, we propose TRACC, a pipeline that imitates the useful portion of the motion trajectory and then completes the task based on the inferred task outcome. The usable motion prefix serves as prior knowledge until the failure occurs, after which the task-completion reward guides the policy to learn the intended task goal without requiring a successful task trajectory. We evaluate our method on six in-the-wild failed human tasks from the Oops! dataset. Our experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach for learning from failed attempts when no successful demonstration is available. Thus, these findings establish failed human videos as a viable source of supervision for humanoid skill learning.

AI.tldr: 提出TRACC，一种利用失败人类视频学习人形机器人技能的流程：模仿失败前可用的运动前缀，并根据推断的任务结果完成任务目标。
AI.motivation: 从视频学习人形技能通常需要成功的人类演示和专门数据采集；而失败视频虽常仅被当作负样本，却仍包含失败前可用的轨迹前缀和预期任务结果信息。
AI.method: TRACC先模仿失败动作中可用的运动轨迹部分，将其作为失败发生前的先验知识；随后根据推断出的任务结果，利用任务完成奖励引导策略学习预期任务目标，无需成功演示轨迹。
AI.result: 在Oops!数据集中的六个真实失败人类任务上评估，结果表明该方法在无成功演示时仍能有效从失败尝试中学习。
AI.conclusion: 失败人类视频可作为人形技能学习的可行监督来源。

title: DeepRewind: Predicting and Repairing Premature Commitments in Deep Research Agents
summary: Deep-research agents conduct long-horizon investigations through iterative search, evidence evaluation, belief revision, and synthesis. However, they may commit to claims before sufficient evidence is available, causing later reasoning to reinforce an incorrect interpretation. We introduce DeepRewind, an additive control layer for reversible deep research that represents the agent's evolving epistemic state as a typed graph of sources, evidence, claims, hypotheses, assumptions, commitments, plans, and drafts. Before accepting an intermediate conclusion, a prompt-based world model predicts its impact and estimates reversibility based on hypothesis narrowing, information loss, recovery cost, and contradiction-trigger coverage. A binary controller blocks risky commitments, while a consistency monitor performs dependency-aware rollback when later evidence invalidates them. Across DRBench and LiveDRBench, DeepRewind improves insight recall by 3.6 percentage points and reduces premature commitments by 59.1% relative to Open Deep Research.

AI.tldr: DeepRewind 是一种用于可逆深度研究的附加控制层，将智能体不断演化的认知状态表示为类型化图，并通过预测承诺风险与依赖感知回滚来减少过早承诺、提升洞见召回。
AI.motivation: 深度研究智能体在长周期迭代搜索与推理中，可能在证据不足时过早接受结论，导致后续推理不断强化错误解释。
AI.method: 将来源、证据、主张、假设、前提、承诺、计划和草稿建模为类型化图；用基于提示的世界模型预测中间结论的影响与可逆性，考虑假设收窄、信息损失、恢复成本和矛盾触发覆盖；二元控制器阻止高风险承诺，一致性监视器在后续证据推翻时执行依赖感知回滚。
AI.result: 在 DRBench 和 LiveDRBench 上，相比 Open Deep Research，DeepRewind 将洞见召回提高 3.6 个百分点，并将过早承诺减少 59.1%。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模认知状态并引入可逆控制与回滚机制，可以有效缓解深度研究中的过早承诺问题，提升长期研究的可靠性。

title: Support-Set Target Leakage in Relational Foundation Models during In-Context Learning: Model Dependence and Evaluation Reliability
summary: Relational in-context learning (ICL) uses labeled support examples and their linked relational context to predict labels for new queries. This creates a failure mode when target-derived features are present in the support context but unavailable for the query. We study this setting as support-set target leakage. We construct 20 controlled target-derived features that vary in signal fidelity, representation, semantic transparency, coverage, and zero-, one-, and two-hop relational placement, and evaluate them across 13 RelBench tasks and five relational ICL configurations that vary the ICL head, message-passing depth, pretraining cohort, or relational encoder architecture. We evaluate matched 0-hop, 1-hop, and 2-hop leakage settings, together with a Full leakage condition containing all 20 leaker columns. Within the tested configurations, target-table (0-hop) and Full leakage produce the largest aggregate deviations from clean evaluation, while higher-hop effects are often weaker, consistent with differences in effective exposure associated with temporal reachability, sampling, and aggregation fidelity. Leakage effects are strongly task- and model-dependent and can reverse relative conclusions between model variants even when aggregate changes are small. For leaker detection, we compare an Integrated Gradients (IG)-based screening method with mutual information (MI) and leave-one-column-out (LOCO) on a common Baseline subset. Ranking quality is strongest in the high-impact 0-hop and Full leakage conditions, but detector-based removal does not consistently restore the clean evaluation. A four-task rel-salt case study further shows the same evaluation concern with native-schema leakage candidates from the original relational schema. These results identify the support/query information boundary as an important component of reliable relational ICL evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究关系型上下文学习中的支持集目标泄漏问题，构建20个受控目标衍生特征，在13个RelBench任务和5种关系型ICL配置上评估0/1/2跳及全泄漏，发现泄漏影响强烈依赖任务与模型，且检测后移除不能稳定恢复干净评估。
AI.motivation: 关系型ICL利用带标签支持样本及其关系上下文预测新查询，但当支持上下文中存在目标衍生特征而查询中不可用时，会产生支持集目标泄漏，影响评估可靠性。
AI.method: 构建20个在信号保真度、表示、语义透明度、覆盖度和0/1/2跳关系位置上变化的目标衍生特征；在13个RelBench任务和5种ICL配置（改变ICL头、消息传递深度、预训练队列或关系编码器架构）上评估匹配的0/1/2跳泄漏及包含全部20列的Full泄漏；比较基于Integrated Gradients的筛选与互信息、留一列法（LOCO）的泄漏检测，并进行四任务rel-salt案例研究。
AI.result: 0跳（目标表）和Full泄漏导致最大的整体评估偏差，更高跳效应通常较弱；泄漏效应强烈依赖任务和模型，即使整体变化小也可能逆转模型变体间的相对结论；检测排序在0跳和Full泄漏下最佳，但基于检测的移除不能一致地恢复干净评估；rel-salt案例研究显示原始关系模式中的原生模式泄漏候选也存在同样问题。
AI.conclusion: 支持/查询信息边界是可靠关系型ICL评估的重要组成部分，需在评估中显式处理目标泄漏。

title: The Safety Operator: Modulating the Expression of Safety Instructions via Spectral Optimization
summary: Context tokens in a transformer-based language model can be absorbed into the model's weights as a multiplicative operator. We study this operator in the setting of safety instructions and show that influencing its dominant eigenvalue modulates how strongly the instruction shapes generation. We derive a Contrastive Safety Loss with a suppression weight that controls the tradeoff between emphasizing the safety instruction on harmful queries while suppressing it on harmless queries. Varying the suppression weight maps a relationship between the attack success and the over-refusal rates, supporting the hypothesis that the operator's eigenvalue acts as a continuous dial for the instruction's influence. Moreover, this relationship holds relatively independently of how the Safety Loss is parameterized, yielding Pareto-improved safety instructions for appropriate values of suppression weight.

AI.tldr: 研究 Transformer 上下文令牌被吸收为乘性算子，在安全指令场景下其主特征值可连续调节指令影响力；提出对比安全损失与抑制权重，权衡有害查询上强化安全指令与无害查询上抑制安全指令，从而改善安全性与过度拒答的权衡。
AI.motivation: 理解上下文指令如何被模型权重吸收并影响生成，尤其是安全指令强度如何被调节；同时缓解安全对齐中攻击成功率与过度拒答率之间的权衡问题。
AI.method: 将上下文令牌视为乘性算子并分析其主特征值；在安全指令设置下设计 Contrastive Safety Loss，引入抑制权重控制有害查询上强调安全指令、无害查询上抑制安全指令的权衡；调节该权重并比较不同 Safety Loss 参数化。
AI.result: 抑制权重的变化可映射出攻击成功率与过度拒答率之间的关系；该关系在不同 Safety Loss 参数化下相对稳定，支持主特征值作为指令影响力的连续调节器；在合适的抑制权重下可获得 Pareto 改进的安全指令。
AI.conclusion: 乘性算子的主特征值可作为控制安全指令影响力的连续旋钮；通过对比安全损失和抑制权重，可在降低过度拒答的同时提升安全性，为安全指令优化提供了新视角。

title: VLM4Cluster: Benchmarking Deep Clustering In the Era of Vision-Language Pre-training
summary: Vision-language pre-training has reshaped image clustering, giving rise to language-assisted image clustering (LaIC), which leverages textual semantics to complement visual representations. Despite the rapid proliferation of LaIC methods, it remains unclear how much LaIC has actually advanced image clustering, as existing studies generally suffer from major limitations, including inconsistent experimental settings, inadequate dataset selection, and limited evaluation dimensions. To address this gap, we introduce VLM4Cluster, a comprehensive benchmark for image clustering in the era of pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs). VLM4Cluster implements 17 representative methods spanning classical, deep, and language-assisted image clustering, and evaluates them on 20 datasets covering classical, challenging, fine-grained, large-scale, and out-of-distribution settings. Beyond effectiveness, VLM4Cluster systematically investigates image clustering along three complementary dimensions: robustness to adversarial perturbations, generalization under distribution shifts, and computational efficiency. Our study shows that LaIC substantially advances the clustering performance frontier on many semantically demanding benchmarks, generally exhibits stronger generalization under distribution shifts, and achieves a more favorable effectiveness-efficiency trade-off. However, its gains become less consistent on large-scale and fine-grained datasets, while language assistance does not systematically reduce sensitivity to adversarial perturbations. VLM4Cluster is released at https://github.com/YuanweiHuu/VLM4Cluster.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了VLM4Cluster，一个在预训练视觉-语言模型时代用于图像聚类的综合基准，涵盖17种方法和20个数据集，从有效性、鲁棒性、泛化和效率四个维度评估语言辅助图像聚类（LaIC）。
AI.motivation: 语言辅助图像聚类（LaIC）方法迅速增多，但现有研究存在实验设置不一致、数据集选择不足、评估维度有限等问题，导致不清楚LaIC实际进展如何。
AI.method: 构建VLM4Cluster基准，包含17种代表性方法（经典、深度和语言辅助图像聚类），在20个数据集（经典、挑战、细粒度、大规模和分布外）上评估；除有效性外，还系统研究对抗扰动鲁棒性、分布偏移泛化和计算效率。
AI.result: LaIC在语义要求高的基准上显著提升聚类性能，在分布偏移下泛化更强，并实现更优的有效性-效率权衡；但在大规模和细粒度数据集上增益不一致，且语言辅助并未系统降低对对抗扰动的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: VLM4Cluster为LaIC提供了全面评估，揭示其优势与局限，基准已在https://github.com/YuanweiHuu/VLM4Cluster开源。

title: FocusVTC: Efficient and High-Performance Visual Text Compression with Adaptive Resolution
