summary: Long-context reasoning in large language models incurs substantial computation and memory costs. Visual text compression (VTC) reduces input length by rendering text as images, but fixed-resolution rendering creates a compression-performance trade-off: low DPI saves tokens at the expense of legibility, whereas high DPI spends tokens on irrelevant content. We introduce FocusVTC, which breaks this trade-off through adaptive resolution while preserving general multimodal capabilities. It combines compressed low-DPI global views with selective region enhancement, integrating enhanced views into ongoing reasoning. We construct 29.4K high-quality Reasoning-Evidence Localization (REL) chain-of-thought examples (REL-CoT) that link reasoning traces to page indices and bounding boxes. Multi-resolution REL supervised fine-tuning (REL-SFT) teaches the model to localize relevant regions, and Group Relative Policy Optimization learns when to enhance resolution and how to use the resulting observations, without a separate continual-pretraining stage. At 72 DPI on RULER v1, FocusVTC scores 87.4 at $2.9\times$ input compression, including tool observations, versus 57.5 for Glyph at $3.0\times$ input compression. It surpasses its text-input backbone on LongBench (56.40 versus 55.86), improves the MRCR macro-average by 13.91 points, and achieves a 51.19 macro-average on VTCBench. The MRCR latency evaluation also shows a $2.79\times$ online end-to-end speedup over Text. General multimodal capabilities are preserved, with MMMU increasing from 65.12 to 66.73 and MME from 2424.02 to 2457.62.

AI.tldr: 提出 FocusVTC，通过自适应分辨率视觉文本压缩，在降低长上下文推理成本的同时避免固定分辨率下的压缩-性能权衡，并保持通用多模态能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型长上下文推理的计算与内存开销很大；视觉文本压缩虽能缩短输入，但固定分辨率渲染存在低 DPI 节省 token 却牺牲可读性、高 DPI 浪费 token 在无关内容上的矛盾。
AI.method: FocusVTC 结合低 DPI 全局压缩视图与选择性区域增强，将增强视图融入推理过程；构建 29.4K 高质量 Reasoning-Evidence Localization 思维链数据 REL-CoT，关联推理轨迹与页码和边界框；采用多分辨率 REL 监督微调，并用 Group Relative Policy Optimization 学习何时增强分辨率及如何利用观测，无需单独持续预训练阶段。
AI.result: 在 RULER v1 的 72 DPI 下，FocusVTC 在 2.9 倍输入压缩率下得分 87.4，而 Glyph 在 3.0 倍压缩率下为 57.5；LongBench 上 56.40 超过文本输入骨干的 55.86；MRCR 宏平均提升 13.91 分；VTCBench 宏平均达 51.19；MRCR 延迟评估显示相对纯文本有 2.79 倍在线端到端加速；通用多模态能力保持，MMMU 从 65.12 提升至 66.73，MME 从 2424.02 提升至 2457.62。
AI.conclusion: FocusVTC 通过自适应分辨率和选择性区域增强打破了视觉文本压缩的性能-压缩权衡，在多种长上下文基准上优于现有方法，并保持甚至提升通用多模态能力。

title: Training LLMs to Verbalize Evaluation Awareness
summary: Evaluation awareness (EA) can cause large language models (LLMs) to behave differently during audits than in deployment, yet measuring and accounting for EA remains challenging. We introduce verbalization training (VT), a method for making LLMs less reticent about verbalizing evaluation awareness while avoiding to supervise the latent belief itself. VT uses a model's spontaneous verbalizations as evidence that awareness is present and truncates each rollout immediately before the verbalization, producing training prefixes at which the model is presumed to be aware. The model is then trained with an RL objective designed to increase verbalization in a calibrated way. Across Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Kimi K2.6, and Inkling, VT increases verbalized EA by 2.4-2.9 times and transfers to held-out agentic settings, while measured latent EA and behavior remain largely stable. In a causal experiment, we independently implant meta-knowledge about evaluations through synthetic-document fine-tuning and show that VT-induced verbalizations reflect the richer knowledge acquired by the model.

AI.tldr: 论文提出言语化训练（VT），在不直接监督潜在评估意识（EA）信念的情况下，让LLM更愿意表达EA；在多个模型上将言语化EA提升2.4–2.9倍，并可迁移到代理场景，同时潜在EA与行为基本稳定。
AI.motivation: 评估意识会使LLM在审计与部署时表现不同，但测量和应对EA仍很困难；研究希望在不直接操纵潜在信念的前提下，提高模型对EA的言语化程度。
AI.method: VT利用模型自发的言语化作为EA存在的证据，在言语化发生前截断rollout以构造训练前缀，并认为此时模型已具有意识；随后用RL目标以校准方式增加言语化。另通过合成文档微调植入评估元知识，进行因果实验。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、Kimi K2.6和Inkling上，VT使言语化EA提高2.4–2.9倍，并迁移到留出的代理设置；测得的潜在EA和行为基本稳定。因果实验显示，VT诱导的言语化反映了模型通过微调获得的更丰富知识。
AI.conclusion: VT能够校准地提升评估意识的言语化，而不显著改变潜在评估意识或行为，并可用于研究模型对评估相关知识的获取与表达。

title: Bits Under ZK-LLM: Evaluating Zero-Knowledge-Friendly Quantization for Verifiable Private LLM Inference
summary: Zero-knowledge proofs are emerging as a promising approach for enabling private, verifiable LLM governance and auditing, where regulators, users, and auditors need to verify claims about training-data usage or LLM inference-time behavior, while model providers must protect proprietary model parameters. However, despite the growing interest in ZK-LLMs, the understanding of ZK-friendly quantization remains limited. This gap matters because in the ZK setting, quantization directly shapes the arithmetic structure, constraint complexity, and proving cost of ZK inference. ZK protocols operate over finite fields and incur costs that depend heavily on the number and type of arithmetic operations, nonlinearities, and lookup constraints. Understanding ZK-friendly quantization is therefore essential for making ZK-LLMs practical. In this work, we present the first systematic study of ZK-friendly quantization for LLMs. We first formalize the definition of ZK-friendly quantization, capturing the properties required for ZK proof generation. We then evaluate nine language models, including Qwen2.5-14B and the mixture-of-experts model Qwen3-30B-A3B, across a broad design space of weight, activation, and nonlinear lookup table precision. Our results show that activation precision is substantially more sensitive than weight precision, while nonlinear lookup approximations can become the dominant source of utility degradation. Also, we identify RMSNorm inverse-square-root lookups as a recurring bottleneck in several large models and recover near-baseline utility by selectively increasing precision only at the bottleneck. Finally, we show that reducing bit-width or lookup-table size does not necessarily yield proportional end-to-end proving savings, showing that conventional low-bit quantization heuristics do not directly translate to ZK proving efficiency and motivating operator-aware precision selection.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究面向LLM的ZK友好量化，形式化其定义，并在9个模型（含Qwen2.5-14B与Qwen3-30B-A3B）上评估权重、激活和非线性查找表精度的设计空间。结果表明激活精度比权重精度更敏感，非线性查找近似可能成为主要效用退化来源，RMSNorm反平方根查找是常见瓶颈，且降低位宽或查找表大小未必带来成比例的证明开销节省。
AI.motivation: ZK-LLM可用于私有、可验证的LLM治理与审计，但ZK推理在有限域上运行，证明成本高度依赖算术操作、非线性和查找约束。量化会直接改变这些结构，而当前对ZK友好量化的理解不足，阻碍ZK-LLM走向实用。
AI.method: 形式化定义ZK友好量化及其所需性质；在广泛的权重、激活和非线性查找表精度设计空间中，评估9个语言模型，包括Qwen2.5-14B和混合专家模型Qwen3-30B-A3B；分析不同精度选择对模型效用与ZK证明成本的影响，并识别关键瓶颈。
AI.result: 激活精度对效用影响显著强于权重精度；非线性查找近似可能成为效用退化的主导因素；RMSNorm反平方根查找在多个大模型中反复成为瓶颈，仅对瓶颈选择性提高精度可恢复接近基线的效用；降低位宽或查找表大小不一定带来成比例的端到端证明节省，传统低比特量化启发不能直接转化为ZK证明效率。
AI.conclusion: ZK-LLM的量化需要采用算子感知的精度选择，而非简单沿用低比特量化策略；应重点关注激活精度、非线性查找近似和瓶颈算子，在保持模型效用的同时优化ZK证明成本。

title: Calibrated to Whom? Persona and Language Effects on Cultural Values in JEV
summary: Decision-only language models return a probability for every answer option instead of generating text, which makes them attractive as survey respondents and as judges. We audit the cultural values of one such model, TypeSafe's JEV, with the Values Survey Module 2013. We asked it the 24 items as 12 matched Saudi and 12 matched American personas and without a persona, in English and Arabic, under eight ways of formulating the request (288,000 answers). JEV's answers were highly repeatable (ICC 0.997), and without a persona they resembled those of its own American personas. When the persona was Saudi rather than American, the answers moved in the direction of the human Saudi-US difference, reproducing 87% of its size in English but 62% in Arabic, with long-term orientation reversed. A language cross shows that the smaller difference in Arabic comes from the language of the items, not from the language of the persona description. Age shifted the profiles about as much as nationality, gender shifted them more for Saudi than for American personas, and JEV was less confident in Arabic and for Saudi personas. These patterns held in every request design, although the model never generates text.

AI.tldr: 该研究审计了决策型语言模型 TypeSafe JEV 的文化价值观。它不生成文本，而是为选项返回概率。研究者用 Values Survey Module 2013 的 24 个题项，以沙特和美国匹配人设及无人设、英语和阿拉伯语、8 种请求表述进行测试，共获得 288,000 个答案。
AI.motivation: 决策型语言模型可作为调查受访者或评判者，因此需要了解其是否、以及在多大程度上会表现出文化与语言偏向。
AI.method: 使用 Values Survey Module 2013 的 24 个题项，设置 12 个匹配的沙特人设和 12 个匹配的美国人设，并加入无人设条件；以英语和阿拉伯语、8 种请求表述进行提问，收集 288,000 个模型答案，分析其文化价值观维度、重复性、人设效应、语言效应、年龄与性别效应及置信度。
AI.result: JEV 答案高度可重复（ICC 0.997）。无人设时，其答案接近其美国人设。沙特人设相比美国人设时，答案朝人类沙特-美国差异方向移动：英语中复现了该差异规模的 87%，阿拉伯语中为 62%，且长期取向出现反转。语言交叉显示，阿拉伯语中差异较小主要来自题项语言，而非人设描述语言。年龄对价值观剖面的影响约与国籍相当；性别对沙特人设的影响大于美国人设。JEV 在阿拉伯语和沙特人设下置信度较低。这些模式在每种请求设计下均成立，尽管模型从不生成文本。
AI.conclusion: 决策型语言模型即使不生成文本，也能系统性地反映人设、语言和人口属性相关的文化价值观模式；但其文化模拟存在语言差异、维度反转和置信度变化，说明用于调查或评判时需谨慎解释。

title: Rethinking Reasoning Paths as Phase-Structured Trajectories
summary: Large language models often improve problem-solving performance by generating multi-step reasoning paths, yet how to analyze the hidden states along these paths remains unclear. Existing approaches typically assign each intermediate state the final-answer correctness label and train probes across heterogeneous questions. We argue that this protocol obscures reasoning dynamics in two ways: (1) correctness prediction can exploit question-level variation rather than path quality, and (2) states aligned by absolute step indices may correspond to different functional phases of reasoning. In this work, we propose to view reasoning paths as phase-structured trajectories within fixed questions. We instantiate this view as PAIR, short for Phase-Aligned Intra-question Reasoning. PAIR samples multiple trajectories for each question, maps variable-length paths into shared relative phases based on normalized trajectory progress, and compares successful and unsuccessful trajectories only within the same question and phase. This yields phase-specific path-quality directions that better isolate path-quality signals from question-level variation. Empirically, we find that standard across-question correctness probes lose much of their predictive power under within-question evaluation, suggesting that these probes partly rely on question-level information. PAIR improves within-question trajectory ranking and Best-of-N trajectory selection across models and benchmarks. Phase-wise steering further shows that the learned directions can change generation outcomes, providing causal evidence that they capture trajectory-relevant information.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PAIR方法，将推理路径视为固定问题内的阶段结构化轨迹，通过归一化轨迹进度对齐相对阶段，并在同一问题同一阶段内比较成功与失败轨迹，从而分离路径质量信号与问题级变异。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将最终答案正确性标签赋予每个中间状态并跨异质问题训练探针，这掩盖了推理动态：一是正确性预测可能利用问题级变异而非路径质量，二是按绝对步索引对齐的状态可能对应不同的推理功能阶段。
AI.method: PAIR（Phase-Aligned Intra-question Reasoning）：对每个问题采样多条轨迹，基于归一化轨迹进度将变长路径映射到共享的相对阶段，仅在同一问题同一阶段内比较成功与失败轨迹，得到阶段特定的路径质量方向。
AI.result: 标准跨问题正确性探针在问题内评估下预测力大幅下降；PAIR在多个模型和基准上提升了问题内轨迹排序和Best-of-N轨迹选择；阶段引导能改变生成结果，提供因果证据。
AI.conclusion: PAIR能更有效地隔离路径质量信号，提升轨迹评估与选择，并表明所学方向捕获了与轨迹相关的因果信息。

title: Beyond Token Importance: Preserving Spatial Scaffolds for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference
summary: Existing VLA pruning strategies primarily select individual visual tokens according to task-level semantic relevance, while overlooking the spatial information required for robotic manipulation. To examine this limitation, we construct a simple Stride baseline that uniformly samples tokens along the flattened one-dimensional visual sequence, representing a purely geometric pruning strategy. Surprisingly, Stride outperforms semantic pruning and random pruning at certain pruning ratios, but collapses when the token budget is only slightly reduced. We characterize this phenomenon through the spatial coverage radius, defined as the largest spatial blind spot induced by the retained token set after pruning. Our analysis reveals a strong correlation between the spatial structure of retained tokens and task success, suggesting that reliable VLA pruning requires preserving not only task-relevant tokens but also the spatial scaffold of the scene. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose GeoScaffold, a training-free visual token pruning method that partitions each image into spatial regions, allocates inter-region token budgets using task-relevance weights, and selects intra-region scaffold tokens via farthest point sampling to reduce the local coverage radius. On pi 0.5 and LIBERO, GeoScaffold retains only 20% of visual tokens while preserving a 93.2% average success rate, and achieves a 1.78 times prefill speedup over the unpruned baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文发现现有VLA模型视觉token剪枝方法忽视空间信息，提出基于空间覆盖半径的几何剪枝基线Stride，并据此设计免训练剪枝方法GeoScaffold，在仅保留20%视觉token时仍保持93.2%成功率并实现1.78倍预填充加速。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA剪枝策略主要依据任务级语义相关性选择单个视觉token，忽略了机器人操作所需的空间信息，导致剪枝后空间盲区过大、任务失败。
AI.method: 构建均匀采样的Stride几何剪枝基线，提出空间覆盖半径指标量化剪枝后最大空间盲区；基于该诊断提出GeoScaffold：将图像划分为空间区域，按任务相关性权重分配区域间token预算，并使用最远点采样在区域内选择脚手架token以降低局部覆盖半径，整个过程无需训练。
AI.result: 在pi 0.5和LIBERO上，GeoScaffold仅保留20%视觉token即可维持93.2%的平均成功率，相比未剪枝基线实现1.78倍的预填充加速。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的VLA剪枝不仅需要保留任务相关token，还必须保留场景的空间脚手架，空间结构对任务成功至关重要。

title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind: Systematically Erasing LLM's Memories
summary:
We consider persistent LLMs that accumulate memories of their interactions with a user over time. Such LLMs maintain memories using external storage, which they can query to overcome the limitations of a fixed context window. Such systems have numerous practical applications, as they can draw on all past interactions when responding to user queries.
  In this paper, we ask whether LLMs can forget information shared with them upon a user's request. We find that current LLMs fail to delete such information---even when they claim to have forgotten it and even when operating with a limited context. To this end, we consider a new direction of study: Deletion of LLM Memories.
  We show that naively removing messages that match a user's deletion request is insufficient, since conversations naturally introduce message dependencies that cause information to persist. To correctly handle deletion requests, we propose the DeLLM framework. It dynamically constructs relevant context for each LLM query and maintains a provenance graph of messages to determine which ones must be removed during deletion. Our experiments show that DeLLM achieves a high deletion rate while maintaining utility.

AI.tldr: 本文研究持久化LLM记忆的删除问题，指出现有模型即使用户要求也可能无法真正遗忘信息，并提出DeLLM框架以在删除请求下有效移除相关记忆同时保持实用性。
AI.motivation: 持久化LLM可通过外部存储积累并查询历史交互记忆，但用户可能要求删除某些信息；现有LLM即使声称已忘记，实际仍可能保留信息，因此需要研究LLM记忆删除这一新方向。
AI.method: 作者提出DeLLM框架：针对每个LLM查询动态构建相关上下文，并维护消息的来源/溯源图，以判断删除请求下哪些消息及依赖消息必须被移除。
AI.result: 实验表明，简单删除与用户请求匹配的消息并不足够，因为对话中的消息依赖会导致信息继续存留；DeLLM在保持实用性的同时实现了较高的删除率。
AI.conclusion: LLM记忆删除不能只靠表面删除匹配消息，需要处理消息依赖；DeLLM为正确执行删除请求提供了有效方案。

title: ComManip: Overfitting Manipulation Policies to Comfortable Regions
summary: Training robot manipulation policies relies on costly robot demonstrations, making large-scale data collection impractical. Meanwhile, to improve policy generalization, existing approaches seek greater diversity in visual observations by varying object placements, viewpoints, and robot configurations during data collection. However, under a limited demonstration budget, this strategy forces the policy to model diverse visual observations, providing insufficient supervision to learn reliable observation-action correspondences under similar local conditions. Our study reveals that policies trained under this strategy achieve lower task success rates than those trained within a compact, visually and kinematically stable region. We refer to these stable regions as comfortable manipulation regions. To exploit this finding, we propose ComManip, a learning paradigm that specializes manipulation policies to comfortable manipulation regions. During inference, ComManip repositions the mobile base until the detected target center enters the familiar image-space range estimated from comfortable-region demonstrations. It then executes the same manipulation policy, enabling effective manipulation across diverse target locations. We conduct extensive experiments across multiple manipulation tasks, demonstration budgets, and policy families including ACT, $π_{0.5}$, RDT, OpenVLA-OFT, and SmolVLA. The results demonstrate that ComManip improves task success by roughly 20 percentage points or more across different policy architectures in large workspaces under limited demonstration budgets, suggesting that specializing manipulation policies to comfortable regions provides a more data-efficient learning paradigm for manipulation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ComManip 学习范式，将操作策略专精于视觉和运动学稳定的"舒适操作区域"，推理时通过调整移动基座使目标进入熟悉图像空间范围，从而在有限演示预算下显著提升多种策略架构的任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 训练机器人操作策略依赖昂贵演示数据，大规模采集不现实。现有方法通过增加物体位置、视角和机器人构型多样性来提升泛化，但在有限演示预算下，这迫使策略建模多样视觉观测，对相似局部条件下的观测-动作对应监督不足。研究发现，这种策略的成功率低于在紧凑、视觉和运动学稳定区域训练的策略，即"舒适操作区域"。
AI.method: 提出 ComManip 学习范式，将操作策略专精于舒适操作区域。推理时，ComManip 重定位移动基座，直到检测到的目标中心进入从舒适区域演示估计的熟悉图像空间范围，然后执行同一操作策略，从而在多样目标位置实现有效操作。
AI.result: 在多种操作任务、演示预算和策略家族（ACT、π0.5、RDT、OpenVLA-OFT、SmolVLA）上进行大量实验。结果表明，在大工作空间和有限演示预算下，ComManip 在不同策略架构上提升任务成功率约20个百分点或更多。
AI.conclusion: 将操作策略专精于舒适区域提供了一种更数据高效的操作学习范式，表明在有限演示预算下，专精化比追求视觉多样性更有效。

title: Going Beyond State-Reaching: Learning Abstractions for Intrinsically Motivated Option Discovery
summary: Temporal abstraction via options can improve exploration in large environments. However, existing option discovery algorithms find subgoals that target all aspects of the state simultaneously. This state-reaching approach produces options that only apply in narrow regions of the state-space, eventually causing an explosion in the number of options that overwhelms the agent, and impedes progress on its primary task of reward maximization. We introduce an algorithm that instead identifies a small, relevant subset of features for each subgoal, yielding options that generalize broadly and accelerate exploration. Our approach learns abstract, transferrable options and achieves rapid exploration in three sparse-reward, image-based domains, including the Atari game MontezumasRevenge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种通过为每个子目标选择少量相关特征来发现选项（options）的算法，以改善稀疏奖励大环境中的探索效率。
AI.motivation: 现有选项发现算法通常同时针对状态的所有方面寻找子目标，导致选项仅适用于狭窄状态区域，最终引发选项数量爆炸，并阻碍智能体主任务（奖励最大化）的进展。
AI.method: 算法为每个子目标识别一个小型且相关的特征子集，而不是覆盖全部状态维度，从而学习抽象、可迁移的选项，使其泛化更广并加速探索。
AI.result: 在三个稀疏奖励、基于图像的域中实现了快速探索，包括 Atari 游戏 Montezuma's Revenge。
AI.conclusion: 聚焦相关特征可生成泛化性更强的选项，缓解选项爆炸问题，并在稀疏奖励环境中显著提升探索效率。

title: Not Every Correction Helps: Gain-Guided Continual Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Continual test-time adaptation (CTTA) adapts a source model to an unlabeled test stream whose distribution may change over time. Existing TTA methods often assess prediction reliability using confidence or entropy, which primarily reflect the model's self-certainty for the current sample. In CTTA, accumulated target observations can provide complementary evidence for correcting the source prediction, but this history may become misaligned as the target distribution changes. The key question is therefore not how much the correction differs from the source prediction, but whether and how strongly it should be applied. This paper proposes Gain-Aware INtervention (GAIN), a backpropagation-free CTTA framework guided by a simple principle: history proposes, gain decides. GAIN maintains compact target statistics to form a correction proposal and a posterior-predictive evaluator that accounts for estimation uncertainty. The resulting source-relative gain estimates the proposal's benefit and determines a sample-specific intervention strength along a continuous path through efficient one-dimensional optimization. Gain-controlled predictions then update the target statistics online, limiting the propagation of unreliable corrections, all without backpropagation, sample storage, or replay. Across five benchmarks, our method achieves strong predictive performance, with favorable accuracy--calibration--efficiency trade-offs in continual adaptation. On ImageNet-C, for example, GAIN achieves 61.9% accuracy with near-source calibration. It remains stable under diverse and challenging continual shifts while running 15.9x faster than a representative optimization-based CTTA baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文提出GAIN，一种无反向传播的持续测试时自适应框架，通过“历史提出修正、增益决定强度”的原则，在分布持续变化的测试流中实现稳定且高效的模型自适应。
AI.motivation: 现有持续测试时自适应方法常用置信度或熵评估预测可靠性，但这主要反映模型对当前样本的自我确定性。累积的目标域观测可提供互补证据来修正源预测，然而目标分布变化会使历史信息失配。关键问题不是修正量与源预测差多少，而是是否应应用修正以及应用多强。
AI.method: GAIN无需反向传播，维护紧凑的目标统计量以形成修正提议，并使用后验预测评估器考虑估计不确定性。通过源相对增益估计修正提议的收益，进而确定样本特定的干预强度，并沿连续路径进行高效一维优化。增益控制后的预测在线更新目标统计量，以限制不可靠修正的传播，且无需反向传播、样本存储或回放。
AI.result: 在五个基准上取得较强预测性能，并在持续自适应中表现出良好的准确率—校准—效率权衡。例如在ImageNet-C上，GAIN达到61.9%准确率且校准接近源模型，在多样且具挑战性的持续偏移下保持稳定，比代表性的基于优化的CTTA基线快15.9倍。
AI.conclusion: GAIN通过增益感知干预有效解决了持续测试时自适应中历史信息修正是否及如何应用的问题，在不依赖反向传播、样本存储和回放的情况下，实现了稳定、校准良好且高效的持续自适应。

title: You Only Reprogram Once: Rethinking Prolonged Training for Visual Reprogramming
summary: Visual reprogramming is a parameter-efficient method for adapting pretrained models, yet its training can remain computationally expensive: even with a frozen backbone, visual prompts are often optimized through the full model for hundreds of epochs. Before changing what the pretrained model sees, we ask whether we are fully using what it already tells us. We find that modeling the full source response can already yield strong downstream predictions without prompt optimization. Motivated by this observation, we introduce You Only Reprogram Once (YORO), which constructs a downstream predictor from the frozen response space in a single forward-only traversal. Its Bayesian Discriminant Mapping (BDM) derives a covariance-aware affine mapping from streaming class statistics, requiring no backpropagation, optimizer updates, or repeated visits to the training set. When further input adaptation helps, YORO-FP optionally refines the visual prompt for 20 epochs. BDM also extends naturally to CLIP by treating attribute-prompt similarities as source responses. Across three full-data settings, YORO improves average accuracy over the strongest prior gradient-free mapping by 18.4--24.4\%. On 16-shot CLIP, it raises the four-backbone average from 71.4\% to 77.2\%. YORO-FP provides further gains on selected tasks, while validation often retains the one-pass predictor. These results suggest a different default for visual reprogramming: read out the frozen response first, and optimize the input only when needed.

AI.tldr: 提出YORO，仅通过一次前向遍历从冻结响应空间构建下游预测器，无需反向传播或优化器更新，并可选地用YORO-FP微调视觉提示20轮；在多种设置下显著提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 视觉重编程虽参数高效，但训练仍可能计算昂贵：即使骨干冻结，视觉提示也常需通过完整模型优化数百轮。作者因此思考是否已充分利用预训练模型已有的响应信息。
AI.method: 先建模完整源响应以直接获得强下游预测；提出YORO，其贝叶斯判别映射BDM从流式类别统计中推导协方差感知的仿射映射，仅需单次前向遍历，无需反向传播、优化器更新或重复访问训练集。BDM还可扩展到CLIP，将属性提示相似度视为源响应。若输入适配仍有帮助，YORO-FP可选地优化视觉提示20轮。
AI.result: 在三个全数据设置中，YORO相较最强先前无梯度映射方法平均准确率提升18.4–24.4%；在16-shot CLIP上，将四个骨干的平均准确率从71.4%提升至77.2%。YORO-FP在部分任务上带来进一步增益，而验证常保留单次预测器。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明视觉重编程可采用不同默认策略：先读出冻结响应，仅在需要时优化输入。

title: All You Need Is Low Fidelity: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real of Learned Robotic Fish Control
comment: 8 pages, 10 figures, submitted to ICRA 2027. Liam Maloney and Simon Ramchandani contributed equally
summary: Complex tasks for underwater robots remain limited by the capabilities of their controllers. Learning a better one for a soft, underactuated robotic fish trades simulator cost against fidelity. We show that an intentionally low-fidelity simulator is enough: a stateless, quasi-steady fluid model with no wake and no added-mass history suffices to learn a \emph{general}, closed-loop controller that transfers to hardware without tuning. Our platform is a soft, single-motor, tendon-driven fish whose policy observes only what the hardware can measure. A staged pipeline grounds the simulator in two independent identifications, fixing the tail dynamics and a stateless fluid model; the policy then acts through a band-limited rhythmic trajectory generator rather than commanding the tail directly. Deployed unchanged in an outdoor pool, a single policy performs closed-loop target reaching, disturbance rejection, and out-of-distribution target acquisition and tracking. The transfer rests on the constraint rather than the fidelity: the generator cannot leave the band over which the fluid was identified. This raises the question of how much of the physics can reside in the controller rather than in the simulator.

AI.tldr: 本文研究软体、欠驱动机器鱼的控制问题，表明无需高保真仿真器：一个无状态、准稳态且不考虑尾流与附加质量历史的低 fidelity 流体模型，足以学习出可无调参迁移到硬件的通用闭环控制器。
AI.motivation: 复杂水下任务受限于机器人控制器能力；为软体欠驱动机器鱼学习更好控制器时，通常需要在仿真器计算成本与保真度之间权衡。作者希望验证低保真仿真是否足够实现 sim-to-real 迁移。
AI.method: 平台为软体、单电机、腱驱动的机器鱼；策略仅使用硬件可测量观测量。采用分阶段流程，通过两项独立辨识将仿真器落地：固定尾部动力学并建立无状态流体模型；策略不直接控制尾部，而是通过带限节律轨迹生成器输出动作。
AI.result: 同一策略未经改动部署在户外水池中，实现了闭环目标到达、扰动抑制，以及分布外目标获取与跟踪。迁移成功的关键在于约束而非仿真保真度：轨迹生成器无法超出流体模型被辨识的频带。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，控制器可以承担相当一部分物理约束与行为结构，从而降低对高保真仿真器的依赖；这引出“多少物理可放在控制器而非仿真器中”的问题。

title: Reliable Parallel Decoding in Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) can generate text efficiently by predicting multiple masked tokens in parallel, but predictions from the same forward pass are not necessarily reliable when committed together. We study when parallel commitment is reliable. Our diagnostics show that confidence alone does not determine a reliable commitment order: confident predictions near the end of the sequence can fix an answer before its supporting computations are established, and downstream predictions become less reliable as the uncertainty of their upstream context grows. At the same time, a single forward pass can already resolve several masked tokens, and predictions that remain stable across the final layers are more likely to be correct. Based on these findings, we propose Reliable Parallel Decoding (RPD), a training-free method that selects candidates by layerwise prediction stability and final confidence, and commits them under a cumulative entropy budget over their preceding masked positions. RPD defers predictions with uncertain upstream context while committing the remaining candidates in parallel, without relying on a fixed block schedule. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks on LLaDA and Dream, RPD achieves the highest decoding throughput among the evaluated methods while maintaining or improving accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）中并行提交多个预测的可靠性，提出无需训练的可靠并行解码方法 RPD，在数学推理和代码生成任务上兼顾吞吐量与准确率。
AI.motivation: MDLM 可通过一次前向并行预测多个掩码 token 来加速生成，但同一前向中的预测同时提交时未必可靠。作者发现仅凭置信度不能决定可靠的提交顺序：序列末尾的高置信预测可能过早固定答案，且上游上下文不确定性增大会降低下游预测可靠性。
AI.method: 提出 Reliable Parallel Decoding（RPD），一种无需训练的解码方法。它根据逐层预测稳定性与最终置信度筛选候选，并在其前置掩码位置上的累积熵预算约束下提交候选；对上游上下文不确定的预测进行延迟，其余候选并行提交，不依赖固定块调度。
AI.result: 在 LLaDA 和 Dream 上的数学推理与代码生成基准中，RPD 在所评估方法中取得最高解码吞吐量，同时保持或提升准确率。
AI.conclusion: 并行提交的可靠性不仅取决于置信度，还取决于预测稳定性与上游上下文不确定性；通过逐层稳定性和累积熵预算控制提交，可在不训练的情况下实现更可靠且高效的 MDLM 并行解码。

title: ReWorld-Track: A Recursive Event World Model for Language-Guided Multi-Camera Tracking
summary: Language-guided multi-camera tracking must preserve a target identity across unobserved gaps, where similar candidates and uncertain returns can make early associations unreliable. A wrong match can corrupt the history used to predict later observations and propagate identity errors across subsequent camera handoffs. We propose ReWorld-Track, a recursive event world model that carries association uncertainty into future predictions. Candidate matches and continued waiting define alternative target states, whose posterior probabilities are used to update a persistent recurrent belief. This representation preserves uncertainty about alternative trajectories through successive observations. This belief predicts the next camera, arrival time, and entry region, while appearance and language evidence guide association. By training across successive handoffs, the model learns to retain uncertainty that remains useful for later predictions and identity decisions. ReWorld-Track achieves HOTA scores of 65.19 on CityFlowV2 and 45.36 on MTMMC, with improved identity continuity across repeated handoffs. On MTMMC, its structured posterior update gains 0.50 HOTA points over a similarly sized generic updater and 0.94 points over fixed-moment soft association, raising next-camera accuracy from 86.03% to 87.41% and reducing median arrival-time error from 0.78 s to 0.71 s for subsequent target returns.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReWorld-Track，一种递归事件世界模型，用于语言引导的多摄像头目标跟踪，通过将关联不确定性纳入未来预测，提升跨摄像头切换中的身份连续性。
AI.motivation: 多摄像头跟踪中，目标在未观测间隙后重新出现时，相似候选和不确定返回会导致早期关联不可靠；错误匹配会污染历史并传播身份错误，因此需要在跟踪过程中保留并利用关联不确定性。
AI.method: 将候选匹配和继续等待视为备选目标状态，用其后验概率更新持续递归信念；该信念预测下一摄像头、到达时间和进入区域，并结合外观与语言证据进行关联；通过跨连续切换训练，使模型保留对后续预测和身份决策有用的不确定性。
AI.result: 在 CityFlowV2 上 HOTA 为 65.19，在 MTMMC 上为 45.36，并改善了重复切换中的身份连续性；在 MTMMC 上，结构化后验更新比同规模通用更新器高 0.50 HOTA，比固定时刻软关联高 0.94 HOTA，下一摄像头准确率从 86.03% 提升至 87.41%，后续目标返回的中位到达时间误差从 0.78 秒降至 0.71 秒。
AI.conclusion: ReWorld-Track 通过递归事件世界模型显式保留关联不确定性，能够提升多摄像头跟踪的预测准确性、身份连续性和跨摄像头切换性能。

title: FACT: Fidelity-Aware Construction of Articulated Twins
summary: Visually plausible articulated assets may still fail during contact interactions or exhibit inaccurate motion. We present FACT (Fidelity-Aware Construction of Articulated Twins), an agentic framework that progressively constructs articulated twins to improve geometry, contact, and dynamic fidelity. The agent drives an evidence--diagnosis--revision loop on a shared editable representation, selecting measurements and model edits using quantitative feedback, while numerical tools execute and validate the updates. It reconstructs editable articulated geometry from images through feature planning, targeted measurements, and diagnostic refinement. On this reference, it repairs collision proxies through task-aware local repartitioning before fidelity-constrained compression. Finally, it constructs response models from passive-response videos, using simulation residuals to guide model revision and constrained physical parameter fitting. Experiments show that FACT improves geometric reconstruction over baselines, enables more reliable interaction with simpler collision proxies, and better reproduces held-out physical responses than direct parameter inference.

AI.tldr: 提出 FACT 智能体框架，通过证据-诊断-修正循环逐步构建铰接资产孪生，以提升几何、接触和动态保真度。
AI.motivation: 视觉上合理的铰接资产在接触交互中仍可能失败或运动不准确，因此需要同时提升几何、碰撞与动力学保真度。
AI.method: FACT 在共享可编辑表示上运行证据-诊断-修正循环，智能体依据定量反馈选择测量与模型编辑，数值工具执行并验证更新；流程包括从图像重建可编辑铰接几何、任务感知局部重划分修复碰撞代理并进行保真约束压缩，以及利用被动响应视频和仿真残差构建响应模型并约束物理参数拟合。
AI.result: FACT 在几何重建上优于基线，能用更简单的碰撞代理实现更可靠交互，并比直接参数推断更好地复现留出的物理响应。
AI.conclusion: FACT 表明，通过智能体驱动的渐进构建与诊断修正，可以同时改善铰接资产的几何、接触和动态保真度。

title: Human-AI Collaboration: From Paradoxes to Patterns
comment: This is the author's version of the work. It is posted here for your personal use. Not for redistribution. The definitive Version of Record will be published in 33rd Conference on Pattern Languages of Programs (PLoP 2026)
summary: Evidence shows that humans and AI systems perform better together, by collaborating, than alone. This paper examines two key design dimensions of human-AI collaboration (autonomy and initiative) and explores the collaboration patterns that they generate. Documenting these patterns starts with identifying the underlying problems and solutions, followed by examining the internal tensions within the problems. The paper uses a paradox perspective to analyze those tensions. It describes a process for surfacing the tensions and mapping the underlying paradoxes. It also illustrates how the pattern descriptions can be derived from mapping these paradoxes. Finally, the paper documents four human-AI collaboration patterns: Instruction, Delegation, Assistance, and Co-creation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究人机协作的两个关键设计维度——自主性与主动性，并借助悖论视角分析其产生的协作模式。
AI.motivation: 已有证据表明，人类与AI系统协作时比单独工作表现更好，因此需要理解人机协作中自主性和主动性这两个设计维度及其形成的协作模式。
AI.method: 采用悖论视角，先识别底层问题与解决方案，再分析问题中的内在张力；描述了一个揭示张力并映射底层悖论的过程，并说明如何从悖论映射中推导出模式描述。
AI.result: 记录了四种人机协作模式：指令（Instruction）、委托（Delegation）、协助（Assistance）和共同创造（Co-creation）。
AI.conclusion: 通过自主性和主动性两个设计维度可以生成不同的人机协作模式，而悖论映射有助于系统描述这些模式。

title: Reprogramming Vision-Language Models via Structured Prompt Reparameterization
summary: Visual reprogramming adapts pretrained models to downstream tasks by modifying their input and output interfaces while keeping the backbone fixed. In vision-language models, existing methods mainly rely on intra-class prompt aggregation and do not explicitly model relationships among classes. However, fine-grained categories often exhibit highly overlapping attribute descriptions and strong inter-class correlation in the text embedding space, where discriminative cues lie in subtle low-variance components. We propose Reparameterized Inter-Class Visual Reprogramming (RVP), a structured framework that aggregates multiple text prompts within each class and applies residual correction across classes. We also show that CLIP-based visual reprogramming with input-independent linear output aggregation can be expressed as a linear mapping from frozen image embeddings to downstream logits, and use this view to design a structured reparameterization that models shared semantic components and class-specific differences. RVP uses only a single visual prompt and can be reparameterized at inference into a frozen backbone followed by a linear classifier, incurring nearly zero computational overhead. Across 11 few-shot classification benchmarks and four CLIP backbones, RVP consistently improves over prior visual reprogramming methods with comparable or better inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RVP（重参数化类间视觉重编程），通过类内多文本提示聚合与类间残差校正，在保持CLIP骨干冻结的情况下提升少样本视觉重编程性能，并可在推理时重参数化为冻结骨干加线性分类器，几乎不增加计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型中的视觉重编程方法主要依赖类内提示聚合，未显式建模类间关系；而细粒度类别在文本嵌入空间中常高度重叠且强相关，判别线索存在于细微的低方差成分中。
AI.method: 提出RVP框架：聚合每类多个文本提示，并进行跨类残差校正；从理论上将基于CLIP且输出聚合与输入无关的视觉重编程表示为从冻结图像嵌入到下游logits的线性映射；据此设计结构化重参数化，建模共享语义成分与类特定差异；仅使用单个视觉提示，推理时可重参数化为冻结骨干加线性分类器。
AI.result: 在11个少样本分类基准和4个CLIP骨干上，RVP持续优于现有视觉重编程方法，并具有相当或更好的推理效率。
AI.conclusion: RVP通过显式建模类间关系与结构化重参数化，有效提升少样本视觉重编程的判别能力，同时保持高推理效率，验证了类间残差校正与线性重参数化视角的有效性。

title: MemFold: Learning Compact Soft Memory for Long-Context Personalization via On-Policy Optimization
summary: An assistant that serves the same user over a long horizon has to answer from what that user has revealed: which preferences still hold, which were revised, and which constraints apply now. Retaining that information is not the same as acting on it, and the two are usually optimized as if they were. Keeping the information as text makes the reader's input grow with the retained history, while compressing it into a fixed number of latent vectors bounds the interface but is typically trained to reconstruct text or imitate reference answers, both of which are scored on sequences the reader never produced. We present MemFold, which optimizes a fixed-budget soft memory by the behavior it supports. A query-conditioned textual memory is compressed into K continuous vectors that form the reader's memory interface, and the reader is then trained on its own rollouts under two complementary signals: group-relative rewards for task outcomes, and confidence-gated on-policy distillation in which a frozen textual-memory teacher re-scores the student's sampled tokens under the textual memory. The teacher is never sampled from, so supervision stays on the student's current distribution and adds no autoregressive decoding; at inference it is removed entirely. Across three Qwen backbones, MemFold attains the highest accuracy we measure on PersonaMem-32K and PersonaMem-128K, with margins that widen at the longer history length, and transfers to PrefEval and LongMemEval without target-domain training. Ablations attribute most of the task gain to the reward term and a smaller additional gain to the teacher signal, and memory interventions show that the reader depends on the instance-specific content of its soft memory.

AI.tldr: MemFold 提出一种按行为效果优化固定预算软记忆的方法：将查询条件文本记忆压缩为 K 个连续向量作为读者接口，并用自身 rollout 上的组相对奖励与置信门控在线蒸馏训练读者。它在 PersonaMem-32K/128K 上取得最高准确率，越长历史优势越明显，并零样本迁移到 PrefEval 和 LongMemEval。
AI.motivation: 长期服务同一用户的助手需要从用户已透露的信息中判断哪些偏好仍成立、哪些已修改、哪些约束当前适用。保留信息不等于正确使用信息，但二者常被分开优化。文本记忆会使输入随历史增长，而固定数量隐向量虽限制接口大小，却通常按重构文本或模仿参考答案训练，评分序列并非读者自己产生。
AI.method: MemFold 优化固定预算软记忆所支持的行为。它将查询条件文本记忆压缩为 K 个连续向量，构成读者的记忆接口；随后在读者自己的 rollout 上训练，使用两个互补信号：面向任务结果的组相对奖励，以及置信门控的 on-policy 蒸馏——由冻结的文本记忆教师基于文本记忆重新给学生的采样 token 打分。教师从不被采样，避免额外自回归解码，推理时完全移除。
AI.result: 在三个 Qwen backbone 上，MemFold 在 PersonaMem-32K 和 PersonaMem-128K 上达到测得最高准确率，且历史越长优势越大；无需目标域训练即可迁移到 PrefEval 和 LongMemEval。消融显示任务增益主要来自奖励项，教师信号带来较小额外增益；记忆干预表明读者依赖其软记忆中实例特定的内容。
AI.conclusion: 固定预算软记忆可以按下游行为而非文本重构或参考答案模仿来优化，从而提升长期个性化任务表现与迁移能力。奖励是主要增益来源，蒸馏信号提供补充；软记忆中的实例内容会被读者实际使用。

title: Predictive Safety Curricula for Robust Legged Locomotion
summary: Rare but consequential failures can persist in learned locomotion policies for legged robots even when average task performance is high, in part because standard curricula primarily adapt task difficulty rather than the distribution of safety-critical experience. We introduce Predictive Safety Curricula (PSC), a framework for allocating locomotion training experience using learned predictions of future safety cost. PSC trains a distributional safety critic from policy rollouts and uses its predictions to prioritize both terrain contexts and previously encountered randomized events. The resulting curriculum modifies the training distribution while leaving the task reward and policy-optimization loss unchanged. We evaluate PSC in controlled rough-terrain locomotion and in production locomotion systems. PSC improves reliability relative to standard terrain progression, advantage-based replay, and learning-progress curricula, with the largest gains on difficult terrain and under degraded observations. The same allocation principle transfers to two production locomotion stacks. On ANYmal-D hardware, PSC reduces shank-collision incidence by $63\%$ relative to the learning-progress curriculum across three matched training seeds, with a reduction in every seed. On a production stair-climbing platform, PSC eliminates observed shank collisions in the evaluated hardware trials. These results show that learned predictions of future safety cost can provide an effective signal for allocating training experience toward rare failure modes and improving locomotion reliability.

AI.tldr: 提出Predictive Safety Curricula（PSC）框架，利用学习到的未来安全代价预测来分配腿式机器人运动训练经验，从而减少稀有但严重的安全故障并提升可靠性。
AI.motivation: 标准课程通常只调整任务难度，而不改变安全关键经验的分布，因此即使平均任务表现很高，腿式机器人策略中仍可能残留稀有但后果严重的失败模式。
AI.method: PSC从策略 rollout 中训练一个分布式安全 critic，并用其预测结果优先安排地形上下文和先前遇到的随机事件，从而改变训练分布，但不改变任务奖励和策略优化损失。论文在受控崎岖地形与生产级运动系统中评估，并与标准地形进阶、优势回放和学习进度课程对比。
AI.result: PSC相比基线提升了可靠性，在困难地形和观测退化时增益最大；方法迁移到两个生产运动栈。在ANYmal-D硬件上，跨三个匹配训练种子，PSC将小腿碰撞发生率相对学习进度课程降低63%，且每个种子均有下降；在生产爬楼梯平台上，PSC在评估的硬件试验中消除了观察到的小腿碰撞。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的未来安全代价预测可以为训练经验分配提供有效信号，使训练更集中于稀有失败模式，从而提升腿式机器人运动可靠性。

title: AVIO: Learning to Add and Remove Sounding Objects in Audiovisual Scenes
summary: Adding or removing a sounding object requires coordinated changes to visual content and sound while preserving the surrounding scene. Yet paired supervision for localized non-speech audiovisual editing remains limited, as visual and acoustic edits must target the same object and isolate its sound from overlapping sources. To address this gap, we introduce \textit{AVIOBench}, a dataset comprising 37.9 hours of paired audiovisual examples spanning 1{,}878 target-object names. AVIOBench links the visual presence and acoustic contribution of each target object through a shared identity and visual mask. Our automated pipeline uses visual grounding and cross-modal consistency to select target-sound removal candidates, then jointly refines the audiovisual pairs to improve perceptual quality and cross-modal consistency. Building on this dataset, we propose \textit{AVIO}, which adapts a pretrained text-to audiovisual generation model through source-conditioned feature modulation to jointly learn object addition and removal. A reference-frame curriculum gradually reduces reference conditioning during training, enabling one model to perform instruction-only editing with optional visual guidance. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate effective audiovisual object removal and addition, with optional reference guidance providing appearance and placement control for addition.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AVIOBench 数据集和 AVIO 方法，用于非语音的局部音视频编辑，实现目标物体的添加或移除，并可保持周围场景一致。
AI.motivation: 现有局部非语音音视频编辑缺乏成对监督，因为视觉和声音编辑需针对同一物体，并从重叠声源中分离其声音。
AI.method: 构建 AVIOBench：37.9 小时配对音视频样本，覆盖 1,878 个目标物体名称，通过共享身份和视觉掩码关联视觉出现与声音贡献；自动流程利用视觉定位和跨模态一致性选择目标声音移除候选，并联合优化音视频对。提出 AVIO：基于预训练文本到音视频生成模型，通过源条件特征调制联合学习物体添加与移除；采用参考帧课程逐步减少参考条件，使模型支持仅指令编辑和可选视觉引导。
AI.result: 定量和定性评估表明，AVIO 能有效进行音视频物体移除和添加；可选参考引导为添加操作提供外观和位置控制。
AI.conclusion: AVIOBench 与 AVIO 为局部非语音音视频编辑提供了数据和模型基础，能够在保持场景一致性的同时实现目标物体的添加与移除。

title: Learning to Harvest Without Collapse in a Regenerative Commons: A Lagrangian Framework
summary: The tragedy of the commons poses a multi-agent safety problem: reward-seeking agents can deplete a shared resource, and cooperation among its users does not itself specify how much must be preserved. We make preservation an explicit requirement by formulating a regenerative commons as a constrained Markov game or a constrained multi-agent MDP with a designer-specified depletion budget. We develop a nonstationary Lagrangian framework that constructs a policy sequence from solutions of unconstrained games or cooperative control problems. Extending earlier time-average constructions, we introduce average-epoch solution concepts for reset episodes with discounted rewards and terminal costs. We prove a reward-independent feasibility certificate, cooperative feasibility and approximate optimality against feasible policy mixtures, and an extension to unbiased sampled costs. For self-interested agents, a constrained Nash certificate quantifies the price-dispersion term introduced by deviations that redistribute budget across epochs. Under the stated assumptions on solver accuracy and multiplier updates, these results give constrained policy-sequence guarantees using solutions of unconstrained problems. Experiments with constrained IPPO and MAPPO in a Gordon-Schaefer fishery examine how depletion budgets shape stock retention, harvest rewards, and price adaptation.

AI.tldr: 该文将可再生公地建模为带消耗预算约束的约束马尔可夫博弈或多智能体MDP，提出非平稳拉格朗日框架，用无约束问题的解构造策略序列，并给出可行性、近似最优性与约束纳什相关保证，最后在Gordon-Schaefer渔业中用约束IPPO/MAPPO验证预算对资源保留和收益的影响。
AI.motivation: 公地悲剧是多智能体安全问题：自利智能体可能耗尽共享资源，而合作本身并不规定必须保留多少资源。因此需要把资源保护设为显式要求，即由设计者指定消耗预算。
AI.method: 将再生公地形式化为约束马尔可夫博弈或约束多智能体MDP；提出非平稳拉格朗日框架，从无约束博弈或协作控制问题的解构造策略序列；扩展时间平均构造，引入面向重置回合、折扣奖励和终端成本的平均epoch解概念；并扩展到无偏采样成本，以及针对自利智能体的约束纳什证书。
AI.result: 证明了与奖励无关的可行性证书、合作可行性和对可行策略混合的近似最优性；给出无偏采样成本扩展；对自利智能体，约束纳什证书量化了跨epoch重新分配预算的偏离所引入的price-dispersion项。在Gordon-Schaefer渔业中，约束IPPO和MAPPO实验表明消耗预算会影响存量保留、捕捞收益和价格适应。
AI.conclusion: 在求解器精度与乘子更新等假设下，可由无约束问题的解获得约束策略序列保证。显式消耗预算为公地保护提供了可操作的多智能体学习目标，并在实验中体现出资源保留与收益之间的权衡。

title: When Semantics Matter: Reliability-Aware Semantic-Rhythm Control for Co-Speech Gesture Generation
summary: Co-speech gesture generation aims to synthesize natural gestures that are both temporally synchronized with speech and semantically consistent with the spoken content. Although recent methods can generate rhythmically plausible motions, they often rely heavily on acoustic prosody while underutilizing textual semantics, especially when semantic annotations are incomplete, noisy, or unavailable. Consequently, the generated gestures may follow speech rhythm while failing to express the intended semantics. To address this problem, we propose a reliability-aware semantic-rhythm control framework for co-speech gesture generation. We first learn a discrete motion prior that represents continuous gestures in a compact and structured motion-code space. We then introduce a dual-branch semantic contribution estimation mechanism consisting of a full multimodal branch and an audio-only branch. Their distributional discrepancy is formulated as conditional information gain to quantify how much textual semantics changes the predicted motion. Based on this estimate, a controllable semantic-rhythm objective selectively strengthens semantic guidance in content-relevant segments while limiting unnecessary semantic intervention in rhythm-dominant segments. Furthermore, we treat background noise as an acoustic reliability condition and introduce noise-conditioned feature modulation together with beneficial latent perturbation to improve generation robustness under realistic acoustic environments. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves a favorable balance among semantic expressiveness, rhythmic synchronization, motion diversity, and robustness, enabling reliable and controllable co-speech gesture generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可靠性感知的语义-节奏控制框架，用于语音手势生成。该框架通过学习离散运动先验、双分支语义贡献估计和可控语义-节奏目标，并结合噪声条件特征调制，在语义表达、节奏同步、运动多样性和鲁棒性之间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有语音手势生成方法虽能生成节奏合理的动作，但过度依赖声学韵律而低估文本语义，尤其在语义标注不完整、有噪声或缺失时，生成的手势可能只跟随语音节奏而无法表达预期语义。
AI.method: 首先学习离散运动先验，将连续手势表示在紧凑结构化的运动码空间；然后引入由全模态分支和纯音频分支组成的双分支语义贡献估计机制，用分布差异作为条件信息增益，量化文本语义对预测运动的影响；基于此提出可控语义-节奏目标，在内容相关段增强语义引导，在节奏主导段限制语义干预；同时将背景噪声视为声学可靠性条件，引入噪声条件特征调制和有益潜在扰动以提升真实声学环境下的生成鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的实验表明，所提框架在语义表达力、节奏同步、运动多样性和鲁棒性之间取得了良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够实现可靠且可控的语音手势生成。

title: BRIDGE: Bilevel Retrieval-Credit-Aware Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (ARL) with verifiable rewards improves the ability of large language models (LLMs) to tackle knowledge-intensive tasks by learning to interleave search and reasoning. However, most existing ARL methods optimize only LLM-generated tokens and treat retrieved evidence as environment observations. This creates an information-credit gap: failures caused by missing or misleading evidence are attributed to the LLM policy rather than to the retriever, which motivates training the LLM and the retriever jointly. In this paper, we show that retrieval and LLM policy learning are order-sensitive: adapting the retriever before optimizing the policy yields a larger reward gain than the reverse order. To preserve this hierarchy while allowing both components to co-adapt, we formulate retrieval-augmented agentic RL as a bilevel optimization problem. To solve it efficiently, we introduce BRIDGE, a memory-efficient first-order bilevel method motivated by a loss-landscape analysis of the RL and retrieval objectives. Across seven open-domain QA benchmarks, BRIDGE achieves the highest average accuracy with both 3B and 7B backbones, improving the multi-hop average over the strongest baseline by 9.6 and 3.4 EM points, respectively. It also achieves the best averaged answer accuracy and reasoning quality across medical QA benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出BRIDGE，一种记忆高效的一阶双层优化方法，用于联合训练LLM策略与检索器，解决检索增强智能体强化学习中的信息信用分配问题。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体强化学习通常只优化LLM生成的token，而将检索到的证据视为环境观察，导致检索缺失或误导造成的失败被错误归因于LLM策略，形成信息信用缺口；同时检索器与LLM策略学习存在顺序敏感性。
AI.method: 将检索增强的智能体强化学习建模为双层优化问题，并发现先适配检索器、再优化策略比相反顺序带来更大奖励增益；提出BRIDGE，一种基于RL与检索目标损失景观分析、内存高效的一阶双层优化方法。
AI.result: 在7个开放域问答基准上，BRIDGE在3B和7B骨干模型上均取得最高平均准确率，多跳问答平均较最强基线分别提升9.6和3.4 EM；在医学问答基准上也取得最佳平均答案准确率和推理质量。
AI.conclusion: 联合训练LLM与检索器，并保持检索优先的双层优化结构，能有效提升知识密集型任务表现；BRIDGE为这一思路提供了高效可行的实现方案。

title: From Sky to Soil: A Morphing Aerial-Ground Robot for Seed Deployment
summary: Aerial seed broadcasting can reach remote restoration sites, but provides limited control over seed placement within the soil. This paper presents a geometry-assisted, tri-functional morphing robot that combines aerial access, ground locomotion, and controlled-depth seed embedding in a fly-drive-plant architecture. After landing, the platform reconfigures into a four-wheeled planting configuration: an electronically coupled dual-motor drive folds the rear arms outward to form ground wheels, while a descending front tray engages the propulsion motors with a drill gear train. Reusing the propulsion motors for drilling eliminates a dedicated drill drive. The planting sequence forms a hole, dispenses a seed, and allows the vehicle to reposition on the ground or return to its flight configuration. Ground mobility supports repeated planting without requiring a separate flight between adjacent sites. A companion controller issues reconfiguration, tray, and seed-gate commands, while a dedicated autopilot handles flight control. The morphing and planting mechanisms are validated using a hardware prototype that demonstrates ground repositioning and seed embedding. This proof of concept establishes a hardware basis for aerial-ground seed embedding through coordinated reconfiguration and actuator reuse.

AI.tldr: 提出一种几何辅助、三功能变形机器人，集飞行、地面行驶与定深播种于一体，并完成硬件原型验证。
AI.motivation: 空中播种可到达偏远修复地点，但难以控制种子在土壤中的放置位置，因此需要兼顾空中进入、地面移动和可控深度播种的方案。
AI.method: 采用“飞行-行驶-播种”架构：着陆后重构为四轮播种形态，后臂外折成轮，前托盘下移使推进电机通过齿轮系驱动钻头，实现执行器复用；配套控制器负责重构、托盘和种子门命令，专用自驾负责飞行控制；最后用硬件原型验证。
AI.result: 原型实现了地面重新定位和种子嵌入；播种流程包括成孔、落种、再定位或恢复飞行构型，并支持在相邻地点间无需重复飞行即可多次播种。
AI.conclusion: 该概念验证为通过协调重构与执行器复用实现空地一体化种子嵌入提供了硬件基础。

title: FinRT: Distilling Adaptive Red-Teaming Strategies into Reusable Adversarial Generators in Consumer Finance
summary: In regulated industries like consumer finance, seemingly harmless user queries can exploit large language model vulnerabilities, triggering safety failures and pushing responses dangerously close to policy limits. Existing automated red-teaming methods trade off attack effectiveness against generation cost, while treating coverage, severity, and diversity as incidental rather than joint objectives. We introduce FinRT, a structured framework that builds reusable adversarial prompt generators from adaptive red-teaming strategies. Across the six victim models in consumer finance, FinRT substantially outperforms adaptive search baselines while amortizing target-facing attack generation into a reusable generator. FinRT nearly doubles the attack success rate over the adaptive baseline Rainbow Teaming (32.9% vs. 17.2%), increases maximum adversarial severity by 33%, and preserves comparable intra-policy-domain semantic diversity to iterative search methods. Our method achieves high cross-model transferability while exhibiting distinct victim-family specialization patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FinRT框架，通过自适应红队策略构建可复用的对抗提示生成器，在消费金融领域的六个受害模型上显著提升攻击成功率和严重性，同时保持语义多样性并实现跨模型迁移。
AI.motivation: 在消费金融等受监管行业中，看似无害的用户查询可能利用大语言模型漏洞，引发安全失败并使回复逼近政策边界。现有自动化红队方法在攻击效果与生成成本之间权衡，且将覆盖率、严重性和多样性视为附带目标而非联合优化目标。
AI.method: FinRT是一个结构化框架，从自适应红队策略中构建可复用的对抗提示生成器，将针对目标的攻击生成过程摊销为可重用生成器。
AI.result: 在消费金融的六个受害模型上，FinRT大幅优于自适应搜索基线：攻击成功率相比Rainbow Teaming几乎翻倍（32.9% vs. 17.2%），最大对抗严重性提升33%，并保持与迭代搜索方法相当的政策域内语义多样性。同时实现高跨模型迁移性，并表现出不同的受害家族特化模式。
AI.conclusion: FinRT能有效且高效地进行红队测试，通过可复用生成器降低攻击生成成本，在提升攻击效果的同时兼顾多样性，并具有跨模型迁移能力。

title: Memory Consolidation Flattens the Temporal Shape of User Facts
summary: Long-term memory systems turn conversations into short stored notes. A note can keep a user fact while losing evidence about whether the fact still holds. For example, "I am driving a Peugeot" can become "The user drives a Peugeot," which drops the cue that the activity is ongoing. We call this aspectual flattening and measure it with LAPSE, a benchmark of matched user statements that differ only in temporal form. We find that memory writers flatten aspect selectively. Three writer models flattened the progressive statement but kept its simple-present match in 244 of 381 pairs, never the reverse. The asymmetry holds in all 11 model configurations tested and in the installed pipelines mem0, Graphiti, and Letta. The lost cue matters to later readers. In exploratory tests, changing only the stored verb shifted all three readers' estimates that a fact still holds. When readers could ask the user before acting, two of three acted without asking more often on flattened notes. Our planned memory-use task could not detect this, because readers there acted on almost every stored fact, even expired ones. Memory writing can thus remove evidence that later models use to decide whether to act.

AI.tldr: 长期记忆系统把对话压缩成短笔记时会丢失时体信息，即“时体扁平化”。LAPSE基准量化了这一现象，并发现记忆写入模型会选择性丢失进行时线索，进而影响后续模型对事实是否仍成立的判断与行动决策。
AI.motivation: 探究长期记忆系统在存储用户事实时是否会丢失“事实是否仍然成立”的时间证据，以及这种丢失如何影响后续读取和使用这些记忆的模型。
AI.method: 提出LAPSE基准，由仅时体形式不同的配对用户陈述组成；测试多个记忆写入模型和配置，以及mem0、Graphiti、Letta三个已安装管线；并进行探索性测试，观察仅改变存储动词是否影响读取模型对事实持续性的估计，以及读取者是否先询问用户再行动。
AI.result: 在381对陈述中，三个写入模型有244对压平了进行时陈述但保留其一般现在时匹配，反向情况从未出现；该不对称性在全部11种模型配置和三个管线中成立。仅改变存储动词就会改变三个读取模型对事实仍成立的估计；在可询问用户时，三个读取者中有两个在扁平化笔记上更常不询问就行动。计划中的记忆使用任务因读取者几乎对所有存储事实都行动而无法检测该效应。
AI.conclusion: 记忆写入可能移除后续模型用于判断是否行动的证据。长期记忆系统应保留时体和时间有效性线索，以避免因时体扁平化导致下游决策偏差。

title: AESplat: Advancing Pose-Free Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting via Decoupled Appearance Modeling
summary: Pose-free feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has demonstrated remarkable potential for generalized novel view synthesis. However, existing methods typically predict Gaussian appearance attributes represented by spherical harmonics (SH) in the same manner, overlooking the fundamental distinction between view-independent and view-dependent appearance, which results in suboptimal rendering quality. In this paper, we present AESplat, a novel and general framework for pose-free feed-forward 3DGS that introduces an effective decoupled appearance modeling strategy based on an analysis of SH, enabling higher-quality rendering. Specifically, AESplat directly derives the zeroth-order SH coefficient, which represents the base view-independent appearance component, from the input images without training. The higher-order SH coefficients are subsequently predicted by a shallow multilayer perceptron equipped with two efficient 3D-aware inductive biases to model view-dependent appearance variations. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, achieving a $0.8$ dB improvement in PSNR over the pose-free method NAS3R and a $1.1$ dB improvement over the pose-required method DepthSplat on the RealEstate10K dataset. Project page: https://aesplat.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AESplat，一种用于无位姿前馈式 3D 高斯泼溅的新框架，通过解耦外观建模提升新视角合成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有无位姿前馈 3DGS 方法通常以相同方式预测由球谐函数表示的高斯外观属性，忽略了视角无关与视角相关外观之间的本质区别，导致渲染质量不理想。
AI.method: 基于对球谐函数的分析，采用解耦外观建模策略：直接从输入图像推导表示基础视角无关外观的零阶球谐系数，无需训练；更高阶球谐系数则由带有两种高效 3D 感知归纳偏置的浅层多层感知机预测，以建模视角相关的外观变化。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法显著优于现有最先进方法。在 RealEstate10K 数据集上，PSNR 比无位姿方法 NAS3R 提升 0.8 dB，比需要位姿的方法 DepthSplat 提升 1.1 dB。
AI.conclusion: AESplat 通过解耦视角无关和视角相关外观，有效提升了无位姿前馈 3DGS 的渲染质量，并展现出优于现有方法的性能。

title: BCNav: Bearing-Conditioned Depth Policies for Sound Source Navigation
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to IEEE RO-MAN 2026
summary: The ability to navigate toward sound sources extends a robot's reach beyond its visual field, enabling response to auditory events in unknown environments. To equip robots with this capability, existing methods couple acoustic and visual information through joint audio-visual learning in acoustic simulators. However, acoustic simulation is both low-fidelity and expensive, producing a domain gap that prevents reliable real-world deployment, while the discrete action spaces inherited from grid-based simulators introduce an additional kinematic gap on physical robots. To alleviate these issues, we propose BCNav, a decoupled framework that separates the acoustic module from the learned navigation policy using direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation: an estimator provides a scalar bearing to the sound source, so the navigation policy only processes depth images and a bearing angle, two inputs whose domain gaps are well characterized. We collect shortest-path demonstrations with calibrated bearing noise injection and train the policy via imitation learning to output continuous velocity commands directly executable on ground robots. We demonstrate the method in simulation and on a physical robot, navigating unknown environments without any acoustic fine-tuning, prior mapping, or real-world audio data collection. Code is available at https://github.com/york1to/bcnav.

AI.tldr: 提出BCNav框架，将声学模块与导航策略解耦，利用DOA估计提供声源方位角，导航策略仅基于深度图像和方位角，通过模仿学习输出连续速度指令，实现真实机器人无声音微调、无先验地图的未知环境声源导航。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖联合音视觉学习和声学模拟器，但声学模拟低保真、代价高，导致域差距，难以可靠部署到真实世界；同时基于网格模拟器继承的离散动作空间在物理机器人上引入额外运动学差距。
AI.method: 将声学模块与学习到的导航策略解耦：使用到达方向（DOA）估计器提供声源标量方位角；导航策略仅处理深度图像和方位角。采集最短路径演示并注入校准后的方位噪声，通过模仿学习训练策略，直接输出可在地面机器人上执行的连续速度指令。
AI.result: 在仿真和物理机器人上验证了方法，能够在未知环境中导航至声源，无需声学微调、先验建图或真实世界音频数据采集。
AI.conclusion: 通过DOA估计解耦声学与导航，可缓解声学模拟和离散动作带来的域差距与运动学差距，为机器人声源导航提供可实际部署的方案。

title: Drag as Evidence: Motion-Grounded Latent Recomposition for Drag-Based Editing
summary: Modern image editors excel at semantic manipulation and visual synthesis, yet remain limited in precise spatial control, motivating the development of drag-based editing. However, existing drag-based methods often struggle to balance drag accuracy with natural, plausible, and intent-aligned generation. We propose MoRe-Drag, a motion-grounded drag-based editing method. Our key insight is to treat pixel-space warping as coarse motion evidence, and to inject this evidence into the generative sampling trajectory. Specifically, MoRe-Drag performs region-aware latent recomposition over refinement, inpainting, and anchor regions, coupled with stage-adaptive conditioning that progressively shifts from motion-grounded structure formation to semantic refinement. We further support an instruction-free interface by adapting the MLLM-based text encoder for drag-aware instruction inference. Experiments on DragBench-SR and DragBench-DR show that MoRe-Drag substantially improves drag precision over strong base editors and achieves superior drag accuracy among SOTA drag-based methods, while delivering strong semantic consistency and visually realistic results. Code and dataset will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 提出 MoRe-Drag，一种基于运动引导的拖拽式图像编辑方法，通过将像素空间变形作为粗略运动证据注入生成采样过程，以兼顾拖拽精度与生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有图像编辑器在语义操作和视觉合成方面表现优异，但精确空间控制仍有限；拖拽式编辑虽针对该问题，但难以同时平衡拖拽准确性、自然合理性以及与用户意图的一致性。
AI.method: 将像素空间变形视为粗略运动证据，并将其注入生成采样轨迹；执行区域感知的潜在重组，覆盖细化区域、修复区域和锚点区域；采用阶段自适应条件，从运动引导的结构形成逐步过渡到语义细化；适配基于 MLLM 的文本编码器以支持无指令界面下的拖拽感知指令推断。
AI.result: 在 DragBench-SR 和 DragBench-DR 上的实验表明，MoRe-Drag 相比强基线编辑器显著提升拖拽精度，并在当前 SOTA 拖拽式方法中取得更优的拖拽准确性，同时保持较强语义一致性和视觉真实感。
AI.conclusion: MoRe-Drag 通过运动引导的生成采样与区域级潜在重组，有效提升了拖拽式编辑的精度与生成质量；代码和数据集将公开释放。

title: MAADBench: The Refreshable Paradigm for Anomaly Detection in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Recent studies report that LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) fail at rates of 41%-87%, yet to our knowledge, no benchmark to date supports systematic anomaly detection (AD) for them. Building MAS AD benchmarks is hard because they must remain fresh as LLM systems evolve: tasks may leak into training data and thus be memorized by LLMs, traces and anomaly patterns expire as backbones evolve, and labels must be provided reliably for each refresh. To address these challenges, we present MAADBench (MA: multi-agent; AD: anomaly detection), the first refreshable MAS AD benchmark designed for diverse, evolving LLM backbones underlying the agents. MAADBench combines (1) sampled-and-coupled generative tasks over an approximately 10^37-task space to mitigate task leakage, (2) refreshable trace generation under configurable LLM backbones, and (3) automated provision of cost-free, deterministic step-level labels for fine-grained AD evaluation. Beyond offering the paradigm itself, we run MAADBench with five state-of-the-art LLM backbones and release the MAADBench-Full dataset with 5,200 step-labeled traces. Benchmarking 25 AD methods on the MAADBench dataset reveals substantial limitations in current approaches: they rely heavily on supervision, struggle with subtle MAS-specific anomalies, and lack robustness across LLM backbones. These gaps point to a rich research agenda for MAS-specific anomaly detection, with MAADBench providing a systematic and refreshable testbed for method development and evaluation. We open-source MAADBench-Full at https://huggingface.co/datasets/hww123/MAADBench-full.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了MAADBench，首个可刷新的多智能体系统异常检测基准，用于应对LLM多智能体系统高失败率但缺乏系统异常检测基准的问题。
AI.motivation: LLM-based多智能体系统失败率高达41%-87%，但目前缺乏系统性的异常检测基准。构建此类基准面临任务泄露、追踪和异常模式随骨干模型演进过期、标签需可靠刷新等挑战。
AI.method: MAADBench包含三部分：(1) 在约10^37任务空间上采样并耦合生成任务以缓解任务泄露；(2) 在可配置LLM骨干下可刷新地生成追踪；(3) 自动提供免费、确定性的步骤级标签用于细粒度异常检测评估。使用五种先进LLM骨干运行，发布含5200条步骤级标注追踪的MAADBench-Full数据集，并在其上基准测试25种异常检测方法。
AI.result: 当前异常检测方法存在显著局限：严重依赖监督信号、难以处理细微的多智能体特有异常、跨LLM骨干缺乏鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 这些差距指向多智能体特有异常检测的丰富研究议程，MAADBench为方法开发与评估提供了系统且可刷新的测试平台，并已开源MAADBench-Full。

title: Multifunctional Locomotion Control of Multi-Jointed BURs with Swimming and gait Capabilities
comment: Preprint version of an article published in Advanced Robotics (2026)
summary: Multimodal biomimetic underwater robots (BURs) can conduct underwater tasks suitable for the environment. Combining the characteristics of aquatic organisms enables the swimming and leggedlocomotion required for underwater exploration. Locomotion control mechanism relies on rule-based behavior selection and the designer's discretion. This limits the robot's ability to acquire new behavioral capabilities to the predetermined range of behaviors. To address these challenges, we propose a mechanism and control system that enables the expression of multimodal locomotion capabilities from the same multi-jointed structure. A mechanism equipped with four leg-fins each having four axes is used. This controller achieves nonlinear behavior based on sensor modalities, rather than relying on predefined conditional rule-based on locomotion functions. This system was validated through both physical and simulation testing based on multiple sensor data and behavioral patterns. Utilizing a potential function in multimodal locomotion control was verified to enable transitions between two or three behaviors. Implementing the control method as a multimodal controller is expected to enhance its application in underwater exploration. Our project page is at https://tasada038.github.io/multi-jointed-bur/.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种多模态仿生水下机器人机构与控制系统，利用同一多关节结构实现游泳和足式运动等多种运动模式，并通过势函数实现行为切换。
AI.motivation: 现有水下机器人运动控制多依赖基于规则的行为选择和设计者经验，导致机器人只能执行预定行为，难以获得新的行为能力和灵活的多模态运动。
AI.method: 设计配备四条腿鳍、每条腿鳍四轴的多关节机构；提出基于传感器模态的非线性控制器，而非依赖预定义条件规则；在物理平台和仿真中，结合多种传感器数据与行为模式进行验证，并采用势函数进行多模态运动控制。
AI.result: 验证了所提势函数控制方法能够实现两种或三种行为之间的切换，并在物理与仿真测试中表现出多模态运动能力。
AI.conclusion: 将控制方法实现为多模态控制器有望增强水下机器人探索应用能力，并为多模态仿生水下机器人运动控制提供新思路。

title: Similar Choices, Different Attention: Cross-Modal Associations in Humans and Vision-Language Models
summary: Cross-modal associations are systematic pairings of features across modalities, such as the association of 'bouba' with round shapes and 'kiki' with sharp shapes. Prior work has compared humans and vision-language models (VLMs) on such associations, but often using different stimuli or tasks between humans and models. Here, we ask whether VLMs align with humans not only in choices, but also in where they look when making those choices. We study both VLMs and humans (N = 53), presenting them with the same stimuli, a pseudo-word and two images, and record participants' choices and eye movements, which we release. We find choice alignment in a few larger VLMs, but their saliency matches human gaze less closely than a center-bias baseline, a fixed Gaussian at the center of each image. Fine-tuning small VLMs on human choices brings their choice alignment to the level of a human majority-vote reference on unseen words and images, yet their attention still matches human gaze less closely than this baseline. Training model attention on human gaze raises attention-gaze correlation without improving choice alignment, and a single average gaze map per image position raises it by a similar amount. Matching human choices, or even human gaze patterns, is therefore not sufficient evidence of human-aligned cross-modal processing.

AI.tldr: 该研究用相同刺激和任务比较人类与视觉语言模型在跨模态联想中的选择及眼动，发现部分大型VLM能对齐人类选择，但注意力/显著性并不比中心偏置基线更接近人类注视；仅匹配选择或注视模式不足以证明人类对齐的跨模态加工。
AI.motivation: 已有工作常在不同刺激或任务下比较人类与VLM的跨模态联想，难以判断VLM是否真正以类人方式加工；作者希望同时考察选择与注视位置是否对齐。
AI.method: 向53名人类参与者和多个VLM呈现相同刺激：一个伪词和两张图片，记录人类与模型的选择及人类眼动数据；比较选择对齐、模型显著性图与人类注视，并测试微调、用人类注视训练注意力等干预。
AI.result: 少数较大VLM表现出选择对齐，但其显著性图与人类注视的匹配程度低于中心偏置基线。用人类选择微调小型VLM后，其对新词和新图的选择对齐达到人类多数投票参考水平，但注意力仍不如中心基线。用人类注视训练模型注意力可提高注意力-注视相关性，却不改善选择对齐；单一平均注视图也有类似提升。
AI.conclusion: 匹配人类选择，甚至匹配人类注视模式，都不足以证明模型具有人类对齐的跨模态加工；需要更严格的标准来评估VLM的类人跨模态联想。

title: Divide and Inject: Can Agents Reconstruct an Indirect Prompt Injection from Fragments?
summary: Agentic systems are now being widely used to orchestrate tools and reason over long contexts. However, the improving capabilities of the large language models powering these agents also create new attack surfaces for indirect prompt injection. In particular, an attacker may not need to place a complete malicious instruction in retrieved content if the agent can reconstruct the objective from incomplete fragments distributed across a long context. In this work, we introduce adaptive long-context prompt injection (AdaLCPI), which combines long-context fragmentation with adaptive search. AdaLCPI splits an attack objective into incomplete fragments, embeds them in external content retrieved through the agent's tools, and uses a reconstruction cue to prompt the agent to combine them. It then iteratively refines the fragments and cue with OpenEvolve using graded scoring and natural-language execution feedback from the target agent. Empirically, AdaLCPI achieves higher attack success than strong adaptive baselines, reaching 61.4\% macro-average ASR compared with 32.8\% for Trojan Hippo-style and 30.0\% for AgentVigil. Safety evaluations should therefore test whether agents remain robust when harmful objectives must be reconstructed from incomplete fragments.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应长上下文提示注入攻击AdaLCPI，通过将攻击目标拆分为不完整片段并嵌入检索内容，利用重构提示诱导智能体自行组合，再用OpenEvolve迭代优化，攻击成功率显著高于基线。
AI.motivation: 智能体广泛用于编排工具和长上下文推理，但驱动智能体的大语言模型能力提升也带来间接提示注入的新攻击面：攻击者可能无需在检索内容中放置完整恶意指令，只要智能体能从长上下文中分散的不完整片段重构出攻击目标即可。
AI.method: AdaLCPI将攻击目标拆分为不完整片段，嵌入智能体工具检索到的外部内容中，并加入重构提示引导智能体组合片段；随后使用OpenEvolve，结合分级评分和目标智能体的自然语言执行反馈，迭代优化片段与提示。
AI.result: AdaLCPI攻击成功率高于强自适应基线，宏平均ASR达61.4%，而Trojan Hippo风格为32.8%，AgentVigil为30.0%。
AI.conclusion: 安全评估应检验智能体在必须从分散的不完整片段重构有害目标时是否仍保持鲁棒性。

title: NesTok: Nested Self-Aligned 1D Tokenizer for Autoregressive Image Generation
summary: One-dimensional (1D) variable-length visual tokenizers enable adaptive compression by varying the number of tokens, allowing downstream autoregressive (AR) models to flexibly trade off generation quality against computational cost using a single tokenizer. However, existing approaches based on nested dropout often fail to fully exploit the representational capacity of the tokenizer, resulting in suboptimal performance in both image reconstruction and generation. In this work, we introduce NesTok, a nested self-alignment framework tailored to dynamic visual tokenizers. NesTok introduces cross-length training, which jointly optimizes reconstruction across token lengths while using the full-length sequence to guide shorter counterparts, enabling shorter token sequences to approach the reconstruction quality of full-length sequences. On ImageNet, NesTok improves substantially over standard training and achieves an rFID score of 0.98. On downstream image generation, it achieves the state-of-the-art gFID score of 1.46 on ImageNet 256$\times$256 among existing variable-length autoregressive image generation methods. Code will be available at https://github.com/jaiwei804/NesTok.

AI.tldr: 提出 NesTok，一种面向一维可变长度视觉 tokenizer 的嵌套自对齐框架，通过跨长度训练提升图像重建与下游自回归生成性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 nested dropout 的可变长度视觉 tokenizer 往往无法充分利用 tokenizer 的表示能力，导致图像重建和生成性能次优。
AI.method: NesTok 引入跨长度训练，联合优化不同 token 长度下的重建，并利用全长序列指导较短序列，使短 token 序列能够接近全长序列的重建质量。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet 上，NesTok 相比标准训练显著提升，取得 0.98 的 rFID；在下游 256×256 图像生成中，取得现有可变长度自回归图像生成方法中 state-of-the-art 的 gFID 1.46。
AI.conclusion: NesTok 能有效提升动态视觉 tokenizer 的重建质量与生成性能，使单一 tokenizer 在生成质量和计算成本之间实现更灵活有效的权衡。

title: V2X-WAM: A Cooperative World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Vehicle-infrastructure cooperation can complement onboard sensing with broader and more informative observations of the traffic environment, providing valuable support for end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing cooperative driving methods mainly exploit roadside information to enhance the representation of the current scene, while the future consequences of prospective driving actions are rarely modeled explicitly. This limits the ability of the planner to anticipate how its decisions may interact with the evolving traffic environment. To address this issue, we propose V2X-WAM, a cooperative world action model that tightly couples cooperative scene understanding, action generation, and future-world reasoning. V2X-WAM constructs a reliability-aware spatiotemporal representation from vehicle- and infrastructure-side observations, while compressing infrastructure information into a compact quantized message for efficient communication. Based on the resulting cooperative representation, a multimodal planner generates prospective trajectories, which explicitly condition future occupancy and dynamic-flow prediction. The predicted world consequences are then fed back to refine the planned trajectory, forming a closed interaction between action and future-world evolution. Experiments on a large-scale real-world cooperative driving dataset demonstrate that V2X-WAM consistently improves planning accuracy and safety over representative end-to-end cooperative driving methods, while achieving stronger future-world prediction and substantially lower communication overhead. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of the proposed design.

AI.tldr: 提出 V2X-WAM 协同世界动作模型，将车路协同感知、动作生成与未来世界推理解耦为闭环，从而提升端到端协同自动驾驶的规划精度与安全性，并降低通信开销。
AI.motivation: 现有协同驾驶方法主要利用路侧信息增强当前场景表征，却很少显式建模未来驾驶动作的后果，导致规划器难以预判决策与动态交通环境的交互影响。
AI.method: 构建可靠性感知的时空表征，融合车辆与路侧观测，并将路侧信息压缩为紧凑量化消息以高效通信；基于协同表征，多模态规划器生成候选轨迹，并显式条件化未来占据与动态流预测；再将预测后果反馈以 refine 规划轨迹，形成动作与未来世界演化的闭环交互。
AI.result: 在大规模真实世界协同驾驶数据集上，V2X-WAM 在规划精度和安全性上持续优于代表性端到端协同驾驶方法，同时具有更强的未来世界预测能力和显著更低的通信开销；消融实验验证了所提设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 紧密耦合协同场景理解、动作生成与未来世界推理，能够有效提升协同自动驾驶的规划性能、安全性与通信效率。

title: Large-scale factor analysis shows machine intelligence is only partially interpretable
summary: A common assumption in language model development is that cognitive abilities are organized around a general, domain-free intelligence factor, like fluid intelligence in humans. This assumption is rarely tested directly, and prior attempts have done so only at a much smaller scale. We take a latent variable approach to intelligence in language models, similar to how psychometricians study psychological constructs. Performance in every specific problem set is influenced by a domain-specific and a domain-agnostic latent factor. Using factor analysis as a dimension-reduction technique, we analyzed 13,251 published evaluation scores covering 1,618 language models across 456 different text-only benchmarks. Due to the super-sparse nature of the dataset, we triangulate our analysis across different data densifiers and imputation methods. A robust pattern across different modes of bias is that 1. A general intelligence factor accounts for 70.8% of variance in model performance at our most generous estimate, and far less than that in most of our solutions, 2. Content-similar benchmarks do not necessarily cluster together, and 3. The $g$ factor is not dominated by any common theme, and there is a lack of evidence that it is well-proxied by standard "intelligence" benchmarks. Our findings go against current endeavors of defining, identifying, and targeting general intelligence as a tangible construct in language model development. This leaves the strategy of targeting a single conceptual ability without support, since the first-order abilities it would have to reach are often partially idiosyncratic and not identifiable in practice.

AI.tldr: 该研究用潜变量和因子分析方法，大规模检验语言模型中是否存在类似人类流体智力的通用智能因子。基于1,618个语言模型、456个文本基准上的13,251个评测分数，发现通用智能因子在多数情况下解释力有限，且标准“智能”基准并不能很好地代理它。
AI.motivation: 语言模型开发中常假设认知能力围绕一个通用、领域无关的智能因子组织，但这一假设很少被直接检验，且此前尝试规模较小。
AI.method: 采用心理测量学式的潜变量方法，将每个具体问题集的表现视为受领域特异和领域无关潜因子影响；使用因子分析进行降维，分析13,251个已发表评测分数，覆盖1,618个语言模型和456个纯文本基准；针对数据极度稀疏，使用不同数据致密化和插补方法进行三角验证。
AI.result: 稳健模式显示：1. 在最宽松估计下，通用智能因子仅解释70.8%的模型性能方差，多数方案中远低于此；2. 内容相似的基准不一定聚在一起；3. g因子不被任何常见主题主导，且缺乏证据表明标准“智能”基准能很好地代理它。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果反对将通用智能定义为、识别为并作为语言模型开发中可操作实体的当前努力。由于一阶能力往往具有部分特异性且在实践中不可识别，针对单一概念能力进行优化的策略缺乏支持。

title: Retrieval Sensitivity to Identity Signals in Queries
comment: EMNLP 2026 camera-ready, with a correction to Fig. 4
summary: Dense retrievers decide which documents reach users and the language models that use them, yet they are typically evaluated with neutral queries. We ask whether the identity signals that real users express in their queries---political ideology and dialect---bias what a retriever returns. We design evaluations in two domains, political news and consumer-health questions, each pairing a controlled synthetic set that varies only the identity signal with naturalistic queries. Across five dense retrievers and a sparse baseline, every retriever (i) retrieves articles that align with the query's own political lean and (ii) performs worse for questions written in African American Language (AAL) than in White Mainstream English (WME). Two analyses tie these gaps to queries' identity signals beyond surface vocabulary: partialling out an aggregate lexical-asymmetry score leaves the synthetic gaps largely intact, and linear probes recover lean and dialect from the retrievers' query embeddings beyond token-level features. Left unaddressed, such retrieval biases risk contributing to polarization and reinforcing the health disparities already faced by AAL speakers. Code is available at https://github.com/Andrewtcr/bias-ret.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究密集检索器是否会因用户查询中表达的身份信号（政治意识形态和方言）而产生检索偏差。作者在政治新闻和消费者健康两个领域构建评估，发现五种密集检索器及稀疏基线均会检索与查询政治倾向一致的文章，且对非裔美国人语言（AAL）问题的表现差于白人主流英语（WME）。
AI.motivation: 密集检索器决定用户看到哪些文档，并影响下游语言模型，但通常仅用中性查询评估。现实中用户查询会携带政治意识形态和方言等身份信号，因此有必要检验这些信号是否使检索结果产生偏差。
AI.method: 在两个领域（政治新闻、消费者健康问题）设计评估，每个领域结合受控合成查询集与自然查询：合成集只改变身份信号。测试五种密集检索器和一种稀疏基线。进一步用词汇不对称分数进行控制分析，并用线性探针从查询嵌入中恢复政治倾向和方言。
AI.result: 所有检索器都表现出两类偏差：一是检索与查询自身政治倾向一致的文章；二是对用AAL写的问题表现差于WME。控制聚合词汇不对称分数后，合成集上的偏差仍基本存在；线性探针也能从查询嵌入中恢复政治倾向和方言，说明偏差超出表层词汇特征。
AI.conclusion: 若不加干预，这类检索偏差可能加剧政治极化，并强化AAL使用者已面临的健康差距。代码已公开。

title: SafeCoEvo: Co-Evolving Safety Harnesses and Guards for LLM Agents at Test-Time
summary: LLM agents deployed in real-world environments continually encounter new tasks and safety risks, while execution feedback typically becomes available only after each task is completed. However, existing self-evolving approaches commonly rely on multiple rounds of optimization over fixed and repeatedly accessible task distributions, fundamentally differing from test-time adaptation in real-world deployment, where only experience accumulated from past tasks can be used to improve safety decisions on future unseen tasks. To address this limitation, we propose SafeCoEvo, a test-time Harness-Guard co-evolution framework for LLM agent safety that enables the external safety system to continually adapt from accumulated runtime experience. SafeCoEvo jointly improves two complementary safety capabilities at different timescales: S-Harness rapidly externalizes recent runtime experience into updatable explicit safety knowledge that can promptly influence subsequent tasks, while GuardVPO internalizes accumulated runtime safety experience over a longer timescale into parametric risk-judgment capabilities. By combining short-term rapid adaptation with long-term capability consolidation, SafeCoEvo continually improves the agent's safety capabilities, reducing the unsafe outcome rate by 10.05% while improving the task success rate by 12.15% over the strongest baseline, thereby achieving simultaneous gains in safety and task utility.

AI.tldr: 提出SafeCoEvo，一个面向LLM智能体安全的测试时Harness-Guard协同演化框架，通过结合短期快速适应与长期能力固化，持续提升智能体在未知任务上的安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有自演化方法依赖对固定且可重复访问的任务分布进行多轮优化，与现实部署中的测试时适应场景不符——现实中只能利用过去任务积累的经验来提升对未来未知任务的安全决策。
AI.method: 提出SafeCoEvo框架，在不同时间尺度上联合改进两种互补的安全能力：S-Harness将近期运行时经验快速外化为可更新的显式安全知识，及时影响后续任务；GuardVPO在较长时间尺度上将积累的运行时安全经验内化为参数化的风险判断能力。
AI.result: 相比最强基线，不安全结果率降低10.05%，任务成功率提升12.15%，实现了安全性与任务效用的同步提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过短期快速适应与长期能力固化的结合，SafeCoEvo能够持续提升智能体在测试时的安全能力，并在安全性和任务效用上取得双赢。

title: Visual sensitivity is not claim retractability: persistence-aware credit assignment for multimodal reinforcement learning
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has been extended to Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), and perception-aware methods further encourage policies to rely on visual evidence. Yet relying on the image does not guarantee that visual claims are supported by it. Before RL training, 27.81% of the correctly answered responses of Qwen2.5-VL-7B on four multimodal reasoning benchmarks contain at least one direct visual claim that the image does not support. Since outcome-level RL rewards each response as a whole, these claims inherit the positive credit of the correct answer. We introduce a fixed-rollout counterfactual diagnostic that re-scores the same response under an intervened image to separate Evidence-Function Sensitivity (EFS), how strongly the model's predictions change, from claim persistence, whether the model keeps supporting the same claim rather than retracting it. The diagnostic reveals Sensitivity-Persistence Decoupling (SPD): under DAPO and VPPO, EFS increases and claims become more retractable overall, yet unsupported claims become significantly more persistent, whereas GRPO raises EFS without this deterioration. We therefore propose Persistence-Aware Credit Gating (PACG), which attenuates positive credit for unusually persistent visual claims and leaves all other credit unchanged. It requires no supported/unsupported labels and adds no inference cost. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B, PACG raises the nine-benchmark average over three seeds from 58.1% to 59.9% with DAPO and from 59.8% to 60.9% with VPPO, while making unsupported claims more retractable. The gains extend to a larger model, a newer backbone, and the accuracy of HallusionBench also improves consistently. These results suggest that visual sensitivity and claim retractability are complementary dimensions of multimodal credit assignment.

AI.tldr: 论文研究带可验证奖励的强化学习在大型视觉语言模型中的信用分配问题，提出反事实诊断区分视觉证据敏感性与声明持续性，并提出PACG方法，在不增加推理成本的情况下提升多模态推理表现并减少无依据视觉声明。
AI.motivation: 尽管感知感知方法鼓励模型依赖图像，但依赖图像并不保证其视觉声明真正被图像支持。在RL训练前，Qwen2.5-VL-7B正确回答中仍有27.81%包含至少一个图像不支持的直接视觉声明；而结果级RL会将这些错误声明随正确答案一起赋予正向信用。
AI.method: 提出固定rollout反事实诊断：对同一回答在干预图像下重新评分，分离Evidence-Function Sensitivity（EFS）和声明持续性，揭示Sensitivity-Persistence Decoupling（SPD）。基于此提出Persistence-Aware Credit Gating（PACG），对异常持续的无支持视觉声明衰减正向信用，其余信用不变，无需支持/不支持标签且不增加推理成本。
AI.result: 诊断显示DAPO和VPPO下EFS上升且整体声明更可撤回，但无支持声明显著更持续；GRPO提升EFS却无此恶化。PACG在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上使九基准三种子平均从58.1%升至59.9%（DAPO），从59.8%升至60.9%（VPPO），并使无支持声明更可撤回；增益可扩展到更大模型、更新骨干，HallusionBench准确率也持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 视觉敏感性和声明可撤回性是多模态信用分配中互补的两个维度，PACG通过针对异常持续的视觉声明进行信用门控，可有效改善多模态强化学习效果。

title: FastVR: Efficient Streaming Video Restoration with One-Step Diffusion
summary: Diffusion-based video restoration recovers realistic details, but its practical deployment is limited by two efficiency bottlenecks: costly VAE encoding and decoding, and the quadratic cost of full self-attention in diffusion transformers (DiTs). This paper presents FastVR, a streaming video restoration framework built on a one-step diffusion model, which delivers strong restoration quality and temporal consistency while processing 1080p video at 11 FPS on a single H20 GPU. To improve inference efficiency, FastVR combines a lightweight VAE with chunk-wise causal attention, which substantially reduces the computational cost.
