During training, it further adopts velocity consistency regularization and continuous trajectory learning, which improve restoration quality. Extensive experiments show that FastVR is more efficient than the evaluated diffusion baselines while achieving state-of-the-art performance on synthetic and real-world benchmarks. We hope that this work supports further progress in the community.

AI.tldr: FastVR 是一个基于单步扩散模型的流式视频修复框架，在单张 H20 GPU 上以 11 FPS 处理 1080p 视频，同时保持较强修复质量和时序一致性。
AI.motivation: 扩散式视频修复能恢复真实细节，但实际部署受限于两个效率瓶颈：VAE 编码与解码开销高，以及扩散 Transformer 中全自注意力的二次计算成本。
AI.method: 提出 FastVR 流式视频修复框架，基于一步扩散模型，并结合轻量级 VAE 与分块因果注意力以降低推理成本；训练阶段采用速度一致性正则化和连续轨迹学习来提升修复质量。
AI.result: 在合成和真实世界基准上达到 state-of-the-art 性能，同时比所评估的扩散基线更高效；在单张 H20 GPU 上实现 1080p 视频 11 FPS 处理。
AI.conclusion: FastVR 表明高效流式扩散视频修复具有实用可行性，并有望推动社区进一步研究。

title: When Updating Stops Being Learning: Rethinking LLM Self-Evolution via learnable information gain
summary: Self-evolution lets large language models (LLMs) improve iteratively using their own generated data, but often suffers from self-evolution degeneration: performance improves, plateaus, then declines. Existing methods address this issue at the component level, targeting either the Questioner or the Solver, and overlook that self-evolution is a tightly coupled system. We propose a holistic framework based on learnable information gain, which measures how much novel, parameterizable information a round provides relative to the previous round. Theoretically, this gain equals the Kullback-Leibler divergence between the two rounds' data distributions plus their entropy change. Practically, it is estimated by fitting a small language model to the previous round and scoring new data via negative log-likelihood. Based on this diagnostic, we propose ATRI (Adaptive Training Regulation via Information-gain), which reweights samples within a round and halts training across rounds when information gain remains low. Experiments on popular datasets demonstrate the superiority of our proposal.

AI.tldr: 论文针对大语言模型自进化中的性能退化问题，提出基于可学习信息增益的整体框架ATRI，通过轮内样本重加权和轮间训练停止来缓解性能先升后降。
AI.motivation: 自进化让大语言模型利用自身生成数据迭代提升，但常出现自进化退化：性能提升后停滞再下降。现有方法只在组件层面解决，分别针对提问者或求解者，忽视了自进化是紧密耦合系统。
AI.method: 提出整体框架，用可学习信息增益衡量当前轮相对上一轮提供多少新颖且可参数化的信息。理论上该增益等于两轮数据分布的KL散度加熵变。实践中用小型语言模型拟合上一轮，并通过负对数似然对新数据打分来估计。基于此诊断提出ATRI，轮内重加权样本，轮间在信息增益持续较低时停止训练。
AI.result: 在流行数据集上的实验证明了所提方法的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 从系统整体角度利用信息增益诊断和调控自进化，能有效缓解自进化退化，ATRI优于现有方法。

title: Dual-Mode Low-Rank Learner with Bridge-Prototype Ensemble for Vision-Language Class-Incremental Learning
comment: 21 pages, 11 figures, and 12 tables, including the appendix
summary: Benefiting from transferable visual-textual alignment, CLIP has been widely adopted for class-incremental learning (CIL). However, existing learners either repeatedly update components shared across tasks, leading to knowledge overwriting, or overly isolate new-task updates, hindering the reuse of CLIP's transferable knowledge and limiting plasticity. Moreover, the text-based or bimodal classifier designs still fail to effectively integrate complementary information from the visual and textual modalities. To address these challenges, we introduce DuLBE, which couples dual-mode low-rank learning with a bridge-prototype ensemble classifier for exemplar-free CIL. DuLBE allocates two visual low-rank update modes according to the gradient demand and uses gradient routing to coordinate them: a compact and rewritable shared mode is selected from historically occupied visual directions to reuse transferable knowledge, while residual modes provide low-interference channels for task-specific variations. Building on the resulting stable inter-modal structure, we further construct geodesic bridges between visual prototypes and text embeddings on the unit hypersphere, and ensemble reliable bridge prototypes to compensate for the modality-gap limitations of textual decision boundaries. Extensive experiments under multiple settings show that DuLBE achieves state-of-the-art CIL performance while retaining the high parameter efficiency of low-rank tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DuLBE，一种用于无样本类增量学习（CIL）的方法，将双模式低秩学习与桥原型集成分类器相结合，以提升 CLIP 在增量学习中的可塑性与知识复用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 CLIP 的 CIL 方法要么反复更新共享组件导致知识覆盖，要么过度隔离新任务更新，限制可迁移知识复用和模型可塑性；同时文本或双模态分类器未能有效融合视觉与文本的互补信息。
AI.method: DuLBE 根据梯度需求分配两种视觉低秩更新模式，并通过梯度路由协调：从历史占用视觉方向中选择紧凑可重写的共享模式以复用可迁移知识，残差模式提供低干扰通道用于任务特定变化。基于稳定的跨模态结构，在单位超球面上构建视觉原型与文本嵌入之间的测地桥，并集成可靠桥原型以补偿文本决策边界的模态差距。
AI.result: 在多种设置下的广泛实验表明，DuLBE 取得了state-of-the-art的 CIL 性能，同时保持低秩微调的高参数效率。
AI.conclusion: DuLBE 通过耦合双模式低秩学习与桥原型集成分类器，有效缓解了知识覆盖、可塑性不足和模态信息融合不充分的问题，实现了高性能且参数高效的无样本类增量学习。

title: Adversarially Robust Geometric Safety Certificates for Nonholonomic Robots Against Maneuvering Obstacles
summary: Safe navigation against obstacles that can actively maneuver within bounded capabilities remains challenging: robust control barrier function methods typically treat obstacle actions as generic disturbances, while differential-game approaches are computationally expensive for online navigation. We propose an adversarially robust geometric certificate that accounts for the worst-case effect of admissible obstacle maneuvers directly in the safe-set geometry through a closed-form contraction of the certificate parameters. The construction exploits a structural property of line-of-sight (LoS) certificates: the robot and obstacle actions enter the certificate through a common state-dependent geometric gain. This gain cancels in the worst-case comparison, reducing the differential game to a direct comparison between obstacle maneuvering capability and the weaker of the robot's longitudinal and steering authorities. Instantiated on the parabolic certificate, the construction yields Adversarially Robust Dynamic Parabolic Control Barrier Functions (AR-DPCBF), for which we establish sufficient conditions for forward invariance of the contracted safe set against all admissible obstacle maneuvers under kinematic bicycle dynamics with bounded inputs. When the obstacle capability is unknown, a sliding-window estimator supplies a high-probability upper bound, allowing the guarantee to be retained with the corresponding coverage probability. We further formulate soft and buffered variants to recover feasibility in dense environments. Simulations across obstacle capabilities, densities, and capability mismatch show substantial reductions in barrier violations and collisions and demonstrate that pointwise robustification of the barrier derivative cannot substitute for contraction of its geometry.

AI.tldr: 提出一种对抗鲁棒几何证书，通过闭式收缩安全集几何来应对有界机动障碍，实例化为AR-DPCBF，在运动学自行车模型下提供前向不变性保证，并在仿真中显著减少障碍函数违反与碰撞。
AI.motivation: 动态障碍安全导航中，鲁棒控制障碍函数方法通常将障碍动作视为一般扰动，而微分博弈方法在线计算成本高，难以兼顾鲁棒性与实时性。
AI.method: 利用视线（LoS）证书的结构性质：机器人及障碍动作通过共同的状态相关几何增益进入证书，该增益在最坏情况比较中抵消，从而将微分博弈简化为障碍机动能力与机器人纵向/转向能力中较弱者的直接比较。基于抛物线证书构造AR-DPCBF，给出有界输入运动学自行车动力学下收缩安全集前向不变的充分条件；未知障碍能力时用滑窗估计器提供高概率上界；并提出软约束与缓冲变体以在密集环境中恢复可行性。
AI.result: 跨障碍能力、密度和能力失配的仿真表明，障碍函数违反和碰撞显著减少；同时表明对障碍函数导数进行逐点鲁棒化不能替代对其几何进行收缩。
AI.conclusion: 该对抗鲁棒几何证书能通过闭式安全集收缩实现可证明的对抗鲁棒安全保证，降低在线计算负担，并可扩展至未知障碍能力与密集环境。

title: DraftTrace: A Multi-View Analytics Environment for AI-Integrated Writing
summary: Generative AI has changed how students produce writing assignments. The final artifact is no longer sufficient to understand the process through which it was produced. We introduce DraftTrace, a writing environment that jointly captures three complementary views of writing: the final product, the writing process and interactions with an integrated AI-assistant. DraftTrace reconstructs how a document develops over time and organizes these signals into submission, longitudinal, and class-level analytics for instructors. We deployed DraftTrace in a graduate NLP course with 81 students and compared their sessions with LLM-generated responses entered by automated tools and with copy-typed responses. While product measures distinguish differences in text formulation, process measures distinguish differences in how text is entered. Considering both views together helps characterize cases such as copy-typing. Interaction traces show that students use the assistant differently across stages of writing: to clarify the question at an early stage and to verify answers at a later stage. A preliminary instructor survey highlights the importance of multi-view writing analytics and their interpretability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DraftTrace写作环境，联合捕捉最终文稿、写作过程和AI助手交互三种视角，并在81名研究生的NLP课程中部署，用于分析学生写作与AI使用行为。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI改变了学生写作方式，仅凭最终文稿已不足以理解写作过程，因此需要同时分析产品、过程与AI交互。
AI.method: DraftTrace重建文档随时间的发展过程，并组织为提交级、纵向和班级级分析；在研究生NLP课程中部署，比较学生写作、自动化工具输入的LLM生成回答以及复制键入回答，并分析交互轨迹和教师调查。
AI.result: 产品指标可区分文本表述差异，过程指标可区分文本输入方式差异，二者结合有助于识别复制键入等情况；交互轨迹显示学生早期用助手澄清问题、后期用于验证答案；教师调查强调多视角写作分析和可解释性的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 多视角写作分析能够更全面理解AI辅助写作，且可解释性对教学应用很重要。

title: ReF-HIL: Shaping the Critic around Human Action Neighborhoods for Efficient Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Shaoyin Luo and Song Wang contributed equally to this work
summary: Human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (HIL-RL) offers a promising route to efficient training of robotic manipulation policies by combining autonomous learning with human demonstrations and online corrections. However, insufficient use of successful human experience in value learning prolongs costly real-world training, while persistent imitation penalties can limit value-driven policy improvement. To address these limitations, we propose ReF-HIL, an efficient HIL-RL framework that uses human guidance to accelerate the learning process. Human-Reference-Guided Value Shaping learns an independent value reference from successful human experience to guide online value learning, while incorporating local corrective feedback. A Human Action Fence defines a learned human-action neighborhood, allowing value-driven optimization for better performance without imitation penalties inside while constraining policy and value updates outside. Experiments on five diverse and challenging real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improved overall learning efficiency and higher success rates compared with the evaluated baselines. Specifically, ReF-HIL reaches 90% autonomous success in only 18-63 minutes of active training and achieves final success rates of 91.7-100%. These results highlight the potential of human-guided reinforcement learning to acquire reliable manipulation skills efficiently in the real world. Project website: https://anonymous.4open.science/w/ReF-HIL-7762/

AI.tldr: 提出ReF-HIL高效人在回路强化学习框架，利用人类指导加速真实机器人操作策略学习，并在多个真实任务中取得更高效率与成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有HIL-RL虽能结合自主学习与人类示范/在线纠正，但对成功人类经验在价值学习中利用不足，导致真实世界训练成本高；持续模仿惩罚也会限制价值驱动的策略改进。
AI.method: ReF-HIL包含两个核心机制：Human-Reference-Guided Value Shaping从成功人类经验中学习独立价值参考以指导在线价值学习，并融合局部纠正反馈；Human Action Fence学习人类动作邻域，在邻域内允许无模仿惩罚的价值驱动优化，在邻域外约束策略与价值更新。
AI.result: 在五个多样且具挑战的真实机器人操作任务上，ReF-HIL相比基线提升了整体学习效率与成功率。仅需18-63分钟主动训练即可达到90%自主成功率，最终成功率达91.7-100%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，人类引导的强化学习有望在真实世界中高效地获取可靠的操作技能。

title: DSPO: Diversity-aware Subjective Policy Optimization for Robust Emotional Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement Learning has significantly advanced the complex reasoning capabilities of MLLMs. However, prevailing RL algorithms suffer a severe failure in emotion reasoning tasks. These methods heavily rely on deterministic hard-label supervision and point-wise isolated evaluation, creating a fundamental gap with the inherently subjective and continuously distributed nature of human emotions. Furthermore, unlike explicit physical objects, emotional states are deeply implicit within visual cues. This abstract nature exacerbates visual hallucinations in MLLMs, leading to plausible yet ungrounded emotional evidence. To address these limitations, we propose Diversity-Aware Subjective Policy Optimization (DSPO), a reinforcement learning framework that jointly promotes subjective affective coverage and visual grounding. First, we construct a context-grounded emotional distribution prior in the VAD space by combining the lexical prior of the annotated emotion with image-specific contextual information. Based on this prior, we introduce a Distribution-Aligned Emotional Diversity Reward (DEDR), which measures the leave-one-out marginal contribution of each candidate emotion within a rollout. DEDR rewards candidates whose inclusion brings the predicted affective set closer to the context-grounded prior, thereby preserving plausible subjective interpretations without encouraging unconstrained dispersion. We further develop Counterfactual Visual Intervention Gating (CVIG), which masks the visual region highlighted in the reasoning process and uses the resulting candidate-wise probability changes to reduce the weights of interpretations unsupported by visual evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DSPO achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple public benchmarks, especially on the cross-domain performance, i.e., improving +10.8\% on average cross-domain accuracy than EMO-R3.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出DSPO强化学习框架，用于提升多模态大模型的情感推理能力，通过主观情感分布覆盖与视觉 grounding 联合优化，在多个公开基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习算法在情感推理任务中表现不佳，主要因为它们依赖确定性硬标签监督和逐点孤立评估，与人类情感主观且连续分布的本质存在根本差距；同时情感状态隐含在视觉线索中，容易加剧多模态大模型的视觉幻觉，产生看似合理但缺乏依据的情感证据。
AI.method: 提出Diversity-Aware Subjective Policy Optimization（DSPO）框架。首先在VAD空间中结合标注情感的词汇先验和图像特定上下文信息，构建上下文 grounding 的情感分布先验。基于该先验，设计Distribution-Aligned Emotional Diversity Reward（DEDR），通过leave-one-out边际贡献衡量每个候选情感在rollout中的作用，奖励使预测情感集合更接近先验的候选，同时避免无约束发散。进一步提出Counterfactual Visual Intervention Gating（CVIG），遮蔽推理过程中高亮的视觉区域，并利用候选概率变化降低缺乏视觉证据支持的解读权重。
AI.result: 大量实验表明DSPO在多个公开基准上达到state-of-the-art性能，尤其在跨域性能上，平均跨域准确率比EMO-R3提升10.8%。
AI.conclusion: DSPO通过联合促进主观情感覆盖和视觉 grounding，能够有效缓解现有强化学习在情感推理中的局限，提升多模态大模型情感推理的准确性与跨域泛化能力。

title: Transformers Stop Thinking Too Early, and a Tiny LoRA Fixes It
summary: Pretrained transformers use little of their depth to follow references in context. Thirteen base models reliably follow only 1.4-3.6 lines, and extra pretrained loops add little. A task-trained rank-8 LoRA at one early layer extends this computation with all model weights frozen. Qwen3-8B improves from 15.5% to 99% exact accuracy on 24-line chains; a longer-trained LoRA reaches 50 lines. Ouro-1.4B reaches 60 lines after four loops and at least 160 after eight. The LoRA starts a relay: program lines pass on their chain identity through a short range of middle layers. Frozen heads read progressively further up the chain, and removing parent-line attention stops the relay. A frozen-model measurement locates the last useful intervention layer within tolerance in three of four held-out models. Task-specific LoRAs also improve MuSiQue. Default answers therefore understate the computation accessible through a tiny edit. Code and an interactive demo are available at https://lunamos.github.io/stop-thinking-too-early/

AI.tldr: 预训练Transformer在上下文引用跟踪任务中只用到很少的深度；通过在一个早期层训练秩为8的LoRA（冻结全部原始权重），可以大幅扩展其链式引用跟踪能力。
AI.motivation: 现有预训练模型在上下文引用跟踪上表现有限，通常只能可靠跟随1.4-3.6行，增加预训练循环也帮助不大，因此作者想探究默认答案是否低估了模型通过微小修改可访问的计算能力。
AI.method: 在冻结模型权重的情况下，于一个早期层训练任务专用的秩为8 LoRA；在Qwen3-8B、Ouro-1.4B等模型上测试不同长度链的精确准确率，并通过冻结模型测量、注意力消融和MuSiQue任务验证机制与泛化性。
AI.result: Qwen3-8B在24行链上从15.5%提升到99%精确准确率，更长训练的LoRA可达50行；Ouro-1.4B四轮循环后达60行，八轮后至少160行。LoRA启动了一个“接力”：程序行通过中间层短程传递链身份，冻结头逐步读取更远的上游链，移除父行注意力会中断接力。冻结模型测量能在四个留出模型中的三个内定位最后有效干预层。任务专用LoRA也能提升MuSiQue。
AI.conclusion: 默认答案低估了通过极小编辑即可访问的计算能力；预训练Transformer的深度利用不足问题可通过早期层LoRA有效缓解，并揭示出一种链身份中继机制。

title: MemEvo: Automatic Discovery of Streaming Video Memory Mechanisms
summary: Query-agnostic streaming video understanding requires vision-language models to continuously compress an indefinitely growing visual stream into a bounded memory before future queries are known. The performance depends critically on the memory mechanism--what observations to preserve, how to represent and consolidate them, and what information to retrieve when a query eventually arrives. Rather than designing a single memory architecture by hand, we formulate memory design as a search problem over executable memory programs. We introduce a lightweight domain-specific language that expresses memory mechanisms through structured primitives for representation, admission, retention, consolidation, budgeting, and retrieval, while enforcing causal and bounded-memory constraints. Although structured, the derived program space remains large and contains heterogeneous, conditionally dependent design choices whose effects can only be assessed via downstream execution. We therefore propose MemEvo, an LLM-driven auto-research framework that uses pretrained LLM as a semantics-aware proposal model to iteratively generate and refine candidate memory programs based on accumulated experimental feedback. At runtime, a deterministic evaluation pipeline validates and evaluates each candidate, while the underlying vision-language model remains frozen throughout discovery. We finally produce a training-free, bounded-memory mechanism. Extensive experiments on StreamingBench and OVO-Bench demonstrate strong streaming video understanding performance together with substantial context and inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出MemEvo框架，将流式视频理解的记忆机制设计转化为可执行程序搜索问题，用LLM自动生成和优化记忆程序，在冻结视觉语言模型下获得免训练、有界内存机制，在StreamingBench和OVO-Bench上取得强性能并显著提升效率。
AI.motivation: 查询无关的流式视频理解要求模型在未来查询未知时，持续将无限增长的视觉流压缩为有界记忆，其性能关键取决于记忆机制；但手工设计单一记忆架构困难，因此需要自动搜索更优的记忆程序。
AI.method: 定义轻量领域特定语言，通过表示、准入、保留、整合、预算和检索等结构化原语表达记忆机制，并施加因果与有界内存约束；将记忆设计建模为可执行程序搜索问题；提出MemEvo，用预训练LLM作为语义感知提议模型，基于实验反馈迭代生成和优化候选记忆程序；运行时使用确定性评估流水线验证和评估候选，视觉语言模型全程冻结。
AI.result: 在StreamingBench和OVO-Bench上展示了强流式视频理解性能，同时显著提升上下文和推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过程序搜索与LLM驱动的自动研究，可以发现免训练、有界内存的记忆机制，为流式视频理解提供有效且高效的新范式。

title: SEED: Self-Speculative Decoding via Implicit Encoder-Decoder
summary: Self-speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by drafting tokens from the target model itself, but faces a sharp tradeoff between the quality and cost of the draft. Early-exit methods produce drafts cheaply by terminating computation at intermediate layers, but forgo the deeper representations that later layers provide and thus suffer in draft quality. Multi-token prediction preserves draft quality by emitting from the model's final hidden states, but pays for a full forward pass to produce those states at every drafting step. We propose self-speculative encoder-decoder (SEED), a self-speculative method that obtains high-quality drafts cheaply by reusing the deep contextual representations already computed during verification. We reinterpret the standard decoder-only transformer as an implicit encoder-decoder: the first layers (encoder) build deep contextual representations, and the last few layers (decoder) emit tokens from them. Encoding and verification are merged into a single step: verification is performed by the full encoder-decoder, and the contextual representations of the verified prefix are cached for reuse during drafting. Drafting is therefore very fast: between verifications, the lightweight decoder drafts multiple tokens autoregressively, each conditioned on the cached representations and on preceding drafts. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that SEED achieves up to 2.7$\times$ average speedup on 4B-scale models, outperforming both early-exit and MTP-style self-speculative baselines and running 28% faster than the state-of-the-art EAGLE-3, while preserving or even improving the generation quality of standard autoregressive fine-tuning. Code is available at https://github.com/lhk2004/SEED.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SEED，一种自推测解码方法，将标准解码器Transformer视为隐式编码器-解码器，通过复用验证阶段已计算的深层上下文表示来低成本生成高质量草稿，从而加速大语言模型推理。
AI.motivation: 现有自推测解码方法在草稿质量与成本之间存在明显权衡：早退方法草稿便宜但质量差，多token预测草稿质量好但每步需完整前向传播，成本高。
AI.method: 将标准解码器-only Transformer重新解释为隐式编码器-解码器：前若干层作为编码器构建深层上下文表示，后几层作为解码器基于这些表示生成token。编码与验证合并为一步，验证由完整编码器-解码器执行，并缓存已验证前缀的上下文表示；在两次验证之间，轻量解码器基于缓存表示和已生成草稿自回归地快速生成多个token。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，SEED在4B规模模型上实现最高2.7倍平均加速，优于早退和多token预测类自推测基线，比最先进的EAGLE-3快28%，同时保持甚至提升标准自回归微调的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: SEED通过复用验证阶段的深层上下文表示，有效解决了自推测解码中草稿质量与成本的权衡，在显著加速推理的同时不损失生成质量，代码已开源。

title: Disentangling Spurious Correlations in Vision-Language-Action Models via Predicting Domain-Invariant Latent Lookahead
comment: Accepted to CoRL 2026. Project website: https://dill-vla.github.io/
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remain brittle under visual distribution shifts, often relying on spurious correlations tied to domain-specific factors rather than task-relevant structure. We propose Domain-Invariant Latent Lookahead (DILL), a representation-learning framework that mitigates shortcut learning in VLA policies. Our key idea is to supervise policies with domain-invariant future latents learned from domain-transformed trajectory data. A Task-Domain Encoder is trained with contrastive objectives and Gaussian disentanglement regularization to separate task-relevant structure from domain-specific visual variation. The learned encoder then provides future latents for VLA policy learning through lookahead prediction and domain disentanglement, encouraging the policy to focus on task-relevant structure rather than incidental visual factors. Counterfactual task-view evaluations show that DILL reduces shortcut reliance, while LIBERO-Plus evaluations demonstrate improved visual robustness, with 69.1% average success, 11.4 percentage points above the strongest baseline. Real-world manipulation experiments further support DILL's applicability beyond controlled simulation. Complementary latent-space diagnostics show that these behavioral gains are accompanied by representations that better preserve task-consistent structure while suppressing domain-specific variation. Our project page is available at https://dill-vla.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出DILL框架，通过域不变未来潜变量监督VLA策略学习，减少视觉分布偏移下的捷径学习，提升视觉鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在视觉分布偏移下表现脆弱，常依赖与域相关因素绑定的虚假关联，而非任务相关结构。
AI.method: 训练Task-Domain Encoder，使用对比目标和高斯解耦正则分离任务结构与域特定视觉变化；利用域变换轨迹学习域不变未来潜变量，并通过前瞻预测和域解耦监督VLA策略学习。
AI.result: 反事实任务视角评估显示DILL减少捷径依赖；LIBERO-Plus上平均成功率69.1%，比最强基线高11.4个百分点；真实机器人操作实验支持其可应用性；潜空间诊断显示表示更好保留任务一致结构并抑制域特定变化。
AI.conclusion: DILL能有效缓解VLA策略中的捷径学习，提升视觉鲁棒性，且在仿真与真实环境中均具适用性。

title: CoRe-VLA: Preserving Cross-View Coordination in VLAs under Camera Shifts
summary: VLAs combine pretrained vision-language representations with action generation to enable language-guided control across diverse tasks, becoming a mainstream paradigm in embodied intelligence. However, multiple studies have reported VLA's substantial declines in task success under camera shifts, revealing a key vulnerability that limits reliable deployment. To address this vulnerability, existing methods collect paired observations of the same scene from different viewpoints to fine-tune the VLA or train visual adaptation modules. Unfortunately, they require additional data collection and VLA training costs. In this paper, we first identify \emph{cross-view coordination breakdown} under external camera shifts: the robot may rely too heavily on wrist-view cues and consequently execute subtasks in the wrong order when losing global view. Motivated by this, we propose CoRe-VLA, a plug-and-play framework requiring neither additional multi-view data collection nor VLA fine-tuning, which can incorporate with exsiting VLAs. It reconstructs a scene point cloud and renders the observation from the VLA's training viewpoint to restore cross-view coordination. In CoRe-VLA, Render-to-Camera (R2C) Restoration reduces rendering-induced visual degradation, while Execution-Trajectory-Conditioned Alignment (ETCA) reduces robot idle time and mitigates motion conflicts during asynchronous execution. Experiments on 5 real-robot tasks, LIBERO-100 and LIBERO-Plus demonstrate CoRe-VLA substantially improves task success across mainstream VLAs under camera shifts. For example, CoRe-VLA raises PI0.5's success rate from 13.3% to 83.3% at a 1.6m camera shift in real-robot environment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoRe-VLA，一个即插即用框架，无需额外多视角数据或微调VLA，通过重建场景点云并从VLA训练视角渲染观测，恢复跨视角协调，显著提升相机偏移下的任务成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA在相机偏移下任务成功率大幅下降，现有方法需额外数据采集和VLA训练成本；作者发现外部相机偏移会导致“跨视角协调崩溃”，机器人过度依赖手腕视角，丢失全局视角时子任务顺序错误。
AI.method: CoRe-VLA集成现有VLA：重建场景点云，从VLA训练视角渲染观测；包含Render-to-Camera (R2C) Restoration减少渲染视觉退化，以及Execution-Trajectory-Conditioned Alignment (ETCA)减少异步执行中的机器人空闲时间和运动冲突。
AI.result: 在5个真实机器人任务、LIBERO-100和LIBERO-Plus上，CoRe-VLA在相机偏移下大幅提升主流VLA任务成功率；例如真实环境中相机偏移1.6m时，PI0.5成功率从13.3%提升至83.3%。
AI.conclusion: CoRe-VLA能有效缓解VLA在相机偏移下的脆弱性，无需额外数据或微调，具有即插即用和广泛适用性。

title: Causal-EVC: Breaking Emotional Spurious Causality via Spatiotemporal Grounding and Counterfactual Intervention
summary: Emotional Video Captioning aims to generate factually accurate and emotionally empathetic descriptions. While recent methods have recognized the importance of visual causes to guide emotion perception and caption generation, they fundamentally rely on simple attention matching, which inevitably suffers from {causal redundancy and spurious correlations} in co-occurrence bias (e.g., misclassifying ``sadness'' as ``joy'' on a sunny beach), leading to severe shortcut learning from confusing backgrounds. Furthermore, existing evaluations fail to verify whether models have genuinely mastered causal reasoning or merely exploited background confounders. To address these limitations, we first construct {EVC-CauseGround}, a comprehensive benchmark with dense spatio-temporal causal annotations. Crucially, it introduces a carefully selected {Causal-Faithfulness Subset} to explicitly quantify genuine emotion-cause attribution. Second, we propose {Causal-EVC}, an emotion-grounding captioning framework, which introduces a Motion-guided Causal Spatiotemporal Localization module to precisely decouple causal triggers from background confounders. Besides, we introduce an Interpretable Sparse Emotion Routing module. By synthesizing counterfactual representations and formulating a novel counterfactual contrastive objective, we enforce the model to anchor its emotion predictions strictly on authentic causal triggers instead of confusing background. Extensive experiments show that Causal-EVC not only achieves the best performance on semantic metrics but also exhibits significant advantages in the causal-faithfulness subset, which demonstrates that our model could mine emotional cues from genuine visual causes and mitigate co-occurrence bias for interpretable multimodal emotion understanding.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对情感视频描述中的因果冗余和虚假相关问题，构建了EVC-CauseGround基准并提出Causal-EVC框架，通过运动引导因果时空定位和反事实对比学习，提升模型对真实情感原因的因果忠实度。
AI.motivation: 现有情感视频描述方法依赖简单注意力匹配，易受共现偏差影响，导致因果冗余和虚假相关，且评估无法验证模型是否真正掌握因果推理。因此需要新基准和框架来促进因果忠实的情感理解。
AI.method: 构建带有密集时空因果标注的EVC-CauseGround基准，包含因果忠实子集；提出Causal-EVC框架，包括运动引导因果时空定位模块、可解释稀疏情感路由模块，并合成反事实表示和引入反事实对比目标。
AI.result: Causal-EVC在语义指标上达到最佳性能，在因果忠实子集上优势显著，表明模型能从真实视觉原因中挖掘情感线索并缓解共现偏差。
AI.conclusion: 该工作实现了可解释的多模态情感理解，推动了情感视频描述中因果推理的研究。

title: Grounded Revision vs. Prior Injection: Probing Retrieval-Augmented Patent Claim Amendment
comment: Accepted to Findings of AACL-IJCNLP 2026. 9 pages, 2 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/TeamLab/probing-rag-patent-amendment
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation is widely used in professional writing, yet whether retrieval grounds revision or merely injects templates is rarely tested where "correct" has a definable meaning. Patent claim amendment supplies that signal: the examiner names the attacked limitation and cites prior art, providing per-case ground truth. We release three artifacts: (i) a corpus of 7,385 USPTO prosecution cases with XML-aligned pre/post claims, rejection, and cited prior art; (ii) a seven-probe battery comparing random and structural-match retrieval as two policies under a fixed prompt scaffold; (iii) a deterministic five-channel metric (C1-C3 and C5 in main, C4 supplementary) requiring no LLM evaluation. Across 9,600 pre-registered calls on four frontier LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4, Claude Haiku 4.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-4o-mini), no tested model exhibits detectable classical prior-injection behavior; retrieval effects are small and direction-inconsistent between random and structural retrieval, and the null is unchanged under a dense (semantic) retriever, across retrieval depths k in {1,3,5,10}, and under a paraphrase-sensitive grounding metric. Revision locality reveals a model-specific difference that the template channel misses. The four-cell taxonomy, which we treat as exploratory, leaves the prior-injector cell unoccupied.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用美国专利权利要求修改作为具有明确正确性标准的任务，检验检索增强生成中的检索究竟是为修改提供依据，还是仅注入模板。作者发布USPTO案例语料、七类探测基准和确定性五通道指标，并在四个前沿LLM上进行9600次预注册调用。结果显示，未发现模型表现出经典先验注入行为，检索效应整体较小且方向不一致。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成广泛用于专业写作，但在“正确”有可定义含义的场景中，检索是支撑修改还是仅仅注入模板，仍缺乏严格检验。专利审查中的权利要求修改提供了逐案真值：审查员会指出被攻击的限制并引用现有技术。
AI.method: 发布三类资源：包含7385个USPTO审查案件的语料，具有XML对齐的修改前后权利要求、驳回理由和引用现有技术；比较随机检索与结构匹配检索两种策略的七项探测组合，并固定提示词脚手架；无需LLM评判的确定性五通道指标，其中C1-C3和C5为主，C4为补充。对四个前沿LLM进行9600次预注册调用，并测试密集语义检索器、不同检索深度k为1、3、5、10以及释义敏感的基础性指标。
AI.result: 所有受测模型均未表现出可检测的经典先验注入行为；随机检索与结构检索的效应较小且方向不一致；在密集语义检索器、不同检索深度和释义敏感指标下，零结果保持不变。修改局部性揭示了模型特异性差异，而模板通道未能捕捉这一差异。四格分类法被视为探索性分析，其中先验注入器格未被占据。
AI.conclusion: 在具有明确真值的专利权利要求修改任务中，检索并未表现为经典意义上的先验注入，检索对修改的影响微弱且不稳定。研究提供的语料、探测和指标可作为检验专业写作中RAG是否真正 grounding 修改的基准，并提示需要更细致地区分模型特异性修改局部性与模板注入。

title: Decoding Affective Nuances: Enhancing MLLMs via Hierarchical Emotion Reasoning and Contrastive Discriminative Pruning
summary: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in objective understanding tasks, their performance in affective reasoning still falls significantly short of human standards. We attribute it to a central capability gap: MLLMs are difficult to reliably distinguish semantically proximal emotions based on fine-grained visual evidence, which could be decoupled as two limitations: 1) Insufficient Attribution. The global reasoning paradigm of conventional MLLMs severely dilutes fine-grained emotion cues, where subtle emotional states are usually implicitly encoded, thereby generating emotional misjudgments in complex scenarios. 2) Insufficient Discrimination. Existing methods could only identify regions generally associated with emotions, which fails to distinguish discriminative regions between semantically similar emotions, leading to ambiguous emotion judgements. To overcome these limitations, we present a training-free inference-time optimization framework, named Decoding Affective Nuances (DAN). Specifically, we propose a Hierarchical Emotional Reasoning Chain (HERC) that enhances the insufficient attribution by harmonizing fine-grained scene/object-level cues and performing a soft-gated reasoning. Furthermore, to discriminate between semantically proximal emotions, we design a Contrastive Discriminative Visual Pruning (CDVP), which isolates discriminative visual tokens to reason the final emotion category by computing the absolute discrepancy between the attention distributions of similar emotions. Performances on several benchmarks demonstrate that DAN significantly improves discrimination for affective nuances without consuming additional training resources, especially achieving +10.47% improvements with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on WebEmo25 dataset that contains 25 fine-grained emotion categories.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出免训练推理时优化框架DAN，通过分层情感推理链与对比判别视觉剪枝，提升多模态大模型对细粒度情感的区分能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在客观理解任务上表现优异，但情感推理远不及人类。核心差距在于难以基于细粒度视觉证据可靠区分语义相近的情感，具体表现为：1）归因不足，全局推理稀释细粒度情感线索；2）判别不足，现有方法只能定位情感相关区域，无法区分相似情感间的判别性区域。
AI.method: 提出免训练推理时优化框架DAN，包含：分层情感推理链HERC，通过协调细粒度场景/物体级线索并进行软门控推理，增强情感归因；对比判别视觉剪枝CDVP，通过计算相似情感注意力分布间的绝对差异，分离判别性视觉token以推理最终情感类别。
AI.result: 在多个基准上显著提升情感细微差别的判别能力，且不消耗额外训练资源。在包含25个细粒度情感类别的WebEmo25数据集上，使用Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct取得+10.47%的提升。
AI.conclusion: DAN通过免训练的推理时优化有效缓解MLLM情感推理中归因不足与判别不足的问题，显著提升细粒度情感识别性能，无需额外训练资源。

title: Generating Edit-Inducing Questions for AI Research Manuscripts
comment: Accepted at the DocInsights Workshop @ EMNLP 2026
summary: We study the ability of LLMs to generate edit-inducing questions whose answer will improve a paper draft. On a dataset of paired submission and camera-ready papers from ICLR and NeurIPS, we compare the helpfulness of questions from GPT models with or without full paper context to that of human reviewers. GPT produces more edit-inducing questions and its questions are associated with more extensive edits and cover a broader range of edited content compared to questions from reviewers. However, a much smaller percentage of the GPT questions are edit-inducing. Our analyses confirm that automated questions can be beneficial to authors and highlight an example task where proper attending to long context deteriorates reasoning model ability to produce helpful output.

AI.tldr: 论文研究LLM能否生成有助于改进论文草稿的编辑诱发问题，并与人类审稿人问题进行比较。
AI.motivation: 探索LLM在论文修改辅助中的潜力，尤其是自动生成能引发有效编辑的问题，并比较其与人类审稿意见的差异。
AI.method: 使用ICLR和NeurIPS的投稿版与最终版配对论文数据集，比较GPT模型在有/无全文上下文下生成问题与人类审稿人问题的帮助性。
AI.result: GPT生成更多编辑诱发问题，且这些问题关联更广泛的修改和更多编辑内容；但GPT问题中真正能诱发编辑的比例远低于人类审稿人。
AI.conclusion: 自动生成问题可帮助作者改进论文，同时也揭示了一个长上下文处理反而损害推理模型输出帮助性的示例任务。

title: EgoHumanoid-V2: Human-to-Humanoid Transfer of Coordinated Whole-Body Skills for Loco-Manipulation
summary: Human demonstrations capture diverse scenes and rich whole-body skills without requiring robot teleoperation. Prior work on egocentric transfer has emphasized scene generalization in loco-manipulation under decoupled control, leaving direct transfer of coordinated whole-body skills less explored. We present EgoHumanoid-V2, the first egocentric human-to-humanoid skill transfer framework for coordinated whole-body loco-manipulation. At its core, coarse-to-fine action alignment combines kinematic reference correction with dynamics-aware refinement. It improves end-effector pose accuracy while preserving whole-body coordination. We also use robot-arm rendering and training-time image augmentation to reduce the visual embodiment gap and improve viewpoint robustness. On four real-world tasks, vision-language-action (VLA) policies trained on aligned human data show zero-shot skill transfer without target-task robot demonstrations. Task scores are comparable to those of policies trained on teleoperation data at a lower collection cost. These results support human data as direct skill supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出EgoHumanoid-V2，首个面向协调全身移动操作的自中心人类到人形机器人技能迁移框架，实现零样本技能迁移。
AI.motivation: 人类演示能捕获多样场景与丰富全身技能，无需机器人遥操作；但先前自中心迁移研究多关注解耦控制下的场景泛化，对协调全身技能的直接迁移探索不足。
AI.method: 采用由粗到细的动作对齐，结合运动学参考校正与动力学感知细化，提升末端执行器位姿精度并保持全身协调；利用机器人手臂渲染和训练时图像增强缩小视觉具身差距并增强视角鲁棒性；在经对齐的人类数据上训练VLA策略。
AI.result: 在四个真实任务上，VLA策略无需目标任务机器人演示即可零样本迁移技能，任务得分与遥操作数据训练的策略相当，且数据采集成本更低。
AI.conclusion: 人类数据可作为直接的技能监督信号，支持人形机器人全身移动操作技能学习。

title: SAKI: Maximal-Coupling-Routed Teacher Supervision for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) reduces train-test state mismatch by training a student on its own generated trajectories, but weak students may visit teacher-misaligned prefixes where supervision is less representative. We introduce SAKI (Supervision Allocation with KL-constrained Interpolation), which combines a KL-constrained teacher-guided rollout with maximal coupling and reuses realized accept/correction events to route token-level supervision. Accepted positions retain sampled-token reverse-KL supervision, while correction positions receive direct supervision on the teacher's highest-probability token. Under maximal coupling, the correction probability is exactly TV(p_t, q_t), so the same trust-region radius controls rollout deviation and upper-bounds intervention and specialized-supervision frequency. We further implement an engine-resident speculative verifier that preserves the exact-q trajectory distribution and coupling semantics while improving matched-workload rollout throughput by 4.22x. Across seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks, SAKI improves the matched teacher-guided baseline in Mean@8 and Pass@8 for both 1.7B and 0.6B students. Placement controls and fixed-prefix analysis further support correction-triggered routing as a conflict-adaptive supervision signal.

AI.tldr: 提出 SAKI，一种基于 KL 约束教师引导 rollout 与最大耦合的 on-policy 蒸馏监督分配方法，通过复用接受/纠正事件进行 token 级监督路由，提升弱学生训练效果。
AI.motivation: on-policy 蒸馏虽能减少训练-测试状态不匹配，但弱学生可能进入与教师不对齐的前缀，导致教师监督不具代表性。
AI.method: SAKI 将 KL 约束的教师引导 rollout 与最大耦合结合：接受位置保留采样 token 的 reverse-KL 监督，纠正位置直接监督教师最高概率 token；理论证明纠正概率等于 TV(p_t, q_t)，同一信任域半径可控制 rollout 偏差并限制干预频率。同时实现引擎内投机验证器，保持精确 q 轨迹分布与耦合语义。
AI.result: 投机验证器在匹配工作负载下将 rollout 吞吐提升 4.22 倍；在 7 个数学推理基准上，对 1.7B 和 0.6B 学生，SAKI 在 Mean@8 与 Pass@8 上均优于匹配的教师引导基线；placement controls 和 fixed-prefix 分析支持纠正触发路由作为冲突自适应监督信号。
AI.conclusion: SAKI 能有效分配监督信号，改善弱学生 on-policy 蒸馏性能，且纠正触发路由是一种有效的冲突自适应监督机制。

title: Gödel Forest: Balancing Search Depth and Breadth for Data-Centric Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to achieve compounding gains by having models improve themselves. While most existing RSI systems optimize external agent harnesses or prompts around a frozen base model, data-centric RSI directly updates the model's own parameters by training on agent-generated data. However, because validating data strategies requires expensive model training, existing methods face a fundamental dilemma: a single agent gets trapped in narrow directions and lacks exploration breadth, while naive parallel search or heavy trace sharing sacrifices long-horizon search depth. To address this challenge, we introduce G"odel Forest, a multi-agent framework that organizes recursive self-improvement as an ensemble of co-evolving search trees. In G"odel Forest, each agent autonomously grows a persistent tree, deepening, branching, or pruning data strategies based on model feedback to secure depth, while parallel trees explore distinct regions of the data space to expand breadth. Crucially, rather than leaving trees isolated or flooding them with heavy execution logs, a dynamically co-evolving memory connects the forest: agents continuously distill their successes and failures into compact procedural lessons anchored to a global leaderboard. Through this forest ecosystem, a dead-end in one tree instantly warns the whole forest against unpromising paths, while an empirical breakthrough quickly seeds new exploration branches in neighboring trees. Evaluated on RSIBench-Data across six diverse domains, G"odel Forest outperforms the single-agent baseline by an average of 10.70% while reducing wall-clock time on five tasks. Ablations confirm that co-evolving shared memory yields a +7.00% gain over independent parallel search, demonstrating that collective distillation is key to scalable self-improvement. The code is available at https://github.com/evolvent-ai/Godel-Forest.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Gödel Forest多智能体框架，将递归自我改进组织为协同演化的搜索树森林，在RSIBench-Data六个领域上平均超越单智能体基线10.70%。
AI.motivation: 数据为中心的递归自我改进（RSI）需通过智能体生成数据直接更新模型参数，但验证数据策略需昂贵训练。现有方法面临两难：单智能体易陷入狭窄方向、缺乏探索广度；朴素并行搜索或大量轨迹共享则牺牲长程搜索深度。
AI.method: Gödel Forest将RSI建模为协同演化搜索树集合。每个智能体自主生长持久树，依据模型反馈深化、分支或剪枝以保障深度；并行树探索不同数据区域以扩展广度。关键是用动态协同演化记忆连接森林：智能体将成功与失败蒸馏为紧凑程序性经验并锚定全局排行榜，使一条树的死胡同警告全森林，突破则快速播种新探索分支。
AI.result: 在RSIBench-Data六个多样领域上，Gödel Forest平均比单智能体基线提升10.70%，并在五个任务上减少挂钟时间。消融实验表明，协同演化共享记忆相较独立并行搜索带来+7.00%增益。
AI.conclusion: 集体蒸馏是可扩展自我改进的关键，协同演化记忆能有效平衡搜索深度与广度，推动数据为中心的递归自我改进。

title: Recovering the View: Benchmarking Physical Active Vision for Occlusion Recovery in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Physical active vision allows robots to change their viewpoint when task-relevant observations become unreliable, yet existing manipulation benchmarks provide limited support for studying how policies recover from occlusion during execution. We introduce BAVO-Bench (Bimanual Active Vision under Occlusion), a bimanual active-vision benchmark that systematically controls external visibility through Clean, Stage Occlusion, and Random-time Occlusion conditions, enabling evaluation of both manipulation performance and active visual recovery. Building on this setting, we present A-FAR (Active Future-Aware Recovery), an active-vision policy for joint viewpoint and manipulation control. A-FAR represents moving-camera observations in a unified robot-centric 3D frame and distills relational structure together with its future evolution from a pretrained 4D model, providing the policy with future-aware geometric guidance without requiring future observations at deployment. Experiments across multiple manipulation tasks show that A-FAR improves robustness to both structured and temporally shifted occlusions while maintaining strong performance under clean observations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出BAVO-Bench双主动视觉遮挡基准和A-FAR主动视觉策略，通过统一3D表示与4D模型蒸馏提升操作策略在遮挡下的恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 现有操作基准对策略在执行中如何从遮挡恢复支持有限，而物理主动视觉允许机器人改变视角应对不可靠观测。
AI.method: 构建BAVO-Bench，控制外部可见性为Clean、阶段遮挡和随机时间遮挡三种条件；提出A-FAR，联合视角与操作控制，将移动相机观测统一到机器人中心3D帧，并从预训练4D模型中蒸馏关系结构及未来演化，提供未来感知几何引导而无需部署时未来观测。
AI.result: 多任务实验表明，A-FAR在结构化及时间偏移遮挡下鲁棒性提升，同时在干净观测下保持强性能。
AI.conclusion: A-FAR能有效结合主动视觉与未来感知引导，提升遮挡场景下的操作鲁棒性。

title: Scene Retargeting: Learning Object Placement with Analogical Transfer
summary: Interactive simulations of embodied AI or spatial computing applications build on realistic 3D scenes that support daily activities. However, sparse, irregular layout structures impose scene-specific physical constraints, making it hard to define a generalizable framework for generating similar functional context. We formalize Scene Retargeting as stably transferring the semantically coherent spatial organization across layouts, rather than relying on textual descriptions or pairwise relationships. Our cluster-wise transfer flexibly handles mismatched object instances and adapts to distinctive floor plans. We optimize to preserve the rich semantic context of individual clusters by respecting the spatial distribution of foundation features. We can then impose physical constraints to refine wall contacts, pairwise alignment, or clear passageways and openings. Our framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods on layout generation on the 3D-FRONT dataset, and demonstrates downstream applications including real-to-sim transfer, analogical trajectory transfer, and multi-reference composition.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“场景重定向”（Scene Retargeting）框架，用于在布局之间稳定迁移语义一致的空间组织，从而生成具有功能语义的3D场景，并在3D-FRONT数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 交互式具身AI或空间计算应用需要支持日常活动的真实3D场景，但稀疏、不规则的布局结构带来场景特定的物理约束，难以定义可泛化的生成框架。
AI.method: 将场景重定向形式化为跨布局迁移语义一致的空间组织；采用簇级迁移以灵活处理不匹配的物体实例并适应不同平面图；通过尊重基础特征的空间分布来优化并保留各簇的丰富语义上下文；再施加物理约束以优化墙体接触、成对对齐、通道与开口。
AI.result: 在3D-FRONT数据集的布局生成任务上超越最先进方法，并展示了真实到仿真迁移、类比轨迹迁移和多参考组合等下游应用。
AI.conclusion: 通过簇级迁移和物理约束优化，可以有效、可泛化地跨布局转移语义一致的空间组织，支持多种下游场景生成与应用。

title: Multi-Channel Mitigation of Source-Trust Shortcuts in Fact-Checking RL Agents
summary: Retrieval-augmented fact-checkers often receive a reliability label, such as HIGH or LOW trust, for each evidence source. These labels should adjust the model's confidence and its decision to search for more evidence, while the verdict should follow the evidence content. We introduce TrustSwap, a counterfactual test that swaps, lowers, or removes source labels while keeping every evidence text fixed, and measures its three output channels (the verdict, the confidence, and the search decision) separately. Across untrained and RL-trained models at two scales, three datasets, and two prompts, confidence and search respond to the labels as intended in 49 of 50 comparisons, yet a label change alone alters 4-23% of confident verdicts for Qwen3 models and up to 50% for an existing RL-trained fact-checker. Standard GRPO fine-tuning amplifies this shortcut at 8B in all six settings. To reduce it, we propose trust-swap augmentation (TSA), which trains GRPO on each claim with both its original and its label-swapped evidence under the same gold verdict. At 4B, TSA lowers the verdict flip rate by 7-35% (relative) in four of six settings, keeps accuracy and the intended confidence and search responses, outperforms reward-based alternatives in the main setting, and carries over to an unseen label-removal perturbation. An added consistency reward helps on the trained-on swap but not on unseen perturbations. At 8B, TSA's effect is not detectable, which makes scale the main open question.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TrustSwap 反事实测试，在保持证据文本不变时交换、降低或移除来源可靠性标签，分别考察判决、置信度和搜索决策。结果显示模型通常能按标签调整置信度和搜索，但判决会被标签变化带偏；为此提出 trust-swap augmentation（TSA）以减轻该捷径，在 4B 上部分有效，8B 上效果不可检测。
AI.motivation: 检索增强的事实核查模型会为证据来源获得 HIGH/LOW 等可靠性标签。理想情况下，标签应影响模型置信度和是否继续搜索，而最终判决应依据证据内容。作者担心模型会走捷径，仅凭来源标签而非证据文本改变判决。
AI.method: 提出 TrustSwap 反事实测试：固定所有证据文本，仅交换、降低或移除来源可靠性标签，并分别测量判决、置信度和搜索决策三个输出通道。随后提出 trust-swap augmentation（TSA），用 GRPO 训练模型，使同一 claim 的原始证据与标签交换证据共享同一 gold verdict。还比较了基于奖励的替代方法，并加入一致性奖励。
AI.result: 在未训练和 RL 训练模型、两种规模、三个数据集、两种 prompt 中，置信度和搜索决策在 50 组比较中有 49 组按预期响应标签。但仅改变标签就会使 Qwen3 模型 4–23% 的自信判决翻转，现有 RL 事实核查器最高达 50%。标准 GRPO 微调在 8B 的六个设置中均放大该捷径。4B 上 TSA 在六种设置中的四种将判决翻转率相对降低 7–35%，保持准确率及预期的置信度和搜索响应，在主设置中优于奖励替代方法，并迁移到未见过的标签移除扰动。额外一致性奖励有助于已训练交换，但对未见扰动无效。8B 上 TSA 效果不可检测。
AI.conclusion: 来源可靠性标签应只调节置信度和搜索，而不应改变基于证据内容的判决，但现有模型存在明显标签捷径。TSA 可在部分中小规模设置中减轻该问题且不损害主要性能，但其有效性依赖规模：4B 有收益，8B 不可检测，因此规模是主要未决问题。

title: Remember What You Did: Action-History Memory with Dual-Expert Denoising for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have driven rapid progress in robotic manipulation, demonstrating strong fine-grained control and promising performance on long-horizon tasks. However, many existing VLAs lack explicit access to interaction history, making them vulnerable to perceptual aliasing: similar current observations and robot states at different task stages may induce action ambiguity and lower success rate. Existing methods incorporate temporal or progress cues through feature conditioning, action-prior modification, or sampling guidance. However, methods that jointly fine-tune memory modules and the base VLA incur additional policy-training costs, motivating the separation of trainable history-conditioned steering from frozen base-policy refinement. We propose ActMem-VLA, a dual-expert handover architecture that augments a frozen, fine-tuned VLA with a memory plugin comprising a Mamba-based memory module and a lightweight PreAction Expert (PAE). Specifically, Mamba encodes executed-action history into memory that conditions PAE alongside current context. With these inputs, PAE steers task progression during early, high-noise denoising, then passes the partially denoised action to the frozen Action Expert (AE) to refine action details during the remaining low-noise steps. The fine-tuned base VLA remains frozen throughout training, while only the Mamba module and PAE are jointly optimized. On LIBERO-Mem, ActMem-VLA achieves 80.8\% average success across all ten tasks, compared with 65.2\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 49.5\% for MemoryVLA, while introducing only 3.45\% additional parameters. Across four real-world tasks, it improves the average success rate over $π_{0.5}$ by 28.8\%.

AI.tldr: 提出ActMem-VLA，一种双专家交接架构，在冻结的微调VLA上外挂Mamba记忆模块与轻量PreAction Expert，通过历史条件化引导解决感知混叠问题。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA缺乏对交互历史的显式访问，导致感知混叠：不同任务阶段出现相似的观测与机器人状态时产生动作歧义，降低成功率。现有时间/进度线索方法需联合微调记忆模块与基础VLA，带来额外策略训练成本，因此需要将可训练的历史条件引导与冻结的基础策略精炼分离。
AI.method: 提出ActMem-VLA：在冻结的微调VLA上增加记忆插件，包含Mamba记忆模块和轻量PreAction Expert（PAE）。Mamba将已执行动作历史编码为记忆，与当前上下文共同条件化PAE；PAE在早期高噪声去噪阶段引导任务进展，再将部分去噪动作传给冻结的Action Expert（AE）在剩余低噪声阶段精炼动作细节。训练时仅联合优化Mamba与PAE，基础VLA保持冻结。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-Mem上十项任务平均成功率80.8%，优于π0.5的65.2%和MemoryVLA的49.5%，仅增加3.45%参数量；在四个真实世界任务上，相比π0.5平均成功率提升28.8%。
AI.conclusion: 将可训练的历史条件引导与冻结的基础策略精炼分离，可高效增强VLA的记忆能力，缓解感知混叠并显著提升长时程操作任务成功率，同时保持较低额外参数与训练成本。

title: Seeing What Should Be Heard: Diagnosing and Repairing Cross-Modal Shortcuts in Omni-Modal LLMs
summary: Omni-modal large language models (LLMs) are expected to answer a question using the modality it explicitly refers to. However, existing training paradigms rarely verify whether models actually follow this modality, because multimodal inputs from the same sample often provide redundant evidence for the same answer. In this work, we uncover a pervasive cross-modal shortcut in omni-modal LLMs: when asked an audio-related question, models rely on the image as much as on the audio, and sometimes even more. To systematically diagnose this behavior, we introduce the Factorized Modality Diagnostic, which independently swaps audio and images between samples to isolate each modality's causal contribution. Across two model families in different settings, we find that this shortcut persists throughout supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning post-training, while judge-based RL may further amplify such reliance on irrelevant visual information. Based on this finding, we propose DMC-Repair, which trains models on the same kind of cross-modal swapped samples while assigning supervision according to the modality specified by the question. This prevents models from exploiting the spurious correspondence between modalities within the same clip. Experiments demonstrate that DMC-Repair reduces the image-induced share of the answer effect by 59.9%, effectively suppressing the cross-modal shortcut without compromising audio-question answering performance. The reduction in shortcut reliance generalizes across two model families and zero-shot to an unseen dataset and an unseen benchmark, and persists through subsequent post-training. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DMC-Repair.

AI.tldr: 本文发现全模态大语言模型存在跨模态捷径：回答音频相关问题时过度依赖图像。提出因子化模态诊断方法，并基于此提出DMC-Repair，通过跨模态交换样本和按问题模态监督，将图像诱导的答案效应降低59.9%，且不影响音频问答性能，泛化性好。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态LLM训练范式很少验证模型是否真的遵循问题指定的模态，因为同一多模态样本中不同模态常提供冗余证据，导致模型可能利用跨模态捷径。
AI.method: 提出因子化模态诊断，通过独立交换样本间的音频和图像来隔离各模态因果贡献；提出DMC-Repair，在跨模态交换样本上训练，并根据问题指定模态分配监督，防止利用同一片段内模态间的虚假对应。
AI.result: 发现跨模态捷径在监督微调和强化学习后训练中持续存在，基于评判的RL可能放大对无关视觉信息的依赖。DMC-Repair将图像诱导的答案效应份额降低59.9%，有效抑制捷径且不损害音频问答性能。该效果在两个模型家族中泛化，零样本泛化到未见数据集和基准，并在后续后训练中持续。
AI.conclusion: 全模态LLM存在跨模态捷径问题，DMC-Repair能有效抑制该捷径且不影响性能，具有泛化性。

title: Neural Structural Reasoner: A Brain-inspired Architecture for Reasoning over Structured Knowledge
summary: Structural reasoning, the ability to recognize and make inferences over the relational structure between objects and concepts, is a hallmark of human cognition, yet prevailing methods often collapse relational topology into flat embeddings, cannot discover hidden structure and lack interpretability. We introduce Neural Structural Reasoner (NSR), a brain-inspired network that preserves relational structure directly in the connectivity and dynamics of coupled neuronal populations. NSR draws inspiration from three biological mechanisms: multi-layered architecture for encoding hierarchical knowledge, stable representations of entity and concepts, and path integration for input-driven state inference. At query time, NSR parallelizes computation over candidate relational structures and leverages confidence-weighted scores to perform link prediction. Across standard knowledge-graph benchmarks, NSR achieves competitive accuracy without leading on every dataset, and has lower reported training times than several neural baselines. Because reasoning is implemented through sequences of human-readable neuron activations, NSR affords native interpretability by tracking intermediate inference steps. The model further extracts latent relational hierarchies and compositional rules, demonstrating the brain-inspired architecture as an effective, efficient, and highly interpretable substrate for structural reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出受大脑启发的神经结构推理器NSR，将关系结构保留在耦合神经元群体的连接与动力学中，用于知识图谱链接预测，兼具竞争力、训练效率和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法常将关系拓扑压缩为扁平嵌入，无法发现隐藏结构且缺乏可解释性；结构推理是人类认知的重要能力，因此需要新的类脑架构来直接保留关系结构。
AI.method: NSR借鉴三种生物机制：多层架构编码层级知识、实体与概念的稳定表征、路径积分进行输入驱动的状态推断。查询时并行计算候选关系结构，并用置信度加权评分进行链接预测。推理通过人类可读的神经元激活序列实现，可追踪中间推理步骤，并提取潜在关系层级与组合规则。
AI.result: 在标准知识图谱基准上取得有竞争力的准确率，虽非每个数据集都领先，但训练时间低于若干神经基线；同时具备原生可解释性，可追踪中间推理步骤，并能提取潜在关系层级和组合规则。
AI.conclusion: 类脑架构NSR可作为结构推理的有效、高效且高度可解释的基础。

title: ProgressCompass: Embodied Progress Reward Models Are Lost Without the Right Context
summary: Embodied agents now take on ever longer tasks. For long tasks, knowing only whether a task finally succeeds or fails says little; the steps along the way matter. Progress Reward Models (PRMs) score how far a task has come at every step, and serve as dense rewards, verifiers and monitors. Yet in long tasks the current frame alone often cannot tell how far the task has come, because progress depends on what happened before. We call this problem context-dependent progress estimation. Existing benchmarks on progress estimation mostly focus on short tasks whose progress can be read from the current observation, and whether PRMs can estimate progress when context is needed remains underexplored. We therefore build ContextProgress-Bench, with 24 manipulation tasks for 120 episodes. The benchmark covers three settings: (i) State Recall, where information needed for progress appeared earlier but is not in the current frame; (ii) Sequence Tracking, where steps follow a fixed order, so progress requires knowing which steps are done and which comes next; and (iii) Recurrence Disambiguation, where look-alike frames sit at very different progress. We then run a paired diagnosis: each PRM keeps the same input format in both runs, and in one run its instruction integrates the right context. Even PRMs that read the entire history get lost in estimating progress, yet with the right context the same five models cut their progress error by 77-82%. Embodied PRMs are thus not incapable of progress estimation, but lost without the right context. We therefore propose ProgressCompass, an autonomous agentic loop that reorients an existing PRM and uses current general-purpose VLMs to supply the context the PRM needs. Wrapped in the loop, the same frozen PRM cuts its progress error by 63% and raises its rank agreement by 76%. With such a compass, PRMs estimate progress far better on longer, more complex tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文研究具身智能体长任务中的进度估计问题，指出当前帧不足以判断进度，因为进度依赖历史上下文（上下文相关进度估计）。作者构建了ContextProgress-Bench基准，涵盖状态回忆、序列跟踪和重复消歧三种场景，并发现提供正确上下文后PRM进度误差大幅降低。进而提出ProgressCompass自主智能体循环，利用通用VLM为冻结的PRM提供所需上下文，显著提升长任务进度估计性能。
AI.motivation: 现有进度估计基准多关注短任务，其进度可从当前观测直接读出，而长任务中进度依赖历史上下文，PRM是否具备上下文相关进度估计能力尚不清楚。仅知任务最终成败不足以指导长任务，需要每步的密集进度奖励。
AI.method: 构建ContextProgress-Bench基准，包含24个操作任务、120个回合，覆盖三种设置：状态回忆（所需信息出现在早期帧）、序列跟踪（步骤有固定顺序）、重复消歧（相似帧对应不同进度）。进行配对诊断实验：同一PRM在两种输入格式下运行，其中一次指令整合正确上下文。提出ProgressCompass，一种自主智能体循环，用当前通用VLM为现有PRM提供其所需上下文，重新定向PRM。
AI.result: 即使读取完整历史的PRM也会在进度估计中迷失；但提供正确上下文后，五个模型将进度误差降低77-82%。ProgressCompass循环包裹下，同一个冻结PRM进度误差降低63%，排名一致性提升76%。
AI.conclusion: 具身PRM并非无法进行进度估计，而是缺少正确上下文时会迷失。通过ProgressCompass自主提供上下文，PRM能在更长、更复杂的任务中更好地估计进度。

title: DualTrack: Synchronized speech-gesture generation via symmetric coupling of pretrained priors
summary: Joint speech-gesture synthesis must coordinate two modalities despite limited paired data. Existing approaches often lack bidirectional interaction, have limited language coverage, or simplify body and finger representations. We present DualTrack, which couples pretrained speech and motion priors on a shared 12.5 Hz timeline. Causal adapters exchange previous-packet information, while current-state fusion coordinates the streams before they separately complete sixteen-codebook packets. We evaluate 43 BEAT2 recordings in four languages, with speakers held out from joint training and validation. On the shared English/Spanish inputs, without speech or motion prefixes, DualTrack achieves lower word error rate and full-motion Fréchet Gesture Distance, higher beat consistency and speech naturalness than the evaluated GELINA baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出 DualTrack，一种联合语音-手势合成方法，通过共享时间轴和双向交互机制，在有限配对数据下提升多语言语音与全身动作生成质量。
AI.motivation: 联合语音-手势合成面临配对数据有限的问题，现有方法常缺乏双向交互、语言覆盖有限，并简化身体与手指表示。
AI.method: 将预训练语音和动作先验耦合在共享的 12.5 Hz 时间轴上；使用因果适配器交换前一包信息；通过当前状态融合协调两路流，再分别生成十六码本包。在 43 个 BEAT2 录音、四种语言上评估，并留出说话人用于联合训练和验证。
AI.result: 在共享英语/西班牙语输入、无语音或动作前缀条件下，DualTrack 相比 GELINA 基线取得更低词错误率、全身动作 Fréchet 手势距离，以及更高的节拍一致性和语音自然度。
AI.conclusion: DualTrack 能有效实现双向语音-手势联合合成，并在多语言、有限配对数据设置下优于对比基线。

title: EGSD: Event-Grounded Self-Distillation for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Real-time video understanding requires incrementally maintaining a memory of streaming content, and optimizing this requires dense process signals. On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which lets one model serve as both teacher and student with the teacher receiving additional privileged information such as the question and ground-truth (GT) answer, can supply such token-level signals. However, applying it directly to streaming video raises two problems. (1) The student cannot be optimized end-to-end, where memory is written before the question arrives, yet the teacher scores it with the question-and-GT privilege, misaligning their preferences. (2) Effective-entity memory collapses, where the question-and-GT privilege makes the teacher favor only question-relevant entities, and token-mean averaging over a memory renders its signal invariant to how many entities that memory covers, both driving memory against the streaming need for diversity. To address these issues, we propose Event-Grounded Self-Distillation (EGSD), which characterizes streaming memory as an incremental update over verifiable Events (key visual entities, actions, and details) and targets the two problems on this basis. For problem (1), we adapt the OPSD signal into a multiplicative weight combined with the outcome reward; for problem (2), we re-weight the teacher with Events as privileged information to counter its question-relevance bias, and add an entity-coverage reward to supply the coverage preference the token-mean teacher lacks. Extensive experiments on mainstream online and offline benchmarks show EGSD achieves strong performance, reaching 79.8% on StreamingBench and 73.4% on the OVO-Bench Real-Time track, while memory analysis shows effective-entity recall rises 17.4% at only 6.8% more memory length.

AI.tldr: 本文提出事件锚定自蒸馏（EGSD），将流式视频记忆建模为可验证事件（关键视觉实体、动作与细节）的增量更新，解决在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）直接用于流式视频时的两个问题，并在多个基准上取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 实时视频理解需增量维护流式内容记忆，而优化该过程需要密集的令牌级信号。OPSD虽能提供此类信号，但直接用于流式视频存在两个问题：（1）学生无法端到端优化——记忆在问题到达前已写入，教师却以问题与真实答案的特权信息打分，导致偏好错位；（2）有效实体记忆坍塌——问题与真实答案特权使教师偏向仅与问题相关的实体，且对记忆做令牌均值平均使信号对记忆覆盖的实体数量不变，二者共同削弱流式所需的记忆多样性。
AI.method: 提出事件锚定自蒸馏（EGSD），将流式记忆刻画为对可验证事件（关键视觉实体、动作和细节）的增量更新，并针对两个问题分别处理：针对问题（1），将OPSD信号改编为与结果奖励相结合的乘性权重；针对问题（2），以事件作为特权信息对教师重新加权，以抵消其问题相关性偏差，并加入实体覆盖奖励，以提供令牌均值教师所缺乏的覆盖偏好。
AI.result: 在主流在线与离线基准上的大量实验表明，EGSD表现强劲：在StreamingBench上达到79.8%，在OVO-Bench实时赛道上达到73.4%；记忆分析显示有效实体召回率提升17.4%，而记忆长度仅增加6.8%。
AI.conclusion: EGSD通过事件锚定的自蒸馏框架有效缓解了流式视频中OPSD的偏好错位与实体记忆坍塌问题，在提升实时视频理解性能的同时，以很小的记忆长度代价显著提高了有效实体覆盖，验证了事件级信号在流式记忆优化中的有效性。

title: Battery-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Aggressive Quadrotor Flight
comment: 9 pages, 9 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to ICRA 2027. Supplementary video: https://youtu.be/-JTRXvstFAo
summary: Agile flight tasks such as drone racing and pursuit-evasion require strong acceleration and precise turns, but the available thrust changes as the battery discharges and voltage drops under load. Conservative command limits make this variation easier to tolerate, at the cost of unused performance. We investigate how learned controllers can use that additional thrust while retaining the flight controller's voltage compensation and rate control. Our training simulator couples an identified load-transient battery model to rotor dynamics and firmware saturation. The feedforward policy receives filtered voltage during both training and deployment. Controlled ablations distinguish the benefit of a larger thrust-command range from that of voltage information. On a 38 g Crazyflie Brushless, the resulting policy reduces circle tracking error by 49% relative to stock-authority RL at 3.84 m/s, while preserving easy-task precision. Mean 20-lap race time decreases from 106.22 s to 95.24 s. Compared with a voltage-blind policy with the same increased authority, hardware error and race time are lower by 15.3% and 4.5%, respectively. In simulation, replacing the policy's voltage input with a recording from a different battery condition worsens hard-circle tracking, with a smaller, voltage-dependent effect in racing. Together, these results show where a simple voltage input complements existing actuator compensation in aggressive learned flight.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在敏捷无人机飞行中，如何让学习控制器在保留飞控电压补偿与角速率控制的同时，利用电池放电和负载压降带来的额外推力，从而提升高速跟踪与竞速表现。
AI.motivation: 无人机竞速和追逃等任务需要强加速和精确转向，但电池放电及负载下的电压下降会改变可用推力。保守的指令限制虽能容忍这种变化，却牺牲了性能，因此希望在学习控制器中安全利用这部分额外推力。
AI.method: 构建耦合负载瞬态电池模型、旋翼动力学和固件饱和的训练模拟器；前馈策略在训练和部署时均接收滤波后的电压信息；通过受控消融实验区分更大推力指令范围与电压信息各自的贡献。
AI.result: 在38克Crazyflie Brushless上，策略在3.84 m/s下将圆轨迹跟踪误差较原权限RL降低49%，并保持简单任务精度；20圈平均竞速时间从106.22秒降至95.24秒。相比同样增加权限但无电压信息的策略，硬件误差和竞速时间分别降低15.3%和4.5%。仿真中替换电压输入会恶化困难圆轨迹跟踪，竞速中影响较小但依赖电压。
AI.conclusion: 简单的电压输入可与现有执行器补偿互补，在激进的学习飞行中有效提升性能，并说明其作用主要体现在高推力、高机动场景。

title: MeteoVerse: Unified Weather-Controllable Video World Model
summary: Video world models aim to predict future content from an observed scene while following prescribed camera motion. Real-world scene evolution is determined not only by changes in viewpoint and object dynamics, but also by environmental conditions such as weather, which can substantially alter scene appearance and visibility. Modeling such realistic weather evolution is challenging because the required weather modification depends jointly on the observed and desired weather states. Depending on their relation, the model may need to preserve, introduce, or remove a weather effect. Existing video world models typically leave this weather transition implicit, forcing the generation backbone to infer weather evolution together with scene dynamics and camera motion, which leads to imprecise weather control. To address this limitation, we propose MeteoVerse, a unified weather-controllable video world model that generates future videos from a single sunny or adverse-weather image, conditioned on a weather-free scene description, a target-weather instruction, and a camera trajectory. Rather than conditioning only on the desired weather, MeteoVerse explicitly estimates the observed and target weather states and represents the required weather transition. A transition-aware mixture of weather experts then translates this transition into category-specific residual weather features, unifying weather preservation, introduction, and removal while enabling fine-grained control over introduced weather intensity. We further construct the MeteoVerse dataset with over 50K real-world weather video clips, generated sunny counterparts, disentangled scene and weather descriptions, weather-intensity annotations, and camera trajectories. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantially improved weather controllability while retaining competitive scene consistency and camera-control performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 MeteoVerse，一种天气可控的视频世界模型，可从单张晴天或恶劣天气图像出发，结合无天气场景描述、目标天气指令和相机轨迹，生成未来视频，并显式建模天气转变。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型通常将天气变化隐含在生成过程中，导致天气控制不精确；真实场景演化同时受视角、物体动态和天气影响，而天气修改取决于观测天气与目标天气的关系，可能需要保留、引入或移除天气效果。
AI.method: MeteoVerse 显式估计观测天气状态和目标天气状态，并表示所需天气转变；通过转变感知的天气专家混合模块，将转变转化为类别特定的残差天气特征，统一天气保留、引入和移除，并支持对引入天气强度的细粒度控制。同时构建 MeteoVerse 数据集，包含超过5万段真实天气视频、生成的晴天对应视频、解耦的场景与天气描述、天气强度标注和相机轨迹。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法显著提升了天气可控性，同时在场景一致性和相机控制方面保持有竞争力的表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模天气转变并利用转变感知的天气专家混合，MeteoVerse 实现了统一的天气可控视频世界模型，优于隐含天气建模的现有方法。

title: Semantic Projection for Continual Self-Evolution of Language Agents
summary: Language-model agents increasingly rely on persistent natural-language skills to adapt beyond their frozen model parameters. When a shared skill is repeatedly revised from a non-stationary, heterogeneous task stream, however, improvements for new tasks can overwrite procedures needed for earlier ones. In continual learning, Orthogonal Gradient Descent (OGD) addresses analogous interference by projecting a new-task gradient onto a subspace that locally preserves prior predictions. Natural-language skill revisions, however, have neither gradients nor a canonical vector space in which such a projection can be performed. We introduce \emph{Semantic-Scope Projected Evolution} (SSPE), which transfers the functional principle of gradient projection from parameter space to behavior space. SSPE treats an unconstrained skill revision as a proposed update, identifies acquired capabilities with which it may interfere, and uses the observed gains and regressions to construct a compatible revision rather than merely rejecting the update. This enables one shared skill to evolve across latent and recurring task contexts without exposing semantic domain identities to the evolution model. Across controlled synthetic streams and heterogeneous real-agent benchmarks, SSPE improves final cross-domain competence and mitigates forgetting relative to strong skill-evolution baselines. The evolved skill also retains the strongest average performance after transfer to a different executor model. These results establish semantic projection as a promising principle for stable and adaptive self evolution of language agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Semantic-Scope Projected Evolution (SSPE)，将正交梯度下降中梯度投影的思想从参数空间迁移到行为空间，用于语言模型智能体的持续技能演化，以缓解新任务修订覆盖旧技能的问题。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体依赖持久化的自然语言技能来适应冻结参数之外的任务，但在非平稳、异构任务流中反复修订共享技能时，新任务改进可能覆盖旧任务所需程序。连续学习中的 OGD 通过梯度投影缓解干扰，但自然语言技能修订既无梯度，也无标准向量空间可供投影。
AI.method: SSPE 将无约束的技能修订视为候选更新，识别可能受干扰的已获得能力，并利用观察到的性能提升与退化构建兼容修订，而非直接拒绝更新。它使一个共享技能能在潜在和重复任务语境中演化，且不向演化模型暴露语义领域身份。
AI.result: 在受控合成任务流和异构真实智能体基准上，SSPE 相比强技能演化基线提升了最终跨域能力并减轻遗忘。演化后的技能迁移到不同执行器模型后，仍保持最高平均性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，语义投影是语言智能体实现稳定且自适应自我演化的一种有前景的原则。

title: Taming VLAs under Robot Execution Errors: Self-Compensation and Stress Testing
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies often fail when a robot's executed motion deviates from their commanded action. Such execution errors arise from the robot's mechanics and operating conditions, such as wear and payload changes. We propose self-compensating VLA, a deployment-time adaptation method that enables a VLA policy to pre-compensate for the robot's execution errors when generating commands. Without task rewards or labels, it updates the policy online using the residual between the action commanded by a VLA and the motion executed by the robot. To stress-test VLA robustness across execution conditions that are impractical to cover with physical robots alone, we introduce RoboStress, a controlled simulation benchmark. It combines established joint-level models of friction, backlash, compliance, and gravity-compensation error into seven deployment scenarios whose execution errors depend on the robot's state and motion history. On RoboStress, self-compensating VLA achieves higher average task success than both the base policies and methods that build in robustness during training. On two physical robot arms with different usage histories, it raises the average task success rate by more than 30 percentage points on each arm, and the gains extend to objects not seen in the task demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出自补偿VLA（self-compensating VLA），一种部署时自适应方法，使视觉-语言-动作策略能够根据指令动作与实际执行动作之间的残差在线更新策略，从而预补偿机器人执行误差。同时提出RoboStress仿真基准，用于系统测试执行误差下的VLA鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: VLA策略在机器人实际执行运动偏离其指令动作时往往失败。这类执行误差源于机器人机械特性和运行条件，如磨损和负载变化。仅靠物理机器人难以覆盖足够多的执行条件，因此需要一种无需任务奖励或标签的部署时自适应方法，以及可控的压力测试基准。
AI.method: 提出self-compensating VLA：在部署时利用VLA指令动作与机器人实际执行运动之间的残差在线更新策略，无需任务奖励或标签。并构建RoboStress仿真基准，将摩擦、间隙、柔顺性和重力补偿误差等关节级模型组合成七种部署场景，其执行误差依赖机器人状态和运动历史。
AI.result: 在RoboStress上，self-compensating VLA的平均任务成功率高于基础策略和在训练阶段增强鲁棒性的方法。在两个具有不同使用历史的物理机械臂上，每个机械臂的平均任务成功率提升超过30个百分点，且增益可泛化到任务演示中未见过的物体。
AI.conclusion: self-compensating VLA能够在部署阶段通过执行残差在线补偿机器人执行误差，无需奖励或标签，即可显著提升仿真和真实机器人任务成功率，并改善对未见物体的泛化能力。

title: Distilling Agentic Systems: A Roadmap across Models, Artifacts, and Harnesses
summary: Modern agents increasingly rely on memories, tools, and execution logic, so their competence extends beyond model parameters. This shift exposes a limitation of conventional knowledge distillation, which asks how a student model imitates a teacher model. We define Agent Distillation as the persistent transfer of task-solving knowledge from a teacher agent to a student agent. Our study organizes the field by where transferred knowledge is retained: within the model, as artifacts, through the execution harness, or across substrates. This perspective separates transfer evidence from its outcome and clarifies how knowledge moves between agent components. We develop an evaluation framework that relates retention to causal contribution and deployed utility. Together, these contributions establish a foundation for the reliable, maintainable, and safe development of increasingly complex agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出“智能体蒸馏”（Agent Distillation），即从教师智能体向学生智能体持久迁移任务求解知识，并依据知识保留位置对领域进行组织，同时提出评估框架。
AI.motivation: 现代智能体越来越依赖记忆、工具和执行逻辑，其能力已超出模型参数本身，传统知识蒸馏仅关注学生模型模仿教师模型，存在局限。
AI.method: 将智能体蒸馏按知识保留位置分类：模型内部、作为制品、通过执行框架、跨基底；并构建评估框架，将知识保留与因果贡献及部署效用关联。
AI.result: 该视角区分了迁移证据与其结果，阐明了知识如何在智能体组件之间流动，并给出了连接保留、因果贡献和部署效用的评估框架。
AI.conclusion: 这些贡献为日益复杂的智能体系统实现可靠、可维护和安全的发展奠定了基础。

title: CurvSpec: Adaptive Multi-Curvature Learning for Partial Relevant Video Retrieval
summary: Partially Relevant Video Retrieval (PRVR) seeks to retrieve untrim-med videos containing a moment that matches a text query, without temporal annotations. The relevant moment may last only seconds within a video spanning several minutes, creating an extremely low signal-to-noise ratio that makes PRVR more challenging than standard full-video retrieval. This task presents two intertwined challenges: (1) signal dilution, where coarse global representations blur the brief relevant signal into the dominant irrelevant surroundings;(2) curvature rigidity, where embedding all videos in the same fixed-geometry space distorts representations for videos that range from flat atomic events to deep compositional hierarchies. Existing PRVR methods have improved moment selection and cross-modal matching, but they still typically encode all videos in a single fixed-curvature retrieval space, limiting their ability to model diverse video structures. To address both challenges, we propose CurvSpec, a framework that learns content-adaptive curvature for video retrieval representations rather than imposing a fixed geometric prior. CurvSpec processes features through parallel Euclidean and hyperbolic attention layers, with independently learned curvatures assigned to the hyperbolic layers, and a content-aware fusion mechanism routes each input to its most suitable geometric regime. To further suppress signal dilution, CurvSpec represents each video with semantic centroids whose number is determined by the video's content complexity, projects them onto the learned manifold, and matches each query against its nearest centroid by geodesic distance. Experiments on ActivityNet Captions, TVR, and Charades-STA demonstrate state-of-the-art retrieval performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 CurvSpec 框架，通过内容自适应曲率与语义质心表示，解决部分相关视频检索中的信号稀释和曲率刚性问题。
AI.motivation: 部分相关视频检索中，相关片段可能仅持续数秒而视频长达数分钟，信噪比极低；现有方法通常将所有视频编码在固定曲率检索空间中，难以建模从简单事件到复杂层次结构的多样视频结构。
AI.method: CurvSpec 并行使用欧氏与双曲注意力层，为双曲层独立学习曲率，并通过内容感知融合机制为输入选择合适几何空间；同时用数量由视频内容复杂度决定的语义质心表示视频，投影到学习流形上，并以测地距离将查询与最近质心匹配。
AI.result: 在 ActivityNet Captions、TVR 和 Charades-STA 数据集上取得了最先进的检索性能。
AI.conclusion: 内容自适应曲率与基于语义质心的表示能有效缓解信号稀释和曲率刚性，提升部分相关视频检索效果。

title: Video2Skill: From Streaming Experience to Reusable Embodied Skills
summary: Manipulation behaviors vary widely across objects and scenes, but they share a small set of reusable skills, and planning with these skills helps embodied agents generalize to new tasks. Yet an agent can only plan with skills it knows. Recovering skills from observed experience, the inverse of planning, builds this knowledge over time and yields skill data for training future agents. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) describe individual manipulation events well, but can they organize a stream of events into reusable skills? We formulate this problem as Streaming Embodied Skill Discovery (SESD): a model watches videos in sequence and maintains a persistent skill library that shapes its later decisions. To systematically measure this ability, we introduce Video2Skill, a benchmark that covers robot tabletop manipulation and human kitchen activity and tests three core capabilities: (i) locating manipulation events in time, (ii) grouping events of the same transformation, and (iii) deciding when to reuse an existing skill or create a new one. Across 19 open-source VLMs, many models group events at near-chance level, and scale does not consistently help. Their errors depend on how perception and library updates are coupled: joint models merge distinct transformations into one skill, while models that update the library from text descriptions duplicate recurring ones. Supervised fine-tuning, including our counterfactual library-state rebalancing (CLaRe), improves grouping but exposes a deeper bottleneck: trained models consolidate familiar skills yet rarely expand the library. Their libraries stall below half the reference size, and transformations unseen in training are located in time but almost never given a new skill. Recognizing when existing skills are insufficient thus emerges as the central challenge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出流式具身技能发现问题，并构建Video2Skill基准，评估视觉语言模型能否从连续视频中持续构建可复用技能库。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体可借助少量可复用技能泛化到新任务，但只能规划已掌握的技能；因此需要从观察经验中反推并持续发现技能，而现有视觉语言模型虽能描述单个操作事件，却未必能把事件流组织成可复用技能。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为流式具身技能发现：模型按序列观看视频并维护持久技能库以影响后续决策；构建Video2Skill基准，覆盖机器人桌面操作和人类厨房活动，测试三项能力：定位操作事件、将同一变换事件分组、决定复用旧技能或创建新技能；评估19个开源视觉语言模型，并提出反事实库状态重平衡等监督微调方法。
AI.result: 多数模型分组接近随机水平，规模并不稳定带来提升；联合模型易把不同变换合并为一个技能，基于文本更新库的模型易重复创建技能；监督微调可改善分组，但模型技能库规模常不足参考库一半，训练中未见过的变换虽能被定位，却几乎不会获得新技能。
AI.conclusion: 核心挑战在于模型能否识别现有技能不足并主动扩展技能库；当前视觉语言模型在流式具身技能发现上仍受限，提升技能库扩展与新技能生成能力是未来关键。

title: Lost in Conversation or Lost in Translation? Diagnosing Multi-Turn Degradation in RAG
summary: When conversing with large language models (LLMs), users often begin with a simple question and build towards a multi-hop question through follow-up turns. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and its graph-based variant (GraphRAG) have become the dominant approaches for grounding LLM responses in external evidence, yet both are evaluated almost exclusively on single-turn, fully specified queries. We systematically investigate this evaluation mismatch through a large-scale simulation study. Building on prior work on multi-turn LLM evaluation, we transform questions from multi-hop question answering (QA) benchmarks into underspecified conversations and evaluate ten LLM assistants with eight retrieval systems across 1.5 million simulated conversations. Our findings reveal that multi-turn interaction causes widespread performance degradation, incurring relative performance drops of up to 21% and increasing unreliability by 47%, making RAG systems simultaneously less accurate and less reliable. We identify two distinct failure modes behind this degradation. Systems are either lost in translation, where conversational rephrasing distorts the retrieval query, or lost in conversation, where retrieval succeeds but the LLM fails to synthesize evidence distributed across turns.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了RAG/GraphRAG在多轮对话中的评估错配：将多跳QA问题转化为信息不完整的对话，模拟150万次对话后发现多轮交互会显著降低性能与可靠性，并揭示两类失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG和GraphRAG几乎只在单轮、完整指定的查询上评估，但真实用户往往从简单问题出发，通过多轮追问逐步构建多跳问题，导致评估方式与实际使用场景不匹配。
AI.method: 基于现有多轮LLM评估工作，将多跳问答基准中的问题转化为欠指定对话，评估10个LLM助手和8种检索系统，在150万次模拟对话中开展大规模仿真研究。
AI.result: 多轮交互导致性能普遍下降，相对性能下降最高达21%，不可靠性增加47%，使RAG系统同时更不准确、更不可靠。研究识别出两种失败模式：一是“lost in translation”，即对话改写扭曲检索查询；二是“lost in conversation”，即检索成功但LLM无法综合跨轮分布的证据。
AI.conclusion: 当前RAG/GraphRAG评估忽视了多轮交互，需重视多轮场景下检索与生成的协同问题，改进查询重构与跨轮证据综合能力。

title: LAURA: Knowledge Distillation for Interpretable Ambiguous Clause Identification in Legal Contracts
summary: Legal contracts contain ambiguities that expose enterprises to financial and legal risks. Some ambiguities allow flexible interpretation without triggering disputes, while others lead to significant legal conflicts. This makes identification alone insufficient, and interpretable rationale analysis essential. We propose LAURA, a post-training framework for interpretable ambiguous clause identification. LAURA leverages knowledge distillation with an IRAC-Unlearning prompting technique to transfer knowledge from a teacher LLM to an open-weight student model (<=1B parameters), which is then trained using a joint objective combining classification and rationale generation losses. The framework supports both legal and non-legal stakeholders in making informed decisions about which ambiguities require further attention. Extensive experiments across 7 baselines and 7 open-weight models demonstrate that LAURA with Flan-T5 (250M) delivers state-of-the-art interpretability over all interpretable baselines while matching the identification performance of the best-performing opaque baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LAURA，一种可解释模糊条款识别的后训练框架，通过知识蒸馏和IRAC-Unlearning提示将教师LLM知识迁移到参数不超过1B的开放权重学生模型，并联合优化分类与理由生成。
AI.motivation: 法律合同中的模糊性会使企业面临财务和法律风险。仅识别模糊条款并不足够，因为有些模糊可灵活解释而不引发争议，有些则会导致重大法律冲突，因此需要可解释的理由分析。
AI.method: LAURA采用知识蒸馏和IRAC-Unlearning提示技术，从教师LLM向开放权重学生模型迁移知识；学生模型参数不超过1B，并使用分类损失与理由生成损失的联合目标进行训练。
AI.result: 在7个基线和7个开放权重模型上的实验表明，使用Flan-T5（250M）的LAURA在所有可解释基线中取得最先进的可解释性，同时识别性能与最佳不透明基线相当。
AI.conclusion: LAURA能够为法律和非法律利益相关者提供可解释的模糊条款识别依据，帮助其判断哪些模糊性需要进一步关注。

title: DROM: A Language-Guided Diffusion Framework for Multi-Skill Robotic Manipulation
summary: Learning robust manipulation policies for diverse, long-horizon tasks from limited demonstrations remains a fundamental challenge in robotics. We present DROM, a language-guided diffusion framework that enables robots to learn, represent, and compose multiple manipulation skills within a single generative policy. DROM leverages Dynamic Movement Primitives (DMPs) to augment a small set of expert demonstrations into expressive multi-skill datasets, substantially reducing data collection while improving spatial generalization beyond the demonstrated workspace. Building upon Motion Planning Diffusion (MPD), we extend the diffusion architecture to support language-conditioned multi-skill trajectory generation through cross-attention, allowing a single model to generate skill-consistent motions for a diverse set of manipulation primitives, including orientation-sensitive behaviors that are difficult to design using conventional motion planning or hard-coded controllers. For long-horizon manipulation, a large language model decomposes high-level operator requests into executable sequences of skills, enabling natural language interaction and autonomous task execution. We validate DROM on a Franka Emika Panda robot, a FANUC CRX25ia robot, and in MuJoCo simulation across a wide range of manipulation tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that DROM outperforms Motion Planning Diffusion and Behavior Cloning baselines, achieves robust multi-skill generalization, and composes learned skills to reliably execute long-horizon manipulation tasks from natural language instructions using only a limited number of human demonstrations. Datasets, simulation environments, and more at https://github.com/automation-robotics-machines/drom.

AI.tldr: DROM是一个语言引导的扩散框架，能够在单个生成策略中学习、表示和组合多种操作技能，从有限演示中实现长时程任务。
AI.motivation: 从有限演示中学习多样、长时程任务的鲁棒操作策略是机器人领域的根本挑战。
AI.method: 利用动态运动基元（DMPs）增强少量专家演示生成多技能数据集；扩展运动规划扩散（MPD）架构，通过交叉注意力支持语言条件多技能轨迹生成；使用大语言模型将高级指令分解为技能序列。在Franka Panda、FANUC CRX25ia和MuJoCo中验证。
AI.result: DROM优于MPD和行为克隆基线，实现鲁棒的多技能泛化，并能从自然语言指令组合技能可靠执行长时程操作任务，仅需少量人类演示。
AI.conclusion: DROM能够从有限演示中学习、表示和组合多种操作技能，实现语言引导的长时程自主任务执行。

title: RED: Reconstruction Evolution Dynamics for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: The rapid evolution of image generators calls for forensic cues that generalize beyond known generation mechanisms. Existing detectors often rely on static image representations or endpoint reconstruction discrepancies, leaving the evolution of intermediate reconstruction stages underexplored.
