We observe that the relative token predictability of real and generated images can reverse across reconstruction scales, suggesting that intermediate stages may expose forensic evidence overlooked by endpoint comparisons. Motivated by this observation, we propose RED (Reconstruction Evolution Dynamics), a framework that captures transferable forensic cues from coarse-to-fine reconstruction evolution. To our knowledge, RED is the first framework to use scale-wise token predictability to guide forensic evidence aggregation across intermediate reconstruction states. It represents the reconstruction trajectory produced by a frozen multiscale VQ-VAE in the shared feature space of a frozen CLIP encoder. To connect the observed predictability variations with visual evidence, RED learns image-adaptive stage weights from scale-wise token negative log-likelihoods provided by a frozen VAR model. A cross-stage evidence aggregation module then jointly models the original-image representation and the weighted reconstruction features, capturing complementary forensic cues through interactions along the reconstruction trajectory. Experiments on six diverse benchmarks demonstrate that RED achieves the highest average accuracy of 92.5\% and average precision of 97.5\% among the evaluated methods. Further evaluations show strong robustness to common image degradations, supporting the value of reconstruction evolution for generalizable AI-generated image detection. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance of this paper.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RED框架，利用多尺度重建过程中token可预测性的变化动态来检测AI生成图像，在六个基准上取得92.5%平均准确率和97.5%平均精度。
AI.motivation: 现有检测器多依赖静态图像表示或端点重建差异，忽略了中间重建阶段的演化信息；研究发现真实与生成图像的相对token可预测性会随重建尺度发生反转，提示中间阶段蕴含被忽视的取证线索。
AI.method: RED将冻结的多尺度VQ-VAE重建轨迹映射到冻结CLIP特征空间，利用冻结VAR模型提供的尺度级token负对数似然学习图像自适应阶段权重，并通过跨阶段证据聚合模块联合建模原图表示与加权重建特征，捕获可迁移的取证线索。
AI.result: 在六个多样化基准上，RED取得最高平均准确率92.5%和平均精度97.5%，并对常见图像退化表现出强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 重建演化动态为通用AI生成图像检测提供了有价值的取证线索，支持该方法在泛化检测中的有效性。

title: RankBuffer: Efficient Ranking-Based Rewards for Open-Ended Generation
summary: Open-ended generation lacks canonical answers, making pointwise rewards difficult to calibrate for group-based reinforcement learning. Directly ranking same-query rollouts provides a more suitable relative reward signal, but existing ranking-based reward methods can incur substantial judging cost. We introduce RankBuffer, which maintains an ordered, query-specific buffer of previously judged responses as a reusable quality scale. Each rollout is first inserted into an anchor interval through an independent coarse judgment, after which only rollouts assigned to the same interval undergo local fine ranking. The resulting complete order is converted into bounded rank rewards, while boundary expansion, local refinement, and inactive-anchor pruning adapt the buffer as the policy evolves. Across four open-ended benchmarks, RankBuffer consistently outperforms all pointwise baselines. It also achieves nearly on-par performance with the strongest ranking-based reward baseline while substantially reducing judging cost. Ablations demonstrate the importance of both local fine ranking and anchor response content, while buffer analyses show that rollout-derived anchors progressively extend and refine the covered quality scale. These results establish response reuse as an effective approach to efficient relative reward construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RankBuffer，通过维护按查询排序的可复用响应缓冲区来低成本构建相对奖励，在多个开放式生成基准上优于 pointwise 基线，并在大幅降低评判成本的同时接近最强排序奖励基线。
AI.motivation: 开放式生成没有标准答案，导致逐点奖励难以校准；直接对同一查询下的多个 rollout 排序能提供更合适的相对奖励信号，但现有基于排序的奖励方法评判成本很高。
AI.method: RankBuffer 为每个查询维护一个有序缓冲区，作为可复用的质量标尺。每个 rollout 先通过独立粗判断插入锚点区间，只有落入同一区间的 rollout 才进行局部精细排序；完整排序被转换为有界排名奖励，并通过边界扩展、局部细化与非活跃锚点剪枝随策略演化自适应调整。
AI.result: 在四个开放式基准上，RankBuffer 持续优于所有 pointwise 基线；与最强排序奖励基线性能几乎相当，但显著降低评判成本。消融实验表明局部精细排序和锚点响应内容都很重要；缓冲区分析显示，由 rollout 产生的锚点会逐步扩展并细化所覆盖的质量范围。
AI.conclusion: 响应复用是一种构建高效相对奖励的有效方法，RankBuffer 证明了其在降低排序评判成本的同时保持较强性能的可行性。

title: FineSID: Scalable and Efficient Semantic Identifier Learning for Generative Recommendation
summary: A critical prerequisite of generative recommendation is designing semantic identifiers (SIDs) that are both scalable to large item sets and efficiently learnable. Existing SID learning methods fundamentally rely on Top-1 hard assignment during vector quantization. While heuristic strategies -- such as clustering-based initialization or forced post-hoc collision resolution -- can artificially inflate codebook coverage, they often disrupt end-to-end semantic alignment and fail to address the underlying optimization bottleneck: sparse gradient propagation. In standard Top-1 assignment, gradients concentrate on a narrow subset of frequently selected codewords, leaving the majority inherently under-trained and causing severe SID collisions. To overcome this limitation natively without relying on complex initialization priors, we propose FineSID, a unified quantization framework that moves beyond Top-1 assignment by enabling fine-grained gradient propagation across the entire codebook. Instead of updating only a single selected codeword, FineSID distributes learning signals to all codewords in a soft, differentiable manner. This design promotes globally balanced codebook optimization while strictly preserving semantic consistency, effectively alleviating SID collisions and stabilizing training in large, high-dimensional codebooks. Extensive experiments on multiple public benchmarks demonstrate that FineSID is robust to initialization configurations and consistently improves both codebook utilization and recommendation accuracy. Our work provides a principled, initialization-agnostic solution for semantic identifier learning, advancing the practicality of generative recommendation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 FineSID，一种用于生成式推荐中语义标识符（SID）学习的统一量化框架，通过将传统 Top-1 硬分配改为面向全码本的细粒度软梯度传播，缓解 SID 冲突并提升码本利用率与推荐准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有 SID 学习方法主要依赖向量量化中的 Top-1 硬分配，导致梯度仅集中于少数高频码字，多数码字训练不足并引发严重 SID 冲突。基于聚类初始化或事后冲突解决等启发式策略虽可提高码本覆盖率，但会破坏端到端语义对齐，且未解决稀疏梯度传播这一根本优化瓶颈。
AI.method: FineSID 不再只更新单个被选中的码字，而是以软性、可微的方式将学习信号分配给码本中的所有码字。该设计旨在促进全局均衡的码本优化，同时严格保持语义一致性，从而减轻 SID 冲突并稳定大型高维码本训练，且不依赖复杂初始化先验。
AI.result: 在多个公开基准上的大量实验表明，FineSID 对初始化配置具有鲁棒性，并能持续提升码本利用率和推荐准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为语义标识符学习提供了一种有原则且与初始化无关的解决方案，增强了生成式推荐的实际可用性。

title: Encore: Few-Shot Agentic Discovery of Manipulation Strategies
summary: Coding agents can now write, run, and debug programs with little human help. Robot tasks, however, are usually specified by a sentence that leaves out how to grasp, in what order to make contact, and what the result should look like, and an agent given only the sentence must find these details by trial and error. We introduce ENCORE, which gives the agent a few demonstrations as evidence to read rather than as training data. A deterministic builder distills each demonstration into a pack of multi-view keyframes, gripper events, frame strips, and the full trajectory. A coding agent studies the pack, writes a policy program against a fixed perception and action API, refines it iteratively over a few development rollouts, and freezes it before a sealed evaluation that never reveals the success signal. On LIBERO-PRO, the agent's first program already succeeds in half of the perturbed tasks with demonstrations and in one task without them, and the frozen programs outperform the strongest prior agentic system run with the same language model (96.3% against 89.3%). On RoboDojo tasks whose instructions leave the goal unstated, no program succeeds without demonstrations. ENCORE also runs on a real bimanual robot, learning cube handover and cup inversion from five demonstrations each.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ENCORE，将少量演示作为可阅读证据而非训练数据，让编码智能体据此编写并迭代机器人策略程序，并在仿真与真实机器人任务上验证效果。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体已能自主写、运行和调试程序，但机器人任务通常仅由一句话指定，缺少抓取方式、接触顺序和预期结果等细节，智能体只能通过试错发现这些信息，效率低且困难。
AI.method: ENCORE 使用确定性构建器将每个演示蒸馏为多视角关键帧、夹爪事件、帧条和完整轨迹组成的证据包；编码智能体研究该证据包，基于固定感知与动作 API 编写策略程序，经过少量开发 rollout 迭代优化，并在不暴露成功信号的密封评估前冻结程序。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-PRO 上，智能体首个程序在有演示时已成功完成一半扰动任务，无演示时仅完成一个任务；冻结程序以 96.3% 超过相同语言模型下最强先前智能体系统的 89.3%。在指令未说明目标的 RoboDojo 任务上，无演示时没有程序成功。ENCORE 还在真实双臂机器人上运行，仅用每个任务五个演示学会方块交接和倒杯。
AI.conclusion: 将演示作为编码智能体可阅读的证据，可有效弥补机器人任务指令中的细节缺失，使程序化策略在扰动仿真任务和真实双臂操作任务上取得成功，并优于先前智能体系统。

title: ATTUNER: Recomputation-Free KV Cache Reuse via Query-Side Adaptation
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents repeatedly load reusable content, such as skills, documents, and memory entries, into the current context. Re-encoding this content for every request wastes computation. Position-independent caching (PIC) alleviates this by encoding each artifact independently and reusing its key-value (KV) states at arbitrary positions, but it incurs a quality loss relative to full-context prefill. Existing methods repair this loss by restoring global position IDs or recomputing selected tokens. In this work, we isolate the source of the loss, finding that the positional mismatch has minor effect, and independently cached artifacts retain faithful representations: reading a provided artifact stays largely accurate, and performance degrades only when the model must select among multiple artifacts. Moreover, replacing PIC's attention scores with full-prefill scores recovers performance with the cached KV unchanged, localizing the failure to the attention rather than KV recomputation. Motivated by this, we propose \textsc{Attuner}, a query-side adaptation method that learns to read a frozen artifact cache. \textsc{Attuner} inserts low-rank adapters into the query projections and is trained by distilling full-prefill distribution into the student. It trains fewer than 0.05\% of the model parameters and, at inference, requires neither cache recomputation nor a full-context reference. On Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across seven benchmarks covering skills, documents, memory, and code, \textsc{Attuner} substantially outperforms prior PIC baselines in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, matches full-context prefill quality while providing up to $3.73\times$ speedup.

AI.tldr: 本文分析位置无关缓存（PIC）导致质量下降的原因，发现主要问题在注意力而非KV表示，并提出Attuner：一种只训练查询侧低秩适配器、蒸馏全上下文分布的方法，使冻结的缓存可被有效读取，在多个基准上超过已有PIC方法并接近全上下文预填质量。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体反复加载技能、文档和记忆等可复用内容，重复编码浪费计算。PIC可独立编码并在任意位置复用KV状态，但相比全上下文预填存在质量损失。现有修复方法需恢复位置ID或重算部分token，成本较高。
AI.method: 作者先隔离质量损失来源，发现位置不匹配影响较小，独立缓存内容仍保持较忠实表示；失败主要出现在多内容选择时的注意力。通过将PIC注意力分数替换为全预填分数可恢复性能且KV不变。基于此提出Attuner，在查询投影中插入低秩适配器，通过蒸馏全预填分布训练学生模型，仅训练少于0.05%参数，推理无需重算缓存或全上下文参考。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上，覆盖技能、文档、记忆和代码的七个基准中，Attuner在域内和域外设置均显著优于先前PIC基线，匹配全上下文预填质量，并提供最高3.73倍加速。
AI.conclusion: PIC的质量损失主要源于注意力读取而非KV缓存本身；通过查询侧轻量适配即可让冻结的工件缓存被有效利用。Attuner以极低训练成本和高效推理，实现了接近全上下文预填的性能与显著加速。

title: Towards Spatial Perception for Heterogeneous Robot Collaboration in Subterranean Mining Environments
summary: The autonomous extraction of deep mineral deposits in abandoned underground mines is fundamentally a multi-agent integration problem. No single platform simultaneously offers the mobility to traverse kilometers of degraded drifts and the sensing payload required to characterize an ore body. This article presents the onboard perception pipeline that bridges two heterogeneous agents within the PERSEPHONE autonomous mining mission. Which consist of a lightweight Explorer robot that maps an unknown mine and generates a 3D scene graph of inspection targets, by running a zero-shot, vision-language semantic segmentation stack that detects mineral deposits directly from natural-language prompts. The map and the graph are then handed to a second Inspector robot, which carries an advanced sensing payload and uses them to plan close-range inspection viewpoints. We detail the complete pipeline, with emphasis on the geometric abstraction that turns raw detections into actionable inspection targets, spanning per-view bounding-box generation, cross-view box merging, plane fitting, and polygon extraction, and we report an extensive field validation in a subterranean test facility and in an active magnesite mine, covering both iron-vein and magnesite mineralization under realistic, perceptually degraded conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了PERSEPHONE自主采矿任务中连接Explorer与Inspector两个异构机器人的机载感知流程：Explorer通过零样本视觉-语言语义分割构建矿井3D场景图并标记 inspection 目标，Inspector据此规划近距离检测视角，并在真实矿井环境中验证。
AI.motivation: 废弃地下矿井深部矿产的自主开采本质上是多智能体集成问题，单一平台难以同时具备长距离退化巷道移动能力与矿体表征所需传感载荷，因此需要异构机器人协同。
AI.method: 提出一套机载感知流程：轻量Explorer机器人利用自然语言提示进行零样本视觉-语言语义分割，检测矿藏并生成3D场景图；随后将地图和场景图交给搭载高级传感载荷的Inspector机器人，用于规划近距离检测视角。重点包括几何抽象流程：单视角边界框生成、跨视角框合并、平面拟合与多边形提取。
AI.result: 在地下属测试设施和活跃菱镁矿中进行了广泛现场验证，覆盖铁矿脉和菱镁矿化，并在真实且感知退化的条件下测试了完整流程。
AI.conclusion: 该异构多智能体感知与规划流程能够将原始检测转化为可执行的检测目标，支持Explorer与Inspector协同完成地下矿井自主矿产勘查与检测任务。

title: Distilling What Matters: Confidence-Aware Selective Distillation for Large Language Models
summary: Knowledge Distillation (KD) trains a smaller-capacity student model to imitate a larger-capacity teacher model by matching output distributions, implicitly assuming the teacher to be a reliable oracle. In large language models (LLMs), this assumption often fails: teacher predictions can exhibit high entropy and hallucinations, causing standard KD to degrade well-calibrated student priors. We propose CaRE-KD, a confidence-gated distillation framework that replaces static objectives with uncertainty-adaptive optimization. CaRE-KD has two components: a token-level loss (CaRE-Divergence) that adaptively switches between Forward and Reverse KL divergence based on teacher--student confidence, and a batch-level epistemic rejection mechanism (Revival) that suppresses updates when the teacher is more uncertain than the student. We provide a gradient-level analysis showing how this dual-granularity design induces a conditional calibration mechanism that prior static divergences cannot reproduce. Empirically, across eight teacher--student pairs and eleven benchmarks spanning instruction following, chat alignment, code generation, and mathematical reasoning, CaRE-KD delivers consistent gains over strong baselines (Skewed-KL, $α$--$β$ divergence). Highlights include up to $+3.2$ average ROUGE-L on instruction-following tasks, $+2.1$ pass@1 on MBPP, $+1.7$ accuracy on GSM8k, and $+1.8$ accuracy on CollegeMath over the strongest baseline, with consistent gains in LLM-as-a-judge factuality (up to $+2.5$ per task over Skewed-RKL). Revival further acts as a principled, loss-agnostic plug-in that systematically strengthens existing distillation objectives by filtering epistemically unreliable teacher supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出CaRE-KD，一种基于置信度门控的知识蒸馏框架，通过不确定性自适应优化缓解大语言模型教师不可靠导致的蒸馏退化。
AI.motivation: 传统知识蒸馏假设教师模型是可靠神谕，但在大语言模型中教师预测常具有高熵和幻觉，静态蒸馏目标会破坏学生模型良好校准的先验。
AI.method: CaRE-KD包含两个组件：token级的CaRE-Divergence根据师生置信度在Forward KL与Reverse KL间自适应切换；batch级的Revival认知拒绝机制在教师比学生更不确定时抑制更新。作者还提供梯度级分析，说明该双粒度设计形成条件校准机制。
AI.result: 在8组师生模型和11个基准上，涵盖指令跟随、对话对齐、代码生成和数学推理，CaRE-KD一致优于Skewed-KL与α-β散度等强基线。最高提升包括：指令跟随任务平均ROUGE-L +3.2、MBPP pass@1 +2.1、GSM8k准确率 +1.7、CollegeMath准确率 +1.8，LLM-as-a-judge事实性最高每任务 +2.5（相对Skewed-RKL）。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性自适应蒸馏能有效提升LLM知识蒸馏的鲁棒性与性能；Revival可作为与损失无关的通用插件，通过过滤认知不可靠的教师监督来增强现有蒸馏目标。

title: Learning via Self-Consistency for Diffusion-based Video Reasoning
comment: 23 pages, including 10 pages for the main body
summary: Video generation models have demonstrated emerging zero-shot capabilities for visual reasoning, perception, and other vision tasks. However, diffusion-based video generation is inherently stochastic, while many downstream vision tasks are deterministic. Motivated by the effectiveness of self-consistency in chain-of-thought reasoning for large language models, we investigate whether self-consistency can similarly improve diffusion-based video reasoning. We first introduce a training-free test-time scaling method that samples multiple video generations and aggregates their predictions through self-consistency. Specifically, we aggregate extracted paths, locations, or masks from multiple rollouts into a consensus prediction. To reduce the inference overhead of multi-rollout generation, we read out predictions early in the denoising trajectory, which preserves consensus quality while reducing denoising steps by more than half. We further propose Rejection Fine-Tuning (RFT) to distill consensus predictions into the video generation model. The resulting model internalizes the benefit of multi-sample consensus and requires only a single generation at inference time, while substantially outperforming the original model. Experiments on three tasks, including maze solving, visual search, and referring segmentation, show that both our self-consistency inference and consensus distillation dramatically improve video-based perception and reasoning, without requiring ground-truth videos or task-specific verification. For visual search, self-consistency raises task accuracy from 48.4% for a single generation to 99.0%. The distilled model retains much of the consensus benefit with a single rollout. For 4-by-4 maze solving, consensus-based training improves the single-generation strict success rate from 72.0% to 84.0% with the same inference latency.

AI.tldr: 论文研究将自一致性方法用于基于扩散的视频生成模型，以提升视觉推理与感知任务表现。方法包括免训练的多轮采样共识推理，以及将共识蒸馏进模型的Rejection Fine-Tuning，从而在单次生成时仍保留性能提升。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型已展现零样本视觉推理能力，但扩散式视频生成具有随机性，而许多下游视觉任务需要确定性输出。受大语言模型思维链中自一致性有效性的启发，作者探索自一致性是否能改善基于扩散的视频推理。
AI.method: 提出免训练测试时扩展方法：对同一任务采样多个视频生成结果，并从多次 rollout 中提取路径、位置或掩码，聚合成共识预测。为降低多轮生成开销，在去噪轨迹早期读取预测，在保持共识质量的同时减少一半以上去噪步数。进一步提出 Rejection Fine-Tuning（RFT），将共识预测蒸馏到视频生成模型中，使模型在推理时仅需单次生成。
AI.result: 在迷宫求解、视觉搜索和指代分割三个任务上，自一致性推理与共识蒸馏均显著提升基于视频的感知和推理，且无需真实视频或任务特定验证器。视觉搜索中，任务准确率从单次生成的48.4%提升到99.0%。蒸馏模型在单次 rollout 下仍保留大部分共识收益。4×4迷宫求解中，基于共识的训练在相同推理延迟下将单次生成严格成功率从72.0%提升到84.0%。
AI.conclusion: 自一致性可用于扩散视频生成模型的测试时推理，聚合多轮预测能显著提高确定性视觉任务表现；通过共识蒸馏，模型可将多采样共识收益内化，在单次生成时仍获得明显性能提升。

title: FP2: Equipping Robotic Foundation Models with Force Control
summary: Robotic foundation models (RFMs) are increasingly capable of general-purpose manipulation, yet reliable physical interaction remains challenging in contact-rich settings. We present FP2, a lightweight downstream interface that equips task-adapted RFMs with explicit force control while preserving their action-generation capability. FP2 adopts an action-regulation decomposition: the task-adapted RFM serves as a foundation policy responsible for task-level action generation, while a high-frequency force control policy focuses solely on interaction regulation. To condition force regulation on the ongoing manipulation, FP2 compresses foundation-policy contextual representations and combines them with wrench and proprioceptive histories to predict structured force-control parameters. We evaluate FP2 with four RFM backbones across four real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks. FP2 consistently improves task performance and force regulation quality over the corresponding foundation policies, while comparing favorably with representative force-aware and force-control baselines. Ablations further show that foundation-policy context and physical feedback are complementary for effective force regulation, while preserving foundation-policy action generation improves both efficiency and novel-object generalization. Project website: http://force-policy.github.io/fp2

AI.tldr: 提出FP2，一种轻量级下游接口，为任务适配的机器人基础模型增加显式力控制，同时保留其动作生成能力，在真实接触丰富操作任务中提升性能与力调节质量。
AI.motivation: 机器人基础模型虽具备通用操作能力，但在接触丰富场景中可靠物理交互仍困难，缺乏显式力控制。
AI.method: 采用动作-调节分解：任务适配RFM作为基础策略负责任务级动作生成，高频力控制策略专注交互调节；压缩基础策略上下文表示，并结合力/力矩与本体感知历史，预测结构化力控制参数。
AI.result: 在4种RFM骨干和4个真实接触丰富操作任务中，FP2持续优于对应基础策略，并与代表性力感知和力控制基线相比表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 消融表明基础策略上下文与物理反馈互补；保留基础策略动作生成可提升效率和新物体泛化能力。

title: FairDiff: Mitigating the Self-Reinforcing Matthew Effect in Diffusion Recommender Models
summary: While the "Matthew Effect" and filter bubbles are widely recognized outcome-level biases in recommender systems, we reveal that Diffusion Recommender Models (DRMs) uniquely compound this issue through their generative dynamics. Rather than merely inheriting data imbalances, DRMs trigger a self-reinforcing amplification of popularity bias. We identify that this phenomenon is driven by two compounding mechanisms. First, while optimization loss is universally dominated by high-frequency items across recommenders, DRMs suffer from a unique structural prior mismatch during generation. Because the forward terminal distribution of long-tailed data deviates significantly from the standard Gaussian prior, reverse sampling trajectories inherently collapse toward high-density popular items, fundamentally suppressing niche item generation. To dismantle this self-reinforcing loop, we propose FairDiff, a plug-and-play fairness-aware diffusion framework. To overcome the popularity-dominated loss, we introduce Popularity Condition Guidance (PCG). Rather than altering the training objective, PCG acts as an inference-time distributional reweighting mechanism, mathematically reshaping the score-based gradient field to penalize high-popularity regions and guide trajectories toward niche semantics. Furthermore, we design a Semantic Calibration (SC) Module to bridge the prior mismatch, aligning the forward and reverse distributions via one-step optimal transport. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that FairDiff achieves state-of-the-art performance while effectively mitigating the self-reinforcing Matthew Effect, highlighting its value as a general framework for DRMs.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示扩散推荐模型（DRMs）会通过其生成动态独特地放大流行度偏差，形成自强化的马太效应；作者提出即插即用的公平性扩散框架FairDiff来打破这一循环。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统中的马太效应和过滤气泡已被广泛认为是结果层面的偏差，但本文进一步探究：DRMs是否不只是继承数据不平衡，而是会通过生成过程主动、自强化地放大流行度偏差。
AI.method: 作者识别出两个复合机制：一是优化损失普遍受高频物品主导，二是DRMs存在结构性先验不匹配，即长尾数据的前向终端分布显著偏离标准高斯先验，导致反向采样轨迹坍缩到高密度热门物品。为此提出FairDiff：Popularity Condition Guidance（PCG）作为推理时分布重加权机制，通过数学方式重塑基于score的梯度场，惩罚高流行度区域并引导轨迹走向长尾语义；Semantic Calibration（SC）模块通过一步最优传输对齐前向与反向分布，以弥合先验不匹配。
AI.result: 综合评估表明，FairDiff在达到最先进性能的同时，有效缓解了自强化的马太效应。
AI.conclusion: FairDiff可作为DRMs的通用公平性框架，在不改变训练目标的情况下，通过推理干预和分布校准缓解流行度偏差。

title: VAA-CSEC: Vote-guided Advantage Allocation for Chinese Semantic Error Correction
summary: Chinese Semantic Error Correction (CSEC) targets semantic errors in Chinese text, which are typically more subtle and complex than spelling and grammatical errors but remain relatively underexplored. Existing LLM-based approaches face two recurring obstacles in this task: over-correction, and unclear interaction between Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning and self-consistency decoding, such that the benefits brought by CoT cannot be reliably transferred to final corrections. We propose Vote-guided Advantage Allocation for CSEC (VAA-CSEC), a multi-stage framework that combines CoT distillation, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Reinforcement Learning (RL) and self-consistency decoding. During RL, we design a task-specific reward function that directly aligned with the minimal-editing principle of CSEC. We further introduce Group-Level Relative Policy Optimization (GLPO), which reallocates GRPO advantages according to the margin between individual rollout rewards and the vote-aggregated group reward, aligning the RL training objective with the self-consistency objective used at inference time. Experiments on CSED-C and NaSGEC-Exam show that VAA-CSEC outperforms all LLM-based baselines on CSED-C with an F0.5 of 47.72%, achieves the highest recall of 42.15% among all methods, and establishes a new state of the art of 41.55% F0.5 on NaSGEC-Exam.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VAA-CSEC框架用于中文语义纠错，通过结合CoT蒸馏、SFT、强化学习与自一致性解码，并设计奖励函数与GLPO优化策略，在CSED-C和NaSGEC-Exam上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 中文语义纠错（CSEC）中的语义错误比拼写和语法错误更隐蔽复杂，但研究不足。现有基于LLM的方法面临两个问题：过度纠正，以及思维链（CoT）推理与自一致性解码之间交互不清晰，导致CoT带来的收益无法可靠地传递到最终纠正结果中。
AI.method: 提出VAA-CSEC多阶段框架，融合CoT蒸馏、监督微调（SFT）、强化学习（RL）和自一致性解码。在RL阶段，设计了一个与CSEC最小编辑原则直接对齐的任务特定奖励函数。进一步提出组级相对策略优化（GLPO），根据单个rollout奖励与投票聚合的组奖励之间的差距重新分配GRPO优势，使RL训练目标与推理时使用的自一致性目标对齐。
AI.result: 在CSED-C和NaSGEC-Exam上的实验表明，VAA-CSEC在CSED-C上以47.72%的F0.5优于所有基于LLM的基线，召回率达到42.15%为所有方法中最高，并在NaSGEC-Exam上以41.55%的F0.5创造了新的最优结果。
AI.conclusion: VAA-CSEC通过将RL训练目标与自一致性解码目标对齐，有效缓解了过度纠正问题，并成功将CoT推理收益转移至最终纠正，在中文语义纠错任务上取得了领先性能。

title: Motion Concept Unlearning in Video Diffusion Models
comment: Accepted to ACM MM 2026. Dr. Chi Zhang is the corresponding author
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models can generate realistic depictions of actions such as kicking, stabbing, and shooting, raising safety concerns that motivate targeted concept erasure. Although concept erasure has been extensively studied for static concepts in text-to-image and T2V models, erasing motion concepts remains largely unexplored. We present a systematic study of motion concept erasure in video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs). Through causal interventions, we show that text-conditioning attention carries concept-specific motion information and supports selective intervention, whereas perturbing temporal positional encoding suppresses both target and non-target dynamics. We further find that directly adapting ESD, a representative weight-level image erasure method, to a video DiT yields modest and uneven motion suppression: reducing its erasure training loss does not by itself remove the concept signal from the difference between the conditional and unconditional predictions, which classifier-free guidance (CFG) then scales at every denoising step. From these findings, we derive three requirements for motion concept erasure: concept specificity, spatial selectivity, and temporal naturalness. Each determines one component of MUTE (Motion concept Unlearning in Text-to-video gEneration): at each denoising step, MUTE extracts a concept direction through token neutralization, derives a spatial gate from the direction's intrinsic structure, and subtracts the resulting correction from the velocity output before CFG is applied. MUTE is training-free and requires no weight modification. Experiments on 20 motion concepts show that MUTE outperforms representative prompt-level, weight-level, and inference-time baselines on Wan2.1-T2V, and the same formulation transfers to CogVideoX, supporting its applicability across distinct T2V attention architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究视频扩散Transformer中的运动概念擦除，提出免训练方法MUTE，在不修改模型权重的情况下选择性擦除指定动作概念。
AI.motivation: T2V模型能生成踢、刺、射击等动作，引发安全担忧；静态概念擦除已有较多研究，但运动概念擦除仍待探索。直接迁移ESD效果有限且不均匀，因为概念信号仍存在于条件与无条件预测之差中，并被CFG逐步放大。
AI.method: 通过因果干预发现文本条件注意力携带概念相关运动信息且可选择性干预，而扰动时间位置编码会同时抑制目标和非目标动态。据此提出运动概念擦除三要求：概念特异性、空间选择性、时间自然性，并设计MUTE：每步去噪时经token中和提取概念方向，由方向内在结构生成空间门，在CFG前从速度输出中减去校正；该方法免训练且无需修改权重。
AI.result: 在20个运动概念上，MUTE在Wan2.1-T2V上优于代表性提示级、权重级和推理时基线；同一形式也可迁移到CogVideoX，说明其适用于不同T2V注意力架构。
AI.conclusion: 运动概念擦除应满足概念特异性、空间选择性和时间自然性；通过推理时的概念方向提取与空间门控修正，可有效擦除运动概念，并具有跨T2V架构的可迁移性。

title: Rethinking Multimodal Fake News Detection in the Generative AI Era
summary: Generative content is increasingly entering the production and dissemination of news, transforming fake news from manually fabricated or simply manipulated material into complex forms in which native and generated content jointly participate. Existing multimodal fake news detection research primarily focuses on veracity assessment and rarely characterizes how generativity differences affect the reliability of evidence. In contrast, AIGC detection primarily determines whether content is generated or modified by generative models, but it does not by itself establish whether the underlying news event is true. To bridge the separation between these tasks in data and evaluation, we construct Weibo26, a multimodal fake news detection dataset for generative-content scenarios. On this basis, we propose the Generativity-Aware Hierarchical Reasoning (GAHR) framework, which combines global judgment with local correction so that generativity information participates in news-veracity reasoning. Experiments on multiple existing fake news detection benchmarks and Weibo26 show that GAHR achieves competitive veracity-detection performance while effectively identifying generative content.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对生成式内容进入新闻领域后假新闻形式更复杂的问题，构建了面向生成内容场景的多模态假新闻检测数据集Weibo26，并提出Generativity-Aware Hierarchical Reasoning（GAHR）框架，将生成性信息融入新闻真实性推理，在多个基准上取得有竞争力的检测效果并能识别生成内容。
AI.motivation: 生成式内容正越来越多地参与新闻生产与传播，使假新闻从人工编造或简单篡改演变为原生内容与生成内容混合的复杂形态。现有研究多侧重多模态假新闻的真实性判断，较少刻画生成性差异对证据可靠性的影响；而AIGC检测虽能判断内容是否由生成模型产生或修改，却不能直接证明新闻事件本身是否真实。二者在数据和评估上存在割裂。
AI.method: 构建Weibo26，一个面向生成式内容场景的多模态假新闻检测数据集。提出Generativity-Aware Hierarchical Reasoning（GAHR）框架，将全局判断与局部校正相结合，使生成性信息参与新闻真实性推理。在多个现有假新闻检测基准和Weibo26上进行实验。
AI.result: 实验表明，GAHR在多个假新闻检测基准和Weibo26上取得了有竞争力的真实性检测性能，同时能够有效识别生成式内容。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过数据集与GAHR框架桥接了多模态假新闻检测与AIGC检测之间的任务和数据割裂，说明将生成性信息纳入分层推理有助于在生成内容场景下进行假新闻真实性判断。

title: Anisotropic Representations Improve Planning in JEPA World Models
summary: Latent world models learn action-conditioned dynamics in representation space and often score candidate actions by Euclidean distance to a goal representation. Joint training typically regularizes the representation to prevent collapse, but the resulting representation geometry also determines how terminal errors are weighted during planning. We show that accurate prediction and noncollapsed representations do not guarantee a task-aligned latent planning cost: isotropic Gaussian regularization can induce a geometry that ranks feasible outcomes differently from the task cost. To address this mismatch, we introduce AnisoWM with $Λ$Reg, which replaces the fixed isotropic Gaussian target with a learnable diagonal covariance under fixed-trace and anisotropy constraints. The prediction objective, predictor architecture, and Euclidean planner remain unchanged; the target is used only during training. Our analysis characterizes the prediction-driven allocation of target variance, its dependence on the training distribution, and the conditions under which the induced metric reduces planning regret. Across four visual control environments, AnisoWM improves planning success over LeWorldModel in all four. Its latent planning cost also shows better agreement with task outcomes. Project website: https://rkdrn79.github.io/AnisoWM-page/

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AnisoWM 与 ΛReg，用可学习对角协方差替代各向同性高斯正则，使潜空间规划的欧氏代价更符合任务代价，从而提升视觉控制中的规划成功率。
AI.motivation: 潜世界模型常以到目标表示的欧氏距离选择动作，但联合训练中的表示正则化会影响潜空间几何，进而决定终端误差如何被加权。准确预测且表示不坍缩并不保证潜空间规划代价与任务代价一致；各向同性高斯正则可能诱导出与任务排序不一致的几何。
AI.method: 提出 ΛReg：将固定的各向同性高斯目标替换为可学习的对角协方差，并施加固定迹与各向异性约束。预测目标、预测器结构和欧氏规划器保持不变，仅训练时使用该目标。论文还分析目标方差如何由预测驱动分配、如何依赖训练分布，以及诱导度量在何种条件下降低规划遗憾。
AI.result: 在四个视觉控制环境中，AnisoWM 的规划成功率均优于 LeWorldModel（四个环境全部提升）；其潜空间规划代价与任务结果的一致性也更好。
AI.conclusion: 通过调整潜空间正则化的协方差几何，可使潜空间欧氏规划代价更好地对齐任务代价，从而在不改变模型架构与规划器的情况下提升基于潜世界模型的规划性能。

title: Surgical Master Console Using General-Purpose Robot Arms and a Separable Articulated Distal Interface: Porcine In-Vivo Evaluation
summary: High-performance surgical master consoles offer intuitive articulated manipulation but are expensive and difficult to reproduce, while accessible commercial haptic devices lack built-in interfaces for surgical wrist articulation and continuous grasp. We present a laparoscopic master in which general-purpose robot manipulators provide the programmable base and surgical-specific interaction is concentrated in a separable distal adapter. Each 6-DoF arm carries a custom 2-DoF direct-drive wrist, continuous grasp sensing, and clutch-based workspace management; the complete bimanual hardware costs approximately US$5,500, below common bimanual commercial haptic references. To support sustained hand-guided use, we characterize current scaling, gravity, and break-away friction and use them for posture-dependent gravity compensation and motion-gated assistance, reducing continuous actuation and thermal loading. A common master state drives either Isaac Sim or an RCM-constrained dual-FR3 platform. Master-state publication to FR3 target update adds at most 8 ms, and tip tracking shows 0.31-0.66 mm mean delay-aligned residuals. In a porcine cholecystectomy experiment, five common operator-side metrics and hand/tip-speed distributions were compared descriptively with human in-vivo telemetry from 120 clinical Versius recordings of 99 cholecystectomy procedures; no interruption originated from the master console, and no abnormal clinical signs were recorded during the 7-day postoperative observation period. These results demonstrate a surgical master built from general-purpose robot arms with surgical-specific interaction concentrated in a separable distal interface.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种低成本腹腔镜手术主操作端：以通用机械臂为可编程底座，将手术专用交互集中在可分离远端适配器中，实现双臂操作、连续抓持感知和离合器式工作空间管理。
AI.motivation: 高性能手术主控台虽操作直观，但价格昂贵且难以复现；普通商用触觉设备又缺少手术腕部关节和连续抓持接口。因此需要一种兼顾可及性、可编程性和手术专用交互的替代方案。
AI.method: 每条6自由度机械臂加装定制2自由度直驱腕、连续抓持传感和离合器式工作空间管理，双臂硬件成本约5500美元。作者表征电流缩放、重力和启动摩擦，并用于姿态相关重力补偿和运动门控辅助。同一主端状态可驱动Isaac Sim或RCM约束的双FR3平台，并开展猪胆囊切除术实验，与120例临床Versius胆囊切除记录进行描述性比较。
AI.result: 主端状态发布到FR3目标更新最多增加8 ms；末端跟踪的平均延迟对齐残差为0.31–0.66 mm。猪胆囊切除术中，主控台未导致操作中断，术后7天观察未记录异常临床体征。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，可以用通用机器人臂构建手术主操作端，并将手术专用交互集中在可分离远端接口中，为低成本、可复现的手术主控方案提供了可行性。

title: On-Policy Visual Evidence Distillation
comment: 44 pages, including appendices. Project page: https://sylvain-wei.github.io/ReVuE/ . Code: https://github.com/sylvain-wei/ReVuE
summary: Visual agents solve problems by interleaving reasoning with image operations, and on-policy distillation (OPD) provides guidance from a strong teacher on student-generated interaction trajectories. However, image operations change the evidence available for subsequent reasoning, so local errors in evidence acquisition (Acquire), reading (Read), or answer grounding (Ground) can propagate through the trajectory and lead to incorrect answers. Existing multimodal OPD methods primarily construct or contrast auxiliary views of the original image to strengthen supervision, without explicitly modeling the connections between student actions, resulting observations, and subsequent reasoning. This limits their ability to provide corrections tailored to different failure stages. We introduce Reflection on Visual Evidence (ReVuE), an on-policy distillation method for visual agents. ReVuE compares multiple student-generated trajectories for the same query, summarizes the observed visual evidence, and diagnoses the first failure across the Acquire, Read, and Ground stages. The resulting reflections provide training-time context for the teacher. We group and reweight token-level distillation losses according to how strongly these reflections affect the teacher's predictions. This design translates trajectory-level evidence diagnosis into targeted token-level supervision, guiding students to improve their visual evidence acquisition and reasoning. Across 11 benchmarks spanning the Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3.5 model families, ReVuE outperforms all evaluated OPD baselines in weighted-average scores for perception, mathematical reasoning, and general tasks. ReVuE also reduces redundancy in reasoning and tool calls while improving tool-call accuracy and task accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/sylvain-wei/ReVuE

AI.tldr: 提出 ReVuE，一种面向视觉智能体的在线策略蒸馏方法，通过诊断学生轨迹中 Acquire、Read、Ground 阶段的首个失败，将轨迹级视觉证据反思转化为 token 级蒸馏监督，提升感知、数学推理和通用任务表现。
AI.motivation: 视觉智能体通过交错推理与图像操作解决问题，但图像操作会改变后续推理可用证据，局部证据获取、读取或答案 grounding 错误会在轨迹中传播并导致错误答案。现有在线策略蒸馏方法主要构建或对比原图辅助视图来加强监督，未显式建模学生动作、观察结果与后续推理之间的联系，难以为不同失败阶段提供定制纠正。
AI.method: ReVuE 对同一查询比较多条学生生成轨迹，总结观察到的视觉证据，并诊断 Acquire、Read、Ground 阶段中的首个失败。生成的反思作为训练时上下文提供给教师，并按反思对教师预测的影响程度对 token 级蒸馏损失进行分组和重加权，从而将轨迹级证据诊断转化为有针对性的 token 级监督，引导学生改进视觉证据获取与推理。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL 和 InternVL3.5 两个模型家族的 11 个基准上，ReVuE 在感知、数学推理和通用任务的加权平均分上优于所有评估的 OPD 基线。同时，ReVuE 减少了推理和工具调用中的冗余，并提高了工具调用准确率与任务准确率。
AI.conclusion: ReVuE 通过将轨迹级视觉证据失败诊断与 token 级蒸馏监督相结合，能够更有效地指导学生改进视觉证据获取和推理能力。代码已开源。

title: JudgeProfile: Understanding and Steering Subjectivity in LLM Judges
summary: LLM judges are inherently subjective, often favoring different responses in pairwise comparison when neither option is objectively wrong. To study this subjectivity, we introduce JudgeProfile, a framework that dissects LLM evaluation into perception (how a judge compares two responses across specific attributes like clarity, correctness, and detail) and prioritization (how much each attribute influences the final choice). We curate SubjectiveSet, a dataset of 50,013 response pairs from 17 public data sources, evaluated by 21 LLM judges across 87 attributes. We find a hidden consensus in perception: judges frequently agree on attribute judgments even when their overall choices diverge. Building on this separation, we first characterize each judge's prioritization using attribute weights estimated from its own overall choices. These weights differ across judges even when estimated from the same attribute judgments. We then learn new weights from reference labels to adapt their decisions to a target evaluation standard. Reweighting perceived attributes improves average held-out agreement with reference labels from 66.48% to 71.97%, outperforming fine-tuning and rubric prompting. Our findings show that understanding and steering the subjectivity of LLM judges requires attention not only to what they perceive, but also to how they prioritize it.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出JudgeProfile框架，将LLM评判分解为感知和优先级，并构建SubjectiveSet数据集，发现评判者在感知上存在共识但优先级不同，通过重新加权可提升与参考标签的一致性。
AI.motivation: LLM评判者具有主观性，在成对比较中常偏向不同回复，即使两个选项客观上都不错。为了研究这种主观性。
AI.method: 提出JudgeProfile框架，将评判分解为感知（跨属性比较两个回复）和优先级（各属性对最终选择的影响权重）。构建SubjectiveSet数据集，包含来自17个数据源的50,013对回复，由21个LLM评判者在87个属性上评估。通过估计属性权重表征优先级，并从参考标签学习新权重以适配目标评估标准。
AI.result: 发现感知存在隐藏共识：评判者在属性判断上常一致，即使整体选择不同。优先级权重因评判者而异。重新加权感知属性后，平均留出集与参考标签一致性从66.48%提升至71.97%，优于微调和提示方法。
AI.conclusion: 理解和引导LLM评判者的主观性，不仅需要关注他们感知到什么，还需要关注他们如何 prioritization（优先级排序）。

title: MLToolBench: Learning Tool-Augmented Agents for Machine Learning Development
summary: Machine learning engineering (MLE) agents have made substantial progress, but learning through ML experimentation remains costly in time and computation. Synthetic environments reduce these costs while introducing variations in data and experimental settings that require task-specific diagnosis. Access to diagnostic tools alone does not ensure that agents learn when to use them or how to act on their findings. We introduce ToolMLBench, a suite of executable tools for data inspection, code verification, and experiment diagnosis, together with an SFT and RL pipeline for learning their use. Diagnostic calls acquire evidence whose value depends on subsequent decisions, so final outcomes provide limited guidance on which calls to reinforce. We address this challenge with SPICE, which measures how privileged context changes the likelihood of a sampled tool action and uses this difference as a turn-level reward alongside the final outcome. We train on 80 synthetic tasks and evaluate on 25 in-domain and 10 out-of-domain tasks. Providing tool interfaces and descriptions alone yields inconsistent gains across unadapted models. With the same diagnostic interface, our training pipeline raises in-domain success from 24.8% to 52.4% for Qwen3-8B and from 35.6% to 69.2% for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. The latter also improves from 31% to 48% out-of-domain, supporting learned diagnostic tool use on held-out sources and targets.

AI.tldr: 提出ToolMLBench可执行工具套件与SPICE回合级奖励方法，通过SFT+RL训练MLE智能体使用诊断工具，在域内和域外任务上显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: MLE智能体训练耗时耗算力，合成环境虽降低开销但引入数据与实验设置差异，需要任务特定诊断。仅有工具接口不足以保证智能体学会何时使用工具及如何根据发现行动；诊断调用的价值取决于后续决策，最终结果难以为其提供有效强化信号。
AI.method: 构建ToolMLBench，含数据检查、代码验证、实验诊断的可执行工具，并设计SFT+RL训练流程。提出SPICE：度量特权上下文对采样工具动作似然的影响，将该差异作为回合级奖励与最终结果奖励结合。在80个合成任务上训练。
AI.result: 仅提供工具接口与描述时，未适配模型提升不稳定。相同诊断接口下，训练流程使Qwen3-8B域内成功率从24.8%升至52.4%，Qwen3.5-35B-A3B从35.6%升至69.2%；后者域外从31%提升至48%。
AI.conclusion: SPICE结合ToolMLBench能有效训练智能体学习使用诊断工具，并在域内及域外（未见的源与目标）任务上均取得提升。

title: Momentum-Coupled Rubric Adaptation for Detailed Image Captioning
comment: 28 pages, natural language processing, computer vision
summary: Detailed image captioning requires accurate and comprehensive descriptions of fine-grained visual content, yet caption quality spans factual accuracy, information coverage, and clarity. Compared with conventional methods that rely mainly on high-quality supervision or holistic rewards, rubric-based reinforcement learning decomposes these requirements into explicit criteria and provides targeted, structured feedback. However, existing methods often use separate models for caption generation, rubric construction, and judging, which may lead to inconsistent interpretations across roles. Some dynamic rubric methods alternate updates between the caption policy and rubric generator while keeping the judge fixed, but staged optimization may still leave rubric construction and judging out of step with policy optimization. We propose MoCo Rubric, a two-stage framework that coordinates these roles. First, role-conditioned, shared-parameter multi-task supervised fine-tuning equips a single vision--language model to serve as the Caption Policy, Rubric Generator, and Rubric Judge. Then, the Generator constructs rubrics online from captions sampled by the current Policy, reference captions, and image evidence. The Judge provides rubric-based rewards, and only the Policy receives GRPO updates. As Policy updates change the candidates being evaluated, we use an exponential moving average of the Policy parameters to update one momentum model shared by the Generator and Judge. This gradual transfer lets both rubric roles track Policy updates without separate RL optimization while smoothing parameter changes that could disrupt their rubric capabilities under direct synchronization. Across five captioning benchmarks, MoCo Rubric achieves an average pairwise win rate of 72.83\%, the best mean rank in blind ranking, and the highest average score in caption-based question answering.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MoCo Rubric，一个两阶段框架，通过共享参数的多任务 SFT 与动量更新机制，协调图像描述生成、评分标准构建和评分判断三个角色，从而提升细粒度图像描述质量。
AI.motivation: 细粒度图像描述需要同时满足事实准确性、信息覆盖度和表达清晰度。传统方法依赖高质量监督或整体奖励，而现有基于评分标准的强化学习方法常使用分离模型分别生成描述、构建标准与评判，导致角色间理解不一致；部分动态标准方法虽交替更新描述策略和标准生成器，但评判器固定，分阶段优化仍可能使标准构建、评判与策略优化不同步。
AI.method: 提出 MoCo Rubric 两阶段框架。第一阶段采用角色条件的共享参数多任务监督微调，使单个视觉语言模型同时充当 Caption Policy、Rubric Generator 和 Rubric Judge。第二阶段中，Generator 基于当前 Policy 采样的描述、参考描述和图像证据在线构建评分标准；Judge 提供基于标准的奖励，仅 Policy 接受 GRPO 更新。由于 Policy 更新会改变候选描述，使用 Policy 参数的指数移动平均更新一个由 Generator 和 Judge 共享的动量模型，使两个标准相关角色逐步跟踪 Policy 更新，同时平滑参数变化。
AI.result: 在五个图像描述基准上，MoCo Rubric 取得平均成对胜率 72.83%，在盲排序中获得最佳平均排名，并在基于描述的问题回答任务中取得最高平均分。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享参数多任务建模与动量式角色协调，MoCo Rubric 能有效缓解生成、标准构建和评判之间的不一致与不同步问题，在多个图像描述评测中优于现有方法。

title: Can AI Scientists Change Their Minds? Prior-Evidence Conflict in Synthetic Universes
summary: Can a scientific agent distinguish a law it inferred from evidence from one it merely recognizes? We introduce Synthetic Universes, a controlled benchmark that pairs canonical famous worlds with matched twisted twins governed by nearby noncanonical mechanisms. We evaluate each reported law twice: by executing it on held-out continuations and transfer settings, and by independently checking whether it recovers the generating mechanism. In the current checkpoint of a pre-specified 60-cell study, 22 trials were graded and one additional run ended in infrastructure failure. Among 20 twin trials, 8 pass predictive verification while 5 recover the generator. The dissociation is bidirectional: six parsable outputs predict successfully while missing the mechanism, whereas three recover the mechanism but fail predictive rollout. Drag exhibits the first pattern (5/5 predictive pass, 1/5 mechanism recovery); Gravity exhibits the second (1/5 predictive pass, 4/5 mechanism recovery). Because matched famous controls, the corrected identifiability sweep, and the Evidence Ladder remain incomplete, we do not claim a confirmatory causal prior-conflict effect. Instead, the completed runs establish a narrower verification result: predictive adequacy and mechanism recovery are distinct scientific claims and require distinct tests.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“合成宇宙”基准，将经典著名世界与受相近非经典机制控制的扭曲孪生世界配对，用于检验科学智能体推断出的定律是否既能预测又能恢复真实生成机制。初步结果显示预测充分性与机制恢复是两个不同科学主张。
AI.motivation: 作者关心：科学智能体能否区分自己从证据中推断出的定律，与仅仅识别出的定律；即预测成功是否等同于真正恢复生成机制。
AI.method: 设计“合成宇宙”受控基准，把典型著名世界与匹配的扭曲孪生世界配对，这些孪生世界由相近但非经典的机制支配。对每条报告定律进行双重评估：一是在保留延续和迁移设置上执行以检验预测；二是独立检查其是否恢复生成机制。
AI.result: 在预设60单元研究的当前检查点中，22个试验已评分，另有1次运行因基础设施故障结束。20个孪生试验里，8个通过预测验证，5个恢复生成器。二者出现双向分离：6个可解析输出预测成功但未命中机制，3个恢复机制但预测推演失败。Drag呈现前者（预测通过5/5，机制恢复1/5）；Gravity呈现后者（预测通过1/5，机制恢复4/5）。由于匹配著名对照、校正可识别性扫描和证据阶梯尚未完成，作者不主张确认性因果先验冲突效应。
AI.conclusion: 已完成运行确立一个较窄的验证结论：预测充分性与机制恢复是不同的科学主张，需要不同的检验。

title: You Cannot Recover What Was Never Measured: Quantifying the Information Ceiling of Ultra-Low-Field MRI Super-Resolution
summary: Generative super-resolution models can turn portable 64 mT MRI into images that look like 3T scans, and the field evaluates them with PSNR, SSIM, and pixelwise uncertainty, most often on pairs built by synthetically degrading high-field images. Prior work acknowledges that these models hallucinate and that the problem is ill posed, but to our knowledge no study measures how much information about the individual subject the real low-field scan actually contains. We measure it. Using paired 64 mT and 3T scans of the same subjects from three public datasets, and a measurement protocol validated on tests whose correct answer is known in advance, we find that, judged over the whole brain, real 64 mT scans carry structure specific to the individual only down to approximately 3 to 4 mm half-pitch in plane, and coarser still through plane. Standard synthetic degradations preserve subject information roughly 1 mm beyond this ceiling, so models trained and benchmarked on synthetic pairs are evaluated on information that real scanners never record. We then test trained diffusion models and a publicly released external model on real paired acquisitions; 24 trained runs of five architectures (GAN, diffusion, and transformer families) give the coverage of the audit. On every subject where faithfulness can be measured, fine output detail is no more correlated with the subject's own 3T scan than with a stranger's, while sample-variance uncertainty does not distinguish fabricated structure from reconstruction difficulty. Because PSNR and SSIM score resemblance to a reference rather than whether detail belongs to the subject, a benchmark scored by them cannot tell recovery from fabrication. Code for the measurement protocol will be released so that recoverability claims can be tested for newer models.

AI.tldr: 研究量化真实64 mT MRI中个体特异信息的含量，发现其仅保留到约3-4 mm半间距，且合成退化配对保留的信息超过真实扫描上限。在真实配对上，多种生成模型输出的细节与本人3T的相关性不高于与陌生人3T的相关性，PSNR/SSIM无法区分恢复与伪造。
AI.motivation: 生成式超分辨可将便携64 mT MRI转成看似3T的图像，但现有评估多基于合成降质配对，并使用PSNR、SSIM和像素不确定性，已知模型会幻觉且问题病态，却未测量真实低场扫描究竟包含多少个体信息。
AI.method: 使用三个公开数据集中同一被试的64 mT与3T配对扫描；采用并在已知正确答案的测试上验证的测量协议，比较真实低场信息上限与标准合成退化保留的信息；测试五种架构、24次训练的GAN、扩散和Transformer模型及一个公开外部模型在真实配对上的表现，并分析输出细节与本人/他人3T的相关性及样本方差不确定性。
AI.result: 全脑范围内，真实64 mT扫描仅能提供平面内约3-4 mm半间距及更粗层间分辨率上的个体特异结构；标准合成退化比该真实上限多保留约1 mm的个体信息。在可测faithfulness的被试上，模型细输出细节与本人3T的相关性不高于与陌生人3T的相关性；样本方差不确定性不能区分伪造结构与重建困难。
AI.conclusion: 基于合成配对的训练与基准测试评估了真实扫描器并未记录的信息；PSNR/SSIM衡量的是与参考的相似度而非细节是否属于该被试，因此无法区分恢复与伪造。作者将公开测量协议代码，以便检验更新模型的可恢复性声明。

title: RAEGNet: Relation-Aware Evidence Graph Network for Harm-Aware Multimodal Fake News Detection
summary: Existing multimodal fake news detection methods often introduce external information to assist detection. However, most of them rely on entity-level retrieval and are therefore prone to introducing event-irrelevant noise. Meanwhile, existing methods mainly focus on improving overall performance and do not account for differences in the degree of harm posed by different instances of fake news. To address these limitations, we design an Event-Level Evidence Retrieval Framework (ELERF) and propose a Relation-Aware Evidence Graph Network (RAEGNet). ELERF retrieves external evidence based on the complete event semantics of a news item. RAEGNet constructs a directed graph that incorporates news-evidence stance relations and evidence-evidence interaction relations, and introduces a conditional-harm branch to jointly model authenticity and potential harm. Experimental results demonstrate that RAEGNet outperforms multiple baseline methods across all evaluated metrics on Weibo-21, Fakeddit, and our self-constructed SSS dataset.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出事件级证据检索框架ELERF和关系感知证据图网络RAEGNet，用于多模态假新闻检测，并联合建模新闻真实性与潜在危害。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多依赖实体级检索，容易引入与事件无关的噪声；同时主要关注整体性能，未考虑不同假新闻实例危害程度的差异。
AI.method: 设计ELERF，基于完整事件语义检索外部证据；提出RAEGNet，构建包含新闻-证据立场关系和证据-证据交互关系的有向图，并引入条件危害分支联合建模真实性与潜在危害。
AI.result: 在Weibo-21、Fakeddit和自建SSS数据集上，RAEGNet在所有评估指标上均优于多个基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 事件级证据检索与关系感知图建模能有效提升多模态假新闻检测性能，并兼顾潜在危害评估。

title: Can Agents Design Libraries for Agents?
comment: 26 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/SprocketLab/librarydesignbench
summary: Agents increasingly build on code written by other agents, and they reimplement rather than reuse, growing the codebases later agents must work in. To measure how well agents design libraries for other agents, we introduce LibraryDesignBench, a two-phase benchmark in which an agent implements a full-featured library from a specification that defines required capabilities and potential use cases without prescribing the design. We evaluate the library through the correctness and simplicity of programs written by three user agents from different model families. The benchmark spans 242 expert-validated programming problems across 15 library-design tasks in four languages. On eleven of the fifteen tasks, agent designers reproduce the abstractions of the human-written production library. Downstream agents adopt agent- and human-written libraries alike but underuse them, reimplementing capabilities the library already provides. Our failure analysis finds that downstream agents write extra code mainly because agent-written libraries are rigid or hard to use, not because capabilities are missing. We also experiment with giving designers more prescriptive, agent-first guidance and having them test their library with subagents; this improves downstream scores and yields simpler programs. LibraryDesignBench provides both a testbed for evaluating library-design practices for agent users and an initial design baseline that improves downstream reuse.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LibraryDesignBench，一个两阶段基准，用于衡量智能体为其他智能体设计库的能力。它让设计智能体根据规格实现库，再由不同模型家族的用户智能体编写程序来评估正确性与简洁性，覆盖 15 个库设计任务、4 种语言和 242 个专家验证问题。
AI.motivation: 智能体越来越依赖其他智能体编写的代码，但倾向于重新实现而非复用，导致代码库膨胀。因此需要衡量智能体如何为其他智能体设计易用、可复用的库。
AI.method: 构建两阶段基准：第一阶段，设计智能体根据只定义能力与用例、不规定设计的规格实现完整库；第二阶段，由来自不同模型家族的三个用户智能体编写程序，通过正确性和简洁性评估库。还进行失败分析，并尝试更规定性的智能体优先指导以及用子智能体测试库。
AI.result: 在 15 个任务中的 11 个上，智能体设计者复现了人类生产库的抽象。下游智能体会采用智能体或人类编写的库，但使用不足，常重新实现库已提供的功能。失败分析表明，额外代码主要源于智能体编写的库僵化或难用，而非能力缺失。更规定性指导与子智能体测试可提升下游得分并产生更简单程序。
AI.conclusion: LibraryDesignBench 为评估面向智能体用户的库设计实践提供了测试平台，并给出了可提升下游复用效果的初步设计基线。

title: GlassFormer: Learning Real-time Glass Segmentation using Radar-Depth Fusion
comment: Accepted for presentation at IEEE IROS 2026. Code available at https://github.com/Suhani92/GlassFormer
summary: Transparent surfaces are ubiquitous in built environments, yet they remain a persistent failure case for robotic perception. RGB cameras perceive the background behind glass rather than the surface itself, while depth sensors such as LiDAR, time-of-flight, and RGB-D often return invalid or background measurements in transparent regions. As a result, systems that rely solely on optical sensing may misinterpret glass walls, doors, or mirrors as free space, compromising safe and reliable navigation. Existing glass segmentation approaches address this by learning visual cues such as reflections, boundaries, and semantic context from RGB images. While effective under favourable lighting and viewing conditions, these cues degrade in low-light environments, under glare, or when glass surfaces are featureless or partially occluded. In this work, we propose a multimodal framework that fuses millimetre-wave radar with RGB-D sensing for real-time transparent surface segmentation. Radar reflects strongly off glass surfaces, providing a geometric cue that remains reliable precisely where vision and depth fail. We exploit this cross-modal inconsistency to generate a radar-guided spatial prior, which is integrated into a lightweight transformer-based segmentation network, GlassFormer, via cross-modal attention. We report results on a mixed-condition test split covering all scene types and a dedicated low-light split designed to stress vision-only methods. GlassFormer achieves 0.88 mIoU on the mixed split, and 0.59 mIoU on the low light split, demonstrating substantial robustness gains over vision-only baselines while maintaining real-time performance on resource-constrained platforms.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种融合毫米波雷达与RGB-D的多模态框架，用于实时透明表面分割，并设计了轻量级Transformer网络GlassFormer，在混合条件和低光场景下均优于纯视觉基线。
AI.motivation: 透明表面（如玻璃墙、门、镜子）是机器人感知的持久失败案例：RGB相机看到的是玻璃后的背景，LiDAR、ToF、RGB-D等深度传感器在透明区域常返回无效或背景测量，导致系统误判为可通行空间，威胁导航安全。现有基于RGB的玻璃分割方法依赖反射、边界和语义线索，在低光、眩光、无纹理或部分遮挡时性能下降。
AI.method: 提出融合毫米波雷达与RGB-D传感的多模态框架。利用雷达对玻璃表面的强反射特性，在视觉和深度失效处提供可靠几何线索；利用跨模态不一致性生成雷达引导的空间先验；通过跨模态注意力将该先验集成到轻量级Transformer分割网络GlassFormer中，实现实时透明表面分割。
AI.result: 在覆盖所有场景类型的混合条件测试集上，GlassFormer达到0.88 mIoU；在专门设计的低光测试集上达到0.59 mIoU。相比纯视觉基线，在保持资源受限平台实时性能的同时，显著提升了鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 融合毫米波雷达与RGB-D可有效弥补视觉和深度传感在透明表面分割中的不足，雷达引导的跨模态注意力机制能够提升低光等困难条件下的分割鲁棒性，并具备实时部署潜力。

title: Does the VGGT Family Need All Its Layers?
summary: Which layers of a feed-forward geometry model are needed to preserve both camera poses and dense 3D structure? We study layer redundancy in VGGT, $π^3$, and VGGT-$Ω$: 3,018 pruned configurations, scored on seven camera-pose and dense-geometry metrics across four indoor and outdoor datasets. Four findings follow: (i) Removable layers cluster in two redundancy regions: a dominant early region and a narrower late one, while deletions spanning the intervening layers are consistently more disruptive. This recurring pattern holds across models, datasets, and metrics, and contrasts with the middle-to-late redundancy commonly reported in the literature. (ii) Within these regions, we observe that the joint degradation from deleting two intervals is approximately the sum of their individual degradations, reducing the number of model evaluations for pruning search from $O(L^4)$ to $O(L^2)$, where $L$ is the aggregator depth. (iii) We find that CKA provides a cheaper representation-based proxy for interval degradation, offering a practical trade-off between pruning quality and calibration cost. (iv) Closed-form linear calibration recovers accuracy after pruning without end-to-end retraining. A least-squares analysis shows that using a shared map for special and patch tokens generally incurs excess reconstruction loss, motivating token-aware recovery. Recovery maps fitted on just 100 calibration scenes generalize to held-out scenes and unseen datasets. The resulting models reduce aggregator parameters by up to 44% while maintaining accuracy comparable to their intact counterparts. Code and experimental results will be available at our project page: https://xian-bei.github.io/vggt-family-layer-redundancy/

AI.tldr: 该论文研究VGGT、π³和VGGT-Ω等前馈几何模型中的层冗余，通过3018种剪枝配置在4个室内外数据集的7个相机位姿与稠密几何指标上评估，发现可移除层集中在早期和晚期两个冗余区域，并提出高效校准恢复方法，最多减少44%的aggregator参数且精度相当。
AI.motivation: 研究哪些层对保持相机位姿和稠密3D结构真正必要，以理解前馈几何模型的层冗余，并为剪枝压缩提供依据；现有文献常报告的中后期冗余模式可能并不适用于这类模型。
AI.method: 对VGGT、π³、VGGT-Ω进行大规模剪枝实验，共评估3018种配置；分析双区间联合退化与单个区间退化的可加性，将剪枝搜索从O(L^4)降至O(L^2)；使用CKA作为区间退化的廉价表示代理；采用闭式线性校准和token-aware恢复，仅用100个校准场景拟合恢复映射。
AI.result: 可移除层聚集在主导的早期冗余区和较窄的晚期冗余区，跨模型、数据集和指标一致，不同于常见的中后期冗余结论；双区间联合退化近似为各自退化之和；CKA可替代昂贵评估；闭式线性校准无需端到端重训即可恢复精度，共享map会导致额外重建损失，token-aware恢复更优；恢复映射可泛化到留出场景和未见数据集，最终模型减少最多44%的aggregator参数并保持与完整模型相当的精度。
AI.conclusion: 前馈几何模型存在结构化层冗余，可通过高效剪枝搜索与轻量校准压缩模型，同时保持相机位姿和稠密几何精度；代码和实验结果将在项目页面发布。

title: BiFE: Search-Efficient Discovery of CPU-Only Branching Policies via LLM-based Bi-Fidelity Evolution
summary: In branch-and-bound (B&B) for mixed-integer linear programming (MILP), branching variable selection critically impacts efficiency. Existing neural branching policies often require GPU inference, while CPU-efficient symbolic expressions lack the representational capacity for complex logic. Large Language Model (LLM)-generated code provides a flexible search space for designing lightweight branching rules with diverse algorithmic logic. To discover effective rules within LLM-based evolutionary frameworks, a core challenge arises: full B&B evaluation on real instances is prohibitively expensive, whereas offline imitation learning suffers from distribution shift. To address this, we introduce a Bi-Fidelity Evolutionary framework (BiFE). It employs low-fidelity imitation scores as a rapid pre-screener and selectively applies high-fidelity on-instance evaluation only to elite candidates, effectively balancing search efficiency with performance reliability. Experiments validate both the search efficiency of BiFE and the competitiveness of its discovered rules, which outperform the SCIP solver and other baselines on CPUs, and even surpass certain GPU-based neural policies.

AI.tldr: 针对MILP分支定界中的分支变量选择问题，提出双保真度进化框架BiFE，利用LLM生成轻量级CPU分支规则，在搜索效率与性能间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有神经分支策略依赖GPU推理，而CPU高效的符号表达式表达能力有限；LLM生成代码虽提供灵活搜索空间，但完整B&B评估代价高昂，离线模仿学习又存在分布偏移。
AI.method: 提出Bi-Fidelity Evolutionary框架（BiFE）：以低保真模仿分数作为快速预筛选，仅对精英候选进行高保真真实实例上的B&B评估。
AI.result: 实验验证了BiFE的搜索效率，其发现的规则在CPU上优于SCIP求解器及其他基线，甚至超越部分基于GPU的神经策略。
AI.conclusion: 双保真度进化方法能有效发现轻量级CPU分支规则，兼顾搜索效率与性能可靠性，为自动设计分支策略提供了可行路径。

title: MultiTalk: Scaling Full-Duplex Speech Models to Long, Multi-Party, Bilingual Conversation
summary: End-to-end full-duplex speech models have brought open-source machine conversation closer to human-like interaction, yet existing systems remain limited in two intertwined dimensions: long-context robustness and multi-party interaction. Real-world scenarios such as meetings, group lessons, and social-robot reception require a single model to track, contextualize, and respond to multiple speakers over extended durations. Progress is constrained by both data and evaluation: open multi-party speech corpora remain small and are not designed for codec-frame-level full-duplex modeling, while existing long-audio benchmarks focus on passive listening and speech-to-speech benchmarks are mostly short and dyadic. We extend the Moshi paradigm jointly along the long-horizon and multi-party axes in English and Chinese. First, we release 57.6k hours of synthetic training data ($\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/MultiTalk/MultiTalkPT}{MultiTalkPT}$ and $\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/MultiTalk/MultiTalkFT}{MultiTalkFT}$) for long-form, multi-party, English-Chinese full-duplex dialogue, with controllable length, participant count, turn-taking, overlap, backchannels, interruptions, addressee shifts, and long-range coreference. Second, we introduce $\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/MultiTalk/MultiTalkBench}{MultiTalkBench}$, built from real human recordings, for evaluating long-form, multi-party, bilingual full-duplex dialogue. Conversations average 32.6 minutes and include probes for long-range entity tracking, topic coherence, and addressee selection. Third, we train a bilingual Moshi-style model that sustains coherent multi-party English-Chinese conversations over extended durations and substantially outperforms open-source baselines including Moshi, MiniCPM-o-4.5, and Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct on MultiTalkBench.

AI.tldr: 该论文面向长上下文与多方交互两大挑战，扩展Moshi范式，发布中英双语长时多方全双工对话合成数据与真实录音评测基准，并训练出可持续进行多方对话的双语模型。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端全双工语音模型在长上下文鲁棒性和多方交互方面仍受限；真实会议、小组课堂、社交机器人接待等场景要求单模型长时间跟踪、理解并回应多个说话人。进展受数据和评测制约：开放多方语音语料小，且不适合codec帧级全双工建模；长音频基准偏被动听，语音到语音基准多为短时双人对话。
AI.method: 沿长时程与多方两个方向扩展Moshi范式，覆盖英语和中文。发布57.6k小时合成训练数据MultiTalkPT和MultiTalkFT，用于长时、多方、中英全双工对话，并可控生成长度、参与人数、轮次、重叠、反馈、打断、受话人切换和长距离指代。构建基于真实人类录音的MultiTalkBench，用于长时、多方、双语全双工对话评测。训练中英双语Moshi风格模型。
AI.result: MultiTalkBench对话平均时长32.6分钟，包含长距离实体跟踪、话题连贯性和受话人选择探针。训练出的双语Moshi风格模型能在长时间中保持连贯的中英多方对话，并在MultiTalkBench上显著优于Moshi、MiniCPM-o-4.5和Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct等开源基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过数据、基准和模型三方面协同推进，该工作提升了全双工语音模型在长时程和多方交互场景下的能力，为中英双语长时多方对话建模提供了新资源与强基线。

title: Contact-Adaptive Robotic Ultrasound Probe Control for Tissue Exploration and Continuous Task-Relevant Visualization Using Robot-Free Image-Motion Demonstration
summary: Robotic ultrasound commonly targets standardized views, predefined scanning protocols, or expert-scan reproduction. We target a different role: while a clinician performs the primary procedure, a robotic assistant maintains a clinician-selected view so that changing tissue remains observable. We present contact-adaptive robotic ultrasound monitoring derived from robot-free demonstrations. Sonologger clamps a six-axis inertial sensor to the clinician-operated probe and records synchronized ultrasound and probe-frame relative rotations without a robot, camera, or tracker. Rather than imitating trajectories, the recordings measure which probe axis and sign the clinician uses to correct an image offset. A measured image latency is removed before still-move-still segmentation yields relative-rotation labels; translation is excluded from control because of inertial drift. These measurements parameterize the Demonstration-Informed Image-Motion Controller (DIMC), an interpretable, non-learned controller combined with beam-axis force regulation and an independent safety supervisor with 5 N forced retreat. On a dynamic bladder phantom, DIMC acquired and held a task-relevant view in 7 of 7 blind, pose-paired trials versus 1 of 7 for a static hold (McNemar p = 0.031), and retained the view during syringe-driven hydro-distension while the supervisor bounded the force excursion. The framework offers an operational representation of ultrasound context for contact-adaptive intraoperative monitoring; clinical validation remains future work.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种免机器人示教的接触自适应超声监测框架：Sonologger 用六轴惯性传感器记录临床医生操作探头时的同步超声与探头相对旋转，提取其纠正图像偏移的轴向和符号，并据此参数化可解释控制器 DIMC；在动态膀胱体模中，DIMC 能在盲法姿态配对试验中获取并保持临床选定视图。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人超声多追求标准化视图、预设扫描协议或复现专家扫描，而临床中还需要一种辅助角色：当医生进行主要操作时，机器人助手维持医生选定的视图，使变化的组织保持可观察。
AI.method: Sonologger 将六轴惯性传感器夹在医生操作的探头上，无需机器人、相机或跟踪器即可记录同步超声和探头坐标系相对旋转；不模仿轨迹，而是测量医生纠正图像偏移时使用的探头轴和符号。去除测得的图像延迟后，通过静-动-静分割生成相对旋转标签，并因惯性漂移排除平移控制。这些测量用于参数化 Demonstration-Informed Image-Motion Controller（DIMC），该控制器可解释且非学习式，并结合束轴力调节和独立安全监督器，在超过 5 N 时强制撤退。
AI.result: 在动态膀胱体模上，DIMC 在 7 次盲法、姿态配对试验中 7 次获取并保持任务相关视图，而静态保持仅 1 次成功，McNemar p = 0.031；在注射器驱动的水扩张期间，DIMC 仍能保持视图，同时安全监督器限制了力超限。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为超声情境提供了一种可操作表示，可用于接触自适应术中监测；临床验证仍有待未来工作。

title: Waggle-Dance-Inspired Multi-UAV Recruitment with RGB and Synthetic Event Vision
summary: The honeybee waggle dance motivates a communication mechanism in which one agent's motion guides the subsequent work of other agents. For aerial robots, realizing this mechanism requires a link from observed movement to a complete message, local task selection, and execution. This paper presents a MuJoCo system for comparing RGB and synthetic event vision within that link. One performer broadcasts six-bit task offers to one to three observers, each of which independently decodes both offers before selecting a task. The RGB receiver extracts trajectories using sparse optical flow; the event receiver uses only local event support and packet timing. Both use a common motion alphabet and explicit null delimiters. Because event silence does not establish target visibility, the event version includes a physical acquisition motion and continuity-qualified null confirmation. In the nominal three-observer case, each version produced 12 complete message receptions, six completed work units, and reassignment after withdrawal of a depleted task. Six paired functional cases produced the same message and work counts; an additional event-stream dropout case preserved inactivity of the affected observer. Replaying 42,060,633 recorded synthetic events reproduced all 12 event-message payloads and completion timestamps. Total nominal mission time was 493.80 s for RGB and 517.40 s for events, with the difference dominated by the event acquisition schedule. These fixed simulation results establish functional feasibility across two receiver implementations, rather than a sensor-performance advantage or hardware validation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于蜂舞通信机制的MuJoCo仿真系统，比较RGB视觉与合成事件视觉在将观察到动作转化为完整任务消息、局部任务选择与执行链路中的表现。
AI.motivation: 受蜜蜂摇摆舞启发，希望让空中机器人通过观察同伴运动来指导后续工作，需要验证从运动到完整消息、再到本地任务选择与执行的通信机制是否可行。
AI.method: 构建MuJoCo系统，一名执行者向1至3名观察者广播六位任务提议；观察者需独立解码。RGB接收端使用稀疏光流提取轨迹，事件接收端仅用局部事件支撑和包时序；两者共享运动字母表和显式空分隔符。事件版因事件静默不能证明目标可见，加入物理采集动作与连续性限定的空确认。
AI.result: 标准三观察者情况下，两种版本均实现12次完整消息接收、6个完成工作单元，并在耗尽任务退出后重新分配。6组配对功能用例的消息与工作计数相同；额外事件流丢包用例使受影响观察者保持不活动。回放42,060,633个合成事件复现全部12个事件消息载荷及完成时间戳。标称任务总时间RGB为493.80 s，事件为517.40 s，差异主要来自事件采集调度。
AI.conclusion: 这些固定仿真结果表明该通信链路在两种接收端实现下具有功能可行性，但并非证明传感器性能优势，也未进行硬件验证。

title: RoXDrive: Closed-Loop Reinforcement Learning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Action-Faithful Rollouts
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving policies are commonly trained via imitation learning on logged demonstrations without observing the consequences of their own actions, leading to causal confusion in closed-loop real-world deployment. To address this issue, reinforcement learning (RL) post-training offers a promising alternative by leveraging world models as interactive training environments to enable future scene generation for policy improvement. Nevertheless, existing approaches either rely on reconstruction-based simulators, offering limited counterfactual interaction, or adopt synthetic simulators to enable long-horizon closed-loop interaction at the cost of a substantial sim-to-real gap. Recently, video world models have exhibited the ability to generate realistic multi-step future rollouts but may not faithfully reflect action conditions, resulting in action-vision mismatch. In this paper, we introduce RoXDrive, a plug-and-play closed-loop RL framework that enables reliable policy optimization by identifying action-faithful world-model rollouts, consisting of two stages: 1) Model pre-training: In addition to imitation-based policy pre-training, we devise an Action-Vision Faithfulness Evaluator for inverse dynamics estimation with our geometry-aware auxiliary trajectory supervision, enabling long-horizon assessment of whether visual dynamics faithfully reflect the conditioning ego actions. 2) Action-faithful RL post-training: Agents iteratively interact with world models to form long-horizon scene rollouts, retaining only action-faithful ones for dense safety-aware scoring and scene-level closed-loop RL post-training. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and an in-house dataset with over 130K training scenarios demonstrate consistent gains across planners, reducing safety violations by 27.6% with DiffusionDrive on nuScenes and 33.7% with Qwen3-VL on the internal data.

AI.tldr: 提出RoXDrive，一种即插即用的闭环强化学习框架，通过识别动作忠实的世界模型推演来可靠优化自动驾驶策略，在nuScenes和内部数据集上显著减少安全违规。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶策略通常通过模仿学习在日志演示上训练，不观察自身动作的后果，导致闭环部署中的因果混淆。现有基于世界模型的强化学习后训练方法存在局限：重建式模拟器反事实交互有限，合成模拟器存在较大虚实差距，视频世界模型可能无法忠实反映动作条件，导致动作-视觉不匹配。
AI.method: RoXDrive包含两阶段：1）模型预训练：除基于模仿的策略预训练外，设计动作-视觉忠实性评估器，通过逆动力学估计和几何感知辅助轨迹监督，实现长时程评估视觉动态是否忠实反映条件自车动作；2）动作忠实强化学习后训练：智能体迭代与世界模型交互形成长时程场景推演，仅保留动作忠实的推演用于密集安全感知评分和场景级闭环强化学习后训练。
AI.result: 在nuScenes和超过13万训练场景的内部数据集上，跨规划器取得一致增益，DiffusionDrive在nuScenes上安全违规减少27.6%，Qwen3-VL在内部数据上减少33.7%。
AI.conclusion: RoXDrive通过动作忠实的闭环强化学习后训练，有效缓解因果混淆和动作-视觉不匹配问题，显著提升自动驾驶策略的安全性，且具有即插即用特性。

title: Learning Social Navigation from Internet Videos in the Policy State Space
summary: Training robust social-navigation policies requires simulators with diverse scene layouts, terrain, and human motion, but constructing such environments and specifying pedestrian behavior is costly. We propose an efficient pipeline that converts ordinary monocular walking videos directly into closed-loop social-navigation training environments in the policy's state space. Our key observation is that local social navigation primarily depends on two types of information: where the robot can traverse and how nearby pedestrians move. We therefore represent the static scene as a metric traversability map, which can be rigidly transformed under counterfactual robot motion, while directly replaying the pedestrian trajectories recovered from the video over time. This abstraction allows us to define the forward dynamics directly in the policy's state space and efficiently simulate counterfactual robot states without reconstructing or rendering photorealistic observations. The resulting policy achieves 81.2% success in the independent Arena benchmark, compared with 75.0% for the strongest baseline, and succeeds in 19/20 real-robot trials without policy fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出一种高效流程，将普通单目行走视频直接转换为闭环社交导航训练环境，并在策略状态空间中训练导航策略，实现较好的仿真基准和真实机器人零微调迁移。
AI.motivation: 训练鲁棒的社交导航策略需要包含多样场景布局、地形和行人运动的仿真器，但构建此类环境并指定行人行为成本高昂。
AI.method: 将单目行走视频转换为闭环社交导航训练环境；把静态场景表示为度量可通行性地图，并可在反事实机器人运动下刚性变换；直接按时间重放从视频中恢复的行人轨迹；在策略状态空间中直接定义前向动力学，从而高效模拟反事实机器人状态，无需重建或渲染逼真观测。
AI.result: 所得策略在独立Arena基准上达到81.2%成功率，最强基线为75.0%；在20次真实机器人试验中成功19次，且无需策略微调。
AI.conclusion: 该抽象化流程能低成本利用普通单目视频生成社交导航训练环境，支持有效策略学习，并展现出良好的仿真到真实机器人迁移能力。

title: BaLEEN: Biasing with Latent Encoded Entities for Context-Aware ASR
summary: Transcribing domain-specific entities and rare proper nouns remains a major challenge in automatic speech recognition (ASR). In this paper, we propose BaLEEN (Biasing with Latent Encoded Entities), a lightweight, hypernetwork-based framework for dynamic contextual adaptation without fine-tuning the underlying ASR model. BaLEEN encodes variable-length contextual keywords using a pretrained language model, compresses them into a fixed sequence of latent vectors via a Perceiver bottleneck, and injects context-dependent bias vectors directly into the intermediate encoder representations of the ASR model. Because both the language model and the backbone ASR model remain entirely frozen during training, BaLEEN operates as a plug-and-play adapter that incurs zero computational overhead at inference time when context biases are precomputed. We evaluate our method on a CTC-based ASR model using a Wikipedia-derived corpus with annotated named entities and synthetic speech. Experimental results demonstrate that BaLEEN reduces keyword miss rate by 8.7% on the test set relative to the unbiased baseline while simultaneously improving overall word error rate by 21% and character error rate by 28%.

AI.tldr: 提出BaLEEN，一种基于超网络的轻量级上下文偏置框架，可在不微调ASR模型的情况下动态适配领域实体和罕见专名，并在CTC ASR上显著降低关键词遗漏率与词/字错误率。
AI.motivation: 自动语音识别中，领域特定实体和罕见专有名词的转写仍很困难，需要一种无需微调底层ASR模型、可动态注入上下文信息的轻量适配方法。
AI.method: BaLEEN使用预训练语言模型编码可变长度的上下文关键词，通过Perceiver瓶颈压缩为固定长度的潜在向量序列，并将上下文相关偏置向量直接注入ASR模型的中间编码器表示。语言模型和骨干ASR模型在训练中保持冻结，因此可作为即插即用适配器，且预计算上下文偏置时可实现推理零额外计算开销。
AI.result: 在基于CTC的ASR模型上，使用带有命名实体标注的Wikipedia衍生语料和合成语音进行评估。相比无偏置基线，BaLEEN将测试集关键词遗漏率降低8.7%，同时将整体词错误率相对改善21%，字符错误率相对改善28%。
AI.conclusion: BaLEEN能够以轻量、免微调、即插即用的方式实现动态上下文自适应，有效提升领域实体和罕见专名的识别效果，并同时改善整体ASR性能。

title: Socialality Anchors: Towards Group-bounded Trajectory Prediction
summary: Trajectory prediction is a key component for understanding human behavior patterns in dynamic scenes. Researchers have devoted substantial efforts to modeling social interactions, especially group-wise interactions, since group membership often reflects shared intention, coordinated motion, and stable mutual adaptation, thus providing a persistent and semantically meaningful social prior for forecasting. However, existing group modeling methods may rely on a fixed threshold and infer groups mainly from agents' relative positions within the observation window, overlooking the fact that grouping rules should be agent-specific, temporally coherent, and context-adaptive across diverse personalities, culturalities, and evolving interaction contexts. Inspired by human social perception that alternates between interpersonal distance in boundary-sensitive situations and relative speed consistency in dynamic interactions, we propose Socialality, a human-inspired trajectory prediction framework with interpretable Socialality anchors and an extended grouping window for stable, context-aware grouping inference. Concretely, Socialality introduces a duo-scalar-controlled grouping kernel Socialality that jointly leverages historical observations and short-term future trajectory previews to learn agent-specific grouping rules, and employs a group-wise perception mechanism to model in-group and out-of-group interactions in an intuitive and explainable manner. Furthermore, we conduct extensive experiments on standard benchmarks to demonstrate the performance gains of Socialality, and provide qualitative analyses and statistical studies of anchor distributions to verify the interpretability and stability of the proposed Socialality anchors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种受人类社交感知启发的轨迹预测框架 Socialality，通过可解释的 Socialality 锚点与扩展分组窗口，实现稳定且情境自适应的分组推断，并分别建模组内与组外交互以提升轨迹预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有群体交互建模方法多依赖固定阈值，主要根据观测窗口内智能体的相对位置推断群体，忽略了分组规则应因智能体而异、在时间上保持一致，并能适应不同个性、文化及动态交互情境。
AI.method: 受人类在边界敏感情境下依赖人际距离、在动态交互中依赖相对速度一致性的启发，提出 Socialality 框架。其核心是双标量控制的 Socialality 分组核，联合历史观测与短期未来轨迹预览学习智能体特定的分组规则；并采用群体感知机制，以直观可解释的方式建模组内与组外交互。
AI.result: 在标准基准上的大量实验表明 Socialality 取得了性能提升；针对锚点分布的定性分析与统计研究验证了所提 Socialality 锚点的可解释性与稳定性。
AI.conclusion: Socialality 能提供稳定、情境自适应且可解释的分组推断，并通过区分组内与组外交互有效提升轨迹预测表现。

title: S2T-Unet: A Structure-to-Style Framework for Inter-Modality MRI Translation
summary: Inter-modality MRI translation aims to synthesize missing MRI modalities from available acquisitions, reducing the need for additional scanning while preserving clinically relevant anatomical information. However, existing image translation methods often learn intensity mappings without explicitly separating modality-invariant structural information from modality-specific appearance, which may lead to structural information loss or unrealistic image details. In this work, we propose S2T-Unet, a structure-to-style framework that explicitly models these two aspects. Specifically, vector quantization is introduced at the lower-level bottleneck to encode modality-invariant structural information using a learned discrete codebook. At higher levels, a modality transformation module uses decoder features to condition and transform encoder representations toward the target modality, thereby recovering modality-specific intensity and contrast information. Experiments on the IXI multi-contrast MRI dataset across four translation tasks demonstrate that S2T-Unet is comparable or outperform with state-of-art method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出S2T-Unet，一种结构到风格的MRI跨模态翻译框架，通过显式分离模态不变的结构信息与模态特定的外观信息，在多个翻译任务上达到或超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有图像翻译方法通常直接学习强度映射，未显式分离模态不变的结构信息与模态特定的外观，可能导致结构信息丢失或生成不真实的图像细节。
AI.method: 提出S2T-Unet框架：在低层瓶颈处引入向量量化，用学习到的离散码本编码模态不变的结构信息；在高层使用模态转换模块，以解码器特征为条件，将编码器表示向目标模态转换，恢复模态特定的强度和对比度信息。
AI.result: 在IXI多对比度MRI数据集上的四个翻译任务中，S2T-Unet与最先进方法相比具有可比性或更优的性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式分离结构信息与风格信息有助于提升跨模态MRI翻译的质量，S2T-Unet能有效保留结构并生成逼真的目标模态图像。

title: Can Language Models Learn to Forecast Stock Prices
summary: Post-training has been shown to significantly improve language models' performance on tasks with verifiable outcomes, including mathematical reasoning, software engineering, and computer use. However, whether the same approach can improve forecasting in financial markets is much less clear. Compared with tasks with verifiable outcomes, not only are realized returns noisy, but even what constitutes a relevant information set for making effective predictions is not obvious a priori: the model must decide which observations to gather and then commit to a numerical judgment before the outcome is known. We study this question in a chronological stock-price sandbox, where a language model gathers price, volume, relative-performance, and market-context evidence and predicts a future return. We post-train Qwen3-4B with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on tool-use demonstrations, then proximal policy optimization (PPO) with a terminal reward given by the forecast score against the realized return. The resulting AURA-4B more than doubles the starting direction--magnitude score, from 20.94 to 43.31, and is comparable to frontier language models on this benchmark. Conditional magnitude agreement rises from 33.3 to 66.2, while directional accuracy changes from 62.9 to 65.4. SFT expands tool use, and PPO further increases the share of ranking and market-context queries. These results show that post-training can substantially improve financial forecasting performance, together with changes in how the model investigates the market, on this outcome-selected benchmark.

AI.tldr: 该研究在按时间顺序的股票价格沙盒中，用SFT和PPO后训练Qwen3-4B，得到AURA-4B，使其金融预测的方向-幅度得分从20.94提升到43.31，接近前沿语言模型水平。
AI.motivation: 后训练已被证明能显著提升数学、软件工程等可验证结果任务上的语言模型表现，但其能否改善金融市场预测仍不明确。金融预测不仅实现收益噪声大，而且模型事前并不清楚哪些信息构成有效预测所需的信息集，还必须先决定收集哪些观测，再在结果未知前给出数值判断。
AI.method: 构建按时间顺序的股票价格沙盒，让语言模型收集价格、成交量、相对表现和市场背景证据，并预测未来收益。先用工具使用示范对Qwen3-4B进行监督微调（SFT），再用近端策略优化（PPO），以预测得分相对实现收益的终端奖励进行训练。
AI.result: AURA-4B将初始方向-幅度得分从20.94提升到43.31，超过两倍，在该基准上可与前沿语言模型相比。条件幅度一致性从33.3升至66.2，方向准确率从62.9变为65.4。SFT扩大了工具使用，PPO进一步提高了排名查询和市场背景查询的占比。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在这个以结果为筛选标准的基准上，后训练不仅能显著提升金融预测表现，也会改变模型调查市场的方式。

title: Distinguish or Homogenize: Last-Chance Policy Identification and Risk-Budgeted Recovery under Irreversible Resource Depletion
summary: Under irreversible resource depletion, an agent can spend resources to distinguish among latent fault models, or to change the system state so that the remaining models admit a common acceptable continuation--at which point further diagnosis becomes unnecessary. This distinguish-or-homogenize principle identifies a path that existing frameworks for identification, planning, and diagnosis do not make explicit: prior formulations treat the mapping from fault models to acceptable policies as a given, whereas LCPI makes it a function of the agent's own actions. We formalize this principle through Last-Chance Policy Identification (LCPI), where correctness is evaluated at the state the agent reaches rather than at the initial state. The Last Identifiable Margin (LIM) marks the feasibility boundary between distinguishing and homogenizing. For deterministic diagnostic graphs we provide the Exact-LIM recursion; for noisy finite-horizon recovery we propose Risk-Budgeted Compatibility Planning (RBCP), which searches a compatibility-aware frontier under a hard worst-case failure constraint. Across incident recovery on abstract microservice topologies and latent-damage navigation in MiniGrid, RBCP improves risk-feasible recovery while satisfying the failure budget. A sham control--cost-matched actions that preserve model incompatibility--eliminates the gain entirely, confirming that the benefit comes from changing which policies are acceptable for which models, not from extra search or additional budget.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“区分或同质化”原则与最后机会策略识别（LCPI）框架，将故障模型到可接受策略的映射视为可由智能体行动改变，并给出确定性图上的 Exact-LIM 递归和噪声有限时域下的风险预算兼容规划（RBCP）。
AI.motivation: 在资源不可逆耗竭的场景中，智能体既要花费资源区分潜在故障模型，也可能通过改变系统状态使剩余模型共享可接受后续，从而无需继续诊断；现有识别、规划与诊断框架未显式刻画这种由自身行动改变可接受策略映射的机制。
AI.method: 形式化 LCPI，在智能体到达的状态而非初始状态评估正确性；用最后可识别边界（LIM）刻画区分与同质化之间的可行性边界；针对确定性诊断图给出 Exact-LIM 递归；针对噪声有限时域恢复提出 RBCP，在硬性最坏情况失败约束下搜索兼容性感知前沿。
AI.result: 在抽象微服务拓扑的故障恢复和 MiniGrid 潜在损伤导航任务中，RBCP 改善了风险可行的恢复表现并满足失败预算；成本匹配但保持模型不兼容的 sham 控制完全消除了收益，表明效果来自改变各模型可接受策略的集合，而非额外搜索或预算。
AI.conclusion: LCPI 将诊断与规划统一为“区分或同质化”的决策问题，说明智能体可通过行动改变可接受策略映射来避免不必要的诊断；LIM 与 RBCP 为资源受限、风险受限场景提供了可行恢复框架。

title: Video2STL: Grounding VLM-Generated Temporal Specifications for Robot Learning
summary: Video-based policy learning is particularly promising, as it illustrates target behaviors without requiring action annotations or embodiment-matched demonstrations. A central challenge is deciding what information should be transferred from the video to the robot. Existing approaches commonly convert visual observations into scalar similarity or value signals, or ask foundation models to directly generate reward code. These approaches can make the temporal structure of a task difficult to inspect, ground, and reuse.
