These results indicate that gender-related biases are common in LLMs. Their direction and magnitude, however, are highly heterogeneous, to the point that some models behave in diametrically opposite ways to others. Bias auditing should therefore be treated as an ongoing, multi-vendor process, rather than a one-time assessment.

AI.tldr: 研究覆盖9家厂商的10个LLM，通过性别归属和道德判断两项研究考察性别偏见，发现偏见普遍存在，但方向和程度高度异质，甚至相反。
AI.motivation: LLM正被嵌入有现实后果的决策支持工具，理解其性别偏见日益重要；已有研究仅覆盖少量模型，尚不清楚偏见的普遍性与异质性。
AI.method: 选取2025年4月至2026年6月发布的10个模型，来自9家厂商，采用两种范式：研究1考察对性别刻板短语的性别归属；研究2考察为阻止灾难性结果而虐待或折磨女性或男性时的道德判断。
AI.result: 研究1中，10个模型里有2个更常把男性刻板短语归因于女性作者，3个模型呈现相反模式。研究2中，若干模型表现出男性不利的不对称，方向与人类保护女性免受伤害的倾向一致，但出现条件因模型而异；另有3个模型在不同条件下无差异。
AI.conclusion: LLM中的性别相关偏见很常见，但其方向与强度高度异质，部分模型甚至表现相反。因此，偏见审计应作为持续、多厂商的过程，而非一次性评估。

title: MetaCtrl: Your Large Language Models Can Reason Better and More Concisely with a Metacognitive Controller
summary: Large reasoning models improve performance on challenging problems by allocating additional computation before answering, but longer reasoning does not always lead to better results and can introduce substantial redundant reasoning on simple problems. Conversely, aggressively shortening reasoning can degrade performance on difficult ones. Effective reasoning therefore requires dynamically deciding when additional computation is useful based on the reasoner's capabilities and evolving solution state. Existing approaches often rely on predefined budgets or intervention rules, retrain the target reasoner, or require additional supervision. We introduce MetaCtrl, a lightweight controller that adaptively regulates a frozen reasoner without predefined token budgets or reasoner retraining. We formulate reasoning regulation as a sequential metacognitive control problem: MetaCtrl observes the evolving reasoning trace and decides whether to continue, simplify, skip redundant steps, or conclude reasoning. It is trained directly with reinforcement learning using a reward that prioritizes correctness while favoring shorter trajectories among correct solutions, requiring neither supervised intervention trajectories nor problem-specific budgets. Across seven benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, and code, MetaCtrl consistently improves the accuracy of LRMs while reducing their reasoning length. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, it improves average accuracy by 4.7 points while reducing generation length by 53.3%. Without further training, the same controller transfers to an unseen reasoner (e.g., Qwen3-14B), improving average accuracy by 2.9 points and reducing generation length by 50.3%. These results establish MetaCtrl as a plug-and-play controller for improving reasoning accuracy while substantially reducing inference-time generation. The code is available at https://github.com/binbin2xs/MetaCtrl.

AI.tldr: 提出 MetaCtrl，一种轻量控制器，可自适应调控冻结的推理模型，无需预设 token 预算或重训练，在提升准确率的同时大幅缩短推理长度。
AI.motivation: 长推理并不总能带来更好结果，简单问题上会产生大量冗余推理；而过度缩短推理又会损害难题表现。因此需要根据推理模型能力和解题状态，动态决定额外计算是否有用。现有方法常依赖预设预算、干预规则、重训练目标推理器或额外监督。
AI.method: 将推理调控建模为序列元认知控制问题：MetaCtrl 观察不断演化的推理轨迹，决定继续、简化、跳过冗余步骤或结束推理。它直接通过强化学习训练，奖励优先保证正确性，并在正确解中偏好更短轨迹；无需监督干预轨迹或问题特定预算，且作用于冻结的推理器。
AI.result: 在数学、科学和代码等七个基准上，MetaCtrl 持续提升 LRM 准确率并减少推理长度。在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 上，平均准确率提升 4.7 分，生成长度减少 53.3%。无需进一步训练，同一控制器可迁移到未见推理器 Qwen3-14B，平均准确率提升 2.9 分，生成长度减少 50.3%。
AI.conclusion: MetaCtrl 是一种即插即用控制器，可在显著减少推理时生成量的同时提升推理准确率。代码已开源。

title: Auditable Long-Term Memory: A Deterministic Retrieval Chain Measured at 479/475 of 500 on LongMemEval-S
comment: Technical report, 14 pages. Evidence repository (reader outputs, judge verdicts, control records, judge harness): https://github.com/cjchanh/longmemeval-evidence (MIT). Re-scoring any run under the official judge costs about $1.28
summary: We evaluate an auditable long-term memory system on LongMemEval-S. Its retrieval chain uses hybrid candidate retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, coverage-first packet compilation, and deterministic reasoning scaffolds; an LLM is used only as a replaceable final reader. The chain places all gold sessions in the candidate pool for 468/470 answerable questions and produces gold-complete packets for 462/470. With a Claude Opus reader called through an unpinned CLI alias, two 500-question passes score 479/500 and 475/500 under GPT-4o. The 72 answerable knowledge-update rows used a substantively modified scoring prompt whose effect under the official text has not been measured. The pair straddles Chronos High's published 478/500; differences in reader generation, scoring prompt, and possibly data version, plus within-system variance, establish neither superiority nor equivalence. A grok-4.6-high reader on the same packets scores 476/474, while a maximum-reasoning-effort agentic variant regresses to 461/465. The headline passes differ on eight verdict-flip rows. A second judge agrees with the headline judge on 493/500 rows (98.6%) in each pass and scores both passes 472/500; the official judge also flips three verdicts when re-scoring byte-identical pass-1 answers. Negative controls rejected a verifier that repaired three wrong drafts but broke eleven correct drafts. All components were developed on the same 500 questions, with no held-out evaluation or independent human adjudication; retrieval and scaffold method sources and transcript-derived audits are held; and the headline reader received extra operator context, its complete requests were not retained, and MCP tool availability is unresolved. We release materialized packets, scaffolds, reader outputs, judge verdicts, and controls for inspection and re-scoring.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估了一个可审计的长期记忆系统在 LongMemEval-S 上的表现：其检索链结合混合候选检索、交叉编码器重排、覆盖优先的包编译和确定性推理支架，LLM 仅作可替换的最终阅读器。系统在候选召回和完整包生成上表现很高，但最终得分与 Chronos High 相近，且因评分提示、阅读器版本、数据版本和系统方差等问题，无法断言优于或等价于对比系统。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是评估一个可审计的长期记忆系统，并试图与 Chronos High 等基线比较。但作者强调，现有评估设置存在多个混杂因素，因此需要透明地报告性能、不确定性以及审计材料，以避免过度宣称。
AI.method: 采用混合候选检索、交叉编码器重排、覆盖优先的包编译和确定性推理支架构建检索链，LLM 仅作为可替换的最终阅读器。在 LongMemEval-S 的 500 个问题上进行两次评估，并使用不同阅读器（Claude Opus、grok-4.6-high、最大推理努力智能体变体）和多个评委进行评分。还进行了负控制实验，并发布物化包、支架、阅读器输出、评委判定和控制材料以供复核。
AI.result: 检索链在 468/470 个可回答问题中将金标会话放入候选池，并为 462/470 生成金标完整包。Claude Opus 阅读器两次 500 题通过 GPT-4o 评分分别得 479/500 和 475/500；72 个可回答的知识更新行使用了实质性修改的评分提示，其官方文本效果未测量。两次结果跨过 Chronos High 公布的 478/500，但因阅读器代际、评分提示、可能的数据版本及系统内方差，既不能证明更优也不能证明等价。grok-4.6-high 在同一包上得 476/474，最大推理努力智能体变体退化为 461/465。头条通过结果在 8 个判定翻转行上不同。第二评委在每次通过中与头条评委一致率为 493/500（98.6%），并将两次通过均评为 472/500；官方评委对字节相同的第 1 次答案重新评分时也翻转了三个判定。负控制拒绝了一个验证器：它修复了 3 个错误草稿，但破坏了 11 个正确草稿。所有组件均在相同的 500 个问题上开发，没有留出评估或独立人工裁决；检索和支架方法来源及转录审计被保留；头条阅读器收到额外操作者上下文，其完整请求未保留，MCP 工具可用性未解决。
AI.conclusion: 该系统在检索和包生成方面表现强劲，且发布了大量可审计材料，但当前证据不足以声称其优于或等价于 Chronos High。主要限制包括无留出评估、无独立人工裁决、评分提示和阅读器设置不一致、以及未解决的审计缺口。因此结论应视为对系统能力的初步评估，需进一步标准化和独立复核。

title: ReMem: Rethinking Perception and Memory in Long-Context Recommendation Agents
summary: Recent Recommendation Agents (RecAgents) offer a promising alternative by shifting recommendation to an active, user-side paradigm, where generative agents autonomously perceive external platforms, reason over user preferences, and execute decisions. However, existing RecAgents still suffer from two critical limitations: brittle item perception based on noisy and heterogeneous item pages, and inefficient long-context reasoning over extended user histories and multi-step interaction traces. To address these challenges, we propose a novel recommendation agent framework, termed as ReMem, that combines OCR-based multimodal perception with time-evolving dynamic memory. Instead of parsing raw HTML, ReMem observes item pages through screenshots and extracts structured multimodal information via an OCR tool, enabling a more humanoid and platform-agnostic perception mechanism. To support long-horizon preference modeling, ReMem further introduces a chunk-wise sequential memory update strategy, where the agent selectively maintains a fixed-size memory of informative historical interactions while processing arbitrarily long contexts with linear inference complexity and bounded context length. This design allows the agent to preserve evolving user preferences without relying on external memory modules or disrupting the standard autoregressive generation process. To enhance the dynamic memory instruction, we further develop a multi-memory GRPO variant, which propagates the final-answer advantage to all intermediate conversations that contribute to the final response. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate that ReMem consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average improvement of 5.16\% across three recommendation agent tasks, namely searching, ranking, and judging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出推荐智能体框架 ReMem，将基于 OCR 的多模态感知与随时间演化的动态记忆相结合，以提升推荐智能体在搜索、排序和判断任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐智能体存在两个关键限制：物品感知依赖噪声大且异构的网页页面，较为脆弱；对长用户历史和多步交互轨迹进行长上下文推理时效率低下。
AI.method: ReMem 不解析原始 HTML，而是通过截图观察物品页面，并利用 OCR 工具提取结构化多模态信息，实现更拟人化、平台无关的感知；同时引入分块式顺序记忆更新策略，选择性维护固定大小的历史交互记忆，以线性推理复杂度和有界上下文长度处理任意长上下文；此外提出多记忆 GRPO 变体，将最终答案优势传播到所有中间对话。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上的大量实验表明，ReMem 持续优于最先进基线，在搜索、排序和判断三类推荐智能体任务上平均提升 5.16%。
AI.conclusion: ReMem 通过 OCR 多模态感知和动态记忆机制，有效缓解了现有推荐智能体在物品感知和长上下文推理方面的局限，并显著提升了多类推荐智能体任务性能。

title: How Local Mixing Encodes Relative Position in Global NoPE Attention
summary: The attention operation is naively position invariant. However, positional information is fundamental to natural language, and therefore a variety of explicit position encodings have been developed in transformer-based models, such as rotary position encoding (RoPE). Although explicit position encodings have long been assumed to be required, recent methods that interleave local mixing layers, such as sliding window attention (SWA) and gated linear attention, while not encoding position (NoPE) in global attention layers has recently been shown to be successful at scale. How and why this approach works is not well-understood. In this paper, we develop an explanation of how hybrid models of this sort can implicitly encode position at global NoPE layers. Supported by both theoretical and empirical evidence, our central argument is that SWA and gated linear attention induce a recency bias in the residual stream that propagates to, and is selected by, the global attention logits. Moreover, in contrast to the implicit position encodings found in models with only global NoPE attention, in which positional information arises solely from the causal mask, the recency bias in hybrid models can be maintained across long sequences. In addition to deepening our understanding of how hybrid models encode position, these findings may provide insights for how to encode position in a way that can extrapolate to longer sequence lengths indefinitely.

AI.tldr: 本文解释混合模型中全局 NoPE 注意力层如何隐式编码位置：局部混合层（如 SWA 和门控线性注意力）在残差流中引入近期偏置，该偏置传播到全局注意力 logits 并被选择。
AI.motivation: 注意力本身位置不变，但自然语言需要位置信息，因此通常使用显式位置编码如 RoPE。近期混合模型在全局注意力层不使用位置编码（NoPE）却取得成功，但其原理尚不清楚。
AI.method: 通过理论分析与实证证据，研究由 SWA、门控线性注意力等局部混合层与全局 NoPE 注意力组成的混合模型，分析残差流中的近期偏置如何影响全局注意力 logits。
AI.result: 发现 SWA 和门控线性注意力会在残差流中诱导近期偏置，该偏置传播至全局注意力 logits 并被其选择。与仅使用全局 NoPE 注意力的模型不同，后者的位置信息仅来自因果掩码，而混合模型中的近期偏置可在长序列中保持。
AI.conclusion: 研究加深了对混合模型如何编码位置的理解，并为设计可外推到任意更长序列长度的位置编码提供了启示。

title: When to Retrieve, When to Stay: Uncertainty-Aware Temporal Evidence Allocation for Streaming Video-LLMs
summary: Streaming video understanding requires Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) to reason over continuous visual streams under causal constraints. As the visual history grows, a bounded visual?processing budget requires evidence selection that balances temporal recency with query relevance. Recent-only selection excludes potentially relevant historical evidence, whereas Semantic-only retrieval can displace useful recent context when relevance scores are ambiguous. We introduce WRWS (When to Retrieve, When to Stay), a training-free framework for uncertainty-adaptive evidence allocation. A lightweight external vision-language encoder scores query relevance across the observed history, while an adaptive allocation module uses the normalized entropy of the similarity distribution as a proxy for retrieval uncertainty. WRWS favors semantic retrieval when relevance cues are reliable and strengthens the recency prior under uncertainty. Following a retrieve-first, encode-later pipeline, WRWS selects evidence before target-model visual encoding, such that only the selected observations are processed by the costly target Video-LLM. Experiments across four Video-LLM families and multiple model scales demonstrate competitive accuracy on StreamingBench and OVO-Bench. In our efficiency evaluation, WRWS reduces average vision-to-answer time to 47.93% of the state-of-the-art method. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 WRWS，用于流式视频理解中的不确定性自适应证据分配，在有限视觉预算下平衡时间近期性与查询相关性。
AI.motivation: 流式视频理解需在因果约束下处理连续视觉流，历史增长使视觉处理预算受限，必须选择证据；仅选近期会遗漏潜在相关的历史信息，仅按语义检索在相关性分数模糊时又会挤占有用的近期上下文。
AI.method: WRWS 免训练：使用轻量外部视觉语言编码器对已观察历史进行查询相关性打分；自适应分配模块以相似度分布的归一化熵作为检索不确定性代理，在相关性可靠时偏向语义检索，在不确定时增强近期先验；采用 retrieve-first, encode-later 流程，先选证据再交由目标 Video-LLM 编码，仅处理被选中的观测。
AI.result: 在四个 Video-LLM 家族和多种模型规模上，WRWS 在 StreamingBench 与 OVO-Bench 上取得有竞争力的准确率；效率评估中，平均 vision-to-answer 时间降至当前最佳方法的 47.93%。
AI.conclusion: WRWS 通过不确定性自适应证据分配，在流式视频理解中兼顾了准确率与计算效率，代码将发布。

title: Mubric: Mutation Testing-Guided Rubric Generation for LLM Evaluation
summary: Rubric-based evaluation is widely used to assess LLM-based systems by decomposing response quality into task-specific scoring criteria. However, automatically generating rubrics that reliably capture task-specific quality requirements remains challenging. We introduce Mubric, a mutation testing-guided approach to rubric generation. Mutation testing, a classic software testing methodology, evaluates a test suite by injecting faults into programs and checking whether the tests detect them. We draw an analogy between test suites and rubrics: if a rubric captures an important quality requirement, introducing a corresponding defect into an otherwise high-quality response should reduce its score. Mubric first mines common defects from real pairs of preferred and dispreferred responses and abstracts these defects into reusable mutation operators, each specifying how to introduce a particular type of response defect. For a new task, it applies relevant operators to a reference response, checks whether the injected defects reduce response quality, and uses insufficiently penalized defects to refine the rubric. We evaluate Mubric on 703 tasks across four representative domains against six advanced rubric generation methods. Mubric achieves the highest overall evaluation accuracy, outperforming the strongest baseline by 7.48 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Mubric，一种基于变异测试引导的评分细则（rubric）自动生成方法，通过向高质量回答注入缺陷来检验评分细则能否识别质量下降，并据此优化细则。
AI.motivation: 基于评分细则的评估广泛用于评估 LLM 系统，但自动生成能可靠捕捉任务特定质量要求的评分细则仍很困难。
AI.method: Mubric 借鉴软件测试中的变异测试：先从真实偏好/非偏好回答对中挖掘常见缺陷并抽象为可复用变异算子；对新任务，将相关算子应用于参考回答，检查注入缺陷是否降低评分，并利用未被充分惩罚的缺陷来改进评分细则。
AI.result: 在四个代表性领域的 703 个任务上，与六种先进评分细则生成方法对比，Mubric 取得最高总体评估准确率，比最强基线高出 7.48 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 变异测试引导的评分细则生成能有效提升自动评估的准确性，表明通过缺陷注入检验和优化评分标准是可行且有效的方法。

title: From Routing Signals to Selective Review: Visual regrounding in MoE VLMs
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) may accept false visual premises, answering questions about a target object's color, count, location, or state even when it is absent. We call this reliability-critical behavior a target-absence grounding failure. Existing visual-grounding detectors primarily rely on generated responses, hidden states, or uncertainty measures. We present the first framework to leverage internal routing decisions in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) VLMs to detect target absence before generation and guide selective correction. We extract target-token routing probabilities from Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct and Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, train a separate L2-regularized linear detector for each model, and use its predictions to selectively invoke a target-aware review prompt. Using routing alone, the Qwen and Gemma detectors achieve ROC-AUCs of 0.9988 and 0.9956 on GQA-Inpaint and retain 0.8095 and 0.7781 on the external OBER dataset, respectively. The resulting routing-gated policy improves end-to-end accuracy on GQA-Inpaint and OBER by +22.25% and +12.17% for Qwen, and by +13.42% and +1.39% for Gemma, without modifying model weights. Further analysis shows that the signal is localized to the target-object token, emerges in early MoE layers, and is distributed across partially substitutable experts. Although cross-dataset threshold shifts require recalibration, false-positive review causes limited harm overall, suggesting that intervention risk can be controlled through joint selection of the detector threshold and review prompt. Overall, we show that routing probabilities alone preserve actionable information about visual perception, allowing computation already produced by an MoE VLM to support low-cost detection and selective visual regrounding.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出首个利用 MoE 视觉语言模型内部路由决策来检测目标缺失的框架，并在生成前进行选择性纠正。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉 grounding 检测器主要依赖生成响应、隐藏状态或不确定性，而 VLM 可能接受虚假视觉前提，对不存在的目标回答颜色、数量、位置或状态，造成目标缺失 grounding 失败，因此需要更可靠且低成本的检测与纠正方法。
AI.method: 从 Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct 和 Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it 中提取目标 token 的路由概率，为每个模型训练独立的 L2 正则化线性检测器，并用其预测选择性触发目标感知复审提示，从而在不修改模型权重的情况下实现检测和纠正。
AI.result: 仅使用路由信息，Qwen 和 Gemma 检测器在 GQA-Inpaint 上达到 ROC-AUC 0.9988 和 0.9956，在外部 OBER 数据集上保持 0.8095 和 0.7781。路由门控策略使 Qwen 在 GQA-Inpaint 和 OBER 上端到端准确率分别提升 +22.25% 和 +12.17%，Gemma 分别提升 +13.42% 和 +1.39%。分析还表明信号定位在目标物体 token，出现在早期 MoE 层，并分布在部分可替代专家上。
AI.conclusion: 路由概率本身保留了关于视觉感知的可操作信息，可利用 MoE VLM 已产生的计算实现低成本目标缺失检测和选择性视觉重新 grounding。跨数据集阈值偏移需要重新校准，但通过联合选择检测器阈值和复审提示可控制误报带来的有限风险。

title: Correct Answers, Invalid Traces: What Verifiable Grade-School Math Reveals About Chain-of-Thought Traces
summary: Chain-of-thought traces are widely read as records of how models reach their answers, informing debugging, agent auditing, and claims about reasoning. Testing this interpretation is difficult because natural-language thinking traces are rarely mechanically verifiable. We revisit it in iGSM, a synthetic grade-school mathematics benchmark designed to study thinking traces and used to support claims of learned reasoning and planning. Crucially, iGSM exposes the exact quantities and dependencies that a correct solution should use, allowing generated traces to be checked programmatically step by step and enabling us to test whether correct answers are reliably accompanied by valid traces. We first evaluate models trained exclusively on valid, minimal traces. Answer correctness and trace validity nearly coincide in distribution but decouple out of distribution: on the hardest instances, 31.6% of correct answers have invalid traces, over half of which pass all syntactic and arithmetic checks but fail semantic dependency checks. We then intervene on trace supervision. Non-minimal training traces induce non-minimal outputs, while re-asking the same problem with a different query reveals computations inherited from the original query, weakening minimality as evidence of selective planning. Shuffling tokens in 10% of training trace sentences preserves near-clean accuracy even out of distribution despite no trace passing verification. Swapped training traces likewise retain high in-distribution accuracy. We discuss the implications of these findings for chain-of-thought monitoring and interpretation in the context of AI safety.

AI.tldr: 论文在可逐步程序化验证的iGSM数学基准上检验CoT轨迹是否真实反映推理过程，发现答案正确与轨迹有效在分布内接近但在分布外解耦，且多种轨迹监督干预会削弱CoT作为推理与规划证据的可靠性。
AI.motivation: CoT轨迹常被当作模型如何得到答案的记录，用于调试、智能体审计和推理能力主张；但自然语言思维链很难被机械验证，因此需要可程序化检查的基准来检验正确回答是否伴随有效轨迹。
AI.method: 使用iGSM合成小学数学基准，该基准暴露正确解所需的精确量和依赖关系，可逐步验证生成轨迹；先评估仅用有效最小轨迹训练的模型，再干预轨迹监督，包括非最小训练轨迹、同题不同查询、打乱10%训练轨迹句子中的token以及交换训练轨迹。
AI.result: 分布内答案正确与轨迹有效几乎重合，但分布外解耦：最难实例中31.6%正确回答的轨迹无效，其中过半通过语法和算术检查却失败语义依赖检查。非最小训练轨迹诱导非最小输出；改换查询会暴露继承自原查询的计算，削弱最小性作为选择性规划证据。打乱10%训练轨迹句子token仍保持近干净准确率，即使分布外，尽管没有轨迹通过验证；交换训练轨迹也保持高分布内准确率。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现表明，正确性不一定保证有效推理，CoT轨迹监督可能被绕过；对CoT监控与解释应保持谨慎，不能简单将自然语言思维链视为可靠推理或规划证据，这对AI安全具有重要启示。

title: HyperSAM: A Promptable Foundation Model for Hyperspectral Remote Sensing
comment: Accepted by IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Magazine (GRSM)
summary: Hyperspectral remote sensing provides dense spectral measurements that are indispensable for material-level Earth observation, yet the construction of a general-purpose hyperspectral foundation model remains difficult. Two bottlenecks are especially limiting. First, large hyperspectral corpora rarely provide high spatial resolution together with reliable dense annotations. Second, many hyperspectral models are still trained almost from scratch, so the geometric and interactive priors learned by modern vision foundation models are not fully reused. To alleviate these issues, we \highlight{present} \textbf{HyperSAM}, a promptable hyperspectral foundation model that couples a data-centric hyperspectral synthesis pipeline with a spectral adaptation architecture based on Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3). On the data side, HyperSAM synthesizes full-spectrum hyperspectral cubes from high-resolution SpaceNet multispectral imagery through a physics-informed abundance-transfer generator, while SAM3-derived pseudo-masks provide object-centric supervision. On the model side, the latest implementation uses a frozen SAM3 RGB image branch, a trainable hyperspectral side encoder initialized from the RGB vision transformer (ViT), ControlNet-style zero-initialized feature injection, and a lightweight mixture-of-experts mask refiner. To enhance training robustness against noisy pseudo-labels, Cross-modal Sample Selection (CromSS)-style confidence selection is incorporated for noisy-label weighting. Extensive experiments show that HyperSAM obtains strong generalization on diverse hyperspectral tasks (e.g., classification, anomaly detection, change detection, target detection, and airborne oil-spill mapping) and that high-quality synthetic hyperspectral data can be more effective than simply scaling noisy hyperspectral supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HyperSAM，一个可提示的高光谱基础模型，通过数据合成管道和基于SAM3的谱适应架构，解决了高光谱基础模型构建中的两大瓶颈，并在多种高光谱任务上展现出强泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 高光谱遥感虽能提供密集光谱测量，但构建通用高光谱基础模型面临两大瓶颈：1) 大型高光谱语料库很少同时提供高空间分辨率和可靠的密集标注；2) 许多高光谱模型几乎从头训练，未能充分利用现代视觉基础模型学到的几何和交互先验。
AI.method: 数据方面，利用物理信息丰度转移生成器从高分辨率SpaceNet多光谱影像合成全谱高光谱立方体，并使用SAM3衍生的伪掩码提供对象级监督；模型方面，采用冻结的SAM3 RGB图像分支、从RGB ViT初始化的可训练高光谱侧编码器、ControlNet风格零初始化特征注入和轻量级混合专家掩码精炼器；此外，引入CromSS风格置信度选择对噪声伪标签加权，增强训练鲁棒性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，HyperSAM在多种高光谱任务（如分类、异常检测、变化检测、目标检测和机载溢油制图）上取得了强泛化性能，且高质量合成高光谱数据比简单扩大噪声高光谱监督更有效。
AI.conclusion: HyperSAM通过结合数据合成与谱适应架构，有效缓解了高光谱基础模型构建的瓶颈，并证明了合成数据在高光谱任务中的潜力。

title: LongHarness Bench: Stress-Testing Language Model Harnesses for Long-Context Reasoning
summary: Language-model (LM) harnesses enable LMs to operate effectively over long contexts using additional compute. However, existing long-context evaluations are insufficient for distinguishing modern harnesses, reflected by saturated accuracy across harnesses and largely similar evaluation costs. In this paper, we introduce a benchmark for evaluating both the effectiveness and efficiency of long-context harnesses. Our tasks require diverse retrieval strategies, including lexical search and semantic matching, together with strategic and adaptive reasoning over global and local context. Much of the context is semantically relevant but only a small subset is useful at each step, creating both a challenging search problem and different accuracy--cost tradeoffs across processing strategies. For example, one task requires identifying every person satisfying several conditions using evidence scattered across documents; strategically checking the most selective condition first can narrow the search before verifying the remaining conditions. We evaluate multiple families of frontier language models with four state-of-the-art harnesses. Our benchmarks remain challenging even for strong model--harness combinations: the best reaches 68\% macro-average accuracy across four evaluation suites. More importantly, we find that the same underlying model can exhibit markedly different efficiency under different harnesses. Our results establish efficiency as an important axis for long-context evaluation and provide a testbed for developing harnesses that process context strategically rather than exhaustively.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个用于评估长上下文处理框架（harness）有效性与效率的新基准，发现现有评测难以区分不同框架，且同一底层模型在不同框架下效率差异显著。
AI.motivation: 现有长上下文评测在区分现代框架方面不够充分，表现为不同框架准确率趋于饱和且评测成本相近，因此需要同时衡量效果与效率的新基准。
AI.method: 构建要求多种检索策略（词法搜索、语义匹配）以及全局与局部上下文推理的长上下文任务；上下文多语义相关但每步仅少量有用，形成搜索难度与准确率-成本权衡；用四个先进框架评估多类前沿语言模型。
AI.result: 即使强模型-框架组合仍具挑战性，最佳仅达四个评测套件的68%宏平均准确率；更重要的是，同一底层模型在不同框架下效率差异明显。
AI.conclusion: 效率应成为长上下文评测的重要维度，该基准为开发能策略性而非穷尽式处理上下文的框架提供了测试平台。

title: TAEC: Trajectory-Aware Evidence Coordination for Multi-Step Visual RAG
summary: Multi-step visual retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) answers complex questions by repeatedly retrieving visual evidence, updating an intermediate state, and deciding whether to continue searching or answer. Yet retrieving relevant evidence does not ensure its effective use throughout the reasoning trajectory. As multi-step reasoning progresses, redundant sources occupy context capacity needed for missing evidence, observations tied to resolved requirements or unproductive searches linger in context, and visual sources are revisited with insufficient detail for fine-grained reading. We term this loss of usable evidence over a reasoning trajectory trajectory-level evidence utilization degradation. To address it, we propose Trajectory-Aware Evidence Coordination (TAEC), a training-free framework that coordinates evidence use around unresolved answer requirements. TAEC tracks these requirements in a shared trajectory state to guide which evidence enters the context, how accumulated memory is retained, and at what level of detail visual evidence is examined. Under a unified evaluation protocol on ViDoSeek, SlideVQA, and MMLongBench-Doc, TAEC achieves the best overall performance against leading training-free visual RAG baselines, with the highest average accuracy across multiple proprietary vision-language models. These results demonstrate that aligning evidence with evolving reasoning needs improves evidence use throughout multi-step visual RAG.

AI.tldr: 该文研究多步视觉RAG中证据利用效率下降的问题，提出免训练框架TAEC，通过跟踪未解决的答案需求来协调证据的选取、记忆保留与视觉细节粒度，在多个基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 多步视觉RAG虽能反复检索视觉证据，但检索到相关证据并不等于能有效利用；随着推理推进，冗余来源占用上下文、已解决需求或无果搜索的观察残留、视觉源被以不足细节重访，造成“轨迹级证据利用退化”。
AI.method: 提出Trajectory-Aware Evidence Coordination（TAEC），一种免训练框架，围绕未解决的答案需求协调证据使用；在共享轨迹状态中跟踪这些需求，以指导哪些证据进入上下文、累积记忆如何保留，以及以何种细节粒度检查视觉证据。
AI.result: 在ViDoSeek、SlideVQA和MMLongBench-Doc的统一评估协议下，TAEC优于领先的免训练视觉RAG基线，并在多个专有视觉语言模型上取得最高平均准确率。
AI.conclusion: 将证据与不断演变的推理需求对齐，能够改善多步视觉RAG中证据的利用效果。

title: VISTA: Value-Informed Event Appraisal for Multimodal Emotion Conflict
summary: Conflicting emotional cues can be individually valid: a subdued voice may reflect a blocked goal while a smile satisfies a social obligation. Their interpretation depends on what the event means to the person. We introduce VISTA (Value-Informed Semantic Trust Arbitration), a learned seven-field appraisal interface that conditions modality arbitration on concerns, event relations, and expression conditions while retaining a joint-evidence residual. A log-odds decomposition separates emotion expectation from cue diagnosticity, motivating an interface that lets appraisal change how evidence is interpreted. With a shared Qwen2.5-Omni-7B backbone and matched training examples and steps, VISTA reaches 64.5% conflict accuracy on CA-MER, improving on modality gating by 2.5 percentage points on conflict and 0.2 on consistency. Shuffling appraisal across scenes or removing its decision connection reduces this benefit. A common frozen-backbone probe reaches 0.600 macro CCC for appraisal readout, compared with 0.505 for emotion-only fine-tuning. Evaluations across five benchmarks connect recognition under increasing conflict with appraisal readout and downstream decision use. Together, the analyses and experiments support scene-specific appraisal as an intermediate representation that helps interpret conflicting emotional evidence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VISTA，一种基于价值信息与语义信任仲裁的七字段评估接口，用于在多模态情感冲突中根据事件对个人的意义来仲裁证据，从而提升冲突情感识别与评估读出。
AI.motivation: 冲突的情感线索可能各自有效，例如低沉语气反映目标受阻，而微笑满足社会义务；其解释取决于事件对个人的意义，因此需要场景特定的评估来帮助理解冲突证据。
AI.method: 提出 VISTA 七字段评估接口，基于关切、事件关系和表达条件调节模态仲裁，并保留联合证据残差；用对数几率分解分离情绪期望与线索诊断性；在共享 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 骨干下，以匹配训练样本和步数进行实验。
AI.result: VISTA 在 CA-MER 上达到 64.5% 冲突准确率，相比模态门控在冲突上提升 2.5 个百分点、在一致性上提升 0.2；打乱场景间评估或移除其决策连接会降低收益。冻结骨干探针达到 0.600 宏观 CCC，优于仅情绪微调的 0.505；五个基准上的评估将冲突识别、评估读出与下游决策使用联系起来。
AI.conclusion: 场景特定评估可作为中间表示，帮助解释冲突的情感证据，说明评估信息在冲突情感识别中具有有效性。

title: PCaPaint: Prostate Cancer Inpainting by Mitigating Shortcut Learning
comment: Accepted at the DGM4MICCAI workshop at MICCAI 2026
summary: The development of AI systems for tumor-specific applications is limited by the scarcity of labeled data. Synthetic tumor inpainting offers a promising approach but faces challenges for prostate cancer MRI which contains high-resolution multi-sequence data. Although methods leveraging latent diffusion models (LDMs) enable large-volume synthesis, they are prone to shortcut learning, simply reproducing the condition image created by masking the lesion region. In this work, we introduce PCaPaint, a prostate cancer inpainting method based on LDMs that explicitly addresses this failure mode. To overcome shortcut learning that compromises synthetic tumor texture, we propose a simple yet efficient conditioning strategy in which the condition image is filled with Gaussian noise, and we provide theoretical justification. In addition, we propose a novel training objective for LDM that emphasizes the error within the lesion region. Furthermore, we introduce a multi-sequence latent design, in which T2w scans and DWI&ADC scans are compressed using two separate autoencoders to preserve their distinct frequency characteristics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the generated synthetic data improves downstream performance in prostate lesion segmentation, patient-level classification and lesion-level detection. Furthermore, our method significantly outperforms a recent state-of-the-art LDM-based tumor inpainting method both in downstream performance and in synthetic image quality.

AI.tldr: 提出PCaPaint，一种基于潜在扩散模型的前列腺癌MRI肿瘤修复方法，解决合成肿瘤纹理中的捷径学习问题，提升下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: AI系统在肿瘤应用受限于标注数据稀缺；合成肿瘤修复有前景，但前列腺癌MRI高分辨率多序列数据中，基于LDM的方法易出现捷径学习，简单复制掩码区域的条件图像，导致合成肿瘤纹理不佳。
AI.method: 提出PCaPaint，采用LDM，使用高斯噪声填充条件图像的条件策略并给出理论依据；设计强调病灶区域误差的新训练目标；多序列潜在设计，用两个独立自编码器压缩T2w和DWI&ADC以保留频率特征。
AI.result: 生成的合成数据提升了下游前列腺病灶分割、患者级分类和病灶级检测性能；在合成图像质量和下游性能上显著优于最新LDM肿瘤修复方法。
AI.conclusion: PCaPaint有效克服捷径学习，生成高质量合成肿瘤数据，改善前列腺癌MRI下游任务，优于现有方法。

title: Think Before You Score: Thinking Reward Model for Visual Generation
summary: Visual reward models are essential for evaluating and improving visual generation models, yet existing approaches typically map task conditions and candidate outputs directly to scalar rewards, leaving implicit what should be evaluated for each individual case. We introduce Think Before You Score, a paradigm that explicitly determines what matters for each case before judging how well the candidate performs. Following this principle, we propose the Thinking Reward Model (TRM), which formulates case-adaptive rubrics, performs rubric-guided assessment, and produces fine-grained pointwise rewards. We further observe that conventional pairwise preference optimization can induce score polarization, and introduce Pairwise Dual-Group Relative Policy Optimization (PD-GRPO), which leverages pairwise supervision to improve reward discrimination while preserving fine-grained pointwise scoring. Extensive experiments on image generation and editing reward-modeling benchmarks demonstrate that TRM achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source reward models while remaining highly competitive with proprietary alternatives. Moreover, using TRM as a reward for reinforcement learning consistently improves diverse visual generation models, demonstrating that its fine-grained, case-adaptive rewards translate into effective optimization signals for visual generation.

AI.tldr: 提出“先思考再评分”范式与Thinking Reward Model（TRM），为每个视觉生成案例动态制定评分标准并给出细粒度逐点奖励，同时提出PD-GRPO缓解分数极化问题，在图像生成与编辑奖励建模基准上达到开源SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉奖励模型通常直接将任务条件和候选输出映射为标量奖励，没有显式判断每个具体案例应评估什么，导致奖励依据隐式且不够细粒度。
AI.method: 提出Thinking Reward Model（TRM）：先根据案例自适应生成评分细则（rubrics），再依据细则进行评估，输出细粒度逐点奖励；并提出Pairwise Dual-Group Relative Policy Optimization（PD-GRPO），利用成对监督提升奖励区分度，同时保持逐点细粒度评分。
AI.result: 在图像生成和图像编辑奖励建模基准上，TRM在开源奖励模型中达到SOTA，并与专有模型相比具有较强竞争力；作为强化学习奖励信号时，能持续提升多种视觉生成模型。
AI.conclusion: 显式、案例自适应且细粒度的奖励建模能提供更有效的优化信号，TRM可同时提升奖励评估性能并改善视觉生成模型的强化学习效果。

title: Seek Before You Move: Evidence Seeking for Progress Grounding in Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to continuously ground task progress from long-horizon instructions and partial egocentric observations. Existing VLM-based navigation agents typically reason only over available observations and may remain confident even when task-relevant evidence is missing. For example, an agent may confidently proceed forward and get lost even though the landmark indicating the next turn lies outside its current field of view. We term this failure mode Progress Myopia: the agent fails to recognize unreliable progress grounding and continues acting on insufficient evidence. To address it, we propose SeekVLN, an evidence-seeking framework that couples semantic progress reasoning with active acquisition of task-relevant observations. SeekVLN is trained in two stages: First, Future-guided Reverse Generation (FRG) uses future expert actions to augment offline expert trajectories with supplementary views and evidence annotations. Supervised fine-tuning on these trajectories establishes a prior for evidence seeking and progress reasoning without additional expert interaction. However, imitation alone does not reveal whether seeking improves subsequent navigation. We therefore introduce Counterfactual Contrastive Policy Optimization (C2PO) for reinforcement fine-tuning. By comparing each evidence-seeking branch with a counterfactual direct-navigation branch from the same state, C2PO uses a contrastive reward to assign credit to seeking decisions based on subsequent navigation benefit. Experiments on simulated benchmarks show that SeekVLN achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving success rate by 12.7% and 7.5% over the base model on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, respectively. Both simulated and real-world evaluations exhibit human-like evidence-seeking behaviors for more reliable progress grounding.

AI.tldr: 针对视觉语言导航中智能体在证据不足时仍盲目行动的“进度短视”问题，提出SeekVLN框架，通过证据寻求与语义进度推理结合，在两阶段训练后实现更可靠的导航。
AI.motivation: 现有基于VLM的导航智能体仅依赖当前观测进行推理，当任务相关证据缺失时仍可能自信前进并迷路，即“进度短视”失败模式。
AI.method: SeekVLN框架：第一阶段未来引导反向生成（FRG）利用未来专家动作增强离线轨迹，添加补充视图和证据标注，并通过监督微调建立证据寻求先验；第二阶段反事实对比策略优化（C2PO）通过对比同一状态下的证据寻求分支与直接导航分支，用对比奖励根据后续导航收益为寻求决策分配信用。
AI.result: 在模拟基准上达到最先进性能，R2R-CE和RxR-CE上的成功率分别比基础模型提升12.7%和7.5%；模拟和真实世界评估均表现出类人的证据寻求行为。
AI.conclusion: SeekVLN通过主动获取任务相关观测和对比强化学习，有效缓解进度短视问题，实现更可靠的进度 grounding 和类人证据寻求导航行为。

title: Pretraining Latent Information Feedback Transformers with Teacher Supervision
summary: Transformer language models (LMs) are feed-forward: deep-layer representations are never fed back to shallower layers, and the only pathway for information to flow downward across generation steps is the decoded token. This narrow channel forces models to recompute intermediate results and to discard alternative continuations. In this work, we remove this bottleneck during pretraining, introducing the LIFT (Latent Information Feedback Transformer) architecture and training method which enable LMs to propagate state across generation. We achieve this by turning recurrent-state learning into a teacher-forced prediction problem: each input token is paired with an information-dense state, derived from the next-token distribution of an off-the-shelf pretrained LM. The model, extended with a small number of additional parameters, is then trained to predict both the next token and the next state. As the input states are precomputed, pretraining remains fully parallel across positions. At inference, the model's own predicted states are fed back, with a minor computational overhead that decreases with model size. Experiments with pretrained models ranging from 135M to 1B parameters show that LIFT consistently outperforms standard Transformers and baselines on language modeling, downstream reasoning tasks, and procedural tasks under token-matched budget, while being on par with or ahead of compute-matched Transformers. Moreover, a controlled study on a state-tracking task shows that a tiny LIFT outperforms same-size Transformers trained on 8x more data, even when trained with the states of a Transformer that fails the task. Overall, we show that LMs can learn to exploit deep-to-shallow feedback during pretraining via scalable teacher supervision.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 LIFT 架构与训练方法，使 Transformer 语言模型在预训练中学习跨生成步骤传递隐状态，从而突破前馈结构中深层信息无法回流到浅层的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 标准 Transformer 是前馈的：深层表示不会反馈到浅层，跨生成步骤的信息只能通过解码出的 token 向下流动。这一狭窄通道迫使模型重复计算中间结果，并丢弃其他可能的续写。
AI.method: 将循环状态学习转化为 teacher-forced 预测问题：每个输入 token 配对一个信息密集状态，该状态来自现成预训练 LM 的下一 token 分布。模型增加少量参数，同时预测下一 token 和下一状态。由于输入状态可预计算，预训练仍可并行；推理时反馈模型自己预测的状态，计算开销较小且随模型规模增大而降低。
AI.result: 在 135M 到 1B 参数模型上，LIFT 在语言建模、下游推理任务和程序性任务中，在 token 匹配预算下持续优于标准 Transformer 和基线，并在计算匹配下持平或领先。状态跟踪任务中，小型 LIFT 甚至优于用 8 倍数据训练的同规模 Transformer，即使其教师状态来自一个无法完成该任务的 Transformer。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型可以通过可扩展的教师监督，在预训练中学会利用深层到浅层的反馈，从而提升建模与推理能力。

title: Solving Without Stopping: On-Policy Distillation at Small Scale
summary: On-policy distillation, where a student learns from a stronger teacher's feedback on its own outputs, is a common way to pass reasoning to smaller models. We analyze what it transfers at small scale, distilling Qwen3-8B into Qwen3 4B, 1.7B and 0.6B students, in thinking mode (reason at length, then end the reasoning and answer) and, for comparison, in non-thinking mode (no separate reasoning phase). Long reasoning needs two abilities, solving a problem and knowing when it is solved, and we find that distillation transfers the first, but in thinking mode not the second. Solving improves at every size, up to two ceilings, which we measure comprehensively across both modes and all student sizes: a student's single attempt never exceeds what it could already reach in many attempts before training, and the smaller the student, the further it stays below the teacher. Stopping is where the modes part. In non-thinking mode every student keeps stopping; in thinking mode students stop ending their reasoning early in training, and the smaller the student, the less of this ability survives: the teacher signals a stop almost only where a student already ends its reasoning, so distillation teaches no new stops; it only keeps the student's existing stops that land on a right answer, and a weak student has few such stops. The smallest students often reach the right value but do not commit to it: they either rarely mark it or mark it and write past it. Together, these results describe how small students behave under on-policy distillation, and a diagnostic that separates answer marking, correctness and stopping.

AI.tldr: 本文分析小规模在线策略蒸馏从强教师到小学生时究竟传递了什么，发现蒸馏主要传递了解题能力，但在思考模式下未能有效传递“知道何时停止推理”的能力。
AI.motivation: 在线策略蒸馏常用于把推理能力迁移到更小模型，但在小规模下它具体传递了什么并不清楚。长推理需要两种能力：解决问题以及知道问题何时已解决。
AI.method: 将 Qwen3-8B 蒸馏到 Qwen3 4B、1.7B、0.6B 学生模型，分别在思考模式与非思考模式下比较，并全面测量两种模式和所有学生规模下的单次尝试上限与训练前多次尝试可达上限。
AI.result: 蒸馏能提升解题能力，但思考模式下不能有效传递停止能力。解题能力在所有规模上都有提升，但受两个上限限制：学生单次尝试不超过训练前多次尝试可达水平，且学生越小越低于教师。非思考模式下学生保持停止能力；思考模式下学生早期较少结束推理，学生越小该能力保留越少。教师几乎只在学生原本会停止处发出停止信号，因此蒸馏不会教出新的停止点，只保留学生已有且落在正确答案上的停止；弱学生此类停止很少。最小学生常能到达正确值却不提交：要么很少标记，要么标记后继续写过去。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果描述了小学生模型在在线策略蒸馏下的行为，并提出一种区分答案标记、正确性和停止行为的诊断方法。

title: Predicting Team Performance from Communications in Simulated Search-and-Rescue
summary: Understanding how individual traits influence team performance is valuable, but these traits are not always directly observable. Prior research has inferred traits like trust from behavioral data. We analyze conversational data to identify team traits and their correlation with teaming outcomes. Using transcripts from a Minecraft-based search-and-rescue experiment, we apply topic modeling and clustering to uncover key interaction patterns. Our findings show that variations in teaming outcomes can be explained through these inferences, with different levels of predictive power derived from individual traits and team dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过Minecraft搜救实验的对话转录，利用主题建模和聚类推断团队特质与互动模式，并分析其与团队结果的关系。
AI.motivation: 个体特质会影响团队绩效，但这些特质往往无法直接观察，因此需要从行为或对话数据中进行推断。
AI.method: 分析Minecraft搜救实验中的对话转录，采用主题建模和聚类方法识别关键互动模式，并评估其与团队结果的关联。
AI.result: 团队结果差异可以通过这些推断得到解释，且个体特质与团队动态在预测能力上存在不同水平。
AI.conclusion: 从对话中推断团队特质和互动模式有助于理解和预测团队表现，个体层面与团队层面的预测力有所差异。

title: Visual Anomaly Synthesis for Model Selection in Data Scarcity
summary: Defect detection systems for industrial condition monitoring can only be relied upon if they are validated, yet defective samples are rare and, for a specific asset, often nonexistent. We present a framework that synthesizes severity-graded defects on real non-defective images without any defect references for the target asset, that can be used for model selection and validation. A defect taxonomy for common failure modes is distilled from literature into prescriptive prompts at varying defect severities. Regions of interest are cropped from in defect-free images and edited with a pre-trained image generation model ("FLUX.2 [klein]"). Color-matching and blending are employed to improve structural coherence with the original image. Generations are filtered out by a scorer and by estimated detection difficulty. Model selection experiments on MVTecAD show image AUROC choice regret over model selection can be nearly halved compared to the best fixed model chosen with access to test data. Experiments show the need for severity-graded anomaly synthesis. A case study investigates the proposed method for in-situ monitoring of Pelton turbine runners in hydropower, where real defect images are rare and expensive to collect. A PatchCorebased anomaly detection model is fit on Pelton turbine images and selected and validated using synthetic images, showing strong detection performance (94 % correct detection at optimal threshold and AUROC 0.97). The model reliably detects moderate and advanced defects, while early-stage defects remain challenging, indicating the synthetic data meaningfully stresses detector sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需目标资产真实缺陷参考、在无缺陷图像上合成严重程度分级缺陷的框架，用于缺陷检测模型的选取与验证，并在MVTecAD和水电Pelton转轮案例中验证有效。
AI.motivation: 工业状态监测中的缺陷检测系统需要验证，但缺陷样本稀少，特定资产甚至没有缺陷样本，真实缺陷图像获取困难且昂贵。
AI.method: 从文献提炼常见失效模式的缺陷分类，转化为不同严重程度的提示词；裁剪无缺陷图像中的感兴趣区域，用预训练图像生成模型FLUX.2 [klein]进行编辑；通过颜色匹配与融合提升结构一致性；再用评分器和估计检测难度过滤生成样本，用于模型选择与验证。
AI.result: 在MVTecAD上，模型选择中图像AUROC的选择遗憾相比用测试数据选出的最佳固定模型近乎减半；实验表明严重程度分级异常合成的必要性。Pelton转轮案例中，基于PatchCore的异常检测模型用合成图像选择与验证，最优阈值下正确检测率94%，AUROC 0.97，能可靠检测中度和重度缺陷，但早期缺陷仍具挑战。
AI.conclusion: 合成缺陷数据可有效用于工业缺陷检测的模型选择与验证，无需目标资产的真实缺陷样本，并能对检测器灵敏度进行有意义的压力测试；但早期缺陷检测仍需进一步改进。

title: Pretrain Once, Route Anywhere: Towards a Foundation Model for LLM Routing
summary: Large language model (LLM) routing aims to assign each query to the most suitable model from a heterogeneous candidate pool, improving the quality--efficiency trade-off of LLM inference. Existing routers are typically learned through local fitting: a router is optimized for a particular query workload and candidate pool, and often requires additional supervision or retraining as the routing environment changes. We ask whether LLM routing can instead be approached from a foundation-model perspective, learning a reusable routing capability that generalizes across tasks, candidate models, and deployment conditions. To this end, we introduce RouteFM, which learns to characterize anonymous candidate models from behavioral context and infer their target-specific capabilities, rather than binding routing decisions to fixed model identities or a single environment. Through episodic pretraining across heterogeneous routing environments, this capability can be reused by a frozen router and adapted to new environments through context alone. Experiments demonstrate transfer across changes in domains, modalities, candidate pools, and context budgets, with the largest gains when behavioral evidence is limited. On MMR-Bench, which is excluded from pretraining, RouteFM outperforms the strongest baseline by 2.23 quality points with only eight observations per candidate. These results support moving LLM routing from repeated local fitting toward a pretrain once, route anywhere paradigm. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/LAMDA-Model-Reuse/RouteFM.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RouteFM，将大语言模型路由视为基础模型问题，通过情景式预训练学习可复用的路由能力，使路由器能根据行为上下文识别匿名候选模型并推断其任务特定能力，实现跨任务、模型池和部署条件的泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 路由器通常针对特定查询负载和候选池进行局部拟合优化，每当路由环境变化时就需要额外监督或重新训练，难以泛化。作者希望探索能否从基础模型视角出发，学习一种可复用的路由能力，从而适应任务、候选模型和部署条件的变化。
AI.method: 提出 RouteFM：不将路由决策绑定到固定模型身份或单一环境，而是从行为上下文中刻画匿名候选模型，并推断其目标特定能力。通过跨异构路由环境的情景式预训练，让冻结的路由器复用该能力，并仅依靠上下文适配新环境。
AI.result: 实验表明，RouteFM 能在领域、模态、候选池和上下文预算变化时实现迁移，且在行为证据有限时增益最大。在未参与预训练的 MMR-Bench 上，每个候选仅用八次观察，RouteFM 就以 2.23 个质量点超越最强基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，LLM 路由可以从反复局部拟合转向“预训练一次、随处路由”的新范式。代码已开源于 https://github.com/LAMDA-Model-Reuse/RouteFM。

title: Anatomy-Aware Prediction of Bronchoscopic Accessibility from 3D CT
summary: Pre-operative planning for bronchoscopy is critical for the diagnosis of lung lesions. Current accessibility assessment relies on subjective manual inspection of CT scans, which is time-consuming and prone to inter-observer variability. In this paper, we formalize bronchoscopy accessibility prediction as a novel supervised learning task and present the first end-to-end framework to address it. We propose an Anatomy-Aware Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model that integrates specialized modules: a CT Expert for local morphological features, a Lobe Expert for anatomical priors, and a Path Geometry Expert that encodes the sequential constraints of the bronchial tree. To support this task, we curated the first clinical dataset of 438 cases with pre-operative CT scans and documented procedural outcomes. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves an AUROC of 0.8052, significantly outperforming both state-of-the-art baselines and experienced human experts. This work establishes a new benchmark for computer-aided interventional planning in pulmonary medicine. Our data and code will be publicly available at https://nubagcilab.github.io/BronchoAccess/.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将支气管镜可及性预测形式化为监督学习任务，并提出端到端的解剖感知混合专家（MoE）框架，用于术前CT规划。
AI.motivation: 当前肺癌病灶支气管镜可及性评估依赖医生手动主观判读CT，耗时且存在观察者间差异，缺乏自动化、标准化的预测方法。
AI.method: 提出解剖感知混合专家（MoE）模型，包含CT专家（局部形态特征）、肺叶专家（解剖先验）和路径几何专家（支气管树序列约束）；并构建首个包含438例术前CT及手术结局的临床数据集。
AI.result: 该方法AUROC达0.8052，显著优于现有最优基线及经验丰富的人类专家，建立了肺医学计算机辅助介入规划的新基准。
AI.conclusion: 将支气管镜可及性预测作为监督学习任务可行且有效，MoE框架能提升术前规划准确性，数据和代码将公开。

title: Beyond Prompt Count: How Data Shapes Transfer in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains students using teacher feedback on their own sampled responses, yet how prompt choice shapes transfer across teacher-student pairs remains poorly understood. We systematically study prompt quantity, source, and selection across RL- and SFT-continuation pairs and cross-model settings. We find that OPD can be highly prompt-efficient: a few prompts can approach large-pool performance, with four DAPO prompts matching the observed mathematics score of 3,840 DeepMath prompts. However, prompt utility is relational rather than intrinsic: changing only the teacher can reverse the relative effectiveness of mathematics and code prompts. To characterize these transfer differences, we analyze parameter and functional changes across prompt supports and model pairs. Functional alignment with the teacher varies across supports and target tasks; in continuation pairs, teacher-aligned prediction changes can coexist with weak parameter alignment. Continued OPD on effective supports can restore performance after unfavorable transfer. Finally, targeted selection does not consistently outperform uniform random sampling, and filtering out a source that performs poorly alone yields no consistent gain across three paired support draws. Overall, our results distinguish prompt efficiency from prompt interchangeability and show that effective data choice depends on the teacher-student pair and target capability, with random sampling providing a competitive baseline in the studied settings.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中提示词的数量、来源和选择如何影响师生对之间的知识迁移，发现提示词效率极高但效用具有关系性，随机采样是强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有OPD研究对提示词选择如何影响师生对之间的迁移理解不足，尤其缺乏对提示词数量、来源和选择策略的系统性分析。
AI.method: 在RL和SFT续训对及跨模型设置下，系统研究提示词的数量、来源和选择；分析参数和功能变化；比较定向选择与均匀随机采样；测试过滤表现差的来源。
AI.result: OPD提示词效率高：4个DAPO提示词在数学分数上接近3840个DeepMath提示词。提示词效用是关系性的：仅更换教师会逆转数学与代码提示词的相对效果。功能对齐随支持和目标任务变化；续训对中教师对齐的预测变化可与弱的参数对齐共存。有效支持上的持续OPD可恢复不利迁移后的性能。定向选择未持续优于随机采样；过滤单独表现差的来源在三次配对支持抽取中无一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 结果区分了提示词效率与提示词可互换性，表明有效数据选择取决于师生对和目标能力，随机采样在所研究设置中提供了有竞争力的基线。

title: STEPQuant: When and Where Errors Matter in Delta-Rule Recurrent State Quantization
summary: Linear attention replaces growing KV caches with fixed-size recurrent states, yet these persistent states can become a substantial memory bottleneck under concurrent serving. Directly quantizing recurrent states to low precision often leads to severe accuracy degradation, as quantization errors propagate through successive state updates. We discover that the impact of these errors depends on two complementary dimensions: temporally, errors in long-lived memory can persist across many decoding steps; spatially, errors in different key rows affect model outputs differently, while state magnitudes vary substantially along both rows and columns. Motivated by these observations, we propose STEPQuant, a spatial-temporal post-training quantization framework for Delta-rule recurrent states. STEPQuant allocates precision according to error magnitude and memory lifetime, and jointly fits key-row and value-column scales based on state distributions and key-row impact on output error. Experiments on Qwen3.8-27B and Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct across both long- and short-generation benchmarks show that STEPQuant closely matches FP32-state accuracy under a nominal 6-bit budget and outperforms uniform INT8 in its 4-bit configuration. Integrated into SGLang with optimized GPU kernels, 6-bit STEPQuant achieves over 5x recurrent-state compression and reduces total serving memory by up to 68.7%. Our code is available at https://github.com/Dreamer-Toby/STEPQuant.

AI.tldr: 论文提出STEPQuant，一种面向线性注意力Delta-rule循环状态的空间-时间后训练量化框架，通过按误差幅度与记忆寿命分配精度并联合拟合key行/val列缩放，在6-bit预算下接近FP32精度，实现超5倍循环状态压缩和最高68.7%的总体服务内存降低。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力用固定大小的循环状态替代不断增长的KV缓存，但在并发服务场景下这些持久状态会成为显著的内存瓶颈；而直接将循环状态量化到低精度会因量化误差在连续状态更新中传播而导致严重的精度下降。
AI.method: 作者发现量化误差影响体现在两个互补维度：时间上，长寿命记忆中的误差会跨多个解码步骤持续存在；空间上，不同key行的误差对模型输出影响不同，且状态幅度在行和列方向上都存在显著差异。基于此提出STEPQuant：根据误差幅度和记忆寿命分配精度，并基于状态分布及key行对输出误差的影响，联合拟合key行与value列的缩放因子。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.8-27B和Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct上，覆盖长/短生成基准：名义6-bit预算下STEPQuant精度接近FP32状态，4-bit配置下优于均匀INT8。集成SGLang并配合优化GPU内核后，6-bit STEPQuant实现超过5倍的循环状态压缩，总服务内存最多降低68.7%。
AI.conclusion: STEPQuant通过空间-时间感知的量化精度分配与缩放因子联合拟合，有效抑制了循环状态量化误差的传播，在保持精度的同时大幅降低服务内存占用，代码已开源。

title: MG-Thinker: Bi-Axial Self-Reflection for Multi-Image Reasoning Grounding
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has recently delivered substantial gains in multimodal reasoning, opening a promising route for fine-grained visual perception. Yet for multi-image reasoning grounding (MRG), reasoning over real-world multi-image contexts toward pixel-precise localization, existing RL-based approaches overlook two characteristics intrinsic to this paradigm: a coarse-to-fine hierarchical reasoning pattern, and heterogeneously distributed task--sample difficulties. In this work, we present MG-Thinker, a post-training RL framework that advances a new MRG paradigm featuring such hierarchical reasoning, supported by a curated 25K MRG dataset with task-adaptive Chain-of-Thought (CoT) annotations that elicit multi-perspective evidence before conclusion. To remedy the heterogeneous task--sample difficulties, we further propose Bi-Axial DAPO (BiA-DAPO), which decomposes rollout advantages along an intra-group signal axis and an inter-group competence axis through two complementary mechanisms, both grounded on our defined candidate pool for stable group-level statistics. Extensive experiments show that MG-Thinker achieves state-of-the-art performance on multi-image reasoning grounding while consistently improving generalization across multi-image understanding and diverse multimodal benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MG-Thinker，一个面向多图推理定位（MRG）的后训练强化学习框架，引入由粗到细的层次推理范式，并构建 25K 任务自适应 CoT 数据集；同时提出 Bi-Axial DAPO 处理任务与样本难度异质性问题，在多图推理定位上达到 SOTA 并提升泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有基于强化学习的方法用于多图推理定位时，忽略了该范式的两个内在特性：由粗到细的层次推理模式，以及任务与样本难度的异质分布。
AI.method: 提出 MG-Thinker 后训练 RL 框架，构建 25K MRG 数据集及任务自适应 CoT 标注，先激发多视角证据再得出结论；提出 BiA-DAPO，基于候选池稳定组级统计，沿组内信号轴和组间能力轴分解 rollout 优势，用两个互补机制处理异质难度。
AI.result: 大量实验显示，MG-Thinker 在多图推理定位上取得 SOTA，并持续提升多图理解及多种多模态基准上的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为多图推理定位提供了支持层次推理的 RL 后训练新范式，并通过 BiA-DAPO 有效应对任务-样本难度异质性，验证了方法的有效性与泛化性。

title: Teaching LLMs to Generate Challenging MILP Instances via Solver Feedback
summary: Generating optimization instances that are both feasible and computationally challenging is crucial for benchmarking solvers and training learning-based optimization algorithms. Existing non-LLM generators rely on seed instances or parameter tuning, resulting in high test-time computational cost, while existing LLM generators lack explicit hardness measures. Recent reinforcement learning methods with verifier feedback evaluate only binary correctness, which is misaligned with generating challenging problems. We note that an optimization solver reports the cost of solving at several stages of its pipeline, and leverage this to design a reward that scores both the solvability and the hardness of generated problems, measured by branch-and-bound nodes and post-cut relaxation gaps. Our key idea is a challenger-solver asymmetric self-play approach, where an LLM challenger generates progressively harder instances and the solver verifies feasibility and hardness, so no seed or training MILP instances are required. We fine-tune Gemma-4-12B and Qwen3.5-4B with GRPO and a size curriculum into OptiScribe-12B and OptiScribe-4B, which generate feasible yet challenging MILP problems from natural language instructions. On capacitated facility location and max-cut, OptiScribe-12B raises median SCIP search nodes by 1.7-5x and post-cut gaps by 1.1-1.7x over its base model and improves the feasibility rate on facility location by 9-19 points, while OptiScribe-4B raises median nodes by up to 15.6x. The problems cover a wider difficulty range than public benchmarks of the same size, follow instructions on density and difficulty, and can tune solver settings for families that public libraries lack. These results indicate that optimization-specific rewards, used in self-play mode, can teach LLMs to generate high-difficulty optimization benchmarks. We will release our code and models publicly on acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出挑战者-求解器非对称自博弈方法，利用求解器阶段成本设计优化专用奖励，微调出OptiScribe-12B/4B，可从自然语言指令生成可行且高难度的MILP问题。
AI.motivation: 生成既可行又计算困难的优化实例对基准测试与学习算法训练至关重要。现有非LLM生成器依赖种子实例或参数调优，测试时开销高；现有LLM生成器缺乏显式难度度量；近期带验证器反馈的强化学习只评估二值正确性，与生成难题目标不一致。
AI.method: 利用求解器流水线中报告的分支定界节点数和割后松弛间隙等成本信号，设计同时衡量可解性与难度的奖励；采用挑战者-求解器非对称自博弈，LLM挑战者逐步生成更难实例，求解器验证可行性与难度，无需种子或训练MILP实例；用GRPO和规模课程微调Gemma-4-12B与Qwen3.5-4B得到OptiScribe-12B和OptiScribe-4B。
AI.result: 在容量设施选址和最大割上，OptiScribe-12B相比基座模型将SCIP中位搜索节点提高1.7-5倍、割后间隙提高1.1-1.7倍，设施选址可行性率提升9-19个百分点；OptiScribe-4B中位节点最高提升15.6倍。生成问题难度范围比同规模公开基准更广，能遵循密度与难度指令，并可调节公共库缺乏的求解器设置。
AI.conclusion: 优化专用奖励结合自博弈模式可教会LLM生成高难度优化基准；代码与模型将在录用后公开。

title: Routing Should Pay for Itself: Sparse Supervision for Economical LLM Routing
summary: Large language model (LLM) routing reduces serving cost by assigning each query to an appropriate model while preserving response quality. Learning such a router, however, often requires executing multiple candidate models on historical queries to collect query--model quality feedback, creating a nontrivial supervision cost before deployment. Existing work largely focuses on serving-time efficiency, overlooking whether the resulting savings are sufficient to recover this upfront expenditure. We further observe that routing quality often saturates well before all query--model feedback is collected, suggesting that dense supervision can be economically over-provisioned. We propose SaveRouter, a sparse-supervision routing framework that selectively acquires informative model feedback and shares capability information across related queries, while retaining query-level refinement for fine-grained routing. We evaluate routing by jointly accounting for supervision expenditure and subsequent serving-time savings. Across four routing benchmarks, the main setting uses only about 33--41% of available training feedback while maintaining competitive or better routing quality, and reduces the break-even deployment volume by approximately 1.9--9.5 times compared with the fastest conventional router. Further analysis shows that acquiring more supervision is not always economically preferable: the supervision level that minimizes serving cost can differ from the one that achieves the earliest payback. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/LAMDA-Model-Reuse/SaveRouter.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SaveRouter，一种稀疏监督的LLM路由框架，通过选择性获取模型反馈并跨相关查询共享能力信息，降低前期监督成本，同时保持路由质量，并联合考虑监督开销与服务节省来评估路由经济性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM路由研究主要关注服务时效率，忽略了为训练路由器而执行多个候选模型所产生的前期监督成本；且观察到路由质量往往在收集全部查询-模型反馈前就已饱和，密集监督可能在经济上过度配置。
AI.method: 提出SaveRouter稀疏监督路由框架：选择性获取有信息量的模型反馈，在相关查询间共享能力信息，并保留查询级细化以实现细粒度路由。评估时联合考虑监督支出与后续服务时节省。
AI.result: 在四个路由基准上，主设置仅使用约33-41%的可用训练反馈，即可保持竞争性或更优的路由质量，并将盈亏平衡部署量较最快的传统路由器减少约1.9-9.5倍。分析还表明，获取更多监督并非总是经济上更优：使服务成本最小的监督水平可能与实现最早回本的监督水平不同。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏监督路由能在显著降低前期监督成本的同时保持路由质量并加速回本；监督量应根据经济目标（成本最小化或最早回本）谨慎选择，而非一味增加。

title: Rational Clarification by Assistive Agents via Value-of-Information Reasoning
summary: Users of language-based assistive agents often make ambiguous requests. In response, an assistant can either directly act on its interpretation of the request --- risking misalignment with the user --- or ask a clarifying question. Which option is the most safe and helpful? A common approach is to ask questions that minimize uncertainty about the user's intent until a threshold is reached. However, this neglects the impact of uncertainty reduction on downstream performance, the costs of asking versus acting immediately, and the possibility that users may provide corrections without being asked. To navigate these trade-offs, we introduce Rational Enquiry via Value-of-Information Reasoning (REVOIR). REVOIR makes clarification decisions via inference-time reasoning about the value-of-information of a question, which captures the expected improvement in task reward due to the answer received. In two assistive tasks --- ambiguous question answering (CondAmbigQA) and preference-aligned household task planning (ADAPT) --- we show that REVOIR achieves greater success with fewer questions than approaches based on prompting, chain-of-thought, fine-tuning, or information gain, improving preference satisfaction on ADAPT by 13-15% over a fine-tuned clarification policy while requiring no training and asking five times fewer questions. Furthermore, when the assistant can receive cheap user corrections after acting, REVOIR naturally infers that asking questions is not always efficient, demonstrating the adaptivity of our approach. In contrast, we find that vanilla reasoning agents fail to adaptively clarify user requests, and request fewer clarifications as reasoning effort increases.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 REVOIR，通过推理提问的信息价值来决定是否澄清用户请求，在歧义问答和偏好对齐家庭任务规划中，以更少提问取得更高成功率，并能适应低成本纠错场景。
AI.motivation: 语言助手常面对歧义请求，直接行动可能违背用户意图，提问又可能不必要。现有方法多以减少不确定性为目标，忽略了不确定性降低对下游任务表现的影响、提问与立即行动的成本，以及用户可能主动纠正的情况。
AI.method: 提出 Rational Enquiry via Value-of-Information Reasoning（REVOIR），在推理时估计提问的信息价值，即预期答案带来的任务奖励提升，并据此决定是否提问。在 CondAmbigQA 和 ADAPT 两个辅助任务中评估，与提示、思维链、微调和信息增益方法对比。
AI.result: REVOIR 在更少提问下获得更高成功率。在 ADAPT 上，偏好满足度比微调澄清策略提升 13-15%，无需训练且提问次数少五倍。当行动后用户可低成本纠正时，REVOIR 能推断提问不一定高效，表现出适应性；而普通推理智能体无法自适应澄清，且推理努力增加时反而更少提问。
AI.conclusion: 基于信息价值的推理能更安全高效地决定是否澄清用户请求，在性能、提问成本和用户纠错之间取得更好权衡，优于固定阈值或仅降低不确定性的方法。

title: BeatDance: Generating Beat-Consistent 3D Dance with Hierarchical Spatial-Temporal Modeling
summary: Generating realistic 3D dance from music is a challenging task that requires accurate synchronization with musical rhythms while capturing the spatial complexity of human motion. Although existing methods can generate physically plausible dance motions, they often struggle to achieve precise alignment with music, such as the beat. To address this limitation, we propose a novel diffusion-based framework, BeatDance, with two components: 1) We present a Hierarchical Decoupled Attention (HDA) module, which first disentangles the learning of human pose and temporal dynamics. A hierarchical structure is then employed to capture both short-term and long-term dependencies, thereby enhancing spatial-temporal modeling. 2) We adopt cycle-consistent learning by introducing an auxiliary dance-to-music module. During training, discrepancies between the reconstructed and original music induce a stronger loss signal, effectively encouraging the consistency property between the music and dance motion. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our proposed approach outperforms recent competitive methods on two benchmark datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出BeatDance，一种基于扩散模型的3D舞蹈生成框架，通过分层解耦注意力和循环一致性学习，提升音乐与舞蹈动作的节拍对齐及时空建模能力。
AI.motivation: 从音乐生成逼真3D舞蹈需要与节奏精确同步并刻画人体运动的时空复杂性；现有方法虽能生成物理合理的动作，但难以实现如节拍等精确音乐对齐。
AI.method: 采用扩散框架BeatDance，包含：1）分层解耦注意力（HDA）模块，解耦人体姿态与时间动态学习，并用分层结构捕捉短期和长期依赖；2）循环一致性学习，引入辅助舞蹈到音乐模块，通过重构音乐与原始音乐的差异增强损失信号，促进音乐与舞蹈运动的一致性。
AI.result: 在两个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法优于近期竞争方法。
AI.conclusion: BeatDance能有效提升3D舞蹈生成的音乐对齐精度和时空建模能力，验证了所提HDA与循环一致性学习的有效性。

title: FORUM: Frozen Outputs Reconciled Using Model Agreement for Visual Grounding
summary: Frozen multimodal large language models (MLLMs) now solve standard referring expression comprehension with a single prompted call, yet on adversarial benchmarks with same-category distractors and negation, even the largest models are confidently wrong, and resampling repeats the error. Models built from different data and architectures rarely fall for the same confounder, so their agreement is a strong label-free signal of the correct target. We present FORUM, a training-free test-time fusion of frozen MLLMs guided by two fixed geometric rules: agreement-based selection keeps the region supported by the most distinct models, and medoid localization returns an actual member box instead of a coordinate average, so one loose prediction cannot shift the answer. Fusing three open MLLMs, FORUM surpasses the 397B-parameter published reference by a relative 5% in mean accuracy on the adversarial Ref-Adv-s benchmark, and a plain averaging ensemble by 15%. The gains transfer to standard RefCOCO+, and a balanced lineup with no dominant member still surpasses the 397B model by 5%.

AI.tldr: 提出 FORUM，一种无需训练的测试时融合方法，通过两条固定几何规则融合多个冻结多模态大模型，用于提升指代表达理解在对抗场景下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 冻结多模态大模型在标准指代表达理解上表现良好，但在含同类干扰物和否定的对抗基准上，即使最大模型也会自信出错且重采样无法纠正；不同数据和架构的模型较少被同一混淆因素欺骗，因此模型间一致性可作为无需标签的正确目标信号。
AI.method: FORUM 在测试时融合三个开源冻结 MLLM，采用两条固定几何规则：基于一致性的选择，保留最多不同模型支持的区域；medoid 定位，返回一个真实成员框而非坐标平均，避免单个松散预测影响结果。
AI.result: 在对抗基准 Ref-Adv-s 上，FORUM 相比已发表的 397B 参数参考模型平均准确率相对提升 5%，比普通平均集成提升 15%；增益可迁移到标准 RefCOCO+；在没有主导成员的均衡模型组合下，仍比 397B 模型高 5%。
AI.conclusion: 无需训练的测试时模型融合，结合一致性选择与 medoid 定位，可显著提升多模态大模型在指代表达理解中的对抗鲁棒性，并能超过更大规模参考模型，说明模型多样性与几何融合规则是关键。

title: Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting for Consistent Long-Form Video Generation
summary: While recent video foundation models excel at generating high-quality short videos, long-form video generation remains a critical challenge, where a major bottleneck lies in conditioning independently generated shots to preserve consistent characters, scenes, and objects throughout a story. Existing training-free approaches typically condition target shots using retrieved historical visuals. However, these references often suffer from severe informational mismatch, either introducing irrelevant contextual redundancy or failing to provide the full combination of required elements for the target shot. To resolve this, we present Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting, an agentic framework that strategically aggregates a compact set of mutually supportive historical references to achieve complete and targeted conditioning for long-form video generation without retraining or modifying the underlying generator. Specifically, our framework explicitly models the visual elements required by each target shot by parsing the narrative script into a text-grounded visual element registry that tracks characters, objects, scenes, and their shot-level states. A VLM-annotated keyframe library further maps these elements to past visual observations. Guided by the required elements, our agent retrieves complementary references that maximize target-element coverage while minimizing historical noise. Finally, the retrieved references, structured element states, and grounding instructions are assembled into a unified prompt for the frozen video generator. This element-aware process provides comprehensive conditioning while remaining fully interpretable. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations on multi-shot story generation demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms recent-frame, memory-based, and entity-level retrieval baselines in cross-shot consistency and text-controllability.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的智能体框架“互补检索增强提示”，通过聚合互补的历史视觉参考，为长视频生成提供完整且有针对性的条件，从而提升多镜头故事中角色、场景和物体的一致性。
AI.motivation: 长视频生成的关键瓶颈在于：独立生成的各镜头难以保持角色、场景和物体在故事中的一致性。现有免训练方法虽检索历史视觉作为参考，但常存在严重信息不匹配——要么引入无关冗余，要么无法提供目标镜头所需的全部元素组合。
AI.method: 解析叙事脚本，构建文本驱动的视觉元素注册表，追踪角色、物体、场景及其镜头级状态；利用VLM标注的关键帧库将元素映射到过往视觉观察；智能体据此检索互补参考，最大化目标元素覆盖并最小化历史噪声；最后将检索到的参考、结构化元素状态和接地指令组装为统一提示，输入冻结的视频生成器。
AI.result: 在多镜头故事生成任务上，定量和定性评估表明，该方法在跨镜头一致性和文本可控性方面持续优于近期帧、基于记忆和实体级检索等基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该元素感知流程无需重训练或修改底层生成器，即可提供全面且完全可解释的条件控制，有效解决长视频生成中的一致性问题。

title: Do-JEPA: From Masking to Intervention in Latent World Models
summary: Latent world models are trained to predict what happens next, so nothing in their objective separates what an action caused from what merely co-occurred with it. Object-masking models such as C-JEPA intervene on what the predictor can see; we intervene on what physically happens. From one saved simulator state we run the dynamics under an action $a$ and under a reference action $a_{\varnothing}$, and train the model to predict the difference $Δz=z^{a}-z^{a_{\varnothing}}$ between the two latent futures. The resulting objective, Do-JEPA, has an effect loss, a support loss (where the action enters), a propagation loss (where its effect travels) and invariance losses (what must not change). In a synthetic system with object-aligned variables, support supervision finds the directly intervened object in 99.95% of test cases, where a sparse action mask sends the action to a nuisance slot in every case, and response-onset supervision recovers the ring-shaped propagation graph (edge AUROC 0.975 vs. 0.624). From pixels, the effect loss beats a control trained on exactly the same data: it lowers latent effect error by 28.4% on an end-to-end LeWM model and physical effect error by 13.5% when trained and tested on natural action sequences, and on three independently generated CausalWorld benchmarks it lowers responsive effect error by about 20% under physics shifts and the latent context sensitivity of predicted effects by 66%. Trained from scratch it costs factual accuracy; fine-tuning an existing model with it removes this cost. Together, these results show that intervening on the world, rather than on what the model sees, helps latent world models predict what their actions cause.

AI.tldr: 提出Do-JEPA：通过比较动作a与参考动作a∅下的潜在未来差异Δz，训练潜在世界模型区分动作因果效应与共现变化，并在合成系统、像素端到端模型和CausalWorld基准上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 现有潜在世界模型仅预测下一状态，目标函数不区分动作引起的变化与仅共现的变化；对象掩蔽方法如C-JEPA只干预模型可见输入，而非物理过程。
AI.method: 从同一模拟器状态分别执行动作a和参考动作a∅，让模型预测两个潜在未来的差Δz=z^a-z^a∅；Do-JEPA包含效应损失、支持损失（动作进入位置）、传播损失（效应传播位置）和不变性损失。在合成对象对齐系统、像素端到端LeWM及CausalWorld基准上评估。
AI.result: 支持监督在99.95%测试中找到直接干预对象，而稀疏动作掩码全部错发到干扰槽；响应起始监督恢复环形传播图，边AUROC为0.975对0.624。像素实验中，效应损失优于同数据对照：LeWM潜在效应误差降低28.4%，自然动作序列物理效应误差降低13.5%；CausalWorld三个基准下响应效应误差降约20%，预测效应的潜在上下文敏感度降66%。从头训练会损害事实准确性，微调现有模型可消除此代价。
AI.conclusion: 对物理世界进行干预，而非仅干预模型可见内容，有助于潜在世界模型预测其动作的因果效应。

title: Multi-task learning for the automatic grading of enlarged perivascular space burden using MRI
summary: Enlarged perivascular spaces (PVS) visible in brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are increasingly thought to be linked to poor brain health. PVS are elongated structures of less than 3 mm in diameter and can be numerous. To reflect the incidence of PVS, radiologists visually score their burden following a clinical grading scale - a task that would benefit from automation to accelerate analyses and overcome the influence of inter-observer differences. We developed and evaluated methods for training machine learning models to score PVS incidence in the basal ganglia (BG) and centrum semiovale (CSO) leveraging the Potters/Wardlaw scale. The novelty in our work lies in the use of imperfect, semi-automatically generated "silver-standard" PVS segmentation masks during training, in addition to PVS radiological scores. We comparatively evaluated a conditional convolutional neural network (CNN) which accepts PVS masks as an extra input channel, a multi-task CNN which performs both PVS segmentation and scoring, and a logistic regression model which utilises features derived from PVS masks to predict PVS scores. Multi-task learning was the most effective method, achieving a mean average precision of 64.08% compared to 60.22% for the conditional CNN, 52.11% for a baseline CNN trained only to predict PVS scores, and 49.32% for the logistic regression model. The multi-task model showed an ability to localise individual PVS not shown by the other CNNs, and behaved in a probabilistically sensible way, predicting with lower confidence on inherently harder classes. Age, sex, hypertension status, white matter hyperintensity volume, and ischaemic stroke lesion status were shown to be associated with the multi-task model's PVS score predictions and the ground truth in a similar way.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发并评估了机器学习模型，用于自动评分脑MRI中扩大的血管周围间隙（PVS）在基底节和半卵圆中心的负担，利用半自动生成的“银标准”分割掩码，发现多任务CNN表现最佳。
AI.motivation: PVS与脑健康不良相关，但手动评分耗时且存在观察者间差异，需要自动化方法来加速分析并提高一致性。
AI.method: 基于Potters/Wardlaw量表，在训练中同时使用半自动生成的PVS分割掩码和放射学评分，比较了条件CNN（以PVS掩码为额外输入通道）、多任务CNN（同时进行PVS分割和评分）以及利用PVS掩码特征的逻辑回归模型。
AI.result: 多任务学习最有效，平均精度达64.08%，高于条件CNN（60.22%）、仅评分基线CNN（52.11%）和逻辑回归（49.32%）。多任务模型能定位单个PVS，并在较难类别上预测置信度较低。年龄、性别、高血压、白质高信号体积和缺血性卒中病灶状态与模型预测及真实标签的关联相似。
AI.conclusion: 多任务学习结合半自动分割掩码能有效自动评分PVS，且模型行为概率合理，其预测与临床变量的关联与真实情况一致。

title: FOCUS: Training-Free Decision-Preserving Context Compression for LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents accumulate interaction histories that grow linearly with task length, causing quadratic inference cost scaling and performance degradation from attention dilution. Existing context-compression methods learn what to discard offline: by contrastively optimizing guidelines, distilling compressors, or training compression policies. This incurs a substantial cost. Further, the compression policy is learned a priori and is not dynamically conditioned on the evolving test-time trajectories. In this paper we ask a complementary question: Which past interactions causally shape the agent's future decisions? We recast context compression as a causal decision preservation problem over discrete interaction units and introduce FOCUS, a training-free context compression framework that operates entirely at test time. Our method requires no offline data collection or fine-tuning, and is architecture-agnostic, attaching to any closed-API frontier model as a modular compression layer. We evaluate FOCUS on diverse agentic benchmarks including API and tool-calling, QA, web domain and multi-turn dialogue. Our method establishes new state of the art performance, cutting peak context by up to 48% and dependency by 73% while improving task success by up to 8.9 percentage points over uncompressed execution.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FOCUS，一种无需训练、完全在测试时运行的上下文压缩框架，将上下文压缩重新定义为离散交互单元上的因果决策保持问题。它无需离线数据或微调，可即插即用于任何闭源API前沿模型，在多个智能体基准上实现SOTA，最高减少48%峰值上下文和73%依赖，并提升任务成功率最多8.9个百分点。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体交互历史随任务长度线性增长，导致推理成本二次方增长和注意力稀释引发的性能下降。现有上下文压缩方法需离线学习丢弃内容，成本高昂，且压缩策略无法根据测试时演化的轨迹动态调整。
AI.method: 将上下文压缩重构为离散交互单元上的因果决策保持问题，提出FOCUS：一种完全在测试时运行的免训练上下文压缩框架。无需离线数据收集或微调，架构无关，可作为模块化压缩层附加到任何闭源API前沿模型上。
AI.result: 在API与工具调用、问答、网页领域和多轮对话等多样化智能体基准上评估，FOCUS取得新的SOTA：峰值上下文最多减少48%，依赖最多减少73%，任务成功率相比未压缩执行最多提升8.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: FOCUS表明，通过测试时因果决策保持进行上下文压缩，无需离线训练即可有效降低上下文负担并提升智能体任务表现，为动态、模型无关的上下文管理提供了新方向。

title: Demistifying Data and Simulator Assumptions in Supervised Causal Discovery
summary: Supervised causal discovery learns to infer causal structure for a new dataset from training datasets paired with structural labels. These training pairs are typically simulated, making the simulator both a source of supervision and a carrier of assumptions about causal graphs, mechanisms, and noise. Understanding the resulting predictions therefore requires examining how these assumptions supplement the information available in observational data, which may be compatible with multiple causal graphs. This paper examines that relationship across representative methods available through June 2026. We organize these methods by prediction target, prediction granularity, encoder, structural decoder, and training regime to relate what each method predicts to how it uses data and simulator-based supervision. Using this framework, we distinguish two questions: whether the target is identifiable under the assumed model class, and whether a trained predictor generalizes beyond its training distribution. Restrictions on mechanisms and noise can make otherwise ambiguous causal directions identifiable, but predictive accuracy under those restrictions does not establish transfer when they change. This distinction motivates evaluation that matches metrics to the identifiable graph target and tests changes in graphs, mechanisms, and noise between training and deployment. Extending such evaluation to real data also requires documenting the external causal evidence and uncertainty behind benchmark reference graphs. Together, these analyses guide method comparison and identify open questions in transfer, test-time adaptation, and uncertainty assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文分析截至2026年6月的代表性监督因果发现方法，梳理其如何利用模拟器监督，并区分因果目标的可识别性与预测器的泛化性，进而提出评估建议。
AI.motivation: 监督因果发现通常依赖模拟数据训练，而模拟器既是监督来源，也承载了关于因果图、机制和噪声的假设。观测数据本身常与多个因果图兼容，因此需要理解这些假设如何补充数据信息，并判断预测结果在何种条件下可信。
AI.method: 按预测目标、预测粒度、编码器、结构解码器和训练范式组织代表性方法，分析各方法预测什么以及如何使用数据和模拟器监督；并区分两个问题：目标在假定模型类下是否可识别，以及训练好的预测器是否能超越训练分布泛化。
AI.result: 对机制和噪声的限制可使原本模糊的因果方向变得可识别，但在这些限制下取得的预测精度并不能证明限制改变时的迁移能力。因此，评估应将指标与可识别的图目标匹配，并测试训练与部署之间在图、机制和噪声上的变化。
AI.conclusion: 本文为方法比较提供分析框架，并指出将评估扩展到真实数据时，需记录基准参考图背后的外部因果证据与不确定性。开放问题包括迁移、测试时适应和不确定性评估。

title: Commitment Hierarchies under Intent Revision: A Belief-Revision Account of Salvage in Tool-Use Agents
comment: Accepted in the 27th International Conference on Principles and Practice of Multi-Agent Systems
summary: When a user changes their mind partway through a task, an agent that has already split the task into sub-goals and paid for tool calls must decide, per cached sub-result, whether to keep, patch, or discard it (salvage), restarting wastes valid work and continuing unchanged answers the old question. Our main finding is that salvage quality is a matter of role design rather than model capability: a language model asked the keep/patch/discard question one node at a time is unreliable, but asked to classify the revision once, with a deterministic layer propagating the decision, it reaches the cost-optimal oracle on all three models tested, from two vendors. Modeling the plan as a commitment hierarchy and the intent change as a belief-revision operator with AGM style postulates, we prove that no policy observing only a node's local view can be both safe and cost optimal, while the single classification design is both. Across three environments the policy recovers the full achievable savings, 43% cheaper than restart, at 100% correctness.

AI.tldr: 当用户中途改变意图时，智能体需对已缓存子结果决定保留、修补还是丢弃。本文发现，关键不在模型能力，而在角色设计：让模型只做一次修订分类，再由确定性层传播决策，即可在安全性和成本上达到最优。
AI.motivation: 用户任务中途改变想法时，重启会浪费已完成的子任务和工具调用，而继续原计划又会回答旧问题。因此需要一种能安全且低成本地复用缓存子结果的决策机制。
AI.method: 将计划建模为承诺层次结构，将意图变化建模为带AGM风格公设的信念修正算子；提出单一分类修订加确定性决策传播的方法；并证明仅观察局部节点信息的策略无法同时做到安全与成本最优，而该单次分类设计可以。
AI.result: 在来自两个供应商的三个模型上，单次分类设计均达到成本最优oracle。在三个环境中，该策略恢复了全部可实现的节省，比完全重启便宜43%，且正确率达到100%。
AI.conclusion: 缓存子结果的救赎质量主要取决于角色设计而非模型能力。通过一次性分类修订并确定性传播决策，智能体可以同时实现安全且成本最优的复用决策。

title: KUPAS MASTER: Distilling the Tacit Expertise of Master Practitioners into Agent-Ready Experience Corpora
comment: Technical Report. Official website: https://lsf.kupasai.com/ Report homepage: https://tongjiai4e.github.io/KUPAS-MASTER-Report/
summary: Experienced professionals know more than just facts and conclusions. They know which cues matter, why a judgment is reasonable, and which action to take. Routine work records often leave out this tacit knowledge, making it difficult for Large Language Model (LLM) agents to use professional experience effectively. We introduce KUPAS MASTER, an experience engineering platform built around nine-layer cognitive corpus construction. It turns heterogeneous work records and practitioner interviews into traceable, reusable experience corpora for agents. Six case elements preserve the task process: context, cues, judgment, action, boundaries, and outcomes. Nine-layer cognitive corpus construction organizes tacit experience along nine extraction dimensions and stores the resulting assets in six libraries: rules, constraints, best practices, negative examples, corner cases, and skills. Semantic alignment, individual experience distillation, organizational consolidation, and cross-review preserve source evidence, conditions of use, and unresolved disagreements. The platform packages these assets into callable skills with explicit inputs, steps, dependencies, and stopping conditions, connecting experience collection to task execution and evaluation feedback. Using authorized samples from 20 randomly selected practitioners, the platform processed 1,576 source files into 23,024 individual experience records and 13,113 organizational assets. The evaluation spans multiple professional domains. Under common task inputs and scoring criteria, the base model, raw corpus retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and KUPAS MASTER agent scored 70.63, 79.75, and 89.58, respectively. The KUPAS MASTER agent improved on raw-corpus RAG in all seven scoring dimensions. The platform provides a practical path from individual tacit experience to organizational knowledge and agent capabilities.

AI.tldr: 论文提出KUPAS MASTER经验工程平台，通过九层认知语料构建，将工作记录和从业者访谈转化为可追溯、可复用的经验语料，并封装为可调用技能以提升LLM智能体的专业任务表现。
AI.motivation: 资深专业人员拥有大量隐性知识，如关键线索、判断依据和行动选择，但常规工作记录往往缺失这些知识，导致LLM智能体难以有效利用专业经验。
AI.method: 平台以六类案例要素（情境、线索、判断、行动、边界、结果）保留任务过程，并通过九层认知语料构建沿九个抽取维度组织隐性经验，存入规则、约束、最佳实践、负面案例、边界案例和技能六个库；结合语义对齐、个体经验蒸馏、组织整合和交叉评审，保留来源证据、使用条件和未解决分歧，最终封装为具有明确输入、步骤、依赖和停止条件的可调用技能。
