AI.result: 在统一SMPL表示下，于社会预测、跟踪与补全、响应生成任务中评估，指标涵盖重建精度、真实性、多样性、时间对齐和人际协调；分层隐空间分析显示其能分离群体级与个体级结构。
AI.conclusion: BRAID能够在完整、稀疏或部分观测下实现连贯的多人交互生成，并提供紧凑的社会状态向量，可作为下游具身智能体系统的接口。

title: Spatiotemporal Hyperedges for EEG Seizure Detection and Prediction
summary: Seizure detection and prediction from EEG are clinically important but challenging because seizures are rare, temporally localized, and propagate as coordinated events across multiple channels. Recent dynamic graph neural networks model this by running a temporal model over a sequence of per-time-step pairwise channel edges. However, this pairwise construction misses the spatiotemporal coupling that constitutes a seizure, at substantial training cost. We propose HyBrain, which summarizes spatiotemporal EEG evidence through a small set of soft hyperedges rather than pairwise edges. A per-channel Mamba backbone produces one token per (channel, second), and a spatiotemporal hyperedge block pools these tokens into E_h shared group embeddings through soft memberships and broadcasts them back. The same encoder serves three downstream tasks: window-based detection, one-second point-wise detection, and preictal seizure prediction. On TUSZ and CHB-MIT, HyBrain achieves the best AUROC on every reported setting against ten baselines, with the largest gap on long-clip preictal prediction. It also matches the most efficient baselines in training time and peak GPU memory. A qualitative analysis shows that even a single learned hyperedge cleanly captures the preictal -> ictal -> postictal trajectory on a real seizure clip.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 HyBrain，用少量软超边而非成对边来建模 EEG 中的时空耦合证据，统一用于癫痫发作检测与预测，并在多个数据集上取得最佳 AUROC。
AI.motivation: 癫痫检测与预测具有重要临床意义，但由于发作稀少、时间局部化且在多个通道间协调传播而极具挑战。已有动态图神经网络通常逐时间步构建成对通道边，既忽略癫痫的时空耦合，又带来较高训练成本。
AI.method: HyBrain 使用每通道 Mamba 主干为每个（通道，秒）生成 token，再通过时空超边块以软成员关系将 token 池化为共享组嵌入并广播回各 token；同一编码器支持窗口级检测、逐秒点检测和发作前预测三个下游任务。
AI.result: 在 TUSZ 和 CHB-MIT 上，HyBrain 在所有报告设置中相比十个基线取得最佳 AUROC，尤其在长片段发作前预测上优势最大；训练时间和峰值 GPU 内存与最高效基线相当。定性分析显示单个学习到的超边即可清晰捕捉真实发作片段的发作前→发作期→发作后轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 以软超边汇总时空 EEG 证据可在提升检测与预测性能的同时保持计算效率，并能学习到具有临床可解释性的发作状态演化结构。

title: TomoTransformer: Towards a Foundation Model for CT Reconstruction
summary: Supervised deep learning has advanced sparse-view tomographic reconstruction. However, conventional models, which typically map filtered back-projection (FBP) images or sinograms to clean reconstructions, are brittle under distribution shifts. Because they require retraining whenever projection counts and angles, detector resolutions, or data distributions change, their deployment in real-world applications remains limited. To address this, we introduce TomoTransformer, a transformer-based architecture that treats each \textit{local} filtered projection as an individual token and predicts missing views via self-attention. Crucially, TomoTransformer operates in a \emph{back-projection space} that separates projections across spatial locations, making view interpolation geometrically well-posed and invariant to detector size. This design yields a single foundation model that can process any number of input projections, at arbitrary angular locations and detector dimensions, and query any number of target angles without retraining. Trained on a large-scale dataset spanning diverse medical CT anatomies and natural images, TomoTransformer generalizes effectively across anatomies, materials, and resolutions. Extensive evaluations on several benchmark sparse-view datasets show that TomoTransformer significantly outperforms concurrent multi-purpose models like ViewTrans and matches or exceeds strong protocol-specific baselines, while remaining fully agnostic to the number of input and target projections. Furthermore, the model demonstrates robust zero-shot generalization on real experimental nanoscale brain data collected from an X-ray synchrotron, showcasing its practical utility for real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 提出 TomoTransformer，一种基于 Transformer 的稀疏视图断层重建架构，将局部滤波投影作为 token，在反投影空间中通过自注意力预测缺失视图，实现无需重训练即可适应任意投影数量、角度和探测器尺寸的基础模型。
AI.motivation: 传统监督深度学习方法通常将 FBP 图像或正弦图映射到干净重建，但在投影数量、角度、探测器分辨率或数据分布变化时表现脆弱，需要重新训练，限制了实际部署。
AI.method: TomoTransformer 将每个局部滤波投影视为独立 token，并利用自注意力预测缺失视图；其关键是在反投影空间中操作，将投影按空间位置分离，使视图插值在几何上适定且对探测器尺寸不变。模型在大规模医学 CT 解剖和自然图像数据集上训练。
AI.result: 在多个稀疏视图基准数据集上，TomoTransformer 显著优于 ViewTrans 等多用途模型，并匹配或超过强协议特定基线，同时对输入和目标投影数量完全无关。在 X 射线同步辐射采集的真实纳米尺度脑数据上，也展现出稳健的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: TomoTransformer 可作为统一基础模型处理任意数量、角度和探测器尺寸的投影输入，无需重训练，并具有跨解剖结构、材料和分辨率的泛化能力及实际应用潜力。

title: Cross-Entropy Guided Routing in Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Models
summary: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) large language models scale model capacity by routing each token to a small subset of experts. Their routers are regularized with load balancing terms and learn affinity scores through the language-model objective. However, these objectives do not provide direct alignment between routing affinities and token-level error. We introduce token-error supervision for sparse routing in two forms. The first form predicts an error score per expert. The affinity-weighted aggregate of these scores is aligned to the next-token cross-entropy loss, while the individual scores attenuate affinity before top-$K$ selection. The second directly aligns the router's affinities to the model's objective without requiring an additional head or inference-time modification. Both formulations use the Itakura--Saito divergence or an exponential negative log-likelihood for aligning affinities and token errors. Across two sparse MoE backbones and four multiple-choice question-answering benchmarks, we evaluate both supervision mechanisms. On Granite, our method improves accuracy by approximately 2.3 percentage points on average over a parameter-matched routing baseline. With stronger supervision, the gain on ARC-Challenge reaches 2.94 points. Both mechanisms preserve the native sparse execution budget and aggregation policy. Our code is available in the supplementary materials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种面向稀疏MoE语言模型路由器的token级错误监督方法，使路由亲和度与下一token预测误差对齐，在多个选择题基准上提升准确率，同时保持原生稀疏执行预算与聚合策略。
AI.motivation: 稀疏MoE依赖负载均衡项和语言模型目标来学习路由亲和度，但这些目标并未将路由选择与token级预测误差直接对齐，因此路由可能并非最优。
AI.method: 提出两种token-error监督形式：一是为每个专家预测误差分数，将其亲和度加权聚合与下一token交叉熵损失对齐，并用个体分数在top-K选择前衰减亲和度；二是直接将路由器亲和度与模型目标对齐，无需额外预测头或推理时修改。两种方法均使用Itakura-Saito散度或指数负对数似然来对齐亲和度与token误差。
AI.result: 在两个稀疏MoE骨干和四个多项选择问答基准上评估。在Granite上，相比参数量匹配的路由基线，平均准确率提升约2.3个百分点；更强监督下，ARC-Challenge提升达2.94个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 两种监督机制均能在不改变原生稀疏执行预算和聚合策略的前提下，有效提升稀疏MoE路由质量与下游问答性能。

title: ContextRender: From Execution Dependencies to Agent Context
summary: LLM agents performing long-horizon tasks accumulate tool results that later steps may need. Passing the full history to every invocation is costly even when it fits within the context window, while reducing it risks omitting needed information. Existing context management methods can overlook how earlier tool results are used in subsequent execution, leaving needed information out of context. We introduce ContextRender, which manages context through a persistent graph of execution dependencies. We develop Tool-Flow Analysis to track how later operations reuse information from earlier tool results, providing a signal called observed reuse. A renderer combines this signal with recency and semantic relevance to select results within a fixed history budget, retaining omitted results for later use. Across AppWorld and 8-objective QA with three execution models, ContextRender outperforms the evaluated context management baselines using a 6K history budget, well below the models' maximum context windows. Within this budget, it achieves task performance close to or above that of passing the full history while reducing mean inference cost by 10.2%-32.2% relative to Full history. Ablations show that observed reuse improves task performance and retention of results reused later.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ContextRender，通过持久化的执行依赖图管理 LLM 智能体长任务中的上下文，在固定历史预算下选择性地保留和复用早期工具结果，从而降低推理成本并保持任务性能。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体执行长周期任务时会累积大量工具调用结果，后续步骤可能需要复用。将完整历史传入每次调用成本高昂，而简单缩减历史又可能遗漏关键信息。现有上下文管理方法常忽视早期工具结果在后续执行中的实际复用方式，导致必要信息未被保留。
AI.method: 提出 ContextRender，基于持久化的执行依赖图管理上下文。开发 Tool-Flow Analysis 追踪后续操作如何复用早期工具结果，得到“observed reuse”信号。渲染器结合该信号、时间新近性和语义相关性，在固定历史预算内选择工具结果，并保留被省略结果以备后续使用。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld 和 8-objective QA 上，使用三种执行模型，ContextRender 在 6K 历史预算下优于所评估的上下文管理基线，且该预算远低于模型最大上下文窗口。在该预算内，任务性能接近或超过传入完整历史，同时相比 Full history 将平均推理成本降低 10.2%–32.2%。消融实验表明，observed reuse 能提升任务性能并增强对后续复用结果的保留。
AI.conclusion: 通过执行依赖图和工具流分析驱动的上下文渲染，可以在有限历史预算下有效保留后续所需信息，兼顾任务表现与推理成本，优于现有上下文管理方法。

title: FedSocket: Recipient-Executable Knowledge Exchange for Heterogeneous Multimodal Federated Learning
summary: Federated knowledge must remain usable by recipients with different modalities, private architectures, and tasks. We present FedSocket, which makes recipient execution a design requirement of the exchanged model. A shared Q combines recipient-computable inputs, task-owned outputs, and ownership-aware aggregation, connecting heterogeneous private models through a common prediction interface. Private models teach local Q copies; the returned Q supports local learning and Joint inference, with only Q parameters and counts exchanged. Across six datasets, FedSocket improves missing-modality recipient accuracy over Local by 14.44 and 15.51 percentage points on MELD and UCF-51. Under matched inference capacity, Joint exceeds independent ensembles by 11.06 points in UCF-51 accuracy and 4.87 points in mean bidirectional Flickr30k R@1. Joint also improves over Q alone on all four heterogeneous endpoints, demonstrating the value of combining local and exchanged predictions. Teacher controls, sharing-path interventions, and component factorials identify the roles of supervision, sharing, and deployment. FedSocket makes exchanged knowledge directly usable from federated training to recipient inference.

AI.tldr: 提出 FedSocket，将接收方执行作为交换模型的设计要求，通过共享 Q 接口连接异构私有模型，使联邦交换知识可直接用于不同模态、架构和任务的接收方。
AI.motivation: 联邦知识需被不同模态、私有架构和任务的接收方使用，但传统交换模型或参数往往难以直接适配接收方。
AI.method: 设计共享 Q，组合接收方可计算输入、任务自有输出和所有权感知聚合，形成公共预测接口；私有模型训练本地 Q 副本，仅交换 Q 参数和计数，返回的 Q 支持本地学习和联合推理。
AI.result: 在六个数据集上，FedSocket 将缺失模态接收方准确率较 Local 在 MELD 和 UCF-51 上分别提升 14.44 和 15.51 个百分点；匹配推理容量下，Joint 在 UCF-51 准确率上超独立集成 11.06 个点，在 Flickr30k 平均双向 R@1 上超 4.87 个点；Joint 在四个异构端点上均优于仅用 Q。
AI.conclusion: 教师控制、共享路径干预和组件因子实验表明监督、共享与部署的作用；FedSocket 使联邦训练交换的知识可直接用于接收方推理。

title: OmniVCBench: Benchmarking Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Reasoning Towards AI Virtual Cells
summary: Artificial Intelligence Virtual Cells (AIVCs) are envisioned as scientific agents that simulate cellular responses, explain underlying mechanisms, and support hypothesis-driven discovery. Existing AIVC benchmarks, however, operate primarily at the simulation layer, motivating complementary evaluation of how models interpret experimental evidence and formulate biological hypotheses. We introduce OmniVCBench, a figure-centric, source-traceable benchmark for the interpretation component of an AIVC. It contains 6,077 curated single- and multi-subfigure question--answer pairs derived from figures and experimental contexts in the scientific literature. Guided by Bloom's taxonomy, we instantiate interpretation-layer counterparts of the AIVC Predict--Explain--Discover agenda through three scientific reasoning tasks. We further introduce AIVC-Judge, a task-conditioned MLLM-as-a-judge framework with category-specific, reference-aware rubrics for evaluating open-ended responses. A complementary Model-Derived Hard-Negative Mining (MDHNM) strategy converts plausible errors observed during model inference into MCQ distractors for lower-cost evaluation. Within the evaluated heterogeneous model pool, MCQ accuracy correlates positively with AIVC-Judge scores, providing a complementary view of performance alongside open-response evaluation. Code and data demo are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/OmniVCBench.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出OmniVCBench，一个面向AI虚拟细胞（AIVC）解释能力的、以图表为中心且可溯源的科学推理基准，并配套AIVC-Judge与MDHNM评估策略。
AI.motivation: 现有AIVC基准主要评估模拟层，缺少对模型如何解释实验证据、提出生物学假设等解释层能力的评估。
AI.method: 构建包含6,077个单/多子图问答对的基准，数据来自科学文献图表与实验背景；依据Bloom分类法设计三类科学推理任务，对应AIVC的预测-解释-发现议程；提出任务条件化的MLLM-as-a-judge框架AIVC-Judge，使用分类别、参考感知的评分标准评估开放式回答；并提出MDHNM策略，将模型推理中的合理错误转化为多选题干扰项以降低评估成本。
AI.result: 在异质模型池中，多选题准确率与AIVC-Judge得分呈正相关，说明两种评估方式可提供互补的性能视角。
AI.conclusion: OmniVCBench为AIVC解释层提供了可溯源、图表驱动的补充评估方案，并结合开放式与低成本多选题评估，促进对模型科学解释与假设生成能力的衡量。

title: Exemplar2VQA: A Scalable Exemplar-Driven Visual Question Answering Generation Framework via Multi-Agent Coding
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 33 pages, 11 figures, 11 tables
summary: Advancing spatial intelligence in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is bottlenecked by the scarcity of complex, scalable 3D question-answer (QA) data. While manual annotation is labor-intensive, directly utilizing LLMs to synthesize these QA pairs often fails due to their inherent deficiencies in spatial and geometric computation. We introduce Exemplar2VQA, a scalable exemplar-driven visual question answering generation framework that rapidly synthesizes large-scale spatial QA pairs in simulated environments via multi-agent coding. By equipping collaborative agents with a meticulously designed library of geometric utilities, Exemplar2VQA bypasses LLMs' spatial reasoning flaws through deterministic code execution. Crucially, the framework exhibits remarkable versatility: taking diverse static object-centric spatial query templates as exemplars, it seamlessly and autonomously scales them into massive, high-fidelity synthetic datasets. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL (3B/7B) exclusively on Exemplar2VQA-generated synthetic indoor data yields significant performance improvements across various diverse benchmarks. Furthermore, its effectiveness is not limited to in-domain indoor datasets but also robustly extends to outdoor and mixed-scene benchmarks. These results establish Exemplar2VQA as a scalable and powerful paradigm for bridging the sim-to-real gap in Embodied AI. Our code is at https://github.com/yingjiayu12/Exemplar2VQA

AI.tldr: 提出Exemplar2VQA，一个示例驱动的可扩展3D空间VQA数据生成框架，通过多智能体编码和几何工具库自动合成大规模高保真空间问答数据，并显著提升MLLM空间智能。
AI.motivation: MLLM空间智能发展受限于复杂、可扩展的3D问答数据稀缺；人工标注成本高，而直接用LLM合成QA对又因空间与几何计算能力不足而效果不佳。
AI.method: Exemplar2VQA采用示例驱动、多智能体编码的生成框架，在模拟环境中为协作智能体配备精心设计的几何工具库，通过确定性代码执行绕过LLM的空间推理缺陷；以多样静态物体中心空间查询模板为示例，自动扩展为大规模合成数据集。
AI.result: 仅使用Exemplar2VQA生成的室内合成数据微调Qwen2.5-VL（3B/7B），在多个基准上取得显著性能提升，并能鲁棒泛化到室外及混合场景基准。
AI.conclusion: Exemplar2VQA是一种可扩展且有效的范式，有助于弥合具身AI中的仿真到现实差距。

title: Texture Space Material Diffusion
summary: We present a method for generating high quality materials for 3D objects entirely in texture space. We finetune a video diffusion transformer for text-guided material generation, multi-view material generation, and material upscaling. Our key insight is to use the known projection from image space to texture space, enabling the diffusion process to generalize across arbitrary geometries and texture parameterizations. This approach also avoids the view consistency issues inherent in video and multi-view diffusion models. Because texture space is two dimensional, we can reuse the strong priors of pretrained video diffusion models. We apply our method to high quality material reconstruction from posed photos captured under unknown lighting, as well as to text- and image guided material generation. Our method can scale to high resolutions (8K), 100+ input views, and neural material representations. In quantitative and qualitative evaluations we show state-of-the-art results for material generation and reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种完全在纹理空间中生成3D对象高质量材质的方法，通过微调视频扩散Transformer实现文本引导材质生成、多视角材质生成和材质超分，并在材质重建与生成任务上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有视频或多视角扩散模型在3D材质生成中常受视角一致性问题困扰，且难以泛化到任意几何与纹理参数化；而纹理空间是二维的，可复用预训练视频扩散模型的强先验。
AI.method: 利用从图像空间到纹理空间的已知投影，在纹理空间中微调视频扩散Transformer，用于文本引导材质生成、多视角材质生成与材质超分；并应用于未知光照下多视角照片的高质量材质重建，以及文本/图像引导的材质生成。
AI.result: 方法可扩展到8K分辨率、100+输入视角和神经材质表示；在定量与定性评估中，材质生成和重建均达到当前最优水平。
AI.conclusion: 在纹理空间进行扩散建模能有效泛化到任意几何与纹理参数化，避免视角一致性问题，并可高质量、可扩展地完成材质生成与重建。

title: Targeted Visual Counterfactual Explanations for Contrastive Vision-Language Model
summary: Current explanation methods for contrastive vision--language models such as CLIP mainly identify important regions without showing how to change the input in order to get a target prediction. We introduce \textbf{M}ask-guided \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{C}ounterfactual \textbf{E}xplanations (\mace), a targeted visual counterfactual method designed specifically for CLIP zero-shot classification. \mace constructs an editable region from either source attribution or source--target attribution differences and expands the mask only when needed to reach a specified target class. A latent diffusion inpainting model then modifies the selected region, while a frozen CLIP model provides modification guidance and anchors the remaining image content to the original input. We evaluate \mace on ImageNet, Food-101, Oxford Pets, and CUB-200. The source-mask variant achieves the highest target top-1 success rate across all four datasets, while the difference-mask variant produces the smallest pixel-level and perceptual changes and the best realism scores. Both variants improve proximity and realism over a Stable Diffusion-only baseline using the same generative backbone. These results show that adaptive mask-guided editing produces effective CLIP counterfactuals. They further reveal a tradeoff between counterfactual validity and source-image preservation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MACE，一种针对CLIP零样本分类的定向视觉反事实解释方法，通过自适应掩码引导的潜在扩散修复生成反事实图像。
AI.motivation: 现有CLIP解释方法主要识别重要区域，但未展示如何改变输入以获得目标预测。需要一种能生成定向反事实的视觉解释方法。
AI.method: MACE基于源归因或源-目标归因差异构建可编辑区域，必要时扩展掩码；使用潜在扩散修复模型修改区域，冻结CLIP提供修改引导并锚定原始图像内容。在ImageNet等四个数据集上评估。
AI.result: 源掩码变体在所有数据集上目标top-1成功率最高；差异掩码变体产生最小像素和感知变化及最佳真实性。两者在接近度和真实性上均优于仅使用Stable Diffusion的基线。
AI.conclusion: 自适应掩码引导编辑能有效生成CLIP反事实，并揭示了反事实有效性与源图像保留之间的权衡。

title: Tracing the Evidence: Faithful Token Attribution Through Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, yet the visual and textual evidence supporting the generated responses remains difficult to identify. Faithful token attribution explains an LVLM's response by assigning scores that rank image and prompt tokens by how much the model relies on them, such that removing higher-ranked tokens causes the likelihood of the generated response to drop more rapidly. However, existing token-attribution methods have been developed mainly for text-based language models, and our empirical study reveals two challenges when complex multimodal sources are involved. First, the joint image-text attribution can underrepresent visual evidence relative to text, obscuring the image regions supporting the response. Second, visual evidence may influence the generated response through multiple intermediate reasoning paths, while existing methods trace only a limited subset of these paths, causing important visual contributions to be underestimated. Motivated by these insights, we introduce VTrace, a multimodal token-attribution framework that traces input contributions through intermediate reasoning and calibrates attribution scores across modalities. VTrace constructs pairwise attributions that highlight token-specific contributions and aggregates all forward attribution paths in closed form to account for both direct and indirect contributions. Cross-modal calibration then rescales image and text attribution scores using modality contributions estimated from response-likelihood changes, enabling a unified ranking of input tokens. Evaluations against seven baselines across six visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the superior attribution faithfulness. Project page: https://vtrace-attribution.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出VTrace，一种多模态token归因框架，通过追踪中间推理路径并跨模态校准归因分数，使LVLM响应的图像与文本证据归因更忠实。
AI.motivation: 现有token归因方法主要面向纯文本语言模型，在多模态场景下存在两个问题：一是联合图文归因会相对低估视觉证据，掩盖支撑响应的图像区域；二是视觉证据可能通过多条中间推理路径影响响应，而现有方法仅追踪有限子集，导致重要视觉贡献被低估。
AI.method: VTrace构建成对归因以突出token特定贡献，并以闭式形式聚合所有前向归因路径，同时涵盖直接与间接贡献；随后通过跨模态校准，利用响应似然变化估计模态贡献，重新缩放图像与文本归因分数，实现输入token的统一排序。
AI.result: 在六个视觉推理基准上与七个基线方法对比，VTrace展现出更优的归因忠实度。
AI.conclusion: VTrace能够更忠实地解释LVLM的响应，并通过统一排序同时呈现图像与文本token的重要性。

title: DIET: Deletion-response Expert Trimming for Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Video diffusion transformers (DiTs) increasingly adopt mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures to reduce active computation, but their full expert storage remains costly. Existing one-shot pruning criteria mainly rely on static activation or routing statistics and cannot capture layer-level re-routing after expert deletion. We introduce DIET, a training-free expert pruning framework based on deletion responses. A single all-expert calibration pass records expert outputs and router states for matched conditional and unconditional tokens. Candidate deletions are then replayed from cached tensors, requiring no additional model forward passes. The resulting deletion-response signatures characterize each expert by the changes induced when it is removed. DIET selects retained experts by minimizing Overall Diversity Loss (ODL), which preserves directional coverage in signature space, and combines intra-layer local search with an inter-layer regression-guided budget search to allocate experts across layers. On LingBot-Video 30B-A3B, pruning 50% of experts (6,144 to 3,072) reduces the checkpoint from 57 GB to 30 GB and enables single-card deployment on a 48 GB GPU without fine-tuning. Under a fixed 284-case VBench protocol, the VBench Total increases from 0.7941 to 0.8115. Across tested retention budgets, DIET consistently outperforms competitive pruning baselines adapted from large language models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免训练的视频扩散Transformer专家剪枝框架DIET，基于删除响应信号进行专家筛选与层间预算分配，在LingBot-Video 30B-A3B上剪掉50%专家后模型从57GB降至30GB，且VBench指标不降反升。
AI.motivation: 视频DiT采用MoE架构虽能降低激活计算量，但全量专家存储成本依然高昂；现有一次性剪枝准则依赖静态激活或路由统计，无法捕捉删除专家后层级的重路由变化。
AI.method: DIET为免训练框架：先做一次全专家校准，记录匹配的条件/无条件token的专家输出与路由状态；随后基于缓存张量回放候选删除，无需额外前向传播，得到删除响应签名；以最小化Overall Diversity Loss（ODL）保留签名空间方向覆盖度，并结合层内局部搜索与层间回归引导的预算搜索来分配各层专家数。
AI.result: 在LingBot-Video 30B-A3B上，专家从6,144剪至3,072（50%），检查点由57GB减至30GB，可在48GB单卡部署且无需微调；在固定284例VBench协议下，VBench总分从0.7941升至0.8115；在各测试保留预算下均优于由大语言模型适配的剪枝基线。
AI.conclusion: 基于删除响应的免训练剪枝能有效压缩视频DiT的MoE专家存储，兼顾部署可行性与生成质量，且优于静态统计类剪枝方法。

title: Are In-Context Images Worth 10 Dimensions?
summary: There has been significant work on understanding the In-Context Learning capabilities of Large Language Models, especially on the induction circuit. For a few-shot classification task, the induction circuit leverages linear representations of each labeled example in-context in order to classify an unlabeled query. However, few works focus on how those linear representations are built in the first place. Leveraging the expressivity of the vision modality compared to text, we uncover a Shared Discriminative Geometry (SDG) inside Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs). It is a low-dimensional space, shared across all image classification tasks, in which in-context images are compressed into linearly separable representations later used to perform classification. We observe that this is the result of the model performing a dimensionality reduction of vision representations in early layers. In order to explain this phenomenon: (1) We show analytically that linear self-attention can perform a dimensionality reduction by projecting in-context data onto its principal components, with each layer implementing one gradient descent step toward this objective. (2) We provide evidence that trained LVLMs reduce the dimensionality of vision representations in early layers via a similar mechanism.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在少样本图像分类中如何构建上下文线性表示，发现模型内部存在一个跨任务共享的低维可判别几何空间，并解释其由早期层的降维机制形成。
AI.motivation: 现有工作多关注上下文学习中的归纳电路，但较少研究上下文线性表示最初是如何建立的。作者利用视觉模态的表达能力来探索这一问题。
AI.method: 作者分析LVLMs中的内部表示，提出共享判别几何（SDG）概念；并从理论上证明线性自注意力可通过投影到主成分实现降维，每层相当于向该目标执行一步梯度下降；同时提供训练后LVLMs早期层存在类似降维机制的证据。
AI.result: 发现LVLMs中存在一个跨所有图像分类任务共享的低维空间，上下文图像被压缩为线性可分表示并用于后续分类；这种压缩源于模型早期层对视觉表示的降维。
AI.conclusion: LVLMs的少样本分类能力依赖于早期层通过类似主成分投影和梯度下降的机制构建共享判别几何，从而形成可用于分类的线性表示。

title: A neural network that maintains and retrieves memories based on context
summary: Every day, people continuously infer situational context and adjust the way they understand and remember the world. Context, signaled by the prefrontal cortex, is known to modulate working memory and episodic memory, but the algorithmic understanding of this modulation remains limited. Here, we train a recurrent neural network (RNN), augmented with an episodic memory buffer, to infer context using Bayesian inference as it continuously makes predictions of upcoming scenes while watching naturalistic movies. When the inferred context modulates the RNN's recurrent connectivity (the basis of working memory) in a low-rank manner, the model's activity patterns best match neural responses in human participants who watched the same movies during fMRI. Context also modulates episodic memory retrieval, such that the model retrieves memories based on not only content similarity but also context similarity. This is implemented as a key-value system with self-attention, designed to additionally encode context and retrieve context-congruent memories. The resulting model not only better resembles human brain representations but also learns to retrieve memories like humans much faster than a model without context modulation. Together, our findings suggest a computational mechanism by which context modulates information maintenance and long-term memory retrieval in naturalistic environments.

AI.tldr: 研究训练一个带情景记忆缓冲的循环神经网络，用贝叶斯推断情境，并通过情境低秩调制工作记忆连接和记忆检索，以解释自然电影观看中人脑工作记忆与情景记忆的情境调制机制。
AI.motivation: 情境由前额叶皮层信号调节工作记忆和情景记忆，但其算法层面的机制仍不清楚。
AI.method: 训练带情景记忆缓冲的RNN，在观看自然电影并预测后续场景时用贝叶斯推断情境；让情境以低秩方式调制RNN循环连接；并用带自注意力的键值系统编码情境，使记忆检索同时依赖内容相似性和情境相似性；与人类fMRI反应比较。
AI.result: 低秩情境调制循环连接时，模型活动模式最匹配人类fMRI反应；情境也调制情景记忆检索，使模型按内容与情境相似性检索；该模型更好地类似人脑表征，并比无情境调制模型更快学会像人类一样检索记忆。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出一种计算机制，说明情境如何在自然环境中调制信息维持和长期记忆检索。

title: Med-RADIO: Reducing All Medical Domains Into One via Multi-Teacher Distillation
summary: The rapid expansion of large-scale medical datasets and computational resources has driven significant progress in medical foundation models. Given the inherent heterogeneity of medical imaging modalities, current research mainly follows two paths: specialized models optimized for specific modalities, and generalist models designed to handle multiple modalities. However, medical generalist models suffer from both insufficient training data scale relative to natural image generalists and inadequate domain-specific depth relative to medical specialists. Empirically, generalist models establish a cross-modality performance baseline, while specialists define the performance ceiling within their respective domains. To elevate this baseline toward these ceilings, we propose Med-RADIO, a medical multi-teacher distillation framework that Reduces All Domains Into One by compressing complementary expertise from multiple domain-specific teachers into a unified medical vision foundation model. Our method curates both generalist and specialist teachers, allocates modality-aligned distillation streams to reorganize generalist pretraining data so it matches specialist domains, and uses a balanced loss to prevent any single teacher from dominating the distillation process. On internal and external classification benchmarks spanning five modalities, Med-RADIO improves over strong medical generalists under linear probing and remains competitive with representative specialists on most evaluated modalities. Code is available at https://github.com/CAIR-HKISI/Med-RADIO.

AI.tldr: 提出Med-RADIO，一个医学多教师蒸馏框架，将多个领域专家模型的知识压缩到一个统一的医学视觉基础模型中，以兼顾跨模态通用性与领域专精性能。
AI.motivation: 医学影像模态异质性强，现有研究分为专科模型与通用模型。通用模型训练数据规模不及自然图像通用模型，领域深度不及医学专科模型；通用模型提供跨模态基线，专科模型定义各自领域上限，因此需要提升通用基线向上限靠拢。
AI.method: 采用多教师蒸馏框架，筛选通用教师与专科教师，分配模态对齐的蒸馏流，将通用预训练数据重组以匹配专科领域，并使用平衡损失防止单一教师主导蒸馏过程。
AI.result: 在涵盖五种模态的内部与外部分类基准上，Med-RADIO在线性探测下优于强医学通用模型，并在多数评估模态上与代表性专科模型保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: Med-RADIO能够将多个领域特定教师的互补专长融合进统一医学视觉基础模型，有效提升跨模态通用模型性能并接近专科模型水平；代码已开源。

title: Adam under Generalized Smoothness with Second-Moment-Type Stochastic Gradients
summary: Adam is widely observed to remain stable even when the objective deviates significantly from global smoothness. Under the generalized smoothness framework, however, existing analyses rely on strong tail assumptions on the stochastic gradients, such as almost-sure boundedness or sub-Gaussianity. Whether Adam converges on generalized smooth objectives under only second moment information on the stochastic gradients, without such concentration assumptions, was identified as an important open direction by Li et al. (2023). This paper gives an affirmative answer under fairly general conditions: such tail assumptions are not necessary. Building on the Adam self-normalization framework of Jin et al. (2026), developed for classical smoothness and bounded variance, we extend the stopping-time and de-preconditioning strategy to the $L_0$-$L_p$ generalized smoothness condition and a generalized second moment ABC condition. Even when the stochastic-gradient condition provides only second moment information that may grow along the trajectory, the stochastic trajectory of Adam remains in a locally well-behaved smoothness region, with stretched-exponential tail decay under bounded variance and global smoothness. Consequently, we establish high-probability convergence rate guarantees over the full range $p<2$, with confidence dependence of order $δ^{-1/2}$, while the stepsize prefactor depends on $δ$ only through a single logarithmic factor. We further construct a hard instance showing that, under only second-moment information, this $δ^{-1/2}$-type confidence dependence is sharp. Finally, in the regime $p<1$, we combine the trajectory control with polynomial-growth estimates on rare events to obtain convergence rate guarantees in expectation.

AI.tldr: 本文证明 Adam 在广义光滑条件下，仅需随机梯度的二阶矩信息即可收敛，无需几乎必然有界或次高斯等强尾部假设。通过扩展 Adam 自归一化框架中的停时与去预处理策略至 L0-Lp 广义光滑和广义二阶矩 ABC 条件，建立高概率收敛率，并给出 δ^{-1/2} 置信依赖的紧性实例；在 p<1 时进一步得到期望收敛率。
AI.motivation: 现有 Adam 在广义光滑框架下的分析依赖强尾部假设，如随机梯度几乎必然有界或次高斯。Li et al. (2023) 提出，在仅有二阶矩信息且无集中假设时 Adam 是否收敛是一个重要开放问题。
AI.method: 基于 Jin et al. (2026) 为经典光滑和有界方差开发的 Adam 自归一化框架，将停时与去预处理策略扩展到 L0-Lp 广义光滑条件和广义二阶矩 ABC 条件；分析随机轨迹在局部良态光滑区域内的行为及尾部衰减；构造硬实例；对 p<1 结合稀有事件上的多项式增长估计。
AI.result: 证明强尾部假设并非必要。随机轨迹保持在局部良态光滑区域，并在有界方差与全局光滑下呈拉伸指数尾衰减。对 p<2 建立高概率收敛率，置信依赖为 δ^{-1/2}，步长前因子仅通过单个对数因子依赖 δ。硬实例表明，在仅利用二阶矩信息时该 δ^{-1/2} 型置信依赖是尖锐的。对 p<1 获得期望收敛率。
AI.conclusion: Adam 在广义光滑目标下仅凭随机梯度的二阶矩信息也能收敛，强尾部集中假设可以去除；所建立的高概率与期望收敛保证以及紧性实例推进了相关开放问题。

title: Mixture of Self-Improving Branches For Agent Harness Optimization
summary: Harness optimization provides a practical setting for recursive self-improvement (RSI), where agent-generated modifications inform subsequent changes through execution feedback. Recent work such as Meta-Harness implements this process through iterative code generation and evaluation, but retains a fixed development set and proposal policy. These constraints channel evolution along a single search trajectory, increasing the risk of converging to a local optimum. We make the improvement process itself adaptive by organizing search into branches with evolving development subsets and proposal policies. Each branch retains development cases solved by more of its leading harnesses than by those of other branches, drops cases solved by every leading harness across all branches, and revises its proposal policy using its own search history. To deploy the resulting complementary harnesses, we propose a router to select one development-selected branch head for each new input before execution. Across mathematical reasoning and agentic coding benchmarks, our system achieves relative improvements over Meta-Harness of 34.8% on Olympiad-level mathematical reasoning, 11.6% on Terminal-Bench 2.0, and 3.8% on SWE-bench Lite, with harness selection and router configuration based solely on development data. These results show that evolving branch objectives and proposal policies can yield complementary harnesses whose strengths a router combines without access to test outcomes.

AI.tldr: 提出一种自适应分支式Harness优化方法，通过演化开发子集和提案策略实现递归自我改进，并利用路由器组合互补的harness。
AI.motivation: 现有Meta-Harness等方法使用固定的开发集和提案策略，导致搜索沿单一轨迹进行，易陷入局部最优。
AI.method: 将搜索组织为分支，每个分支保留被其多数领先harness解决而其他分支未解决的开发案例，剔除所有分支领先harness均解决的案例，并基于自身搜索历史修订提案策略；使用路由器为每个新输入选择开发集选定的分支头。
AI.result: 在数学推理和智能体编码基准上，相对Meta-Harness提升：奥林匹克级数学推理34.8%，Terminal-Bench 2.0 11.6%，SWE-bench Lite 3.8%，且harness选择和路由器配置仅基于开发数据。
AI.conclusion: 演化分支目标和提案策略可产生互补的harness，路由器无需测试结果即可组合其优势。

title: Active Budget Can Kill Sensitivity: Diagnosing and Repairing TopK Sparse Autoencoder Reliability
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are increasingly scaled to wider dictionaries to recover fine-grained structure from large language model activations. However, a feature is useful for interpretation only if it remains a stable unit of analysis when the same meaning is expressed in different surface forms. We study this reliability question for TopK SAEs via feature sensitivity. Experiments demonstrate that scaling selectively reduces the sensitivity of rare features, while common features remain comparatively stable. A controlled width\(\times k\) factorial experiment identifies the active budget k as the root cause: the degradation arises from the selection boundary rather than dictionary width alone. We attribute this failure to the geometry of TopK selection. The active margin, the distance to the cutoff, predicts feature loss without thresholds. Guided by this margin diagnosis, we introduce pairwise rank stabilization. Our method targets ordering failures at the cutoff and improves rare-feature sensitivity by \(8.83\) percentage points, while keeping reconstruction and alive-feature coverage near the baseline. Overall, our results suggest that wide TopK SAEs should be evaluated not only by reconstruction, sparsity, and feature count, but also by feature reliability under semantic variation and boundary geometry for stable interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 TopK 稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征在语义相同但表面形式不同时是否稳定，发现扩大字典宽度会选择性降低稀有特征的敏感性，根源在于 TopK 选择边界，并提出成对秩稳定化方法改善该问题。
AI.motivation: SAE 被越做越宽以从大语言模型激活中恢复细粒度结构，但特征只有在同一含义以不同表面形式出现时仍保持稳定，才能作为可靠的可解释性分析单元。
AI.method: 通过特征敏感性研究 TopK SAE 的可靠性；进行宽度×k 因子实验定位原因；从 TopK 选择几何出发提出活跃边际（active margin）诊断；据此提出成对秩稳定化（pairwise rank stabilization）方法。
AI.result: 扩大宽度会选择性降低稀有特征敏感性，而常见特征相对稳定；控制实验表明主动预算 k 是根因，退化来自选择边界而非仅字典宽度；active margin 可无需阈值预测特征丢失；所提方法将稀有特征敏感性提升 8.83 个百分点，同时重建和存活特征覆盖率接近基线。
AI.conclusion: 宽 TopK SAE 不应仅用重建、稀疏性和特征数量评估，还应评估语义变化下的特征可靠性以及边界几何，以实现稳定可解释性。

title: PolyOCR-Venus: Unified OCR Foundation Models for Text-Centric Visual Intelligence
summary: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is evolving from plain-text transcription toward general visual intelligence, requiring models to recognize, localize, and reason over textual information in complex visual environments. However, existing OCR systems often excel at only some tasks and struggle to balance recognition, parsing, and reasoning across scenarios. In this report, we present PolyOCR, a family of unified OCR foundation models of varying scales. PolyOCR combines a shared instruction-following framework with a large-scale data engine that converts heterogeneous visual resources into quality-verified OCR supervision. We introduce Competence-Guided Policy Optimization, which combines verifier-based Group Relative Policy Optimization with on-policy distillation through sample-wise routing based on teacher reliability and the teacher--student competence gap. We also introduce OCRBench v2.1, our revision of OCRBench v2 with manually verified annotation corrections and task-aligned scoring metrics. Extensive experiments across OCRBench v2.1, CC-OCR, in-house KIE Benchmark, OmniDocBench v1.6 and MDPBench demonstrate that PolyOCR achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一OCR基础模型族PolyOCR，旨在将OCR从纯文本转录推进到复杂视觉环境中的识别、定位与推理，并在多个基准上取得领先或极具竞争力的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有OCR系统通常只擅长部分任务，难以在识别、解析和推理之间取得跨场景平衡，因此需要统一的OCR基础模型来适应通用视觉智能的发展。
AI.method: PolyOCR采用共享的指令跟随框架，并构建大规模数据引擎，将异构视觉资源转化为经过质量验证的OCR监督数据。同时提出能力引导策略优化，结合基于验证器的组相对策略优化与在线策略蒸馏，通过教师可靠性和师生能力差距进行样本级路由。还推出OCRBench v2.1，对标注进行人工校验修正并采用任务对齐评分指标。
AI.result: 在OCRBench v2.1、CC-OCR、内部KIE Benchmark、OmniDocBench v1.6和MDPBench上的大量实验表明，PolyOCR达到最先进或极具竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: PolyOCR通过统一框架、大规模数据引擎和能力引导优化，为通用OCR基础模型提供了有效方案，并推动了OCR向复杂视觉场景下的综合识别与推理发展。

title: Honeycomb: Constant-Size Scene Memory Representation for Video World Models
summary: Video world models require persistent scene memory to maintain consistency during long-horizon video generation. Existing spatial memory systems accumulate RGB observations or latent features, causing storage requirements to grow as generation proceeds. We introduce **Honeycomb**, a video world model built on **HexMemory**, a compact low-rank representation that stores scene features in a fixed-size memory comprising six spatial and spatiotemporal planes. A feed-forward writer maps each newly generated video chunk to plane features. As the spatial coverage or temporal range expands, HexMemory warps the existing planes while preserving their dimensions, then integrates new features through confidence-weighted pooling and a learned residual correction. A reader retrieves latent features from HexMemory to condition subsequent video generation. Because the writer processes only observations from the latest chunk, Honeycomb avoids per-scene optimization and repeated processing of the full generation history. Experiments on WorldScore and RealEstate10K demonstrate strong video generation quality and robust consistency when revisiting previously observed regions, while maintaining constant feature-storage requirements throughout generation. Code and additional visualizations are available on our https://jackswl.github.io/honeycomb/.

AI.tldr: 提出 Honeycomb 视频世界模型，基于固定大小的低秩记忆 HexMemory（六个空间与时空平面），在长时视频生成中保持场景一致性，同时使特征存储恒定。
AI.motivation: 现有空间记忆系统通过累积 RGB 观测或潜在特征来维持长时视频生成的场景一致性，导致存储需求随生成过程不断增长，并需逐场景优化或重复处理完整生成历史。
AI.method: 构建 HexMemory 紧凑低秩表示，将场景特征存入固定大小的六个空间与时空平面；前馈写入器把每个新生成的视频块映射到平面特征；随空间覆盖或时间范围扩展，对现有平面进行 warp 并保持维度，通过置信度加权池化与学习到的残差校正融合新特征；读取器从 HexMemory 检索潜在特征以条件化后续视频生成。
AI.result: 在 WorldScore 和 RealEstate10K 上展现出强视频生成质量，在重访已观测区域时具有稳健一致性，且整个生成过程中特征存储需求保持恒定。
AI.conclusion: Honeycomb 仅处理最新视频块的观测，避免逐场景优化和重复处理全部生成历史，实现了恒定存储、长时一致的视频世界模型生成。

title: PAIQ: Patch-Aligned Semantic Injection via Residual Rotation
summary: Language-aligned and self-supervised visual encoders offer complementary strengths in semantic abstraction and spatial detail. Harnessing this complementarity requires enriching local features while retaining distinctions between semantically related patches. We introduce PAIQ, a patch-aligned semantic injection framework that combines content-based cross-encoder matching with orthogonally constrained residual updates. Using DINOv3 patch features as the spatial base, PAIQ aggregates complementary SigLIP features through joint source allocation and injects the aggregate--base differences through a shared orthogonal transformation Q. This rotation adapts update directions while preserving residual norms and pairwise angles. For fixed projected features, we derive conditions for patch separability under similar semantic aggregates and show that rotation adds a nonnegative separation term over direct interpolation when the aggregate is shared. Only the projection and fusion parameters are trained; both visual encoders and the language model remain frozen, and fusion retains 196 visual tokens. Across diverse language backbones, PAIQ yields broad gains in judge-assessed correctness and reductions in hallucination severity over single-encoder interfaces on image description and visual question answering. On the 2B and 9B Qwen backbones, this compact interface outperforms the strongest evaluated fusion or token-compression baselines by about 2.9 correctness points on average.

AI.tldr: 提出PAIQ，一个补丁对齐的语义注入框架，将语言对齐编码器SigLIP的特征注入到自监督编码器DINOv3的补丁特征中，从而提升多模态接口的正确性并降低幻觉。
AI.motivation: 语言对齐与自监督视觉编码器在语义抽象和空间细节上各有优势，但融合时需要增强局部特征，同时保留语义相关补丁之间的区分度。
AI.method: 以DINOv3补丁特征为空间基础，通过基于内容的跨编码器匹配聚合SigLIP特征，并用正交约束的残差更新注入聚合特征与基础特征的差异；使用共享正交变换Q调整更新方向，同时保持残差范数和成对角度。理论分析给出相似语义聚合下补丁可分性条件，并证明共享聚合时旋转相比直接插值增加非负分离项。仅训练投影与融合参数，冻结两个视觉编码器和语言模型，融合后保留196个视觉token。
AI.result: 在多种语言骨干上，PAIQ在图像描述和视觉问答中较单编码器接口普遍提升judge评估正确率并降低幻觉严重度；在2B和9B Qwen骨干上，平均正确率比最强融合或token压缩基线高约2.9个点。
AI.conclusion: PAIQ通过补丁对齐的语义注入有效融合互补视觉编码器，在保持紧凑视觉token表示的同时提升多模态理解性能并减少幻觉。

title: VIF-Bench: Evaluating Visual Instruction Following in Multi-Reference Image Generation
summary: Recent multimodal image generation models can take multiple images and textual instructions as input, enabling reference-based generation guided not only by text but also by visual instructions such as layouts, arrows, and pose cues. However, existing benchmarks do not evaluate the joint setting in which multiple references must be composed under multiple and heterogeneous visual-instruction images. To address this gap, we introduce VIF-Bench, a benchmark of 1,241 tasks designed to assess the edge of model capabilities in this joint setting by covering: (i) multi-reference generation (up to 7) under multiple heterogeneous visual instructions (up to 6), (ii) cases where reference images can potentially compete with visual instructions (e.g., a strongly posed subject vs. a target pose), and (iii) controlled comparison of visual instructions with text descriptions at different levels of specificity. Using these capabilities, we uncover three findings: (1) models face an adherence-artifact trade-off: once models reach stronger visual instruction adherence, stronger adherence tends to coincide with more instruction artifacts in generated images, (2) visual instruction adherence tends to be lower on tasks whose reference images carry a salient state of the controlled attribute (e.g., a neon-lit subject under a light-direction instruction), most consistently for light and wind, and (3) for models that can understand visual instructions, it is often better to provide visual constraints directly rather than describe them in text; when using text, a moderate level of detail works better than an exhaustive description. VIF-Bench is released as an open benchmark to establish a basis for fair comparison in controllable multi-reference image generation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VIF-Bench，一个用于评测多参考图像与多异构视觉指令联合可控生成能力的基准，包含 1,241 个任务，并揭示模型在指令遵循、伪影和参考冲突方面的关键表现。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态图像生成模型可同时接受多张图像和文本指令，并支持布局、箭头、姿态等视觉指令，但已有基准未评测“多参考图像 + 多异构视觉指令”的联合设定，因此需要新基准来评估该场景下的模型能力边界。
AI.method: 构建 VIF-Bench，包含 1,241 个任务，覆盖：最多 7 张参考图像与最多 6 个异构视觉指令的联合生成；参考图像可能与视觉指令冲突的情况（如强姿态主体与目标姿态）；以及视觉指令与不同具体程度文本描述的受控比较。
AI.result: 发现三点：(1) 模型存在遵循度与伪影的权衡，视觉指令遵循越强，生成图像越易出现指令相关伪影；(2) 当参考图像携带被控属性的显著状态时，视觉指令遵循度通常更低，在光照和风相关任务中尤为一致；(3) 对能理解视觉指令的模型，直接提供视觉约束通常优于用文本描述，若用文本，中等细节优于过度详尽描述。
AI.conclusion: VIF-Bench 作为开放基准发布，为可控多参考图像生成提供公平比较基础，并推动该联合设定下的模型评测与改进。

title: Guide, Then Let Go: Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling for Sparse-Reward Agentic RL
summary: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon agents typically relies on sparse outcome-based rewards. This leads to a severe cold-start problem, as early-stage policies often fail to solve sampled tasks, leaving little useful reward signal for learning. To mitigate this problem, we use on-policy distillation (OPD) to provide token-level guidance on the student's own rollouts. We find that the benefit of this guidance depends on the performance gap between the teacher and the student. When the teacher substantially outperforms the student, distillation helps guide the student through the early training stage where outcome rewards provide little learning signal. As the gap narrows and eventually reverses, however, continued distillation becomes less beneficial and may hinder further improvement. Motivated by this observation, we propose Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling (GATS), which augments the student's RL objective with an OPD term whose weight adapts to the teacher-student performance gap. Specifically, GATS gradually reduces teacher guidance as the student approaches the teacher's reference performance and withdraws it once that reference is reached. This enables GATS to leverage task-trained teachers smaller than the student, since teacher guidance is primarily needed during early training. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld with three Qwen2.5 teacher-student configurations, GATS achieves the highest average success rate among the compared methods in all three configurations, improving over reward-only GRPO by 4.37%-11.87% under matched student rollout budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/Ricardo-H/guide-then-let-go.

AI.tldr: 针对长时程强化学习中稀疏结果奖励导致的冷启动问题，提出GATS方法：在学生的on-policy rollout上加入token级蒸馏引导，并让蒸馏权重随师生性能差距自适应变化，差距缩小时减少并最终撤除教师指导。
AI.motivation: 长时程强化学习依赖稀疏的结果奖励，早期策略往往无法完成任务，导致缺乏有效奖励信号，出现严重的冷启动问题。
AI.method: 采用on-policy distillation（OPD）在学生的自身rollout上提供token级指导；观察到指导效果取决于师生性能差距。据此提出Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling（GATS），在学生的RL目标中加入OPD项，其权重根据师生性能差距自适应调整：学生接近教师参考性能时逐渐减少引导，达到后撤除；因此可使用比学生更小的任务训练教师。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和ScienceWorld上，使用三种Qwen2.5师生配置，GATS在所有配置中均取得最高平均成功率，在相同学生rollout预算下比仅用奖励的GRPO提升4.37%-11.87%。
AI.conclusion: 自适应教师调度能有效利用早期蒸馏引导解决冷启动，并在学生追平教师后及时退出以避免阻碍进一步提升，验证了根据师生差距动态调节蒸馏权重的有效性。

title: Co-PiLOT: Constrained Physics-Informed Latent Optimization for Target-Driven Inverse Design
summary: Inverse design of physical systems (molecules, devices, microstructures) often reduces to optimizing a high-dimensional structure against an expensive black-box simulator. Direct search is difficult because the space is non-Euclidean, feasibility is hard to encode, and each evaluation is expensive. We present Co-PiLOT, a latent optimization approach that maps candidates through a generative encoder-decoder, uses the decoder as a learned validity prior, and searches the latent space with physics-informed black-box optimization. The framework is applied on the inverse design of magnesium alloy microstructure/texture. We develop a vision transformer based-encoder; paired with latent diffusion, diffusion transformer and rectified-flow transformer-based decoders on $\sim80{,}000$ EBSD-derived microstructure dataset to learn a minimal bottleneck, $z$. The ViT-FMDiT model ($z$=$768$) reconstructs high-fidelity microstructure images (FID $27.86$, MS-SSIM $0.178$), which our self-segmenting orientation codec converts into input grids for crystal plasticity solver. Finally, we introduce MERIDIAN, an active latent optimizer driven by deep-kernel Gaussian-process uncertainty, failure-aware feasibility prediction, manifold-aware trust regions, and target-aware acquisition. Within a budget of $160$ simulations, the ViT-FMDiT and MERIDIAN combination yields the best target-driven objective score, reducing the relative target error by $3$--$22\%$ against seven baselines (DANTE, TuRBO, BAxUS, CMA-ES, DDOM, SEIKO, DDPO) on the same decoder.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Co-PiLOT 与 MERIDIAN，用于昂贵黑盒物理系统逆设计；在镁合金微观组织/织构逆设计中，通过 ViT-FMDiT 学习低维潜空间，并用物理信息主动潜优化器 MERIDIAN 搜索，取得优于多种基线的目标驱动设计效果。
AI.motivation: 物理系统逆设计通常需在高维、非欧几里得且可行性难以编码的结构空间中优化昂贵黑盒模拟器，直接搜索困难且评估成本高。
AI.method: 提出 Co-PiLOT 潜空间优化框架：用生成式编码器-解码器映射候选结构，将解码器作为学习到的有效性先验，并用物理信息黑盒优化搜索潜空间。基于约8万条 EBSD 微观组织数据，训练 ViT 编码器及潜在扩散、扩散Transformer、rectified-flow Transformer 解码器；ViT-FMDiT 使用 z=768 瓶颈。通过自分割取向编解码器将生成图像转为晶体塑性求解器输入网格。提出 MERIDIAN 主动潜优化器，结合深度核高斯过程不确定性、失败感知可行性预测、流形感知信任域与目标感知采集。
AI.result: ViT-FMDiT 可高保真重建微观组织图像，FID 27.86、MS-SSIM 0.178。在160次模拟预算内，ViT-FMDiT 与 MERIDIAN 组合取得最佳目标驱动目标分数，相较 DANTE、TuRBO、BAxUS、CMA-ES、DDOM、SEIKO、DDPO 七种基线，将相对目标误差降低3%–22%。
AI.conclusion: 结合潜空间生成模型与物理信息黑盒优化，可有效应对昂贵、高维、受约束的逆设计问题；在镁合金微观组织/织构逆设计中，Co-PiLOT 与 MERIDIAN 展现出优于现有基线的性能。

title: Multi-Site Real-World Performance of Commercial AI for Pulmonary and Incidental Pulmonary Embolism Detection
summary: Pulmonary embolism (PE) is a leading cause of cardiovascular mortality, yet the real-world performance of FDA-cleared AI detection models remains incompletely characterized. We retrospectively evaluated two FDA-cleared AI algorithms from a single commercial platform (Aidoc Medical BriefCase), one for PE triage on dedicated CT pulmonary angiography (CTPA; n = 30,678) and one for incidental PE (iPE) detection on routine contrast-enhanced CTs (n = 37,191), across a 17-facility academic health system. Reference-standard labels were extracted from radiology reports using a validated LLM pipeline (97% accuracy, kappa = 0.94). The PE model achieved 86.8% sensitivity and 99.1% specificity, with sensitivity declining from 99.3% for saddle emboli to 72.9% for subsegmental PE, and from 89.7% for acute to 65.3% for non-acute PE. The iPE model achieved 73.5% sensitivity and 99.8% specificity. Both models demonstrated lower sensitivity than FDA-clearance benchmarks while exceeding cleared specificity, with diminishing performance for peripheral and non-acute emboli mirroring known human reader limitations and underscoring the need for standardized post-market surveillance of AI-enabled medical devices.

AI.tldr: 该研究回顾性评估了两个FDA批准的AI模型在真实临床环境中检测肺栓塞（PE）和偶发肺栓塞（iPE）的表现，发现敏感性低于审批基准，特异性较高，且对周围型和非急性栓塞敏感性下降。
AI.motivation: 肺栓塞是心血管死亡的主要原因，但FDA批准的AI检测模型在真实世界中的性能尚未被充分表征。
AI.method: 在17家学术医疗系统中，回顾性评估同一商业平台（Aidoc Medical BriefCase）的两个FDA批准AI算法：一个用于专用CTPA上的PE分诊（n=30,678），另一个用于常规增强CT上的偶发PE检测（n=37,191）。参考标准标签通过经验证的LLM流程从放射学报告中提取（准确率97%，kappa=0.94）。
AI.result: PE模型敏感性为86.8%，特异性为99.1%；敏感性从鞍状栓塞的99.3%降至亚段PE的72.9%，从急性PE的89.7%降至非急性PE的65.3%。iPE模型敏感性为73.5%，特异性为99.8%。两个模型的敏感性均低于FDA审批基准，但特异性高于审批基准。
AI.conclusion: AI模型在真实世界中对周围型和非急性栓塞的敏感性下降，与已知的人类阅片局限性相似，凸显了对AI医疗器械进行标准化上市后监测的必要性。

title: Pixels to Keys: Exploring Spatial and Motion Cues in Gameplay Inverse Dynamics
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Multimodal Digital Agents (ECCV 2026): https://mda-workshop.allen.ai/
summary: Video games offer scalable environments for studying perception and control in embodied agents.Abundant online gameplay videos could supply demonstrations, but they rarely include player inputs for training. Inverse Dynamics Models (IDMs) have thus been proposed to infer inputs from frames. Large (up to 1B parameters) IDMs trained on $\sim$1K-2K gameplay hours demonstrate feasibility and cross-environment generalization at this scale, but researchers do not clarify what the key components are to recover individual actions and often report only aggregate accuracy that can mask rare-action failures. We study the problem in a data-constrained scenario to evaluate how spatial motion features, model architectures, and training objectives affect an IDM's outcome and we analyse our models on per-key and balanced metrics such as $F_1^{macro}$. Our experiments on Trackmania highlight the importance of factors like the model architecture and motion flow extraction in preprocessing, while also showing the limits of evaluation through unbalanced metrics. The application of the same architecture and training recipe to Cyberpunk 2077 reveals uneven performance across game mechanics. Our per-action evaluation and failure analysis highlight ambiguities from camera motion, delayed effects and imbalanced key-press frequencies that call for explicit modeling of 3D scene structure, long-term state and the adoption of proper losses in future implementations.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究从游戏视频帧中推断玩家输入的反向动力学模型（IDM），在数据受限场景下分析空间运动特征、模型架构和训练目标的影响，并通过逐按键与平衡指标揭示现有评估和模型泛化的局限。
AI.motivation: 在线游戏视频可提供演示数据，但通常缺少玩家输入，因此需要IDM从帧中恢复输入；已有大规模IDM虽展示可行性，但关键组件不明确，且聚合准确率会掩盖稀有动作失败，因此需在数据受限条件下深入评估。
AI.method: 在Trackmania和Cyberpunk 2077上进行实验，考察空间运动特征、模型架构与训练目标对IDM表现的影响，并使用逐按键指标和平衡指标（如F1 macro）进行评估与失败分析。
AI.result: Trackmania实验表明模型架构和预处理中的运动流提取等因素很重要，同时显示非平衡指标的评估局限；将相同架构和训练方案用于Cyberpunk 2077时，不同游戏机制下性能不均衡。
AI.conclusion: 逐动作评估和失败分析指出，相机运动、延迟效应和按键频率不平衡会带来歧义，未来实现需要显式建模3D场景结构、长期状态并采用更合适的损失函数。

title: GRFBrain: Graph-Structured Rectified Flows for EEG Dynamic Modeling
summary: Forecasting time-varying functional connectivity from electroencephalography (EEG) requires modeling both history-dependent trends and structured variability across channels. Conditional flow matching provides a framework for distributional forecasting, yet it remains unclear whether graph-informed source distributions offer practical advantages over isotropic noise and strong deterministic predictors. We introduce a graph-structured residual flow framework that separates conditional mean prediction from stochastic residual transport. A history-only predictor estimates the future connectivity graph, while a graph Gaussian source encodes dependencies derived from past connectivity through a Laplacian-based covariance. A conditional velocity field transports source samples to future graph residuals, with transport time explicitly distinguished from physical EEG time. Our study identifies the conditions and controls needed to distinguish useful residual transport from improvements attributable to deterministic prediction, learned representations, and sampling effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种图结构残差流框架，用于从EEG预测时变功能连接，将条件均值预测与随机残差传输分离，并探讨图信息源分布是否优于各向同性噪声和强确定性预测器。
AI.motivation: 从EEG预测时变功能连接需要同时建模历史依赖趋势和跨通道结构化变异；条件流匹配虽可用于分布预测，但图信息源分布相比各向同性噪声和强确定性预测器是否具有实际优势尚不明确。
AI.method: 提出图结构残差流框架：仅用历史的预测器估计未来连接图；图高斯源通过基于拉普拉斯协方差编码过去连接依赖；条件速度场将源样本传输为未来图残差；并将传输时间与EEG物理时间明确区分。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体定量结果，主要指出研究识别了区分有用残差传输与确定性预测、学习表征和采样效应所带来改进所需的条件与控制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作强调需谨慎区分随机残差传输的真实增益与确定性预测、表示学习和采样效应等混杂因素，为EEG功能连接分布预测提供了框架和评估条件。

title: HiRAE: Hierarchical Representation Autoencoding with Residual Budgets
summary: Pretrained visual representations support image generation, but may not fully preserve the fine-grained details needed for faithful reconstruction. Meanwhile, intermediate encoder layers contain complementary visual details, but learning to fuse them for reconstruction can produce a latent distribution that is difficult to model. Existing fusion methods require empirical tuning of layer selection or staged optimization of fusion and decoding, increasing configuration effort or training complexity. We introduce HiRAE (Hierarchical Representation Autoencoder), which learns a hierarchical fusion framework over the full encoder hierarchy to improve reconstruction fidelity while maintaining compatibility with generative modeling. HiRAE groups encoder layers by depth and learns residual corrections to the deepest representation. Group-wise norm caps bound these corrections relative to the deep anchor, with tighter budgets for shallower groups. Our HiRAE-24 preserves the latent token count and channel dimension. On ImageNet-256, HiRAE-24 reduces reconstruction FID from 0.299 to 0.209 relative to RAEv2 while maintaining competitive guided generation quality. For text-to-image generation, HiRAE-24 improves alignment over RAEv2 on GenEval, DPG-Bench, and GenAI-Bench both before and after supervised fine-tuning. Under the same generator-training and evaluation protocol, post-fine-tuning GenEval increases from 84.86 to 87.70.

AI.tldr: 提出 HiRAE，一种分层表示自编码器，通过分层融合编码器各层特征，在保持生成建模兼容性的同时提升重建保真度。
AI.motivation: 预训练视觉表示虽支持图像生成，但可能无法完整保留忠实重建所需的细粒度细节；中间编码器层包含互补细节，但现有融合方法需经验性选择层或分阶段优化，增加配置与训练复杂度，且融合后的潜分布可能难以建模。
AI.method: HiRAE 按深度对编码器层分组，学习对最深表示的残差修正；使用组级范数上限约束修正幅度，越浅层组预算越紧；HiRAE-24 保持潜 token 数量和通道维度不变。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-256 上，HiRAE-24 将重建 FID 从 RAEv2 的 0.299 降至 0.209，并保持有竞争力的引导生成质量；在文本到图像生成中，HiRAE-24 在 GenEval、DPG-Bench 和 GenAI-Bench 上均优于 RAEv2，监督微调后 GenEval 从 84.86 提升至 87.70。
AI.conclusion: HiRAE 通过分层融合全编码器层次结构，在提升重建保真度的同时保持与生成建模的兼容性，并减少层选择调参和分阶段优化带来的配置与训练复杂度。

title: Topological Coherence for Self-evolving Multi-agent Systems
summary: Complex tasks inherently couple workflow structure, agent responsibility, collaboration, and memory access: task regions delimit responsibility and tool scope, cross-region dependencies give rise to handoffs, and ownership boundaries delimit private and selectively shared memory. Existing methods can jointly optimize agent and communication structures, yet such optimization does not by itself require responsibility, handoff, and memory boundaries to remain consistent with task dependencies. We term this requirement topological coherence. We introduce TOCOMAS, a Topology-Coherent Multi-Agent System. TOCOMAS grounds a task graph in tool interfaces, organizes compatible task nodes into reusable responsibility domains, and derives dependency-induced and profile-conditioned collaboration together with boundary-regulated memory visibility. During online self-evolution, TOCOMAS proposes coupled changes to agent, collaboration, and memory policies, retaining for subsequent tasks only candidates that satisfy structural constraints and improve evaluated reward. Across BBEH, WorkBench, SWE-Bench-Verified, and CoMemBench, TOCOMAS improves task success over baselines across backbones. CoMemBench also shows gains over the self-evolving baseline in verified progress, handoffs, and memory isolation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出拓扑一致的多智能体系统TOCOMAS，通过将任务图基于工具接口、组织责任域、推导协作与记忆可见性，并结合在线自演化，在多个基准上提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 复杂任务天然耦合工作流结构、智能体责任、协作与记忆访问；现有方法虽能联合优化智能体与通信结构，但无法保证责任、交接与记忆边界同任务依赖保持一致，即缺乏“拓扑一致性”。
AI.method: TOCOMAS将任务图锚定于工具接口，将兼容任务节点组织为可复用责任域，推导依赖驱动与画像条件化的协作关系及边界规约的记忆可见性；在线自演化中提出智能体、协作与记忆策略的耦合变更，仅保留满足结构约束且提升评估奖励的候选方案。
AI.result: 在BBEH、WorkBench、SWE-Bench-Verified和CoMemBench上，TOCOMAS在不同骨干模型上均提升任务成功率；CoMemBench还显示其在验证进度、交接次数与记忆隔离方面优于自演化基线。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑一致性对复杂多智能体任务至关重要，TOCOMAS通过统一责任、交接与记忆边界与任务依赖，实现了性能提升。

title: You Cannot Pick a Provider From the Price List: Market-Aware Routing for Open-Weight LLM Inference
summary: Existing LLM routers choose among models using static per-model costs. We show that open-weight inference markets introduce a second, largely ignored decision axis: after choosing a model, a client must still choose which provider serves it. Measuring live endpoints across [nummodels] open models, competing providers, multiple task types, and three measurement waves, we find that provider choice cannot be inferred from the price list. The same model can vary sharply in quality, latency, availability, and price across providers; higher-priced providers are consistently faster, but price does not reliably predict quality or availability; and provider feasibility is task-selective, with one deployment nearly normal on knowledge tasks but catastrophically degraded on multi-step reasoning. We formulate same-model provider selection as a price-taker market-aware routing problem. A simple measured-map policy routes to the cheapest provider that is both quality-equivalent and healthy, yielding matched-quality savings while avoiding degraded endpoints. Because the map drifts, we introduce FACET, an online provider router that certifies per-(provider x task) feasibility facets and fails safe to an anchor before serving uncertified arms. Across relaxed deployment assumptions, FACET tolerates imperfect task assignment and sparse feedback, while systematic evaluator bias exposes a quality-signal trust boundary that can be mitigated with ground-truth probes or audits. Live provider runs further confirm that certification can move real traffic from a premium anchor to a substantially cheaper certified endpoint. Our results suggest that market-aware LLM routing must measure not only which model to use, but also who serves it.

AI.tldr: 论文指出开放权重推理市场中，同一模型在不同提供商间的质量、延迟、可用性和价格差异显著，因此LLM路由不仅要选模型，还要选提供商；提出FACET在线提供商路由器，在动态市场中认证可用端点并安全回退。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM路由器仅按静态的每模型成本选择模型，忽略了开放权重推理市场中“由哪个提供商服务同一模型”这一决策维度；而且提供商选择无法从价目表推断。
AI.method: 跨[nummodels]个开放模型、多个竞争提供商和多种任务类型进行三轮实时端点测量；将同模型提供商选择形式化为价格接受者、市场感知的路由问题；提出FACET在线路由器，按(提供商×任务)认证可行性facet，未认证时安全回退到锚点，并测试不完美任务分配、稀疏反馈和评估器偏差。
AI.result: 同一模型在不同提供商间质量、延迟、可用性和价格差异大；高价提供商通常更快，但价格不能可靠预测质量或可用性；提供商可行性具有任务选择性。简单实测映射策略可选质量等价且健康的最便宜提供商，实现匹配质量下的节省。FACET能容忍不完美任务分配与稀疏反馈，并通过真值探针或审计缓解评估器偏差；真实运行中可将流量从高价锚点迁移到显著更便宜的认证端点。
AI.conclusion: 市场感知的LLM路由必须同时测量“用哪个模型”和“由谁服务”，提供商选择是独立且重要的决策轴；FACET这类认证与回退机制可在动态开放推理市场中安全地实现成本优化。

title: The Camera Inside the Editor: Reading the Implicit Camera of Image Editors with Painted Calibration Patterns
summary: Instruction-based image editors insert objects, restyle scenes and render new viewpoints, but it is unknown which camera they assume when they paint into a photograph. Asked to cover the floor with a checkerboard, an editor paints projective structure from which classical vanishing-point geometry reads pitch, roll, focal length, yaw and, on renders, the principal point, without any training. Unlike a calibrator such as GeoCalib, which estimates the camera of an image, this isolates the camera under which the editor paints. On 120 rendered cameras with exact ground truth, Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 paints tile edges that meet their vanishing points within 0.26 degrees, and its implicit camera matches the true one to 0.8 degrees in pitch and 6% in focal length, more accurately than GeoCalib except in roll. Asked to draw the horizon or mark a vanishing point instead, the editor fails, so this knowledge is revealed by painting and not by the explicit tasks we tried. The implicit camera has two priors: roll is pulled towards level (slope 0.71), and telephoto perspective towards a default of about 30 mm, which roughly matches the camera the models paint without any scene. For Qwen, the priors do not grow when blur removes four fifths of the line evidence. They are stronger on real photographs, and on NYUv2 a shorter wording of the task removes the difference for roll. On photographs from a 24--240 mm zoom lens the painted perspective grows with only 0.62 of the lens's slope, while GeoCalib and MoGe-2 saturate at about 52 and 42 mm. FLUX.1 Kontext and LongCat-Image-Edit are pulled much harder. Finally, from a level camera a camera-control LoRA executes pose commands at only 50--70% of their strength, and a board painted into its output agrees with the camera it produced.

AI.tldr: 研究探测指令图像编辑器绘画时隐含假设的相机参数。让编辑器在地面绘制棋盘格，再用消失点几何无训练反推相机，发现Qwen-Image-Edit-2511的隐式相机较准确，但显式画地平线或标消失点会失败，说明该知识只能通过绘画显现。
AI.motivation: 基于指令的图像编辑器会插入物体、重绘场景和渲染新视角，但它们把内容画进照片时默认采用什么相机并不清楚。与GeoCalib等估计输入图像相机的校准器不同，本文要隔离并测量编辑器自身绘画时假设的相机。
AI.method: 让编辑器用棋盘格覆盖地面，从其绘制的透视线和消失点中读取pitch、roll、焦距、yaw，并在渲染图上读取主点；在120个有精确真值的渲染相机上测试，并与GeoCalib比较；还测试显式地平线/消失点任务、模糊、真实照片、NYUv2、24至240毫米变焦照片，以及相机控制LoRA。
AI.result: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511绘制的瓷砖边缘与消失点误差0.26度，隐式相机pitch误差0.8度、焦距误差6%，除roll外优于GeoCalib；存在roll趋平先验，斜率0.71，以及约30毫米长焦先验；模糊去除五分之四线条证据后先验未增强；真实照片上先验更强；NYUv2短措辞消除roll差异；24至240毫米变焦上绘制透视斜率仅0.62，GeoCalib和MoGe-2约在52和42毫米饱和；FLUX.1 Kontext和LongCat-Image-Edit被更强拉向先验；相机控制LoRA仅以50至70%强度执行姿态命令，但输出棋盘与产生的相机一致。
AI.conclusion: 指令图像编辑器隐含一个可通过绘画揭示的相机模型，并带有朝向水平及默认约30毫米焦距的先验。显式相机任务不能暴露该知识，绘画是探测其隐式三维相机假设的有效方式。

title: Video-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Video Understanding Agents via Harness Evolution
summary: Video understanding agents acquire evidence through an executable harness that controls what they observe and how they use those observations. However, execution traces contain only the evidence acquired by the current harness, leaving competing explanations for failure unresolved and limiting the basis for self-improvement. We introduce Video-RSI, a framework for recursive self-improvement in which a video understanding agent uses its own language model to revise its harness. Through active video investigation, the model revisits the original training videos to test competing failure explanations with additional observations, grounding proposed changes in evidence beyond the existing trace. Cost-aware harness evolution turns these diagnoses into reusable revisions and determines which revisions to retain by considering both answer accuracy and visual cost. Across our evaluation settings on video understanding benchmarks, the evolved agent improves accuracy while processing fewer frames and achieves competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-offs against existing video understanding agents. These results demonstrate the potential for video understanding agents to improve their own evidence acquisition and use through harness evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/Video-RSI .

AI.tldr: 提出 Video-RSI 框架，让视频理解智能体利用自身语言模型修订可执行 harness，实现递归自我改进，在提升准确率的同时减少处理帧数。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解智能体通过固定 harness 获取证据，执行轨迹仅包含当前 harness 获得的证据，导致失败原因存在多种竞争解释而无法验证，限制了自我改进的基础。
AI.method: 通过主动视频调查，模型重新访问原始训练视频，用额外观察检验竞争性失败解释，使修改建议基于现有轨迹之外的证据；采用成本感知的 harness 演化，将诊断转化为可复用修订，并根据答案准确率和视觉成本决定保留哪些修订。
AI.result: 在视频理解基准评测中，演化后的智能体准确率提升且处理帧数更少，在准确率-效率权衡上与现有视频理解智能体相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明视频理解智能体可通过 harness 演化改进自身的证据获取与利用方式，展现出递归自我改进的潜力。

title: A Benchmark & Dataset for Detecting AI-Manipulated Visual Evidence in the Court System
summary: Photographic evidence is becoming increasingly vulnerable to forms of alteration and fabrication that existing legal and technical workflows are not well equipped to evaluate. Surveillance frames, dashcam stills, and phone photographs may be used to establish presence, sequence, causation, damage, or identity, yet contemporary generative systems allow non-experts to alter or fabricate such images through ordinary prompt-based interfaces. Existing image-forensics benchmarks provide important resources for face manipulation, classical tampering, and general synthetic-image detection, but they are not organized around the forms of visual evidence submitted in courts, the localized edits that can change what an exhibit appears to prove, or the consumer-tool threat model now facing the justice system. We introduce the CIFAR Synthetic Evidence Corpus for Detecting AI-Manipulated Images, a benchmark for evidentiary image authentication in court and justice-system contexts. The corpus contains 1,505 photographic items, including 720 authentic controls and 785 manipulated or fabricated images, spanning surveillance, dashcam, and consumer-photo imagery. Manipulations are organized into scene-condition edits, localized element edits, and full fabrications produced with contemporary generative systems. Each item is released with structured metadata covering source provenance, manipulation tier, subtype, generator, prompt template, and scene attributes, enabling controlled evaluation beyond aggregate binary detection. We also establish baselines with publicly available image-manipulation detectors, showing that current systems exhibit error profiles that remain problematic for evidentiary use. The dataset, prompts, metadata, code, and baseline evaluation scripts are released to support research on visual evidence authentication, information integrity, and trustworthy AI for the justice system.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CIFAR Synthetic Evidence Corpus基准，用于法庭与司法场景中的AI篡改图像检测。该语料包含1505张图像，其中720张真实图像、785张被篡改或伪造图像，覆盖监控、行车记录仪和消费照片，并建立公开检测器基线。
AI.motivation: 摄影证据日益容易被生成式系统通过普通提示界面篡改或伪造，而现有法律和技术流程难以评估。现有图像取证基准多关注人脸操纵、传统篡改和通用合成图像检测，未围绕法庭提交的视觉证据、可改变证明内容的局部编辑以及消费级工具威胁模型组织。
AI.method: 构建CIFAR Synthetic Evidence Corpus，包含1505个摄影项目，涵盖监控、行车记录仪和消费照片。操纵类型分为场景条件编辑、局部元素编辑和完整伪造。每项提供结构化元数据，包括来源、操纵层级、子类型、生成器、提示模板和场景属性。同时使用公开图像篡改检测器建立基线。
AI.result: 公开图像篡改检测器在该基准上表现出仍不利于证据使用的错误特征。数据集、提示、元数据、代码和基线评估脚本均已发布。
AI.conclusion: 该资源可支持视觉证据认证、信息完整性和面向司法系统的可信AI研究。

title: BrainNet Studio: A Unified Toolkit for Brain Network Construction, Intelligent Analysis, and Visualization
summary: Brain networks characterize structural and functional relationships among brain regions and support research on cognition, brain disorders, and brain-computer interfaces. Their time-varying topology and higher-order spatiotemporal dependencies are not adequately represented by conventional static networks. Existing tools primarily focus on static connectomes and provide limited integration of dynamic network modeling with modern graph and sequence learning methods. We present BrainNet Studio, an integrated toolkit for static and dynamic brain network analysis. It provides a unified workflow encompassing network construction, feature extraction, predictive modeling, candidate biomarker identification, visualization, and assisted interpretation. The toolkit integrates 27 algorithms, including deep learning, graph neural networks, and spatiotemporal sequence models, to support classification and the identification of discriminative brain regions and connections. A large language model generates researcher-verifiable summaries of functional connectivity, structural connectivity, and structure-function coupling at individual and group levels. Within a consistent computational framework, users can configure analytical tasks, compare methods, inspect outputs, and extend functionality without repeatedly assembling application-specific pipelines. BrainNet Studio provides a practical and extensible platform for connectome analysis in cognitive neuroscience, exploratory studies of brain disorders, and brain-computer interfaces. The toolkit is publicly available at https://github.com/xbrainnet/Brainnet-Studio.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了 BrainNet Studio，一个用于静态和动态脑网络分析的综合工具包，支持从网络构建到建模、可视化和解释的完整流程。
AI.motivation: 传统静态脑网络难以充分表征脑网络的时变拓扑和高阶时空依赖，现有工具多聚焦静态连接组，且动态网络建模与现代图学习、序列学习方法的整合有限。
AI.method: 提出 BrainNet Studio，集成网络构建、特征提取、预测建模、候选生物标志物识别、可视化和辅助解释的统一工作流；整合27种算法，包括深度学习、图神经网络和时空序列模型；并利用大语言模型生成个体和群体水平的功能连接、结构连接及结构-功能耦合的可验证总结。
AI.result: 该工具包支持分类任务以及判别性脑区和连接的识别，用户可在统一计算框架中配置分析任务、比较方法、检查输出并扩展功能，无需反复搭建特定应用流程。
AI.conclusion: BrainNet Studio 为认知神经科学、脑疾病探索研究和脑机接口中的连接组分析提供了一个实用且可扩展的平台，并已公开可用。

title: Planetary Feature Fields are Scalable Earth Representations
summary: Satellite observations, precomputed embeddings, and map products describe the same evolving Earth, yet are stored as independent, petabyte-scale data products. Their continued growth calls for compact representations of multiple products while preserving spatial and temporal detail. We introduce Planetary Feature Fields (PFFs), which exploit redundancy across data products by modeling them jointly as continuous functions of space and time at planetary scale. PFFs are spatially local explicit-implicit (hybrid) neural fields. Each field shares a factored feature volume---a decomposition of an explicit 3D grid with smaller factors---across products, while lightweight implicit decoders reconstruct individual products across multiple timesteps. PFFs reconstruct EO products over space and time more accurately than single-product fields at matched compression rates. At $1800\times$ compression relative to the uncompressed source data, reconstructed features retain approximately $90\%$ or more of the performance achieved with the original features on pixel-level segmentation, change detection, and patch-level classification tasks. PFFs can add new timesteps by extending their factored feature volumes and add new products by attaching new decoders, while leaving existing outputs unchanged. PFFs reduce end-to-end feature access latency by an order of magnitude relative to evaluated API and cloud-storage pipelines.

AI.tldr: 提出行星特征场（PFFs），一种联合建模多源地球观测数据产品的混合神经场，可在高压缩率下保留时空细节并支持增量扩展。
AI.motivation: 卫星观测、预计算嵌入和地图产品描述同一演化地球，却作为独立的PB级数据产品存储，其持续增长需要能紧凑表示多个产品并保留时空细节的方法。
AI.method: PFFs是空间局部的显隐式混合神经场，每个场跨产品共享一个分解特征体积（将显式3D网格分解为更小因子），并用轻量隐式解码器重建各产品在多个时间步的数据。
AI.result: 在匹配压缩率下，PFFs比单产品场更准确地重建EO产品；在1800倍压缩下，重建特征在像素级分割、变化检测和块级分类任务上保留约90%或更高性能；可通过扩展特征体积添加新时间步、附加解码器添加新产品而不改变现有输出；端到端特征访问延迟比API和云存储管道降低一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: PFFs能有效联合压缩多源地球观测产品，保持时空细节和下游任务性能，并支持增量更新与快速访问。

title: WINGS: Reference-Free Gaussian Splatting Inpainting with 3D-Native Generative Priors
summary: Inpainting 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes, a key challenge in 3D editing, requires generating plausible content within a masked region of 3D space. Prior approaches rely on 2D diffusion models to produce one or several inpainted reference views, making them susceptible to challenges associated with multi-view inconsistency and lengthy optimization times. Departing from these approaches, we introduce a reference-free Gaussian splatting inpainting method operating natively in 3D. Our method leverages the embedding space of a large, pre-trained 3D prior, combined with a structure completion network to feed a generative prior which reconstructs the missing region's geometry and appearance. Performing content generation entirely in 3D, it avoids the need to reconcile inconsistencies of multiple inpainted reference images, and is faster than related 2D-based methods. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method qualitatively and quantitatively, through extensive experiments and a user study. To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first Gaussian splatting inpainting method to operate in the learned representation space of a 3D-native generative prior without relying on inpainted reference views.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种无需参考视图的3D高斯泼溅修复方法，直接在3D空间和预训练3D先验的嵌入空间中进行缺失区域的内容生成。
AI.motivation: 现有3D高斯泼溅场景修复方法依赖2D扩散模型生成一个或多个修复参考视图，易受多视图不一致和优化时间长的问题影响。
AI.method: 利用大规模预训练3D先验的嵌入空间，结合结构补全网络，将信息输入生成先验，从而在3D原生空间中重建缺失区域的几何与外观，无需2D修复参考视图。
AI.result: 在大量实验和用户研究中，该方法在定性和定量上均表现出有效性，并且比基于2D的相关方法更快。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个不依赖修复参考视图、在3D原生生成先验的学习表示空间中运行的高斯泼溅修复方法。

title: ByteTraX: Enhancing the ByteTrack Architecture with Optimised Thresholding
summary: The ByteTrack algorithm is a widely used and computationally efficient multi-object tracking architecture. Its core innovation lies in the combination of lenient bounding box associations with tracklet similarity matching to robustly deal with object occlusions. However, this strategy is nevertheless vulnerable to erroneous track reclassification and identity switching, as detection confidence scores dictate association priority. To address this, I present a simple enhancement of the ByteTrack architecture, named ByteTraX, that optimises track continuity via a single unified matching threshold, while penalising identity switches through stringent track initiation criteria. This approach achieves consistently improved performance across a range of diverse benchmarks including GMOT-40, LC-MOT, SportsMOT, TeamTrack, DAMUNT, and DeepSea-MOT, while simultaneously increasing processing speed by >10%. Specifically, results demonstrate a >40% reduction in identity switches, accompanied by mean increases in HOTA of 3.6, IDF1 of 5.6, and FPS of 6.3. As such, adoption of the ByteTraX algorithm has the potential to substantially enhance tracking performance over the ByteTrack baseline, while retaining the efficiency needed for real-time deployment. To facilitate usage, I provide the source code, integration functionality for the YOLO family of object detection models, and deployment instructions via an open source repository.

AI.tldr: 提出 ByteTraX，一种对 ByteTrack 的简单改进多目标跟踪算法，通过统一匹配阈值和严格轨迹初始化提升跟踪连续性并减少身份切换，在多个基准上性能与速度均优于 ByteTrack。
AI.motivation: ByteTrack 虽计算高效且能通过宽松框关联与轨迹相似度匹配应对遮挡，但其依赖检测置信度决定关联优先级，容易导致错误的轨迹重分类和身份切换。
AI.method: 在 ByteTrack 架构基础上进行增强：使用单一统一匹配阈值优化轨迹连续性，并通过严格的轨迹初始化标准惩罚身份切换；同时在 GMOT-40、LC-MOT、SportsMOT、TeamTrack、DAMUNT 和 DeepSea-MOT 等基准上评估，并提供源码、YOLO 系列集成与部署说明。
AI.result: 在多个多样化基准上取得一致改进，处理速度提升超过 10%；身份切换减少超过 40%，平均 HOTA 提升 3.6、IDF1 提升 5.6、FPS 提升 6.3。
AI.conclusion: ByteTraX 能在保持实时部署效率的同时，显著提升相对 ByteTrack 基线的跟踪性能，并具备实际应用与部署潜力。

title: Pixel-Level Transformers in Remote Sensing: A Canopy Height Case Study
summary: Predicting canopy height from medium-resolution satellite imagery is a common and scalable approach for assessing the condition of the world's forests, which play a crucial role in climate change mitigation. While Transformer-based architectures have shown strong performance in many domains, their straightforward application to dense (i.e., pixel-level) regression tasks often yields suboptimal results. In particular, the patch size has a crucial impact on the model performance. In this work, we consider pixel-level attention schemes and show that the resulting models generally outperform those relying on larger patch sizes. However, pixel-level attention can be a prohibitively resource-intensive operation. For this reason, we conduct an extensive experimental study using efficient attention variants to identify favorable trade-offs between prediction quality and resource requirements, facilitating the practical deployment of the proposed models. In addition, we perform a comprehensive comparison with several well-established models in the field and show that, with suitable hyperparameter choices, Transformer-based architectures can outperform competing approaches. Our findings provide practical guidance for designing models for pixel-level regression tasks on medium-resolution satellite imagery, including canopy height and biomass estimation, soil moisture mapping, and yield forecasting.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何从中分辨率卫星影像预测冠层高度，重点探讨 Transformer 在像素级稠密回归任务中的注意力机制与 patch 大小影响，并评估高效注意力变体在精度与资源消耗之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 全球森林对缓解气候变化至关重要，而从卫星影像可扩展地预测冠层高度是评估森林状况的重要方法。Transformer 在许多领域表现优异，但直接用于像素级回归任务效果常不理想，尤其 patch 大小会显著影响性能。
AI.method: 作者研究了像素级注意力方案，并系统实验比较不同 patch 大小与高效注意力变体，以分析预测质量与资源需求之间的折中；同时与领域内多种成熟模型进行综合对比。
AI.result: 像素级注意力模型通常优于依赖较大 patch 的模型；但像素级注意力资源消耗很高。通过采用高效注意力变体并合理选择超参数，基于 Transformer 的架构可以超过竞争方法。
AI.conclusion: 研究为在中分辨率卫星影像上设计像素级回归模型提供了实践指导，可应用于冠层高度与生物量估计、土壤湿度制图以及产量预测等任务。

title: KV-Kaizen: Learning Context-Adaptive Cache Compression Choices
summary: As the context size of text processed with an LLM grows, the size of KV caches can outstrip the memory allocated for the original model weights. This impacts LLM throughput negatively, since decoding is memory-bound and decode cost grows with cache size. Recent work alleviates this bottleneck by discarding the least relevant tokens. Eviction introduces a tension, since a one-off decision to discard content may prove detrimental later. Instead, we focus on alternative choices that can lead to cache compression without evicting tokens. We achieve this by learning a selector that is able to produce, based on context, a per-layer cache configuration towards an overall compression budget. The selector operates along three axes: sharing one cache across layers (depth), caching at fewer bits (precision), or truncating the low-rank latent cache representations (rank). We call the resulting method KV-Kaizen, for the many small per-layer choices it compounds. We observe that these interventions taken independently and uniformly over all layers limit achievable compression because they degrade accuracy. Crucially, composing them locally and adaptively to the context can instead preserve accuracy while achieving large memory savings. At inference, the selector runs once, before pre-fill. In evaluations on instruction following and reasoning tasks, our selectors reach the Pareto frontier of accuracy against cache size, against learning-free and post-hoc baselines. On long-context tasks, KV-Kaizen improves on eviction and can be composed with it, reaching a 32x smaller decode-time cache on a 14B model while preserving accuracy. A 4x cache size reduction incurs no accuracy degradation from 7B parameters up, and a compressed model is more accurate than a smaller uncompressed one with the same cache size. Together, these findings support pre-training large models and compressing them only afterwards.

AI.tldr: 提出 KV-Kaizen，通过学习一个上下文感知的选择器，在每层自适应地组合跨层共享、低精度量化和低秩截断，从而在不丢弃 token 的情况下压缩 KV cache，显著降低长上下文解码内存并保持精度。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 上下文变长，KV cache 可能超过模型权重内存，且解码是内存受限的，cache 越大会拖慢吞吐。现有通过丢弃最不相关 token 的淘汰方法存在一次性决策可能损害后续生成的矛盾，因此需要不依赖 token 淘汰的 cache 压缩方案。
AI.method: 训练一个选择器，在推理前、pre-fill 前运行一次，根据上下文为每层生成 cache 配置，并满足整体压缩预算。选择器沿三个轴操作：深度上跨层共享 cache、精度上用更少比特缓存、秩上截断低秩潜在 cache 表示；关键是将这些局部、自适应的选择组合起来，而非统一作用于所有层。
AI.result: 在指令遵循和推理任务上，选择器达到精度与 cache 大小之间的 Pareto 前沿，优于免学习和事后基线。在长上下文任务上，KV-Kaizen 优于淘汰方法且可与之组合，在 14B 模型上实现 32 倍更小的解码时 cache 并保持精度；从 7B 参数起，4 倍 cache 缩小不带来精度下降；相同 cache 大小下，压缩模型比更小的未压缩模型更准确。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，应预训练大模型，之后再对其进行压缩；KV-Kaizen 说明不淘汰 token、通过逐层自适应组合多种压缩方式，可以在大幅节省内存的同时保持甚至提升精度。

title: CHOQOLATE: Organizing Concept Bottleneck Latent Spaces with Choquet Integrals
summary: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) built on vision-language models such as CLIP represent a latent space as human-understandable concepts.
