Collective visual experience distillation (CVED) organizes these observations with their interaction context and aligns them with individual decisions, while heterogeneity-aware policy improvement (HAPI) reinforces successful trajectories and provides experience-guided distillation for unsuccessful attempts. An experience-conditioned teacher evaluates the student's sampled response prefixes, allowing discoveries from one trajectory to guide learning in another without replacing the student's original history or generating new target trajectories. The trained agent retains its visual tools and acts using its own interaction history. VISTA achieves the strongest average performance among the evaluated active multimodal agents of comparable size and consistently outperforms same-backbone training baselines across fine-grained perception and general reasoning tasks, demonstrating the value of collective experience for active multimodal learning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VISTA，通过同输入多轨迹的集体视觉经验蒸馏提升主动多模态智能体，在多项任务上取得最佳平均表现。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习虽为每个输入采样多条交互轨迹，但基于结果的目标主要只用组内信息估计标量优势，导致互补的视觉发现未被充分利用。
AI.method: VISTA 采用在策略蒸馏，将同输入 rollout 的观察转化为共享监督。其包含集体视觉经验蒸馏（CVED），用于组织观察及其交互上下文并对齐个体决策；以及异质性感知策略改进（HAPI），用于强化成功轨迹并为失败尝试提供经验引导蒸馏。经验条件教师评估学生采样响应前缀，使一条轨迹的发现能指导另一条轨迹学习，同时不替换学生原始历史或生成新目标轨迹。训练后智能体仍保留视觉工具并依赖自身交互历史行动。
AI.result: 在同类规模的主动多模态智能体中，VISTA 取得最强平均性能，并在细粒度感知和通用推理任务上持续优于同骨干训练基线。
AI.conclusion: 集体经验对主动多模态学习具有重要价值，VISTA 能有效内化跨轨迹视觉发现并提升智能体表现。

title: HelixWorld: A Real-time Interactive Audio-Visual World Model
summary: World simulation is inherently multisensory, demanding synchronized visual and acoustic dynamics in real time. Yet prevailing interactive world models remain strictly silent, focusing exclusively on visual rendering and control while overlooking the acoustic dimension. We present HelixWorld, a real-time interactive audio-visual world model where visual scenes and camera-grounded spatial stereo sound co-evolve natively under user interaction. We curate a high-fidelity spatial audio-visual dataset with true stereo acoustics and metric camera poses, upon which we pre-train a bidirectional teacher conditioned on 6-DoF camera trajectories and user actions. To enable low-latency causal interaction, we distill the teacher into a few-step streaming student via an online trajectory distillation loss, sustaining drift-free joint audio-visual rollouts at 24 FPS on a single GPU. Furthermore, we formalize spatial-acoustic consistency and introduce HelixBench to evaluate whether synthesized sound fields faithfully track dynamic viewpoint motion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HelixWorld matches state-of-the-art silent world models in visual fidelity and responsiveness, while significantly surpassing existing baselines in camera-aligned spatial-acoustic immersion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HelixWorld，一个实时交互式视听世界模型，使视觉场景与相机空间立体声在用户交互下原生同步演化，并实现单 GPU 上 24 FPS 的无漂移联合生成。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式世界模型大多只关注视觉渲染与控制，忽略声音维度；然而真实世界模拟本质上是多感官的，需要实时同步的视觉与声学动态。
AI.method: 构建高保真空间视听数据集，包含真实立体声与带尺度相机姿态；预训练一个以 6-DoF 相机轨迹和用户动作为条件的双向教师模型；通过在线轨迹蒸馏损失将教师蒸馏为少步流式学生模型，实现低延迟因果交互；形式化空间声学一致性并提出 HelixBench 评测合成声场是否随动态视角运动。
AI.result: HelixWorld 在视觉保真度和响应性上匹配最先进的无声世界模型，并在相机对齐的空间声学沉浸感上显著超越现有基线；可在单 GPU 上以 24 FPS 进行无漂移的联合视听 rollout。
AI.conclusion: HelixWorld 将声音维度原生引入实时交互式世界模型，实现了视觉与空间立体声的同步演化，并通过 HelixBench 推动空间声学一致性评测，为多感官世界模拟提供了有效方案。

title: VideoLoop: Looped Working Memory Against Semantic Thrashing in Long-Form Video Agents
summary: Long-form video understanding requires multimodal agents to iteratively gather evidence over many reasoning steps. However, most existing agentic methods suffer from semantic thrashing: as append-only working memory grows, attention to key evidence collapses, and the agent loses access to what it has already found. First, we provide a structural argument showing that append-only memory can incorporate newly observed target evidence, but cannot remove accumulated noise or prevent ordered context growth without a rewrite operator. Second, motivated by this analysis, we propose VideoLoop, a multimodal agent with two coupled loops. The outer loop reasons over the video and the inner loop, after each step, retrieves artifacts from an unbounded filesystem of past observations and intermediate analysis, and rewrites a bounded working memory. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of VideoLoop, which improves four popular LVLM backbones in a plug-and-play manner, with an average gain of 4.2% points over baseline on VideoMME (long). Further analysis of working memory suggests that VideoLoop mitigates semantic thrashing: on the hardest quarter of VideoMME (long) questions, a blind judge that reads only the agent's context answers 81.1% correctly, versus 60.9% for the append-only agent. With Gemini 3.1 Pro, VideoLoop reaches 88.3% on VideoMME (long), 88.8% on VideoMMMU, and 80.9% on LongVideoBench (long).

AI.tldr: 本文针对长视频理解中多模态智能体因仅追加式记忆导致的语义抖动问题，提出 VideoLoop：一种带外层推理循环与内层记忆检索重写循环的双循环智能体，可即插即用地提升多个 LVLM 骨干的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有大多数智能体方法采用仅追加（append-only）的工作记忆，随着推理步骤增加，工作记忆不断增长，关键证据的注意力被稀释，噪声不断累积且无法删除，导致智能体逐渐丢失已发现的信息，即产生语义抖动（semantic thrashing）。
AI.method: 首先从结构上论证仅追加式记忆虽能纳入新观察到的目标证据，但在没有重写算子的情况下无法移除累积噪声或阻止有序上下文增长。基于此提出 VideoLoop，包含两个耦合循环：外层循环在视频上进行推理；内层循环在每一步之后从无界的过往观察与中间分析文件系统中检索相关产物，并重写有界的工作记忆。
AI.result: 大量实验表明 VideoLoop 以即插即用方式提升四个主流 LVLM 骨干，在 VideoMME（long）上平均比基线提升 4.2 个百分点。工作记忆分析显示其缓解了语义抖动：在 VideoMME（long）最难的四分之一问题上，仅阅读智能体上下文的盲判正确率为 81.1%，而仅追加式智能体为 60.9%。使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 时，VideoLoop 在 VideoMME（long）达到 88.3%，VideoMMMU 达 88.8%，LongVideoBench（long）达 80.9%。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入检索与重写机制维护有界工作记忆，VideoLoop 有效缓解了长视频理解中仅追加记忆带来的语义抖动问题，并显著提升了多模态智能体在多个长视频基准上的表现。

title: LIFT: Layout-In-Future Video Generation under Large Viewpoint Change via On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: We introduce LIFT, a unified image-to-video generation framework that complements camera control with Layout-In-FuTure control, enabling users to specify what should appear in a future view and where it should appear. This addresses a practical need in controllable video generation: given an initial image, users often care not only about how the camera moves, but also about what the scene should look like at key future moments, especially the final frame. Existing camera controls specify viewpoint trajectories, while text prompts provide only coarse semantic guidance; neither precisely determines the content and spatial layout of future views. This limitation becomes particularly pronounced under large viewpoint changes, where the camera reveals regions that are not visible in the first frame. LIFT therefore uses the last-frame layout as an explicit control signal for the desired future scene. Since learning from such sparse layout guidance is substantially more challenging than conditioning on dense per-frame layouts, we introduce on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) to transfer the control capability of a dense-layout teacher to a last-frame-layout student. We further curate LIFT-Vista, a dataset featuring large viewpoint changes with camera and temporally consistent layout annotations. Experiments show that LIFT improves video quality, future-layout controllability, and camera controllability over other methods.

AI.tldr: LIFT 是一个统一的图像到视频生成框架，通过“未来布局”（Layout-In-FuTure）控制来补充相机控制，让用户指定未来视图中应出现的内容及其位置。该方法引入在线自蒸馏（OPSD）技术，将密集布局教师模型的控制能力迁移到仅使用最后一帧布局的学生模型，并构建了 LIFT-Vista 数据集。实验表明，LIFT 在视频质量、未来布局可控性和相机可控性上均优于其他方法。
AI.motivation: 在可控视频生成中，给定初始图像，用户不仅关心相机如何运动，还关心未来关键帧（尤其是最后一帧）的场景内容与空间布局。现有相机控制仅指定视点轨迹，文本提示只提供粗粒度语义指导，均无法精确决定未来视图的内容和空间布局；在大视角变化下，相机揭示首帧中不可见的区域，这一问题尤为突出。
AI.method: 提出 LIFT 框架，以最后一帧布局作为未来场景的显式控制信号。由于从稀疏布局引导中学习比基于密集逐帧布局的条件生成更具挑战性，引入在线自蒸馏（OPSD），将密集布局教师模型的控制能力迁移到最后一帧布局学生模型。同时构建 LIFT-Vista 数据集，包含大视角变化以及相机和时间一致的布局标注。
AI.result: 实验表明，LIFT 在视频质量、未来布局可控性和相机可控性方面均优于其他方法。
AI.conclusion: LIFT 通过最后一帧布局控制和在线自蒸馏，有效解决了大视角变化下未来视图内容与布局难以精确控制的问题，实现了更高质量、更可控的图像到视频生成。

title: FracGen: Learning How Objects Stretch and Tear with Physics-Informed Video Generation
summary: We introduce FracGen, a fracture-aware video generation model that produces plausible, controllable fracture dynamics from a single image of an intact object, conditioned on physics signals. To train FracGen, we build FracSim, a fracture-aware simulation framework that augments material point method (MPM) simulation with a continuum damage model, producing paired fracture videos and dense, pixel-aligned physical fields at no additional cost beyond standard rendering. FracGen leverages these maps in two ways: it is trained to jointly predict them alongside RGB video, encouraging the model to capture physical state rather than surface appearance; and it is supervised with physics-informed losses that encourage consistency among the predicted maps. As a result, FracGen captures distinct material-specific fracture behavior without expensive test-time simulation or per-scene tuning, while offering fine-grained control over where an object tears, how fast the crack propagates, and how much deformation precedes failure. We further introduce a benchmark for evaluating the physical plausibility of generated fracture video, and show through extensive experiments that FracGen outperforms existing video generation baselines in both physical and visual fidelity. Results are best viewed in our project website: https://fracgen.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出FracGen，一种从单张完整物体图像生成可控断裂动力学视频的模型，并构建FracSim仿真框架与评估基准。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成方法难以生成物理上合理、可控的断裂效果，且缺少物理信号条件与细粒度控制能力。
AI.method: 构建FracSim：在物质点法（MPM）中引入连续损伤模型，低成本生成成对断裂视频与像素对齐物理场。FracGen联合预测RGB视频与物理场，并施加物理信息损失以保持预测图一致性，实现材料特异的断裂行为与裂缝位置、扩展速度、变形量控制。
AI.result: 无需测试时仿真或逐场景调参即可生成材料特异的断裂行为；提出断裂视频物理合理性评估基准；实验表明FracGen在物理与视觉保真度上优于现有视频生成基线。
AI.conclusion: FracGen能生成物理合理、可控的断裂视频，验证了联合物理场预测与物理信息监督的有效性。

title: CLeaR: A Unified Framework for Resolving the Leakage-Degradation Dilemma in Style Transfer
summary: Style transfer aims to render target content in the style of a reference image, but existing methods often suffer from content leakage, where objects, layouts, or semantics from the style reference appear in the generated output. Although prior data-driven and training-free methods can reduce leakage, they often face a leakage-degradation dilemma: stronger content suppression may weaken style fidelity, while richer style preservation may reintroduce unwanted reference content. We identify this dilemma across the full style-transfer pipeline, including feature separation, feature-space grounding, and diffusion generation. To address these issues, we propose CLeaR, a training-free framework for content-leakage-resistant style transfer. CLeaR first uses Orthogonal Subspace Projection to define content-reduced style targets in each vision foundation model (VFM) feature space. It then performs Ensemble Inversion, which optimizes a shared pixel-space style anchor satisfying style constraints across multiple VFMs. Finally, Energy-Guided Calibration maintains style alignment during diffusion sampling by steering the denoising trajectory toward the ensemble-defined style manifold. We further provide a theoretical analysis showing that the style-anchor estimation error decreases with the number of VFMs. Experiments on StyleBench demonstrate that CLeaR improves style alignment, reduces content leakage, and achieves better LLM-as-Judge evaluation compared with existing methods. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/0606zt/CLeaR}{https://github.com/0606zt/CLeaR}.

AI.tldr: 该论文关注风格迁移中的内容泄漏问题，提出免训练框架CLeaR，通过正交子空间投影、集成反演和能量引导校准，在多个视觉基础模型特征空间中抑制参考图内容泄漏并保持风格保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有风格迁移方法常出现内容泄漏，即参考图中的物体、布局或语义进入生成结果。虽然已有方法能减轻泄漏，但存在“泄漏-退化困境”：更强的内容抑制会削弱风格保真度，而更强的风格保持又会重新引入参考内容。作者在特征分离、特征空间 grounding 和扩散生成全流程中识别到这一矛盾。
AI.method: 提出CLeaR，一种免训练的内容抗泄漏风格迁移框架。首先使用正交子空间投影（Orthogonal Subspace Projection）在各视觉基础模型（VFM）特征空间中定义内容减少的风格目标；然后执行集成反演（Ensemble Inversion），优化一个共享的像素空间风格锚点，使其满足多个VFM上的风格约束；最后采用能量引导校准（Energy-Guided Calibration），在扩散采样中通过将去噪轨迹导向集成定义的风格流形来保持风格对齐。作者还提供了理论分析，表明风格锚点估计误差随VFM数量增加而降低。
AI.result: 在StyleBench上的实验表明，CLeaR相比现有方法提升了风格对齐、减少了内容泄漏，并在LLM-as-Judge评估中取得更好表现。
AI.conclusion: CLeaR通过多视觉基础模型集成与扩散采样引导，有效缓解风格迁移中的内容泄漏与风格退化矛盾，实现更高质量的风格迁移，且无需训练。代码已开源。

title: PowerSim: Differentiable Physics Simulation and Rendering with Power Diagrams
summary: We introduce PowerSim, a method to bring physically grounded, differentiable dynamics to PowerFoam's power diagram based 3D representation. PowerSim directly couples a pre-trained PowerFoam scene to the Material Point Method (MPM) by exploiting a natural alignment between the two: the geometric and appearance properties of each primitive correspond closely to the quantities MPM already tracks as an object deforms. Consequently, simulated motion can drive the scene's geometry and appearance directly, without an auxiliary representation in between. Built on this framework, we enable a range of applications on real and synthetic scenes: (1) simulating a static scene under user interaction, (2) recovering spatially varying material fields, (3) compositing primitives from independently captured scenes into a single simulation-ready scene and (4) ray-tracing reflections that update consistently as the object deforms. Our results suggest that PowerSim excels over previous frameworks for physically grounded dynamics, while unlocking unique advantages-such as secondary ray lighting effects on dynamic scenes. Results are best viewed on our project website: https://power-sim.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出 PowerSim，将物理驱动、可微的动力学引入基于幂图的 3D 表示 PowerFoam，并直接与 Material Point Method (MPM) 耦合，从而支持交互仿真、材质恢复、场景合成与动态反射等应用。
AI.motivation: 现有物理仿真与基于基元的 3D 表示之间通常需要额外中间表示，难以直接利用表示自身的几何与外观属性进行可微动力学仿真，因此作者希望将 PowerFoam 与 MPM 自然对齐并直接耦合。
AI.method: 利用 PowerFoam 中每个基元的几何和外观属性与 MPM 在形变过程中追踪的量高度对应这一特点，将预训练的 PowerFoam 场景直接耦合到 MPM，使仿真运动可直接驱动物体的几何与外观，无需辅助表示。
AI.result: 在真实和合成场景上实现了四类应用：交互式静态场景仿真、空间变化材质场恢复、将独立捕获场景的基元合成为可仿真场景，以及随物体形变一致更新的光线追踪反射；结果表明 PowerSim 优于已有物理驱动动力学框架，并支持动态场景的二次光线光照效果等独特优势。
AI.conclusion: PowerSim 表明直接耦合 PowerFoam 与 MPM 是一种有效的物理 grounded 可微动力学方案，能够扩展基于幂图的 3D 表示的应用范围，并在动态场景中实现一致的渲染与反射效果。

title: LongLive-Plug: Once-for-All Distillation for Video Generation
comment: Code and models are available at https://github.com/NVlabs/LongLive
summary: Video diffusion models are increasingly developed into specialized models for diverse downstream tasks, and this development often includes a distillation stage, for example to accelerate sampling or to improve long-video generation. This stage is typically repeated for every specialized model. We introduce LongLive-Plug, a once-for-all distillation framework that learns reusable capabilities as LoRAs on a base model for training-free, plug-and-play deployment to compatible downstream models. These capabilities include single-pass classifier-free guidance, few-step sampling, and long-context error correction for autoregressive generation. The adapters remain reusable even when downstream models add conditioning branches, expand output channels. Despite training at a fixed guidance scale, our dedicated CFG LoRA provides text guidance control through its inference weight. Combining it with a few-step LoRA simultaneously preserves few-step generation and CFG controllability on downstream tasks. We verify training-free deployment on 54 downstream models across three backbone families and eight task categories, including world modeling, robotics, editing, and multimodal generation. The approach may support additional compatible models. Each capability can thus be distilled once per backbone family and reused without per-target retraining.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LongLive-Plug，一种一次性蒸馏框架，将可复用能力学习为基座模型上的 LoRA，可无需训练地即插即用到兼容的下游视频扩散模型。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型日益专门化，但每个专用模型通常都要单独进行蒸馏（如加速采样或改进长视频生成），导致重复训练成本高。
AI.method: 在基座模型上以 LoRA 形式一次性学习可复用能力，包括单次分类器无引导（CFG）、少步采样和自回归生成的长上下文纠错；适配器在下游模型增加条件分支或扩展输出通道时仍可复用。专用 CFG LoRA 可通过推理权重控制文本引导，即使训练时固定引导尺度；与少步 LoRA 结合可同时保持少步生成与 CFG 可控性。
AI.result: 在 3 个骨干家族、8 类任务（含世界建模、机器人、编辑和多模态生成）的 54 个下游模型上验证了无需训练的部署；该方法可能支持更多兼容模型。
AI.conclusion: 每种能力只需在每个骨干家族上蒸馏一次，即可复用，无需针对每个目标模型重新训练。

title: Cropland PAtteRNS: Parallel Dimensional Attention Networks and Attention to Dataset Disparity for Crop Segmentation in Satellite Imagery Time Series Data
comment: Main body: 19 pages, 7 figures; Appendices: 15 pages, 16 figures. All code and models associated with this work are available at https://github.com/JoeMetc/CroplandPAtteRNS , along with preparation guides for the two publicly available crop segmentation datasets used in this work
summary: The landscape of satellite imagery time series datasets and boundary-pushing architectures for cropland segmentation has never been richer. However, in this gold rush, important truths are being missed on both fronts, as a drive for the most novel concepts or the largest datasets pushes finer details to the side. In this paper, we present our hybrid transformer-convolutional model, Cropland Parallel Attention and Refinement Network for Segmentation (PAtteRNS), the first model to use self-attention mechanisms separately for each of the temporal, spectral, and spatial aspects of Sentinel-2 multispectral SITS data. To achieve fully-factorised attention in our proposed model, we introduce a novel parallel transformer architecture which significantly reduces the computational complexity of triple-factorised self-attention. We validate our architecture with an in-depth ablation study, and analyse the performance of our model against state-of-the-art crop segmentation models on multiple tile-size variants of the popular PASTIS and MTLCC datasets. Our findings show our model to outperform all others in the task of crop class segmentation, verified across multiple important segmentation metrics, with especially strong performance against compared models seen in the often under-reported parcel delineation quality, for which we use the Boundary IoU metric. We also find that flawed class groupings within datasets can have a significant negative impact on model performance, and report that alternate tile-size variants of crop segmentation datasets produce results incomparable to one-another, invalidating fair comparison between model performance when trained on different tile-sizes. Based on these findings, we suggest further work is required to standardise best practices when constructing SITS crop segmentation datasets, and to enable future dynamic-tile-sizing for ideal model performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合Transformer-卷积模型PAtteRNS，首次针对Sentinel-2多光谱SITS数据的时间、光谱和空间维度分别使用自注意力，并在PASTIS和MTLCC数据集上验证其作物分割性能。
AI.motivation: 当前卫星影像时间序列数据集和作物分割架构快速发展，但过度追求新颖架构或大规模数据集，导致细节问题被忽视，例如地块边界质量和数据集标准化不足。
AI.method: 提出PAtteRNS模型，采用并行Transformer架构实现时间、光谱、空间三方面完全因子化自注意力，降低三因子自注意力计算复杂度；通过消融实验验证，并在PASTIS和MTLCC多个瓦片尺寸变体上与SOTA作物分割模型比较，使用包括Boundary IoU在内的多种分割指标。
AI.result: PAtteRNS在作物类别分割上优于所有对比模型，尤其在常被忽视的地块边界划分质量（Boundary IoU）上表现突出；同时发现数据集中的错误类别分组会显著负面影响模型性能，不同瓦片尺寸变体结果不可直接比较，从而影响公平评估。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调需要标准化SITS作物分割数据集的构建最佳实践，并推动未来采用动态瓦片尺寸以实现理想模型性能。

title: DMA$^2$: Pixel-space Distribution Matching with Adversarial and Anchor Losses
summary: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) provides a general framework for few-step diffusion generation, but its modern text-to-image instantiations have been developed primarily around latent diffusion. It therefore overlooks key properties and design opportunities of native RGB. We revisit two DMD interfaces for pixel-space teachers. On the teacher-matching side, diagnostics show low-noise RGB matching is dominated by a local-texture cue, motivating a fixed high-noise matching band. On the real-data side, native clean-RGB outputs allow guidance from an external visual representation without traversing a decoder or sharing the heavy fake-score critic. DINO-Adv removes this critic from the adversarial gradient path and supplies local parametric patch guidance. For distribution-level guidance, we introduce AF-Loss, a parameter-free auxiliary semantic distribution-field objective designed for text-to-image DMD. It operates on detached rolling real and generated supports in the shared DINOv2 space while preserving prompt-conditioned teacher supervision. AF-Loss adds no learnable parameters or inference-time computation. Together these designs form DMA$^2$. Across DPG-Bench, GenEval, VQAScore, and COCO30K, the four-step DMA$^2$ student performs better than the 25-step teacher and evaluated few-step distillers.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对现有文本到图像扩散蒸馏主要基于潜空间扩散、忽略原生RGB特性与设计机会的问题，重新审视像素空间教师的DMD接口，提出DMA^2方法，使四步学生模型在多个基准上超越25步教师模型及现有少步蒸馏方法。
AI.motivation: 现代文本到图像DMD实例主要围绕潜空间扩散开发，忽略了原生RGB的关键属性与设计机会，因此有必要重新审视像素空间教师的DMD接口并挖掘其潜力。
AI.method: 重新审视像素空间教师的两个DMD接口：在教师匹配侧，诊断发现低噪声RGB匹配由局部纹理线索主导，故采用固定高噪声匹配带；在真实数据侧，原生干净RGB输出允许外部视觉表示引导，无需解码器或共享繁重的假评分评论器。提出DINO-Adv，从对抗梯度路径中移除评论器并提供局部参数化块引导；提出AF-Loss，一种无参数辅助语义分布场目标，在共享DINOv2空间中对分离的滚动真实与生成支持集操作，同时保留提示条件教师监督。二者共同构成DMA^2，不增加可学习参数或推理计算。
AI.result: 在DPG-Bench、GenEval、VQAScore和COCO30K上，四步DMA^2学生模型表现优于25步教师模型及所评估的少步蒸馏器。
AI.conclusion: 通过为像素空间教师重新设计DMD接口，DMA^2实现了高效且高质量的少步文本到图像生成，验证了原生RGB空间在扩散蒸馏中的优势。

title: Point2Part: Unified 3D Partitioning from Point Prompts
summary: Existing 3D part decomposition methods do not necessarily partition the original shape into non-overlapping parts that collectively cover the entire shape, allowing overlaps or gaps that hinder downstream part-level applications. We instead formulate part decomposition as a joint partitioning of the entire shape, where the predicted parts are non-overlapping and jointly recover the entire shape. Our key insight is that part decomposition should consider all desired parts jointly, rather than modeling each part independently. To this end, we develop a promptable model for 3D part decomposition from images or meshes. Users can specify desired parts through 3D point prompts for controllable decomposition. Given one point prompt per desired part, our model produces the corresponding parts as a complete partition of the entire shape. We build on a pretrained 3D generation model and first obtain a shape latent from either an input image or mesh. We then introduce a prompt encoder that maps each 3D point prompt to a part token while attending to the shape latent. To decode the desired parts, we propose a novel part decoder jointly scoring the entire shape against all part tokens in a coarse-to-fine manner, assigning every position within the shape volume to exactly one part. We perform part decomposition in this shared shape latent space, enabling a unified model for image-to-part generation, mesh-to-part generation, and part segmentation. Our method outperforms existing works on all part-quality metrics across all three tasks, and improves compatibility among parts by an order of magnitude over previous SOTA methods. Code and models will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可提示的3D部件分解模型，将形状分解建模为对所有部件进行联合划分，使预测部件互不重叠且完整覆盖整个形状，支持图像或网格输入，并通过3D点提示控制分解。
AI.motivation: 现有3D部件分解方法不一定将原始形状划分为互不重叠且完整覆盖的部件，产生的重叠或空隙会阻碍下游部件级应用。作者认为部件分解应联合考虑所有目标部件，而非独立建模每个部件。
AI.method: 构建基于预训练3D生成模型的可提示模型：先从图像或网格获得形状隐码；引入提示编码器，将每个3D点提示映射为部件token并关注形状隐码；提出新型部件解码器，在粗到细的方式下联合将所有部件token与整个形状进行评分，把形状体积内每个位置恰好分配给一个部件；在共享形状隐空间中完成分解，统一支持图像到部件生成、网格到部件生成和部件分割。
AI.result: 在所有三个任务上，该方法在全部部件质量指标上均优于现有工作，并将部件间兼容性较此前SOTA方法提升一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 联合划分所有部件的建模范式有效实现了非重叠且完整覆盖的3D部件分解，代码和模型将开源。

title: Adversarial Training for Pixel Diffusion
summary: Pixel diffusion models generate RGB images directly, avoiding the bottleneck of an autoencoder, yet their outputs still systematically underrepresent fine-scale natural-image statistics. We show that adversarial learning provides an effective post-training correction for this deficiency. Starting from a pretrained model, we retain its original diffusion or flow-matching objective and add an adversarial loss to the predicted output at non-high-noise timesteps, leaving the model architecture and sampling procedure unchanged. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of adversarial post-training for pixel diffusion. Across two pixel backbones, the method jointly improves distribution fidelity, coverage, prompt alignment, and perceptual quality. We further investigate why it works. Frequency-band and power-law analyses show that the original models systematically underproduce natural-image high-frequency content, while adversarial post-training restores this missing spectral power. In contrast, perceptual loss also increases high-frequency content but sacrifices distribution fidelity and prompt alignment. Nearest-neighbor, recall, and matched no-GAN SFT controls further rule out memorization, mode dropping, and additional optimization as simple explanations. Finally, we examine the boundary of this effect. Under the tested latent diffusion configurations, the same procedure does not produce comparable joint gains and adds almost no decoded high-frequency power. These results identify direct output access to the image statistics being corrected as a key factor governing when adversarial post-training succeeds.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究像素扩散模型的对抗式后训练，发现在保留原有扩散或流匹配目标、仅对非高噪声时间步的预测输出加入对抗损失后，可显著改善生成质量并恢复缺失的高频自然图像统计。
AI.motivation: 像素扩散模型直接生成RGB图像，避免了自编码器瓶颈，但其输出仍系统性地低估自然图像的细尺度统计特征。作者希望找到有效的后训练校正方法，并理解其作用机制与适用边界。
AI.method: 从预训练模型出发，保留原始扩散或流匹配目标，在非高噪声时间步对预测输出加入对抗损失，不改变模型架构和采样过程。通过频带与幂律分析、感知损失对比、最近邻/召回/无GAN的SFT控制实验，并在潜在扩散配置下测试相同流程。
AI.result: 在两个像素骨干网络上，该方法同时提升分布保真度、覆盖度、提示对齐和感知质量。分析表明原始模型系统性缺少自然图像高频内容，对抗式后训练能恢复缺失的谱功率；感知损失虽也增加高频，但牺牲分布保真度和提示对齐。控制实验排除了记忆、模式丢弃和额外优化等解释。在测试的潜在扩散配置下，相同流程未带来可比联合增益，且几乎未增加解码后的高频功率。
AI.conclusion: 对抗式后训练能有效校正像素扩散模型的细尺度统计缺陷，而能否直接访问待校正的图像统计量，是决定该方法成功与否的关键因素。

title: PrototypeNAS: Rapid Design of Deep Neural Networks for Microcontroller Units
comment: Accepted at ECML-PKDD 2026. 18 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. This work was funded by the European Commission as part of the MANOLO project under the Horizon Europe programme Grant Agreement No.101135782
summary: Enabling efficient deep neural network (DNN) inference on edge devices with different hardware constraints is a challenging task that typically requires DNN architectures to be specialized for each device separately. To avoid the huge manual effort, one can use neural architecture search (NAS). However, many existing NAS methods are resource-intensive and time-consuming because they require the training of many different DNNs from scratch. Furthermore, they do not take the resource constraints of the target system into account. To address these shortcomings, we propose PrototypeNAS, a zero-shot NAS method to accelerate and automate the selection, compression, and specialization of DNNs to different target microcontroller units (MCUs). We propose a novel three-step search method that decouples DNN design and specialization from DNN training for a given target platform. First, we present a novel search space that not only cuts out smaller DNNs from a single large architecture, but instead combines the structural optimization of multiple architecture types, as well as optimization of their pruning and quantization configurations. Second, we explore the use of an ensemble of zero-shot proxies during optimization instead of a single one. Third, we propose the use of Hypervolume subset selection to distill DNN architectures from the Pareto front of the multi-objective optimization that represent the most meaningful tradeoffs between accuracy and FLOPs. We evaluate the effectiveness of PrototypeNAS on 12 different datasets in three different tasks: image classification, time series classification, and object detection. Our results demonstrate that PrototypeNAS is able to identify DNN models within minutes that are small enough to be deployed on off-the-shelf MCUs and still achieve accuracies comparable to the performance of large DNN models.

AI.tldr: 提出 PrototypeNAS，一种零样本神经架构搜索方法，用于加速并自动化面向不同微控制器（MCU）的 DNN 选择、压缩与专用化，能在数分钟内找到适合部署且精度接近大型 DNN 的小型模型。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限的边缘设备上高效运行 DNN 通常需要为每种硬件单独设计架构，人工成本高；现有 NAS 方法往往需要从头训练大量 DNN，计算资源消耗大、耗时长，且未充分考虑目标系统的资源约束。
AI.method: PrototypeNAS 将 DNN 设计与专用化和训练解耦，采用三步搜索：1）设计新搜索空间，联合优化多种架构类型及其剪枝和量化配置；2）在优化中使用多个零样本代理组成的集成，而非单一代理；3）使用超体积子集选择，从多目标优化（精度与 FLOPs 权衡）的 Pareto 前沿中提取最具代表性的 DNN 架构。
AI.result: 在图像分类、时间序列分类和目标检测三类任务的 12 个数据集上评估，PrototypeNAS 能在数分钟内识别出足够小、可部署在现成 MCU 上的 DNN 模型，同时达到与大型 DNN 模型相当的精度。
AI.conclusion: PrototypeNAS 能有效加速并自动化面向不同 MCU 的 DNN 选择、压缩与专用化，在资源受限边缘设备上实现高效部署，并减少传统 NAS 的训练开销和人工成本。
